verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧·最上真言离言说，沙弥，心、心髓、根本心咒
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), ascetic, mendicant, heart, core essence, heart-mantra
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 伊𤚥吠室囉摩拏紇㗚乃野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，我递送、推进
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness & supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust, I send, impel, hurl, throw, raise , utter, proclaim
verses.tangNoteZh: 石经原刻悉昙对音：𑖨𑖿𑖝𑖿𑖝(rtta=㗚多) ｜ 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切众生·乐·御
verses.meaningEn: All sentient beings + joy + to transport
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三悉地、妙成就
verses.meaningEn: Siddhi, spiritual accomplishment/perfection again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness (imperative seal) again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 石经原刻悉昙对音：𑖦𑗜(mu=母) ｜ 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三妙行迁变空
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三行持妙道、周游救护（左啰）
verses.meaningEn: Move forth in compassionate activity! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三流注周遍、速行护念（萨啰）
verses.meaningEn: Flow forth and pervade with blessing! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三掌
verses.meaningEn: Palm again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三舒散光明、散布吉祥！（源自 √kṝ）
verses.meaningEn: Scatter rays of blessing! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三成办羯磨事业（俱噜）
verses.meaningEn: Accomplish & enact this sacred work! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三速疾摧碎烦恼结缚（亩噜）
verses.meaningEn: Swiftly dissolve karmic knots & obstacles! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 石经原刻悉昙对音：𑖦𑗜(mu=母) ｜ 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三速疾运转妙法加持（祖噜）

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 请成办、令速成就！义利、所求善愿、胜义，我之（行者所有）
verses.meaningEn: Accomplish! fulfill! perfect! meaning, benefit, aim, welfare, my, of me (the practitioner)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 常，钻，愿成、善住
verses.meaningEn: With constantly internal mind fixing your will on salvation, afflicting, injuring, destroying, be! become!
verses.tangNoteZh: 石经原刻悉昙对音：𑖡𑖰(ni=捏) · 𑖡𑖺(no=努) ｜ 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 18 · 三合 1 · 引 37 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 大、摩诃（广大无边），俱吠滥，尊胜降伏·法界总持任持

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！

verses.meaningZh: 再三弯曲、超群

verses.meaningZh: 再三迅疾度脱一切危厄（都噜）

verses.meaningZh: 再三一切诸谛圆满·六度满行清净·远离虚妄安立

verses.meaningZh: 摩尼宝珠（如意离垢宝），黄金、纯金光明

verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢

verses.tangNoteZh: 石经原刻悉昙对音：𑖜𑖿𑖚(ṇḍa=𠯆) ｜ 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 24 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 已解脱、自在无碍，归命，离一切相无相·支分寂静·造作离相

verses.meaningZh: 婆字门（破有相福德光（bhava

verses.meaningZh: 一切众生、普皆有情，口彩

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 24 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 定居者丈夫

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 24 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.tangNoteZh: 石经原刻悉昙对音：𑖟𑖸(de=𭰖) ｜ 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 24 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 破暗合集·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤

verses.tangNoteZh: 石经原刻悉昙对音：𑖑𑗜(ghu=具) ｜ 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 24 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三无我大慈三昧·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 24 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 禅智观照·施度调伏

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 24 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 施予，雪尊

verses.tangNoteZh: 石经原刻悉昙对音：𑖦(ma=末) ｜ 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 24 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 观照
verses.meaningEn: Darśanaṃ

verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy
verses.tangNoteZh: 石经原刻悉昙对音：𑖡𑖾(naḥ=諾) ｜ 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 24 · 弹舌 0

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 23 · 三合 0 · 引 24 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切智！

verses.meaningZh: 各个·烦恼·气习，我之（行者所有），诸一切众生、普皆有情之以及再三请摄取、遣除苦厄！再三桑请摄取
verses.meaningEn: Of different kinds + affliction + permeation, my, of me (the practitioner), of all all sentient beings and carry away (suffering)! remove! again and again, saṃ + carry away ! remove! again and again
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 麼薩嚩薩怛嚩難左賀囉賀囉僧賀囉僧賀囉度嚕徵度嚕徵摩賀𭦗拏羅迦

verses.iast: dhuruṭi dhuruṭi mahāmaṇḍalakaraṇa śataprasekāvabhāsa viṣanāśamaka mahābodhisattva varada svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 再三法界总持任持·清净离诸尘垢·断除憍慢执障，大·规格·烦恼，百·释放·普光明照，搅拌·自然·事业·忧苦，大菩提萨埵，施愿者、满善愿尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Dharma-realm retention & stainless purity free from dust & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation) again and again, great + disease which destroys a family + passion, hundred + flowing forth + splendor, stir + certainly + labour + not-joy, great + Bodhisattva, boon-granting, wish-bestowing, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: āryāvalokiteśvaro bodhisattvo gambhīrāṃ prajñāpāramitācaryāṃ caramāṇo vyavalokayati sma pañcaskandhāṃs tāṃś ca svabhāvaśūnyān paśyati sma
verses.meaningZh: 圣观自在菩萨，菩提萨埵，甚深、深妙难测，般若波罗蜜多所行，妙行流布·清净离诸尘垢，照见，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），诸五阴，彼等（连音式宾格复数）以及空虚，了知、聪明，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Noble Avalokiteśvara, bodhisattvo, profound, deep, unfathomable, Perfection of Wisdom + actions, practicing, to look down upon, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, five aggregates, them, those and emptiness, looking, knowing, intelligent, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 阿哩也嚩路枳帝濕嚩嚕冐地薩怛舞 ｜ 儼鼻㘕鉢囉枳孃播囉弭跢左哩演左囉麼喃弭也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 113 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: iha śāriputra rūpaṃ śūnyatā śūnyataiva rūpam
verses.meaningZh: 于此、今于此处，舍利子，色，空性、毕竟空寂，本性寂静止息·离名相假立·一乘如实之道，色
verses.meaningEn: Here, in this world/place, Sariputra, rūpaṃ, emptiness, voidness of inherent existence, primordial tranquil peace & beyond nominal designation & supreme vehicle of awakening, rūpam
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 嚩路迦野底娑麼半左塞建擔 ｜ 娑黨室者娑嚩婆嚩舜你焰 ｜ 鉢始也底娑麼
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 113 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: rūpān na pṛthak śūnyatā śūnyatāyā na pṛthag rūpam
verses.meaningZh: 色、妙色身，不、非、无，各，空性、毕竟空寂，空性即是，不、非、无，第一义谛·无住安立·妙行趣入，色
verses.meaningEn: Form, matter, sacred body, not, non-, every, emptiness, voidness of inherent existence, emptiness + thus, not, non-, ultimate truth & non-abiding equipoise & awakened spiritual movement, rūpam
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 伊賀舍哩補怛囉 ｜ 嚕𠰢戍你也哆 ｜ 戍你也帶嚩嚕𠰢
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 113 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: yad rūpaṃ sā śūnyatā yā śūnyatā tad rūpam
verses.meaningZh: 凡所…者，色，彼、彼圣母（阴性主格），空性、毕竟空寂，凡彼（阴性关系代词），空性、毕竟空寂，彼、如是真实，色
verses.meaningEn: Which, what, that which, rūpaṃ, she, that, emptiness, voidness of inherent existence, who, whichever (f.), emptiness, voidness of inherent existence, that, thus, rūpam
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 嚕𠰢曩畢哩籜忖你也哆 ｜ 秫你也哆夜曩畢哩他櫱嚕𠰢
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 113 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 如是（如《如是我闻》evam mayā śrutam），唯、正是、决定，受·想·行·一切圣智了别
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in this manner, indeed, verily, alone, sensation + perception + volitional formations + discerning consciousness
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 拽訥嚕𠰢娑舜你也哆 ｜ 戍你也帶嚩夜娑嚕𠰢 ｜ 醫嚩銘嚩

verses.meaningZh: 于此、今于此处，舍利子，诸诸法，空性相
verses.meaningEn: Here, in this world/place, Sariputra, all things, emptiness + mark
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 尾那曩僧枳孃僧娑迦囉尾枳孃曩𩕳 ｜ 舍哩補怛囉 ｜ 薩囉嚩達囉磨戍你也哆𠸪訖义拏

verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·真如实际·第一义谛，阿泥律陀
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness & ultimate truth, Aniruddha
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 阿努怛播曩 ｜ 阿寧𠷈䭾 ｜ 阿摩攞
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 113 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 无垢、离染清净，无无垢地
verses.meaningEn: Stainless, spotless, pure, non-nirmala
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 113 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 成就、充分，无诸圆满
verses.meaningEn: Not wanting, complete, full, non-filled or covered with , full, entire, complete, accomplished, attained (plural)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 三布囉拏 ｜ 怛娑每㻮你也哆野 ｜ 曩嚕𠰢

verses.iast: tasmāc chāriputra śūnyatāyāṃ na rūpaṃ na vedanā na saṃjñā na saṃskārāḥ na vijñānam
verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧，车·踊跃·子，于空性、毕竟空寂中，不、非、无，色，不、非、无，受（领纳苦乐受），不、非、无，想（取相认知），不、非、无，诸行（诸行造作），不、非、无，识
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness, cha + eager + son, in emptiness, voidness of inherent existence, not, non-, rūpaṃ, not, non-, sensation, feeling, not, non-, perception, conceptualization, not, non-, volitional formations, conditioned phenomena (plural), not, non-, vijñānam

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 113 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 不、非、无，妙行迁变空·造作离相·六度满行清净
verses.meaningEn: Not, non-, awakened conduct beyond flux & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās (vocative invocation)

verses.meaningZh: 不、非、无，色·声·香·味·触·诸正法
verses.meaningEn: Not, non-, form + sound + smell + the sap or juice of plants and fruits + contact + Dharma

verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 113 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 不、非、无，眼界，一乘如实之道·最上真言离言说·离名相假立，不、非、无，意识界
verses.meaningEn: Not, non-, cakṣurdhātur, supreme vehicle of awakening & supreme ineffable speech & beyond nominal designation, not, non-, manovijñānadhātuḥ
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩尾你也曩 ｜ 阿尾你也諾訖义喻 ｜ 夜嚩曩惹囉拏麼囉南
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 113 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: nāvidyā nāvidyākṣayo yāvan na jarāmaraṇaṃ na jarāmaraṇakṣayaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·最上真言离言说·施度调伏，离名相假立·最上真言离言说·施度调伏，一乘如实之道·最上真言离言说·离名相假立，不、非、无，老死，不、非、无，老死尽
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery, beyond nominal designation & supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery, supreme vehicle of awakening & supreme ineffable speech & beyond nominal designation, not, non-, jarāmaraṇaṃ, not, non-, old age and death + exhaustion
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩惹囉拏阿麼囉拏訖义藥 ｜ 曩耨佉三母曩曳𩕳嚕達囉摩𭋓誐 ｜ 曩枳孃曩納鉢囉鉢底

verses.meaningZh: 不、非、无，苦·集·灭谛·诸圣道
verses.meaningEn: Not, non-, suffering + origin + suppression + path
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 室左哆澁喯那鉢囉鉢底怛鍐 ｜ 胃地薩怛嚩 ｜ 鉢囉枳孃播囉弭哆沫室隸底也尾賀攞底也唧哆阿嚩囉拏
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 113 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 不、非、无，圣智、无漏真智，不、非、无，到何处，脐时
verses.meaningEn: Not, non-, primordial wisdom, gnosis (Jñāna), not, non-, prāptir, the navel or any navel-like cavity
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 唧哆阿嚩囉拏 ｜ 曩悉底怛嚩阿怛囉薩哆
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 113 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: tasmād aprāptitvād bodhisattvasya prajñāpāramitām āśritya viharaty acittāvaraṇaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情）之，般若波罗蜜多（智慧度彼岸），本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，最上真言离言说·因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢，非心障蔽
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, of Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, Perfection of Wisdom (Prajñāpāramitā), primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, supreme ineffable speech & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust, without thought + obscuration
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 尾鉢哩也娑底訖㘓跢 ｜ 涅哩瑟吒你哩嚩拏 ｜ 底哩也特嚩曩嚩悉體哆薩囉嚩沒䭾
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 113 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 妙行迁变空·真如实际·最上真言离言说，无有恐怖，颠倒古昔，超绝涅槃
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech, having no fear, delusion, excelling + Nirvāṇa
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 鉢囉枳孃播囉弭跢沫室哩底也 ｜ 阿耨哆囉三藐三沒地麼鼻糝沒䭾 ｜ 怛薩麼枳孃怛尾焰鉢囉枳孃播囉弭跢
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 113 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: tryadhvavyavasthitāḥ sarvabuddhāḥ prajñāpāramitām āśrityānuttarāṃ samyaksaṃbodhim abhisaṃbuddhāḥ
verses.meaningZh: 三世诸不是连词，一切诸佛，般若波罗蜜多（智慧度彼岸），本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，三耶三佛，诸最正觉
verses.meaningEn: Of the three times + separated, all + all Buddhas, Perfection of Wisdom (Prajñāpāramitā), primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, unsurpassed complete perfect enlightenment, supreme perfect enlightenment (plural)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩賀滿咄嚕 ｜ 摩賀尾你也滿怛囉 ｜ 阿耨哆囉滿怛囉
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 113 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: tasmāj jñātavyaṃ prajñāpāramitā mahāmantro mahāvidyāmantro nuttaramantro samasamamantraḥ
verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧，觉知勇健，般若波罗蜜多（智慧度彼岸），贡高大方颤动，大明咒真言，离名相假立·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，比较平等真言
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness, know + strong, Perfection of Wisdom (Prajñāpāramitā), high-minded + tremble, Mahāvidyā + Mantra, beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust, quite equal + Mantra
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 阿三麼三麼滿怛𫬠 ｜ 薩囉嚩耨欠鉢囉舍麼曩
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 113 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: sarvaduḥkhapraśamanaḥ satyam amithyatvāt prajñāpāramitāyām ukto mantraḥ
verses.meaningZh: 一切·苦·疗，谛、真实不虚语，从不虚，于般若波罗蜜多（智慧度彼岸）中，曰，真言、密咒（护心密语）
verses.meaningEn: All + suffering + heal, truth, reality, veracity, from not false, in Perfection of Wisdom (Prajñāpāramitā), said, Mantra, sacred formula
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 娑底也蜜體拽 ｜ 怛嚩鉢囉枳孃播囉弭跢穆屈姤滿怛囉 ｜ 怛你也他
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 113 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 唵 ｜ 誐諦誐諦 ｜ 播囉誐諦
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 113 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: oṃ gate gate pāragate pārasaṃgate bodhi svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三度越吧、已往彼岸尊！度向彼岸吧、已达究竟彼岸！普同度至彼岸吧（圆证菩提）！菩提、无上正觉，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! gone, O One gone beyond! again and again, gone all the way to the other shore! gone completely altogether beyond! Bodhi, awakening, enlightenment, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 播囉僧誐諦 ｜ 冐地 ｜ 娑嚩賀
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 113 · 三合 0 · 引 11 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 般若波罗蜜多心经
verses.meaningEn: Prajñāpāramitā Heart Sūtra
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 鉢囉倪也鉢囉蜜多 ｜ 𠶹哩那野素怛囉 ｜ 阿哩也嚩路枳帝 ｜ 濕嚩嚕
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 108 · 三合 0 · 引 1 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: āryāvalokiteśvaro bodhisattvo gambhīrāṃ prajñāpāramitācaryāṃ caramāṇo vyavalokayati sma pañcaskandhāṃs tāṃś ca svabhāvaśūnyān paśyati sma
verses.meaningZh: 圣观自在菩萨，菩提萨埵，甚深、深妙难测，般若波罗蜜多所行，妙行流布·清净离诸尘垢，照见，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），诸五阴，彼等（连音式宾格复数）以及空虚，了知、聪明，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Noble Avalokiteśvara, bodhisattvo, profound, deep, unfathomable, Perfection of Wisdom + actions, practicing, to look down upon, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, five aggregates, them, those and emptiness, looking, knowing, intelligent, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 胃地薩怛舞 ｜ 儼鼻㘕 ｜ 鉢囉倪也播囉弭跢 ｜ 左哩演左囉麼耨尾也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 108 · 三合 0 · 引 1 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: iha śāriputra rūpaṃ śūnyatā śūnyataiva rūpam
verses.meaningZh: 于此、今于此处，舍利子，色，空性、毕竟空寂，本性寂静止息·离名相假立·一乘如实之道，色
verses.meaningEn: Here, in this world/place, Sariputra, rūpaṃ, emptiness, voidness of inherent existence, primordial tranquil peace & beyond nominal designation & supreme vehicle of awakening, rūpam
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 嚩嚕迦野 ｜ 底娑麼半左塞建跢 ｜ 娑跢室佐 ｜ 娑嚩婆嚩舜你焰
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 108 · 三合 0 · 引 1 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: rūpān na pṛthak śūnyatā śūnyatāyā na pṛthag rūpam
verses.meaningZh: 色、妙色身，不、非、无，各，空性、毕竟空寂，空性即是，不、非、无，第一义谛·无住安立·妙行趣入，色
verses.meaningEn: Form, matter, sacred body, not, non-, every, emptiness, voidness of inherent existence, emptiness + thus, not, non-, ultimate truth & non-abiding equipoise & awakened spiritual movement, rūpam
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 鉢始底娑麼 ｜ 伊賀舍哩補怛囉 ｜ 嚕𠰢戍你也跢 ｜ 戍你也帶嚩嚕𠰢
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 108 · 三合 0 · 引 1 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: yad rūpaṃ sā śūnyatā yā śūnyatā tad rūpam
verses.meaningZh: 凡所…者，色，彼、彼圣母（阴性主格），空性、毕竟空寂，凡彼（阴性关系代词），空性、毕竟空寂，彼、如是真实，色
verses.meaningEn: Which, what, that which, rūpaṃ, she, that, emptiness, voidness of inherent existence, who, whichever (f.), emptiness, voidness of inherent existence, that, thus, rūpam
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 嚕𠰢拏必哩跢 ｜ 戍你也跢咩 ｜ 拏必哩跢櫱嚕𠰢 ｜ 拽訥嚕伴
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 108 · 三合 0 · 引 1 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 如是（如《如是我闻》evam mayā śrutam），唯、正是、决定，受·想·行·一切圣智了别
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in this manner, indeed, verily, alone, sensation + perception + volitional formations + discerning consciousness
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 娑舜你也跢舜你也跢 ｜ 娑嚕𠰢 ｜ 翳嚩銘嚩 ｜ 尾娜拏
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 108 · 三合 0 · 引 1 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 于此、今于此处，舍利子，诸诸法，空性相
verses.meaningEn: Here, in this world/place, Sariputra, all things, emptiness + mark
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 僧擬惹僧娑伽囉 ｜ 尾倪也喃 ｜ 伊賀舍哩補怛囉 ｜ 薩囉嚩達囉磨

verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·真如实际·第一义谛，阿泥律陀
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness & ultimate truth, Aniruddha
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 戍你也跢𠸪乞义拏 ｜ 阿努怛播拏 ｜ 阿努嚕䭾 ｜ 阿麼攞 ｜ 阿尾麼攞
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 108 · 三合 0 · 引 1 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 无垢、离染清净，无无垢地
verses.meaningEn: Stainless, spotless, pure, non-nirmala
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 阿努𢲉阿鉢哩部囉拏 ｜ 怛娑麼𢲉哩布怛囉 ｜ 戍你也哆咩 ｜ 嚕𠰢
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 108 · 三合 0 · 引 1 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 成就、充分，无诸圆满
verses.meaningEn: Not wanting, complete, full, non-filled or covered with , full, entire, complete, accomplished, attained (plural)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 拏吠那拏 ｜ 拏僧擬惹 ｜ 拏僧塞迦囉 ｜ 拏尾倪也捺
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 108 · 三合 0 · 引 1 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: tasmāc chāriputra śūnyatāyāṃ na rūpaṃ na vedanā na saṃjñā na saṃskārāḥ na vijñānam
verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧，车·踊跃·子，于空性、毕竟空寂中，不、非、无，色，不、非、无，受（领纳苦乐受），不、非、无，想（取相认知），不、非、无，诸行（诸行造作），不、非、无，识
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness, cha + eager + son, in emptiness, voidness of inherent existence, not, non-, rūpaṃ, not, non-, sensation, feeling, not, non-, perception, conceptualization, not, non-, volitional formations, conditioned phenomena (plural), not, non-, vijñānam
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 拏作屈蒭 ｜ 秫嚕怛囉 ｜ 伽囉喃 ｜ 𠰒賀嚩
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 108 · 三合 0 · 引 1 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 不、非、无，妙行迁变空·造作离相·六度满行清净
verses.meaningEn: Not, non-, awakened conduct beyond flux & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 迦野 ｜ 摩曩悉 ｜ 拏嚕播濕嚩巘䭾囉娑 ｜ 舍鉢囉瑟吒尾也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 108 · 三合 0 · 引 1 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 不、非、无，色·声·香·味·触·诸正法
verses.meaningEn: Not, non-, form + sound + smell + the sap or juice of plants and fruits + contact + Dharma
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 達囉磨 ｜ 拏斫乞蒭䭾覩 ｜ 夜嚩拏麼努 ｜ 尾倪也曩䭾覩
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 108 · 三合 0 · 引 1 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 不、非、无，眼界，一乘如实之道·最上真言离言说·离名相假立，不、非、无，意识界
verses.meaningEn: Not, non-, cakṣurdhātur, supreme vehicle of awakening & supreme ineffable speech & beyond nominal designation, not, non-, manovijñānadhātuḥ
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 拏尾你也拏尾你也諾乞义喻欲 ｜ 拏尾你也諾乞义喻 ｜ 夜嚩拏惹囉喃 ｜ 摩囉喃拏惹囉喃
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 108 · 三合 0 · 引 1 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: nāvidyā nāvidyākṣayo yāvan na jarāmaraṇaṃ na jarāmaraṇakṣayaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·最上真言离言说·施度调伏，离名相假立·最上真言离言说·施度调伏，一乘如实之道·最上真言离言说·离名相假立，不、非、无，老死，不、非、无，老死尽
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery, beyond nominal designation & supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery, supreme vehicle of awakening & supreme ineffable speech & beyond nominal designation, not, non-, jarāmaraṇaṃ, not, non-, old age and death + exhaustion
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩囉喃諾乞义喻 ｜ 拏耨佉 ｜ 三母䭾野 ｜ 𩕳嚕達磨𠻱誐
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 108 · 三合 0 · 引 1 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 不、非、无，苦·集·灭谛·诸圣道
verses.meaningEn: Not, non-, suffering + origin + suppression + path
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 拏倪也喃 ｜ 拏鉢囉鉢底 ｜ 拏畢三磨野 ｜ 怛娑麼阿鉢囉鉢帝怛嚩 ｜ 冐地薩怛嚩喃
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 108 · 三合 0 · 引 1 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 不、非、无，圣智、无漏真智，不、非、无，到何处，脐时
verses.meaningEn: Not, non-, primordial wisdom, gnosis (Jñāna), not, non-, prāptir, the navel or any navel-like cavity
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 鉢囉倪也鉢囉弭跢 ｜ 沫室𭋸底也 ｜ 尾賀囉底也 ｜ 唧哆嚩囉喃
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 108 · 三合 0 · 引 1 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: tasmād aprāptitvād bodhisattvasya prajñāpāramitām āśritya viharaty acittāvaraṇaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情）之，般若波罗蜜多（智慧度彼岸），本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，最上真言离言说·因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢，非心障蔽
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, of Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, Perfection of Wisdom (Prajñāpāramitā), primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, supreme ineffable speech & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust, without thought + obscuration
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 唧哆嚩囉拏 ｜ 拏娑底怛嚩 ｜ 那怛囉娑跢 ｜ 吠鉢哩惹
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 108 · 三合 0 · 引 1 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 妙行迁变空·真如实际·最上真言离言说，无有恐怖，颠倒古昔，超绝涅槃
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech, having no fear, delusion, excelling + Nirvāṇa
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 娑底訖㘓跢 ｜ 祢瑟吒祢哩嚩拏 ｜ 底哩尾也嚩悉體多 ｜ 薩囉嚩沒䭾
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 108 · 三合 0 · 引 1 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: tryadhvavyavasthitāḥ sarvabuddhāḥ prajñāpāramitām āśrityānuttarāṃ samyaksaṃbodhim abhisaṃbuddhāḥ
verses.meaningZh: 三世诸不是连词，一切诸佛，般若波罗蜜多（智慧度彼岸），本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，三耶三佛，诸最正觉
verses.meaningEn: Of the three times + separated, all + all Buddhas, Perfection of Wisdom (Prajñāpāramitā), primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, unsurpassed complete perfect enlightenment, supreme perfect enlightenment (plural)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 鉢囉倪也播囉弭哆 ｜ 磨室哩底也 ｜ 阿耨多囉三藐三沒地 ｜ 阿鼻粹沒䭾
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 108 · 三合 0 · 引 1 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: tasmāj jñātavyaṃ prajñāpāramitā mahāmantro mahāvidyāmantro nuttaramantro samasamamantraḥ
verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧，觉知勇健，般若波罗蜜多（智慧度彼岸），贡高大方颤动，大明咒真言，离名相假立·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，比较平等真言
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness, know + strong, Perfection of Wisdom (Prajñāpāramitā), high-minded + tremble, Mahāvidyā + Mantra, beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust, quite equal + Mantra
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 怛薩麼倪也䭾尾焰 ｜ 鉢囉倪也播囉弭跢摩賀滿覩嚕 ｜ 摩賀尾你也滿怛囉 ｜ 阿訥哆囉滿怛囉
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 108 · 三合 0 · 引 1 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: sarvaduḥkhapraśamanaḥ satyam amithyatvāt prajñāpāramitāyām ukto mantraḥ
verses.meaningZh: 一切·苦·疗，谛、真实不虚语，从不虚，于般若波罗蜜多（智慧度彼岸）中，曰，真言、密咒（护心密语）
verses.meaningEn: All + suffering + heal, truth, reality, veracity, from not false, in Perfection of Wisdom (Prajñāpāramitā), said, Mantra, sacred formula
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 阿三摩三麼滿怛囉 ｜ 薩囉嚩耨佉鉢囉舍摩拏 ｜ 娑底也麼 ｜ 蜜體曳怛嚩
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 108 · 三合 0 · 引 1 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 鉢囉倪也播囉弭哆 ｜ 穆骨覩滿怛囉 ｜ 怛你也他 ｜ 誐誐諦誐
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 108 · 三合 0 · 引 1 · 弹舌 0

verses.iast: oṃ gate gate pāragate pārasaṃgate bodhi svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三度越吧、已往彼岸尊！度向彼岸吧、已达究竟彼岸！普同度至彼岸吧（圆证菩提）！菩提、无上正觉，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! gone, O One gone beyond! again and again, gone all the way to the other shore! gone completely altogether beyond! Bodhi, awakening, enlightenment, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 播囉誐諦 ｜ 播囉僧誐諦 ｜ 播囉娑擔 ｜ 冐地 ｜ 娑嚩賀
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 108 · 三合 0 · 引 1 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼圣观自在菩萨！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Noble Avalokiteśvara!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫阿哩也 ｜ 嚩路枳帝
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 向菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情）
verses.meaningEn: To/for Bodhisattva, Awakening Being
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 向摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨）
verses.meaningEn: To/for Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 冐地薩怛嚩野 ｜ 摩賀薩怛嚩野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 向大悲圣尊、具足大悲心者
verses.meaningEn: To/for Greatly Compassionate One
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！于诸一切怖畏，向救护掌
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! all + among, protection + to
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 怛你也他唵薩嚩婆曳數 ｜ 怛囉喃
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 向彼尊（为格），顶礼敬拜已
verses.meaningEn: To him, to that one, having paid homage/salutation
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 此（真言，清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: This (accusative), stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening & supreme ineffable speech
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 怛寫銘 ｜ 曩莫塞訖哩怛嚩
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 青颈观自在·名为·心，最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Nīlakaṇṭha + by name, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 一切义利修习，清净吉祥、善妙庄严，山羊此圣女
verses.meaningEn: All aims and benefits, auspicious, pure, bright, virtuous, drift + this
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 诸一切处、到处可见之，愿成·圣道·容易净化
verses.meaningEn: Of all being everywhere, ubiquitous, be! become! + path + purifying
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩麼𠶹哩娜野 ｜ 麼嚩哩跢伊灑弭也
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！光明、智慧明照尊，衍伸羯磨事业，世间古昔尊
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O light, illumination, clear vision / in light, illumination, clear vision, spawn + action, world + O surpassing
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 薩嚩囉他 ｜ 娑䭾喃輸伴阿𠰒琰
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 呼唤圣尊叹词（咄！圣者！），唯愿救苦圣尊（诃利，大菩提萨埵
verses.meaningEn: O! Hail! Vocative invocation particle, O Hari / Remover of Suffering! great + Bodhisattva
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三忆念本誓，心
verses.meaningEn: Remember Your primordial vow! again and again, hṛdayam
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 婆嚩沫𭌇誐 ｜ 尾戍䭾劒
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三成办羯磨事业（俱噜），事
verses.meaningEn: Accomplish & enact this sacred work! again and again, actions
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三请成办、令速成就！
verses.meaningEn: Accomplish! fulfill! perfect! again and again
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 唵阿路計阿路迦摩底路迦底訖囒帝 ｜ 呬呬賀𭋸
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三坚固任持总持法印（度噜），诸尊最胜尊胜、普胜一切！大诸尊最胜尊胜
verses.meaningEn: Firmly uphold the dhāraṇī seal! again and again, they supreme victory! triumph! great + they supreme victory! triumph!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三请执持、总持护念！请执持·因陀逻·自在主
verses.meaningEn: Hold! bear! sustain! again and again, hold! bear! sustain! + Śakra king of the gods + Īśvara
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 娑麼囉娑麼囉 ｜ 𠶹哩娜野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三震动警觉、破除昏沉（左攞），无垢地·垢染·坚硬
verses.meaningEn: Stir awake and shake off delusion! again and again, nirmala + stain + O thickened
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 善来（连音式：迎请圣尊速降）！善来降临坛场（翳呬），世间自在王（观音尊号）
verses.meaningEn: Come! approach! come forth, O Blessed One! Lokeśvara, Sovereign Lord of the World
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 娑達野娑達野 ｜ 度嚕度嚕尾演底
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 贪染箭毒，请息灭、消灭一切毒害罪障！
verses.meaningEn: Passion, destroy! annihilate all evils/poisons!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 喷子不是毒素，请息灭、消灭一切毒害罪障！
verses.meaningEn: Hater + no poison, destroy! annihilate all evils/poisons!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 達囉達囉達哩寅捺囉 ｜ 濕嚩囉
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 愚痴·网·箭毒，请息灭、消灭一切毒害罪障！
verses.meaningEn: Delusion + net, destroy! annihilate all evils/poisons!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 左攞左攞 ｜ 麼攞尾麼攞
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三威猛速疾摄护除灾（呼嚧），大勇力士、降魔大力尊，威猛速疾摄护除灾（呼嚧）
verses.meaningEn: Swiftly protect and sweep away calamity! again and again, mighty champion, fearless hero, swiftly protect and sweep away calamity!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 唯愿救苦圣尊（诃利，秋天·我身·星宿
verses.meaningEn: O Hari / Remover of Suffering! fall + you were almost cursed by me + star
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 伊䤈曳呬 ｜ 路枳濕嚩囉
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三流注周遍、速行护念（萨啰）
verses.meaningEn: Flow forth and pervade with blessing! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三吉祥福德流注庄严（悉哩
verses.meaningEn: Auspicious Śrī fortune & sacred grace again and again
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 你吠灑尾灑尾曩捨也 ｜ 謨賀左囉尾灑
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三甘露妙流普润群生（素噜）
verses.meaningEn: Stream forth auspicious ambrosia! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三请觉知、垂鉴觉照！
verses.meaningEn: Awake! perceive! behend! again and again
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 護嚕護嚕麼攞護嚕 ｜ 賀𭋸鉢娜麼曩婆
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 再三请开晓觉悟、令发菩提觉智！
verses.meaningEn: Awaken! enlighten! illuminate! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 弥勒菩萨（慈氏尊），青颈观自在（吞摄诸毒大悲相）
verses.meaningEn: Maitreya, Loving-Kindness Bodhisattva, Nīlakaṇṭha, Blue-Throated Compassionate One
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 悉哩悉哩 ｜ 素嚕素嚕
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 希之，观照，请令心生清凉大欢喜！自尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Of wish, darśanaṃ, gladden! delight and refresh! pride, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 向成就者、已成就，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: To/for accomplished, perfected adept (Siddha), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 冐䭾野冐䭾野 ｜ 梅帝𭋸曳𩕳攞建姹
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 向大圣，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: To/for a great adept, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 迦麼寫那捺哩捨喃 ｜ 鉢囉賀娜野
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 向魔法机构自在主，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Magic agency + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 向青颈观自在（吞摄诸毒大悲相），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: To/for Nīlakaṇṭha, Blue-Throated Compassionate One, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 悉䭾野娑嚩賀 ｜ 摩賀悉䭾野娑嚩賀
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 向野猪面门嘴子，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Boar + face + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 悉䭾喻儗濕嚩囉野娑嚩賀
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 向莲华手，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Lotus flower + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 𩕳攞建姹野娑嚩賀 ｜ 嚩囉阿穆佉僧賀目佉野娑嚩賀
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 向颤动器械，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Tremble + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 鉢娜麼賀娑哆野娑嚩賀
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 向法螺·声·在于·带劲，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Conch shell + sound + in + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 作羯囉庾䭾野娑嚩賀 ｜ 商佉捨鉢哆𩕳冐達曩野娑嚩賀
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 向酒席·衍伸·部族·请执持，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Feast + spawn + buddha-family + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 摩賀攞矩吒䭾囉野娑嚩賀
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 向左·境界塞建陀·立·深青黑·人皮，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Left + the region of the shoulder + standing + dark-blue + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 嚩麼娑謇䭾祢捨悉體哆訖哩瑟拏𠰒曩野娑嚩賀 ｜ 尾野伽囉拶囉麼𩕳嚩娑曩野娑嚩賀
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 向豹·膜·犹如·古老，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Tiger + membrane + like + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 归命向佛法僧三宝，归命，向圣观自在菩萨，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to to/for the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha), homage to to/for Noble Avalokiteśvara, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 曩莫阿哩也 ｜ 嚩路枳帝
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 愿诸真言章句悉皆成就，于我、为我，一切真言秘密章句，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: May all mantra-padas succeed! to me, my, sacred mantra words and phrases, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 濕嚩囉野娑嚩賀 ｜ 悉鈿都銘滿怛囉鉢䭾𩕳娑嚩賀
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 60 · 三合 1 · 引 3 · 弹舌 0

recitationTipsZh: 原典古汉语音译：「古者能仁氏之王堪忍也始獲正覺談教法以度僧伽之眾三寶於是乎現馬埋世霧之六師薎如霜殞麗義天之五教朗若日懸然有樂廣之徒慕博知而常說尚略之輩希捷見以勤行人既二類不同法遂兩端亦異為樂廣廣開性相曲示於淵玄對尚略略啟呪名直增於功德其性也實多詮真理少議俗事其相也權多議俗事少詮真理其呪也密多從笁語少就支音其名也顯多就支音少從笁語勃陁住世四十九年年別續演達磨䟽歧一十二分分各無叅論夫析奧之幽其閒甚眾議乃拯淪之急唯此為先生死浪由是乎涸乾圓寂峯以之而峭峻。今我聦文聖武英略神功睿哲仁孝皇帝陛下承祧以立為世而來乘宿敦菩薩之因據現感皇王之位體佛在之正化闡佛後之遺風俯控外氓闢三學於三府高提內吒傳六明於六宮」。上方已按原卷逐句标注石刻 <cb:tt> 悉昙梵字原载状态，并补全完整六体对照与声韵音法。

provenance.rawSnippet: 古者能仁氏之王堪忍也始獲正覺談教法以度僧伽之眾三寶於是乎現馬埋世霧之六師薎如霜殞麗義天之五教朗若日懸然有樂廣之徒慕博知而常說尚略之輩希捷見以勤行人既二類不同法遂兩端亦異為樂廣廣開性相曲示於淵玄對尚略略啟呪名直增於功德其性也實多詮真理少議俗事其相也權多議俗事少詮真理其呪也密多從笁語少就支音其名也顯多就支音少從笁語勃陁住世四十九年年別續演達磨䟽歧一十二分分各無叅論夫析奧之幽其閒甚眾議乃拯淪之急唯此為先生死浪由是乎涸乾圓寂峯以之而峭峻。今我聦文聖武英略神功睿哲仁孝皇帝陛下承祧以立為世而來乘宿敦菩薩之因據現感皇王之位體佛在之正化闡佛後之遺風俯控外氓闢三學於三府高提內吒傳六明於六宮

verses.iast: namo buddhāya namo dharmāya namaḥ saṃghāya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛陀、觉者·正法、诸法实相·圣僧伽、清净海众！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Buddha, the Awakened One, Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena, Saṃgha, noble spiritual community!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 古者能仁氏之王堪忍也始獲正覺談教法以度僧伽之眾三寶於是乎現馬埋世霧之六師薎如霜殞麗義天之五教朗若日懸然有樂廣之徒慕博知而常說尚略之輩希捷見以勤行人既二類不同法遂兩端亦異為樂廣廣開性相曲示於淵玄

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切佛陀菩提萨埵！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, Buddha, Bodhisattva!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 對尚略略啟呪名直增於功德其性也實多詮真理少議俗事其相也權多議俗事少詮真理其呪也密多從笁語少就支音其名也顯多就支音少從笁語勃陁住世四十九年年別續演達磨䟽歧一十二分分各無叅論夫析奧之幽其閒甚眾議乃
verses.tangNoteZh: 房山石经夹注：二合 0 · 三合 0 · 引 4 · 弹舌 0

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！一切如来·心·陀罗尼，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! all Tathagatas + heart + Dhāraṇī, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 拯淪之急唯此為先生死浪由是乎涸乾圓寂峯以之而峭峻。今我聦文聖武英略神功睿哲仁孝皇帝陛下承祧以立為世而來乘宿敦菩薩之因據現感皇王之位體佛在之正化闡佛後之遺風俯控外氓闢三學於三府高提內吒傳六明於六宮

verses.meaningZh: 再三集智敏锐、觉察神验，再三护摩遣障神验、献供除厄，再三如来教敕威令神验，勇猛护摩除障神验，寂静息灾神验善巧，借由善妙多闻之力令威神敏锐成就
verses.meaningEn: Keen in gathering wisdom & mindfulness again and again, efficacious in sacred oblation & dispelling harm again and again, efficacious in awakened command & authority again and again, swift and efficacious in protective oblation, skillful and efficacious in pacifying afflictions, efficacious through auspicious hearing of the Dharma

verses.meaningZh: 寻伺观照护摩神验，借由此处至诚献供之力令威神敏锐成就，和合梵呗妙音赞咏中，借由彼力、以是因缘令威神敏锐成就，正知正觉相应成就，借由彼力、以是因缘令威神敏锐成就，借由清明圣智了别之力
verses.meaningEn: Keen in contemplative inquiry & oblation, efficacious by this sacred offering & invocation here, in harmonious sacred chant and union, efficacious by that truth, thereby, through that power, endowed with clear right perception, efficacious by that truth, thereby, through that power, through discerning spiritual consciousness

verses.meaningEn: Keen, skillful, efficacious in spiritual power, efficacious through exalted proclamation & ascension, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 耳语·最后·颇，最胜尊胜、普胜一切！无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢·离名相假立，嚩啰阇，最上真言离言说·离名相假立·妙果圆成，清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧·一切诸谛圆满，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Whisper + farthest + pha, supreme victory! triumph! selfless great loving-kindness & stainless purity free from dust & beyond nominal designation, free from dust, supreme ineffable speech & beyond nominal designation & fruition of enlightenment (imperative seal), stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 2 大数据库「大正藏 T84 悉昙部」日本 空海 撰撰《梵字悉曇字母并釋義》（T84n2701，共 1 卷，3642 字）。核心法义涵盖：悉曇五十字門釋義（阿字本不生）、十八章建立與摩多體文、二合三合連聲法則。原典摘要：梵字悉曇字母并釋義沙門空海撰夫梵字悉曇者印度之文書也西域記云梵天所製五天竺國皆用此字然因地隨人稍有增減語其骨體以此為本劫初之時世無法教梵王下來授以此悉曇章根原四十七言流派餘一萬世人不解元由謂梵王所作若依大毗盧遮那經云此是文字者自然道理之所作也非如來所作亦非梵王諸天之所作若雖有能作者如來不隨喜諸佛如來以佛眼觀察此法然之文…

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 2 大数据库「大正藏 T84 悉昙部」日本 明覺 撰撰《悉曇要訣》（T84n2706，共 4 卷，13744 字）。核心法义涵盖：梵音反切與和音假名對照、二合三合四合連聲要訣。原典摘要：悉曇要訣辨言悉曇翻為成就悉馱悉地亦翻成就依轉聲法而可解也諸家梵章多就業聲安其標目又具題悉曇阿羅率覩翻成就吉祥字母字體從本以來諸義利成就故顯示異方文字不同此例殊標悉曇嘆其法德而為令之仰信領會其深義乎經曰祕密主我今觀諸佛國土無不見此遍一切處字門諸如來無有不宣説者菩薩住此字門一切事業悉得成就標章因由實在于此矣成就一切文辭章句…

provenance.editionCitation: Taishō Vol. 84 T84n2706 (悉曇要訣, 日本 明覺 撰)
provenance.manuscriptNotesZh: 日本东密/台密悉昙学权威原典（KR6t0417）。
provenance.rawSnippet: 悉曇要訣辨言悉曇翻為成就悉馱悉地亦翻成就依轉聲法而可解也諸家梵章多就業聲安其標目又具題悉曇阿羅率覩翻成就吉祥字母字體從本以來諸義利成就故顯示異方文字不同此例殊標悉曇嘆其法德而為令之仰信領會其深義乎經曰祕密主我今觀諸佛國土無不見此遍一切處字門諸如來無有不宣説者菩薩住此字門一切事業悉得成就標章因由實在于此矣成就一切文辭章句故標為悉曇諸師釋名大底如是此有淺深淺則成就諸顯教及世間多名句文辭深則成就微妙章句大陀羅尼等即是不空自在王家大因陀羅輪微妙章句皆得成就若夫隨緣字門以為其心觀誦如法得止一境則所安布字門成本有金剛字體到此妙

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 2 大数据库「大正藏 T84 悉昙部」日本 慈雲 撰撰《梵學津梁》（T84n2709，共 1 卷，558 字）。核心法义涵盖：千卷《梵學津梁》總綱、梵文語法（八轉聲・蘇漫多）與悉曇原典還原。原典摘要：悉曇輪略圖抄序夫遮那之為三密教主也顯五十字於法界宮之月釋尊之為一代能化也和十四音於沙羅林之風自爾以降本法自然聲字文文吐金玉之光劫初轉教文言句句散香花之匂依之傳法聖者付法賢聖結集堂裏寫梵文於貝葉翻經院窗記漢語於簡牘加之傳教弘法慈覺智證面面學梵王所製文字於振旦東記山記林記石記各各釋智廣能撰字紀於扶桑專是即身頓悟之祕術豈非極…

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 2 大数据库「大正藏 T84 悉昙部」日本 行智 撰撰《悉曇字記創學鈔》（T84n2710，共 10 卷，20820 字）。核心法义涵盖：《悉曇字記》逐句詳解、十八章字例全譜。原典摘要：三密鈔悉曇三密鈔序詳夫悉曇梵章之為學也入真言門之閫閾升瑜伽堂之階梯不由閫閾而入門不踐階梯而升堂者未之有也故學金剛乘者要須先肄悉曇凡梵字有字相有字義所言字相者如中國隸楷訓詁竺乾人兒女走卒亦通習之若夫據字義則聲字實相法佛境界不染指真道者雖大人耆宿非所得而窺窬佛言若出法性外別有世間文字者妄心謬見非真言也自字義觀則世間文字即法…

provenance.rawSnippet: 三密鈔悉曇三密鈔序詳夫悉曇梵章之為學也入真言門之閫閾升瑜伽堂之階梯不由閫閾而入門不踐階梯而升堂者未之有也故學金剛乘者要須先肄悉曇凡梵字有字相有字義所言字相者如中國隸楷訓詁竺乾人兒女走卒亦通習之若夫據字義則聲字實相法佛境界不染指真道者雖大人耆宿非所得而窺窬佛言若出法性外別有世間文字者妄心謬見非真言也自字義觀則世間文字即法然聲字亦是法身之語密也與身心二密平等無差故云法身三密一一皆至第一實際妙極之境語等於心身等於語所以名為三密平等法門也悉曇三密之稱蓋亦由茲乎繹其世間字本有梵王毗伽羅論摩醯悉地囉窣覩等章厥餘支流者不可勝言暨

verses.meaningZh: 如是、如此所成，最极听，造作离相·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧，三昧耶（本誓、平等契合、时际），出有坏喫食，生起不可得·尊胜·妙行趣入·因缘空寂大乐，能觉·助理·矣

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 6 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：vaṁśeyasyāsīdāyurekaṁśata mihasaradāṁsarvvalokaikabaddhoṣa nirjityāśecca mulesurucimāpisadānunta rāyenavodhistaṁvandeśo sihaṁsurana ranamitaṁ buddhamādityabaṁdhu|| jātiviprapraśaṣṭhu nṛpavaramahite ketumahyāṁgṛhītvā buddhatvaṁyaḥ kariṣyatyāmita guṇanidhirnnāga vṛkṣasyamule| aṣṭāvavdāyutānikṣa pitabhagavate bhāviyagramāyu rvvandemaitrayanāthaṁtuṣita puravarāvāskitaṁ taṁmunīndraṁ|| stutvāvi saptabuddhansakalamupagatānsa ptasaptārksa bhāsometrayaṁbāṣumaṁmetuṣita puragataṁbhā vitaṁlokanātha| yatpupyaṁsaṁprasuta tubhagatiphala dadahināmeva sarvvācchitvā saṁlkeśayāśo nmunayaśvavarāniṣṭati saṁprayāntu|| itisugatā vadānasapta buddha muni samāptaḥ oṁ namaḥ sarvabuddha bodhisatvānāṁ mulāmūlahālakā nantā sukṣataḥ sarvvajinā-asimaniṣṭha| varadāmamadhantu abhyudā|。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 7 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：lambaramatrāṁmamasarvvadā anantatasyavayāpadā arara asamantānanta dharmātekhana 3 mahāvīrapastra samasahamahāvarakaṇṇara mahābalokite ha ha ra vajavajārkaradhara rū hūṃ hūṃ maṇulamavarāgra vikamakurutsurūsarvatathā hijyala agrā-agriṇīphaṭ svāhā| imūlavidhāmantrasiddhimādhāraṇī samāptaḥ oṁ namo buddha-āya|| oṁ namo bhagavate vairocana prabhaketu buddha-āya|| tayathā|| oṁ śuṣkera samayara śānte 2 dānte 2 samā-ū pe-anālaṁvetaramveja sobhavanti mahātejenilālamve nilākūlanirvvāṇesa vve buddhānāṁdhiṣṭhānādhiṣṭhite svāhā| itivaiśacanāmadhāraṇī samākaṁ|| oṁ namo bhagavate āryya śrā-akṣobhyāyatabhāgatā yā rhate。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 9 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：oṁ namaḥ śrīmaṁjunāthāya|| oṁ namo-arapañacanāyamukatidahanadakṣāyamaṁjuśrīpradātāyacandrakāntimaṇibuddhipradāyākhaṅaga pustakavyagrahastāyamaṁjuvāṇivaraprudāyasarvvasatvānāṁñaca śāntiṁkurūpuṣṭikururakṣākurū oṁ āḥ dhīḥ hūṁ phaṭ-svāhā| iti-arapañacanamaṁjuśrīḥ sādhananāmadhāraṇīsamāptaḥ|| oṁ namaḥ śākyasiṁhāya|| tadyathā| oṁ dhṛtiśrutivijayesvāhā|| namostuhabuddhāya suviśuddhabodhayeviśuddhadharmmāpratibhānubuddhe| saddharmma punyāpagatā nuddhayebhavāgraśunpāpariśuddhabuddhaye|| aho aho buddhamanakṣatejasaṁ aho aho sāgaramerū| aho aho buddhamanantagocaraṁ āṃdunvaṁraṁ puṣa-apamivāti dullabhaṁ|| aho aho kāṇikastathāgataḥ śākyakulatunarendrasūryyāyenedṛśaṁbhāṣita- sutramubhumaṁsarvaṣusatvāmanugrahārtha|| śa-ānteśa-avaraḥ śākyamunistathāgataḥ satvobhumaḥ gāntapurepraviṣṭhaḥ||。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第11品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (11): khāṅatanuttarāya sampakkaṁ bodhau pratiṣṭhāya
titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (11): khāṅatanuttarāya sampakkaṁ bodhau pratiṣṭhāya
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 11: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (11): khāṅatanuttarāya sampakkaṁ bodhau pratiṣṭhāya
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §11
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (11)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 11 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：khāṅatanuttarāya sampakkaṁ bodhau pratiṣṭhāya|| ji āḥ maitreya hūṃ svāhā| iti maitrīya nāmadhāraṇī samāptaṁ|| 23|| ḍenamaḥ śrīlokanāthāya|| amogha pāśāyanamaḥ|| evaṁmayā śrutamekasmiṁ samaye bhagavān protarakeparvvate viharatisma|| āryyāva lokiteśvaraspabhavane| aneka śāsagatamāsa campakāśa-okātimukta kanānānāratnavṛkṣa samalaṁkṛtemahatābhikṣū saṁghenasārddha aṣṭādaśabhirbhikṣa sahasrairnavanavati bhiścabodhisatva koṭiniyuteśatasahasraiḥ parivṛttaḥ puraskṛta iśvara maheśvara vraphnta kāyikāṁ deva putrā nādha-ikṛtya dharmmadeśayatisma|| athakhalvāryyāca lokiteśvaro bodhisatvo mahāsatvotchāyāsanādekāṁśa muttarā saṅgakṛtvāda kṣiṇajā majulaṁ pṛthiṣyā pratiṣṭha-āpyayenabhagavāṁsta nāñajalīkṛtvāpraṇya prahasita vadano bhūtvā bhagavanta meta davocata|| astima mebhaṁga。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第12品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (12): na vyuhaṁnāma samādhiṁ prati labhate| yadi-icchati tatkarotyeva śādhaka iti
titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (12): na vyuhaṁnāma samādhiṁ prati labhate| yadi-icchati tatkarotyeva śādhaka iti
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 12: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (12): na vyuhaṁnāma samādhiṁ prati labhate| yadi-icchati tatkarotyeva śādhaka iti
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §12
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (12)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 12 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：na vyuhaṁnāma samādhiṁ prati labhate| yadi-icchati tatkarotyeva śādhaka iti|| idamavocad bhagavānāttamanā āryāva lokiteśvaro bodhisatvo mahāsatvastaca bhikṣavastaica bodhisatvā satcaśuddhāvā sakā-īka devapūtrā sadeva mānūṣā saragaruḍa gandharvvaśca lokobha gavatoṣitamabhya nandanniti|| iti āryā smoghapāśanāma hṛdayaṁmahāyāna sūtraṁ nāmadhāraṇāṁ parisamāptaḥ oṁ namaḥ śrīlokanāthāya|| oṁ namaḥ śrīkhasarpyanāyai| trailokya darpyanātha ekāgracittā cittāya sakala lokavināsana karāya sarvasatvānātrya śānti kurupūṣṭiṁ kururakṣā kurusiddhiṁ kuru-oṁ āḥ hṛṁ hu phaṭ svāhā|| āryā khasarpyanāmadhāraṇī samāpta| oṁ namaḥ trailokanātha|| oṁ namo bhagavate āryāva lokiteśvarāya bodhisatvāya mahāsatvāya mahākāruṇikāya|| tadyathā oṁsūmūṣṭi chedani nirmmaresū。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 14 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：verocana vyusarājāpaya tathāgatārhate samyakaṁ buddhāya| tadyathā| nama| sarva tathāgatetatya| samyakaṁ buddhāyatya| namaḥ āryāvajñokī| teśvarāya bodhisatvāya| mahāsatvāya| mahākārūṇikāya| taghayā| oṁ dhara tu dhirītu ṣar-tu bhadrevatu, pracajñetu kusumetu vane| iti bhilici| li vajjālā pranaye svāhā| ārya śrī sabhamra bhujalokeśvarasya nāma dhāranī samāpta| oṁ nama, śrī siṁha nādāya| namoratna namāya| namo āryāvalo kiṁteśvarāya bodhisatvāya mahāsatvāya, mahākāruṇikāya| taghayā| oṁ akaṭe, vikaṭe, nikaṭe, ikaṭe| kaṭaṁkaṭa kaloka karāṭavīryva| svāhā| āryā siṁhanādalokeśvara nāma dhāranī samāpta| oṁ namo mokṣa padāya| oṁ nama śrī āryāvajño kineśvarāya, bodhisatvāya mahāsatvāya, mahākāruṇikāya| tadyathā| oṁ yajñetu, cilītu, culutu, hayutu m。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 16 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：bhate|| ānanda paurāṇāṁsa tyathatāṣitekarmma vivākaṁ|| ida mavocadbhagavānattamanā āyuṣyānā nando bhagavato bhāṣita matya nandanniti|| āryya ṣaḍakṣarī mahāviyānāma dhāraṇī samāptaḥ|| 31|| oṁ namo nīlakaṇṭha lokaśvarāya|| oṁ namo āryyā valokiteśvarāya bodhita-ūttvāya| mahāsatvāya mahākāruṇikāya| tadyathā|| oṁ maṇi padme hūṃ|| oṁ sarvva bandhanache danakarāya| sarvapāpa samudrocheṣanakarāya sarvvavyādhipraśesana karāya| sarvvabhyu padravanināśanakarāya| sarvva bhayeṣutrāṇāya| tasmenamaskṛtaṁ| iti āryyā valokiteśvarasya stavanīlakaṇṭha nāma hṛday āryyāvirtt-yiṣyāmi| sarvvārthasādhana śubhavetanaṁ| sarvva satvā nāṁpāpamārgja viśodhakaḥ|| tadyathā|| avalokiḍata lokatalokagati-ehe mahābodhisatva he prīya bodhisatva dekālunikalpa hṛdayaṁ ehe āryyā valokiteśvara paramamaitrī vittka ruṇika kukarmma sādhanīvi。

sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §17
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (17)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 17 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：ṇaṁ prasādhayamesvāhā|| siddhāyasvāhā|| varāhamukhāyasvāhā|| mahāpadmahastāya svāhā|| vajrahastāya svāhā|| mahāvajrahastāya svāhā|| kṛṣṇasarvyatayajñāpavītāya svāhā|| mahākālamakūṭadharāya svāhā|| cakrāyūdhadharāyasvāhā|| śaṁkhaśadvanirnno danakarāya svāhā|| bodhanakarāya svāhā|| vāmaskandha deśaskidata kṛṣṇā jināya svāhā|| vāmahastavyāghracarmma nivāsanāya svāhā| lokeśvarāya svāhā|| mahālokeśvarāya svāhā|| sarva siddheśvarāya svāhā|| namāṁ svāhā|| kurūrakṣā mūrtiṇāṁ svāhā|| namo bhagavate āryyā valokiteśvarāya bodhisatvāyamāstvāya mahāsatvāya mahākāruṇikāya siddha yumemakantra padāvisvāhā|| itiśrī āryyāvalokiteśvara sya nīla kaṇṭha hṛdayaṁ sāmaptaḥ||32|| oṁ namo padmahastāya|| oṁ namo āryyāvalokiteśvarāya bodhisatvāya mahasatvā|。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 18 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：yamahākāruṇikāya|| tadyathā|| oṁ cara 2 ciri 2 cura 2 ha 2 mur 2 huṃ huṃ huṃ huṃ huṃ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā|| padmahastāya svārha āryya padmahastadhāraṇī samāptaḥ|| 33|| oṁ namo sahasravarktāya|| oṁ namo āryyāvilokiteśvarāya bodhisatvāya mahāsatvāya mahākāruṇikāya|| tadyathā|| oṁ jaya 2 mahājaya- vāhinijayoktarikala 2 mara 2 cara 2 hadu 2 kṣiṇi sarvvakarmmāvalanānima ma bhagavati sahasrāvarbhṛma| sarvva buddhava lokita cakṣustrota jivhā manovijñāna viśonila|| tadyathā|| || oṁ surū 2 prasurū 2 bhara 2 sambhara 2 phara 2 smara 2 oṁ sarvva buddhādhiṣṭhite svāhā|| oṁ sarvva buddhalikite svāhā|| oṁ dharmādhātū garbhbesvāhā|| oṁ abhāvasvabhāva dharmmāvabodhani svāhā|| āryya sahasravarktānāma (varttānāma) dhāraṇī samāptaḥ|| 34|| oṁ namo lokanāthāya|| oṁ maṇipadma huṃ|| oṁ kāra dhyānayogaṁvara kamala。

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！行持妙道、周游救护（左啰），久远常恒护持不退（唧哩），妙行迁变空·清净离诸尘垢，贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·损减除灭忧苦），再三金刚怒王种子字（摧伏魔障），泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! move forth in compassionate activity! enduring steadfast protection & mindfulness, awakened conduct beyond flux & stainless purity free from dust, causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — primordial non-arising, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — dispelling sorrow, vajra seed syllable Huṃ again and again, Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第19品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (19): rasapta miśrana saṁyukta ṣaḍakṣarasatva
titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (19): rasapta miśrana saṁyukta ṣaḍakṣarasatva
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 19: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (19): rasapta miśrana saṁyukta ṣaḍakṣarasatva
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §19
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (19)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 19 品（罗马转写本 820/2949）。跋文：rasapta miśrana saṁyukta ṣaḍakṣarasatva samāptaḥ|| 35|| oṁ namo lokanāthāya namaste bodhisatvāya mahāsatvāyatāpine| āryyāva lokiteśāya maheśvarāya suśriye||1|| padmaśrī bhuṣitā ya saddharmmavacadāyate namāva śaṁkarāya truvanadṛṣṭika nāyate|| 2|| sarvadā jagadāśvāsavara dāna pradāyaca| śata sahamrahastāya koṭīlakṣekṣaṇāyaca|| 3|| vaḍavā mukha paryyanta śaśidiśāna nāyaca| sarva dharmmānurupāya dharmma priyāṁya suddhiye|| 4|| sarvva satva mahā duḥkha saṁmokṣaṇa karāyaca| matsya dayāmbujūja mṛnāmā śvāsana karāyacaṁ||5|| jñāna rāśṣutta māṁgāya dharmmārtha priyadāyine| ratna śrī bhuṣitāṁtyāya saṅṇa śrī pradāyaca||6|| sarvva naraka bhumīnāṁ saṁśoṣaṇa karāyaca| jñāna śrī saṁprabhāsāya jñāna laṣkī pradāyaca|| sāmaraiḥ sāsurendreśvalokaiḥ saṁpūjitāyaca namaḥ。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 20 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：ye vajapāṇi mahāyakṣa vijadaṇakarāyaca||17|| trai loke dusatvānī bhīṣaṇa mūrtti dhāriṇe| bhutacetā ekūmbhāṇura kṣoyakṣā dibhī da de|| 18|| nilotyala khunatrāya gambhīcadhīca buddhaye| sarvva dhinā thāya sarvva kle śopāriṇe|| bhūvi vidharmma sambā dhimārgoya citāyaca| mokṣa bhārgā bhiruḍhāya pravaradhamma pitrute|| 20|| prāpta saṁbodhi saccitta sanmārgo pacitāyaca| pretā didurgati kleśa parimokṣaṇa karāyaca||21|| paramoṇu rajo saṁkhya samādhida dhate namaḥ| nama mtrai laukanāthāya bodhisatvāya tesadā|| 22|| mahāsatvāya saddharmma guṇa saṁpaktidāyine| namāmi tejaga chāstā sadāhaṁ śaraṇaṁ vrajate||23|| bhajābhisatavaṁbhakkāta tprasadi jagatprabho| kṣanta vyaṁme rādhatvaṁyatmathā prakṛtaṁbhavet||24|| itiśrī madā ryyā va lokiteśvara spajamacā jā muti samāptaḥ|| oṁ na mo loka。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第21品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (21): nāthāya
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 21: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (21): nāthāya
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §21
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (21)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 21 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：nāthāya|| namehaṁ bhagavanchāstre va lokite śvarāyate| padmabhṛte maheśāya sū pralhāda karāyaca||1|| padmāsanāya padmaśrī pariṣṭata samūktaye| saṁśubha padmahastāya jagadāśvā sadāyine||2|| pṛthivī carane trāya saṁśuddha patrvacakṣuṣa| jinaratna kirīṭāya cintāmaṇi vibhūṣiṇa||3|| itimaheśvarakṛta stavaḥ|| namehaṁ bhagavanchāstreve lokite śvarāyate| maheśāya jagabhartta prāṇadāya mahātmate||1|| pṛthivīvarane trāyaṁ śubhapadmadharāyaca| padmaśrī pariṣṭatāya sūcetana karāyaca||2|| dharmmadharāya nāthāya daśabhūmīśvarāya cāsū nirvṛtti mahāyāna saṁprasthitāya sarvvadā||3|| iti āryyāvalokiteśvarasya umāmaheśvara kṛtmṇati samāptaṁ||3|| oṁ namaḥ samatra bhadrāya|| atha khalū samanta bhadro bodhisatva mmahāsatva etāneva loka dhātu paraṁparona bhilā pyānābhilāpya būddha kṣatrapara。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 22: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (22): pariṇampayadāpta puṇṣamana kamatīvaviśiṣṭaṁ| tenajagadvya sanoghati magnaṁ yātvamitābha purīvaramaca
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §22

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 22 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：pariṇampayadāpta puṇṣamana kamatīvaviśiṣṭaṁ| tenajagadvya sanoghati magnaṁ yātvamitābha purīvaramaca|| || āryyabhadravarīmahāpraṇidhāna ratna rājaṁ samāptaṁ|| || oṁ namo lokathāya|| oṁ namaḥ śrī āryyā va lokiteśvarāya|| bodhisatvāyamahā satvāya mahākāruṇikāya|| evaṁmayā śṛta me kasminsamaye bhagavānāryyāvalokiteṇṣaṭasya bhagavate pāṭarake parvvata śikharayarānāratna vṛkṣasahasra samādhi vyakīrṇte jāmvanade suvarṇtukāctrenobhāsa|| nānāratnamaya vimāna bhūmipradeśa viharātisma|| anekaiśvadevanāgayakṣa suragaruḍa kinnara mahoragamatuṣyā koṭi niyūta śata sasamraiḥ sārddha tatrakhalū bhagavānū puraskṛta smaṁskṛtī gurūkṛto mānitaḥ pūjito ardhito apacāyito parivūta dharmma deśayatisma|| ādaukalyānaṁ madhaukalyānaṁ paryyavasāṇakaṁsyā。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 23 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：suryyasahasrātireka tejā ruciraśarīre vraṣkendādine maskate iti|| || yaḥ kaścidāryāvalokite śvaraspanāmāṣṭotara śatenamtrotrā pahārakuryyotātaspatrca nannataryyāṇikarmmācaraṇāni parikṣayaṁ gacchati|| sarvvamāgulaṁ praviṣṭhobhavanti| sarvva mantrānita spasiddhānita| aneka kalpa koṭhiniyuta satasahasrāṇi durgatinnajārā|| avicīna praviśaṁti| tasyacamaraṇa kālasamaye sutvāvatyāṁloka dhātu dhupa yadyaṁte|| jātojātau āryyāvalokiteśaravirahito bhavanti|| samatrajāpena medhāvī bhavati|| śurāśurayaḥ savaraḥ sarvva śāsta viśārada ā deyavāṣṭo bhavati|| anenamtotrā pahāraṁ kuryyāta dvāṣaṣṭhī gargānadīyālukāsamoyu būddhā bhagavanta pujito bhavanti|| samovipākonā ṣṭi viśe| sarvvajñajina ratnadhātu karaṇukaṁnāma bhagavanta āryyālokiteśvara spa-aṣṭobhāra śatanāma mahāyāna śūtraṁ samāptaṁ||0||。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第24品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (24): kha svāhā
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 24: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (24): kha svāhā
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §24
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (24)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 24 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：kha svāhā|| oṁ kuvaleya svāhā|| oṁ jūṃ jūṃ jūṃ śiva svāhā|| oṁ urddhaṣnuṇe svāhā|| oṁ suryyāya grahādhipataye svāhā|| oṁ candāyārakṣatrādhipataye svāhā|| adhipṛthivyai svāhā|| oṁ asurebhyaḥ svāhā|| oṁ nāgebhyaḥ svāhā|| oṁ sarvvayogecittamu pātpādayāmī samudraphalanasamaye haṃ asamācara samīrasāra dharmminaḥ karuṇātmakaḥ jagaduḥkhahānathaḥ|| asamanta sarva guṇāsiddhi dāyine|| asamāṁcara samīra sāra dharmminaḥ karuṇātmakaḥ jagaduḥkhahānayaḥ|| samanta sarva guṇāsiddhidāyine|| asamāṁcasamavarāgra dharmmiṇaḥ gagaṇe samāpatatānavidyate|| guṇaresareṇū- kanikaṁvyasimiko sphutasatvadhātuvara siddhidāyakaṁ|| vigato prareṣu-asamanta siddhipuśatatāmalokanavega taddhitā praṇidhāna siddhibala nirodhaḥ dharmmatājagatārtha sādhanaparāḥ samattini satatṣvi rocani mahā kṛpātmamānanirodhātmakaruṣācārī kāyarotavajatetrīsokavara siddhidāyakāḥ amitābhateṣu samāpti tamatāḥ sata。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第25品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section (25)

translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §25

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 25 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：|| āryā sarvva dūrgnati pariśo dhanarājyasya tathāgatasyārhataḥ samyakaṁ būḍacasya kalpaika samāptaḥ|| oṁ namo ratnatracāya|| oṁ namaḥ sarvva buddha bodhisatvebhaḥ|| tadyathā|| oṁ kinira tathāgato dbhabaśānta bala daṁḍattama tathāgato dabhabahūṃ phaṭ svāhā āryya gandhavyū hanāmadhāraśāṁ samāptaḥ oṁ namo ratnatrayāya tadyathā|| ḍaṁdhana 2 hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā āryya samādhi rājanāma dhāraṇī samāptaḥ|| oṁ namoca laṁkāya tārāya|| buddhe bhagabadbhe rbhāṣitā nibhāṣiṣante|| tadyathā|| oṁ ṭṭa 2 dhūṭṭa 2 kaṭa 2 amale 2 vimale 2 nima 2 vame 2 kase 2 aṭamaṭṭaka gholathapagho dimera paca 2 vandha 2 ace 2 mace dūtāre dūśovatāre arkkara sarkka 2 vakre 2 dime 2 ṭūṭūṭūṭū|| ḍū ḍū ḍū ḍū|| rū rū rū rū|| phū phū phū phū svāhā|| āryya laṁkābatāra pathi phalanāma dhāraṇīsamā。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 27 品（罗马转写本 820/2949）。跋文：dharaṇī samāptaḥ|| || oṁ namo vaja sarasvasye|| vajasamāja yudreyā|| oṁ vaja samājaḥ jaḥ ja jñāna satvapravasādi pūrvvaka prajñāyā ramitā vaja paryyarka samāsirā bhāvayat|| oṁ pivu 2 prajñābaddha nivdāla 2 spadhāvaddha nidhiri 2 buddhi baddha nisvāhā|| āryya pajasarasvatī 1 nāmadhāraṇī samāpta|| oṁ namo bhagavate suvarṇu prabhā indrarājāya tathāgatāyārhate samyakkaṁ buddhāya|| tayathā|| oṁ ptu ṭini 2 amitākta sani-ayiniyiriṇi svāhā|| āryya puṇya vibaddhanī nāmadhāraṇī samāptaṁ|| oṁ namo saddharmma yuśra| puśra rīktāya|| namo ratna trayāya|| namaḥ prabhūgaratnādi sarvva tathāgatān monamaḥ| namo śākta munaye tathāgatā yārhate samyakaṁka buddhāya tayathā|| ane 2 arau dharau amane mamanacilkatta varite| samasamitā viśānta mukta mukte yasame avisane sabhejayajaya akṣimeśā||。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 28 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：ante amitedhāraṇi ālokabhāmya pratyavākṣa ni ni dhi rucū viru-atyanta 2 ni vicha anta 2 yā ri vi śuddhi ukūle mūkūle araḍe paraḍe sūkākṣi asame same būddha vilokite dharmma parikṣipratya vākṣini sadyanidaryasa nidyoṣanimayā bhaya vinodhani|| mantre mantrā kṣaya te nūta kauśalya-a kṣayavanatā vakkulava ratāyavaloka amanpatāya|| tadyathā|| jvale mahājvale ubhyabhūko aḍa-a ḍovati nṛtya nṛtyāvati yiḍi ni vidrū viprū nṛtyarinṛtyāvati|| tadyathā|| aṭṭa bh naṭṭa venadṛ avadya nā vikūna yisvādā|| tadyathā|| agaṇe gaṇe gaurīgāṁdhāricāndrā rimātargiyū| kasisaṁkula vūla sisvāhā| tadyathā|| iti mekū timera sahe sahe sahe saha sahe stuhe stuhe stuhe stuhe stuhe svāhā iti saddharmma paśunī kānāmadhāraṇī samāptā|| onamogāthā dvayāya|| oṁ padme mahāpadme ve pamodbhave sūkhāvatī ga。

verses.iast: sarvva grahe vetāla nanāgāśca duṣṭa cibhtā navandha kala gṛnha gata māla

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 30 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：rvvaṇatraṁ sarvvamantrātasarvvajogānu sarvvarākṣasā dināṁ rakṣa 2 māṁmamasarvva satvānāctra savvepidravo pasaṁgo pāyāsesyaḥ svāhā|| āryyā amritā nāma dhāraṇī samāptaṁ|| || oṁ namo ratnatrayāya|| oṁ namo buddhāya mahākāruṇikāya bharaṇikṛtahṛdayāya|| oṁ āḥ sugatavajatṛsyahoḥ svāhā|| āryya sugata nāmadhāraṇī samāptaṁ|| oṁ namo bhagavate bheṣayavaiḍuryyaprabha rājāya tathāgatāyarhate samyakasaṁbuddhāya|| tadyathā oṁ bheṣaye 2 mahābhaiṣaṭta bhaiṣaṭate svāhā|| āryya bhaiṣayta rājanāma dhāraṇī samāptaṁ|| oṁ maṇi padme hūṃ|| oṁ namo bhagavate āryyapara maguravai mahākāruṇikāya śākya manuṣye tathāgatā yārhate samyaksaṁbuddhāya|| tadyathā|| oṁ mūne 2 mahāmunaye svāhā|| āryya śākya muni nāmadhāraṇī samāptaṁ|| oṁ namaḥ sapta saptīnāṁsamyaksaṁbuddhā koṭīnāṁ||。

titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 32: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (32): tato dhārayita vyāmānūṣpasyā rāja cūḍakaṇṭhecā likhikṛta dhārayetū sarvva michākaroti mtrīrupātra dhāraye yurājāvā atirakṣā karoti
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §32
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (32)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 32 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：tato dhārayita vyāmānūṣpasyā rāja cūḍakaṇṭhecā likhikṛta dhārayetū sarvva michākaroti mtrīrupātra dhāraye yurājāvā atirakṣā karoti|| parasainpadya yeti prāpta kā śrīlakṣīnā mutrcati pāpakāḥ|| idamavoca dbhagavānāttamanāsteca śakrādidevābhi kṣavo bodhisatvā mahāsatvā sāva sarvvāca tīparṣatsadevaḥ mānuṣā suragaruḍa gandharvvaśca loko bhagavato bhāṣita matyanandanniti| āryya dhvajā grakeyaranāma dhāraṇī samāptaṁ|| oṁ namaḥ śrī mahāsamvarāya|| pūrvvavataḍhatiṭhi śūnya tānantaraṁ hūṃ kāroṭbha vaṁ yogiṇī gaṇanākaṁ| bhairavaṁ kāli rātrīnatrca karttikā sūryyā gaupati ritāṇu vaṇna mahākāyaṁ kṛṣṇārddhaha ritārddha kaṁpaṣṭati jujāstasya saptadaśa trirocana jaṭā mekuṭa dharaṁvīraṁ viśvavajārddha candrakaṁ| mahādraṣṭrā kallāro śāṁsa vyāvasaḥ sadā|| nīlāpītāra。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 34 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：hā roṣaṇa samādhi hṛdaya samāptaṁ|| oṁ namaḥ śrī harukāya|| oṁ kroḍhapirgelakeśāya sahamratekṣasyadhara 2 jvāla 2 prajvāla 2 triśūla vyagrahate hara 2 prasara 2 dama 2 gṛntpāpaya 2 sarvva dūṣṭa satvānāṁ nāgānāgarājā nāṁ mūkhaṁ kīlaya 2 śulaṁnośa 2 piṁhanāśaya 2 aśmarāṇāśaya 2 evaṁ sarvva nāśānāṁ nāśaya 2 ekāhikaṁ dayāhikaṁ bhyāhikaṁ cāturthihikaṁ sarvvajvalaṁ sannipātajvalaṁ dūṣṭa jvalaṁ vātikaṁ pittikaṁ śreṣṭikaṁ sannipātikaṁ māsā-ī māsikaṁ sāmvatsarikaṁ evaṁ evaṁ sarva rogāna nāśaya 2 hūṃ śrī akṣotya vajarupamama sarvvasatvā nātrca śānti kūra 2 svāhā|| āryya śrī heru kaspaprasavaroganāmadhāraṇī samāptaṁ|| oṁ namo bhagavatyai āryyavajavārārṣke|| tadyathā|| oṁ namā bhagavati vajavārā hi āryya parājite trailokya mātre mahāvaidye sarvvabhūta yāvaha mahāvaja vajāmane ajite parājite vaśāṁkarane。

verses.iast: oṃ caṇu mahāroṣaṇa dya dya dyāṭa sarvvadūṣṭāyendrāsa parivārāna kīlaya hūṃ phaṭ

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! awakened conduct beyond flux & conflict-free peace (imperative seal), great + angry, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising again and again, generosity & self-mastery & supreme vehicle of awakening & cutting rigid pride, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, accessory + breath, pin down with the vajra-stake! Hūṃ! Phaṭ!

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！妙行迁变空·无我大慈三昧·离诸诤论无诤，摧尊，被他所胜尊，再三啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·威神增益圆满·大空菩提点摄持），拥护、守护，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 35 品（罗马转写本 820/2949）。跋文：gaḥ rājaruṣya vrailokya da mahamūdra rośanegrasa 2 hūṃ pha vīcāddhe te hūṃ hā 2 mahāyaśu mahāniyā gauritvaṁ ḍākiṇi lokānāṁ vandani saṁghaḥ pratyaya kālini hūṃ pha|| bhūta trāsani mahāvīra parama siddha vidyai hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā|| valimantraḥ|| oṁ namo vajavārahī|| oṁ sarva ṣṭāna hūṃ phaṭ|| svāhā|| oṁ vajavārāhī āveśaya sarvvadūṣṭān svāhā|| upahṛdaya|| oṁ phū hrīṁ hāṃ|| hṛdayaḥ| oṁ a hriṁ hūṃ hā hūṃ|| ārya mahāmāyā vajavārāhī nāmadhāraṇī samāptā|| 31|| oṁ namaḥ śrīnairātmā mahādevyai|| oṁ namo bhagavatyai neṁ rairātmā dervye vajavirā śiniya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ|| oṁ namaḥ sarvva bhūta bhayāvahe mahāvaje hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ|| oṁ namo vajāsana akṣite aparājite vaśvaṁkara netratomani hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ| oṁ namaḥ jayāvijayā jambha nimbha vi mohāni。

verses.iast: namaḥ samanta buddhānāṃmahā jārgulī hṛdaya nāma tathāgatāyorhate samyūkkaṃ buddhāya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼普遍、周遍十方·没驮南大·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢·妙行趣入·心、心髓、根本心咒·名为、号曰·真如实际·无住安立·妙行趣入·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·一乘如实之道·佛陀、觉者！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to universal, all-encompassing, buddhānām, great, transcending birth & victorious & stainless purity free from dust & awakened spiritual movement, heart, core essence, heart-mantra, by name, called, immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise & awakened spiritual movement (vocative invocation), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme vehicle of awakening, Buddha, the Awakened One!

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:

verses.iast: sarvva paramantra vandhaya surendra juvaṇavandhaya mahācṭakṣi vandhaya iha vāsināṃdhāraya yenake nacit
verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，钵啰么怛啰，一样饮用，自在主神明，礼敬赞叹·生起不可得·尊胜，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，一样饮用，于此、今于此处，总持任持·最上真言离言说，一乘如实之道·离名相假立·造作离相，不感觉
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, paramantra, te + sucking, lord of gods, venerating, great (vocative invocation), te + sucking, here, in this world/place, upholding, supreme vehicle of awakening & beyond nominal designation & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation), not + perceive

verses.devanagariOriginal: सर्व्व परमन्त्र वन्धय सुरेन्द्र जुवणवन्धय महाच्टक्षि वन्धय इह वासिनांधारय येनके नचित्

verses.iast: bhayādikaṃ chedya bhedya śiri piri hūṃ phūṭ namastu te svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 怖畏第一，断截，开除，头尊，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢，吽（金刚心印）！吒字门（断除憍慢执障（ṭaṅka）·威神增益圆满），不顶首，向汝、彼等，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Fear + first, cutting, to be cleft or pierced, śiri, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), Hūṃ! cutting rigid pride (ṭaṅka) — perfected spiritual vigor, not + head, to Thee / they, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.devanagariOriginal: भयादिकं छेद्य भेद्य शिरि पिरि हूं फूट् नमस्तु ते स्वाहा

verses.iast: iti āryya jārgulī hṛdaya nāmadhāraṇī samāptaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 如是（结句印定），圣、尊贵圣者，生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢·妙行趣入，心、心髓、根本心咒，名为陀罗尼，三磨钵耽
verses.meaningEn: Thus, so it is stated, noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), transcending birth & victorious & stainless purity free from dust & awakened spiritual movement, heart, core essence, heart-mantra, by name + Dhāraṇī, finished, complete, perfect

verses.devanagariOriginal: इति आर्य्य जार्गुली हृदय नामधारणी समाप्तं

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！归命，施度调伏·本性寂静止息·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to generosity & self-mastery & primordial tranquil peace & freedom from karmic agency (reverent offering)

verses.iast: yanmāntaka prajñāntaka padmāntaka ka-acalavīra tarkkirājanīla mahāvala uṣī ṣacakra sumbharājaḥ sarvva kroḍhetyaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 一乘如实之道·离名相假立·无我大慈三昧，聪明下贱，莲华下贱，迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·本不生体性），不动明王勇猛丈夫，假定·散射·来诣·绀青，大发，六度满行清净，六度满行清净·妙行迁变空·造作离相，孙婆来诣，一切、普皆遍满，造作离相·清净离诸尘垢·法鼓觉悟
verses.meaningEn: Supreme vehicle of awakening & beyond nominal designation & selfless great loving-kindness, intelligent + destructions, lotus flower + destructions, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — primordial non-arising, Acala + heroic, suppose + scattering + coming from or belonging to goats + sapphire-blue, great + giving clothes to the naked, perfection of the six pāramitās, perfection of the six pāramitās & awakened conduct beyond flux & freedom from karmic agency, coming from or belonging to goats, all, every, complete, freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust & awakening Dharma-drum resonance

verses.devanagariOriginal: यन्मान्तक प्रज्ञान्तक पद्मान्तक क-अचलवीर तर्क्किराजनील महावल उषी षचक्र सुम्भराजः सर्व्व क्रोढेत्यः

verses.iast: pūrvva dakṣiṇa paścimottara agne vāyave iśāne naiṛte adha-ūrdhvamete daśadigmā lān
verses.meaningZh: 本，右，西无上，妙行趣入·离名相假立，向风、风大命息，伊舍尼尊，离名相假立·真如实际，下，上此等诸尊，施度调伏·本性寂静止息·妙行趣入，曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·远离寂静周遍）
verses.meaningEn: Former, right, lowest + upper, awakened spiritual movement & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), to wind, vital air, O Isana / in Isana, beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), then, so, and but, therefore, accordingly, these, generosity & self-mastery & primordial tranquil peace & awakened spiritual movement, beyond nominal designation (nāma) — expansive quiescence

verses.devanagariOriginal: पूर्व्व दक्षिण पश्चिमोत्तर अग्ने वायवे इशाने नैऋते अध-ऊर्ध्वमेते दशदिग्मा लान्

verses.iast: indra yamavarulaku vairādi agni vvayavo īśānādhipatiḥ naiṛtyā disaka lamālāḥ śrī guruvaja mājñā
verses.meaningZh: 因陀逻，一乘如实之道·无我大慈三昧·最上真言离言说，怨元，圣火、智火（火大），最上真言离言说·一乘如实之道，自在主控制器，离名相假立·真如实际·一乘如实之道，施度调伏·一切诸谛圆满·造作离相，不过诸衍伸，吉祥、圣德威光，一样能化山羊，勿觉知
verses.meaningEn: Śakra king of the gods, supreme vehicle of awakening & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme ineffable speech (imperative seal), enmity + beginning, fire, sacred flame (Agni), supreme ineffable speech & supreme vehicle of awakening, owning + controller, beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening, generosity & self-mastery & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from karmic agency, only + spawn, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, like the teacher + drift, do not + know

verses.devanagariOriginal: इन्द्र यमवरुलकु वैरादि अग्नि व्वयवो ईशानाधिपतिः नैऋत्या दिसक लमालाः श्री गुरुवज माज्ञा

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第39品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (39): ka yavāk cittena

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 39 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：ka yavāk cittena|| tadyathā|| māraya 2 kāraya 2 garjjaya 2 s-hoṭhaya 2 dyāṭaya 2 sarvvaduṣṭānnā śaya 2 hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phuṭ phuṭ phuṭ phuṭ svāhā|| itri daśa kroṭha nāma dhāraṇī samāptaṁ|| 13|| oṁ namo ratna trayāya|| oṁ namaḥ samanta buddhānāṁmahā pratyagiroṣlīṣa cakra vakṣīrojāya tathāgatāyārhate samyakkaṁ buddhāya|| tadyathā|| sarvva yantravandha 2 indra juvanavandha 2 cṭakṣa devavandha 2 dhāraya 2 iha vāsināṁyenakene cidbhayā dikaṁchindra 2 bhindra 2 ciri 2 girī 2 bhiri 2 hūṃ hūṃ phuṭ phuṭ svāhā|| āryya uṣī cakravartī nāmadhāraṇī samāptaṁ|| 14|| oṁ namo buddhāya|| lokā taṁnamamula vivikta jñāna vedane| yasatvaṁ jaga dvitārtha yakhinnaka ruma yāciraṁ|| skandhamātra vinirmūktona satvo stimite mataṁ| satvārthatrca parikhedaṁ agamasatrcaṁ mahāmune|| tepiskandhā sbhvayādhī。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 42 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：jñānārtha syāvidaḥ svīhṛdayala dhūta yā svacchatāṁvindatīca|| kalyāṇānda siṁdhū prakaṭaśaśikaleśrī bharāṁde driṣṭaṣṭi pūṣṭijñānāya deśekurudhana karuṇaścaṁ sayaścātaṁ maktaḥ| ttvanstotrāṁbhaḥ pavitrīkṛtamanasimathiśreya saṁskāramekaṁ dṛṣṭuṁ yasmāda modhaṁjagati tavaguṇatramātraṁ prajānāṁ|| maṁsulatvaṅjugu ṇodhāvayavamaniyame yatra māptaṁ mayāyatpūṇyaṁ pūṇyādrevāṁchā phala madhura rasāsvāda bhābhakti bhogyam| lokastanāryya lokeśca svaraṇagarasva stikaṁsyāsmi ciṁkrāma krāyāyaṁ prayāyātsūgata sutamahītāstvā va ryāpāsyome|| inyāryyantarā bhaṭṭā rikāyāḥ śragdharāskāśraṁ samāptaṁ|| 90|| oṁ namaḥ śrī āryya ugra tārā yo ekajaṭāyai|| namaḥ śrāvakapraścaka yūśca bodhisatva krorarajāyūśca dharmmasaṁghasyaḥ| namo bhagavate parama gurave mahākāruṇi kāyaśākka mūnaye tathāgato yorhame sampakkaṁ būddhāya|| evaṁ。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 43 品（罗马转写本 820/2949）。跋文：nyasavacanaṁyathā|| yāntrīdhārayake vidyāprasūyaṅuṇī sukhaṁ| apūtrī labhatepūtraṁvyādhi mūkto sukhāśiṇī|| dhanadhānyaiṁ valaiḥ pūṇyāmo nanīyā priyaṁvadā| sūsva prāsavya karī vajiṇakṣataṁ samāpnayātū|| oṁ āḥ rima ha haḥ|| idamavoca dbhavagavānsāya padmamālagiriyarṣa tsadeva mānūṣā suraga ruḍa gandharvva ścalākobhagavato bhāṣita matyanandanniti|| āryyā eka jaṭā nāmadhāraṇī samāptaṁ|| oṁ namaḥ śrīdharmma dhātave|| natvā rktavandhū jūgade kavandhū svayaṁ tubhadrārakamādidevaṁ| jarā-ūjā mṛtyūharai kadakṣaṁkṣyetadddeśamahaṁ samastaṁ|| nepālejagati khyāte gośṛ gonāma parvdataḥ bhedosticaja getassa nāstrācajagabhedakaḥ|| yūgyesatyapanāgirimtetā thāṁvaja kūṭakaḥ| gośṛṅovāpare khyātāḥ kaligopūcha parvataḥ|| gartekālabhaviṣya cavarnta māne pravartate|| itiddeśavāśī。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第44品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (44): asyepūṇya prabhāvena caibhyodvādaśavatsare
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 44: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (44): asyepūṇya prabhāvena caibhyodvādaśavatsare
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §44
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (44)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 44 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：asyepūṇya prabhāvena caibhyodvādaśavatsare|| pañcāmijñā bhilāsīsā bhaviṣyatina saṁśayaḥ|| ityvāca jaga śreṣṭhośākya siṁhojagadguruḥ|| śrutetikāśya pavarābhikṣavo lodhimārgmagāḥ| maitreya pramukhā devā nāgalo kā sūrāḍhyaḥ|| sāca sarvvāvatīparṣadanū godanta-ityalaṁ| idaṁ sūraṁ khalū mānavāṇāṁ sūbūddhā vādyātū vimokṣa mārggaṁ||śṛśrotivāśrākyate maṇūṣyaḥ sayātrinūjaṁ sūgatasya lokaṁ api khalū lokāvāgma tīnāṁ prabhāvanaviditta catākāraciḍhyānti satyaṁ|| taḍhanūsakalamātma sokhyaṁ catuktyā sūgatavara rājyaṁ tuṇūnaṁ prayānti|| itiśrī svayatthūḥ pūrāṇe caitya bhaṭarakoddeśa mahaprabhāvarṇṇano namo-uṣṭhamaḥ paricheda samāptaṁ|| 22|| oṁ namo bhagavatye āryyaśrī vasūdhārāyai|| vasūdhārāṁ sadānatvā dāridrāṇaktāreṇī deśayāgi manūḍhyārthaṁ sarvvadaḥ khapramocanī|| pūrvvaṁ śrī vasūdhārādevī vratasūtraṁ prakāśitaḥ|| kathā pravankāmikṣū yaṁtātāvata。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

verses.meaningEn: Maitreya, Loving-Kindness Bodhisattva, foremost, god, celestial deity (Deva), beyond nominal designation & awakened spiritual movement & freedom from conditioned marks, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — expansive quiescence, the sun

verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & awakened conduct beyond flux, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, godanta, immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening & freedom from conditioned marks

verses.iast: idaṃ sūraṃ khalū mānavāṇāṃ sūbūddhā vādyātū vimokṣa mārggaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 此、此法门，日轮，等虚空无碍·离一切相无相，诸儒童，一切诸谛圆满·解脱系缚大力·施度调伏，最上真言离言说·施度调伏·一乘如实之道，解脱，圣道、解脱正道
verses.meaningEn: This, here, the sun, space-like boundlessness & freedom from conditioned marks, of descended from or relating to Manu, human, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & spiritual strength freeing bonds & generosity & self-mastery, supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery & supreme vehicle of awakening, liberation, path, noble way

verses.devanagariOriginal: इदं सूरं खलू मानवाणां सूबूद्धा वाद्यातू विमोक्ष मार्ग्गं

verses.iast: śṛśrotivāśrākyate maṇūṣyaḥ sayātrinūjaṃ sūgatasya lokaṃ api khalū lokāvāgma tīnāṃ prabhāvanaviditta catākāraciḍhyānti satyaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，无我大慈三昧·离诸诤论无诤·六度满行清净，一切诸谛圆满·一乘如实之道·真如实际，一切诸谛圆满·妙行趣入·真如实际，世间、世界，亦、虽、乃至，等虚空无碍·离一切相无相，离一切相无相·造作离相·最上真言离言说，真如实际·离名相假立，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·破有相福德光，妙行迁变空·真如实际·造作离相，谛、真实不虚语

verses.devanagariOriginal: शृश्रोतिवाश्राक्यते मणूष्यः सयात्रिनूजं सूगतस्य लोकं अपि खलू लोकावाग्म तीनां प्रभावनविदित्त चताकारचिढ्यान्ति सत्यं

verses.iast: taḍhanūsakalamātma sokhyaṃ catuktyā sūgatavara rājyaṃ tuṇūnaṃ prayānti
verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·法鼓觉悟·离名相假立，一切诸谛圆满·等虚空无碍·一乘如实之道，妙行迁变空·真如实际·造作离相，一切诸谛圆满·妙行趣入·真如实际，皇图，真如实际·离诸诤论无诤·离名相假立，乐趣一极
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & awakening Dharma-drum resonance & beyond nominal designation, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & space-like boundlessness & supreme vehicle of awakening, awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness & freedom from karmic agency, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & awakened spiritual movement & immutable Suchness, rājyaṃ, immutable Suchness & conflict-free peace & beyond nominal designation, pleasure + O ultimate

verses.devanagariOriginal: तढनूसकलमात्म सोख्यं चतुक्त्या सूगतवर राज्यं तुणूनं प्रयान्ति

verses.iast: itiśrī svayatthūḥ pūrāṇe caitya bhaṭarakoddeśa mahaprabhāvarṇṇano namo-uṣṭhamaḥ paricheda samāptaṃ

verses.meaningEn: Thus + auspiciousness, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme ineffable speech & supreme vehicle of awakening, full + O command, object of veneration, not-joy + exposition, great, homage to perfection of the six pāramitās & beyond conceptual fabrication & selfless great loving-kindness, wisdom + to cut off, finished, complete, perfect

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，世尊疾速，圣吉祥，总持任持·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to Bhagavān + O hastening, noble + auspiciousness, upholding (vocative invocation)

verses.meaningEn: You + udder + awl, he + having generosity, ferrying across, part + O sacrifice, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & awakening Dharma-drum resonance, a lake + speaking, hole + liberator from forward

verses.devanagariOriginal: वसूधारां सदानत्वा दारिद्राणक्तारेणी देशयागि मनूढ्यार्थं सर्व्वदः खप्रमोचनी

verses.meaningZh: 元，吉祥、圣德威光，你们·胸部·鎚锉·天女，禁界线，转载·有形·趣往
verses.meaningEn: First, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, you + udder + awl + goddess, prohibit, forward + be visible + going

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第47品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (47): prasanna citta sūmanoḥ śucivastrairalaṁkṛtaḥ
titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (47): prasanna citta sūmanoḥ śucivastrairalaṁkṛtaḥ
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 47: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (47): prasanna citta sūmanoḥ śucivastrairalaṁkṛtaḥ
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §47
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (47)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 47 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：prasanna citta sūmanoḥ śucivastrairalaṁkṛtaḥ || teca sarvva priduṣṭātmā upasargga sudāraḥ nanejānsidapraśānyente samastāḥ sarvvamonphatāṁā yuścavardvate puṇyaṁ sarvvapāpaurvimocitaṭha || maṇi sarṣapadūrvābhiḥ ratnākṣala saṁvandarneḥ | vajūbhāchīna puṣpaiśca jalabhā yūrjjakāñcanaṁ || ghaṭaṁturajataṁ vāpiśu vivestuṇavāsitaṁ || eka viṁśativā raṁvāvālamaṣṭhāttaraśataṁ || jayaṃdvaja vidāraṇaṁ mantraṁsnādhāyatpārthivaḥ sadā || evaṁpaśyahi dinātne satata sapadayateśubhaṁ || || ita mavocad bhagavāna vajapāṇirbhāṣita matyāntunniti || iti āryyaśrīvajacidāriṇī hṛdaya mūlamaṁtra dhāraṇī samāpta || 84 || om namo bhagavatyai āryyagavaṇāti hṛdayāyai || sumukhaścai vadantaśya kapirogaja karṇukaṁ likhādaṁsalaścaṇikato ghna rājovināyakaḥ || dhamake karṇaṇādhikṣā bhāracandro gajānana śrī vakratuṇḍaḥ kla varṇṇā helambaskaṁndapūrvva。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 49 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：vitamatyanandanniti || āryyaṣnīvijayamāntāmadhāraṇī parisamāptāṁ || om namo bhagavatyai āryyapūrṣṇa suvatī tārārai || om namo amitābhāya tathāgatāyārhatesamyakkaṁ būddhāya || namo dharmmāyā namomahāsyāthamaprāpataya || vāmanetyīnemesthāmitvāṁnasasyāmivā mane || bhagavatipiśācipūrṇṇa savaripāśa paraśudhāriyā niphakānidabhayānpūtyakṣyante || yānimāni cinmahāmāyāryakecidūpadravāḥ sabūddhā vā tyadyante || sarvāṇitāni vālatai nravātyadayante || tena pāṇtitastadane nastyanasatye vacanenaṁ || jajajaja || etiḥ yantritādhiṣṭhitairmantra padairmasarvvasatvāścarakṣāṁkuru | parimrarhakurūśāntiṁsvastyayarnayaṇu parihārraśamtra parihāraṁviṣadū ṣaṇaṁkuru | agniparihāraṁkuru | udakaparihāraṁ || kāravārddacchedanaṁkurūśīmāvandhakuru || tadayathā || om amṛte amṛtādrave | amṛtasaṁbhave avīṁste aśvaste gemāgara 2 māsara 2 śama。
