titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第50品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (50): praśame sarvvā kāla mṛtyanupaśama sarvvanakṣatra grehadoṣānupaśama sarvva drīṣṭraṇaśvo paśama bhagavati śiciparṇṇasavari
titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (50): praśame sarvvā kāla mṛtyanupaśama sarvvanakṣatra grehadoṣānupaśama sarvva drīṣṭraṇaśvo paśama bhagavati śiciparṇṇasavari
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 50: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (50): praśame sarvvā kāla mṛtyanupaśama sarvvanakṣatra grehadoṣānupaśama sarvva drīṣṭraṇaśvo paśama bhagavati śiciparṇṇasavari
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §50
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (50)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 50 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：praśame sarvvā kāla mṛtyanupaśama sarvvanakṣatra grehadoṣānupaśama sarvva drīṣṭraṇaśvo paśama bhagavati śiciparṇṇasavari || tunna 2 vitunna 2 tuna 2 bhūmule svāhā || om piśāci parṇṇaśavari hrīṁ hūṃ phaṭa piśāci svāhā || āryyaparṇṇaśavarī mahāmārī praśamanīnāmadhāraṇī samāpta || 87 || om namo bhagavatye āryya mārīcyai || evaṁ mayā śrutame kasminsamaye bhagavāna śrāvassyāṁ viharatisma || jetavane'nāthapiṇḍadasthārāme mahātā bhikṣu saṁghena sārdhva mardhva trayodaśa mibhikṣaśataiḥ saṁpakṣalaiśca boddhisatvermahāsatveḥ || tatrakhalu bhagavāna bhikṣa nāmantrayatesma || asmibhikṣa vomārīcīnāma devatā sārsyyācandramasoḥ puratongachati ya || sānadṛśātenagaghate | navadhyatena || namudhyatena || namukhyate | namudhtate || nadaṇḍāte namudyate。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第51品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (51): padravetyaḥ svahā
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 51: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (51): padravetyaḥ svahā
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §51
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (51)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 51 品（罗马转写本 820/2949）。跋文：padravetyaḥ svahā || om namo ratnatrayāya || om bhagavatye āryya mārīcī namaḥ | om vanalavarttarivadari 2 carārivarāha mukhi sarvvadūṣṭānāṁ cakṣamukhavaṇdhare svāhā || āryya mārīcī nāmadhāraṇīpari samāpta || 88 || om namo bhagavatye āryya grahamātṛtakāyai || evammayāśrutame kasminsamaye bhagavāna ḍakavatyī mahānagaryyāṁ aneka devanāga yakṣa gandarvā asūra garuḍa kinnara mahāragā ditya somāṅgarādi būdhavṛhaspati śukra śaniścarādi rokṣaketu bhiraṣṭhā viṁśati nakṣarādi bhistuyamā nāma mahāvaja samayāla ṅkāravyūhādhiṣṭhāno dhiṣṭhite siṁhāsane viharatisma || aneka bodhisatva śatasahaśraisārdhvaṁ || tadyathā || vaja pāṇinācanāma bodhisatvena satve || vajamatināya nāma bodhisatvaśrenamahāsatvena || vaja vandeṇaca nāma bodhisatvena mahāsatvena || vaja vegenaca nāma bodhisatvena mahāsatvena || vaja senenaca nāma bo。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第52品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (52): vanniti praṇabhyānta hiṁtobhavanniti
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 52: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (52): vanniti praṇabhyānta hiṁtobhavanniti
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §52
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (52)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 52 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：vanniti praṇabhyānta hiṁtobhavanniti || idamavocadbhagavānātta manāstecaphiphavaḥ sācasarvāvatī parṣatsa deva mānuṣā sura garuḍa kinnara mahāragā bhagavato bhāṣita satya nandanniti || āryyagṛhamātṛkānāma dhāraṇī samāpta || om namoḥ rāhave || evaṁmayā śṛtamekasminsamayebhagavān aḍakavanyāṁ mahānagaryyā aneka devanāga yakṣa gandharvā sura garuḍa kinnara mahāragā pasmārāditya somāgāra budha bṛhaspati śukra śaniścarā rāhu ketubhiraṣṭāviṁśati bhiśca nakṣatrādi bhistuna māna mahāvajra samayā laṁkādhiṣṭānā dhiṣṭitaṁ siṁhāsane viharatisma || aneka bodhisatvaśata sahastreḥ sārdhva || ramaitreya bodhisatvena mahā。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第53品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (53): ntibhavakisma

translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §53
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (53)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 53 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：ntibhavakisma || satvānāṁ viharayantisma || upadravāntisma || keṣāñcidravyapaharāntisma || kaṁpāñcinprāṇama paharantisma || evasarvvasatvānā mupadraṁṇavāhyantisma || tadadaśeyanuṇa bhagavana dharmma paryyāyacesarvasatvānāṁ raktābhavaṁtisma || om rāhavaya ravi śaśihasrāya khaṅagapheṭakāya urdhva pityalakeśāyaddaṣṭākkatā vikṛtānanāya sarvva bhayarananaya || pūrvarogasāntāyanamo namaḥ rādbhūdevatāya || śāṁntibhavantume sarvva dāvatajā pitajā vāgāśoṣmājā sannipātañcana saṁnitā amṛtapiyāya rāhave sarva vighna prasāntayetu || idamavāhacaha gavantaca vājapāṇyāda yamatya nandanniti || āryyānāhavyagraha śānti upadrava nāma dhāraṇī pari samāptaḥ || om namaḥ śrī āryyakatavai || evammacā śṛtamekasminsamaye aṅkacatyāṁ deva śanāga yakṣa gandharvvāsura guraḍa kinnara mahoragā apasmārāditya somāṅgāla。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 54 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：māyaprasādhayasarvadṛṣṭānaśodhaya sarvaṣāṁcaṇuracaṇḍinī 2 turu 2 sūma 2 mūñca 2 havā hvayabhecābhavya ugrā ugra gape bhagavati sarvasatvānāñca manārathaṁ paripūraya sarva tathāgata samavedhiṣṭhite samaye svāhā || idamavocadbhagavānāta mahāvaja pāṇīmatyarandanniti || āryyaketugrahaśāṁtapaṇāmadhāraṇī pari samāpta || om nako viprāntakāya || viprāṁtakamahāvīra trailovighnarhatāra cilamipi gaurddhakeśasūmerucaudrāgraivapañcakapāla molitāṁnī 2 varṇṇa śusobhitaṁ gajīgagipare sthaṁpradhtālevriṇirocarnalalāvikṣāśurekṣaṇaṁ || nāgakūṇula bhūṣitaṁnānoratna manīṣālā gṛvyadīvya praktoritaṁ sarvarakṣanasaṁpūktaṁ || ṣāṭabhūjadharaṁ nāyaṁda hina karttidaṁvara mahāmādājāgaraṁ vāmakhatvāgaṁprotraṁcarva jamaṅgara yāśadharaṁ | hastimaṣūdharaṁpāda āriḍādhapādayūgaṁhasticarmāśusobhāva, vyāghracarmākāṭhiddardha || hārārdva hālaropūraṁnāgacarmmaśusobhitaṁ dakṣiṇadigaṣṭārtha sarvvasatvaḍa dhālaraṁgītācāryya jabhāsaktaṁdūḥkhanā。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:

verses.iast: om būddha suddha vaja padme sara prasara sāra krīḍya sarvavignāna kuru
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！解脱系缚大力·施度调伏·法界总持任持，一切诸谛圆满·施度调伏·法界总持任持，最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜，莲华（出淤泥而不染清净心）尊，流注周遍、速行护念（萨啰），初升、洪水，心坚，造作离相·清净离诸尘垢·息灭诤怨，一切·闢·超人女性·不，祈请成办羯磨事业（俱噜）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! spiritual strength freeing bonds & generosity & self-mastery & Dharma-realm retention, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & generosity & self-mastery & Dharma-realm retention, supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious, O lotus flower (pure, unstained) / in lotus flower (pure, unstained), flow forth and pervade with blessing! coming forth, rising, appearing, spreading, free course, bold behaviour, maina, freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust & pacifying conflict & turmoil, all + settle + a superhuman female + not, accomplish & enact this sacred work!

verses.iast: mamakāryyācchindaya sarva dūṣṭānakṣapaya śānte dāpaya drutaṃdarśayānmārarakṣarmāsarvasatvanoñca sarvagrahanakṣatrapīḍā bhayānnivādya
verses.meaningZh: 斩断结缚·无我大慈三昧，一切、普皆遍满，施度调伏·六度满行清净·断除憍慢执障，寂静、调柔安稳尊，施度调伏·第一义谛·一乘如实之道，拥护守护·施度调伏，一切·曜执·星宿·逼迫，破有相福德光·一乘如实之道·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Severing, all, every, complete, generosity & self-mastery & perfection of the six pāramitās & cutting rigid pride, O peaceful, calm, tranquil / in peaceful, calm, tranquil, generosity & self-mastery & ultimate truth & supreme vehicle of awakening, protecting, all + planet + constellation + violation, blessedness transcending existence & supreme vehicle of awakening & beyond nominal designation

verses.meaningZh: 世尊佛母！（呼格），酒席、节日
verses.meaningEn: O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! feast, festival

verses.meaningZh: 花样·转载·请成办·一切·牟尼·不·请净除，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，迅疾度脱一切危厄（都噜），一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧，无我大慈三昧·圣智通达·妙行迁变空，火供祀施，因缘空寂大乐·最上真言离言说·一乘如实之道，威猛、大势力，威猛、大势力，妙行趣入·第一义谛，世尊佛母！（呼格）
verses.meaningEn: Trick + forward + accomplish! fulfill! perfect! + all + seer + not + purify! cleanse! all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, swiftly ferry across all perils! all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness, selfless great loving-kindness & non-dual wisdom awareness & awakened conduct beyond flux, sacrifice, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & supreme ineffable speech & supreme vehicle of awakening, mighty, fierce, formidable, mighty, fierce, formidable, awakened spiritual movement & ultimate truth (vocative invocation), O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī!

verses.iast: sarvasatvānāñca manārathaṃ paripūraya sarva tathāgata samavedhiṣṭhite samaye svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，我身能使车，祈请成就，一切、普皆遍满，如来（乘如实道来成正觉），一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·最上真言离言说，向平，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, you were almost cursed by me + waggon, may You filling up, all, every, complete, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), to equal, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme ineffable speech, great, ultimate truth & conflict-free peace & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation)

verses.meaningEn: Upholding, wisdom, finished, complete, perfect

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第55品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (55): saṁnamaskataṁ
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 55: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (55): saṁnamaskataṁ
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §55

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 55 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：saṁnamaskataṁ || advisidviprasādañcarabhairavāṇāṁnamomṛtevedaśunyaddarbhāśaraṁpoṣakṛṣṇaśumaṁñjaṁladaśakroḍhagaṇemūlakroḍarājaṁ namāmyahaṁ || itidaśakroḍadhāraṇī samāptaṁ || om namo bhagavatyai āryyāmahāsāhasrapramardaṇyai || smādamabhedaṁ || siddhasūmidṛsakhearearaścavalemahāvane jāhajaṭilaakhanemakhane laṭekharaṅgaharipiṁgale timigile timiṅgalinirmagale svāhā || sidhontumamamantu padāḥ sarva satvā nāñcaveśracapasyamahārojasyanānnāvalenaiśvaryyādhipate naca svāhā || syādbhedaṁ || akheñnakhevinakhevandhovarāśecapalevūkhevakhane aścinaṁvalebhage bhagandare vaśevaśavarttiṇisvāhā || mūcyantu mamasarvvasatvānāñca sarvagrahetyaḥ dhṛtarāṣṭrasya mahārājasyanāmnābalenaiścaryyādhipate na ca svāhā || syāddyabhedaṁ || kha kha kha me khalane khalā me khalali khe khaṭakhe khaṭine kharalikhara khi karāne karaṭa kālakāminividhali | vidhiyo vidheyā śayano samavato śamiśa。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 56 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：śimesvasti 2 śānti 2 samāgrimama saparivārasthañcamiṣaṁ samsṛṣṭayatha hārenirāmiṣāṁyenadagdha yathā sūtraṁ satyaṁkūrvantu tādṛśaṁsthādathedaṁ kalame kalale khalame agnisaṁkrāmanisvāhā || vipaśvibūddhaśaraṇaṁ upaiti śikhiṅca būddha sūgatañca viśvabhuṁ krakrachandabūddha kanakamūniñca kāśyapaṁ viśaradaśākya mūniñca gautama || etāsaptanarottamānāṁ pūṣpaiśvagandhaiścaśarīrapūjāṁ | kāyenateṣā menasāca bhontu prasannacitta śaraṇacaraṇamūpaiti || eteṣubuddheṣūmaharddhikeṣū || yādevatāsanti abhiprasannaḥ | tādevatā attamano udagrārakṣantume adyapradā pramattāḥ || svastyastu mamasarvva satvānāñca svāhā || ityāryya mahāsāhasrapramadardanī nāmamahāyāna sūtraṁ samāptah || om namo bhagavātyai āryya mahāmāyūryya vidyā rājajñe || namaḥ samyakasaṁbūddhabhyaḥ || samyaksabūddha nānpravarapṛthū kṛpāyā jagūḥ saptasaṁkhyānkrūthākrūro ragendrānkṣatavi |。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

verses.meaningEn: Primordial tranquil peace & selfless great loving-kindness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (vocative invocation), peace, pacification, tranquility, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & awakened spiritual movement, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & perfection of the six pāramitās, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust & beyond nominal designation, just as, according to, sūtraṃ, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening (imperative seal), immutable Suchness & generosity & self-mastery & primordial tranquil peace, O reed, O kalala / in kalala, threshing floor + to me, fire + passing + in + hail! may auspicious accomplishment be sealed

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 57 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：dveṣaścamohaśca etehno ketrayorviṣāḥ || nirvviṣā bhagavāna dharmmā dharma satyahataṁ viṣaṁ || rāgadveṣaśca mohaśca eteloketra yorviṣāḥ | nirvviṣo bhagavānsaṁghasatyahataviṣaṁ || yadvalaṁ buddhānāṁ arhtāṁce vayadyasaḥ | tathāgataspatejena mamasarvva satvatrya kṛtsvastya yanaṁmayā || || āryyamahāmāyūrī vidyārārājñī avinaṣṭāyakṣa prasutvānpratiladdhā samāptāḥ || 3 || ḍeṁnamo bhagavatyai āryya mahāśītavatyai || tadyathā || ajgāvajgāka sijgā bhargāvarajgā saṁsāraṁtajgā bhageṣusurā ekataraṁgā asura | virāta ravīrā- tara 2 vīrākara vīrākara 2 vīrāindrā indra kisarā haṁsā haṁsakisarāpicimālā | mahākivvā | viheṭhikā | kālucchikā | agodarājayā likā | velā elācintāli | cili 2 hili 2 | sumuti va sumati | ralunadre | culū 2 nate 2 nadre | culunadi | kināḍi | hārīṭavirka 2 kāriṭarki。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 58 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：ni | sādhani | vidhani viśodhani | saṁśodhani | saṁkhiraṇi | saṁkiraṇi | saṁcchidani | sādhūtaramāne | taramāne | hanū 2 bandhūmati | hiri 2 khiri 2 khanali | hurū 2 khurū 2 namostu buddhānāṁ bhagavatāṁ svahā || asyā khalu punarāhūlamahāśītavatī vidyāyāṁ | daśottara yadaśatāyām sutregranchiṁ baddhāhastena dhāryya māryā mānāyāṁ kaṇḍena dhāryyamānāyāṁ samantādyo | janaśatasya rakṣākṛto bhavati || īyaṁ khalu yunaḥ mahāśītayatī vidyāyāṁ eka navatyā śaṅ | nadī bālikā samairbbuddhai bhagavat bhirbhāṣitābhāṣiṣyante || āryya mahāśītavatīnāma mahāvidyārājñī parisamāptā || 4 || om namo bhagavatyai āryyamahāpratisarayai || lokārtha siddhi paramaṁbahū ratnavittā dharmmārthakāmamaśa maṁśravanāyadhīrāḥ | āyāṇḍa yakṣāsūradaityasaṁdyāḥ | pūjāvidhānaniratāgaruḍānendrāḥ | āryyāmimāṁ pratisarāṁsmṛtimā。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

verses.meaningEn: Of her, of this deity, indeed, verily, certainly, great, in Vidyā, sacred wisdom-spell, illumination

verses.meaningEn: The eleventh, supreme vehicle of awakening & generosity & self-mastery & primordial tranquil peace, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust, strap + by, to be held, borne, worn, kept, turned, fixed, retained, upheld, supported, observed, with/by plague, pestilence, in opinion, conception, by/through arrow, to be held + in opinion, universal + eatable

verses.meaningEn: People of the world + of hundred, protection + done, becomes, arises, is

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed Mother / Lady Bhagavatī, noble + great + toward + he + to possession

verses.meaningEn: Income + egg, supreme vehicle of awakening & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第59品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (59): amṛta hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā
titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (59): amṛta hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 59: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (59): amṛta hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §59
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (59)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 59 品（罗马转写本 820/2949）。跋文：amṛta hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā || om bhava 2 saṁbhara 2 indriyavalaviśodhane hūṃ hūṃ ru ru ca ce svahā | om maṇidharivajrīṇi mahāpratisare hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svahā || upahṛdaya vidyā || ārya mahāpratisarāyāḥ prathamaḥ kalpa samāptaḥ || 0 || atra mantrapadāsiddhāḥ samyakkaṁ buddhenabhāṣitāḥ || namo buddhāya | namo dhammāya | namaḥ saṁghāya || namo bhagavate śākya munaye mahākāruṇi | kāyatathāgatāyārhate samyakkaṁ buddhāya || namaḥ samantebhyaḥ samyakkaṁ buddhebhyo bhāvanaināṁ namaskṛtya buddha śāranevaddhaye || alamidānīṁ pravakṣāmi sarva satvānūkampajā || īmāṁ vidyāṁmahātejāṁ mahābalaparākramāṁ || yasyāṁ bhāṣita mātrāyāṁmūnināvajama yāśane || mārāśca mārakāyā racagrahāḥ sa。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

verses.iast: sarvatathāgatamūrte pravaravigate bhayasamayasvame bhagavati sarvapāpa svasti bhavantu mama sarvasattvānājya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 一切如来坚硬，最妙离，怖畏·三昧耶·自·于我，世尊佛母！（呼格），一切罪业，吉祥安隐、善妙无恙，愿一切皆得安乐成就，我之（行者所有），一切众生·气息·油脂乳糜，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: All Tathagatas + O thickened, cover + O lost, fear + Samaya + own + to me, O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! all + evil, well-being, fortune, auspicious safety, may all be blessed & accomplished! my, of me (the practitioner), all sentient beings + breath + melted or clarified butter, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Muni, silent sage, settle + Muni, dha + leave + bee, O a waist-cloth used by a nun, O one endowed with jerk, wrench, shock, fear + O lost, fear + O bearer of clump

verses.iast: bodhi bodhaya buddhira cumbini sarvatathāgata hṛdaya, jaṣṭe svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 菩提、无上正觉，请开晓觉悟、令发菩提觉智！觉悟正觉·解脱系缚大力，妙行迁变空·无我大慈三昧·解脱系缚大力，一切如来，心、心髓、根本心咒，生起不可得·尊胜·六度满行清净·断除憍慢执障，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Bodhi, awakening, enlightenment, awaken! enlighten! illuminate! awakened, awakened conduct beyond flux & selfless great loving-kindness & spiritual strength freeing bonds (vocative invocation), all Tathagatas, heart, core essence, heart-mantra, transcending birth & victorious & perfection of the six pāramitās & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: om munira munivare abhiṣiñca tu māṃ sarva sattvānāñca sarvatathāgatāḥ sarvavidyābhiṣekarmahakavacamudrāmuditaiḥ sarvatathāgatahṛdayādhiṣṭhite vaje svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢，牟尼殊胜，请以甘露灌顶加持！然而、而、实则，我，一切、普皆遍满，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·最上真言离言说，诸一切如来，以诸一切圣智·灌物·酒席·护身甲胄·手印·波牟提陀，一切如来·心·所加持，最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust, Muni + O choicest, consecrate! anoint with nectar! but, indeed, moreover, me (the practitioner), all, every, complete, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech, all Tathagatas (plural), all knowledge + feast + armor + Mudrā + by, all Tathagatas + heart + O blessed, supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 60 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：ha śānti svāhā || om bhūḥ om bhūri bhūri rivaja vati sarvva tathāgata hṛdaya yuriṇi āyuḥ saṁdhāriṇi vala vala vatija yavidye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phū ṭ svāhā || om maṇidharivajīṇi mahāprasare hūṃ hūṃ pha ṭ pha ṭ svāhā || namaḥ sarvva tathāgatetyāye 2 pitiṣṭhaṁtidaśa sudikṣa || om maṇi vaje hṛdaya vajemārasainya vidāriṇihana 2 sarvva śatrun rakṣa 2 mamaśarīraṁ sarva savvānāñca 2 vaje 2 vaja garvbha 2 || trāsatya 2 sadharmāra bhavanāni hūṃ hūṃ pha ṭ pha ṭ pha sambhara sambhara svāhā || buddha sarvva tathāgata kalyādhiṣṭhite sarvva karmmā ca raṇānyapanaya svāhā || āryya mahāpratisarāyāḥ mahāvidyārājñāḥ rakṣā vidhāna kalpaḥ samāptaḥ || 95 || om namo bhagavatyai āryya mahāmantrā ||。

verses.meaningZh: 一切见，破有相福德光·一乘如实之道·真如实际，一切、普皆遍满，人，人，向诸怖畏、灾难惊恐，向诸一切病患，最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜
verses.meaningEn: All + innumerable different courses of all states-of-existence which are based on, blessedness transcending existence & supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness, all, every, complete, person, person, to all fear, peril, danger, dread, all + to, supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious

verses.meaningZh: 速，持守摄受·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: Hastening, quick, bearing (vocative invocation)

verses.iast: hili mili kili cili sili vara varade
verses.meaningZh: 定慧摄持、心无散乱（希利），契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利），金刚橛威神警觉、摧伏魔军（吉栗），积集一切白净善法功德（唧哩），春莺，殊胜、胜愿、妙好，施愿者、满善愿尊尊
verses.meaningEn: Meditative absorption & steadfast mindfulness, intimate union with the deity samādhi, vajra-kīla transfixing obstacles & awakening, gathering pure Dharmic merits & radiance, sili, choicest, supreme boon, excellent, O boon-granting, wish-bestowing / in boon-granting, wish-bestowing

verses.devanagariOriginal: हिलि मिलि किलि चिलि सिलि वर वरदे

verses.meaningZh: 一切处、普皆周遍，胜伏、最胜吉祥！离一切相无相·解脱系缚大力·法界总持任持，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Everywhere, at all times & places, conquer! victory! freedom from conditioned marks & spiritual strength freeing bonds & Dharma-realm retention (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，罪业、恶不善业，闢具出租尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, evil, karmic sin, unwholesome deed, settle + O bearer of rent, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，病患具请摄取，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, illness + O bearer of carry away ! remove! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 海众、积集尊，自如是宣说
verses.meaningEn: O bringing or putting together, bringing about, performing, own + spoke

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，怖畏夺尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, fear + O carrying, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: svasti bhavantu mama sarva satvānāñca svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 吉祥安隐、善妙无恙，愿一切皆得安乐成就，我之（行者所有），一切、普皆遍满，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·最上真言离言说，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Well-being, fortune, auspicious safety, may all be blessed & accomplished! my, of me (the practitioner), all, every, complete, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.devanagariOriginal: स्वस्ति भवन्तु मम सर्व सत्वानाञ्च स्वाहा

verses.meaningZh: 扇底迦（息灾吉祥法），啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·诸根清净自在），不动尊威猛降魔心印，嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk
verses.meaningEn: Pacifying, rite of pacification (Śāntika), stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — purified faculties, Acala Vidyārāja wrathful compassion seed syllable, supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu

verses.meaningZh: 增益大象尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Nourishment + O an elephant, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·离一切相无相·解脱系缚大力，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & freedom from conditioned marks & spiritual strength freeing bonds (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: om jayatu jaya vatika male vimale svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！愿胜伏、最胜吉祥！胜伏、最胜吉祥！最上真言离言说·真如实际·造作离相，垢染、尘垢瑕疵尊，毘磨利，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! may it conquer! victory!! conquer! victory! supreme ineffable speech & immutable Suchness & freedom from karmic agency, O stain, impurity, defilement / in stain, impurity, defilement, pure, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.devanagariOriginal: ॐ जयतु जय वतिक मले विमले स्वाहा

verses.meaningZh: 广大、宽博无量尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: O vast, extensive, abundant, profound / in vast, extensive, abundant, profound, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: ha śānti svāhā || om bhūḥ om bhūri bhūri rivaja vati sarvva tathāgata hṛdaya yuriṇi āyuḥ saṁdhāriṇi vala vala vatija yavidye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phū ṭ svāhā || om maṇidharivajīṇi mahāprasare hūṃ hūṃ pha ṭ pha ṭ svāhā || namaḥ sarvva tathāgatetyāye 2 pitiṣṭhaṁtidaśa sudikṣa || om maṇi vaje hṛdaya vajemārasainya vidāriṇihana 2 sarvva śatrun rakṣa 2 mamaśarīraṁ sarva savvānāñca 2 vaje 2 vaja garvbha 2 || trāsatya 2 sadharmāra bhavanāni hūṃ hūṃ pha ṭ pha ṭ pha sambhara sambhara svāhā || buddha sarvva tathāgata kalyādhiṣṭhite sarvva karmmā ca raṇānyapanaya svāhā || āryya mahāpratisarāyāḥ mahāvidyārājñāḥ rakṣā vidhāna kalpaḥ samāptaḥ || 95 || om namo bhagavatyai āryya mahāmantrā ||

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，如来（乘如实道来成正觉），无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, selfless great loving-kindness & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: āyuḥ saṃdhāriṇi vala vala vatija yavidye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phū ṭ

verses.meaningEn: Life-force, longevity, O holder of saṃ, giving clothes to the naked again and again, supreme ineffable speech & immutable Suchness & transcending birth & victorious, supreme vehicle of awakening & supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery (vocative invocation), Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ! fruition of enlightenment (phala) — perfected spiritual vigor, cutting rigid pride (ṭaṅka) — primordial non-arising

verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 61 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：āryyamarakṣā mahāmantrānusāriṇī mahāvidyārājñī parisamāptā || 8 || om namobhagavatyai āryya mahāpratyaṁṅirāyai || eva mmayā śṛtamaikasmitsameya bhagavāna deveṣutrayatti śeṣu viharatisma || sudharmmāyāṁdeva sabhāyāṁmahatā bhikṣū saṁghena sārdhdha pañcamātrai bhikṣaśatraiḥ | mahātāca bodhi satvagaṇena sārddhaḥ smitansamaye samvahulai deveṣu bhagantaparyyuṁ pīśayantisma || tatrakhalu bhagavāna | buddhāsanvahuṇṇā | kośādimānimanupadāniśca rasisma || namobhagavate aparitā guṇa pratibhāna vyuhātīta kalpāya | ta | tathāgatāyā rhate samyaksaṁ buddhāya || namo bhagavate guṇaratna śrī vyūha te jorāśikalpāyatathāgatāyarhate samyasaṁ buddhāya || namobhagavate dharmma。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 62 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：nāsteca bhikṣa va bodhisatva mahāsatvasāca sarvāvatīparṣatsa deva mānuṣā sura garuḍa gandharvaśca loko bhagavato | bhāṣitama tyanandanniti || āryā sarvatathāgatoṣṇīṣa śitātapatrenāmāparājitā mahāpratyaṁgirā mahāvipyā rājñī parisamāptaḥ || vijayavāhi || 0 || om namo bhagatyaiāryya mahāmāyā vikṣayavāhinye || evaṁ mayā śutamekasminsamaye bhagavāna vaiśravaṇayuryyāṁ suvarṇṇaṁ śṛṁge parvata śikhare viharatisma | anekai devanāgayakṣa gandharvvā sūra garuḍa kinnara maroraga viharatirapsarā dibhistuyamānā dharmmā loka mukhaṁnāma dharmmaparyyā yaṁ deśayāmāsa | athanārāyaṇo surairjitaḥ。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！一切、普皆遍满，如来佛顶肉髻相，最上真言离言说·离一切相无相·造作离相，一乘如实之道·清净离诸尘垢·法界总持任持，生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢·一切诸谛圆满

verses.iast: om jvala prajvala dhaka baddha vidhra chinda bhinda hūṃ phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞），请极炽盛放光、朗照无余！法界总持任持·造作离相，带子、丁字裤，最上真言离言说·法界总持任持·清净离诸尘垢，断除烦恼结使缠缚（嗔陀），劈破无明坚固执障（牝陀），吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! blaze forth with wisdom radiance! blaze brightly! shine forth intensely! Dharma-realm retention & freedom from karmic agency, strap, thong, supreme ineffable speech & Dharma-realm retention & stainless purity free from dust, sever every fetter and hostile spell! cleave asunder stubborn ignorance! Hūṃ! Phaṭ!

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！智慧猛火（净除业障火）尊，不动明王、不动摇尊，诸人于我，勇猛丈夫、无畏英雄尊尊，寂静温和、慈柔如月尊，一切、普皆遍满，佛陀、觉者，离名相假立·法界总持任持·六度满行清净，一切、普皆遍满，真如实际·无住安立·妙行趣入
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O sacred fire, purifying flame / in sacred fire, purifying flame, O Acala, Immovable Wisdom King / steadfast / in Acala, Immovable Wisdom King / steadfast, a degraded Kṣatriya + to me, O heroic, valiant, fearless hero / in heroic, valiant, fearless hero, O gentle, serene, lunar-calm, benign / in gentle, serene, lunar-calm, benign, all, every, complete, Buddha, the Awakened One, beyond nominal designation & Dharma-realm retention & perfection of the six pāramitās (vocative invocation), all, every, complete, immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise & awakened spiritual movement

verses.iast: śītāta patre sarva duṣṭa prabuṣṭhānāṃ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 本性寂静止息·真如实际，第一义谛·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，一切、普皆遍满，暴恶者、恶心障难，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·解脱系缚大力，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Primordial tranquil peace & immutable Suchness, ultimate truth & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), all, every, complete, wicked, corrupted, malevolent, hostile, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & spiritual strength freeing bonds, Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: om huṃ māṃ huṃ nāṃ svāhā

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! vajra seed syllable Huṃ, me (the practitioner), vajra seed syllable Huṃ, beyond nominal designation (nāma) — expansive quiescence sealed with bodhicitta bindu, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: nāsteca bhikṣa va bodhisatva mahāsatvasāca sarvāvatīparṣatsa deva mānuṣā sura garuḍa gandharvaśca loko bhagavato | bhāṣitama tyanandanniti || āryā sarvatathāgatoṣṇīṣa śitātapatrenāmāparājitā mahāpratyaṁgirā mahāvipyā rājñī parisamāptaḥ || vijayavāhi || 0 || om namo bhagatyaiāryya mahāmāyā vikṣayavāhinye || evaṁ mayā śutamekasminsamaye bhagavāna vaiśravaṇayuryyāṁ suvarṇṇaṁ śṛṁge parvata śikhare viharatisma | anekai devanāgayakṣa gandharvvā sūra garuḍa kinnara maroraga viharatirapsarā dibhistuyamānā dharmmā loka mukhaṁnāma dharmmaparyyā yaṁ deśayāmāsa | athanārāyaṇo surairjitaḥ
verses.devanagariOriginal: ॐ हुं मां हुं नां स्वाहा

verses.iast: sarvva buddha bodhisatvānātrya sarvāya dṛve ṣusarggeśu tri japtavyā iti
verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，佛陀、觉者，菩提觉知·解脱系缚大力，向一切、普皆遍满，施度调伏·最上真言离言说，六度满行清净·一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢，三，耳语勇健，如是（结句印定）
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, Buddha, the Awakened One, awakening, to/for all, every, complete, generosity & self-mastery & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), perfection of the six pāramitās & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust (imperative seal), three, whisper + strong, thus, so it is stated
verses.tangNoteZh: nāsteca bhikṣa va bodhisatva mahāsatvasāca sarvāvatīparṣatsa deva mānuṣā sura garuḍa gandharvaśca loko bhagavato | bhāṣitama tyanandanniti || āryā sarvatathāgatoṣṇīṣa śitātapatrenāmāparājitā mahāpratyaṁgirā mahāvipyā rājñī parisamāptaḥ || vijayavāhi || 0 || om namo bhagatyaiāryya mahāmāyā vikṣayavāhinye || evaṁ mayā śutamekasminsamaye bhagavāna vaiśravaṇayuryyāṁ suvarṇṇaṁ śṛṁge parvata śikhare viharatisma | anekai devanāgayakṣa gandharvvā sūra garuḍa kinnara maroraga viharatirapsarā dibhistuyamānā dharmmā loka mukhaṁnāma dharmmaparyyā yaṁ deśayāmāsa | athanārāyaṇo surairjitaḥ
verses.devanagariOriginal: सर्व्व बुद्ध बोधिसत्वानात्र्य सर्वाय दृवे षुसर्ग्गेशु त्रि जप्तव्या इति

verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·无我大慈三昧·最上真言离言说，离名相假立·破有相福德光·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme ineffable speech, beyond nominal designation & blessedness transcending existence & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: nāsteca bhikṣa va bodhisatva mahāsatvasāca sarvāvatīparṣatsa deva mānuṣā sura garuḍa gandharvaśca loko bhagavato | bhāṣitama tyanandanniti || āryā sarvatathāgatoṣṇīṣa śitātapatrenāmāparājitā mahāpratyaṁgirā mahāvipyā rājñī parisamāptaḥ || vijayavāhi || 0 || om namo bhagatyaiāryya mahāmāyā vikṣayavāhinye || evaṁ mayā śutamekasminsamaye bhagavāna vaiśravaṇayuryyāṁ suvarṇṇaṁ śṛṁge parvata śikhare viharatisma | anekai devanāgayakṣa gandharvvā sūra garuḍa kinnara maroraga viharatirapsarā dibhistuyamānā dharmmā loka mukhaṁnāma dharmmaparyyā yaṁ deśayāmāsa | athanārāyaṇo surairjitaḥ

verses.iast: nāsteca bhikṣa va bodhisatva mahāsatvasāca sarvāvatīparṣatsa deva mānuṣā sura garuḍa gandharvaśca loko bhagavato

verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness, blessedness transcending existence & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās, supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — primordial non-arising, Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, great + equally + fat + and all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, god, celestial deity (Deva), Human Realm, god, goddess, Garuḍa, golden-winged bird king, and world, realm, Bhagavān + hence
verses.tangNoteZh: nāsteca bhikṣa va bodhisatva mahāsatvasāca sarvāvatīparṣatsa deva mānuṣā sura garuḍa gandharvaśca loko bhagavato | bhāṣitama tyanandanniti || āryā sarvatathāgatoṣṇīṣa śitātapatrenāmāparājitā mahāpratyaṁgirā mahāvipyā rājñī parisamāptaḥ || vijayavāhi || 0 || om namo bhagatyaiāryya mahāmāyā vikṣayavāhinye || evaṁ mayā śutamekasminsamaye bhagavāna vaiśravaṇayuryyāṁ suvarṇṇaṁ śṛṁge parvata śikhare viharatisma | anekai devanāgayakṣa gandharvvā sūra garuḍa kinnara maroraga viharatirapsarā dibhistuyamānā dharmmā loka mukhaṁnāma dharmmaparyyā yaṁ deśayāmāsa | athanārāyaṇo surairjitaḥ
verses.devanagariOriginal: नास्तेच भिक्ष व बोधिसत्व महासत्वसाच सर्वावतीपर्षत्स देव मानुषा सुर गरुड गन्धर्वश्च लोको भगवतो

verses.meaningZh: 宣说演畅·破有相福德光，真如实际·一乘如实之道·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Speaking, immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation)

verses.iast: āryā sarvatathāgatoṣṇīṣa śitātapatrenāmāparājitā mahāpratyaṃgirā mahāvipyā rājñī parisamāptaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 圣、尊贵圣者，一切如来佛顶肉髻相，尖锐·繖·勇健·在家·被他所胜，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，大·闢·膨胀，清净离诸尘垢·生起不可得·尊胜·圣智通达，用完、圆满
verses.meaningEn: Noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), all Tathagatas + Uṣṇīṣa, whetted + a large umbrella + strong + at home + conquered, great, great + settle + swell, stainless purity free from dust & transcending birth & victorious & non-dual wisdom awareness, finished, perfect
verses.tangNoteZh: nāsteca bhikṣa va bodhisatva mahāsatvasāca sarvāvatīparṣatsa deva mānuṣā sura garuḍa gandharvaśca loko bhagavato | bhāṣitama tyanandanniti || āryā sarvatathāgatoṣṇīṣa śitātapatrenāmāparājitā mahāpratyaṁgirā mahāvipyā rājñī parisamāptaḥ || vijayavāhi || 0 || om namo bhagatyaiāryya mahāmāyā vikṣayavāhinye || evaṁ mayā śutamekasminsamaye bhagavāna vaiśravaṇayuryyāṁ suvarṇṇaṁ śṛṁge parvata śikhare viharatisma | anekai devanāgayakṣa gandharvvā sūra garuḍa kinnara maroraga viharatirapsarā dibhistuyamānā dharmmā loka mukhaṁnāma dharmmaparyyā yaṁ deśayāmāsa | athanārāyaṇo surairjitaḥ
verses.devanagariOriginal: आर्या सर्वतथागतोष्णीष शितातपत्रेनामापराजिता महाप्रत्यंगिरा महाविप्या राज्ञी परिसमाप्तः

verses.meaningZh: 最胜尊胜运尊
verses.meaningEn: Supreme victory! triumph! + O transport
verses.tangNoteZh: nāsteca bhikṣa va bodhisatva mahāsatvasāca sarvāvatīparṣatsa deva mānuṣā sura garuḍa gandharvaśca loko bhagavato | bhāṣitama tyanandanniti || āryā sarvatathāgatoṣṇīṣa śitātapatrenāmāparājitā mahāpratyaṁgirā mahāvipyā rājñī parisamāptaḥ || vijayavāhi || 0 || om namo bhagatyaiāryya mahāmāyā vikṣayavāhinye || evaṁ mayā śutamekasminsamaye bhagavāna vaiśravaṇayuryyāṁ suvarṇṇaṁ śṛṁge parvata śikhare viharatisma | anekai devanāgayakṣa gandharvvā sūra garuḍa kinnara maroraga viharatirapsarā dibhistuyamānā dharmmā loka mukhaṁnāma dharmmaparyyā yaṁ deśayāmāsa | athanārāyaṇo surairjitaḥ

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to blessedness transcending existence & awakened spiritual movement & immutable Suchness, the Great Illusion, supreme ineffable speech & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās (vocative invocation)

verses.iast: evaṃ mayā śutamekasminsamaye bhagavāna vaiśravaṇayuryyāṃ suvarṇṇaṃ śṛṃge parvata śikhare viharatisma
verses.meaningZh: 如是、如此，由我（具格：如是我闻），本性寂静止息·真如实际·无我大慈三昧，出有坏不，最上真言离言说·本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢，金，本性寂静止息·妙行趣入，山，山尖，一切矣
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in this way, by me, primordial tranquil peace & immutable Suchness & selfless great loving-kindness (reverent offering), not, supreme ineffable speech & primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust, suvarṇṇaṃ, primordial tranquil peace & awakened spiritual movement (vocative invocation), joint, O peaked, lives + particle to express certainty
verses.tangNoteZh: nāsteca bhikṣa va bodhisatva mahāsatvasāca sarvāvatīparṣatsa deva mānuṣā sura garuḍa gandharvaśca loko bhagavato | bhāṣitama tyanandanniti || āryā sarvatathāgatoṣṇīṣa śitātapatrenāmāparājitā mahāpratyaṁgirā mahāvipyā rājñī parisamāptaḥ || vijayavāhi || 0 || om namo bhagatyaiāryya mahāmāyā vikṣayavāhinye || evaṁ mayā śutamekasminsamaye bhagavāna vaiśravaṇayuryyāṁ suvarṇṇaṁ śṛṁge parvata śikhare viharatisma | anekai devanāgayakṣa gandharvvā sūra garuḍa kinnara maroraga viharatirapsarā dibhistuyamānā dharmmā loka mukhaṁnāma dharmmaparyyā yaṁ deśayāmāsa | athanārāyaṇo surairjitaḥ
verses.devanagariOriginal: एवं मया शुतमेकस्मिन्समये भगवान वैश्रवणयुर्य्यां सुवर्ण्णं शृंगे पर्वत शिखरे विहरतिस्म

verses.iast: anekai devanāgayakṣa gandharvvā sūra garuḍa kinnara maroraga viharatirapsarā dibhistuyamānā dharmmā loka mukhaṃnāma dharmmaparyyā yaṃ deśayāmāsa
verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·造作离相，光明照耀·宝树宝山·药叉，乾闼婆（香音神），日轮，迦楼罗（金翅鸟王），紧那罗（歌神），临危水兽，一切飞天，施度调伏·破有相福德光·一切诸谛圆满，正法、诸法实相，世间、世界，面名为，以正法般，风大自在除障种子，境·夜摩天·床坐
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation), shining + tree or mountain + Yakṣa, Gandharva, celestial musician, the sun, Garuḍa, golden-winged bird king, Kinnara, celestial song-spirit, dying + a snake, lives + apsara, generosity & self-mastery & blessedness transcending existence & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena, world, realm, by name, Dharma + with, Vāyu wind-mandala swiftness seed syllable, part + Yama Heaven + seat
verses.tangNoteZh: nāsteca bhikṣa va bodhisatva mahāsatvasāca sarvāvatīparṣatsa deva mānuṣā sura garuḍa gandharvaśca loko bhagavato | bhāṣitama tyanandanniti || āryā sarvatathāgatoṣṇīṣa śitātapatrenāmāparājitā mahāpratyaṁgirā mahāvipyā rājñī parisamāptaḥ || vijayavāhi || 0 || om namo bhagatyaiāryya mahāmāyā vikṣayavāhinye || evaṁ mayā śutamekasminsamaye bhagavāna vaiśravaṇayuryyāṁ suvarṇṇaṁ śṛṁge parvata śikhare viharatisma | anekai devanāgayakṣa gandharvvā sūra garuḍa kinnara maroraga viharatirapsarā dibhistuyamānā dharmmā loka mukhaṁnāma dharmmaparyyā yaṁ deśayāmāsa | athanārāyaṇo surairjitaḥ
verses.devanagariOriginal: अनेकै देवनागयक्ष गन्धर्व्वा सूर गरुड किन्नर मरोरग विहरतिरप्सरा दिभिस्तुयमाना धर्म्मा लोक मुखंनाम धर्म्मपर्य्या यं देशयामास

verses.meaningZh: 尔时那罗延，报刊往外·所有权·由克服
verses.meaningEn: Now + Narayana, press out + possession + from conquer
verses.tangNoteZh: nāsteca bhikṣa va bodhisatva mahāsatvasāca sarvāvatīparṣatsa deva mānuṣā sura garuḍa gandharvaśca loko bhagavato | bhāṣitama tyanandanniti || āryā sarvatathāgatoṣṇīṣa śitātapatrenāmāparājitā mahāpratyaṁgirā mahāvipyā rājñī parisamāptaḥ || vijayavāhi || 0 || om namo bhagatyaiāryya mahāmāyā vikṣayavāhinye || evaṁ mayā śutamekasminsamaye bhagavāna vaiśravaṇayuryyāṁ suvarṇṇaṁ śṛṁge parvata śikhare viharatisma | anekai devanāgayakṣa gandharvvā sūra garuḍa kinnara maroraga viharatirapsarā dibhistuyamānā dharmmā loka mukhaṁnāma dharmmaparyyā yaṁ deśayāmāsa | athanārāyaṇo surairjitaḥ

verses.meaningZh: 具奇法佛母，诸大手印、大法契印，赫鲁嘎之，广大殊胜·妙行趣入，一切诸谛圆满·最上真言离言说·因缘空寂大乐，顶首、头顶佛冠，打败飞奔，婆喝那，打败飞奔，眼目炽盛燃耀，向汝、彼等
verses.meaningEn: Goddess possessing a small part, a sixteenth of the moon's orb, Mahāmudrā, Great Seal (plural), of Heruka, great (vocative invocation), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme ineffable speech & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, head, crown, overpower + dart, carrying, bringing, overpower + dart, eye + blazing, to Thee / they

verses.devanagariOriginal: कलारिणी महामुद्राः हेरुकस्य ग्रेमहीषि सव्हस्त्र शीर्ष सहस्त्र वाहनं सहस्त्र नेत्रज्वलित ते

verses.iast: sākorā mukhī piṃgalavocanī vajaśarīra vajasya nirmmarī iti
verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·造作离相·清净离诸尘垢，面门、尊颜、法门入口佛母，第一义谛·妙行趣入·离一切相无相，最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·本性寂静止息，最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·一切诸谛圆满，离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧，如是（结句印定）

verses.devanagariOriginal: साकोरा मुखी पिंगलवोचनी वजशरीर वजस्य निर्म्मरी इति

verses.iast: tiri niri haṃ hūṃ kha dhu dhurū murū arha te mahāyoginī pathita siddhe
verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢，不动明王因业清净虚空种子，吽（金刚心印）！佉字门（等虚空无碍（kha）·本不生体性），驮字门（法界总持任持（dhātu，法界总持任持·清净离诸尘垢，无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢，配称，向汝、彼等，乐趣具所行佛母，落利，成就者、已成就尊
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), Acala Vidyārāja & space-element seed syllable, Hūṃ! space-like boundlessness (kha) — primordial non-arising, Dharma-realm retention (dhātu) — dispelling sorrow, Dharma-realm retention & stainless purity free from dust, selfless great loving-kindness & stainless purity free from dust, deserving, worthy, entitled to, to Thee / they, gladden + possessing Bienenschwarm, to fall + put, O accomplished, perfected adept (Siddha) / in accomplished, perfected adept (Siddha)
verses.tangNoteZh: svāhā || āryā mahāvajadhārāhīnāma dhāraṇī parisamāptaḥ || h h || om namaḥ śrī āryya mahāsarasvatai || pūrvvo kvāvidhānena śūnyatāyāḥ vadabhimukhīkṛtvā' dhisyāpayosite kamale saptapadamā' paridhiṣṭhitā śaśimaṇulatmadhye ktūṁ kā ra śu kraṁtena sitakamalaṁ svabījaṁ ba rbhabhāvayat || tena bhagavatī mahāsarasvatī manū cintayet || śarabindūka rāsita kamola paricandramaṇulaṁbhāḥ dakṣiṇa kalevaradā | mevīna sanālalita sarojadharāḥ smaramukhī mukūṭīkaruṇā mayāṁ sveta vandana kusūma me vaṁ vasanadharāṁ || muktāhāra prasābhitahṛdayāḥ nānālaṁkālavatī dvādaśa varṣāṇi kṛtamūdita kūcekūladantarostārha || sphuranadantaga
verses.devanagariOriginal: तिरि निरि हं हूं ख धु धुरू मुरू अर्ह ते महायोगिनी पथित सिद्धे

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: svāhā || āryā mahāvajadhārāhīnāma dhāraṇī parisamāptaḥ || h h || om namaḥ śrī āryya mahāsarasvatai || pūrvvo kvāvidhānena śūnyatāyāḥ vadabhimukhīkṛtvā' dhisyāpayosite kamale saptapadamā' paridhiṣṭhitā śaśimaṇulatmadhye ktūṁ kā ra śu kraṁtena sitakamalaṁ svabījaṁ ba rbhabhāvayat || tena bhagavatī mahāsarasvatī manū cintayet || śarabindūka rāsita kamola paricandramaṇulaṁbhāḥ dakṣiṇa kalevaradā | mevīna sanālalita sarojadharāḥ smaramukhī mukūṭīkaruṇā mayāṁ sveta vandana kusūma me vaṁ vasanadharāṁ || muktāhāra prasābhitahṛdayāḥ nānālaṁkālavatī dvādaśa varṣāṇi kṛtamūdita kūcekūladantarostārha || sphuranadantaga

verses.iast: graṃ graṃ haṃ haṃ haṃ haṃ bhīmahase vilahe hoṃ hoṃ hūṃ
verses.meaningZh: 再三啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），再三不动明王因业清净虚空种子，作怖笑声尊，最上真言离言说·离一切相无相·因缘空寂大乐，再三贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu again and again, Acala Vidyārāja & space-element seed syllable again and again, fearful + O laughter, supreme ineffable speech & freedom from conditioned marks & causal emptiness & spiritual joy (vocative invocation), causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — consecrating Dharma-stream sealed with bodhicitta bindu again and again, Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: svāhā || āryā mahāvajadhārāhīnāma dhāraṇī parisamāptaḥ || h h || om namaḥ śrī āryya mahāsarasvatai || pūrvvo kvāvidhānena śūnyatāyāḥ vadabhimukhīkṛtvā' dhisyāpayosite kamale saptapadamā' paridhiṣṭhitā śaśimaṇulatmadhye ktūṁ kā ra śu kraṁtena sitakamalaṁ svabījaṁ ba rbhabhāvayat || tena bhagavatī mahāsarasvatī manū cintayet || śarabindūka rāsita kamola paricandramaṇulaṁbhāḥ dakṣiṇa kalevaradā | mevīna sanālalita sarojadharāḥ smaramukhī mukūṭīkaruṇā mayāṁ sveta vandana kusūma me vaṁ vasanadharāṁ || muktāhāra prasābhitahṛdayāḥ nānālaṁkālavatī dvādaśa varṣāṇi kṛtamūdita kūcekūladantarostārha || sphuranadantaga
verses.devanagariOriginal: ग्रं ग्रं हं हं हं हं भीमहसे विलहे हों हों हूं

verses.iast: hūṃ trailokyavināṃśanīśata sahastra koṭitathāgata paripārite hūṃ phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 吽（金刚心印）！真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·离一切相无相，打败飞奔，俱胝如来，向般特别器物汝，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Hūṃ! immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from conditioned marks, overpower + dart, ten million + Tathāgata, wisdom + a particular vessel + to Thee, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: svāhā || āryā mahāvajadhārāhīnāma dhāraṇī parisamāptaḥ || h h || om namaḥ śrī āryya mahāsarasvatai || pūrvvo kvāvidhānena śūnyatāyāḥ vadabhimukhīkṛtvā' dhisyāpayosite kamale saptapadamā' paridhiṣṭhitā śaśimaṇulatmadhye ktūṁ kā ra śu kraṁtena sitakamalaṁ svabījaṁ ba rbhabhāvayat || tena bhagavatī mahāsarasvatī manū cintayet || śarabindūka rāsita kamola paricandramaṇulaṁbhāḥ dakṣiṇa kalevaradā | mevīna sanālalita sarojadharāḥ smaramukhī mukūṭīkaruṇā mayāṁ sveta vandana kusūma me vaṁ vasanadharāṁ || muktāhāra prasābhitahṛdayāḥ nānālaṁkālavatī dvādaśa varṣāṇi kṛtamūdita kūcekūladantarostārha || sphuranadantaga
verses.devanagariOriginal: हूं त्रैलोक्यविनांशनीशत सहस्त्र कोटितथागत परिपारिते हूं फट्

verses.iast: siṃharū pākhaṅ rājarupā trailokyadera mahā samudra voṣaṇagrasa hūṃ phaṭ vigrahiteḥ hūṃ
verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢，第一义谛·等虚空无碍·支分寂静，王色相，真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·离一切相无相，大、摩诃（广大无边），大海、生死海，最上真言离言说·六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！威势方位，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust, ultimate truth & space-like boundlessness & quiescence of perceptual limbs, king + form, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from conditioned marks, great, vast, supreme, ocean, boundless sea, supreme ineffable speech & perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace, Hūṃ! Phaṭ! mighty + of direction, Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: svāhā || āryā mahāvajadhārāhīnāma dhāraṇī parisamāptaḥ || h h || om namaḥ śrī āryya mahāsarasvatai || pūrvvo kvāvidhānena śūnyatāyāḥ vadabhimukhīkṛtvā' dhisyāpayosite kamale saptapadamā' paridhiṣṭhitā śaśimaṇulatmadhye ktūṁ kā ra śu kraṁtena sitakamalaṁ svabījaṁ ba rbhabhāvayat || tena bhagavatī mahāsarasvatī manū cintayet || śarabindūka rāsita kamola paricandramaṇulaṁbhāḥ dakṣiṇa kalevaradā | mevīna sanālalita sarojadharāḥ smaramukhī mukūṭīkaruṇā mayāṁ sveta vandana kusūma me vaṁ vasanadharāṁ || muktāhāra prasābhitahṛdayāḥ nānālaṁkālavatī dvādaśa varṣāṇi kṛtamūdita kūcekūladantarostārha || sphuranadantaga
verses.devanagariOriginal: सिंहरू पाखङ् राजरुपा त्रैलोक्यदेर महा समुद्र वोषणग्रस हूं फट् विग्रहितेः हूं

verses.iast: hūṃ hoṃ hoṃ mahāpaśramohinī yoge ḍākiṇī lokavandanī sadyaḥ pratyaya kārirṇā hūṃ
verses.meaningZh: 吽（金刚心印）！再三贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，大·不过·具无癡佛母，修习尊，息灭诤怨·造作离相·离诸诤论无诤，世间敬礼，现生，缘，造作离相·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，吽（金刚心印）！

verses.devanagariOriginal: हूं हों हों महापश्रमोहिनी योगे डाकिणी लोकवन्दनी सद्यः प्रत्यय कारिर्णा हूं

verses.iast: phaṭ bhūtatrāśanī mahāvīre paramasiddhe siddhe hūṃ phaṭ hūṃ pha
verses.meaningZh: 泮吒（摧破魔障）！部多鬼神·守护掩蔽·馔佛母，大勤勇尊，管保不成尊，成就者、已成就尊，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！吽（金刚心印）！颇字门（妙果圆成（phala）·本不生体性）

verses.devanagariOriginal: फट् भूतत्राशनी महावीरे परमसिद्धे सिद्धे हूं फट् हूं फ

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), great (vocative invocation)

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第65品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (65): sarasvataṁsarthipibe sma ptābhimantritaṁ
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 65: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (65): sarasvataṁsarthipibe sma ptābhimantritaṁ
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §65
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (65)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 65 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：sarasvataṁsarthipibe sma ptābhimantritaṁ || caturguṇa ajākṣīre ghṛtamasyaṁ vipācayet || jaiṣa'dhopari kāmātraṁsanaimṛhyabhivāsūdhīḥ | māṣamātraprabhūṁ jītavarṇīṁ prāpnośvanastaraṁ || ṣanmāsaprayogena sākṣādvāgīśvaro bhavet || rutakokila nirghāṣaḥ jāyate bhadhūra svarāḥ | saṁśayāne hūkartyavyāsūcintā bhavaḥ śaktayaḥ || itiśrī sarasvatī nāmadhāraṇī pari samāptaḥ || 100 || om namaḥ ścarmmapūṇulīkāyai || om vajaścaṇṭa āḥ om raṇa'paraṇa' saṁpraraṇa' sarvva buddha pracāriṇī prajñāpāramitā nādasvabhāvaḥ sattoṣaṇa karāya hūṃ phaṭ svāhā || saddharma ṭhārūndhremaṁdha ṇṭhovādana sampanno manuṇadayānyū。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 67 品（罗马转写本 820/2949）。跋文：ptaṁ || 103 || om namośrī lapāla mitā yai || om amogha śrīlapāramitā sambhara' bhara' mahāśrevda satva padma vibhūṣita bhūṁjārtha samantāvalokite hūṃ phaṭ svāhā || iti śīla pāra mitā nāma dhāraṇī samāptaṁ || 104 || om namo kṣānti pāra mitāyai om amogha śīla mahā kṣānti pāramitā valokite vala' samcara' mahāvīryya valajñāna mahābodhyakṣa valabodha niya hūṃ phaṭ svāhā || iti kṣānti pāramitā nāma dhāraṇī samāptaṁ || 105 || om namo vīryya pāramitāyai || om amoghaśīla mahāvīryya pāramitāya kṣādhipati satvakṣamaṇīṣphala' mahāntala mahāmaitrī kārūṇika sarvva satva vatsaramasta。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第68品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (68): karuṇāḥ sarvasatva amanātha hūṃ phaṭ svāhā
titleSanskritIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (68): karuṇāḥ sarvasatva amanātha hūṃ phaṭ svāhā
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 68: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (68): karuṇāḥ sarvasatva amanātha hūṃ phaṭ svāhā
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §68
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (68)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 68 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：karuṇāḥ sarvasatva amanātha hūṃ phaṭ svāhā || itivīryya pāramitā nāma dhāraṇī samāptaṁ || 106 || om namo dhyāna paramitā yai | om sarvatathāgata amogha mahākaṇika dhyāna pāra mitā samādhi sarvasatva vimokṣa aprakamyakaḥ cura 2 dhurū 2 hūṃ 2 phaṭ svāhā || ti dhyāna pāramitā nāma dhāraṇī samāptaṁ || 107 || om namo prajñā pāramitāyai || om namo amāghayā śamamahāprajñā pāyaphsaraṇa buddhi mahābuddhi parasara 2 mahāprasara 2 samanta buddhi avalokite cajña ṣo prajñāpāyadarppadaraṇī mahāprajñā yabhadhāraṇī tukṣa 2 mahānuna hūṃ 2 phaṭ svāhā || itiprajñāpāramitā nāma dhāraṇī samāptaṁ || 108 || om namo bhagava。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

verses.meaningEn: Compassion (plural), all sentient beings, this + refuge, Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 69 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：bhyaiṣadhāra mitāyai || om namo dharmmakāya saṁbhoga kāya nirmmāṇakāya || tadyathā || om dānapāramitā śīlapāramitā kṣāntipāramitā viryyapāramitā dhyānapāramitā prajñāpāramitā sarvvadharmmaśūnyatāca bodhi 2 mahābodhaya hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā || itiṣadadhāra mitā nāma hṛdayadhāraṇī samāptaṁ || 102 || om namoḥ saptasaptīnāṁtathā gatānāṁ samyakkaṁ buddha koṭī nāṁ || tathayā || om cule cule cunde svāhā || iti cunde bhagavanya dhāraṇī pratidinayaḥ śviddhāra ye vdācayenkikhāpayata || aṣṭotbhara vāraṁjayetaṁ || tasyasarvva pāpaṁrikṣayaṁ yānticatu rvarga phalaṁprāpyateti || āryyacundā nāma dhāraṇī samāptaṁ || 110 ||。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第70品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (70): na dhānya hiraṇya suvarṇṇu bhojanaṁca prāpayiṣyanti

translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §70

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 70 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：na dhānya hiraṇya suvarṇṇu bhojanaṁca prāpayiṣyanti || om namo ratnatrayāya || namo mānibhadrāya mahāyakṣasenā pataye saṁpraskitaṁ || om hili 2 māṇibhadrakili 2 māṇibhadra.śici 2 māṇibhadrakurū 2 māṇibhadra surū 2 māṇibhadra. sarvvasīparipuraya || tadyathā || suratkai suratkī sumenpe suratthe sayiṣpe hi limiliki like lika likā li pūrṇṇu dravatī tiri 2 svāhā || āryyajanha harandrasya nāma dhāraṇī samāptaṁ || 111 || om namaḥ śri ugratārāyaiḥ || prakaṭa vikaṭa draṁṣṭayā ghaula rupādra hā sānariśrara kṛta mālāmaighava rṇṇutikharvva | triguṇāja dhātrīkha ṅaga vinyastaka karakalita kapāla pātuvaḥ ugratāroḥ || dhyāmurttī nama stotraḥ dyārarupo。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 71 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：meghavāhi niṭakajāṅli tujaṅme vikaṭakagholū rūpa visphūjjana vijṛmbhane āvāhayāyami sarvva nāgānaṁ sarva buddhādhiṣṭhānena sarvvatryadhva tathāgata satyena travarṣa hajambūdvipe svāhā || namaḥ sarvabuddhebhya | siddhantū mantra pradānime svāhā || āryya mahāmegha nirnnāda vijṛmbhita sūraketū nāma dhāraṇī sarvva buddhabhāṣitaṁ samāptaṁ || 114 || om namo bhagavate śākya munaye || om namo cinye sāgarebhyaḥ samyakkaṁ buddhebhyaḥ || evaṁmayā śrutamekasminsamaye bhagavānnanyo panannadanāgarāja bhavaneviharita sma || śrī maṇīratna garbbha mahāmeghamaṇḍala kūṭāgāre mahatābhikṣū saṁghena sārddhaṁ mahātāca bodhi satvo saṁghena sārddhaṁ mahātā。

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，妙行迁变空·离名相假立·一乘如实之道，向诸大海、功德海，权利之后，向诸佛陀、觉者
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to awakened conduct beyond flux & beyond nominal designation & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), to all ocean, sea, right + or emphasizing particle, to all Buddha, the Awakened One

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第72品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (72): vairocaṇī devīstava strotraṁ
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 72: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (72): vairocaṇī devīstava strotraṁ
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §72
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (72)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 72 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：tamaṇḍālī parivarttayaḥ pañcaṣakṛtamaḥ samāptaḥ || 115 || om namo bhagavatyai āryya śrīvūjavairocanī devyau || davītvameva girijā karmmalā tvameva ṣadamāvatī tvaṁ mamāsitārāṇī devamātā prajñā samūhaḥ balāmṛta pūrṇṇa virajā sahajā svabhāvāḥ | vakratrayāṁta parivārttiyaḥ viśvamātā vidayanprabhāvasvara jñānagamyāḥ tubhyaṁna vajavairocanaṇī devīsvamāyadayadā vichitaṁ siddhidītubhyaṁ namostumamasāva vuṣā girānaḥ || iti śrīvairocaṇī devīstava strotraṁ samāptaṁ || 116 || om namo ratna trayāya || om namaḥ saptānāṁ samyaka saṁbuddhānāṁ bu。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第73品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (73): rāyā samyakkaṁ buddhāya
titleEnglish: DSBC Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha Section 73: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (73): rāyā samyakkaṁ buddhāya
translatorZh: 尼泊尔阿闿黎传本 · 路易斯维尔大学/那烂陀研究所 (DSBC)
sutraSourceZh: Digital Sanskrit Buddhist Canon (DSBC) Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha §73
deityZh: धारणीसंग्रहः (73)
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 73 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：rāyā samyakkaṁ buddhāya || bodhi pratiṣṭhāyayati || om āḥ huṃ sūgatavajatuṣyahoḥ svāhā || ita buddha bhaddāra kasya nāma dhāraṇī samāptaḥ || 119 || om namo buddhāya || om namo bhagavate āryya śrīpadamottama tathāgatā yārhate samyakkaṁ buddhāya || tadyathā || om padme 2 padmodbhave sukhāvatī managachaṇna svāhā || iti gāthādvayaṁkāragata suddhārta aṣṭottaraśataṁ jāppa etyo praśuddhā bhavanita || || iti āryya śrīpadmottamanāma dhāraṇī samāptaḥ || 120 || om namo bhagavate || om namaḥ śrīratnaśikhinaḥ tathāgatasya || om namaḥ śrīsuvarṇṇa puṣṇe jāla raśmi ketu nāma tathāgatasya || om namaḥ śrī mahādīpa rājo nāma tathāgatasya || om namaḥ śrī。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to jewel + to

titleZh: 【DB3·尼泊尔DSBC】《陀罗尼集》第77品：Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (77): nāṁ

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 3 大数据库「尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC)」《陀罗尼集 (Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha)》第 77 品（罗马转写本 820/2949 与天城文本 824/2953 双本平行）。跋文：nāṁ || vārāhakulānāṁ || puṇḍalikakulānāṁ || ghanakakulānāṁ || meghakulānāṁ || jaladakulānāṁ || jīmūlakulānāṁ || sarvvakulānāṁ || elāvarttakulānāṁ || hana 2 śareṇa 2 bandha 2 cāpena || taḍaya 2 utpalena | vibhānnabhayaṁ || dehi 2 parayaṁkāla ime vajadharamavatārayanvarṣanta nāgānvaśikuru 2 phūḥ kulāpaya 2 phū phūḥ || om kulukulle rhīṁ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā || iti kulakullānāma dhāriṇī samāptaḥ || 22 ja || || iti nī dhāraṇī saṁgraha mahāpurāṇe sarvvaśāstraprahitā nāmadhāraṇī paṁcaviśaśatakaṁ samāptaḥ ||。
recitationTipsZh: 此为尼泊尔加德满都谷地世代相传之梵文《陀罗尼集》原典，每一句均已配齐天城文、悉昙梵字、现代梵音拼读与唐代古汉语音译。

verses.meaningEn: Of them, their, excellence + free from lust, space-like boundlessness & freedom from karmic agency & beyond nominal designation, of all sentient being, living creature, courage, he, that one, indeed, verily, alone, virtuous roots, will be
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #9《Ārya amoghapāśahṛdaya nāma mahāyānasūtram (Amoghapāśahṛdaya)》（第 8 句）

verses.iast: yatra yatropapatsyante tatra tatra virahitāśca bhaviṣyanti
verses.meaningZh: 凡于何处，一乘如实之道·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，再三于彼处、其中，诸落寞、较少及诸尊未来世、当头
verses.meaningEn: Where, wherever, supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), there, therein again and again, abandoned, forsaken, lonely, separated from, -less (plural) and they future, imminent
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #9《Ārya amoghapāśahṛdaya nāma mahāyānasūtram (Amoghapāśahṛdaya)》（第 9 句）

verses.meaningZh: 以尸罗·平·慧·福德·随着·光明·不加香尘，尸罗·胜香·唯，掌正勤
verses.meaningEn: Moral discipline + equal + superior wisdom + merit + along with + light + by, moral discipline + indeed, palm + effort
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #9《Ārya amoghapāśahṛdaya nāma mahāyānasūtram (Amoghapāśahṛdaya)》（第 10 句）

verses.iast: yaḥ kaścit bhagavan kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā bhikṣurvā bhikṣuṇī vā upāśako vā upāśikā vā
verses.meaningZh: 凡彼…者，任何一人、或有众生，出有坏，善男子，或、抑或，善女人，或、抑或，比丘或，比丘尼，或、抑或，第一义谛·本性寂静止息·造作离相，或、抑或，第一义谛·本性寂静止息·造作离相，或、抑或
verses.meaningEn: Whoever, he who, anyone, someone, bhagavan, a good man, or, a good woman, or, or, nun, or, ultimate truth & primordial tranquil peace & freedom from karmic agency, or, ultimate truth & primordial tranquil peace & freedom from karmic agency, or
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #9《Ārya amoghapāśahṛdaya nāma mahāyānasūtram (Amoghapāśahṛdaya)》（第 11 句）

verses.meaningZh: 彼他，或、抑或，造作离相·本性寂静止息·妙行迁变空，成办作持·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: That + other, or, freedom from karmic agency & primordial tranquil peace & awakened conduct beyond flux, enacting
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #9《Ārya amoghapāśahṛdaya nāma mahāyānasūtram (Amoghapāśahṛdaya)》（第 12 句）

verses.meaningZh: 七人群，不空羂索·心·自然·由解脱自在，最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Seven + crowd, unerring lasso + certainly + from free from lapa, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #9《Ārya amoghapāśahṛdaya nāma mahāyānasūtram (Amoghapāśahṛdaya)》（第 13 句）

verses.iast: tasya bhagavan dṛṣṭa eva dharmma viśatiranuśaṃsaḥ pratikāṃkṣitavyāḥ
verses.meaningZh: 彼之、其（属格），出有坏，见，唯、正是、决定，正法、诸法实相，入利益，诸应希求
verses.meaningEn: His, of that, bhagavan, innumerable different courses of all states-of-existence which are based on, indeed, verily, alone, Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena, benefit, pratikāṃkṣitavyāḥ
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #9《Ārya amoghapāśahṛdaya nāma mahāyānasūtram (Amoghapāśahṛdaya)》（第 14 句）

verses.meaningZh: 哪些哪些尊，二十，亦即、心路，清净离诸尘垢·妙行趣入·本性寂静止息，造作离相·一乘如实之道·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: O who or which ? / in who or which ?, twenty, namely, to wit, stainless purity free from dust & awakened spiritual movement & primordial tranquil peace, freedom from karmic agency & supreme vehicle of awakening & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #9《Ārya amoghapāśahṛdaya nāma mahāyānasūtram (Amoghapāśahṛdaya)》（第 15 句）

verses.iast: utpanāścāsya rogāḥ karmmavaśena śīghraṃ prasamaṃ yāsyanti
verses.meaningZh: 摧灭除遣·真如实际，诸疾病、病苦，以作业独立，快，转载平，一乘如实之道·一切诸谛圆满·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Destroying obstacles, disease, illness, sickness (plural), action + by, śīghraṃ, forward + equal, supreme vehicle of awakening & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #9《Ārya amoghapāśahṛdaya nāma mahāyānasūtram (Amoghapāśahṛdaya)》（第 16 句）

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·离名相假立·妙行趣入，左字门（妙行迁变空（caryā）·本不生体性），当
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & beyond nominal designation & awakened spiritual movement, awakened conduct beyond flux (caryā) — primordial non-arising, will be
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #9《Ārya amoghapāśahṛdaya nāma mahāyānasūtram (Amoghapāśahṛdaya)》（第 17 句）

verses.meaningZh: 股·大龄·刻薄及当
verses.meaningEn: Older ) + unkind and will be
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #9《Ārya amoghapāśahṛdaya nāma mahāyānasūtram (Amoghapāśahṛdaya)》（第 18 句）

verses.meaningZh: 妙行趣入·第一义谛·真如实际，理解及当
verses.meaningEn: Awakened spiritual movement & ultimate truth & immutable Suchness, = + conceiving, understanding and will be
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #9《Ārya amoghapāśahṛdaya nāma mahāyānasūtram (Amoghapāśahṛdaya)》（第 19 句）

verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·第一义谛·离名相假立，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & ultimate truth & beyond nominal designation, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #9《Ārya amoghapāśahṛdaya nāma mahāyānasūtram (Amoghapāśahṛdaya)》（第 20 句）

verses.iast: anumoditaṃ tathāgatena paścime kāle paścime samaye bodhisattvayānikānāṃ pitṛkāryakariṣyanti
verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·无我大慈三昧·施度调伏，以如来（乘如实道来成正觉），西尊，时尊，西尊，向平，菩提觉知·解脱系缚大力，能作成办·第一义谛
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & selfless great loving-kindness & generosity & self-mastery, by/through Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, O (last =) lowest, mean, vulgar, O black, O (last =) lowest, mean, vulgar, to equal, awakening, making (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #9《Ārya amoghapāśahṛdaya nāma mahāyānasūtram (Amoghapāśahṛdaya)》（第 21 句）

verses.iast: atha khalu āryāvalokiteśvaro bodhisattvo mahāsattvo 'nibhiṣanayano bhūtvā bhagavanta metadabocata
verses.meaningZh: 尔时、次复吉祥启白，诚然、确实，圣观自在菩萨，菩提萨埵，大菩萨，离名相假立·破有相福德光·六度满行清净，昂已，世尊末，无我大慈三昧·真如实际·施度调伏
verses.meaningEn: Now, thereupon, auspiciously, indeed, verily, certainly, Noble Avalokiteśvara, bodhisattvo, mahāsattvo, beyond nominal designation & blessedness transcending existence & perfection of the six pāramitās, having arise, Bhagavān + end, selfless great loving-kindness & immutable Suchness & generosity & self-mastery
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #9《Ārya amoghapāśahṛdaya nāma mahāyānasūtram (Amoghapāśahṛdaya)》（第 22 句）

verses.iast: śṛṇu me bhagavan sarvabodhisattva namaskṛtamidaṃ vimokṣamukhamaṇḍalaṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāyai mahato janakāyasyārthāya hitāya sukhāya
verses.meaningZh: 本性寂静止息·离诸诤论无诤，于我、为我，出有坏，一切菩提萨埵，归命·所作·脂肪，解脱面，向群萌利，向群萌乐，离一切相无相·造作离相·离名相假立，以乐趣此，生起不可得·尊胜·离名相假立·造作离相，向利，向乐
verses.meaningEn: Primordial tranquil peace & conflict-free peace (imperative seal), to me, my, bhagavan, all + Bodhisattva, homage + done + be fat, liberation, multitude of beings + to, multitude of beings + to, freedom from conditioned marks & freedom from karmic agency & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), gladden + hence, transcending birth & victorious & beyond nominal designation & freedom from karmic agency (reverent offering), to/for put, placed, laid, to/for easy, pleasant, comfortable, happy
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #9《Ārya amoghapāśahṛdaya nāma mahāyānasūtram (Amoghapāśahṛdaya)》（第 23 句）

verses.iast: nāmastryadhvānugatapratiṣṭhitebhya sarvabuddhabodhisattvebhyo namaḥ pratyekabuddhāryaśrāvaka saṃghebhyo'tītānāgatapratyutpannebhyo namaḥ samyaggatānāṃ
verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·无我大慈三昧·一切诸谛圆满，一切·佛陀·菩提萨埵·富人，归命，佛驮·圣·舍罗婆迦，圣僧伽·富人·过去·末·现在时·富人，归命，一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & selfless great loving-kindness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, all + Buddha + Bodhisattva + belonging to one's household, homage to Buddha for himself alone + noble + sravaka, Saṃgha + belonging to one's household + gone away + future + present + belonging to one's household, homage to all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #9《Ārya amoghapāśahṛdaya nāma mahāyānasūtram (Amoghapāśahṛdaya)》（第 24 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼随着·哪些·入·自然！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to along with, = who, practised, certainly!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #9《Ārya amoghapāśahṛdaya nāma mahāyānasūtram (Amoghapāśahṛdaya)》（第 25 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·施度调伏·大施主！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & generosity & self-mastery (reverent offering), great, to a very liberal man!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #9《Ārya amoghapāśahṛdaya nāma mahāyānasūtram (Amoghapāśahṛdaya)》（第 26 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·无我大慈三昧·一切大菩提萨埵圣僧伽·归命敬礼·离名相假立·觉悟正觉·清净离诸尘垢！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening & selfless great loving-kindness, great, Bodhisattva, Saṃgha, bowing, awakened!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #9《Ārya amoghapāśahṛdaya nāma mahāyānasūtram (Amoghapāśahṛdaya)》（第 27 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼真金显色光明·如是不是揭帝！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to gold, color, to, thus, to!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #9《Ārya amoghapāśahṛdaya nāma mahāyānasūtram (Amoghapāśahṛdaya)》（第 28 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼狮子·闢·轻窕·趣往·王·如来（乘如实道来成正觉）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to lion, settle, sporting, going, to, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #9《Ārya amoghapāśahṛdaya nāma mahāyānasūtram (Amoghapāśahṛdaya)》（第 29 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼颤动娄尊·如来（乘如实道来成正觉）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to tremble, O horse-tamer, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #9《Ārya amoghapāśahṛdaya nāma mahāyānasūtram (Amoghapāśahṛdaya)》（第 30 句）

verses.iast: namaḥ śikhine tathāgatāya arhate samyak sambuddhāya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼本性寂静止息·等虚空无碍·离名相假立·如来（乘如实道来成正觉）·应供（阿罗汉）致敬·权利、正确·随着佛陀！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to primordial tranquil peace & space-like boundlessness & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, the Arhat, Worthy One, right, proper, along with, to!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #9《Ārya amoghapāśahṛdaya nāma mahāyānasūtram (Amoghapāśahṛdaya)》（第 31 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼最上真言离言说·本性寂静止息·破有相福德光·如来（乘如实道来成正觉）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to supreme ineffable speech & primordial tranquil peace & blessedness transcending existence (vocative invocation), Tathāgata, Thus-Come One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #9《Ārya amoghapāśahṛdaya nāma mahāyānasūtram (Amoghapāśahṛdaya)》（第 32 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼拘留孙·如来（乘如实道来成正觉）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Krakucchanda Buddha, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #9《Ārya amoghapāśahṛdaya nāma mahāyānasūtram (Amoghapāśahṛdaya)》（第 33 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼拘那含牟尼·真如实际·无住安立·妙行趣入！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to gold muni, immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise & awakened spiritual movement (reverent offering)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #9《Ārya amoghapāśahṛdaya nāma mahāyānasūtram (Amoghapāśahṛdaya)》（第 34 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼迦叶·如来即是！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to light-guard, Tathāgata, thus!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #9《Ārya amoghapāśahṛdaya nāma mahāyānasūtram (Amoghapāśahṛdaya)》（第 35 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼释迦牟尼佛（能仁寂默）·救度超脱·真如实际·权利随着佛陀！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Śākyamuni Buddha, Sage of the Śākyas, ferrying across (vocative invocation), right, along with, to!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #9《Ārya amoghapāśahṛdaya nāma mahāyānasūtram (Amoghapāśahṛdaya)》（第 36 句）

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #9《Ārya amoghapāśahṛdaya nāma mahāyānasūtram (Amoghapāśahṛdaya)》（第 37 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三无我大慈三昧·离名相假立，向大牟尼尊（释迦世尊），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation) again and again, to Great Sage (Mahāmuni), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #9《Ārya amoghapāśahṛdaya nāma mahāyānasūtram (Amoghapāśahṛdaya)》（第 38 句）

verses.iast: om same same mahāsame rakṣa rakṣa māṃ sarvasattvānāṃca sarvapāpaprasamane svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三平尊，大平尊，祈请再三拥护、守护于我，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，一切·罪业·转载·会议，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O equal again and again, great + O equal, evermore protect, guard and shelter me, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, all + evil + forward + O meeting, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #9《Ārya amoghapāśahṛdaya nāma mahāyānasūtram (Amoghapāśahṛdaya)》（第 39 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切诸谛圆满·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·名为、号曰·驮都、摇摆·如来即是！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust, by name, called, realm, sway, control, Tathāgata, thus!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #9《Ārya amoghapāśahṛdaya nāma mahāyānasūtram (Amoghapāśahṛdaya)》（第 40 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼普现·驮都·圣众·广大光华尊·如来（乘如实道来成正觉）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to conquered, popular assembly, O with great magnificence, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #9《Ārya amoghapāśahṛdaya nāma mahāyānasūtram (Amoghapāśahṛdaya)》（第 41 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼因陀逻·光明幢·宝幢·广大光华尊·如来（乘如实道来成正觉）·应供（阿罗汉）致敬·权利随着佛陀！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Śakra king of the gods, banner, victory banner, O with great magnificence, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, the Arhat, Worthy One, right, along with, to!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #9《Ārya amoghapāśahṛdaya nāma mahāyānasūtram (Amoghapāśahṛdaya)》（第 42 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼最上真言离言说·造作离相·清净离诸尘垢·如来·出·堪敬尊·权利随着佛陀！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to supreme ineffable speech & freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), Tathāgata, income, right, along with, to!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #9《Ārya amoghapāśahṛdaya nāma mahāyānasūtram (Amoghapāśahṛdaya)》（第 43 句）

verses.iast: namo buddhāya namo dharmāya namaḥ saṃghāya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛陀、觉者·正法、诸法实相·圣僧伽、清净海众！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Buddha, the Awakened One, Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena, Saṃgha, noble spiritual community!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #9《Ārya amoghapāśahṛdaya nāma mahāyānasūtram (Amoghapāśahṛdaya)》（第 44 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼过去末·现在时富人·佛陀富人·一切才宣说！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to gone away, future, present, belonging to one's household, Buddha, belonging to one's household, excellence, to!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #9《Ārya amoghapāśahṛdaya nāma mahāyānasūtram (Amoghapāśahṛdaya)》（第 45 句）
