verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #10《Āryamahāpratisarāvidyādhāraṇī (Mahāpratisarā)》（第 419 句）

verses.meaningZh: 再三定慧摄持、心无散乱（希利）
verses.meaningEn: Meditative absorption & steadfast mindfulness again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #10《Āryamahāpratisarāvidyādhāraṇī (Mahāpratisarā)》（第 420 句）

verses.meaningZh: 再三契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利）
verses.meaningEn: Intimate union with the deity samādhi again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #10《Āryamahāpratisarāvidyādhāraṇī (Mahāpratisarā)》（第 421 句）

verses.meaningZh: 再三金刚橛威神警觉、摧伏魔军（吉栗）
verses.meaningEn: Vajra-kīla transfixing obstacles & awakening again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #10《Āryamahāpratisarāvidyādhāraṇī (Mahāpratisarā)》（第 422 句）

verses.meaningZh: 再三积集一切白净善法功德（唧哩）
verses.meaningEn: Gathering pure Dharmic merits & radiance again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #10《Āryamahāpratisarāvidyādhāraṇī (Mahāpratisarā)》（第 423 句）

verses.meaningZh: 再三春莺
verses.meaningEn: Sili again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #10《Āryamahāpratisarāvidyādhāraṇī (Mahāpratisarā)》（第 424 句）

verses.meaningZh: 再三殊胜、胜愿、妙好
verses.meaningEn: Choicest, supreme boon, excellent again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #10《Āryamahāpratisarāvidyādhāraṇī (Mahāpratisarā)》（第 425 句）

verses.meaningZh: 施愿者、满善愿尊尊
verses.meaningEn: O boon-granting, wish-bestowing / in boon-granting, wish-bestowing
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #10《Āryamahāpratisarāvidyādhāraṇī (Mahāpratisarā)》（第 426 句）

verses.meaningZh: 一切处、普皆周遍，尊胜降伏·生起不可得·尊胜，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Everywhere, at all times & places, conquering (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #10《Āryamahāpratisarāvidyādhāraṇī (Mahāpratisarā)》（第 427 句）

verses.meaningZh: 罪业·闢·具出租尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Evil + settle + O bearer of rent, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #10《Āryamahāpratisarāvidyādhāraṇī (Mahāpratisarā)》（第 428 句）

verses.meaningZh: 一切·病患·夺尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: All + illness + O carrying, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #10《Āryamahāpratisarāvidyādhāraṇī (Mahāpratisarā)》（第 429 句）

verses.meaningZh: 一切处、普皆周遍，怖畏夺尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Everywhere, at all times & places, fear + O carrying, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #10《Āryamahāpratisarāvidyādhāraṇī (Mahāpratisarā)》（第 430 句）

verses.iast: svastir bhavatu mama sarvasattvānāṃ ca svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 吉祥安隐、善妙无恙，愿成就、愿悉吉祥，我之（行者所有），诸一切众生、普皆有情之以及圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Well-being, fortune, auspicious safety, may it be, let there be! my, of me (the practitioner), of all all sentient beings and Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #10《Āryamahāpratisarāvidyādhāraṇī (Mahāpratisarā)》（第 431 句）

verses.meaningZh: 息灾、寂静、安隐，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Peace, pacification, tranquility, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #10《Āryamahāpratisarāvidyādhāraṇī (Mahāpratisarā)》（第 432 句）

verses.meaningZh: 增益、丰饶增长，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Nourishment, increase, prosperity (Puṣṭi), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #10《Āryamahāpratisarāvidyādhāraṇī (Mahāpratisarā)》（第 433 句）

verses.meaningZh: 愿胜伏、最胜吉祥！胜伏、最胜吉祥！尊
verses.meaningEn: May it conquer! victory!! O conquer! victory! / in conquer! victory!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #10《Āryamahāpratisarāvidyādhāraṇī (Mahāpratisarā)》（第 434 句）

verses.meaningZh: 具足胜伏、最胜吉祥！尊
verses.meaningEn: O one endowed with conquer! victory!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #10《Āryamahāpratisarāvidyādhāraṇī (Mahāpratisarā)》（第 435 句）

verses.meaningZh: 胜伏、最胜吉祥！
verses.meaningEn: Conquer! victory!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #10《Āryamahāpratisarāvidyādhāraṇī (Mahāpratisarā)》（第 436 句）

verses.meaningZh: 毘磨利
verses.meaningEn: Pure
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #10《Āryamahāpratisarāvidyādhāraṇī (Mahāpratisarā)》（第 437 句）

verses.meaningZh: 广大、宽博无量尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: O vast, extensive, abundant, profound / in vast, extensive, abundant, profound, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #10《Āryamahāpratisarāvidyādhāraṇī (Mahāpratisarā)》（第 438 句）

verses.meaningZh: 一切如来坚硬，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: All Tathagatas + O thickened, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #10《Āryamahāpratisarāvidyādhāraṇī (Mahāpratisarā)》（第 439 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！再三聪慧
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! intelligence again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #10《Āryamahāpratisarāvidyādhāraṇī (Mahāpratisarā)》（第 440 句）

verses.meaningZh: 具足金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊
verses.meaningEn: O one endowed with Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #10《Āryamahāpratisarāvidyādhāraṇī (Mahāpratisarā)》（第 441 句）

verses.meaningZh: 如来·心·遂尊
verses.meaningEn: Tathāgata + heart + O satisfy
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #10《Āryamahāpratisarāvidyādhāraṇī (Mahāpratisarā)》（第 442 句）

verses.meaningZh: 擎尊
verses.meaningEn: O supporting
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #10《Āryamahāpratisarāvidyādhāraṇī (Mahāpratisarā)》（第 443 句）

verses.meaningZh: 再三力、十力神通威神力
verses.meaningEn: Power, strength, spiritual force again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #10《Āryamahāpratisarāvidyādhāraṇī (Mahāpratisarā)》（第 444 句）

verses.iast: jayavidye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 胜伏发现物尊，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Conquer! victory! + O finding, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #10《Āryamahāpratisarāvidyādhāraṇī (Mahāpratisarā)》（第 445 句）

titleZh: 【DB3·DSBC专书】《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》(Book #11)
titleEnglish: DSBC Sanskrit Canon Book #11: Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam
translatorZh: Miroj Shakya & Milan Shakya (DSBC Project)
sutraSourceZh: DSBC Dhāraṇī Collection (Book #11)
deityZh: आर्यश्रीमहादेवीव्याकरणम्
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC) 陀罗尼专目第 #11 号梵本《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（录入校勘：Miroj Shakya & Milan Shakya (DSBC Project)）。
recitationTipsZh: 基于尼泊尔梵文写本直接转写，支持六体汇总与 48kHz 梵音合成朗读。

provenance.editionCitation: DSBC Book #11: Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam (Nagarjuna Institute of Buddhist Studies (Kathmandu, Nepal))
provenance.manuscriptNotesZh: 尼泊尔 DSBC 独立陀罗尼梵文经卷 (#11)。
provenance.rawSnippet: āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam om namaḥ sarvabuddhabodhisattvebhyaḥ|| evaṃ mayā śrutamekasamaye bhagavān sukhāvatyāṃ viharati sma mahatā bodhisattvasaṃghena sārdhaṃ - tadyathā avalokiteśvareṇa ca bodhisattvena mahāsattvena mahāsthāmaprāptena ca bodhisattvena mahāsa

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！归命，向诸一切佛陀菩提萨埵
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to all + Buddha + to all Bodhisattva
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 1 句）

verses.iast: evaṃ mayā śrutamekasamaye bhagavān sukhāvatyāṃ viharati sma mahatā bodhisattvasaṃghena sārdhaṃ -
verses.meaningZh: 如是、如此，由我（具格：如是我闻），向听·彼·一·平，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，乐·鸿毛·那个，一切，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，以菩提萨埵圣僧伽，俱
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in this way, by me, to listen + him + one + to equal, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, easy + down + that, lives, dwells, spends oneʼs time, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, great, Bodhisattva + by, together
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 2 句）

verses.iast: tadyathā avalokiteśvareṇa ca bodhisattvena mahāsattvena mahāsthāmaprāptena ca bodhisattvena mahāsattvena sarvanīvaraṇaviṣkaṃbhinā ca
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：以观自在菩萨（观世音）以及以菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情），以摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨），以大势至以及以菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情），以摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨），一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说以及
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: by/through Avalokiteśvara, Lord Who Looks Down in Compassion and by/through Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, by/through Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero, by/through Mahāsthāma and by/through Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, by/through Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech and
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 3 句）

verses.iast: bodhisattvena mahāsattvena kṣitigarbheṇa ca bodhisattvena mahāsattvena samantabhadreṇa ca bodhisattvena mahāsattvena ākāśagarbheṇa
verses.meaningZh: 以菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情），以摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨），以地藏菩萨以及以菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情），以摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨），以普贤菩萨（遍吉）以及以菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情），以摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨），以虚空藏菩萨
verses.meaningEn: By/through Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, by/through Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero, by/through Kṣitigarbha, Earth-Treasury Bodhisattva and by/through Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, by/through Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero, by/through Samantabhadra, Universally Worthy Bodhisattva and by/through Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, by/through Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero, by/through Ākāśagarbha, Womb of Space Bodhisattva
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 4 句）

verses.iast: ca bodhisattvena mahāsattvena vajrapāṇinā ca bodhisattvena mahāsattvena sarvabhayahareṇa ca bodhisattvena mahāsattvena
verses.meaningZh: 左字门（妙行迁变空（caryā）·本不生体性），以菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情），以摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨），以金刚手菩萨（执金刚秘密主）以及以菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情），以摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨），以一切怖畏请摄取以及以菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情），以摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨）
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux (caryā) — primordial non-arising, by/through Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, by/through Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero, by Vajrapāṇi, Vajra-in-Hand Bodhisattva and by/through Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, by/through Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero, all + fear + by and by/through Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, by/through Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 5 句）

verses.iast: evaṃ sarvamaṅgaladhāriṇā ca bodhisattvena mahāsattvena sarvapuṇyalakṣaṇadhāriṇā ca bodhisattvena mahāsattvena candrasūryatrailokyadhāriṇā ca
verses.meaningZh: 如是、如此，总持任持·一切诸谛圆满以及以菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情），以摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨），总持任持·一切诸谛圆满以及以菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情），以摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨），总持任持·妙行迁变空以及
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in this way, upholding and by/through Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, by/through Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero, upholding and by/through Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, by/through Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero, upholding and
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 6 句）

verses.iast: bodhisattvena mahāsattvena sarvatīrthamaṅgaladhāriṇā ca bodhisattvena mahāsattvena maṃjuśriyā ca kumāra bhūtena ca
verses.meaningZh: 以菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情），以摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨），总持任持·一切诸谛圆满以及以菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情），以摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨），无我大慈三昧·生起不可得·尊胜·本性寂静止息以及孺童，以部多鬼神、一切生类、真实以及
verses.meaningEn: By/through Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, by/through Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero, upholding and by/through Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, by/through Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero, selfless great loving-kindness & transcending birth & victorious & primordial tranquil peace and boy, youth, son, prince, by/through spirit, living being, true/existent and
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 7 句）

verses.meaningZh: 以菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情），以摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨），菩提觉知·广大殊胜·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: By/through Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, by/through Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero, awakening, great
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 8 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼吉祥健南·如来（乘如实道来成正觉）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to auspiciousness, to, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 9 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼清净离诸尘垢·真如实际·离名相假立·如来（乘如实道来成正觉）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), Tathāgata, Thus-Come One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 10 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼恒迦河·一切·津·面门·吉祥·广大光华尊·如来（乘如实道来成正觉）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Ganges River, all, a ford, face, auspiciousness, O with great magnificence, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 11 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命敬礼·离名相假立，向如来（乘如实道来成正觉）
verses.meaningEn: Bowing (vocative invocation), to/for Tathāgata, Thus-Come One
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 12 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼普现·驮都·圣众·广大光华尊·如来（乘如实道来成正觉）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to conquered, popular assembly, O with great magnificence, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 13 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼功德·大海·普光明照·曼荼罗·广大光华尊·如来（乘如实道来成正觉）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to virtue, ocean, splendor, Maṇḍala, O with great magnificence, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 14 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼驮废物·神变·宝幢·余力·广大光华尊·如来（乘如实道来成正觉）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to dha, rubbish, a divine transformation, victory banner, jerk, O with great magnificence, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 15 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼生起不可得·尊胜·一乘如实之道·真如实际·如来（乘如实道来成正觉）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to transcending birth & victorious & supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), Tathāgata, Thus-Come One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 16 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼勇猛大士·意乐·寂静息灭·身躯·广大光华尊·如来（乘如实道来成正觉）！

verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 19 句）

verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 21 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切·功德梵音·以及·责任·广大光华尊·如来（乘如实道来成正觉）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, quality of voice and blame, O with great magnificence, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 22 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼般若灯论·阿僧祇·光明·光明幢·广大光华尊·如来（乘如实道来成正觉）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Prajñāpradīpa, innumerable, light, banner, O with great magnificence, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 23 句）

verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 30 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼香·灯·广大光华尊·如来（乘如实道来成正觉）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to smell, lamp, O with great magnificence, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 31 句）

verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 32 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼化·云·雷音·美称·广大光华尊·如来（乘如实道来成正觉）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to a magic creation, cloud, thunder, yaśaḥ, O with great magnificence / in with great magnificence, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 33 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼宝树·来诣·闢·种类盘子·广大光华尊·如来（乘如实道来成正觉）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to tree, coming from or belonging to goats, settle, a kind of dish, O with great magnificence, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One!

verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 37 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼大·即时·余力·广大光华尊·如来（乘如实道来成正觉）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to great, then was the 2d pra˚, jerk, O with great magnificence, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 38 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼广大广大光华尊·如来（乘如实道来成正觉）！

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切·财·驮·他·召请·广大光华尊·如来（乘如实道来成正觉）！

verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 42 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼钩召摄受·离一切相无相·如来（乘如实道来成正觉）！

verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 44 句）

verses.iast: imāni tathāgatanāmāni satkṛtya dhārayitavyāni vācayitavyāni evaṃ sa kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā bahutaraṃ puṇyaṃ prasaviṣyati
verses.meaningZh: 一切本刹，如来一切名为，有偿方面、好好儿，放置·极微·一切勇健，语言·极微·一切勇健，如是、如此，彼、此尊（阳性主格），善男子，或、抑或，善女人，或、抑或，什多，福德、胜妙功德，转载·彼·搅拌·戒精进
verses.meaningEn: This (plural), Tathāgata + by name, paying respect, respectfully, put + or interrog + strong, words + or interrog + strong, thus, in this way, he, that one, a good man, or, a good woman, or, numerous, merit, auspicious virtue, forward + he + stir + as many
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 45 句）

verses.meaningZh: 包扎九渊以及大吉祥天女（功德天），以诸如来（乘如实道来成正觉）
verses.meaningEn: Wrap + cleft and Śrīmahādevī, Great Goddess of Auspiciousness, by/with Tathāgata, Thus-Come One
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 46 句）

verses.iast: bhaviṣyasi tvaṃ śrīmahādevī anāgate'dhvani śrī mahā ratnapratimaṇḍitāyāṃ lokadhātau tatra śrīmaṇiratnasambhavo nāma tathāgato'rhan samyak sambuddhaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 当有汝即是，汝、圣尊您，大吉祥天女（功德天），自然·度越吧·以下·劝请，吉祥、圣德威光，大、摩诃（广大无边），珍宝·对·甲板·于趣往，离一切相无相·造作离相·法界总持任持，于彼处、其中，吉祥·摩尼宝珠·宝生佛，名为、号曰，如来应供，权利、正确，随着觉者
verses.meaningEn: Thou art, Thou, You, Śrīmahādevī, Great Goddess of Auspiciousness, certainly + gone + below + request, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, great, vast, supreme, jewel + toward + deck + in going, freedom from conditioned marks & freedom from karmic agency & Dharma-realm retention (imperative seal), there, therein, auspiciousness + Maṇi jewel + Ratnasambhava Buddha, by name, called, Arhat, right, proper, along with
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 47 句）

verses.meaningZh: 彼、彼圣母（阴性主格）以及离一切相无相·造作离相·法界总持任持，当
verses.meaningEn: She, that and freedom from conditioned marks & freedom from karmic agency & Dharma-realm retention, will be
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 48 句）

verses.iast: tatra ca lokadhātau sa eva tathāgata ālokakaro bhaviṣyati
verses.meaningZh: 于彼处、其中以及离一切相无相·造作离相·法界总持任持，彼、此尊（阳性主格），唯、正是、决定，如来（乘如实道来成正觉），光明羯磨事业，当
verses.meaningEn: There, therein and freedom from conditioned marks & freedom from karmic agency & Dharma-realm retention (imperative seal), he, that one, indeed, verily, alone, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, light + action, will be
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 49 句）

verses.iast: te ca bodhisattvāstatra buddhakṣetre svayaṃprabhā bhaviṣyantyaparimitāyuṣaśca
verses.meaningZh: 向汝、彼等以及菩提觉知·解脱系缚大力，佛土，亲自光明，破有相福德光·最上真言离言说·六度满行清净
verses.meaningEn: To Thee / they and awakening, O Buddha-field, region or, oneself + light, blessedness transcending existence & supreme ineffable speech & perfection of the six pāramitās
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 50 句）

verses.meaningZh: 由虚空界（无碍周遍）及佛法，圣僧伽、和合众，音，妙行流布·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: From space, ether, open sky and Dharma, Saṃgha, noble assembly, sound, practicing (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 51 句）

verses.iast: ye ca bodhisattvāstatra buddhakṣetre upapatsyante sarve te padmakarkaṭikāsūpapatsyante
verses.meaningZh: 凡彼等诸有情以及菩提觉知·解脱系缚大力，佛土，第一义谛·真如实际·一切诸谛圆满，一切、普皆遍满尊，向汝、彼等，能作成办·第一义谛
verses.meaningEn: Those who, whoever (pl.) and awakening, O Buddha-field, region or, ultimate truth & immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (vocative invocation), O all, every, complete / in all, every, complete, to Thee / they, making (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 52 句）

verses.meaningZh: 于彼处、其中，造作离相·真如实际·无我大慈三昧，名为一百八，离垢有形，赞叹、偈子
verses.meaningEn: There, therein, freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness & selfless great loving-kindness, by name + one hundred and eight, immaculate + visible, praise, hymn
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 53 句）

verses.meaningZh: 本性寂静止息·离诸诤论无诤，无畏观自在菩萨，广大光华，以摩诃室利，一切名为、号曰
verses.meaningEn: Primordial tranquil peace & conflict-free peace (imperative seal), non-fear + Avalokiteśvara, with great magnificence, with/by Mahādevī, by name, called (plural)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 54 句）

verses.iast: tadyathā sarvatathāgatābhiṣiktā sarvadevatābhiṣiktā sarvatathāgatamātā sarvadevatāmātā sarvatathāgataśrīḥ sarvabodhisattvaśrīḥ sarvāryaśrāvakapratyekabuddhaśrīḥ brahmaviṣṇumaheśvaraśrīḥ mahāsthānagataśrīḥ sarvadevatābhimukhaśrīḥ
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：一切如来灌顶，一切·何为·灌顶，萨嚩怛他蘖多南架子，一切·天神·母，一切如来吉祥，一切·菩提萨埵·吉祥，湖·墙壁·舍罗婆迦·佛驮·吉祥，神父·遍入·大自在天·吉祥，圣地·去·吉祥，一切·何为·现前·吉祥
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: all Tathagatas, all + divinity, sarvatathāgataṃ + frame, all + a god, all Tathagatas, all + Bodhisattva, a lake + to be checked or restrained + sravaka + Buddha for himself alone, priest + thousands with names containing prabha + Maheśvara, mahāsthāna + understood, all + divinity + having the face towards
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 55 句）

verses.iast: sarvadevanāgayakṣagandharvāsuragaruḍakinnaramahoragaśrīḥ sarvavidyādharavajrapāṇivajradharaśrīḥ catuḥpañcalokapālaśrīḥ aṣṭagrahāṣṭāviṃśatinakṣatraśrīḥ om sāvitrī dhātrī mātā caturvedaśrīḥ lakṣmīḥ bhūtamātā
verses.meaningZh: 一切施·犹如·龙族·药叉·乾闼婆·阿修罗·迦楼罗·紧那罗·摩睺罗伽·吉祥，一切·持明仙·金刚手菩萨·金刚总持·吉祥，警觉震动·守护养育·吉祥庄严·妙行迁变空，八·曜执·二十八·星宿·吉祥，嗡！一切诸谛圆满·最上真言离言说·真如实际，母，母，四围陀吉祥，吉祥相，部多鬼神母
verses.meaningEn: One who gives everything + like + Nāga + Yakṣa + Gandharva + Asura + Garuḍa + Kinnara + Mahoraga, all + Vidyādhara + Vajrapāṇi + Vajradhara, stirring, guarding, glorious, eight + planet + twenty-eight + constellation, Oṃ! all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme ineffable speech & immutable Suchness, dhātrī, mātā, the four Vedas, lakṣmīḥ, spirit

verses.iast: candanadhūpaṃ dattvā vācayitavyāni sarvaśriyamadhigamiṣyati sarvasukhasaumanasyalābhī bhaviṣyati sarvadevatāśca rakṣāvaraṇaguptiṃ kariṣyanti sarvakāryasiddhistasya bhaviṣyati
verses.meaningZh: 檀香烧香，齿已，语言·极微·一切勇健，趣入通行·一切诸谛圆满，安乐妙善·一切诸谛圆满，当，一切诸何为及守护，能作成办·造作离相，悉地成就·一切诸谛圆满，当
verses.meaningEn: Best of its kind + to burn incense, dattvā, words + or interrog + strong, going toward (vocative invocation), blissful, will be, all + divinity and guard, protection, and defense, making (vocative invocation), perfected, will be
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #11《Āryaśrīmahādevīvyākaraṇam》（第 90 句）

titleZh: 【DB3·DSBC专书】《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》(Book #12)

sutraSourceZh: DSBC Dhāraṇī Collection (Book #12)
deityZh: आर्यवज्रविदारणा नाम धारणी
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC) 陀罗尼专目第 #12 号梵本《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（录入校勘：Miroj Shakya & Milan Shakya (DSBC Project)）。

provenance.manuscriptNotesZh: 尼泊尔 DSBC 独立陀罗尼梵文经卷 (#12)。
provenance.rawSnippet: āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī om namo bhagavatyai āryavajravidāraṇāyai | evaṃ mayā śrutamekasmin samaye bhagavān vajreṣu viharati sma |sarvaśarīraṃ vajramayamadhiṣṭhāya vajrapāṇiśca buddhānubhāvena vajrasamādhiṃ samāpannaḥ | tato vajrapāṇiḥ [sarva] buddhānubh

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊佛母顶礼，清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed Mother / Lady Bhagavatī, stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 1 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！归命，向佛法僧三宝
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to/for the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 2 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命敬礼·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Bowing (reverent offering)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 3 句）

verses.meaningZh: 向大药叉军主
verses.meaningEn: Mahāyakṣasenāpataye
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 4 句）

verses.iast: tadyathā - om truṭa truṭa troṭaya troṭaya sfuṭa sfuṭa sfoṭaya sfoṭaya
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！再三真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·断除憍慢执障，再三真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·断除憍慢执障，再三一切诸谛圆满·断除憍慢执障，再三一切诸谛圆满·断除憍慢执障·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & cutting rigid pride again and again, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & cutting rigid pride again and again, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & cutting rigid pride again and again, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & cutting rigid pride & supreme vehicle of awakening again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 5 句）

verses.iast: ghurṇa ghurṇa ghurṇāpaya ghurṇāpaya sarvasattvānāṃ vibodhaya vibodhaya sambodhaya sambodhaya bhrama bhrama
verses.meaningZh: 再三破暗合集·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，再三破暗合集·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，诸一切众生、普皆有情之，再三请令圆满开悟、朗然大觉！再三随着请开晓觉悟，再三头旋
verses.meaningEn: Dissolving dense ignorance & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace again and again, dissolving dense ignorance & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace again and again, of all all sentient beings, fully awaken and enlighten! again and again, along with + awaken! enlighten! illuminate! again and again, spring again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 6 句）

verses.iast: saṃbhrāmaya saṃbhrāmaya sarvabhūtāni kuṭa kuṭa saṃkuṭaya saṃkuṭaya sarvaśatrūn ghaṭa ghaṭa saṃdhāṭaya
verses.meaningZh: 再三桑祈请遊，一切一切处、到处可见，再三造作离相·断除憍慢执障，再三桑祈请庵，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，再三瓶，一切诸谛圆满·法界总持任持·断除憍慢执障
verses.meaningEn: Saṃ + may You to tour! again and again, being everywhere, ubiquitous, freedom from karmic agency & cutting rigid pride again and again, saṃ + may You cottage! again and again, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, jar, ewer again and again, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & Dharma-realm retention & cutting rigid pride
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 7 句）

verses.iast: saṃghāṭaya sarvavidyā vajra vajra sphoṭaya vajra vajra kaṭa vajra vajra maṭa
verses.meaningZh: 祈请僧伽吒，一切圣智，再三金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），请击碎、破除一切结缚！再三金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），席，再三金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），无我大慈三昧·断除憍慢执障
verses.meaningEn: May You assembly! all knowledge, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt again and again, shatter! split open! Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt again and again, straw mat, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt again and again, selfless great loving-kindness & cutting rigid pride
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 8 句）

verses.iast: vajra vajra matha vajra vajra aṭṭahāsanīlavajrasuvajrāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 再三金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），摧碎魔军与我慢烦恼（末他），再三金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），向大声笑声·绀青·金刚·勇健金刚杵，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt again and again, churn and crush demonic hindrances! Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt again and again, loud laughter + sapphire-blue + Vajra + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 9 句）

verses.iast: om he fullu nirufullu nigṛhṇa kullu mili cullu kuru kullu vajravijayāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！呼唤圣尊叹词（咄！圣者！），离一切相无相，离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢·离一切相无相，离名相假立·妙行趣入·因缘空寂大乐，造作离相·离一切相无相，契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利），妙行迁变空·离一切相无相，祈请成办羯磨事业（俱噜），造作离相·离一切相无相，向金刚最胜尊胜，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O! Hail! Vocative invocation particle, freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal), beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal), beyond nominal designation & awakened spiritual movement & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal), intimate union with the deity samādhi, awakened conduct beyond flux & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal), accomplish & enact this sacred work! freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal), Vajra + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 10 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！向金刚橛威神警觉杵，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! vajra-kīla transfixing obstacles & awakening + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 11 句）

verses.iast: om kaṭa kaṭa maṭa maṭa raṭa raṭa moṭana pramoṭanāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三席，再三无我大慈三昧·断除憍慢执障，再三清净离诸尘垢·断除憍慢执障，摧碎，向转载摧碎，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! straw mat again and again, selfless great loving-kindness & cutting rigid pride again and again, stainless purity free from dust & cutting rigid pride again and again, crushing, breaking, strangling, forward + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 12 句）

verses.iast: om cara nicara hara hara sara sara māraya vajravidāraṇāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！行持妙道、周游救护（左啰），在于行持妙道，再三请摄取、遣除苦厄！再三流注周遍、速行护念（萨啰），祈请魔、天魔烦恼障，向金刚裂解，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! move forth in compassionate activity! in + move forth in compassionate activity! carry away (suffering)! remove! again and again, flow forth and pervade with blessing! again and again, may You Māra, demon, obstacle to awakening! Vajra + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 13 句）

verses.iast: om chinda chinda bhinda bhinda mahākilikīlāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三断除烦恼结使缠缚（嗔陀），再三劈破无明坚固执障（牝陀），向大金刚橛威神警觉杵，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! sever every fetter and hostile spell! again and again, cleave asunder stubborn ignorance! again and again, great + vajra-kīla transfixing obstacles & awakening + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 14 句）

verses.iast: om bandha bandha krodha krodha vajrakilikīlāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），再三忿，向金刚金刚橛威神警觉杵，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! again and again, wrath again and again, Vajra + vajra-kīla transfixing obstacles & awakening + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 15 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三速疾运转妙法加持（祖噜），向威猛金刚橛威神警觉杵，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! swiftly set sacred blessings in motion! again and again, fierce + vajra-kīla transfixing obstacles & awakening + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 16 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·一切诸谛圆满，向金刚金刚橛威神警觉杵，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness again and again, Vajra + vajra-kīla transfixing obstacles & awakening + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 17 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三请摄取、遣除苦厄！向金刚总持、执金刚尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! carry away (suffering)! remove! again and again, to/for Vajradhara, Holder of the Vajra, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 18 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三巡，向金刚风息，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! a watch a period of about hours again and again, Vajra + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 19 句）

verses.iast: om matisthiravajra śrutisthiravajra pratisthiravajra mahāvajra apratihatavajra amoghavajra aihivajra śīghraṃ vajrāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！慧·坚硬·金刚，闻·坚硬·金刚，对·坚硬·金刚，大金刚，无碍金刚，不空，因缘空寂大乐·最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜，快，向金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! intelligence + hard + Vajra, hearing + hard + Vajra, toward + hard + Vajra, great + Vajra, unobstructed + Vajra, Amoghavajra, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious, śīghraṃ, to/for Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 20 句）

verses.iast: om dhara dhara dhiri dhiri dhuru dhuru sarvavajrakulamāvartāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三请执持、总持护念！再三禅定坚固总持不失（地利），再三坚固任持总持法印（度噜），向一切·金刚·大地·不过·绕，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! hold! bear! sustain! again and again, steadfast meditative retention (dhṛti) again and again, firmly uphold the dhāraṇī seal! again and again, all + Vajra + earth + only + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 21 句）

verses.meaningZh: 某甲，祈请魔、天魔烦恼障，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: A certain person, may You Māra, demon, obstacle to awakening! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 22 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！归命，普遍诸金刚之
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to universal + of Vajra
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 23 句）

verses.iast: sarvabalamāvartaya mahābale kaṭabale tatale acale maṇḍalamaye ativajra mahābale vegaraṇa ajite jvala
verses.meaningZh: 一切·跋蓝·祈请绕，大力威神、大势力尊尊，席力，彼严，不动明王、不动摇尊，曼荼罗极微，太金刚，大力威神、大势力尊尊，余力烦恼，无胜尊，炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞）
verses.meaningEn: All + may You circumambulate! O of great power and might / in of great power and might, straw mat + O power, That, O Acala, Immovable Wisdom King / steadfast / in Acala, Immovable Wisdom King / steadfast, particle, very + Vajra, O of great power and might / in of great power and might, jerk + passion, O unsurpassed, blaze forth with wisdom radiance!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 24 句）

verses.iast: jvala tiṭi tiṭi ti(piṃṅgale daha daha tejovati tili tili bandha bandha
verses.meaningZh: 炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞），再三真如实际·断除憍慢执障，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·诸根清净自在），第一义谛·支分寂静·妙行趣入，再三智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺），具足威光尊，再三芝麻尊，再三结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮）
verses.meaningEn: Blaze forth with wisdom radiance! immutable Suchness & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation) again and again, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — purified faculties, ultimate truth & quiescence of perceptual limbs & awakened spiritual movement (vocative invocation), incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! again and again, tejovati, O the sesamum plant or seed again and again, bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 25 句）

verses.meaningZh: 大力威神、大势力尊尊，向金刚面天焰光，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: O of great power and might / in of great power and might, Vajrāṅkuśa + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #12《Āryavajravidāraṇā nāma dhāraṇī (Vajravidāraṇā)》（第 26 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊（薄伽梵）致敬，向圣入无分别法门经
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, noble + to Ru Wu Fenbie Famen Jing
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #13《Avikalpapraveśadhāraṇī》（第 1 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #13《Avikalpapraveśadhāraṇī》（第 2 句）

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #13《Avikalpapraveśadhāraṇī》（第 3 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！无分别，无分别性交尊
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! avikalpe, O entering
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #13《Avikalpapraveśadhāraṇī》（第 4 句）

verses.meaningZh: 诸诸法之，自性最极清净
verses.meaningEn: Of all things, own-being + O completely purified
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #13《Avikalpapraveśadhāraṇī》（第 5 句）

verses.meaningZh: 无着尊，无相门尊，漫无目的、解脱自在尊
verses.meaningEn: O Asanga / in Asanga, O having no cause, motive, or design, O aimless, not bent on anything
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #13《Avikalpapraveśadhāraṇī》（第 6 句）

verses.meaningZh: 寂静、调柔安稳尊，寂静、赊多尊，一切·分别·离·虚空·随着·地狱道·最极清净
verses.meaningEn: O peaceful, calm, tranquil / in peaceful, calm, tranquil, O tranquillized, quiet, calm, indifferent, all + thought + lost + sky + along with + of a hell + O completely purified
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #13《Avikalpapraveśadhāraṇī》（第 7 句）

verses.meaningZh: 法界性交尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Dharmadhātu + O entering, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #13《Avikalpapraveśadhāraṇī》（第 8 句）

verses.iast: namo bhagavate dhvajāgra rājāya tathāgatāya arhate samyak sambuddhāya tadyathā
verses.meaningZh: 归命向世尊（薄伽梵）致敬，顶部计都、规格，向王，向如来（乘如实道来成正觉），向应供（阿罗汉）致敬，权利、正确，向随着佛陀，即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Homage to to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, top of a banner, to/for king, to/for Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, to the Arhat, Worthy One, right, proper, along with + to, Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #14《Dhvajāgrakeyūrā dhāraṇī》（第 1 句）

verses.iast: jaya jaya vijaya vijaya jayavāhini-sam gari prabhañjani prabhañjani sarva śatruṇām jambhaya
verses.meaningZh: 再三胜伏、最胜吉祥！再三最胜尊胜、普胜一切！尊胜降伏·生起不可得·尊胜，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），饮料、毒素尊，再三风息、暴雨尊，一切、普皆遍满，本性寂静止息·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，请调伏、摧折憍慢魔障！
verses.meaningEn: Conquer! victory! again and again, supreme victory! triumph! again and again, conquering (vocative invocation), selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, O devouring, O wind, storm again and again, all, every, complete, primordial tranquil peace & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust, crush! quell jaws of hostility!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #14《Dhvajāgrakeyūrā dhāraṇī》（第 2 句）

verses.iast: jambhaya stambhaya stambhaya mohaya mohaya bhagavati jayavāhini mātha mātha pra-mātha pra-mātha
verses.meaningZh: 请调伏、摧折憍慢魔障！再三请制止、令暴恶魔障止息不动！再三请令怨魔迷闷失其毒力！世尊佛母！（呼格），尊胜降伏·生起不可得·尊胜，再三消灭，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性），消灭，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性），消灭
verses.meaningEn: Crush! quell jaws of hostility! immobilize! halt hostile forces! again and again, bewilder hostile forces! again and again, O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! conquering (vocative invocation), destruction, annihilation again and again, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising, destruction, annihilation, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising, destruction, annihilation
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #14《Dhvajāgrakeyūrā dhāraṇī》（第 3 句）

verses.iast: grasa grasa hasa hasa huṃ huṃ lambodari trinetre caturmukhe caturvaktre catur
verses.meaningZh: 再三妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢·一切诸谛圆满，再三笑声，再三金刚怒王种子字（摧伏魔障），腹垂尊，三眼目，神明尊，四面目，四
verses.meaningEn: Awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness again and again, laughter, mirth again and again, vajra seed syllable Huṃ again and again, O having a large belly, three + O eye, O four faces, four + O meters, four
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #14《Dhvajāgrakeyūrā dhāraṇī》（第 4 句）

verses.iast: daṃṣṭre catur bhuje asi musala khaḍga triśūla vajra dhāraṇīrakṣa rakṣa mām
verses.meaningZh: 牙尊，四，臂、千臂庄严尊，汝即是（当体即是），碓，智慧宝剑（断烦恼剑），三戟叉（破三毒戟），金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），陀罗尼眼目，拥护、守护，我（宾格：守护
verses.meaningEn: O large tooth, tusk, fang / in large tooth, tusk, fang, four, O arm, hand / in arm, hand, Thou art, pestle, mace, club, bell-clapper, sword (wisdom-blade), trident, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, Dhāraṇī + eye, protect, guard and shelter! me
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #14《Dhvajāgrakeyūrā dhāraṇī》（第 5 句）

verses.iast: bhagavati hana hana daha daha paca paca mātha mātha pramātha pramātha huṃ huṃ phaṭphaṭbhañja bhañja sarva śatrūṇām
verses.meaningZh: 世尊佛母！（呼格），再三击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），再三智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺），再三成熟善根、烧尽业障（跛左），再三消灭，再三姦妇女、压倒性，再三金刚怒王种子字（摧伏魔障），顿断魔障·顿断魔障·摧碎破除一切魔障，摧碎破除一切魔障，一切、普皆遍满，本性寂静止息·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again, incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! again and again, ripen merit and burn away karmic obstructions! again and again, destruction, annihilation again and again, tearing, rape , overwhelming, destruction again and again, vajra seed syllable Huṃ again and again, shatter obstacles and ignorance! + shatter obstacles and ignorance! + shatter and break all obstacles! shatter and break all obstacles! all, every, complete, primordial tranquil peace & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #14《Dhvajāgrakeyūrā dhāraṇī》（第 6 句）

verses.iast: dhvajāgra keyure tisṭhat tisṭhat triṭa ulkā dhāraṇi trailokyanātha vidhvaṃśaya para sainya
verses.meaningZh: 顶部计都、规格，造作离相·一乘如实之道·清净离诸尘垢，再三真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·远离虚妄安立，真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·断除憍慢执障，炬，陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义）尊，三界依，服务天神祈请笛，他人，多
verses.meaningEn: Top of a banner, freedom from karmic agency & supreme vehicle of awakening & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & beyond conceptual fabrication again and again, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & cutting rigid pride, meteor, firebrand, flame, O Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell, the Three Worlds + refuge, serve a god + may You tradition, someone else, relating to an army
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #14《Dhvajāgrakeyūrā dhāraṇī》（第 7 句）

verses.iast: rakṣa rakṣa māṃ cala cala cili cili culu culu kala kala
verses.meaningZh: 祈请再三拥护、守护于我，再三震动警觉、破除昏沉（左攞），再三积集一切白净善法功德（唧哩），再三鼓动法水涤除罪垢（主嚧），再三尊手
verses.meaningEn: Evermore protect, guard and shelter me, stir awake and shake off delusion! again and again, gathering pure Dharmic merits & radiance again and again, stir the purifying waters of compassion! again and again, hand again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #14《Dhvajāgrakeyūrā dhāraṇī》（第 8 句）

verses.iast: kili kili kulu kulu muncaṭṭa hāsaya vidhvaṃśaya parasainya bhramaya
verses.meaningZh: 再三金刚橛威神警觉、摧伏魔军（吉栗），再三造作离相·离一切相无相，无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·妙行迁变空，祈请笑声、欢喜，服务天神祈请笛，他人多，祈请头旋
verses.meaningEn: Vajra-kīla transfixing obstacles & awakening again and again, freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal) again and again, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & awakened conduct beyond flux, may You laughing, laughter, mirth, joy, derision! serve a god + may You tradition, someone else + relating to an army, may You spring
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #14《Dhvajāgrakeyūrā dhāraṇī》（第 9 句）

verses.iast: buddha satyena dharma satyena saṃgha satyena satya vādināṃ satyena buddha satyāmatikrama
verses.meaningZh: 佛陀、觉者，以谛、真实不虚语，正法、诸法实相，以谛、真实不虚语，圣僧伽、清净海众，以谛、真实不虚语，谛、真实不虚语，最上真言离言说·施度调伏·离名相假立，以谛、真实不虚语，佛陀、觉者，参半·趣往·趣往以上
verses.meaningEn: Buddha, the Awakened One, by/through truth, reality, veracity, Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena, by/through truth, reality, veracity, Saṃgha, noble spiritual community, by/through truth, reality, veracity, truth, reality, veracity, supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery & beyond nominal designation, by/through truth, reality, veracity, Buddha, the Awakened One, equally + going + going over
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #14《Dhvajāgrakeyūrā dhāraṇī》（第 10 句）

verses.iast: dharma satyāṃ atikrama saṃgha satyāṃ atikrama satya vādinaṃ satyamatikrama
verses.meaningZh: 正法、诸法实相，谛、真实不虚语，趣往以上、易逝，圣僧伽、清净海众，谛、真实不虚语，趣往以上、易逝，谛、真实不虚语，最上真言离言说·施度调伏·离名相假立，参半·摄伏·趣往以上
verses.meaningEn: Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena, truth, reality, veracity, going over, passing, Saṃgha, noble spiritual community, truth, reality, veracity, going over, passing, truth, reality, veracity, supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery & beyond nominal designation, equally + hold + going over
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #14《Dhvajāgrakeyūrā dhāraṇī》（第 11 句）

verses.iast: lambodare kuṭṭa kuṭṭa kuṭṭya kuṭṭya rudra mānaya biṣṇu mānaya candra sūrya
verses.meaningZh: 腹垂尊，再三摧碎，再三造作离相·断除憍慢执障·一乘如实之道，紧恶，祈请慢，解脱系缚大力·六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤，祈请慢，月轮、清凉满月，日轮、太阳光明
verses.meaningEn: O having a large belly, sqashing, stamping, crushing, hammering again and again, freedom from karmic agency & cutting rigid pride & supreme vehicle of awakening again and again, of gods, may You opinion, conception, spiritual strength freeing bonds & perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace (imperative seal), may You opinion, conception, moon, lunar disc, sun, solar orb
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #14《Dhvajāgrakeyūrā dhāraṇī》（第 12 句）

verses.iast: mānaya trailokya adhipatya mānaya sarva devo mānaya sarva yakṣa rākṣasa gandharva
verses.meaningZh: 祈请慢，三界、三千世界，自在主那个，祈请慢，一切、普皆遍满，天，祈请慢，一切、普皆遍满，药叉（夜叉护法捷疾神），罗刹（暴恶鬼神），乾闼婆（香音神）
verses.meaningEn: May You opinion, conception, the Three Worlds (Trailokya), lord + that, may You opinion, conception, all, every, complete, devo, may You opinion, conception, all, every, complete, Yakṣa, nature/wealth guardian spirit, Rākṣasa, fierce spirit/demon, Gandharva, celestial musician
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #14《Dhvajāgrakeyūrā dhāraṇī》（第 13 句）

verses.iast: kinnara mahoraga mānaya vidhvamsaya mama sarva śatru vaḥ rangha rangha ranghāpaya
verses.meaningZh: 紧那罗（歌神），摩睺罗伽（大蟒神），祈请慢，最上真言离言说·法界总持任持·无我大慈三昧，我之（行者所有），一切、普皆遍满，怨敌、仇害违缘，嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，再三喜滋滋想必，喜滋滋祈请令想必
verses.meaningEn: Kinnara, celestial song-spirit, Mahoraga, great serpent spirit, may You opinion, conception, supreme ineffable speech & Dharma-realm retention & selfless great loving-kindness, my, of me (the practitioner), all, every, complete, enemy, adversary, hostile force, supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release, be pleased + surely again and again, be pleased + cause to surely
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #14《Dhvajāgrakeyūrā dhāraṇī》（第 14 句）

verses.iast: ranghāpaya jvala jvala puṣpa mālini liḍhi liḍhi triṭa triṭa bhṛkuti mukhaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 喜滋滋祈请令想必，再三炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞），花，无我大慈三昧·离一切相无相·离名相假立，再三离一切相无相·法鼓觉悟，再三真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·断除憍慢执障，毘倶胝尊，面门、尊颜、法门入口
verses.meaningEn: Be pleased + cause to surely, blaze forth with wisdom radiance! again and again, flower, selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from conditioned marks & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), freedom from conditioned marks & awakening Dharma-drum resonance (vocative invocation) again and again, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & cutting rigid pride again and again, O Bhrkuti, face, mouth, gateway/door
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #14《Dhvajāgrakeyūrā dhāraṇī》（第 15 句）

verses.iast: parasainya kurucchedana karaṇha ha hi hi hu hu he he riṇi
verses.meaningZh: 他人多，祈请成办羯磨事业除断，能作成办·造作离相，贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，再三诚然、因为、实乃，再三贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，再三呼唤圣尊叹词（咄！圣者！），清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: Someone else + relating to an army, accomplish & enact this sacred work! + removing, making, causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — primordial non-arising, for, indeed, surely again and again, causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — dispelling sorrow again and again, O! Hail! Vocative invocation particle again and again, stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #14《Dhvajāgrakeyūrā dhāraṇī》（第 16 句）

verses.meaningZh: 清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，母尊，愿悉胜伏、最胜吉祥！宝幢、胜幡尊
verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation), stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace, māte, may they conquer! victory!! O victory banner, standard / in victory banner, standard
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #14《Dhvajāgrakeyūrā dhāraṇī》（第 17 句）

verses.iast: buddhāvalokite rakṣa rakṣa mama bhagavatāvalokite svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 佛陀观照，再三拥护、守护，我之（行者所有），才·鸣呼·观照，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Buddha + O beheld, protect, guard and shelter! again and again, my, of me (the practitioner), excellence + O beheld, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #14《Dhvajāgrakeyūrā dhāraṇī》（第 18 句）

verses.meaningZh: 功德、殊胜妙德，王，神明男人尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Virtue, excellence, auspicious quality, king, O of gods men, also of a celebrated place of pilgrimage / in of gods men, also of a celebrated place of pilgrimage, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #14《Dhvajāgrakeyūrā dhāraṇī》（第 19 句）

verses.meaningZh: 日阿罗歌花，毘磨利，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！

verses.meaningEn: Tathāgata + command, protect!watch over! cherish! Dharma + Saṃgha + allowed, to me, my, actions, śīghraṃ, accomplish & enact this sacred work! again and again, do not, let not, hanging down
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #16《Hayagrīvavidyā》（第 16 句）

verses.iast: hayagrī vā ya phaṭ vajrakhurāya phaṭ vajradaṃṣṭrāya phaṭ vajradaṃṣṭrotkaṭabhayabhairavāya phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 因缘空寂大乐·一乘如实之道·妙行趣入，或、抑或，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），泮吒（摧破魔障）！向金刚蹄，泮吒（摧破魔障）！向金刚牙，泮吒（摧破魔障）！向金刚牙·极了广大·怖畏·怖畏，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Causal emptiness & spiritual joy & supreme vehicle of awakening & awakened spiritual movement, or, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, Phaṭ! Vajra + to, Phaṭ! to/for Vajradaṃṣṭra, Phaṭ! Vajradaṃṣṭra + exceedingly great + fear + to, Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #16《Hayagrīvavidyā》（第 17 句）

verses.meaningZh: 向愈加·无明·桑·星宿·一刹那，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Beyond + ignorance + saṃ + star + to, Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #16《Hayagrīvavidyā》（第 18 句）

verses.meaningZh: 向钵啰么怛啰摧灭，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: To, Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #16《Hayagrīvavidyā》（第 19 句）

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech (reverent offering), Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #16《Hayagrīvavidyā》（第 20 句）

verses.meaningZh: 向一切毒害凶手，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: All + poison + to, Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #16《Hayagrīvavidyā》（第 21 句）

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech (reverent offering), Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #16《Hayagrīvavidyā》（第 22 句）

verses.meaningZh: 向海心，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Vaḍavāmukhāya, Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #16《Hayagrīvavidyā》（第 23 句）

verses.meaningZh: 一切·曜执·毗舍遮，于我、为我，因为祈请慢
verses.meaningEn: All + planet + Piśāca, to me, my, on account of + may You opinion
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #16《Hayagrīvavidyā》（第 24 句）

verses.iast: yāvanto mama ye kecit ahitaiṣiṇastān sarvān vaḍavāmukhena nikṛntaya phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 乃至末，我之（行者所有），凡彼等诸有情，任何众生、凡有诸类，因缘空寂大乐·真如实际·六度满行清净，一切、普皆遍满，以海心，祈请切断、断除，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: How + end, my, of me (the practitioner), those who, whoever (pl.), any, some (plural), causal emptiness & spiritual joy & immutable Suchness & perfection of the six pāramitās, all, every, complete, vaḍavāmukhena, may You cut off, Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #16《Hayagrīvavidyā》（第 25 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼圣观自在菩萨·菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情）·摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Noble Avalokiteśvara, Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #16《Hayagrīvavidyā》（第 26 句）

verses.iast: sidhyantu mama maṃtrapadā hayagrīvo bhagavān ājñā pa yati svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 愿诸真言章句悉皆成就，我之（行者所有），无我大慈三昧·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，马头明王（马头观音迅速啖障尊），世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，命令、圆满，跛字门（第一义谛（paramārtha）·本不生体性），戒精进，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: May all mantra-padas succeed! my, of me (the practitioner), selfless great loving-kindness & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust, Hayagrīva, Horse-Necked Wrathful Vidyārāja, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, command, ultimate truth (paramārtha) — primordial non-arising, as many, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #16《Hayagrīvavidyā》（第 27 句）

verses.meaningZh: 向归命如来，香·光明·广大光华尊
verses.meaningEn: Homage + to, smell + light + O with great magnificence
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 1 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼大神父音！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to great, priest, to!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 2 句）

verses.meaningZh: 此等，陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义），施度调伏·妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: They, Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell, generosity & self-mastery & awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 3 句）

verses.meaningZh: 由我（具格：如是我闻），住，于明咒、真言明妃、圣智明中，成就，得
verses.meaningEn: By me, asyāṃ, in Vidyā, sacred wisdom-spell, illumination, siddhiḥ, filled with astonishment and wonder
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 4 句）

verses.meaningZh: 再三鸿毛是的尊
verses.meaningEn: Down + O yes again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 5 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！殊胜、胜愿、妙好尊，嗡！殊胜、胜愿、妙好尊
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O choicest, supreme boon, excellent / in choicest, supreme boon, excellent, Oṃ! O choicest, supreme boon, excellent / in choicest, supreme boon, excellent
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 6 句）

verses.iast: parikuñja naṭa naṭa puskara vahaja lukha
verses.meaningZh: 般灌木，再三作舞，能作成办·第一义谛，御山羊，离一切相无相·等虚空无碍
verses.meaningEn: Wisdom + bush, a dancer or mime again and again, making, to transport + drift, freedom from conditioned marks & space-like boundlessness
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 7 句）

verses.meaningZh: 再三等虚空无碍·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: Space-like boundlessness & selfless great loving-kindness again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 8 句）

verses.meaningZh: 法界平等摄持心印（伊利），契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利）
verses.meaningEn: Primordial Dharma-realm equipoise, intimate union with the deity samādhi
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 9 句）

verses.meaningZh: 金刚橛威神警觉、摧伏魔军（吉栗），契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利）
verses.meaningEn: Vajra-kīla transfixing obstacles & awakening, intimate union with the deity samādhi
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 10 句）

verses.meaningZh: 誉殊胜
verses.meaningEn: Renown + choicest
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 11 句）

verses.meaningZh: 再三阶位双手尊，面门、尊颜、法门入口尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: O position of the hands / in position of the hands again and again, O face, mouth, gateway/door / in face, mouth, gateway/door, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 12 句）

verses.iast: atha bhagavān tasmin samaye māramaṇḍalavidhvaṃsanaṃ nāma samādhiṃ samāpede
verses.meaningZh: 尔时、次复吉祥启白，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，于彼处、于彼时，向平，魔·曼荼罗·摧灭，名为、号曰，三摩地、正定等持，平·净水·此处尊
verses.meaningEn: Now, thereupon, auspiciously, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, in that, therein, to equal, Māra + Maṇḍala + ruining, by name, called, Samādhi, meditative absorption, equal + water
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 13 句）

verses.meaningZh: 借由彼因缘，一切、普皆遍满，玻璃·器械·一雨，天妙·青莲华·莲华·固目答·白莲华，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，滋养增益·第一义谛
verses.meaningEn: By which, whereby, all, every, complete, a precious stone + striking + rain, divine + blue lotus + lotus flower + the flower of the white water-lily + white lotus, great, nourishing
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 14 句）

verses.meaningZh: 多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·远离寂静周遍·大空菩提点摄持）及声，离名相假立·最上真言离言说·施度调伏
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness (tathatā) — expansive quiescence sealed with bodhicitta bindu and sound, beyond nominal designation & supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 15 句）

verses.iast: yaduta dharmaśabdaṃ buddhaśabdaṃ saṃghaśabdaṃ pāramitāśabdam abhijñāśabdaṃ bodhimaṇḍopasaṃkramaṇaśabdaṃ yāvatsopā dānanirupādānaśabdā nadhyatiṣṭhat
verses.meaningZh: 亦即、心路，正法声，佛陀声，截至军队年度，波罗蜜多声，六通声，菩提藏·演出弩蘖帝·声，一乘如实之道·最上真言离言说·真如实际，布施·在于·色相·执着·声，离名相假立·法界总持任持·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Namely, to wit, Dharma + sound, Buddha + sound, by troops + year, Pāramitā + sound, six supernatural powers + sound, platform + act of approaching + sound, supreme vehicle of awakening & supreme ineffable speech & immutable Suchness, generosity + in + form + grasping + sound, beyond nominal designation & Dharma-realm retention & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 16 句）

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，尘·一样·号啕·阿野婆，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·本性寂静止息
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, the same + cry, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & primordial tranquil peace
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 17 句）

verses.iast: ye kecidiha cāturdīpike tṛṇagulmauṣadhivanaspatikṣitiśailaparvatāstān sarvān sapta mahāratnānadhyatiṣṭhat
verses.meaningZh: 凡彼等诸有情，造作离相·妙行迁变空·施度调伏，妙行迁变空·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，真如实际·离诸诤论无诤·妙行趣入，一切、普皆遍满，七（七佛，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: Those who, whoever (pl.), freedom from karmic agency & awakened conduct beyond flux & generosity & self-mastery, awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), immutable Suchness & conflict-free peace & awakened spiritual movement, all, every, complete, seven, great
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 18 句）

verses.iast: anava loka nataḥ mūrdhnā bhagavān yāvad brahmalokaṃ kāyena vaśaṃ vartayāmāsa
verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·最上真言离言说，世间、世界，由不、非、无，无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢·法界总持任持，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，一乘如实之道·最上真言离言说·施度调伏，梵世，以身、佛身法身，因为、截至所以，幅度·以彼·月
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & supreme ineffable speech, world, realm, from not, non-, selfless great loving-kindness & stainless purity free from dust & Dharma-realm retention, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, supreme vehicle of awakening & supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery, Brahma World, by/through body, kāya (sacred dimension), on account of, for the sake of, by reason of, width + moon
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 19 句）

verses.iast: ekaikasmācca lakṣaṇādbhagavatastādṛśī prabhā niścacāra yayā prabhayā tri sāhasramahāsāhasralokadhātū dāreṇābhāsena sphuṭo'bhūt
verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧，离一切相无相·造作离相·六度满行清净，光明、清净毫光，离名相假立·本性寂静止息·妙行迁变空，一乘如实之道，以光明、清净毫光，三，广大殊胜·一切诸谛圆满，施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，开曾有
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness, freedom from conditioned marks & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās, light, radiance, splendor, aura, beyond nominal designation & primordial tranquil peace & awakened conduct beyond flux, supreme vehicle of awakening, with/by light, radiance, splendor, aura, three, great, generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace (by spiritual power), suffused
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 20 句）

verses.iast: ye cāsyāṃ trisāhasramahāsāhasrayāṃ lokadhātau devanāgayakṣagandharvāsuragaruḍakinnara-mahoragapretapiśāca-kumābhāṇḍa manuṣyāmanuṣyā nairayikā vā tairyagyonikā vā yāmalaukikā
verses.meaningZh: 凡彼等诸有情，妙行迁变空·一切诸谛圆满·一乘如实之道，广大殊胜·真如实际，离一切相无相·造作离相·法界总持任持，光明照耀·宝树宝山·药叉·乾闼婆·阿修罗·迦楼罗·紧那罗，摩睺罗伽·饿鬼·毗舍遮，大地·勿·椀，人非人，地狱道，或、抑或，真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，或、抑或，趣往特殊
verses.meaningEn: Those who, whoever (pl.), awakened conduct beyond flux & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme vehicle of awakening, great, freedom from conditioned marks & freedom from karmic agency & Dharma-realm retention (imperative seal), shining + tree or mountain + Yakṣa + Gandharva + Asura + Garuḍa + Kinnara, Mahoraga + Preta + Piśāca, earth + do not + bowl, person + a non-human, of hell, or, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening, or, going + not common in the world
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 21 句）

verses.iast: vā te sarve bhagavantamadrākṣuḥ bahūni ca devanāgayakṣamanuṣyāmanuṣyaśatasahasrāṇi gaganasthāḥ puṣpairavākiran pra dakṣiṇaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 或、抑或，向汝、彼等，一切、普皆遍满尊，若衍底·本刹·经营·喷嚏，解脱系缚大力·因缘空寂大乐·离名相假立以及光明照耀·宝树宝山·坚持下去·非人·非人·一切百千，虚空诸依止处，滋养增益·第一义谛，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性），右
verses.meaningEn: Or, to Thee / they, O all, every, complete / in all, every, complete, victorious passed beyond + this + run + sneeze, spiritual strength freeing bonds & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation) and shining + tree or mountain + press on + a non-human + a non-human + sgl, sky + standing, nourishing, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising, right
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 22 句）

verses.meaningZh: 妙行迁变空·造作离相·清净离诸尘垢，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·最上真言离言说，归命敬礼·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux & freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech, bowing
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 23 句）

verses.iast: bahūni nairayikā tairyagyonikā yāmalaukikākṣobhyakoṭīśatasahasrāṇi smṛtiṃ pratilebhire
verses.meaningZh: 解脱系缚大力·因缘空寂大乐·离名相假立，地狱道，真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，趣往·特殊·阿閦如来·魔爪·一切百千，正念、忆持不忘，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Spiritual strength freeing bonds & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), of hell, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening, going + not common in the world + Akṣobhya + the curved end of the bow + sgl, mindfulness, recollection, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 24 句）

verses.iast: pūrvāvaropitakuśalamūlamanusmṛtya namo buddhāya iti kṛtvā tebhyo'pāyebhyaścyavitvā deveṣūpapannaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 本·种善根·那罗·忆持·那个，归命，向佛陀、觉者，如是（结句印定），既作已、行持已，真如实际·破有相福德光·一乘如实之道，神圣宝箭揭帝降临
verses.meaningEn: Former + man + remember + that, homage to to/for Buddha, the Awakened One, thus, so it is stated, having done, having performed, immutable Suchness & blessedness transcending existence & supreme vehicle of awakening, a divine arrow + having gone or come to
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 25 句）

verses.iast: tataśca mārasainyā dvāviṃśatimāraputraśatasahasrāṇi sapārṣadyāni bhagavata evaṃrūpaṃ prātihāryaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhagavato'ntike atīva prasādaṃ pratilabdhvā yena bhagavāṃstenopajagmatuḥ
verses.meaningZh: 由伊人、本刹及魔多，二十二·魔·子·一切百千，一切诸谛圆满·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢，才鸣呼，如是，瑞，施度调伏·六度满行清净·断除憍慢执障，世尊·以此·于，很，淳，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，借由彼因缘，破有相福德光·妙行趣入·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: From stem of he, she, it, Māra + relating to an army, twenty-two + Māra + son + sgl, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), excellence, evaṃrūpaṃ, a miracle, generosity & self-mastery & perfection of the six pāramitās & cutting rigid pride, Bhagavān + hence + near to, very, pure, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, by which, whereby, blessedness transcending existence & awakened spiritual movement & supreme ineffable speech
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 26 句）

verses.iast: upetya taiḥ sārdhaṃ pañcabhirmārakanyāśatairbhagavataḥ pādau śirasābhivandya añjalīn pragṛhya ābhirgāthabhiradhibhāṣante sma
verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·真如实际·一乘如实之道，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·大自在威德统摄·涅槃除障点证入），俱，第一义谛·圣智通达·妙行迁变空，第一义谛·施度调伏，礼敬赞叹·本性寂静止息，圣智通达·生起不可得·尊胜·离一切相无相，转载可见，宣说演畅·破有相福德光，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — sovereign spiritual mastery with nirvāṇic visarga release, together, ultimate truth & non-dual wisdom awareness & awakened conduct beyond flux, ultimate truth & generosity & self-mastery (imperative seal), venerating, non-dual wisdom awareness & transcending birth & victorious & freedom from conditioned marks, forward + to be seized or taken, speaking (vocative invocation), selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #17《Mahāsannipātaratnaketudhāraṇī sūtraṃ》（第 27 句）

titleZh: 【DB3·DSBC专书】《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》(Book #18)
titleEnglish: DSBC Sanskrit Canon Book #18: Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī
translatorZh: Miroj Shakya & Milan Shakya (DSBC Project)
sutraSourceZh: DSBC Dhāraṇī Collection (Book #18)
deityZh: नारायणपरिपृच्छा आर्यमहामायाविजयवाहिनी नाम धारणी
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自尼泊尔数字化梵文佛典库 (DSBC) 陀罗尼专目第 #18 号梵本《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（录入校勘：Miroj Shakya & Milan Shakya (DSBC Project)）。
recitationTipsZh: 基于尼泊尔梵文写本直接转写，支持六体汇总与 48kHz 梵音合成朗读。

provenance.editionCitation: DSBC Book #18: Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī (Nagarjuna Institute of Buddhist Studies (Kathmandu, Nepal))
provenance.manuscriptNotesZh: 尼泊尔 DSBC 独立陀罗尼梵文经卷 (#18)。
provenance.rawSnippet: nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī namaḥ sarvabuddhabodhisattvebhyaḥ evaṃ mayā śrutamekasminsamaye bhagavān svarṇaśṛṅge parvatāgre vaiśravaṇasya gṛhe viharati sma| tatra devanāgayakṣagandharvāsuragaruḍakinnaramahoragavidyādharāpsaraḥprabh

verses.iast: tena nārāyaṇa gṛhāṇatvaṃ mahāmāyāvijayavāhinīṃ nāma dhāraṇīmantrapadāṇi
verses.meaningZh: 借由彼力、以是因缘，那罗延，妙行趣入·因缘空寂大乐·离诸诤论无诤，广大殊胜·尊胜降伏·无我大慈三昧，名为、号曰，陀罗尼一切真言章句
verses.meaningEn: By that truth, thereby, through that power, Narayana, awakened spiritual movement & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & conflict-free peace, great, conquering, by name, called, Dhāraṇī + sacred mantra phrase
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 1 句）

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：归命敬礼·离名相假立，向诸一切佛陀菩提萨埵
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: bowing, all + Buddha + to all Bodhisattva
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 2 句）

verses.meaningZh: 向诸一切手印真言章句
verses.meaningEn: All + Mudrā + to all sacred mantra phrase
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 3 句）

verses.iast: om māye mahāmāye mahāmāyādhāraṇi iyaṃ sā mahāmāyāmantreṇa mahāmāyārūpeṇa
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！花样尊，神明尊，广大泡影陀罗尼，此圣女、此陀罗尼，彼、彼圣母（阴性主格），以广大泡影真言，以广大泡影色
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O trick, wile / in trick, wile, O very deceitful or illusory, the Great Illusion + O Dhāraṇī, this (feminine), she, that, the Great Illusion + by, the Great Illusion + by
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 4 句）

verses.iast: bhrama bhrama sattvānāñca ye virūdhakaṃ cintayanti sarvaduṣṭasattvāstān bhrāmaya bhrāmaya mohaya mohaya mūrcchāpaya mūrcchāpaya māraya māraya vidhvaṃsaya vidhvaṃsaya
verses.meaningZh: 再三头旋，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·最上真言离言说，凡彼等诸有情，最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·法界总持任持，认为诸尊此处，一切·暴恶者·有情·故乡，再三遊，再三请令怨魔迷闷失其毒力！再三无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢·妙行迁变空，再三魔、天魔烦恼障，再三请彻底摧毁、令其坏散无余！
verses.meaningEn: Spring again and again, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech, those who, whoever (pl.), supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & Dharma-realm retention, think + they walk, all + wicked + sentient being + home, may You to tour! again and again, bewilder hostile forces! again and again, selfless great loving-kindness & stainless purity free from dust & awakened conduct beyond flux again and again, may You Māra, demon, obstacle to awakening! again and again, utterly demolish and disperse! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 5 句）

verses.iast: mara mara mahāmāye alalalale mahāmāyājālasahasramukhi sahasraśire sahasramuje jvalitanetre sarvatathāgatahṛdayagarbhe asidhanuparaśupāśatomarakanayaśaktinṛmuṇḍihaste mudgaracakrahaste
verses.meaningZh: 再三临危、死厄，神明尊，严·体育·严，广大泡影·网·打败·眼泪尊颜尊，截至成千饮料，千胸尊，炽盛燃耀眼目，一切如来·心·藏，一切诸谛圆满·法界总持任持·离名相假立，锤·颤动·无手尊
verses.meaningEn: Dying, death again and again, O very deceitful or illusory, sport, the Great Illusion + net + overpower + O having tears in the face, by thousands + O drink, sahasramuje, blazing + O eye, all Tathagatas + heart + O womb, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & Dharma-realm retention & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), hammer + tremble + O handless
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 6 句）

verses.iast: ehyehi bhagavati sarvatathāgatasatyena devarṣigaṇasatyena mahāmāyāvijayavāhinī smara smara sarvatathāgatajñānarūpeṇa gaccha gaccha sarvāvaraṇakṣayaṅkari
verses.meaningZh: 祈请速疾降临道场（翳呬翳呬），世尊佛母！（呼格），以一切如来谛，施度调伏·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，广大泡影·最胜尊胜·具画儿，再三忆念本誓，以一切如来圣智色，再三去吧、趣向菩提！能作成办·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: Come, come swiftly to this sanctuary! O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! all Tathagatas + by, generosity & self-mastery & supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust (by spiritual power), the Great Illusion + supreme victory! triumph! + possessing carrying, remember Your primordial vow! again and again, all Tathagatas + primordial wisdom + by, go! proceed! again and again, making (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 7 句）

verses.iast: parasainyavidrāviṇi mohaya mohaya mama sarvasattvānāñca sarvaduṣṭān
verses.meaningZh: 他人·多·解·具叫声，再三请令怨魔迷闷失其毒力！我之（行者所有），一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，一切暴恶者
verses.meaningEn: Someone else + relating to an army + understanding + O bearer of roaring, bewilder hostile forces! again and again, my, of me (the practitioner), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, all + wicked
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 8 句）

verses.iast: rakṣa rakṣa māṃ sarvasattvāṃśca yakṣabhayopadravebhyaḥ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 祈请再三拥护、守护于我，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，向诸坚持下去无畏灾横，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Evermore protect, guard and shelter me, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, press on + non-fear + to all calamity, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 9 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！广大泡影·陀罗尼·此处尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! the Great Illusion + Dhāraṇī, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 10 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！大·曼荼罗·所加持，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! great + Maṇḍala + O blessed, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 11 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！向金刚总持·赞叹·趣往·所恭敬，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Vajradhara + praise + going + to honored, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 12 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！向莲华手菩萨惜者，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Padmapani bodhisattva + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 13 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！一切施·犹如·归命·所作，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! one who gives everything + like + homage + O done, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 14 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！礼敬赞叹·供养礼赞·无我大慈三昧，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! venerating, worshipping (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 15 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！胜伏、最胜吉祥！尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O conquer! victory! / in conquer! victory! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 16 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！最胜尊胜、普胜一切！尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O supreme victory! triumph! / in supreme victory! triumph! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 17 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 18 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！向不是规定汝，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! no rule + to Thee, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 19 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！无能胜、不可摧伏尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O invincible, unconquered / in invincible, unconquered, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 20 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！三婆嚩尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O producing or relating to illusion / in producing or relating to illusion, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 21 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！僵仆出，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! laming + O income, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 22 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！生起不可得·尊胜·无我大慈三昧·破有相福德光，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! transcending birth & victorious & selfless great loving-kindness & blessedness transcending existence (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 23 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！尊胜降伏·生起不可得·尊胜，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! conquering (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 24 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！破有相福德光·清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! blessedness transcending existence & stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 25 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！破有相福德光·清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! blessedness transcending existence & stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 26 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 27 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！广大殊胜·礼敬赞叹·供养礼赞·无我大慈三昧，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! great, venerating, worshipping (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 28 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！造作离相·无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! freedom from karmic agency & selfless great loving-kindness & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 29 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！花样·此边·慧眼·汝即是·此处尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! trick + the hither + eye + Thou art, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 30 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！清净离诸尘垢，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! stainless purity free from dust, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 31 句）

verses.iast: om rū rū hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ he he jaye māyā bhagavati mahāmāyāvijayavāhinī gṛhāṇa
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·威神增益圆满），吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！再三呼唤圣尊叹词（咄！圣者！），胜伏、最胜吉祥！尊，幻化、如幻妙力，世尊佛母！（呼格），广大泡影·最胜尊胜·具画儿，妙行趣入·因缘空寂大乐·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — perfected spiritual vigor again and again, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ! O! Hail! Vocative invocation particle again and again, O conquer! victory! / in conquer! victory! illusion, magical display (Māyā), O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! the Great Illusion + supreme victory! triumph! + possessing carrying, awakened spiritual movement & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & conflict-free peace
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 32 句）

verses.iast: śīghramāvilambasva mama sarvasattvānāṃca sarvakāryaṃ kuru kuru hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 快·勿·搭拉·自，我之（行者所有），一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，一切果，再三成办羯磨事业（俱噜），吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Quick + do not + hanging down + own, my, of me (the practitioner), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, all, accomplish & enact this sacred work! again and again, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 33 句）

verses.meaningZh: 兽主徒，静·即时·渊博，世间过去，归命愿得成就，向汝、彼等
verses.meaningEn: Śivaḥ, then + to be seized, world, homage + may it be so, to Thee / they
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 34 句）

verses.meaningZh: 持守摄受·法界总持任持，正法、诸法实相，谛、真实不虚语，归命愿得成就，向汝、彼等
verses.meaningEn: Bearing (imperative seal), Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena, truth, reality, veracity, homage + may it be so, to Thee / they
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #18《Nārāyaṇaparipṛcchā āryamahāmāyāvijayavāhinī nāma dhāraṇī》（第 35 句）
