provenance.rawSnippet: ṣaṇmukhī-dhāraṇī oṃ namo buddhāya|| evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān śuddhāvāsopari-gaganatala-pratiṣṭhite sapta-ratna pravibha kta-vicitra-ratna-vyūhe mahā-maṇḍalamāḍe viharati sma|| asaṃ-khyeyena bodhi sa[t]tva-gaṇena sār(d)dhaṃ|| tatra khalu bhagavā

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！归命，向佛陀、觉者
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to/for Buddha, the Awakened One
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #19《Ṣaṇmukhī dhāraṇī》（第 1 句）

verses.iast: evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān śuddhāvāsopari-gaganatala-pratiṣṭhite sapta-ratna pravibhakta-vicitra-ratna-vyūhe mahā-maṇḍalamāḍe viharati sma
verses.meaningZh: 如是、如此，由我（具格：如是我闻），闻，一时，向平，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，净居天般，穹苍，踞尊，七（七佛，珍宝、摩尼宝，分布式、隔离，斑驳陆离、微质怛囒，珍宝、摩尼宝，庄严尊，大、摩诃（广大无边），周廊尊，一切，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in this way, by me, heard, at one time, to equal, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, suddhavasa + wisdom, celestial vault, firmament, O squat / in squat, seven, jewel, precious gem, treasure, distributed, divided, separate, variegated, many-coloured, jewel, precious gem, treasure, O mass, heap, great, vast, supreme, O a circular hall, lives, dwells, spends oneʼs time, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #19《Ṣaṇmukhī dhāraṇī》（第 2 句）

verses.iast: asaṃ-khyeyena bodhi sa t tva-gaṇena sār(ddhaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 乃是、存在，以观照此处，菩提、无上正觉，彼、此尊（阳性主格），多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·本不生体性），嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，以海会众、圣众眷属，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·远离寂静周遍），驮字门（法界总持任持（dhātu
verses.meaningEn: Be, exist, happen, become, see, Bodhi, awakening, enlightenment, he, that one, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — primordial non-arising, supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — primordial non-arising, by/through assembly, host,retinue, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — expansive quiescence, Dharma-realm retention (dhātu) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #19《Ṣaṇmukhī dhāraṇī》（第 3 句）

verses.iast: tatra khalu bhagavān bodhisa t tvān āmantrayate sma
verses.meaningZh: 于彼处、其中，诚然、确实，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，菩提彼，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·本不生体性），曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·远离寂静周遍），妙意三重，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: There, therein, indeed, verily, certainly, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, Bodhi + he, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — primordial non-arising, beyond nominal designation (nāma) — expansive quiescence, benevolent + triple, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #19《Ṣaṇmukhī dhāraṇī》（第 4 句）

verses.iast: udgṛhṇīdhavaṃ yūyaṃ kulaputrā imāṃ ṣaṇmukhī-nāma-dhāraṇīṃ sarva-jagad-dhitārthaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 施度调伏·妙行趣入·因缘空寂大乐，一乘如实之道，善男子，此（陀罗尼明妃，阴性宾格），六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤·无我大慈三昧，名为、号曰，总持任持·法界总持任持，一切、普皆遍满，生起不可得·尊胜·妙行趣入·施度调伏，救度超脱·法界总持任持
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery & awakened spiritual movement & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, supreme vehicle of awakening, a good man, this (feminine accusative), perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace & selfless great loving-kindness, by name, called, upholding, all, every, complete, transcending birth & victorious & awakened spiritual movement & generosity & self-mastery, ferrying across
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #19《Ṣaṇmukhī dhāraṇī》（第 5 句）

verses.meaningZh: 彼、如是真实，犹如此圣女
verses.meaningEn: That, thus, just as + this
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #19《Ṣaṇmukhī dhāraṇī》（第 6 句）

verses.iast: namo bhagavate uṣṇīṣāya śuddhe viraje vimale svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 归命向世尊（薄伽梵）致敬，向佛顶肉髻相、无见顶相，清净、纯洁无染尊，嚩啰阇尊，毘磨利，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, to/for Uṣṇīṣa, Buddha's crown protuberance, O pure, cleansed, bright / in pure, cleansed, bright, O free from dust, pure, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #20《Sitātapatrā dhāraṇī》（第 2 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊（薄伽梵）致敬·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤·佛顶肉髻相、无见顶相！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace, Uṣṇīṣa, Buddha's crown protuberance!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #20《Sitātapatrā dhāraṇī》（第 3 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛陀、觉者！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Buddha, the Awakened One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #20《Sitātapatrā dhāraṇī》（第 4 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼正法、诸法实相！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #20《Sitātapatrā dhāraṇī》（第 5 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼圣僧伽、清净海众！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Saṃgha, noble spiritual community!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #20《Sitātapatrā dhāraṇī》（第 6 句）

verses.iast: namaḥ saptānāṃ samyaksaṃbuddhakoṭīnāṃ namo maitreyapramukhānāṃ sarvabuddhabodhisattvānāṃ saśrāvakasaṃghānām
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼诸七（七佛·正等正觉诸俱胝·弥勒菩萨诸上首·一切·佛陀·诸菩提萨埵·彼·舍罗婆迦·诸圣僧伽！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to seven, Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha, of ten million, Maitreya, of all foremost, all, Buddha, of all Bodhisattva, he, sravaka, of all Saṃgha!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #20《Sitātapatrā dhāraṇī》（第 7 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世间、世界尊·诸应供、阿罗汉（破烦恼贼）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to O world, realm / in world, realm, Arhat, Worthy One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #20《Sitātapatrā dhāraṇī》（第 8 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·诸入！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust, entered!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #20《Sitātapatrā dhāraṇī》（第 9 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼斯陀含是的！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Sakrdagamin, yes!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #20《Sitātapatrā dhāraṇī》（第 10 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼自然·宝树宝山·急躁！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to certainly, tree or mountain, impetuous!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #20《Sitātapatrā dhāraṇī》（第 11 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世间、世界尊·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·一乘如实之道！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to O world, realm / in world, realm, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme vehicle of awakening!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #20《Sitātapatrā dhāraṇī》（第 12 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼权利诸入！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to right, of all practised!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #20《Sitātapatrā dhāraṇī》（第 13 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼施度调伏·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to generosity & self-mastery & supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #20《Sitātapatrā dhāraṇī》（第 14 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼施度调伏·最上真言离言说·解脱系缚大力！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to generosity & self-mastery & supreme ineffable speech & spiritual strength freeing bonds (vocative invocation)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #20《Sitātapatrā dhāraṇī》（第 15 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛陀、觉者！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Buddha, the Awakened One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #20《Sitātapatrā dhāraṇī》（第 16 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊（薄伽梵）致敬·紧恶·自在主一连！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, of gods, the lord or husband of Umā, to!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #20《Sitātapatrā dhāraṇī》（第 17 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼水神！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the All-encompasser, of a god!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #20《Sitātapatrā dhāraṇī》（第 18 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊（薄伽梵）致敬·那罗延！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, Narayana!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #20《Sitātapatrā dhāraṇī》（第 19 句）

verses.meaningZh: 大·五·手印，归命，向归命所作

verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #21《Vasudhārādhāraṇī (Vasudhārā)》（第 33 句）

verses.iast: subhadramati śubhamati candramati āgacchāgaccha samayamanusmara svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 善哉慧，滑行一同相貌，享受经营那么，唯愿降临赴会！唯愿降临赴会！平·摄伏·随念本昔弘誓大愿，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Excellent + intelligence, glide along + appearance, delight in + run about, come hither! approach! + come hither! approach! equal + hold + recall Your ancient compassionate vow! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #21《Vasudhārādhāraṇī (Vasudhārā)》（第 34 句）

verses.meaningZh: 忆念本誓·一切诸谛圆满，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Recalling, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #21《Vasudhārādhāraṇī (Vasudhārā)》（第 35 句）

verses.meaningZh: 想
verses.meaningEn: Holding fast, firmness, solidity, constancy, resolution
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #21《Vasudhārādhāraṇī (Vasudhārā)》（第 36 句）

verses.meaningZh: 诸一切如来之，调伏，心，下属，胜伏、最胜吉祥！最胜尊胜、普胜一切！一切众生·颤动·此尊·随念本昔弘誓大愿，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Of all all Tathagatas, discipline, hṛdayaṃ, subordinate, conquer! victory! supreme victory! triumph! all sentient beings + dart up or back + this one + recall Your ancient compassionate vow! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #21《Vasudhārādhāraṇī (Vasudhārā)》（第 37 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！吉祥宝部心印（福德庄严总持），最上真言离言说·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! auspicious Lakṣmī/Ratna-family seed syllable, supreme ineffable speech & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #21《Vasudhārādhāraṇī (Vasudhārā)》（第 38 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！吉祥宝部心印（福德庄严总持），财物吉祥，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! auspicious Lakṣmī/Ratna-family seed syllable, good + auspiciousness, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #21《Vasudhārādhāraṇī (Vasudhārā)》（第 39 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！吉祥宝部心印（福德庄严总持），财物广大光华尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! auspicious Lakṣmī/Ratna-family seed syllable, good + O with great magnificence, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #21《Vasudhārādhāraṇī (Vasudhārā)》（第 40 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！嚩苏摩底尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O Vasumati, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #21《Vasudhārādhāraṇī (Vasudhārā)》（第 41 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！财物·慧·广大光华尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! good + intelligence + O with great magnificence, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #21《Vasudhārādhāraṇī (Vasudhārā)》（第 42 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！最上真言离言说·一切诸谛圆满，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! supreme ineffable speech & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #21《Vasudhārādhāraṇī (Vasudhārā)》（第 43 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！优渥尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O bestowing wealth, liberal / in bestowing wealth, liberal, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #21《Vasudhārādhāraṇī (Vasudhārā)》（第 44 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！你们持闇尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! you + O bearer of am, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #21《Vasudhārādhāraṇī (Vasudhārā)》（第 45 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！具请执持、总持护念！尊，具方位尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O bearer of hold! bear! sustain! O bearer of holding, bearing, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #21《Vasudhārādhāraṇī (Vasudhārā)》（第 46 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！三昧耶寂静温和，平·风大自在除障种子·大象尊，向大平，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Samaya + O gentle, equal + Vāyu wind-mandala swiftness seed syllable + O an elephant, great + to equal, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #21《Vasudhārādhāraṇī (Vasudhārā)》（第 47 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！广大光华尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O with great magnificence / in with great magnificence, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #21《Vasudhārādhāraṇī (Vasudhārā)》（第 48 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！吉祥大象尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! auspiciousness + O an elephant, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #21《Vasudhārādhāraṇī (Vasudhārā)》（第 49 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！财大象尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! treasure + O an elephant, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #21《Vasudhārādhāraṇī (Vasudhārā)》（第 50 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！驮·他·大象尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! dha + other + O an elephant, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #21《Vasudhārādhāraṇī (Vasudhārā)》（第 51 句）

verses.meaningZh: 尾真言
verses.meaningEn: Root + Mantra
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #21《Vasudhārādhāraṇī (Vasudhārā)》（第 52 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！广大光华尊，吉祥大象尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O with great magnificence / in with great magnificence, auspiciousness + O an elephant, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #21《Vasudhārādhāraṇī (Vasudhārā)》（第 53 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！财大象尊，驮·他·大象尊，清净离诸尘垢·真如实际·离名相假立，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! treasure + O an elephant, dha + other + O an elephant, stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #21《Vasudhārādhāraṇī (Vasudhārā)》（第 54 句）

verses.meaningZh: 所修习肠
verses.meaningEn: Intestines
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #21《Vasudhārādhāraṇī (Vasudhārā)》（第 55 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！财源佛母（持世丰饶母）尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O Vasudhārā, Stream of Gems Goddess / in Vasudhārā, Stream of Gems Goddess, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #21《Vasudhārādhāraṇī (Vasudhārā)》（第 56 句）

verses.meaningZh: 心
verses.meaningEn: Hṛdayam
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #21《Vasudhārādhāraṇī (Vasudhārā)》（第 57 句）

verses.meaningZh: 向吉祥相，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: To mark, sign, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #21《Vasudhārādhāraṇī (Vasudhārā)》（第 58 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！下属
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! subordinate
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #21《Vasudhārādhāraṇī (Vasudhārā)》（第 59 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！吉祥相，地表·在于·天衣·勇健，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! mark, sign, the surface of the earth + in + garment + O strong, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #21《Vasudhārādhāraṇī (Vasudhārā)》（第 60 句）

verses.iast: saṃ yathā daṃ om yānapātrāvahe svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），犹如、如…所说，陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，嗡！舶·鸿毛·呼唤圣尊叹词，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, just as, according to, generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, Oṃ! a large ship + down + O! Hail! Vocative invocation particle, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #21《Vasudhārādhāraṇī (Vasudhārā)》（第 61 句）

verses.iast: mā dūragāminī anutpannānāṃ dravyāṇāmutpādini utpannānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ vṛddhiṃkari truṭe liṭe liṭe li
verses.meaningZh: 勿、莫令，远程具是的佛母，离名相假立·真如实际·第一义谛，施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，迸诸喫食，诸实之，能作成办·最上真言离言说，真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·断除憍慢执障，再三离一切相无相·断除憍慢执障，攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·诸根清净自在）
verses.meaningEn: Do not, let not, going far + possessing yes, beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness & ultimate truth, generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), burst forth + of all food, of property, wealth, making (vocative invocation), immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation), freedom from conditioned marks & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation) again and again, freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — purified faculties
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #21《Vasudhārādhāraṇī (Vasudhārā)》（第 62 句）

verses.iast: ita ita āgacchāgaccha bhagavati mā vilambaṃ manorathaṃ me paripūraya
verses.meaningZh: 再三趣往、途径，唯愿降临赴会！唯愿降临赴会！世尊佛母！（呼格），勿、莫令，搭拉、垫料，希望、贪欲，于我、为我，祈请成就
verses.meaningEn: Going, way again and again, come hither! approach! + come hither! approach! O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! do not, let not, hanging down, wish, desire, fancy, to me, my, may You filling up
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #21《Vasudhārādhāraṇī (Vasudhārā)》（第 63 句）

verses.iast: daśabhyo digbhyo yathodakadhārā paripūrayanti mahīṃ yathā tamāṃsi bhāskaro raśminā vidhyāpayati ciraṃtanāni yathā śaśī śītāṃśunā niṣpādayatyauṣadhīḥ
verses.meaningZh: 向诸十（十方，施度调伏·妙行趣入·破有相福德光，犹如·净水·边缘，圆满充盈·第一义谛，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，犹如、如…所说，暗肩尊，一样、日轮，以光芒、百千光明聚，服务天神住，妙行迁变空·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，犹如、如…所说，兔佛母，以月轮，禅智观照·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: To/from ten, generosity & self-mastery & awakened spiritual movement & blessedness transcending existence, just as + water + edge, fulfilling (vocative invocation), great, just as, according to, dark + O shoulder, the same, by ray of light, beam, serve a god + nourishes, awakened conduct beyond flux & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), just as, according to, hare (feminine), by cold-rayed, meditative wisdom
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #21《Vasudhārādhāraṇī (Vasudhārā)》（第 64 句）

verses.iast: itiśrī vajrasatva kāyasva tathāgata vyāpta śataṃsamāptaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 如是吉祥，金刚萨埵（普贤金刚心），身自，如来（乘如实道来成正觉），内装、获得性，百三磨钵耽
verses.meaningEn: Thus + auspiciousness, Vajrasattva, Diamond-Essence Being, body + own, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, pervaded or penetrated by, filled with, finished
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #820《Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (Dhāraṇīsaṃgraha — Nepalese Compendium, 820/2949 IAST & 824/2953 Devanāgarī)》（第 2 句）

verses.meaningZh: 清净吉祥、善妙庄严
verses.meaningEn: Auspicious, pure, bright, virtuous
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #820《Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (Dhāraṇīsaṃgraha — Nepalese Compendium, 820/2949 IAST & 824/2953 Devanāgarī)》（第 3 句）

verses.meaningZh: 凡彼等诸有情，正法、诸法实相，开始即是
verses.meaningEn: Those who, whoever (pl.), Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena, beginning thus
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #820《Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (Dhāraṇīsaṃgraha — Nepalese Compendium, 820/2949 IAST & 824/2953 Devanāgarī)》（第 4 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！至心归命礼！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! reverent homage!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #820《Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (Dhāraṇīsaṃgraha — Nepalese Compendium, 820/2949 IAST & 824/2953 Devanāgarī)》（第 5 句）

verses.iast: bhakkyā vācayāmi praṇamitā praṇamitā śirasā taṃ mahāyāga sūtraṃ namo buddhā
verses.meaningZh: 破有相福德光·造作离相·一乘如实之道，语言我此处，再三第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·一切诸谛圆满，彼（宾格），大火供祀施，界线，归命，佛陀、觉者
verses.meaningEn: Blessedness transcending existence & freedom from karmic agency & supreme vehicle of awakening, words + I walk, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace again and again, primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, him, that, great + sacrifice, sūtraṃ, homage to Buddha, the Awakened One
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自尼泊尔 DSBC 专书 #820《Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (Dhāraṇīsaṃgraha — Nepalese Compendium, 820/2949 IAST & 824/2953 Devanāgarī)》（第 6 句）

verses.meaningZh: 耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），归命，向正法、诸法实相，归命，向圣僧伽、清净海众

provenance.rawSnippet: Āryaśrī grahamātṛkā nāma dhāraṇī omnamo bhagavate āryya graha mātṛkāyai om namo sarvaṁbuddha bodhisatbebhya evaṁ mayā śruta mekasmin samaye bhagabān(a) ḍakavatyāṁ mahānagaryyā maneka deba, nāga, yakṣa; gandharbā, sura; garuḍa; kinnara, mahoragāpsarādibhirādity

verses.meaningZh: 归命诸般舟
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the thus-gone ones of the three times. Oṁ , O you who are best in splendor, O you who have been uttered, culu culu ! Hold firm, hold firm! O holder of the relics of all the thus-gone ones, O lotus matrix, best among victories, unmoving one! Remember! O thus-gone one, setting in motion the wheel of the doctrine! O you who adorn with ornaments the adamantine seat of enlightenment! O you who are blessed by all the thus-gone ones! Arouse, arouse toward enlightenment, enlightenment! Thoroughly arouse, arouse toward the buddha, the buddha! Shake, shake! All obscurations must shake! O you in whom all evil has disappeared, huru huru ! O you in whom all grief has disappeared! O quintessence of all the thus-gone ones, O wielder of the adamantine thunderbolt, engender, engender, O secret of all the thus-gone ones, O seal of the dhāraṇī, O knowing one, O well-knowing one, O you who are blessed by all the thus-gone ones, O matrix of relics, svāhā ! O you who are blessed by the pledge, svāhā ! O quintessence of all the thus-gone ones, O seal of relics, svāhā ! O well-constructed stūpa blessed by the thus-gone one, hūṁ hūṁ svāhā ! Oṁ , O seal of the relics of all the thus-gone ones’ uṣṇīṣas, O you who are blessed by the ornament of the dimension of reality of all the thus-gone ones, huru huru , hūṁ hūṁ svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Reading traiyadhvikānāṃ , as in the Compendium of Incantations section of the Dege edition. The version in the Tantra section is somewhat illegible here, so although it seems to read dhī , it may be that dhvi was intended.

verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (vocative invocation), Thou art, awakened spiritual movement & freedom from conditioned marks & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), awakened conduct beyond flux & supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), great (vocative invocation), Thou art, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Following S pa dA kra ma si , which is supported by Skt. padākramasi . Toh 564 and 988 read pa tā kra ma si .

verses.meaningEn: All + press on + free from Rākṣasas + of planet, maker of ruining, spoiling, destroying, violating, Hūṃ! adamantine Uṣṇīṣa protection seed syllable, Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, cutting rigid pride (ṭaṅka) — consecrating Dharma-stream sealed with bodhicitta bindu

verses.meaningZh: 谨慎诸八十之，曜执诸千，能作摧灭尊，吽（金刚心印）！佛顶庄严结界心印，莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），吒字门（断除憍慢执障（ṭaṅka）·摄受法流灌顶·大空菩提点摄持）
verses.meaningEn: Swift + of eighty, planet + of thousand, maker of ruining, spoiling, destroying, violating, Hūṃ! adamantine Uṣṇīṣa protection seed syllable, Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, cutting rigid pride (ṭaṅka) — consecrating Dharma-stream sealed with bodhicitta bindu

verses.iast: aṣṭāviṃsatīnāṃ nakṣatrāṇāṃ prasādanakarī hūṃ drūṃ hrīḥ ṣṭoṃ
verses.meaningZh: 六度满行清净·断除憍慢执障·最上真言离言说，诸星宿（二十八宿）之，能作一样尊，吽（金刚心印）！佛顶庄严结界心印，莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），吒字门（断除憍慢执障（ṭaṅka）·摄受法流灌顶·大空菩提点摄持）

verses.iast: aṣṭānāṃ mahāgrahāṇāṃ vidhvaṃsanakarī hūṃ drūṃ hrīḥ ṣṭoṃ
verses.meaningZh: 诸八（八正道，乐趣诸执拗之，能作摧灭尊，吽（金刚心印）！佛顶庄严结界心印，莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），吒字门（断除憍慢执障（ṭaṅka）·摄受法流灌顶·大空菩提点摄持）

verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The Dege version reads prasādhanakarī ( pra sA d+ha na ka rI ), which has been emended here, as in the prose passage above, to prasādanakarī based on CL 1326 ,

verses.meaningZh: 祈请再三拥护、守护于我，诸一切众生、普皆有情以及
verses.meaningEn: Evermore protect, guard and shelter me, all sentient beings and

titleEnglish: Sitātapatrā Born from the Uṣṇīṣa of All Tathāgatas — Standalone Mantra 3/5 (TOH590 / TOH985)

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！再三炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! blaze forth with wisdom radiance! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The Tibetan and Sanskrit sources consistently read º jāmakebhyaḥ , so that reading has been retained. The Tibetan transliteration of the same spell in Toh 591

verses.meaningZh: 再三法界总持任持·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: Dharma-realm retention & freedom from karmic agency again and again

verses.meaningZh: 再三揭幕、一些

verses.meaningZh: 再三断除烦恼结使缠缚（嗔陀）

verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The Tibetan and Sanskrit sources consistently read º jāmakebhyaḥ , so that reading has been retained. The Tibetan transliteration of the same spell in Toh 591

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 4 大数据库「84000 藏文大藏经开放 TEI 语料库」（TOH597 / TOH984，部类：Kriyātantra，BDRC: W22084 / MW22084）。梵文经题：Āryasarvadurgatipariśodhaniuṣṇīṣavijayānāmadhāraṇī；藏文经题：གཙུག་ཏོར་རྣམ་པར་རྒྱལ་བའི་གཟུངས། (gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ba’i gzungs)；英文经题：The Uṣṇīṣavijayā Dhāraṇī。本篇共 60 句。
recitationTipsZh: 84000 学者团队根据梵藏写本严格校勘还原之古典梵文真言，附有权威英译咒义与校勘记。

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼珍宝、摩尼宝·三重、三合会！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to jewel, precious gem, treasure, triple, threefold!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 243.b–248.a · 藏文名：གཙུག་ཏོར་རྣམ་པར་རྒྱལ་བའི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: oṃ namo bhagavate sarvatrailokyaprativiśiṣṭāya buddhāya te namaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊（薄伽梵）致敬，向一切·三界·对·殊胜，向佛陀、觉者，向汝、彼等，至心归命礼！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, all + the Three Worlds + toward + to, to/for Buddha, the Awakened One, to Thee / they, reverent homage!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！再三一字顶轮王与尊胜佛顶最上心印
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Uṣṇīṣa-cakravartin & Vijayā crown seed syllable again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请净除、涤荡清净！
verses.meaningEn: Purify! cleanse! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请最极净除、彻底涤净一切业障！
verses.meaningEn: Thoroughly purify! cleanse completely! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 无等·普现·遍·趣向·虚空，自性最极清净
verses.meaningEn: Unequalled + suffusion + course + O sky, own-being + O completely purified
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 愿一切如来普施甘露灌顶！于我，诸一切如来，真言宣演·一切诸谛圆满，以诸大手印真言章句
verses.meaningEn: May all Buddhas consecrate and anoint me, all Tathagatas (plural), uttering, Mahāmudrā + by
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.iast: āhara āhara mama āyuḥsandhāraṇi śodhaya śodhaya
verses.meaningZh: 再三请摄召、赐予妙寿福德供养！我之（行者所有），寿命·赢得·陀罗尼，再三请净除、涤荡清净！
verses.meaningEn: Bring! fetch! bestow! again and again, my, of me (the practitioner), life-force + win + O Dhāraṇī, purify! cleanse! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请最极净除、彻底涤净一切业障！
verses.meaningEn: Thoroughly purify! cleanse completely! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 虚空·自性·最极清净
verses.meaningEn: Sky + own-being + O completely purified
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 佛顶尊胜佛母圆满清净
verses.meaningEn: Uṣṇīṣavijayā + O thoroughly pure
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 六·波罗蜜多·般·遂尊
verses.meaningEn: Six + Pāramitā + wisdom + O satisfy
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 萨嚩怛他蘖多南架子，十地踞尊
verses.meaningEn: Sarvatathāgataṃ + O frame, the Ten Bodhisattva Grounds + O squat
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 一切如来·心·加持·所加持
verses.meaningEn: All Tathagatas + heart + spiritual blessing + O blessed
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 再三阶位双手尊，大手印、大法契印尊
verses.meaningEn: O position of the hands / in position of the hands again and again, O Mahāmudrā, Great Seal / in Mahāmudrā, Great Seal
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 金刚身·好好儿编织·不·圆满清净
verses.meaningEn: Vajrakāya + struck together + not + O thoroughly pure
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 一切·业障·最极清净
verses.meaningEn: All + karmic obscuration + O completely purified
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 请回遮逆转（灾厄）、令寿复延！我之（行者所有），寿命最极清净
verses.meaningEn: Turn back (evil)! restore! my, of me (the practitioner), life + O completely purified
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 一切如来·三昧耶·加持·所加持
verses.meaningEn: All Tathagatas + Samaya + spiritual blessing + O blessed
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！再三牟尼、寂默圣者，大牟尼尊（释迦世尊）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Muni, silent sage again and again, Great Sage (Mahāmuni)
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 再三闢牟尼，大·闢·牟尼
verses.meaningEn: Settle + Muni again and again, great + settle + Muni
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 再三慧、正念妙慧，大慧，我之（行者所有），善心、人情
verses.meaningEn: Intelligence, wisdom, mindfulness again and again, great wisdom, my, of me (the practitioner), benevolence, favour
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 真如·实际·圆满清净
verses.meaningEn: Suchness + limit of reality + O thoroughly pure
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 闢·开·清净尊
verses.meaningEn: Settle + suffused + O pure in heart or intention
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 再三呼唤圣尊叹词（咄！圣者！）
verses.meaningEn: O! Hail! Vocative invocation particle again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 再三胜伏、最胜吉祥！
verses.meaningEn: Conquer! victory! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 再三最胜尊胜、普胜一切！
verses.meaningEn: Supreme victory! triumph! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 再三忆念本誓，再三请遍满舒光、周遍法界！
verses.meaningEn: Remember Your primordial vow! again and again, pervade! radiate forth everywhere! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请大放光明遍照十方！
verses.meaningEn: Cause to radiate and expand universally! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 一切·佛陀·加持·所加持
verses.meaningEn: All + Buddha + spiritual blessing + O blessed
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 再三清净、纯洁无染尊
verses.meaningEn: O pure, cleansed, bright / in pure, cleansed, bright again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 再三佛陀、觉者尊
verses.meaningEn: O Buddha, the Awakened One / in Buddha, the Awakened One again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 再三金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊，大金刚尊，勇健金刚杵尊
verses.meaningEn: O Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt / in Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt again and again, great + O Vajra, O having a strong thunderbolt / in having a strong thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 金刚藏尊
verses.meaningEn: Vajragarbhe
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 胜伏藏
verses.meaningEn: Conquer! victory! + O womb
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 最胜尊胜藏
verses.meaningEn: Supreme victory! triumph! + O womb
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 金刚·光焰·藏
verses.meaningEn: Vajra + blaze + O womb
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 金刚氏族
verses.meaningEn: Vajra + O origin
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 金刚三婆婆尊
verses.meaningEn: Vajra + O Sambhava
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊
verses.meaningEn: O Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt / in Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 具金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊
verses.meaningEn: O bearer of Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.iast: vajraṃ bhavatu mama śarīraṃ sarvasattvānāñ ca kāyapariśuddhir bhavatu
verses.meaningZh: 金刚，愿成就、愿悉吉祥，我之（行者所有），躯，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说以及身净，愿成就、愿悉吉祥
verses.meaningEn: Vajraṃ, may it be, let there be! my, of me (the practitioner), śarīraṃ, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech and body, may it be, let there be!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kanxi Kangyur versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 恒常、一切时，于我、为我，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说以及

verses.iast: arara asama samatā anantadharmmatre khaṇā khaṇā mahāvire calesa mama āsahā mahābale kaṇa
verses.meaningZh: 阿啰啰，无等、无比伦，萨麻丹，无边·正法·守护掩蔽，再三等虚空无碍·离诸诤论无诤，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，警觉震动·妙行迁变空，我之（行者所有），一切诸谛圆满·因缘空寂大乐，大力威神、大势力尊尊，赤红
verses.meaningEn: Arara, unequalled, peerless, matchless, to, boundless + Dharma + O protect shelter, space-like boundlessness & conflict-free peace again and again, great (vocative invocation), stirring, my, of me (the practitioner), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, O of great power and might / in of great power and might, kernel
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：K, Y, N anantadharmatre ; H anantadharmetre ; J, C anantadharmma .

verses.meaningZh: 赤红，大力威神、大势力尊，妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐，再三贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢，再三请执持、总持护念！吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！曼荼罗、坛城轮圆具足
verses.meaningEn: Kernel, of great power and might, awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy (vocative invocation), causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — primordial non-arising again and again, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), hold! bear! sustain! again and again, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Maṇḍala, sacred cosmogram/circle
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：K, Y, N anantadharmatre ; H anantadharmetre ; J, C anantadharmma .

verses.iast: samapara-akravikrame kuru kuru turu turu sarvathā sarva hi jvala jvala akriṇi phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 随着必然，消极超尊，再三成办羯磨事业（俱噜），再三迅疾度脱一切危厄（都噜），诸相本，一切、普皆遍满，诚然、因为、实乃，再三炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞），具消极尊，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Along with + a certain, inactive + O surpass, accomplish & enact this sacred work! again and again, swiftly ferry across all perils! again and again, in all ways, by all means, at all, all, every, complete, for, indeed, surely, blaze forth with wisdom radiance! again and again, O bearer of inactive, Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：K, Y, N anantadharmatre ; H anantadharmetre ; J, C anantadharmma .

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：K, Y, N anantadharmatre ; H anantadharmetre ; J, C anantadharmma .

verses.iast: oṃ vajraprākāra vajraprākāra vajradaṃṣṭā bhayābhahā curu curu paricumbike culutele namo ratnatrayāya namo
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三金刚园，最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢，破有相福德光·一乘如实之道·因缘空寂大乐，再三速疾运转妙法加持（祖噜），第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·妙行迁变空，鼓动法水涤除罪垢谛罗尊，归命，向佛法僧三宝，至心归命礼！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Vajra + encircling wall again and again, supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious & stainless purity free from dust, blessedness transcending existence & supreme vehicle of awakening & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, swiftly set sacred blessings in motion! again and again, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & awakened conduct beyond flux (vocative invocation), stir the purifying waters of compassion! homage to to/for the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha), reverent homage!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：K, Y daṃṣṭraṃ ; C, U daṃṣṭā ; H, N daṃṣṭaṃ . Note that the Comparative Edition itself appears to read daṃṣṭwā .

verses.iast: vajrabhairavasya mahāgaṇapatisya vajraśakti parśupāśahastāya vajrakanka vajravaiḍūrya alaṅkṛtaśarīrāya vajrapāṇir anupālāya tadyathā bhuru bhuru
verses.meaningZh: 妙吉祥瑜伽大教金刚陪罗嚩轮观想成就仪轨经之，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，金刚威，向肋骨阎王，最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢，金刚净琉璃宝，离一切相无相·支分寂静·造作离相，金刚手，向日复一日婆罗，即说咒曰：再三破有相福德光·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Of Miao Jixiang Yujia Da Jiao Jingang Pei Luo Fu Lun Guan Xiang Chengjiu Yi Gui Jing, great, Vajra + ability, rib + to, supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious & stainless purity free from dust, Vajra + lapis lazuli, freedom from conditioned marks & quiescence of perceptual limbs & freedom from karmic agency (reverent offering), vajrapāṇir, day after day + to, Thus goes the mantra: blessedness transcending existence & stainless purity free from dust (imperative seal) again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：K, Y daṃṣṭraṃ ; C, U daṃṣṭā ; H, N daṃṣṭaṃ . Note that the Comparative Edition itself appears to read daṃṣṭwā .

verses.iast: ānayā ānayā mahāgaṇapati laghu laghu ehi ehi ākrama ākrama śarīraṃ gṛhītam graṃhītam
verses.meaningZh: 再三以气息，大誐那鉢底，再三轻，再三善来降临坛场（翳呬），再三邻近、攻击，躯，在家人彼，妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐
verses.meaningEn: With/by breath again and again, great + Ganapati, light again and again, come forth, O Blessed One! again and again, approach, attack again and again, śarīraṃ, become a house or habitation + him, awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：K, Y daṃṣṭraṃ ; C, U daṃṣṭā ; H, N daṃṣṭaṃ . Note that the Comparative Edition itself appears to read daṃṣṭwā .

verses.iast: daṃṣṭāmā daṃśṭrīmāvā attra viśatu śarīraṃ kiñ cirāyasi vidhuna vadhana paṭa paṭa kampa
verses.meaningZh: 施度调伏·六度满行清净·断除憍慢执障，施度调伏·本性寂静止息·断除憍慢执障，真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，愿进入、趣行，躯，孃字门（圣智通达（jñāna）·诸根清净自在），久铁杆尊，搏动不，刑不，再三褐子，疟疾
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery & perfection of the six pāramitās & cutting rigid pride, generosity & self-mastery & primordial tranquil peace & cutting rigid pride, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust, may it enter, go in or into, sit or settle down on, śarīraṃ, non-dual wisdom awareness (jñāna) — purified faculties, lasting a long time + O of iron, throb + not, punishment + not, cloth again and again, trembling, shaking, earthquake
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：K, Y daṃṣṭraṃ ; C, U daṃṣṭā ; H, N daṃṣṭaṃ . Note that the Comparative Edition itself appears to read daṃṣṭwā .

verses.iast: kampa raṅga raṅga moda moda dhama dhama vijṛmabā vijṛmabā pūra pūra ghūrṇṇa
verses.meaningZh: 疟疾，再三颜料，再三乐趣、干陀，再三法界总持任持·无我大慈三昧，再三最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·无我大慈三昧，再三充分、充分称计，索索、滴溜溜
verses.meaningEn: Trembling, shaking, earthquake, colour, hue again and again, delight, gladness again and again, Dharma-realm retention & selfless great loving-kindness again and again, supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious & selfless great loving-kindness again and again, full again and again, moving to and fro, trembling, whirling
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：K, Y daṃṣṭraṃ ; C, U daṃṣṭā ; H, N daṃṣṭaṃ . Note that the Comparative Edition itself appears to read daṃṣṭwā .

verses.iast: ghūrṇṇa āviśa āviśa śīghraṃ śīghraṃ mahāvajrabhairabhe gaṇapatir ājñāvayati svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 索索、滴溜溜，再三最上真言离言说·本性寂静止息，再三快，大·金刚·吠·猕猴尊，誐那鉢底，命令小壮，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Moving to and fro, trembling, whirling, supreme ineffable speech & primordial tranquil peace again and again, śīghraṃ again and again, great + Vajra + vai + O of a monkey, Ganapati, command, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：K, Y daṃṣṭraṃ ; C, U daṃṣṭā ; H, N daṃṣṭaṃ . Note that the Comparative Edition itself appears to read daṃṣṭwā .

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 4 大数据库「84000 藏文大藏经开放 TEI 语料库」（TOH612 / TOH923，部类：Kriyātantra，BDRC: W22084 / MW22084）。梵文经题：Āryadhvajāgrakeyūrānāmadhāraṇī；藏文经题：རྒྱལ་མཚན་རྩེ་མོའི་དཔུང་རྒྱན་གྱི་གཟུངས། (rgyal mtshan rtse mo’i dpung rgyan gyi gzungs)；英文经题：The Dhāraṇī of Dhvajāgrakeyūrā。本篇共 96 句。

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三佛陀、觉者尊，再三金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊，再三莲华（出淤泥而不染清净心）尊，再三流注周遍、速行护念（萨啰），再三初升、洪水，祈请忆念本誓
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O Buddha, the Awakened One / in Buddha, the Awakened One again and again, O Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt / in Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt again and again, O lotus flower (pure, unstained) / in lotus flower (pure, unstained) again and again, flow forth and pervade with blessing! again and again, coming forth, rising, appearing, spreading, free course, bold behaviour again and again, remember Your primordial vow!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 91 (rgyud ’bum, ba), folios 180.b–183.b · 藏文名：འཕགས་མ་གཟའ་རྣམས་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 祈请忆念本誓，再三戏剧、体育，再三魔、天魔烦恼障，再三无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢·法界总持任持，再三破暗合集·断除憍慢执障·一乘如实之道，一切障碍，再三成办羯磨事业（俱噜）
verses.meaningEn: Remember Your primordial vow! may You playing, sporting again and again, may You Māra, demon, obstacle to awakening! again and again, selfless great loving-kindness & stainless purity free from dust & Dharma-realm retention again and again, dissolving dense ignorance & cutting rigid pride & supreme vehicle of awakening again and again, all + obstacle, accomplish & enact this sacred work! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 91 (rgyud ’bum, ba), folios 180.b–183.b · 藏文名：འཕགས་མ་གཟའ་རྣམས་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 我之（行者所有），果，斩断结缚·妙行迁变空，一切暴恶者，再三令刍，再三寂静、调柔安稳尊，再三低调、佛口婆心尊，再三施物
verses.meaningEn: My, of me (the practitioner), to be done, severing, all + wicked, cause to kṣ! again and again, O peaceful, calm, tranquil / in peaceful, calm, tranquil again and again, O tamed, subdued, patient, passionless again and again, may You gift again and again

verses.meaningZh: 经营、迅速，祈请镜子，我，祈请再三拥护、守护于我，诸一切众生、普皆有情以及一切·曜执·气息·田园·秋天，离名相假立·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，世尊佛母！（呼格），神明尊，祈请淳，一切暴恶者，请净除、涤荡清净！一切罪业，再三威猛、暴烈除障尊，再三迅疾度脱一切危厄（都噜），再三妙行迁变空·离诸诤论无诤·息灭诤怨，再三无我大慈三昧·一乘如实之道，再三无我大慈三昧·妙行迁变空，再三最上真言离言说·因缘空寂大乐，威猛、大势力尊，妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，于我、为我，祈请充分、充分称计，于我、为我，希望、贪欲，祈请成就，一切如来所加持，向平，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Run, fled, may You looking-glass, mirror, self, evermore protect, guard and shelter me, all sentient beings and all + planet + breath + field + fall, beyond nominal designation & supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust, O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! O very deceitful or illusory, may You pure! all + wicked, purify! cleanse! all + evil, O fierce, ardent, wrathful / in fierce, ardent, wrathful again and again, swiftly ferry across all perils! again and again, awakened conduct beyond flux & conflict-free peace & pacifying conflict & turmoil (vocative invocation) again and again, selfless great loving-kindness & supreme vehicle of awakening (imperative seal) again and again, selfless great loving-kindness & awakened conduct beyond flux (imperative seal) again and again, supreme ineffable speech & causal emptiness & spiritual joy again and again, O mighty, fierce, formidable / in mighty, fierce, formidable, awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, to me, my, may You full, to me, my, wish, desire, fancy, may You filling up, all Tathagatas + O blessed, to equal, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningEn: Lotus flower + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningEn: All + to all constellation, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 向诸一切·十二·群体·在于，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: All + the twelfth + group + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 91 (rgyud ’bum, ba), folios 180.b–183.b · 藏文名：འཕགས་མ་གཟའ་རྣམས་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！一切圣智尊，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O all knowledge / in all knowledge, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: oṃ kaṭa kaṭa maṭa maṭa dara dara vidara vidara hana hana gṛhṇa
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三席，再三无我大慈三昧·断除憍慢执障，再三揭幕、一些，再三闢揭幕，再三击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），妙行趣入·因缘空寂大乐·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! straw mat again and again, selfless great loving-kindness & cutting rigid pride again and again, cleaving, rending, opening again and again, settle + cleaving again and again, strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again, awakened spiritual movement & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & conflict-free peace
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 91 (rgyud ’bum, ba), folios 192.b–193.a · 藏文名：ཚོགས་ཀྱི་བདག་པོའི་སྙིང་པོ།

verses.iast: gṛhṇa dhāva dhāva bhañja bhañja stambha stambha jambha jambha moha moha dehi
verses.meaningZh: 妙行趣入·因缘空寂大乐·离诸诤论无诤，再三濯，再三摧碎破除一切魔障，再三柱，再三齿相、獠牙，再三愚痴、无明迷妄，请施予、慈悲垂赐悉地！
verses.meaningEn: Awakened spiritual movement & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & conflict-free peace, wash again and again, shatter and break all obstacles! again and again, post, column, prop, support again and again, tooth, tusk, the jaws, mouth again and again, delusion, ignorance, bewilderment again and again, give! grant! bestow!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 91 (rgyud ’bum, ba), folios 192.b–193.a · 藏文名：ཚོགས་ཀྱི་བདག་པོའི་སྙིང་པོ།

verses.iast: dehi dāpaya dāpaya dhādhānyaṃ siddhiṃ me prayaccha
verses.meaningZh: 请施予、慈悲垂赐悉地！再三施度调伏·第一义谛·一乘如实之道，放置·驮·他，悉地、妙成就，于我、为我，乐趣喜
verses.meaningEn: Give! grant! bestow! generosity & self-mastery & ultimate truth & supreme vehicle of awakening again and again, put + dha + other, Siddhi, spiritual accomplishment/perfection, to me, my, pleasure + close by
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 91 (rgyud ’bum, ba), folios 192.b–193.a · 藏文名：ཚོགས་ཀྱི་བདག་པོའི་སྙིང་པོ།

verses.meaningZh: 三昧耶（本誓、平等契合、时际），随念本昔弘誓大愿，大·水獭·责备，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Samaya, sacred vow, pledge, union, recall Your ancient compassionate vow! great + a kind of aquatic animal + O to be spoken, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 91 (rgyud ’bum, ba), folios 192.b–193.a · 藏文名：ཚོགས་ཀྱི་བདག་པོའི་སྙིང་པོ།

verses.iast: oṃ śrīmahākāla gaṇaguti svāhā namaḥ śrīmahākāla gaṇe gutiśāya namo yoginaṇīna tadyathā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！吉祥大黑天护法，妙行趣入·离诸诤论无诤·真如实际，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！归命，吉祥大黑天护法，海会众、圣众眷属尊，妙行趣入·真如实际·本性寂静止息，归命，一乘如实之道·妙行趣入·离名相假立，即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! auspiciousness + Mahākāla, awakened spiritual movement & conflict-free peace & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! homage to auspiciousness + Mahākāla, O assembly, host,retinue / in assembly, host,retinue, awakened spiritual movement & immutable Suchness & primordial tranquil peace (reverent offering), homage to supreme vehicle of awakening & awakened spiritual movement & beyond nominal designation, Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Following Toh 668: ga Na gu ti . Toh 1085: gha Na gha Na Ti . N, H: gA Na gu ti . S: gA Na gu te .

verses.iast: oṃ hile hile kite kiteni cite citeni svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三因缘空寂大乐·离一切相无相，造作离相·真如实际，造作离相·真如实际·离名相假立，积累、浓厚尊，妙行迁变空·真如实际·离名相假立，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! causal emptiness & spiritual joy & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation) again and again, freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), O piled up, heaped up, awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Following Toh 668: ga Na gu ti . Toh 1085: gha Na gha Na Ti . N, H: gA Na gu ti . S: gA Na gu te .

verses.meaningZh: 再三一切、一切处尊，再三边框，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: O all, every again and again, rim again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三那罗在于，再三光明照耀、光净尊，再三真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·断除憍慢执障，再三怛啰尊，再三对击破怨魔与无明惑，一切·事·管保·一切他人，于我、为我，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! heron + in again and again, O shining, bright, beautiful again and again, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation) again and again, O trasana again and again, toward + strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again, all + actions + assuredly + someone else, to me, my, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud, tsha), folios 236.a–236.b · 藏文名：ལས་ཀྱི་སྒྲིབ་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་རྣམ་པར་སྦྱོང་བའི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 归命敬礼·离名相假立，向威猛金刚手菩萨
verses.meaningEn: Bowing, fierce + to Vajrapāṇi
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 向大药叉军主
verses.meaningEn: Mahāyakṣasenāpataye
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！再三真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·断除憍慢执障
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & cutting rigid pride again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·断除憍慢执障
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & cutting rigid pride again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三开
verses.meaningEn: Suffused again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请击碎、破除一切结缚！
verses.meaningEn: Shatter! split open! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三索索、滴溜溜
verses.meaningEn: Moving to and fro, trembling, whirling again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三破暗合集·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤
verses.meaningEn: Dissolving dense ignorance & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 一切一切众生、普皆有情
verses.meaningEn: All sentient beings (plural)
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请开晓觉悟、令发菩提觉智！
verses.meaningEn: Awaken! enlighten! illuminate! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三理解、聪慧
verses.meaningEn: May You understanding, intelligence! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三头旋
verses.meaningEn: Spring again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三敬行
verses.meaningEn: May You confusion, agitation, haste, hurry again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 一切一切处、到处可见，再三造作离相·断除憍慢执障
verses.meaningEn: Being everywhere, ubiquitous, freedom from karmic agency & cutting rigid pride again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三桑祈请庵
verses.meaningEn: Saṃ + may You cottage! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，再三瓶
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, jar, ewer again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三桑祈请瓶
verses.meaningEn: Saṃ + may You jar again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 一切圣智，再三金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: All knowledge, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 请击碎、破除一切结缚！再三金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Shatter! split open! Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 席，再三金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Straw mat, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧·断除憍慢执障，再三金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness & cutting rigid pride, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 摧碎魔军与我慢烦恼（末他），再三金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Churn and crush demonic hindrances! Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 大声笑声绀青，金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Loud laughter + sapphire-blue, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 向勇健金刚杵，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: To/for having a strong thunderbolt, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 呼唤圣尊叹词（咄！圣者！），妙果圆成·离一切相无相
verses.meaningEn: O! Hail! Vocative invocation particle, fruition of enlightenment & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal)
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢·妙果圆成
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust & fruition of enlightenment (imperative seal)
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·妙行趣入·因缘空寂大乐，造作离相·离一切相无相
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & awakened spiritual movement & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal)
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利），妙行迁变空·离一切相无相
verses.meaningEn: Intimate union with the deity samādhi, awakened conduct beyond flux & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal)
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 成办作持·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: Enacting (imperative seal)
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 向金刚最胜尊胜，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Vajra + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 杵尊，向杵，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: O a pointed piece of wood, to/for a pointed piece of wood, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三席
verses.meaningEn: Straw mat again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三无我大慈三昧·断除憍慢执障
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness & cutting rigid pride again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三清净离诸尘垢·断除憍慢执障
verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust & cutting rigid pride again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 摧碎，向转载摧碎，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Crushing, breaking, strangling, forward + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 行持妙道·在于·行持妙道
verses.meaningEn: Move forth in compassionate activity! + in + move forth in compassionate activity!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请摄取、遣除苦厄！
verses.meaningEn: Carry away (suffering)! remove! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三流注周遍、速行护念（萨啰），祈请魔、天魔烦恼障
verses.meaningEn: Flow forth and pervade with blessing! again and again, may You Māra, demon, obstacle to awakening!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious & stainless purity free from dust (reverent offering), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三断除烦恼结使缠缚（嗔陀）
verses.meaningEn: Sever every fetter and hostile spell! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三劈破无明坚固执障（牝陀）
verses.meaningEn: Cleave asunder stubborn ignorance! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Great (reverent offering), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮）
verses.meaningEn: Bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三忿
verses.meaningEn: Wrath again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·离一切相无相·一乘如实之道，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks & supreme vehicle of awakening (reverent offering), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三速疾运转妙法加持（祖噜），妙行迁变空·离诸诤论无诤·息灭诤怨，向杵，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Swiftly set sacred blessings in motion! again and again, awakened conduct beyond flux & conflict-free peace & pacifying conflict & turmoil (vocative invocation), to/for a pointed piece of wood, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 金刚杵尊，向杵
verses.meaningEn: O thunderbolt, to/for a pointed piece of wood
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请摄取、遣除苦厄！向金刚总持、执金刚尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Carry away (suffering)! remove! again and again, to/for Vajradhara, Holder of the Vajra, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三巡
verses.meaningEn: A watch a period of about hours again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 向金刚风息，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Vajra + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 慧坚硬，金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Intelligence + hard, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 闻坚硬，金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Hearing + hard, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 对坚硬，金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Toward + hard, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 大金刚
verses.meaningEn: Great + Vajra
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 无碍、无能障碍，金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Unobstructed, irresistible, unimpeded, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 不空、决定成就无虚，金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Unfailing, infallible, never in vain, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 善来降临坛场（翳呬），金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Come forth, O Blessed One! Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 快，向金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Śīghraṃ, to/for Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.iast: dhara dhara dhiri dhiri dhuru dhuru sarvavajrakulamāvartāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 再三请执持、总持护念！再三禅定坚固总持不失（地利），再三坚固任持总持法印（度噜），向一切·金刚·大地·不过·绕，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Hold! bear! sustain! again and again, steadfast meditative retention (dhṛti) again and again, firmly uphold the dhāraṇī seal! again and again, all + Vajra + earth + only + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 某甲，祈请魔、天魔烦恼障，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: A certain person, may You Māra, demon, obstacle to awakening! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼普遍诸金刚！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to universal, of all Vajra!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 一切跋蓝，祈请绕
verses.meaningEn: All, may You circumambulate!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 大力威神、大势力尊尊
verses.meaningEn: O of great power and might / in of great power and might
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 席力
verses.meaningEn: Straw mat + O power
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 彼严
verses.meaningEn: That
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 不动明王、不动摇尊
verses.meaningEn: O Acala, Immovable Wisdom King / steadfast / in Acala, Immovable Wisdom King / steadfast
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 曼荼罗出
verses.meaningEn: O income
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 太金刚
verses.meaningEn: Very + Vajra
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 大力威神、大势力尊尊
verses.meaningEn: O of great power and might / in of great power and might
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 余力烦恼
verses.meaningEn: Jerk + passion
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 无胜尊
verses.meaningEn: O unsurpassed
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞）
verses.meaningEn: Blaze forth with wisdom radiance! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·诸根清净自在），吒字门（断除憍慢执障（ṭaṅka）·诸根清净自在），多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·诸根清净自在），吒字门（断除憍慢执障（ṭaṅka）·诸根清净自在）
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness (tathatā) — purified faculties, cutting rigid pride (ṭaṅka) — purified faculties, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — purified faculties, cutting rigid pride (ṭaṅka) — purified faculties
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 黄白色尊
verses.meaningEn: O a man's name, of an author on Chandas or metrics, of gods demons
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺）
verses.meaningEn: Incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 具足威光尊
verses.meaningEn: Tejovati
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三芝麻尊
verses.meaningEn: O the sesamum plant or seed again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮）
verses.meaningEn: Bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 大力威神、大势力尊尊
verses.meaningEn: O of great power and might / in of great power and might
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious & stainless purity free from dust, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：- oṃ ] I.

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：+ oṃ ] Dh, I.

verses.meaningZh: 归命敬礼·离名相假立，向威猛金刚手菩萨
verses.meaningEn: Bowing, fierce + to Vajrapāṇi
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：+ oṃ ] Dh, I.

verses.meaningZh: 向大药叉军主
verses.meaningEn: Mahāyakṣasenāpataye
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：+ oṃ ] Dh, I.

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：+ oṃ ] Dh, I.

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！再三请摄取、遣除苦厄！金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! carry away (suffering)! remove! again and again, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：+ oṃ ] Dh, I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三摧碎魔军与我慢烦恼（末他），金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Churn and crush demonic hindrances! again and again, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：+ oṃ ] Dh, I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三护摩献供·法界总持任持，金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Offering oblation again and again, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：+ oṃ ] Dh, I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺），金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! again and again, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：+ oṃ ] Dh, I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三成熟善根、烧尽业障（跛左），金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Ripen merit and burn away karmic obstructions! again and again, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：+ oṃ ] Dh, I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请执持、总持护念！金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Hold! bear! sustain! again and again, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：+ oṃ ] Dh, I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三方位，金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: May You holding, bearing! again and again, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：+ oṃ ] Dh, I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三惨酷，金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Hard, rough, harsh, cruel, severe again and again, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：+ oṃ ] Dh, I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三断除烦恼结使缠缚（嗔陀），金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Sever every fetter and hostile spell! again and again, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：+ oṃ ] Dh, I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三劈破无明坚固执障（牝陀），金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Cleave asunder stubborn ignorance! again and again, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：+ oṃ ] Dh, I.

verses.meaningZh: 吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：+ oṃ ] Dh, I.

verses.meaningZh: 归命敬礼·离名相假立，向威猛金刚忿
verses.meaningEn: Bowing, fierce + Vajra + to
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：+ oṃ ] Dh, E, I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三威猛速疾摄护除灾（呼嚧）
verses.meaningEn: Swiftly protect and sweep away calamity! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：+ oṃ ] Dh, E, I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三安住加持
verses.meaningEn: Abide steadfastly & bestow grace! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：+ oṃ ] Dh, E, I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮）
verses.meaningEn: Bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：+ oṃ ] Dh, E, I.

verses.meaningZh: 再三击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩）
verses.meaningEn: Strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：+ oṃ ] Dh, E, I.

verses.meaningZh: 甘露、不死妙法尊，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: O ambrosia, nectar of immortality / in ambrosia, nectar of immortality, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：+ oṃ ] Dh, E, I.

verses.iast: tadyathā gate gate pāragate pārasaṃgate bodhi svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：再三度越吧、已往彼岸尊！度向彼岸吧、已达究竟彼岸！普同度至彼岸吧（圆证菩提）！菩提、无上正觉，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: gone, O One gone beyond! again and again, gone all the way to the other shore! gone completely altogether beyond! Bodhi, awakening, enlightenment, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Most witnesses of Recension A (though not the versions in the Dege Kangyur, nor the versions in Chone, Lhasa, Lithang, or Urga) include the syllable oṃ after

verses.iast: oṃ mañjubhara mañjughoṣa hana hana hana daha daha paca paca vece vece
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！玅方位，妙音文殊菩萨，再三击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），再三智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺），再三成熟善根、烧尽业障（跛左），再三最上真言离言说·妙行迁变空
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! beautiful + bearing, Mañjughoṣa, Gentle-Voiced Mañjuśrī, strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again, incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! again and again, ripen merit and burn away karmic obstructions! again and again, supreme ineffable speech & awakened conduct beyond flux (vocative invocation) again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur vol. 101 (gzungs ’dus, waM), folios 183.a–183.b · 藏文名：སྡུག་བསྔལ་ཐམས་ཅད་རབ་ཏུ་ཞི་བར་བྱེད་པ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: bhita bhita iphuta iphuta herate sottani namaḥ sottani pripiśale tang pritahasa prabhinata
verses.meaningZh: 再三破有相福德光·真如实际，再三火供净施·妙果圆成，因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·离名相假立，归命，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·离名相假立，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·本性寂静止息，誐字门（妙行趣入（gati）·本不生体性），第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·破有相福德光
verses.meaningEn: Blessedness transcending existence & immutable Suchness again and again, sacred offering again and again, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), homage to all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & primordial tranquil peace (vocative invocation), awakened spiritual movement (gati) — primordial non-arising, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & blessedness transcending existence
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur vol. 101 (gzungs ’dus, waM), folios 183.a–183.b · 藏文名：སྡུག་བསྔལ་ཐམས་ཅད་རབ་ཏུ་ཞི་བར་བྱེད་པ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: jaya hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ herate sottani hūṃ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 胜伏、最胜吉祥！吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·离名相假立，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Conquer! victory! Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur vol. 101 (gzungs ’dus, waM), folios 183.a–183.b · 藏文名：སྡུག་བསྔལ་ཐམས་ཅད་རབ་ཏུ་ཞི་བར་བྱེད་པ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: oṃ vāgīśvari muṃ mañjughoṣa hana vatisidhoharini svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！尊主语言尊，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·损减除灭忧苦·大空菩提点摄持），妙音文殊菩萨，击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），最上真言离言说·真如实际·一切诸谛圆满，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O a master of language, selfless great loving-kindness — dispelling sorrow sealed with bodhicitta bindu, Mañjughoṣa, Gentle-Voiced Mañjuśrī, strike down afflictions and mara-forces! supreme ineffable speech & immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur vol. 101 (gzungs ’dus, waM), folios 183.a–183.b · 藏文名：སྡུག་བསྔལ་ཐམས་ཅད་རབ་ཏུ་ཞི་བར་བྱེད་པ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: oṃ kara kara svāhā kuru kuru svāhā bhara bhara svāhā bhuru bhuru
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三掌，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！再三成办羯磨事业（俱噜），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！再三方位、战斗，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！再三破有相福德光·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! palm again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! accomplish & enact this sacred work! again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! bearing, carrying again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! blessedness transcending existence & stainless purity free from dust (imperative seal) again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 101 (gzungs ’dus, waṃ), folios 236.a–236.b · 藏文名：སྡོང་པོ་རྒྱན་གྱི་མཆོག་གི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: svāhā dhara dhara svāhā dhuru dhuru svāhā cara cara svāhā curu curu
verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！再三请执持、总持护念！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！再三坚固任持总持法印（度噜），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！再三行持妙道、周游救护（左啰），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！再三速疾运转妙法加持（祖噜）
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! hold! bear! sustain! again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! firmly uphold the dhāraṇī seal! again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! move forth in compassionate activity! again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! swiftly set sacred blessings in motion! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 101 (gzungs ’dus, waṃ), folios 236.a–236.b · 藏文名：སྡོང་པོ་རྒྱན་གྱི་མཆོག་གི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三聪明、英明尊，鸿毛·随一·努力利养，自尊尊，善妙成就、最胜悉地尊，圣、尊贵圣者，炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞），名为、号曰，无我大慈三昧·圣智通达·生起不可得·尊胜，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！恒迦河·元·一切·诸津之，现前地，祈请成办羯磨事业（俱噜），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！

verses.iast: tadyathā alata vitāla vibhrina atirtha abhrida anuḍa vibramha nahikhagarunga māyāsukha ānanda jālada
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：离一切相无相·真如实际，闢七多罗树，最上真言离言说·破有相福德光·清净离诸尘垢，太他，破有相福德光·清净离诸尘垢·施度调伏，离名相假立·息灭诤怨，最上真言离言说·解脱系缚大力·清净离诸尘垢，离名相假立·因缘空寂大乐·等虚空无碍，幻化乐，阿难，生起不可得·尊胜·离一切相无相·施度调伏
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: freedom from conditioned marks & immutable Suchness, settle + palm-tree, supreme ineffable speech & blessedness transcending existence & stainless purity free from dust, very + tha, blessedness transcending existence & stainless purity free from dust & generosity & self-mastery, beyond nominal designation & pacifying conflict & turmoil, supreme ineffable speech & spiritual strength freeing bonds & stainless purity free from dust, beyond nominal designation & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & space-like boundlessness, illusion + easy, servant, transcending birth & victorious & freedom from conditioned marks & generosity & self-mastery

verses.meaningEn: Cry + enemy, enemy, transcending birth & victorious & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, going toward, aim at + and all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & spiritual strength freeing bonds & stainless purity free from dust

verses.meaningZh: 再三陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义）尊，总持任持·施度调伏，随着踞尊，最胜尊胜、普胜一切！幅度不，忠诚约定·床坐·齿相，具足圣智、无漏真智尊，迸粮尊，闢形变尊，破有相福德光·本性寂静止息·妙行迁变空，融通常恒
verses.meaningEn: O Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell again and again, upholding (vocative invocation), along with + O squat, supreme victory! triumph! width + not, faithful to a promise + seat + scratching, O one endowed with primordial wisdom, gnosis (Jñāna), burst forth + O provisions, settle + O bending, blessedness transcending existence & primordial tranquil peace & awakened conduct beyond flux (vocative invocation), to + eternal from the standpoint of common experience

verses.iast: śubhavati jīmatu ehi kumabālan vaha hara kleśāna dhuna pāvama śodhaya mārgan nirāhikadharmātā
verses.meaningZh: 具足清净吉祥、善妙庄严尊，生起不可得·尊胜·无我大慈三昧·真如实际，善来降临坛场（翳呬），造作离相·无我大慈三昧·解脱系缚大力，最上真言离言说·因缘空寂大乐，请摄取、遣除苦厄！烦恼气息，护摩献供·法界总持任持，饮用守护本刹，请净除、涤荡清净！无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢·妙行趣入，持守摄受·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: O one endowed with auspicious, pure, bright, virtuous, transcending birth & victorious & selfless great loving-kindness & immutable Suchness (imperative seal), come forth, O Blessed One! freedom from karmic agency & selfless great loving-kindness & spiritual strength freeing bonds, supreme ineffable speech & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, carry away (suffering)! remove! affliction + breath, offering oblation, drinking or protecting + this, purify! cleanse! selfless great loving-kindness & stainless purity free from dust & awakened spiritual movement, bearing
