verses.iast: śuddhāloka vitimirarājasa dukkha śamana sarva buddha avalokana adhiṣṭhite prajñā jñānabhe svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 真实世间，闢·眩·来诣·彼，施度调伏·造作离相·等虚空无碍，寂静息灭、止息灾障（古译「奢摩奴」），一切、普皆遍满，佛陀、觉者，观不，所加持、安住摄持尊，般若、超越妙慧，圣智星宿，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: World, settle + obscuring of vision + coming from or belonging to goats + he, generosity & self-mastery & freedom from karmic agency & space-like boundlessness, pacifying, calming, extinguishing afflictions, all, every, complete, Buddha, the Awakened One, viewing + not, O blessed, empowered, consecrated / in blessed, empowered, consecrated, Prajñā, transcendent wisdom, primordial wisdom + O star, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 64 (mdo sde, wa), folios 250.b–263.a · 藏文名：སྤྲིན་ཆེན་པོ།

verses.iast: mahājñāna avabhāsāni śrītejolakṣmi vṛṣṭivikrama vajra siṃhatane paramavirāja nirmalaguṇa ketusūryaprabhe vimalāṇgayaṣṭi bhara bhara
verses.meaningZh: 乐趣权威，一切普光明照、遍照瑞光，吉祥·威光·吉祥相，一雨超，金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），狮子裔胄，最胜光明照耀，净无垢秽功德，光明幢日光尊，最上真言离言说·无我大慈三昧·离一切相无相，再三方位、战斗
verses.meaningEn: Gladden + authority, splendor, universal illumination (plural), auspiciousness + O mark, rain + surpass, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, lion + O offspring, supreme + shining, utterly spotless + virtue, banner + O bright as the sun, supreme ineffable speech & selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), bearing, carrying again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 64 (mdo sde, wa), folios 250.b–263.a · 藏文名：སྤྲིན་ཆེན་པོ།

verses.iast: sambhara sambhara dudumbu hana hana mahāprabhe vibhūta mahā maho andhakāre prajñāgraśuddhe paripūrṇṇamaitri
verses.meaningZh: 再三参婆啰，施度调伏·无我大慈三昧·解脱系缚大力，再三击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），大光尊，离，大、摩诃（广大无边），威力、光耀，暗尊，聪明·尊·清净，圆满慈心尊
verses.meaningEn: Bestower again and again, generosity & self-mastery & selfless great loving-kindness & spiritual strength freeing bonds (imperative seal), strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again, O exceedingly brilliant / in exceedingly brilliant, variously, great, vast, supreme, greatness, might, lustre, splendour, abundance, plenty, feast, festival, joy, pleasur, O dark, intelligent + first + O pure, filled or covered with + O loving-kindness
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 64 (mdo sde, wa), folios 250.b–263.a · 藏文名：སྤྲིན་ཆེན་པོ།

verses.iast: maitri viraṇaskandha maitrāmabuddhare jala jala jala jala jalam buddhare bodhyaṅgakusume daśabale caturveśvaradhe
verses.meaningZh: 慈心（与乐大慈）尊，闢·烦恼·蕴，觉悟正觉·无我大慈三昧，再三净水，净水，觉悟正觉·解脱系缚大力，觉支妙花尊，十力尊，四·定居者·幅度·下尊
verses.meaningEn: O loving-kindness, benevolence (Maitrī), settle + passion + aggregate, awakened (vocative invocation), water again and again, water, awakened (vocative invocation), aid to enlightenment + O flower, O possessing the ten bala, four + settler + width + O then
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 64 (mdo sde, wa), folios 250.b–263.a · 藏文名：སྤྲིན་ཆེན་པོ།

verses.iast: aṣṭādaśa apanigabuddhadharme śubhamadi puṇyarāśi śukladharmasamanvite gambhāre virajase vimale viśiṣaprāpte nirāsrapadharme sarvalokajyaiṣṭha jeṣṭhaparapravare
verses.meaningZh: 十八，觉悟正觉·持守摄受·第一义谛，清净吉祥曼殊，福德群体，白·正法·辅以，往包袱，闢不明不白，毘磨利，最上真言离言说·本性寂静止息·六度满行清净，在于·噜噜·絮叨·非法尊，世界月份夏天，孟夏·他人·最妙尊
verses.meaningEn: Eighteenth, awakened, bearing (vocative invocation), auspicious + O gladdening, merit + group, white + Dharma + O accompanied by, to go + O burden, settle + O obscure, pure, supreme ineffable speech & primordial tranquil peace & perfection of the six pāramitās (vocative invocation), in + roar + chatter + O unrighteousness, the universe + a month in summer, someone else + O cover
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 64 (mdo sde, wa), folios 250.b–263.a · 藏文名：སྤྲིན་ཆེན་པོ།

verses.iast: anuttare asaṇge dhara dhara dhiri dhiri dhuru dhura śāntamahe śāntavege cara cara
verses.meaningZh: 无上、无与伦比尊，一切诸谛圆满·离诸诤论无诤·妙行趣入，再三请执持、总持护念！再三禅定坚固总持不失（地利），坚固任持总持法印（度噜），勤爱，寂静欢喜，寂静余力，再三行持妙道、周游救护（左啰）
verses.meaningEn: O unsurpassed, supreme, peerless / in unsurpassed, supreme, peerless, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & conflict-free peace & awakened spiritual movement (vocative invocation), hold! bear! sustain! again and again, steadfast meditative retention (dhṛti) again and again, firmly uphold the dhāraṇī seal! burden, peaceful + for joy, peaceful + O jerk, move forth in compassionate activity! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 64 (mdo sde, wa), folios 250.b–263.a · 藏文名：སྤྲིན་ཆེན་པོ།

verses.iast: cara cara ciri ciri curu curu paramabuddhānumate mahāprajñāpāramite svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 再三行持妙道、周游救护（左啰），再三久远常恒护持不退（唧哩），再三速疾运转妙法加持（祖噜），最胜·佛陀·便利，摩诃般若波罗蜜尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Move forth in compassionate activity! again and again, enduring steadfast protection & mindfulness again and again, swiftly set sacred blessings in motion! again and again, supreme + Buddha + O allowed, O Great Perfection of Wisdom / in Great Perfection of Wisdom, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 64 (mdo sde, wa), folios 250.b–263.a · 藏文名：སྤྲིན་ཆེན་པོ།

verses.meaningZh: 陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，犹如此
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — expansive quiescence, just as + this
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Sara sara means “move, move!” Here, and all the way up to and including the paragraph at , only the first pair of the Sanskrit words is translatable. The

verses.iast: sara sara siri siri suru suru nāgā nāgā java java jivi jivi juvu juvu
verses.meaningZh: 再三流注周遍、速行护念（萨啰），再三吉祥福德流注庄严（悉哩，再三甘露妙流普润群生（素噜），再三龙族、大龙王，再三速，再三生起不可得·尊胜·最上真言离言说，再三生起不可得·尊胜·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: Flow forth and pervade with blessing! again and again, auspicious Śrī fortune & sacred grace again and again, stream forth auspicious ambrosia! again and again, Nāga, dragon/serpent deity again and again, hastening, quick again and again, transcending birth & victorious & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation) again and again, transcending birth & victorious & supreme ineffable speech (imperative seal) again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Sara sara means “move, move!” Here, and all the way up to and including the paragraph at , only the first pair of the Sanskrit words is translatable. The

verses.iast: cara cara ciri ciri curu curu
verses.meaningZh: 再三行持妙道、周游救护（左啰），再三久远常恒护持不退（唧哩），再三速疾运转妙法加持（祖噜）
verses.meaningEn: Move forth in compassionate activity! again and again, enduring steadfast protection & mindfulness again and again, swiftly set sacred blessings in motion! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Cara cara means “Act, act!”

verses.iast: vara vara viri viri vuru vuru
verses.meaningZh: 再三殊胜、胜愿、妙好，再三最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，再三最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Choicest, supreme boon, excellent again and again, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation) again and again, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust (imperative seal) again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Vara vara means “Surround, surround!”

verses.iast: bhara bhara bhiri bhiri bhuru bhuru
verses.meaningZh: 再三方位、战斗，再三无畏威神震伏魔怨（毗利），再三破有相福德光·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Bearing, carrying again and again, fearless spiritual majesty again and again, blessedness transcending existence & stainless purity free from dust (imperative seal) again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Bhara bhara means “Maintain, maintain!”

verses.iast: ghaḍa ghaḍa ghiḍi ghiḍi ghuḍu ghuḍu
verses.meaningZh: 再三破暗合集·息灭诤怨，再三破暗合集·息灭诤怨，再三破暗合集·息灭诤怨
verses.meaningEn: Dissolving dense ignorance & pacifying conflict & turmoil again and again, dissolving dense ignorance & pacifying conflict & turmoil (vocative invocation) again and again, dissolving dense ignorance & pacifying conflict & turmoil (imperative seal) again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The meaning of ghaḍa ghaḍa could not be determined. It possibly means “Cover, cover!” or “Spread over, spread over!”

verses.iast: taṭa taṭa tiṭi tiṭi tuṭu tuṭu
verses.meaningZh: 再三坡度、海滨，再三真如实际·断除憍慢执障，再三真如实际·断除憍慢执障
verses.meaningEn: Slope, declivity again and again, immutable Suchness & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation) again and again, immutable Suchness & cutting rigid pride (imperative seal) again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Taṭa taṭa means “Rumble, rumble!”

verses.iast: kala kala kili kili kulu kulu
verses.meaningZh: 再三尊手，再三金刚橛威神警觉、摧伏魔军（吉栗），再三造作离相·离一切相无相
verses.meaningEn: Hand again and again, vajra-kīla transfixing obstacles & awakening again and again, freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal) again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Kala kala means “Murmur, murmur!”

verses.iast: rala rala rili rili rulu rulu
verses.meaningZh: 再三清净离诸尘垢·离一切相无相，再三清净离诸尘垢·离一切相无相，再三清净离诸尘垢·离一切相无相
verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust & freedom from conditioned marks again and again, stainless purity free from dust & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation) again and again, stainless purity free from dust & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal) again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The meaning of rala rala could not be determined.

verses.iast: ghama ghama ghimi ghimi ghumu ghumu svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 再三破暗合集·无我大慈三昧，再三破暗合集·无我大慈三昧，再三破暗合集·无我大慈三昧，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Dissolving dense ignorance & selfless great loving-kindness again and again, dissolving dense ignorance & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation) again and again, dissolving dense ignorance & selfless great loving-kindness (imperative seal) again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The meaning of ghama ghama could not be determined.

verses.iast: nara nara niri niri nuru nuru svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 再三男子，再三离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢，再三离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Man, husband, hero again and again, beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation) again and again, beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust (imperative seal) again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The meaning of nara nara could not be determined.

verses.iast: gaṭa gaṭa giṭi giṭi guṭu guṭu svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 再三妙行趣入·断除憍慢执障，再三妙行趣入·断除憍慢执障，再三妙行趣入·断除憍慢执障，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Awakened spiritual movement & cutting rigid pride again and again, awakened spiritual movement & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation) again and again, awakened spiritual movement & cutting rigid pride (imperative seal) again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The meaning of gaṭa gaṭa could not be determined.

verses.iast: śara śara śiri śiri śuru śuru svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 再三箭，再三头尊，再三本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Reed, arrow again and again, śiri again and again, primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust (imperative seal) again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The meaning of śara śara could not be determined.

verses.iast: kara kara kiri kiri kuru kuru dara dara diri diri duru duru naṭa naṭa niṭi niṭi nuṭu nuṭu
verses.meaningZh: 再三掌，再三舒散光明、散布吉祥！（源自 √kṝ），再三成办羯磨事业（俱噜），再三揭幕、一些，再三施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢，再三施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢，再三作舞，再三离名相假立·断除憍慢执障，再三离名相假立·断除憍慢执障
verses.meaningEn: Palm again and again, scatter rays of blessing! again and again, accomplish & enact this sacred work! again and again, cleaving, rending, opening again and again, generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation) again and again, generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust (imperative seal) again and again, a dancer or mime again and again, beyond nominal designation & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation) again and again, beyond nominal designation & cutting rigid pride (imperative seal) again and again

verses.meaningZh: 再三不脂肪，再三无我大慈三昧·生起不可得·尊胜·离名相假立，清净离诸尘垢·六度满行清净·远离虚妄安立，最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·六度满行清净，因缘空寂大乐·真如实际·支分寂静，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，再三请执持、总持护念！尊

verses.iast: tadyathā akhe makhe samantamukhe sautiyukte nirukte prabhe samayoge citavivarte ame khame madane
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：等虚空无碍，欢乐、三摩耶欢喜尊，普门尊，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·一乘如实之道，那罗尊，光明、星星尊，随着不具尊，积累沿革尊，本刹尊，虚空于我，泡沫自然
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: space-like boundlessness (vocative invocation), O gay, jocund, O Universal Gate / in Universal Gate, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), O explained, O light, along with + O separation, piled up + O  evolution, O this / in this, hole + to me, bubble + O certainly
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：D (Toh 273): citavivarte ; D (Toh 511, Toh 853): cittacitte ; S: cittacittarte .

verses.iast: vivarte samantaguṇe satyārame yukte prayukte hili mili masale ānale came aciṭi aciṭi
verses.meaningZh: 沿革尊，普遍功德，谛·此边·于我，具，相应，定慧摄持、心无散乱（希利），契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利），无我大慈三昧·一切诸谛圆满·离一切相无相，离名相假立·离一切相无相，妙行迁变空·无我大慈三昧，再三妙行迁变空·断除憍慢执障
verses.meaningEn: O (period of) evolution, universal + O virtue, truth + the hither + to me, O yoked, harnessed, set to work, appointed, instituted, occupied with,, O yoked, used, employed, acted, proceeded , lent, meditative absorption & steadfast mindfulness, intimate union with the deity samādhi, selfless great loving-kindness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), beyond nominal designation & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), awakened conduct beyond flux & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), awakened conduct beyond flux & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation) again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：D (Toh 273): citavivarte ; D (Toh 511, Toh 853): cittacitte ; S: cittacittarte .

verses.iast: coce arahe bahudche māyugrahe hemavati jyotivati dharmaciti cyutapaṅke avikṣepe radhikṣa me skandhavibhakte
verses.meaningZh: 妙行迁变空，配称尊，解脱系缚大力·因缘空寂大乐·施度调伏，护符曜执，具足金尊，具足打败正勤尊，正法积累，没泥尊，无心乱，清净离诸尘垢·法界总持任持·造作离相，于我、为我，部派浑然
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux (vocative invocation), O worthy / in worthy, spiritual strength freeing bonds & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & generosity & self-mastery (vocative invocation), charm + O planet, hemavati, overpower + O one endowed with effort, Dharma + O piled up, gone away + O mud, non-O a putting off, excuse, stainless purity free from dust & Dharma-realm retention & freedom from karmic agency, to me, my, ramification + O undivided
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：D (Toh 273): citavivarte ; D (Toh 511, Toh 853): cittacitte ; S: cittacittarte .

verses.meaningEn: Conflict-free peace & pacifying conflict & turmoil & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), ultimate truth & conflict-free peace & pacifying conflict & turmoil (vocative invocation), O a bracelet worn on the upper arm / in a bracelet worn on the upper arm, up + O hand, a lake, connection + intelligence, hold! bear! sustain! poison, venom, toxin, gathering pure Dharmic merits & radiance, intimate union with the deity samādhi, gain + O inclined to, just as + saṃ + O food, bull, freedom from karmic agency & conflict-free peace & pacifying conflict & turmoil (reverent offering)

verses.iast: Oṃ prajñe mahāprajñe hūṃ svāhā phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！聪明、英明尊，大慧，吽（金刚心印）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O intelligent, wise, knowing, mahāprajñe, Hūṃ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 79 (rgyud ’bum, ga), folios 73.b–158.b · 藏文名：ཡང་དག་པར་སྦྱོར་བ།

verses.iast: a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ
verses.meaningZh: 悉昙字门总持：a(本不生体性)、ā(远离寂静周遍)、i(诸根清净自在)、ī(禅定三昧总持)、u(损减除灭忧苦)、ū(威神增益圆满)、ṛ(神变善巧应化)、ṝ(安住真实不动)
verses.meaningEn: Siddhaṃ Akṣara-mukha gates: a (Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising); ā (Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'ā': expansive quiescence); i (Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'i': purified faculties); ī (Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'ī': deep samādhi retention); u (Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'u': dispelling sorrow); ū (Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'ū': perfected spiritual vigor); ṛ (Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'ṛ': miraculous skillful manifestation); ṝ (Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'ṝ': steadfastness in reality)
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 79 (rgyud ’bum, ga), folios 73.b–158.b · 藏文名：ཡང་དག་པར་སྦྱོར་བ།

verses.iast: ḷ ḹ e ai o au aṃ aḥ
verses.meaningZh: 悉昙「ḷ」韵字门：清净无染调柔，悉昙「ḹ」韵字门：究竟任持不退，悉昙「e」韵字门：钩召发起三昧，悉昙「ai」韵字门：大自在威德统摄，悉昙「o」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，悉昙「au」韵字门：最上大悲化导，悉昙「aṃ」韵字门：本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持，涅槃除遣点种子字（远离烦恼生死）
verses.meaningEn: Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'ḷ': gentle stainlessness, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'ḹ': irreversible retention, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'e': samādhi invocation, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'ai': sovereign spiritual mastery, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'o': consecrating Dharma-stream, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'au': supreme compassionate guidance, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'aṃ': primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, nirvāṇa-visarga seed syllable Aḥ
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 79 (rgyud ’bum, ga), folios 73.b–158.b · 藏文名：ཡང་དག་པར་སྦྱོར་བ།

verses.iast: ka kha ga gha ṅa ca cha ja jha ña ṭa ṭha

verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — primordial non-arising, space-like boundlessness (kha) — primordial non-arising, awakened spiritual movement (gati) — primordial non-arising, dissolving dense ignorance (ghana) — primordial non-arising, quiescence of perceptual limbs (aṅga) — primordial non-arising and coolness free of obscuration (chāyā) — primordial non-arising, transcending birth & victorious (jaya) — primordial non-arising, quelling calamity & affliction — primordial non-arising, non-dual wisdom awareness (jñāna) — primordial non-arising, cutting rigid pride (ṭaṅka) — primordial non-arising, beyond conceptual fabrication — primordial non-arising

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from conditioned marks

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! width + before oneʼs face

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！殊胜女性善友
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! choicest + female friend
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt., oṃ varāli vattāli varāhamukhi sarvaduṣṭapraduṣṭānāṃ kāyavākcittaṃ mukhaṃ jambhaya stambhaya .

verses.meaningZh: 不过逮捕七多罗树
verses.meaningEn: Only apprehend + palm-tree
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt., oṃ varāli vattāli varāhamukhi sarvaduṣṭapraduṣṭānāṃ kāyavākcittaṃ mukhaṃ jambhaya stambhaya .

verses.meaningZh: 再三跛字门（第一义谛（paramārtha）·损减除灭忧苦·大空菩提点摄持），火大清净智火种子（焚尽罪垢）
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth (paramārtha) — dispelling sorrow sealed with bodhicitta bindu again and again, Agni wisdom-fire purifying seed syllable

verses.meaningZh: 再三救度佛母（绿度母）根本种子字

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness & spiritual strength freeing bonds (vocative invocation) again and again

verses.meaningZh: 再三破暗合集·息灭诤怨

verses.meaningEn: O! Hail! Vocative invocation particle again and again, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — dispelling sorrow again and again, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：There are eight phuḥ syllables, one of (“for”?) each of the eight nāga kings.

verses.meaningEn: Siddhaṃ Akṣara-mukha gates: Phuḥ (fruition of enlightenment (phala)); phuḥ (fruition of enlightenment (phala)); phuḥ (fruition of enlightenment (phala)); puḥ (ultimate truth (paramārtha)); phuḥ (fruition of enlightenment (phala)); phuḥ (fruition of enlightenment (phala)); phuḥ (fruition of enlightenment (phala)); phuḥ (fruition of enlightenment (phala))
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：There are eight phuḥ syllables, one of (“for”?) each of the eight nāga kings.

verses.meaningZh: 吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！

verses.meaningZh: 泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！

Oṃ hrīḥ svāhā
Hūṃ phaṭ ! | Svāhā !
Rulu rulu ! | Bhyo , hūṃ phaṭ !
One of many different garbs! | Hūṃ phaṭ !
Cook, cook! | Do not tarry, do not tarry! | Rouse everybody! | Hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ !

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 79 (rgyud ’bum, ga), folios 73.b–158.b · 藏文名：ཡང་དག་པར་སྦྱོར་བ།

verses.meaningZh: 吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt., oṃ vajraguhye siddhaparamayogeśvari kapālamālādhāriṇi rudhirapriye śmaśānavāsini hūṃ phaṭ svāhā .

verses.meaningZh: 再三清净离诸尘垢·离一切相无相；耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·摄受法流灌顶），吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal) again and again Supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — consecrating Dharma-stream, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt., oṃ vajracaṇḍeśvari khaṭvāṅgi mahāvajriṇi kapālamālāmakuṭe ākaḍḍa ākaḍḍa sarvaduṣṭahṛdayam ākaḍḍa rulu rulu bhyo hūṃ phaṭ .

verses.iast: One of many different garbs! | Hūṃ phaṭ !
verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立，悉昙「of」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢·离名相假立，娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·本不生体性）；吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'of': consecrating Dharma-stream, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust & beyond nominal designation, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — primordial non-arising Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt., oṃ vajrāparājite paramaguhye kapālamālāvibhūṣite sarvaduṣṭamohani priye ehi ehi bhagavati vajraguhyeśvari bahuvividhaveśadhāriṇi sarvaduṣṭanivāriṇi hūṃ phaṭ .

verses.meaningZh: 再三妙行迁变空·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux & freedom from karmic agency again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt., oṃ vajravetāli kha kha khahi khahi sarvaduṣṭān vikṛtaveśadhāriṇi vikṛtālaṅkārabhūṣite hana hana daha daha paca paca mā vilamba mā vilamba samayam anusmara praveśaya maṇḍalamadhye utthāpaya sarvaṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ .

verses.iast: Do not tarry, do not tarry!
verses.meaningZh: 陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·摄受法流灌顶），耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·摄受法流灌顶），耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — consecrating Dharma-stream, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — consecrating Dharma-stream, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — consecrating Dharma-stream, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — consecrating Dharma-stream, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising

verses.meaningZh: 清净离诸尘垢·一切诸谛圆满，最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (vocative invocation), supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening

provenance.rawSnippet:
Oṃ , Vajramṛdaṅgā! Hūṃ svāhā !
Hiḥ , hi hi hi hi , hūṃ jaḥ !
Trāṃ , va va , hūṃ !
Ṭāṃ ṭāṃ , vaṃ !
Assuming any shape at will! | Trāṃ ! | Traṭa traṭa ! | Hoḥ !

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！金刚杖鼓，吽（金刚心印）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Vajra + a kind of drum, Hūṃ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt., oṃ vajramṛdaṅge hūṃ svāhā .

verses.iast: Hiḥ , hi hi hi hi , hūṃ jaḥ !
verses.meaningZh: 威神遣除破障声印，再三诚然、因为、实乃，吽（金刚心印）！金刚钩召摄引入坛种子
verses.meaningEn: Wrathful dispelling seed exclamation, for, indeed, surely again and again, Hūṃ! Vajra-hook summoning seed syllable (ākarṣaṇa)
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt., oṃ vajravaḍavāmukhe yogeśvari hiḥ hi hi hi hi hūṃ jaḥ .

verses.meaningZh: 宝生如来宝部灌顶种子字，再三嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Ratnasaṃbhava jewel-family seed syllable Trāṃ, supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — primordial non-arising again and again, Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The Tib. (149a.6) reflects trāṃ va trāṃ va ( trAM va trAM va ).

verses.meaningZh: 再三吒字门（断除憍慢执障（ṭaṅka）·远离寂静周遍·大空菩提点摄持），金刚界大日智法身水轮甘露种子
verses.meaningEn: Cutting rigid pride (ṭaṅka) — expansive quiescence sealed with bodhicitta bindu again and again, Vajradhātu Mahāvairocana ambrosia seed syllable
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt., oṃ candrasūryahutāśani siṃhanirnāde siṃhavaktre siṃhini ṭāṃ ṭāṃ vaṃ .

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·离名相假立，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），一切诸谛圆满·因缘空寂大乐·第一义谛，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·本不生体性），攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·诸根清净自在）
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & ultimate truth (vocative invocation), immutable Suchness (tathatā) — primordial non-arising, freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — purified faculties
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：“ Oṃ ” has been added on the authority of the Tib. (149a.7).

verses.meaningZh: 宝生如来宝部灌顶种子字
verses.meaningEn: Ratnasaṃbhava jewel-family seed syllable Trāṃ
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：“ Oṃ ” has been added on the authority of the Tib. (149a.7).

verses.meaningZh: 再三真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·断除憍慢执障
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & cutting rigid pride again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：“ Oṃ ” has been added on the authority of the Tib. (149a.7).

verses.meaningZh: 金刚欢喜三昧耶融摄种子
verses.meaningEn: Vajra-joy samaya-union seed syllable
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：“ Oṃ ” has been added on the authority of the Tib. (149a.7).

verses.iast: Oṃ , glorious He-he-ru-ru-ka-vajra! One surrounded by a multitude
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！妙行趣入·离一切相无相·清净离诸尘垢，再三呼唤圣尊叹词（咄！圣者！），再三啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·损减除灭忧苦），迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·本不生体性），金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），离名相假立，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·离名相假立，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性，无我大慈三昧·离一切相无相·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! awakened spiritual movement & freedom from conditioned marks & stainless purity free from dust, O! Hail! Vocative invocation particle again and again, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — dispelling sorrow again and again, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — primordial non-arising, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & beyond nominal designation, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from conditioned marks & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt., oṃ śrīheherurukavajra ḍākinījālasaṃvara hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā .

verses.iast: of ḍākinīs! Hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ, phaṭ , svāhā !
verses.meaningZh: 悉昙「of」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，息灭诤怨·造作离相·离名相假立，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'of': consecrating Dharma-stream, pacifying conflict & turmoil & freedom from karmic agency & beyond nominal designation, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt., oṃ śrīheherurukavajra ḍākinījālasaṃvara hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā .

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！金刚荼吉尼
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Vajra + Ḍākinī
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The reading “Vajraḍākinī” was adopted on the authority of the Dege (150a.1) and all the other editions. All Skt. manuscripts, on the other hand, have the reading “Vajraḍāka.”

verses.meaningZh: 吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The reading “Vajraḍākinī” was adopted on the authority of the Dege (150a.1) and all the other editions. All Skt. manuscripts, on the other hand, have the reading “Vajraḍāka.”

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！金刚钩召摄引入坛种子，吽（金刚心印）！金刚界大日智法身水轮甘露种子，金刚欢喜三昧耶融摄种子
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Vajra-hook summoning seed syllable (ākarṣaṇa), Hūṃ! Vajradhātu Mahāvairocana ambrosia seed syllable, Vajra-joy samaya-union seed syllable
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The reading “Vajraḍākinī” was adopted on the authority of the Dege (150a.1) and all the other editions. All Skt. manuscripts, on the other hand, have the reading “Vajraḍāka.”

verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·摄受法流灌顶），解脱系缚大力·因缘空寂大乐·离一切相无相
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), immutable Suchness (tathatā) — consecrating Dharma-stream, spiritual strength freeing bonds & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & freedom from conditioned marks
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The reading “Vajraḍākinī” was adopted on the authority of the Dege (150a.1) and all the other editions. All Skt. manuscripts, on the other hand, have the reading “Vajraḍāka.”

verses.meaningZh: 金刚欢喜三昧耶融摄种子
verses.meaningEn: Vajra-joy samaya-union seed syllable
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The reading “Vajraḍākinī” was adopted on the authority of the Dege (150a.1) and all the other editions. All Skt. manuscripts, on the other hand, have the reading “Vajraḍāka.”

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！再三佉字门（等虚空无碍（kha）·本不生体性），再三施度调伏·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! space-like boundlessness (kha) — primordial non-arising again and again, generosity & self-mastery & supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt., oṃ kha kha khāhi khāhi sarvayakṣarākṣasabhūtapretapiśāconmādāpasmāraḍākaḍākinyādaya imaṃ baliṃ gṛhṇantu samayaṃ rakṣantu sarvasiddhiṃ me prayacchantu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā .

verses.meaningZh: 吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt., oṃ kha kha khāhi khāhi sarvayakṣarākṣasabhūtapretapiśāconmādāpasmāraḍākaḍākinyādaya imaṃ baliṃ gṛhṇantu samayaṃ rakṣantu sarvasiddhiṃ me prayacchantu hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā .

Remain, remain! Enter, enter! Āḥ , great crazed youth, dhūṇa , dhūṇa ! Tiṇa , tiṇa ! Eat, eat! Kill the obstacle makers, kill! Devour the rogues, devour! Accomplish everything, accomplish! Kiri , kiri ! Great Vajra of Poison , phaṭ ! Hūṃ , hūṃ , hūṃ , you with a threefold, ruddy curl between your eyebrows, hūṃ , hūṃ , hūṃ ! Acala, ceṭa ! Phaṭ ! Injure, injure, hūṃ , hūṃ ! Asamantikā, trāṭ ! Great Strength, sāṭaya ! Bring near, trāṃ , māṃ , hāṃ ! May the worlds be purified! May the vajrin be pleased! Homage be to those possessing an unassailable strength! Set ablaze, trāṭ ! Impatient One, homage to you, svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 80 (rgyud ’bum, nga), folios 304.b–343.a · 藏文名：ཁྲོ་བོ་ཆེན་པོའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·离一切相无相·妙行趣入，威猛·大·激愤，再三多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·诸根清净自在），吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all the tathāgatas, the fulfillers of all wishes in every way, trāṭ ! Unfailing Caṇḍamahāroṣaṇa, split, split, hūṃ ! Confuse, confuse, hūṃ , trāṭ , hāṃ , māṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 80 (rgyud ’bum, nga), folios 304.b–343.a · 藏文名：ཁྲོ་བོ་ཆེན་པོའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — samādhi invocation, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt (feminine), Hūṃ! Phaṭ!

verses.meaningZh: 再三清净离诸尘垢·破暗合集·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , homage to the blessed lord Caṇḍamahāroṣaṇa, to him who frightens the gods, demigods, and humans, to him who destroys the entire army of māras, to him whose head is adorned with a jewel crest! Take this oblation, take! Kill all my obstacle makers, kill! Restrain the Four Māras, restrain! Frighten, frighten! Shake, shake! Chop, chop! Break, break! Destroy, destroy! Burn, burn! Wither, wither! Split, split! Smash the evil beings that obstruct my thoughts, smash! Turn them into ashes, turn! Phaṭ , phaṭ ! Svāhā !

verses.iast: Oṃ , cili , mili , when playing, hūṃ , phaṭ !
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！积集一切白净善法功德（唧哩），契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利），曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·钩召发起三昧），第一义谛·离一切相无相·一乘如实之道，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! gathering pure Dharmic merits & radiance, intimate union with the deity samādhi, beyond nominal designation (nāma) — samādhi invocation, ultimate truth & freedom from conditioned marks & supreme vehicle of awakening, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!

verses.meaningZh: 归命向佛法僧三宝，归命，向诸一切佛陀菩提萨埵，归命，向八蛇补特伽罗，归命，广收富人，向诸佛陀俱胝，即说咒曰：嗡！莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子）
verses.meaningEn: Homage to to/for the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha), homage to all + Buddha + to all Bodhisattva, homage to eight + crawling + to, homage to joined + belonging to one's household, Buddha + to, Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 29.b–42.b · 藏文名：འཕགས་མ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ཀུ་རུ་ཀུལླེའི་རྟོག་པ།

verses.meaningZh: 再三莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），一切诸龙族，无边诸部族之，和修吉诸部族之，木匠诸部族之，法螺·婆罗·诸部族之，诸人诸部族之，莲华诸部族之，大红莲华诸部族之，良好部族诸部族之，野猪诸部族之
verses.meaningEn: Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara again and again, all + of all Nāga, boundless + of all buddha-family, Vasuki + of all buddha-family, cutter + of all buddha-family, conch shell + warden + of all buddha-family, of a serpent-demon + of all buddha-family, lotus flower + of all buddha-family, Mahapadma + of all buddha-family, of good family + of all buddha-family, boar + of all buddha-family
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 29.b–42.b · 藏文名：འཕགས་མ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ཀུ་རུ་ཀུལླེའི་རྟོག་པ།

verses.iast: puṇḍarīkakulānāṃ ghanakulānāṃ meghakulānāṃ jaladakulānāṃ jaladharakulānāṃ jīmūtakulānāṃ saṃvartakulānāṃ vasantakulānāṃ airāvatakulānāṃ kumudakulānāṃ kahlārakulānāṃ saugandhikakulānāṃ
verses.meaningZh: 白莲华诸部族之，想必诸无种之，云诸部族之，云彩诸部族之，云彩诸部族之，花木诸部族之，一切诸谛圆满·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，春诸部族之，一样诸部族之，固目答诸部族之，造作离相·因缘空寂大乐·离一切相无相，胜香诸部族之
verses.meaningEn: White lotus + of all buddha-family, surely + of all the ichneumon, cloud + of all buddha-family, a cloud + of all buddha-family, cloud + of all buddha-family, thunder-cloud + of all buddha-family, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust, spring + of all buddha-family, the same + of all buddha-family, the flower of the white water-lily + of all buddha-family, freedom from karmic agency & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & freedom from conditioned marks, sweet-scented + of all buddha-family
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 29.b–42.b · 藏文名：འཕགས་མ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ཀུ་རུ་ཀུལླེའི་རྟོག་པ།

verses.iast: hana hana śareṇa bandha bandha cāpena tāḍaya tāḍaya utpalena bhītānām abhayaṃ dehi
verses.meaningZh: 再三击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），以箭，再三结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），以宝弓，再三抃掌尊手，以青莲华（优钵罗花），诸惊疑、怖畏之，无畏，请施予、慈悲垂赐悉地！
verses.meaningEn: Strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again, by/through reed, arrow, bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! again and again, by/through bow, may You cymbal again and again, by/through blue lotus (Utpala), of all frightened, terrified, afraid of, non-fear, give! grant! bestow!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 29.b–42.b · 藏文名：འཕགས་མ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ཀུ་རུ་ཀུལླེའི་རྟོག་པ།

verses.iast: pralayakāla iva jaladhāram avatāraya varṣaṃ tān nāgān vaśīkuru kuru phuḥ kulāpaya kulāpaya
verses.meaningZh: 转载·惛沈·时，犹如、如同，净水方位，祈请入，年，彼等（宾格复数），龙族、大龙王，成办作持·最上真言离言说，祈请成办羯磨事业（俱噜），颇字门（妙果圆成（phala）·损减除灭忧苦·涅槃除障点证入），再三令部族（佛
verses.meaningEn: Forward + dulling or hebetating the mind + black, like, just as, water + holding, may You descent, appearance, varṣaṃ, them, those, Nāga, dragon/serpent deity, enacting (imperative seal), accomplish & enact this sacred work! fruition of enlightenment (phala) — dispelling sorrow with nirvāṇic visarga release, cause to buddha-family, lineage! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 29.b–42.b · 藏文名：འཕགས་མ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ཀུ་རུ་ཀུལླེའི་རྟོག་པ།

verses.iast: phuḥ phuḥ, oṃ kurukulle hrīḥ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 再三颇字门（妙果圆成（phala）·损减除灭忧苦·涅槃除障点证入），嗡！作明佛母（咕噜咕列怀爱母）尊，莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Fruition of enlightenment (phala) — dispelling sorrow with nirvāṇic visarga release again and again, Oṃ! O Kurukullā, Magnetizing Wisdom Goddess / in Kurukullā, Magnetizing Wisdom Goddess, Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 29.b–42.b · 藏文名：འཕགས་མ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ཀུ་རུ་ཀུལླེའི་རྟོག་པ།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！簷，再三请执持、总持护念！吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！守护、结界护念，祈请成办羯磨事业（俱噜），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! support, hold! bear! sustain! again and again, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! protection, safeguarding, accomplish & enact this sacred work! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The Sanskrit amuka , sometimes rendered in Tibetan as che ge mo , is a term marking the point at which one should insert the name of the intended beneficiary or target of a rite.

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·远离寂静周遍·大空菩提点摄持），风大自在除障种子，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），揭幕广阔、大口，最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·离一切相无相，金刚界大日智法身水轮甘露种子，揭幕广阔、大口，广大，一切施哪些，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — expansive quiescence sealed with bodhicitta bindu again and again, Vāyu wind-mandala swiftness seed syllable, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, projecting , opening wide, gaping, ugly, terrible, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from conditioned marks, Vajradhātu Mahāvairocana ambrosia seed syllable, projecting , opening wide, gaping, ugly, terrible, great lord of devotion, one who gives everything + = who, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！乞洒字门（尽诸漏障究竟寂灭（kṣaya）·禅定三昧总持·大空菩提点摄持），吉祥宝部心印（福德庄严总持），呼请垂听叹词，乞洒字门（尽诸漏障究竟寂灭（kṣaya）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入），我祈请时候，泮吒（摧破魔障）！

verses.iast: oṃ lāṃ kaṃ kulikeśvarī he pheṃ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·远离寂静周遍·大空菩提点摄持），迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），良好部族自在主，呼唤圣尊叹词（咄！圣者！），颇字门（妙果圆成（phala）·钩召发起三昧·大空菩提点摄持），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — expansive quiescence sealed with bodhicitta bindu, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, of good family + Īśvara, O! Hail! Vocative invocation particle, fruition of enlightenment (phala) — samādhi invocation sealed with bodhicitta bindu, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！金刚橛威神警觉、摧伏魔军（吉栗），闢揭幕广阔，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·禅定三昧总持·涅槃除障点证入），再三乞洒字门（尽诸漏障究竟寂灭（kṣaya）·禅定三昧总持·大空菩提点摄持），吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! vajra-kīla transfixing obstacles & awakening, settle + projecting, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — deep samādhi retention with nirvāṇic visarga release, exhaustion of all karmic outflows (kṣaya) — deep samādhi retention sealed with bodhicitta bindu again and again, Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！左字门（妙行迁变空（caryā）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），再三损害、伤残人员，吽（金刚心印）！莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! awakened conduct beyond flux (caryā) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, may You injure again and again, Hūṃ! Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！妙行迁变空·无我大慈三昧·离诸诤论无诤，再三智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺），再三成熟善根、烧尽业障（跛左），此、此法门，施食

verses.meaningEn: Awakened spiritual movement & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & conflict-free peace again and again, Hūṃ! fruition of enlightenment (phala) — samādhi invocation sealed with bodhicitta bindu, causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — samādhi invocation sealed with bodhicitta bindu, Phaṭ! Phaṭ!

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·损减除灭忧苦·涅槃除障点证入），不动尊威猛降魔心印，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·破有相福德光，向愚痴、无明迷妄，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！

Phaṭ!

Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, Agni wisdom-fire purifying seed syllable, awakened conduct beyond flux & selfless great loving-kindness & conflict-free peace, causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!

verses.iast: oṃ haḥ kaha kaha malinimukhe prasādhaya prasādhaya mahākāla buddhajñāṃ prahitosi māraya māraya
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，再三造作离相·因缘空寂大乐，无我大慈三昧·离一切相无相·离名相假立，再三转载请成办，大黑天护法（摩诃迦罗），佛陀觉知，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐，再三魔、天魔烦恼障
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release, freedom from karmic agency & causal emptiness & spiritual joy again and again, selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from conditioned marks & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), forward + accomplish! fulfill! perfect! again and again, Mahākāla, Great Black Dharmapāla, Buddha + know, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy (vocative invocation), may You Māra, demon, obstacle to awakening! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.iast: kāraya kāraya sarvaduṣṭāṃ praduṣṭān gṛhṇa gṛhṇa mara mara kha kha khāhi khāhi
verses.meaningZh: 再三偈子赞叹、敬礼，一切暴恶者，败坏、糟糕，再三妙行趣入·因缘空寂大乐·离诸诤论无诤，再三临危、死厄，再三佉字门（等虚空无碍（kha）·本不生体性），再三请吞啖、纳受（火供
verses.meaningEn: May You hymn of praise again and again, all + wicked, corrupt, bad, wicked, libidinous, awakened spiritual movement & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & conflict-free peace again and again, dying, death again and again, space-like boundlessness (kha) — primordial non-arising again and again, devour! consume all calamities! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.iast: śīghraṃ daha daha paca paca hūre hūre maṃ raṃ hūṃ phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 快，再三智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺），再三成熟善根、烧尽业障（跛左），再三因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），火大清净智火种子（焚尽罪垢），吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Śīghraṃ, incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! again and again, ripen merit and burn away karmic obstructions! again and again, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation) again and again, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, Agni wisdom-fire purifying seed syllable, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.iast: idaṃ baliṃ graha graha śrī svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 此、此法门，施食，再三曜执、星曜鬼神执障，吉祥、圣德威光，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: This, here, tax, impost, tribute, gift, present, pious offering, planet, seizing spirit/graha again and again, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！妙行迁变空·无我大慈三昧·离诸诤论无诤，再三击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），再三智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺），吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! awakened conduct beyond flux & selfless great loving-kindness & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation), strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again, incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! again and again, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！偈子赞叹·衍伸·巨大·自在主，再三因缘空寂大乐·离一切相无相，再三金刚橛威神警觉、摧伏魔军（吉栗），大·形骸·耕，乞洒字门（尽诸漏障究竟寂灭（kṣaya）·远离寂静周遍·大空菩提点摄持），吉祥宝部心印（福德庄严总持），金刚界大日智法身水轮甘露种子，左字门（妙行迁变空（caryā）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），不动明王因业清净虚空种子，吽（金刚心印）！向乐趣阿难自在主，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! hymn of praise + spawn + exceeding the usual measure + Īśvara, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal) again and again, vajra-kīla transfixing obstacles & awakening again and again, great + skeleton + plough, exhaustion of all karmic outflows (kṣaya) — expansive quiescence sealed with bodhicitta bindu, auspicious Lakṣmī/Ratna-family seed syllable, Vajradhātu Mahāvairocana ambrosia seed syllable, awakened conduct beyond flux (caryā) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, Acala Vidyārāja & space-element seed syllable, Hūṃ! gladden + servant + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: acchan te kā lī bo lī
verses.meaningZh: 妙行迁变空·离覆障清凉·离名相假立，向汝、彼等，迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·远离寂静周遍），攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·禅定三昧总持），跋字门（解脱系缚大力（bala，攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·禅定三昧总持）
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux & coolness free of obscuration & beyond nominal designation, to Thee / they, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — expansive quiescence, freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — deep samādhi retention, spiritual strength freeing bonds (bala) — consecrating Dharma-stream, freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — deep samādhi retention

verses.meaningEn: O fierce, ardent, wrathful / in fierce, ardent, wrathful, he, that one again and again, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — deep samādhi retention, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — dispelling sorrow, freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — purified faculties, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — deep samādhi retention, beyond nominal designation (nāma) — deep samādhi retention, blessedness transcending existence (bhaga) — purified faculties, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — purified faculties, freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — expansive quiescence, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising

verses.iast: ge ta yi kiṃ pūrṇṇa puccha si lo bho li
verses.meaningZh: 誐字门（妙行趣入（gati）·钩召发起三昧），多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·本不生体性），耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·诸根清净自在），迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·诸根清净自在·大空菩提点摄持），富楼那，跟踪，娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·诸根清净自在），攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·摄受法流灌顶），呼请仁者圣众叹词，攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·诸根清净自在）
verses.meaningEn: Awakened spiritual movement (gati) — samādhi invocation, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — primordial non-arising, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — purified faculties, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — purified faculties sealed with bodhicitta bindu, Purna, tail, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — purified faculties, freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — consecrating Dharma-stream, O Venerable Ones! freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — purified faculties
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.iast: a ī na an ta na na hi to he ka
verses.meaningZh: 悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性，悉昙「ī」韵字门：禅定三昧总持，不、非、无，曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·本不生体性），多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·本不生体性），再三不、非、无，诚然、因为、实乃，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·摄受法流灌顶），呼唤圣尊叹词（咄！圣者！），迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·本不生体性）

verses.meaningZh: 悉昙字门总持：e(钩召发起三昧)、kā(造作离相（kārya)、nai(离名相假立（nāma)、ka(造作离相（kārya)、ri(清净离诸尘垢（rajas)、ya(一乘如实之道（yāna)、si(一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya)、stta(真如实际（tathatā)、bā(解脱系缚大力（bala/bandha)、thā(无住安立（sthāna)
verses.meaningEn: Siddhaṃ Akṣara-mukha gates: e (Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'e': samādhi invocation); kā (freedom from karmic agency (kārya)); nai (beyond nominal designation (nāma)); ka (freedom from karmic agency (kārya)); ri (stainless purity free from dust (rajas)); ya (supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna)); si (all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya)); stta (immutable Suchness (tathatā)); bā (spiritual strength freeing bonds (bala)); thā (non-abiding equipoise (sthāna))

verses.iast: ed bhu ta su ma hi ya ka ri hi si jo yi
verses.meaningZh: 陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，婆字门（破有相福德光（bhava，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·本不生体性），娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·损减除灭忧苦），摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），诚然、因为、实乃，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·本不生体性），啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·诸根清净自在），诚然、因为、实乃，娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·诸根清净自在），惹字门（生起不可得·尊胜（jāti，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·诸根清净自在）
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — samādhi invocation, blessedness transcending existence (bhaga) — dispelling sorrow, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — primordial non-arising, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — dispelling sorrow, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, for, indeed, surely, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — primordial non-arising, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — purified faculties, for, indeed, surely, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — purified faculties, transcending birth & victorious (jaya) — consecrating Dharma-stream, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — purified faculties

verses.iast: oṃ mahākālakāruṇika sarvaśatrūn mukhaṃ bandhaya stambhaya mohaya hūṃ heṃ phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！大黑天护法具悲心者，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，面，祈请结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），请制止、令暴恶魔障止息不动！请令怨魔迷闷失其毒力！吽（金刚心印）！贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Mahākāla + compassionate, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, mukhaṃ, may You bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary!! immobilize! halt hostile forces! bewilder hostile forces! Hūṃ! causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — samādhi invocation sealed with bodhicitta bindu, Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Following N and S sarba sha truM mukhaM baM d+ha ya . D reads sarba sha trUM Ni mu khaM baM d+ha ya . S T and RST 15 read sarvasatrūm mukhabandhaya . The rendering in N and S is supported in S T and RST 15 .

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三法界总持任持·无我大慈三昧，造作离相·六度满行清净·无我大慈三昧，乞洒字门（尽诸漏障究竟寂灭（kṣaya）·本不生体性），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Dharma-realm retention & selfless great loving-kindness (imperative seal) again and again, freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās & selfless great loving-kindness (imperative seal), exhaustion of all karmic outflows (kṣaya) — primordial non-arising, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: oṃ balimaṇi raṃ hūṃ jaḥ rakṣaṇi rakṣami rakṣami kha kha ghṛṇa ghṛṇa
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！施食摩尼宝珠，火大清净智火种子（焚尽罪垢），吽（金刚心印）！金刚钩召摄引入坛种子，卫尊，再三拥护守护·清净离诸尘垢，再三佉字门（等虚空无碍（kha）·本不生体性），再三热力、阳光
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! tax + Maṇi jewel, Agni wisdom-fire purifying seed syllable, Hūṃ! Vajra-hook summoning seed syllable (ākarṣaṇa), O guard, protecting (vocative invocation) again and again, space-like boundlessness (kha) — primordial non-arising again and again, heat, sunshine, again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.iast: baliṃ mahābhīṣaṇaṃ prasādhaya prasādhaya hulu hulu phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 施食，大恐怖他，再三转载请成办，再三威猛速疾摄护除灾（呼嚧），泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Tax, impost, tribute, gift, present, pious offering, great, forward + accomplish! fulfill! perfect! again and again, swiftly protect and sweep away calamity! again and again, Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.iast: oṃ yakṣa kīlikīlināma phaṭkāra rakṣa rakṣa diśam bandha mukham bandha hastam bandha
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！药叉（夜叉护法捷疾神），造作离相·离一切相无相·离名相假立，顿断魔障偈子赞叹，再三拥护、守护，方，结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），下额，结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），手、尊手执持，结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Yakṣa, nature/wealth guardian spirit, freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks & beyond nominal designation, shatter obstacles and ignorance! + hymn of praise, protect, guard and shelter! again and again, direction, bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! mukham, bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! hand, bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.iast: bandha sarvāṅgaṃ hūṃ hūṃ raṃ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），全身、一切，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！火大清净智火种子（焚尽罪垢），吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! the whole body, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Agni wisdom-fire purifying seed syllable, Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release, Hūṃ! space-like boundlessness (kha) — primordial non-arising again and again, devour! consume all calamities! again and again, Māra, demon, obstacle to awakening again and again, all + cut in pieces + sound, great + formidable, pleasure + close by, but, indeed, moreover, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！乞洒字门（尽诸漏障究竟寂灭（kṣaya）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），再三悉昙「ū」韵字门：威神增益圆满，再三请击碎、破除一切结缚！祈请魔、天魔烦恼障，祈请临危、死厄，再三噜噜、音声，再三梵音、号啕，贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! exhaustion of all karmic outflows (kṣaya) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'ū': perfected spiritual vigor again and again, shatter! split open! again and again, may You Māra, demon, obstacle to awakening! may You dying, death! roar, noise, thunder again and again, voice, cry, sound again and again, causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!

verses.meaningEn: Eight + of all Nāga, space-like boundlessness (kha) — primordial non-arising again and again, devour! consume all calamities! again and again, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'ūḥ': perfected spiritual vigor with nirvāṇic visarga release again and again

verses.iast: oṃ cītili hili hūṃ mahāśanaiścaraṃ kha kha hūṃ phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！妙行迁变空·真如实际·离一切相无相，定慧摄持、心无散乱（希利），吽（金刚心印）！大土星，再三佉字门（等虚空无碍（kha）·本不生体性），吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), meditative absorption & steadfast mindfulness, Hūṃ! great + moving slowly, space-like boundlessness (kha) — primordial non-arising again and again, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.iast: oṃ hṛḥ hūṃ pataṅga nucchedaya kṣiḥ phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，吽（金刚心印）！蝴蝶，高显超胜·离名相假立，乞洒字门（尽诸漏障究竟寂灭（kṣaya）·诸根清净自在·涅槃除障点证入），泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — miraculous skillful manifestation with nirvāṇic visarga release, Hūṃ! pataṅga, exalting, exhaustion of all karmic outflows (kṣaya) — purified faculties with nirvāṇic visarga release, Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：D and S read ts+tshe daM yak+Shi . F reads tsh+tsha da ya kShi . N D 44-5 and RAS H 47 read cchādaya cchādaya kṣīṃ . UT M 288 reads cchādaya cchādaya kṣī . UT M 286 reads cchādamaya cchādamaya kṣīṃ . BnF S 84 reads cchādaya cchādaya kṣi phaṭ . The transliteration of this term is informed by the Sanskrit witnesses. Otherwise, the mantra follows D.

verses.meaningZh: 悉昙字门总持：cī(妙行迁变空（caryā)、a(本不生体性)、pa(第一义谛（paramārtha)、la(离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa)、vi(最上真言离言说（vāk/vara)、pa(第一义谛（paramārtha)、phā(妙果圆成（phala)、ra(清净离诸尘垢（rajas)、ṇā(离诸诤论无诤（araṇa)、kāṃ(造作离相（kārya)、ti(真如实际（tathatā)、ma(无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī)、ṇā(离诸诤论无诤（araṇa)
verses.meaningEn: Siddhaṃ Akṣara-mukha gates: cī (awakened conduct beyond flux (caryā)); a (Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising); pa (ultimate truth (paramārtha)); la (freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa)); vi (supreme ineffable speech (vāk)); pa (ultimate truth (paramārtha)); phā (fruition of enlightenment (phala)); ra (stainless purity free from dust (rajas)); ṇā (conflict-free peace (araṇa)); kāṃ (freedom from karmic agency (kārya)); ti (immutable Suchness (tathatā)); ma (selfless great loving-kindness); ṇā (conflict-free peace (araṇa))

verses.meaningZh: 诸尊星宿、那乞叉多罗，迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·本不生体性），他字门（无住安立（sthāna）·本不生体性），曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持）
verses.meaningEn: They star, asterism, lunar mansion, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — primordial non-arising, non-abiding equipoise (sthāna) — primordial non-arising, beyond nominal designation (nāma) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 81 (rgyud ’bum, ca), folios 45.b–86.a · 藏文名：ནག་པོ་ཆེན་པོ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.meaningZh: 吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Hūṃ! Phaṭ!

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — deep samādhi retention with nirvāṇic visarga release, objects that cause a change + mouth, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)! to/for characterized by conduct like  D.  and  U, peace, pacification, tranquility, accomplish & enact this sacred work! homage to Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：This term indicates the place where the target's name is to be inserted.

verses.iast: namaḥ sarvatathāgatebhyaḥ sarvamukhebhyaḥ sarvathā he buddhamātari sarvapāpanāśani garja garja bhañja bhañja marda
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切如来·一切面门·诸相本·呼唤圣尊叹词（咄！圣者！）·佛陀·勿·船舶·一切·罪业·摧灭·噜噜、音声·摧碎破除一切魔障·调伏摧碾一切恶障（末娜）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all Tathagatas, all, face, in all ways, by all means, at all, O! Hail! Vocative invocation particle, Buddha, do not, boat, all, evil, O destroying, roar, noise, thunder, shatter and break all obstacles!, subdue and pulverize all evil forces!!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 87 (rgyud ’bum, da), folios 157.a–158.a · 藏文名：ལྷ་མོ་བརྒྱད་ཀྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: marda gambhari gambhari hasa hasa dama dama matha matha vidhvaṃsaya vidhvaṃsaya sarvaśatrūn
verses.meaningZh: 调伏摧碾一切恶障（末娜），再三甚深法海渊广难测，再三笑声，再三柔善，再三摧碎魔军与我慢烦恼（末他），再三请彻底摧毁、令其坏散无余！一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: Subdue and pulverize all evil forces! profound ocean-like Dharma depth again and again, laughter, mirth again and again, or house, home again and again, churn and crush demonic hindrances! again and again, utterly demolish and disperse! again and again, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 87 (rgyud ’bum, da), folios 157.a–158.a · 藏文名：ལྷ་མོ་བརྒྱད་ཀྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: taramati vimale pūraya pūraya pratijñāna sarvabuddhaparyupasiti bhagavati gana gana jahi jahi vimasani
verses.meaningZh: 星宿相貌，毘磨利，再三充分、充分称计，协定、约定，一切·佛陀·愈加·阻碍·阿夷尊，世尊佛母！（呼格），再三妙行趣入·离名相假立，再三弃捨尊，最上真言离言说·无我大慈三昧·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: Star + appearance, pure, may You full again and again, agreement, promise, statement, assertion, all + Buddha + beyond + only pf + O dark-coloured, O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! awakened spiritual movement & beyond nominal designation again and again, O abandoning, giving up again and again, supreme ineffable speech & selfless great loving-kindness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 87 (rgyud ’bum, da), folios 157.a–158.a · 藏文名：ལྷ་མོ་བརྒྱད་ཀྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: kramaṇi dhavani ramaṇi mātaṅgi ge svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 措施、踥蹀尊，驮劝请，丈夫、小老婆尊，下贱种，誐字门（妙行趣入（gati）·钩召发起三昧），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: O step, dha + request, O = — lover, husband, O elephant, greatest or best of, awakened spiritual movement (gati) — samādhi invocation, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 87 (rgyud ’bum, da), folios 157.a–158.a · 藏文名：ལྷ་མོ་བརྒྱད་ཀྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切如来·一切面门·诸相本·仙人、天神尊·坡度、海滨·摧碎破除一切魔障·酇字门（除灭灾患（jhamara）·本不生体性）·无我大慈三昧·妙行迁变空！

verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness & awakened conduct beyond flux (vocative invocation), shatter! split open! again and again, churn and crush demonic hindrances! again and again, badly tamed or hard to tame + tame + not-joy, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningEn: Homage to all Tathagatas, all, face, belonging to one's household, in all ways, by all means, at all, O! Hail! Vocative invocation particle, freedom from karmic agency & beyond nominal designation & generosity & self-mastery (vocative invocation), all Tathagatas, speak, O one, blessedness transcending existence & Dharma-realm retention, giving, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & cutting rigid pride!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：This follows Toh 497. Toh 499 reads hUM hUM phaT phaT .

verses.meaningEn: Homage to all Tathagatas, all, face, in all ways, by all means, at all, O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī!, O Perfection of Wisdom (Prajñāpāramitā) / in Perfection of Wisdom (Prajñāpāramitā), Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, making (vocative invocation), knowing (vocative invocation), shatter and break all obstacles!, churn and crush demonic hindrances!!

verses.meaningZh: 摧碎魔军与我慢烦恼（末他），再三柔善，再三离名相假立·一乘如实之道，再三流注周遍、速行护念（萨啰），再三魔、天魔烦恼障，觉悟正觉·一切诸谛圆满，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Churn and crush demonic hindrances! or house, home again and again, beyond nominal designation & supreme vehicle of awakening again and again, flow forth and pervade with blessing! again and again, may You Māra, demon, obstacle to awakening! again and again, awakened (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 87 (rgyud ’bum, da), folios 157.a–158.a · 藏文名：ལྷ་མོ་བརྒྱད་ཀྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningEn: Homage to all Tathagatas, all, face, in all ways, by all means, at all, roar, noise, thunder, churn and crush demonic hindrances!, or house, home, shatter and break all obstacles!!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 87 (rgyud ’bum, da), folios 157.a–158.a · 藏文名：ལྷ་མོ་བརྒྱད་ཀྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 大鼓，一切责任，再三击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），再三请彻底摧毁、令其坏散无余！再三满陀，再三智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺），广大·净无垢秽·揭帝，请摄召、赐予妙寿福德供养！
verses.meaningEn: Drum, all + O blame, strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again, utterly demolish and disperse! again and again, may You mota again and again, incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! again and again, vast + utterly spotless + O gone or come forth or out, bring! fetch! bestow!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 87 (rgyud ’bum, da), folios 157.a–158.a · 藏文名：ལྷ་མོ་བརྒྱད་ཀྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 请摄召、赐予妙寿福德供养！再三去吧、趣向菩提！觉悟正觉·一切诸谛圆满，勿、莫令，搭拉、垫料，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Bring! fetch! bestow! go! proceed! again and again, awakened, do not, let not, hanging down, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 87 (rgyud ’bum, da), folios 157.a–158.a · 藏文名：ལྷ་མོ་བརྒྱད་ཀྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningEn: Subdue and pulverize all evil forces! bring! fetch! bestow! again and again, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! transcending birth & victorious & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！造作离相·清净离诸尘垢，面，诸诸法之，起讫·微妙·不，如是、亦复如是，嗡！语金刚种子字（一切法本不生清净妙语），吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust, mukhaṃ, of all things, beginning and end + be wonderful + not, thus, in that same way, Oṃ! speech-vajra seed syllable Āḥ (non-arising), Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Vaiśravaṇa, All-Hearing Guardian King, he + accessory, assembly, Vajra-hook summoning seed syllable (ākarṣaṇa), Hūṃ! Vajradhātu Mahāvairocana ambrosia seed syllable, Vajra-joy samaya-union seed syllable

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！嗡！毗沙门天王（多闻天王），请钩召、慈悲摄引善法！吽（金刚心印）！金刚钩召摄引入坛种子
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — samādhi invocation, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Oṃ! Vaiśravaṇa, All-Hearing Guardian King, attract! summon! draw near! Hūṃ! Vajra-hook summoning seed syllable (ākarṣaṇa)

verses.iast: Oṃ nīlāmbaradharavajrapāṇi ājñāpayati imaṃ baligṛhnantu Samayarakṣantu Mama sarvasiddhiṃ me prayacchantu mama karmāmogha svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！绀青·天衣·请执持·金刚手菩萨，命令·净水·戒精进，此（真言，解脱系缚大力·离一切相无相·妙行趣入，三昧耶愿诸尊普皆守护！我之（行者所有），一切悉地，于我、为我，乐趣愿悉喜，我之（行者所有），事不空，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! sapphire-blue + garment + hold! bear! sustain! + Vajrapāṇi, command + water + as many, this (accusative), spiritual strength freeing bonds & freedom from conditioned marks & awakened spiritual movement (imperative seal), Samaya + may they all protect! my, of me (the practitioner), all + Siddhi, to me, my, pleasure + may they close by, my, of me (the practitioner), actions + unfailing, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: Oṃ vaiśravaṇāya hūṃ hūṃ paca paca chinda chinda svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！向毗沙门天王（多闻天王），吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！再三成熟善根、烧尽业障（跛左），再三断除烦恼结使缠缚（嗔陀），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! to/for Vaiśravaṇa, All-Hearing Guardian King, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! ripen merit and burn away karmic obstructions! again and again, sever every fetter and hostile spell! again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 87 (rgyud ’bum, da), folios 158.a–167.a · 藏文名：བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས་ཕྱག་ན་རྡོ་རྗེ་གོས་སྔོན་པོ་ཅན་གྱི་རྒྱུད།

Oṃ , kha kha ! | Devour, devour! | Cook, cook! | Do not delay, do not delay! | Hūṃ hūṃ ! | Phaṭ phaṭ ! | Split, split! | Svāhā !

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 88 (rgyud ’bum, na), folios 88.a–334.a (in 1737 par phud printing), 105.a–351.a (in later printings) · 藏文名：འཇམ་དཔལ་གྱི་རྩ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！再三佉字门（等虚空无碍（kha）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , kha kha ! Devour, devour! O tamer of evil beings, with a sword, a club, an axe, and a noose in your hands! One with four arms, four faces, and six feet, go, go! O great destroyer of obstacles with contorted face, inspiring fear in all nonhuman beings! One who roars with wild laughter and wears a tiger skin, perform, perform all tasks! Cut, cut all the mantras [of non-believers]! Break, break all the mudrās of non-believers! Draw here, draw here all nonhuman beings! Grind, grind all the wicked ones! Cause them to enter into the center of the maṇḍala! O terminator of the life of Vaivasvata, perform, perform tasks for me! Burn, burn! Cook, cook! Do not delay, do not delay! Remember your samaya pledge! Hūṃ hūṃ ! Phaṭ phaṭ ! Split, split! Fulfiller of all wishes! Hey, hey, blessed one! Why do you tarry? Accomplish all my aims! Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：sarba kArya ma D.

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , kha kha ! Devour, devour! O tamer of evil beings, with a sword, a club, an axe, and a noose in your hands! One with four arms, four faces, and six feet, go, go! O great destroyer of obstacles with contorted face, inspiring fear in all nonhuman beings! One who roars with wild laughter and wears a tiger skin, perform, perform all tasks! Cut, cut all the mantras [of non-believers]! Break, break all the mudrās of non-believers! Draw here, draw here all nonhuman beings! Grind, grind all the wicked ones! Cause them to enter into the center of the maṇḍala! O terminator of the life of Vaivasvata, perform, perform tasks for me! Burn, burn! Cook, cook! Do not delay, do not delay! Remember your samaya pledge! Hūṃ hūṃ ! Phaṭ phaṭ ! Split, split! Fulfiller of all wishes! Hey, hey, blessed one! Why do you tarry? Accomplish all my aims! Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：sarba kArya ma D.

Oṃ , hrīṃḥ ! O Kālarūpa! Huṃ , khaṃ ! Svāhā !
Win a victory, an auspicious victory, O most compassionate lord whose nature is everything!

verses.iast: Oṃ , hrīṃḥ ! O Kālarūpa! Huṃ , khaṃ ! Svāhā !
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·禅定三昧总持·大空菩提点摄持），悉昙「o」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，时色，金刚怒王种子字（摧伏魔障），大空无碍法界虚空种子，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — deep samādhi retention sealed with bodhicitta bindu, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'o': consecrating Dharma-stream, black + form, vajra seed syllable Huṃ, boundless Dharmadhātu sky seed syllable, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 88 (rgyud ’bum, na), folios 88.a–334.a (in 1737 par phud printing), 105.a–351.a (in later printings) · 藏文名：འཇམ་དཔལ་གྱི་རྩ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: Win a victory, an auspicious victory, O most compassionate lord whose nature is everything!
verses.meaningZh: 曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·诸根清净自在），悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性，最上真言离言说·妙行迁变空·真如实际，曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·本不生体性），一切诸谛圆满·第一义谛·妙行迁变空，最上真言离言说·妙行迁变空·真如实际，悉昙「o」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·摄受法流灌顶），妙行迁变空·无我大慈三昧·第一义谛，陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，因缘空寂大乐·一切诸谛圆满，不迅疾，娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·诸根清净自在），最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Win a victory, an auspicious victory, O most compassionate [lord] whose nature is everything! Go, go to your own abode and dismiss [also] all the buddhas with their retinues. Cause them to return to their respective dwellings. Remember the pledge. May the words of [these] mantras fulfill my every purpose. Make my wishes come true, svāhā !

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！放光勇健，一乘如实之道·无住安立
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , divine youth! Great prince, play, play! O six-faced one, authorized by the bodhisattvas! Mounted on a peacock seat and raising your hand with a spear in it! Your color is red and you are fond of red fragrances and unguents. Kha kha ! Eat, eat, eat! Huṃ ! Dance, dance! Your images are worshiped with red flowers. Please remember your samaya! Move about, move! Stir them up, do, do! Quick, quick! Don't delay! Carry out all my tasks, do! You with a bright and colorful form, remain, remain, huṃ ! You have the authorization from all of the buddhas, svāhā !

provenance.rawSnippet: Oṃ ghuṇu ! Ghuṇu , ghuṇu , O secret one! Come, come, O guhyakī! Svāhā !

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！再三破暗合集·离诸诤论无诤，悉昙「o」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! dissolving dense ignorance & conflict-free peace (imperative seal) again and again, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'o': consecrating Dharma-stream
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：shrI Nu Tib. Ghuṇu is a verbal form, second person imperative, but the meaning is unclear. Possibly this is an encouragement to make a move, or perhaps to make a buzzing sound that heralds the arrival of a spirit (cf. Edgerton, p. 220, the entry for ghuṇaghuṇāyate ). In the Tib., this word appears as shrI Nu , which seems to be a transliteration of *śrīṇu (“cling on”?).

verses.iast: secret one! Come, come, O guhyakī! Svāhā !

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！被覆大地，龛慧，被覆具住房；圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ Guhilā , Guhāmati, Guhāvāsinī! Please come, O blessed one, close to me! Remember your samaya! Svāhā !

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — deep samādhi retention with nirvāṇic visarga release, Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'o': consecrating Dharma-stream, awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, beyond nominal designation & generosity & self-mastery (vocative invocation), Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！再三佉字门（等虚空无碍（kha）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , kha kha ! Devour, devour! O tamer of evil beings, with a sword, a club, a noose, and an axe in your hands! One with four arms, four faces, and six feet, go, go! O great destroyer of obstacles with a contorted face, inspiring fear in all nonhuman beings! You who roar with wild laughter and wear a tiger skin, perform, perform all tasks! Cut, cut all the mantras [of non-believers]! Break, break the mudrās of non-believers! Draw here, draw all nonhuman beings! Grind, grind all the wicked ones! Cause them to enter into the center of the maṇḍala! O terminator of the life of Vaivasvata, perform, perform tasks for me! Burn, burn! Cook, cook! Do not delay, do not delay! Remember your samaya pledge! Hūṃ hūṃ ! Phaṭ phaṭ ! Split, split! Fulfiller of all wishes! O blessed one, why do you tarry? Please accomplish all my aims! Svāhā !

O great destroyer of obstacles with a contorted face, inspiring fear in all nonhuman beings! You who roar with wild laughter and wear a tiger skin, perform, perform all tasks! Cut, cut all the mantras [of non-believers]! Break, break the mudrās of non-believers! Draw here, draw all nonhuman beings! Grind, grind all the wicked ones! Cause them to enter into the center of the maṇḍala! O terminator of the life of Vaivasvata, perform, perform tasks for me! Burn, burn! Cook, cook! Do not delay, do not delay! Remember your samaya pledge! Hūṃ hūṃ ! Phaṭ phaṭ ! Split, split! Fulfiller of all wishes! O blessed one, why do you tarry? Please accomplish all my aims! Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 88 (rgyud ’bum, na), folios 88.a–334.a (in 1737 par phud printing), 105.a–351.a (in later printings) · 藏文名：འཇམ་དཔལ་གྱི་རྩ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 再三金刚怒王种子字（摧伏魔障），泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , kill, kill all those that pose danger! Destroy and annihilate them! Make them afraid! Crush, chop, and break them! Burn them, burn! Huṃ huṃ , phaṭ phaṭ , svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 88 (rgyud ’bum, na), folios 88.a–334.a (in 1737 par phud printing), 105.a–351.a (in later printings) · 藏文名：འཇམ་དཔལ་གྱི་རྩ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 再三妙行迁变空·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , the omnifarious form of the divine youth, come, come! Quick, quick! Bhrūṃ bhrūṃ , hūṃ hūṃ ! O victorious Victor! Splendorous Mañjuśrī! Deliver me from all suffering! Phaṭ phaṭ ! Pacify, pacify! You who arise from and are the source of immortality, destroy my negativity, svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Although it is difficult to determine in the vague BHS language of this mantra, the gender here seems feminine. The Skt. uses the form kumārarūpiṇi , which is the vocative of kumārarūpiṇī (“you (feminine) with the form of the divine youth”). This would be in line with the preceding commentary that one uses this mantra to invoke, at the time of death, the form ( mūrti , which is feminine in Skt.) of the dharmadhātu, which is Mañjuśrī. As this mantra is a vidyā , this also makes it likely that a female entity is addressed here. The epithet, viśvasambhava (“omnifarious”), could be a vocative form ( viśvasambhave before sandhi) of the feminine form viśvasambhavā .

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！弯曲、超群佛母，离一切相无相·解脱系缚大力·清净离诸尘垢，解放佛母，清净离诸尘垢·离一切相无相·一切诸谛圆满，自由化佛母，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·钩召发起三昧），清净离诸尘垢，生起不可得·尊胜·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! carrying over, rescuing, freedom from conditioned marks & spiritual strength freeing bonds & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), delivering from, hurling, stainless purity free from dust & freedom from conditioned marks & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (vocative invocation), freeing, delivering, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — samādhi invocation, stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), transcending birth & victorious & supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: oṃ kāśe syanda kuśe syanda syanda tvaṃ śūnyaveśmani
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！种类草本尊，做出、结果，吉祥草，再三做出、结果，汝、圣尊您，空·房·在于
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O a kind of grass / in a kind of grass, issue, outcome, result, O grass, the sacred grass used at rel, issue, outcome, result again and again, Thou, You, empty + in

verses.meaningZh: 我之（行者所有），汝、圣尊您，如是、亦复如是，做出、结果，犹如、如…所说，一切诸谛圆满·一乘如实之道·离名相假立，最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: My, of me (the practitioner), Thou, You, thus, in that same way, issue, outcome, result, just as, according to, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme vehicle of awakening & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious & stainless purity free from dust, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: oṃ stambhani stambhaya jambhani jambhaya mohani mohaya rakṣaṇi rakṣaya māṃ varade siddhalocane svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！僵仆尊，请制止、令暴恶魔障止息不动！令愚尊，请调伏、摧折憍慢魔障！作昏尊，请令怨魔迷闷失其毒力！卫尊，祈请拥护、守护于我，施愿者、满善愿尊尊，成就者眼，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O laming, paralyzing, fixing, stopping, restraining, immobilize! halt hostile forces! O crushing, destroying, crush! quell jaws of hostility! O stupefying, perplexing, deceiving, bewilder hostile forces! O guard, may You protect, guard and shelter! me, O boon-granting, wish-bestowing / in boon-granting, wish-bestowing, accomplished + O eye, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: Oṃ , Svapnavilokinī! Siddhalocanā! Interpret my dream for me! Svāhā !
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！梦·闢·具世间，成就者眼，离名相假立·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·摄受法流灌顶），于我、为我，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! sleep + settle + possessing world, accomplished + eye, beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — consecrating Dharma-stream, to me, my, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
