verses.meaningZh: 嗡！咸净水，汝即是（当体即是），猛利，汝即是（当体即是），喜，汝即是（当体即是），能作成办·破有相福德光
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! salt + water, Thou art, tīkṣṇo, Thou art, udagro, Thou art, making
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 89 (rgyud ’bum, pa), folios 1.b–13.a · 藏文名：དཔའ་བོ་གཅིག་པུ་གྲུབ་པའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: amukasya daha gātrāṇi daha māṃsāni daha tvacam nakhāny api daha asthīni asthibhyo majjakaṃ daha
verses.meaningZh: 某甲之，智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺），一切腔，智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺），一切肉，智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺），桂枝，离名相假立·等虚空无碍·一乘如实之道，亦、虽、乃至，智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺），一切诸谛圆满·无住安立·离名相假立，向诸骨，髓之后，智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺）
verses.meaningEn: Of a certain person, incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! a limb of the body, incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! sgl, incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! cinnamon, beyond nominal designation & space-like boundlessness & supreme vehicle of awakening, even, also, incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & non-abiding equipoise & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), to/from bone, or emphasizing particle, incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 89 (rgyud ’bum, pa), folios 1.b–13.a · 藏文名：དཔའ་བོ་གཅིག་པུ་གྲུབ་པའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: lavaṇaṃ chindati lavaṇaṃ bhindati lavaṇaṃ pacati
verses.meaningZh: 咸，断除烦恼结使缠缚（嗔陀），咸，劈破无明坚固执障（牝陀），咸，成熟善根、烧尽业障（跛左）
verses.meaningEn: Lavaṇaṃ, sever every fetter and hostile spell! lavaṇaṃ, cleave asunder stubborn ignorance! lavaṇaṃ, ripen merit and burn away karmic obstructions!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 89 (rgyud ’bum, pa), folios 1.b–13.a · 藏文名：དཔའ་བོ་གཅིག་པུ་གྲུབ་པའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: kṣoṇitalavaṇe hriyamāṇe kuto nidrā kuto ratiḥ
verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤，因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，为谁的，睡觉，为谁的，嬉
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation), causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), kuto, sleep, † causing sleep, kuto, pleasure
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 89 (rgyud ’bum, pa), folios 1.b–13.a · 藏文名：དཔའ་བོ་གཅིག་པུ་གྲུབ་པའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: yadi vasati yojanaśate nadīnāṃ ca śatāntare
verses.meaningZh: 设使，髁骨，踰缮那百尊，诸访客之以及因缘内部
verses.meaningEn: If, when, donʼt stop (stay, rest, delay)! harnessing + O hundred, of crier, caller and cut in pieces + O interior
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 89 (rgyud ’bum, pa), folios 1.b–13.a · 藏文名：དཔའ་བོ་གཅིག་པུ་གྲུབ་པའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 小邑，铁园尊，深青黑·蛇·断除·糊涂
verses.meaningEn: O town, city / in town, city, reddish + O encircling wall, dark-blue + crawling + cut + O confounded
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 89 (rgyud ’bum, pa), folios 1.b–13.a · 藏文名：དཔའ་བོ་གཅིག་པུ་གྲུབ་པའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 于彼处犹如，因为、截至所以，离名相假立·因缘空寂大乐，咸·结界系缚邪魔外障·立行面前
verses.meaningEn: There + like, on account of, for the sake of, by reason of, beyond nominal designation & causal emptiness & spiritual joy (vocative invocation), salt + bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! + placed before
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 89 (rgyud ’bum, pa), folios 1.b–13.a · 藏文名：དཔའ་བོ་གཅིག་པུ་གྲུབ་པའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: oṃ ciṭi ciṭi vikloli amukaṃ sadhanaparivāram eva samānaya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三觉知警策妙音（唧置），最上真言离言说·造作离相·离一切相无相，某甲，普通财物眷属，唯、正是、决定，祈请一样，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! awakening mindfulness mantra-pada again and again, supreme ineffable speech & freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), a certain person, common wealth + accessory, indeed, verily, alone, may You being, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 89 (rgyud ’bum, pa), folios 1.b–13.a · 藏文名：དཔའ་བོ་གཅིག་པུ་གྲུབ་པའི་རྒྱུད།

provenance.rawSnippet:
oṃ kurukulle svāhā
Oṃ, svāhā to Kurukullā!
amale vimale kuṅkume samayena baddho 'si | bindūn bindūn icchayā devo varṣati vidyotayati garjati garjati | vismayamahārāja samāyita vardhayita hūṃ | devebhyo manuṣyebhyo gandarvebhyo śikhigrahadeva ānandasya grahaṇāyāgamanāyākramaṇāya juhomīha svāhā
O amazing great king! | Hūṃ !

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！作明佛母（咕噜咕列怀爱母）尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O Kurukullā, Magnetizing Wisdom Goddess / in Kurukullā, Magnetizing Wisdom Goddess, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 89 (rgyud ’bum, pa), folios 1.b–13.a · 藏文名：དཔའ་བོ་གཅིག་པུ་གྲུབ་པའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·摄受法流灌顶），作明佛母（咕噜咕列怀爱母）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! immutable Suchness (tathatā) — consecrating Dharma-stream, Kurukullā, Magnetizing Wisdom Goddess
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 89 (rgyud ’bum, pa), folios 1.b–13.a · 藏文名：དཔའ་བོ་གཅིག་པུ་གྲུབ་པའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 无垢、离染清净尊，毘磨利，郁金香，以三昧耶（本誓、平等契合、时际），带子、丁字裤，汝即是（当体即是）
verses.meaningEn: O stainless, spotless, pure / in stainless, spotless, pure, pure, O saffron / in saffron, by/through Samaya, sacred vow, pledge, union, strap, thong, Thou art
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Grahaṇāyāgamanāyākramaṇāya is a conjectured reading. In the manuscripts we have grahaṇīyāgamanāyākramaṇīya .

verses.iast: bindūn bindūn icchayā devo varṣati vidyotayati garjati garjati
verses.meaningZh: 再三解脱系缚大力·离名相假立·施度调伏，以欲，天，年，猥亵性暴露戒精进，再三噜噜、音声
verses.meaningEn: Spiritual strength freeing bonds & beyond nominal designation & generosity & self-mastery again and again, with/by wish, desire, devo, raining, flashing + as many, roar, noise, thunder again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Grahaṇāyāgamanāyākramaṇāya is a conjectured reading. In the manuscripts we have grahaṇīyāgamanāyākramaṇīya .

verses.meaningZh: 微萨么曳大王，一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·一乘如实之道，增长福慧·最上真言离言说，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Free from pride + great king, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme vehicle of awakening, increasing, Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Grahaṇāyāgamanāyākramaṇāya is a conjectured reading. In the manuscripts we have grahaṇīyāgamanāyākramaṇīya .

verses.iast: devebhyo manuṣyebhyo gandarvebhyo śikhigrahadeva ānandasya grahaṇāyāgamanāyākramaṇāya juhomīha svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 天人富人，人富人，妙行趣入·离名相假立·施度调伏，本性寂静止息·等虚空无碍·妙行趣入，阿难，向摄伏·出·宝树宝山·铁杆虔诚·降镇，生起不可得·尊胜·因缘空寂大乐·无我大慈三昧，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: God + belonging to one's household, person + belonging to one's household, awakened spiritual movement & beyond nominal designation & generosity & self-mastery, primordial tranquil peace & space-like boundlessness & awakened spiritual movement, of servant, to seize + income + tree or mountain + be zealous or devout + to, transcending birth & victorious & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & selfless great loving-kindness, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Grahaṇāyāgamanāyākramaṇāya is a conjectured reading. In the manuscripts we have grahaṇīyāgamanāyākramaṇīya .

verses.meaningZh: 悉昙「o」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·妙行趣入，妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，誐字门（妙行趣入（gati）·诸根清净自在）；吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'o': consecrating Dharma-stream, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & awakened spiritual movement, awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, awakened spiritual movement (gati) — purified faculties Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Perhaps a metaphor is intended here: it is the function of the god of comets and planets to control the seizing (i.e., eclipsing), coming, and traversing of heavenly bodies, but here he is meant to apply this function to the “movements” of happiness. The grammar, however, is not very clear.

verses.iast: oṃ jñānāloke triratnavaṃśasaṃdhāraṇi bhagavati abhayaṃ dādi abhayaṃ datte me bodhicittavajraparipālaya samantāvabhāsena hana
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！圣智光明，三·珍宝·笛·擎尊，世尊佛母！（呼格），无畏，施物尊，无畏，施度调伏·真如实际，于我、为我，菩提心·金刚·请周遍护持，以普现，击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! primordial wisdom + O light, three + jewel + tradition + O supporting, O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! non-fear, O gift, non-fear, generosity & self-mastery & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), to me, my, aspiration to enlightenment + Vajra + completely protect and sustain! samantāvabhāsena, strike down afflictions and mara-forces!

verses.meaningZh: 击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），一切众生·桑·一线·倒，烦恼、惑染尘劳，祈请断，幅度·一如·严·身躯，菩提觉知·解脱系缚大力，请周遍护持、恒常守护！佛陀、觉者，祈请帐户、资料，光明照耀·宝树宝山·药叉·乾闼婆·阿修罗·迦楼罗·紧那罗·摩睺罗伽，因为、截至所以尊，祈请令依止处、活生生
verses.meaningEn: Strike down afflictions and mara-forces! all sentient beings + saṃ + thread, affliction, mental defilement, may You cutting off! width + without characteristic mark + adornment + O body, awakening, completely protect and sustain! Buddha, the Awakened One, may You account, information, prophecy, shining + tree or mountain + Yakṣa + Gandharva + Asura + Garuḍa + Kinnara + Mahoraga, O on account of, for the sake of, by reason of, cause to standing, living, being in, occupied with, devoted to!

verses.meaningZh: 无畏，施予，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Non-fear, giving, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningEn: Causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust & awakened conduct beyond flux (vocative invocation), buddha-family + do not + O blessed, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, to fall + Thou art, śiri again and again, awakened spiritual movement & primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), awakened spiritual movement & ultimate truth & primordial tranquil peace (vocative invocation), well-being, fortune, auspicious safety, of all all sentient beings, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningEn: O Samantabhadra, Universally Worthy Bodhisattva / in Samantabhadra, Universally Worthy Bodhisattva, all aims and benefits, O accomplishing, means of attainment (Sādhana), O of man, of a goddess, = / in of man, of a goddess, =, great + O of man, O extraordinary, O most wonderful / in most wonderful, stainless purity free from dust & transcending birth & victorious (vocative invocation), O free from dust, O unshaken, firm, imperishable, O ambrosia, nectar of immortality / in ambrosia, nectar of immortality, stainless purity free from dust & transcending birth & victorious (vocative invocation)

verses.meaningEn: Vajra-kīla transfixing obstacles & awakening again and again, accomplish & enact this sacred work! again and again, swiftly dissolve karmic knots & obstacles! again and again, swiftly set sacred blessings in motion! again and again, accomplish! fulfill! perfect! self + certainly, constantly, eternally, interior + realm

verses.meaningZh: 归命向极微妙音自然，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！

verses.meaningZh: 向施财，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！

verses.meaningZh: 向希望般充分，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼种类小鸟、男人·佛陀、觉者！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to a kind of bird, Buddha, the Awakened One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to the Narthang version of Toh 555 and the Dege version of Toh 556. The Dege of Toh 555 has deviye .

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼毗沙门天王（多闻天王）·俱吠滥·大王·太王！

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼吉祥、圣德威光·广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, great (vocative invocation)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to the Narthang version of Toh 555 and the Dege version of Toh 556. The Dege of Toh 555 has deviye .

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to the Narthang version of Toh 555 and the Dege version of Toh 556. The Dege of Toh 555 has deviye .

verses.iast: tara tara turu turu vara vara suśuddho suśuddho hana hana maṇikanaka
verses.meaningZh: 再三弯曲、超群，再三迅疾度脱一切危厄（都噜），再三殊胜、胜愿、妙好，再三报刊往外清净，再三击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），摩尼宝珠黄金
verses.meaningEn: Crossing, surpassing, overcoming again and again, swiftly ferry across all perils! again and again, choicest, supreme boon, excellent again and again, press out + pure again and again, strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again, Maṇi jewel + gold
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to the Narthang version of Toh 555 and the Dege version of Toh 556. The Dege of Toh 555 has deviye .

verses.iast: vajravaidūrya muktikālaṃkrta sarirāya sarvasatvānāṃ hitakāma vaiśravaṇa śriyadevīprabhāya ehi ehi māvilamba ghūrṇa ghūrṇa parasya parasya dadāhi mama amukanāsya
verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢，无我大慈三昧·造作离相·真如实际，向湖饮料，诸一切众生、普皆有情之，口彩，毗沙门天王（多闻天王），本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，再三善来降临坛场（翳呬），勿搭拉，再三索索、滴溜溜，再三他人之，施予饶益·施度调伏，我之（行者所有），无我大慈三昧·造作离相·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious & stainless purity free from dust, selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness, a lake + to, of all all sentient beings, well-wishing, Vaiśravaṇa, All-Hearing Guardian King, primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening (reverent offering), come forth, O Blessed One! again and again, do not + hanging down, moving to and fro, trembling, whirling again and again, of someone else again and again, granting (vocative invocation), my, of me (the practitioner), selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from karmic agency & beyond nominal designation
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to the Narthang version of Toh 555 and the Dege version of Toh 556. The Dege of Toh 555 has deviye .

verses.iast: darśanakāmasya darśanaṃ mama mana, pralahadāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 观照希之，观照，我之（行者所有），自尊，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·离一切相无相，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: False + of wish, darśanaṃ, my, of me (the practitioner), pride, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from conditioned marks (reverent offering), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to the Narthang version of Toh 555 and the Dege version of Toh 556. The Dege of Toh 555 has deviye .

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·妙行趣入·断除憍慢执障，最上真言离言说·妙行趣入·断除憍慢执障，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！

verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 555 has same visame .

verses.meaningZh: 安乐妙善·一切诸谛圆满，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Blissful (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 555 has same visame .

verses.meaningZh: 向大海三姥驮，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Ocean + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 555 has same visame .

verses.meaningZh: 向部派仙人，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Ramification + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 555 has same visame .

verses.meaningZh: 向青颈观自在（吞摄诸毒大悲相），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: To/for Nīlakaṇṭha, Blue-Throated Compassionate One, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 555 has same visame .

verses.meaningZh: 向无能胜精进，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Invincible + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 555 has same visame .

verses.meaningZh: 向雪山三姥驮，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: To, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 555 has same visame .

verses.meaningZh: 冥合融摄·离名相假立，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Uniting (reverent offering), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 555 has same visame .

verses.meaningZh: 归命向世尊（薄伽梵）致敬，婆罗门，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, O brahmanhood, brahmanic condition / in brahmanhood, brahmanic condition, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 555 has same visame .

verses.meaningZh: 归命向妙音天女（辩才天），向天女、佛母明妃，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to to Sarasvatī, Goddess of Eloquence & Wisdom, to goddess, sacred female deity, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 555 has same visame .

verses.meaningZh: 愿诸真言章句悉皆成就，真言章句、密咒句义，陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: May all mantra-padas succeed! sacred mantra phrase, generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 555 has same visame .

verses.meaningZh: 作满，收，神父·日复一日·愿持心，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Bharato, searched, priest + day after day + may it thinking one's self-, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 555 has same visame .

verses.meaningZh: 陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，犹如此
verses.meaningEn: syād yathedaṃ | mure cire avaje avajavate higule migule pigalavati maguśe marici samati daśamati agrima gritara citara capati cicirī śirimiri mandhi demakhi marici praṇaye lokajyeṣṭhe lokapriye siddhiprite vimamukhi śucikharī apratihate apratehatabuddhe namuci namuci mahādevī pratigṛhnanamaskaraṃ [say your name] mama buddhi viśduddhi bhagavadtyaṃ bevayaṃ sparasatya karade keyūre keyūramati hilimili apayame mahādeve buddhasatyana dharmasatya saṃghasatyena indrasatyena varuṇasatyena yeloke stayasatyena teśamastyena sattivadcanini avahayami mahādevem hilimili hilimili vicidato [say your name] mama buddhi namo bhavati mahādeve sarasatya sidhyanti mantrapadāni svāhā |

verses.meaningZh: 陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，犹如此，充分殊胜，普遍·吠陀·宝山，大·果·对·领军向着，有情·义利·萨麻丹·日复一日·转载·原来，来诣实相，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，大慈爱，愈加·一层·于此，向桑在家人汝，功能·日复一日·守护尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — expansive quiescence, just as + this, full + O choicest, universal + Vedas + mountain, great + to be done + toward + O leading towards, sentient being + meaning + to + day after day + forward + formerly, coming + true appearance, great (vocative invocation), great + O friendly, thereto + layer + O here, saṃ + become a house or habitation + to Thee, ability + day after day + O keeping, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningEn: Gathering pure Dharmic merits & radiance again and again, swiftly set sacred blessings in motion! again and again, accomplish & enact this sacred work! again and again, freedom from karmic agency & cutting rigid pride (imperative seal) again and again, immutable Suchness & cutting rigid pride (imperative seal) again and again, supreme ineffable speech & causal emptiness & spiritual joy again and again, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & perfection of the six pāramitās again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼珍宝活期！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to jewel, to!

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼毗沙门天王（多闻天王）·大王！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Vaiśravaṇa, All-Hearing Guardian King, great king!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to the Narthang version of Toh 555. The Dege version of Toh 555 has manorathaparipūraya , while the Dege of Toh 556 has manorathaparipuraya .

verses.iast: simi simi sumu sumu caṇḍa caṇḍa cara cara, sara sara kara kara
verses.meaningZh: 再三一切、一切处尊，再三一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧，再三威猛、暴烈除障，再三行持妙道、周游救护（左啰），再三流注周遍、速行护念（萨啰），再三掌
verses.meaningEn: O all, every again and again, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness (imperative seal) again and again, fierce, ardent, wrathful again and again, move forth in compassionate activity! again and again, flow forth and pervade with blessing! again and again, palm again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to the Narthang version of Toh 555. The Dege version of Toh 555 has manorathaparipūraya , while the Dege of Toh 556 has manorathaparipuraya .

verses.iast: kili kili kuru kuru muru muru curu curu sandhāya ātmanām nitatyan antardhātu
verses.meaningZh: 再三金刚橛威神警觉、摧伏魔军（吉栗），再三成办羯磨事业（俱噜），再三速疾摧碎烦恼结缚（亩噜），再三速疾运转妙法加持（祖噜），赢得一层，我自然，在于·彼·假定今日，裏界
verses.meaningEn: Vajra-kīla transfixing obstacles & awakening again and again, accomplish & enact this sacred work! again and again, swiftly dissolve karmic knots & obstacles! again and again, swiftly set sacred blessings in motion! again and again, win + layer, self + certainly, in + That + suppose now, interior + realm
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to the Narthang version of Toh 555. The Dege version of Toh 555 has manorathaparipūraya , while the Dege of Toh 556 has manorathaparipuraya .

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to the Narthang version of Toh 555. The Dege version of Toh 555 has manorathaparipūraya , while the Dege of Toh 556 has manorathaparipuraya .

verses.meaningZh: 归命向极微妙音自然，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to particle emphasizing the preceding word or merely expletive + sound + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to the Narthang version of Toh 555. The Dege version of Toh 555 has manorathaparipūraya , while the Dege of Toh 556 has manorathaparipuraya .

verses.meaningZh: 向施财，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: To/for giving money or wealth, munificent, liberal, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to the Narthang version of Toh 555. The Dege version of Toh 555 has manorathaparipūraya , while the Dege of Toh 556 has manorathaparipuraya .

verses.meaningZh: 向希望般充分，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Wish + wisdom + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：According to the Narthang version of Toh 555. The Dege version of Toh 555 has manorathaparipūraya , while the Dege of Toh 556 has manorathaparipuraya .

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼种类小鸟、男人·佛陀、觉者！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to a kind of bird, Buddha, the Awakened One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 555 has muktikālaṃkrta , observing the rules of sandhi or “euphonic combination.”

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼毗沙门天王（多闻天王）·俱吠滥·大王·太王！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Vaiśravaṇa, All-Hearing Guardian King, king of the Yakṣas, of Kubera, great king, very, to!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 555 has muktikālaṃkrta , observing the rules of sandhi or “euphonic combination.”

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼吉祥、圣德威光·广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, great (vocative invocation)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 555 has muktikālaṃkrta , observing the rules of sandhi or “euphonic combination.”

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 555 has muktikālaṃkrta , observing the rules of sandhi or “euphonic combination.”

verses.iast: tara tara turu turu vara vara, suśuddho suśuddho hana hana maṇikanaka vajravaidūrya
verses.meaningZh: 再三弯曲、超群，再三迅疾度脱一切危厄（都噜），再三殊胜、胜愿、妙好，再三报刊往外清净，再三击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），摩尼宝珠黄金，最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Crossing, surpassing, overcoming again and again, swiftly ferry across all perils! again and again, choicest, supreme boon, excellent again and again, press out + pure again and again, strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again, Maṇi jewel + gold, supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious & stainless purity free from dust
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 555 has muktikālaṃkrta , observing the rules of sandhi or “euphonic combination.”

verses.iast: muktika alaṃkṛta sarirāya sarvasatvānāṃ hitakāma vaiśravaṇa śriyadevīprabhāya ehi ehi māvilamba ghūrṇa ghūrṇa
verses.meaningZh: 无我大慈三昧·造作离相·真如实际，严，向湖饮料，诸一切众生、普皆有情之，口彩，毗沙门天王（多闻天王），本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，再三善来降临坛场（翳呬），勿搭拉，再三索索、滴溜溜
verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness, adornment, a lake + to, of all all sentient beings, well-wishing, Vaiśravaṇa, All-Hearing Guardian King, primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening (reverent offering), come forth, O Blessed One! again and again, do not + hanging down, moving to and fro, trembling, whirling again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 555 has muktikālaṃkrta , observing the rules of sandhi or “euphonic combination.”

verses.meaningZh: 再三他人之，施予饶益·施度调伏，我之（行者所有），无我大慈三昧·造作离相·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Of someone else again and again, granting (vocative invocation), my, of me (the practitioner), selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from karmic agency & beyond nominal designation
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 555 has muktikālaṃkrta , observing the rules of sandhi or “euphonic combination.”

verses.iast: darśanakāmasya darśanaṃ mama mana pralahadāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 观照希之，观照，我之（行者所有），自尊，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·离一切相无相，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: False + of wish, darśanaṃ, my, of me (the practitioner), pride, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from conditioned marks (reverent offering), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 555 has muktikālaṃkrta , observing the rules of sandhi or “euphonic combination.”

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：再三因缘空寂大乐·无我大慈三昧，再三造作离相·等虚空无碍·离一切相无相，虚空小鸟尊，生起不可得·尊胜·因缘空寂大乐·最上真言离言说，速度严，请摄取从中，具请摄取、遣除苦厄！尊，本性寂静止息·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，息灾、寂静、安隐，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·一切诸谛圆满，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！浣尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！转载浣尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！歌手尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！转载·蹩脚·在于，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！一切·压镇·所作·毘陀罗鬼·除断尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: causal emptiness & spiritual joy & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation) again and again, freedom from karmic agency & space-like boundlessness & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation) again and again, hole + O a bird, transcending birth & victorious & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), quickness, carry away ! remove! + from, O bearer of carry away (suffering)! remove! primordial tranquil peace & supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), peace, pacification, tranquility, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! O causing to wash, having washed, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! forward + O causing to wash, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! O belonging or peculiar to the Gandharvas, or a marriage without any ceremony, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! forward + lame + in, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! all + an evil demon + done + zombie + O removing, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 自如是宣说
verses.meaningEn: These mantra syllables cause all the deities to shear, eliminate, vanquish, and overcome all kākhordas, vetāḍas, medicinal herbs, mantras, poisons, and potions. Svāha !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Yongle and Peking Kangyurs read kyis (instrumental/agentive particle); Dege has kyi (genitive particle).

verses.iast: syād yathedam harigiśinakili ehere amare aṇḍare paṇḍare kaṭake keyūre hase hase hase khase khase khase kharaṅge marugahaṇe svāhā mumukṣa svāhā hile svāhā mile svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，犹如此，因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢·妙行趣入，此间风息尊，仙人、天神尊，离诸诤论无诤·息灭诤怨·清净离诸尘垢，第一义谛·离诸诤论无诤·息灭诤怨，腕环尊，璎珞尊，再三笑声尊，再三诸人尊，虚空颜料尊，无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢·妙行趣入，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！无我大慈三昧·造作离相·六度满行清净，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！因缘空寂大乐·离一切相无相，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！冥合融摄·无我大慈三昧，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — expansive quiescence, just as + this, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust & awakened spiritual movement (vocative invocation), here + O wind, O immortal, conflict-free peace & pacifying conflict & turmoil & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), ultimate truth & conflict-free peace & pacifying conflict & turmoil (vocative invocation), O ring / in ring, O a bracelet worn on the upper arm / in a bracelet worn on the upper arm, O laughter, mirth / in laughter, mirth again and again, O a degraded Kṣatriya again and again, hole + O colour, selfless great loving-kindness & stainless purity free from dust & awakened spiritual movement (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! causal emptiness & spiritual joy & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! uniting (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 63.a–87.b · 藏文名：སྟོང་ཆེན་མོ་རབ་ཏུ་འཇོམས་པ།

verses.iast: syād yathedam amṛte agrapuṣpe bahuphale nivāriṇi sarvārthasādhani aparājite varaṭe dharaṇi guhyāvarte gautame guptamati jambhani svāhā prajambhani svāha balaprabhañjani svāhā jaye svāhā vijaye svāhā jaye vijaye svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，犹如此，甘露、不死妙法尊，尊花尊，多果尊，在于具人群，一切义利成就法，无能胜、不可摧伏尊，种类胡蜂、胡蜂尊，大地，密绕尊，瞿昙，维持暗，令愚尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！转载令愚尊，自如是宣说，力风息，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！胜伏、最胜吉祥！尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！最胜尊胜、普胜一切！尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！胜伏、最胜吉祥！尊，最胜尊胜、普胜一切！尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — expansive quiescence, just as + this, O ambrosia, nectar of immortality / in ambrosia, nectar of immortality, first + O flower, many + O direct effect, in + O bearer of crowd, all aims and benefits + O accomplishing, O invincible, unconquered / in invincible, unconquered, O a kind of wasp, the earth, hidden or covered + O circumambulate, O descending from Gotama, keep + dark, O crushing, destroying, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! forward + O crushing, own + spoke, power + O wind, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! O conquer! victory! / in conquer! victory! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! O supreme victory! triumph! / in supreme victory! triumph! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! O conquer! victory! / in conquer! victory! O supreme victory! triumph! / in supreme victory! triumph! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 63.a–87.b · 藏文名：སྟོང་ཆེན་མོ་རབ་ཏུ་འཇོམས་པ།

verses.iast: syād yathedaṃ bodhi bodhi mahābodhi bodhanumate phalini bahuphale śikṣa śikṣa sāravate sāgali durāsade dūrāgame śūraprāpte śūravate bhage bhagavate bhāgini nivāriṇi svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，犹如此，再三菩提、无上正觉，大菩提，菩提觉知·解脱系缚大力，方位水果尊，多果尊，再三本性寂静止息·造作离相·六度满行清净，坚硬因素尊，有罪罪行蜜蜂，难敬，远传，勇得尊，勇鸣呼尊，才尊，向世尊（薄伽梵）致敬，破有相福德光·妙行趣入·离名相假立，在于具人群，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — expansive quiescence, just as + this, Bodhi, awakening, enlightenment again and again, great + Bodhi, awakening (vocative invocation), O bearing fruit, many + O direct effect, primordial tranquil peace & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās again and again, O solid element, guilty of a crime + bee, O difficult to be approached or met, unaccessible, impracticable, unheard of / in difficult to be approached or met, unaccessible, impracticable, unheard of, distant + O traditional, bold + O filled with astonishment and wonder, bold, O excellence / in excellence, to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, blessedness transcending existence & awakened spiritual movement & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), in + O bearer of crowd, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 63.a–87.b · 藏文名：སྟོང་ཆེན་མོ་རབ་ཏུ་འཇོམས་པ།

verses.meaningZh: 陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，犹如此，需要次第尊，超尊，部多鬼神音尊，昂·彼·趣往，炽燃、摧灭尊，驮请执持，驮阿婆罗尊，酪在于，埋难迥遮，经过·经过·于我，再三虚空虚空，趣入通行·一切诸谛圆满，月轮、清凉满月尊，嚣尊，因缘空寂大乐·离一切相无相·无我大慈三昧，耕，具胸严尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — expansive quiescence, just as + this, O want of order, O surpass / in surpass, spirit + O sound, arise + him + O going to or in, O burning, consuming, destroying, dha + O hold! bear! sustain! dha + O lower, giving + in, bury + O flax, of course + of course + to me, hole + hole again and again, going toward (vocative invocation), O moon, lunar disc / in moon, lunar disc, O inconsiderate / in inconsiderate, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & freedom from conditioned marks & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), O plough / in plough, O bearer of clump, mass, thicket, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 63.a–87.b · 藏文名：སྟོང་ཆེན་མོ་རབ་ཏུ་འཇོམས་པ།

verses.meaningZh: 陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，犹如此，虚空·虚空·于我，再三虚空虚空，经过·经过·于我，再三正勤尊，本性寂静止息·因缘空寂大乐·无我大慈三昧，再三正勤尊，再三吉祥安隐、善妙无恙，我之（行者所有），寂静、调柔安稳尊，心坚从中
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — expansive quiescence, just as + this, hole + hole + to me, hole + hole again and again, of course + of course + to me, O endeavour, effort / in endeavour, effort again and again, primordial tranquil peace & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), O endeavour, effort / in endeavour, effort again and again, well-being, fortune, auspicious safety again and again, my, of me (the practitioner), O peaceful, calm, tranquil / in peaceful, calm, tranquil, maina + from
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 63.a–87.b · 藏文名：སྟོང་ཆེན་མོ་རབ་ཏུ་འཇོམས་པ།

verses.meaningZh: 陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，犹如此，精神忧苦尊，羯罗蓝，力在于，能作成办·造作离相，衍伸出，妙行趣入·离名相假立，一切诸谛圆满·造作离相·清净离诸尘垢，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — expansive quiescence, just as + this, drive + O not-joy, O kalala / in kalala, power + in, making, spawn + O income, awakened spiritual movement & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: Tadyathā akaṭe vikaṭe hariṇi hāriṇi dharaṇi dhāraṇi hukke hukke vukke vukke. hana hana hana hana hana hana hana hana hana hana my enemies
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：造作离相·断除憍慢执障，巨大、怪异尊，具请摄取、遣除苦厄！尊，具胸严尊，大地，陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义）尊，再三因缘空寂大乐·造作离相，再三肾脏尊，再三击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），离名相假立·无我大慈三昧·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: freedom from karmic agency & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation), O exceeding the usual measure, huge, monstrous, hideous, wicked, bad, O bearer of carry away (suffering)! remove! O bearer of clump, mass, thicket, the earth, O Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation) again and again, O kidney / in kidney again and again, strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, beyond nominal designation & selfless great loving-kindness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Within the Tibetan transliteration of this vidyā, the phrase amitrān mama (“my enemies”) is translated into Tibetan with bdag gi mi mdza' ba rnam . The term hana means “kill.”

verses.meaningEn: Causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — primordial non-arising again and again, cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation), transcending birth & victorious & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation) again and again, generosity & self-mastery & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, beyond nominal designation & selfless great loving-kindness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness

verses.meaningZh: 再三鼓动法水涤除罪垢（主嚧），再三定慧摄持、心无散乱（希利），再三契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利），再三妙果圆成·清净离诸尘垢，再三觉知警策妙音（唧置），施度调伏·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），离名相假立·无我大慈三昧·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: Stir the purifying waters of compassion! again and again, meditative absorption & steadfast mindfulness again and again, intimate union with the deity samādhi again and again, fruition of enlightenment & stainless purity free from dust (imperative seal) again and again, awakening mindfulness mantra-pada again and again, generosity & self-mastery & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, beyond nominal designation & selfless great loving-kindness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：As above, the phrase śatrūn mama is translated into Tibetan. And, as above, the verb naśaya is given in transliterated Sanskrit but has been translated here for clarity.

verses.meaningZh: 因缘空寂大乐·造作离相，无我大慈三昧·造作离相，黏腻实物，施度调伏·造作离相，妙祥，最极吉祥、致福清净尊，普贤菩萨（遍吉）尊，金胎神尊，一切义利成就法，无垢、离染清净尊，妙莲华、红莲尊，毘磨利，月轮、清凉满月尊，月光尊，日轮、太阳光明尊，水晶尊，一样尊，施度调伏·无我大慈三昧，施度调伏·无我大慈三昧·解脱系缚大力，施度调伏·无我大慈三昧·解脱系缚大力，能作成办·第一义谛
verses.meaningEn: Causal emptiness & spiritual joy & freedom from karmic agency, selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from karmic agency, sticky matter, generosity & self-mastery & freedom from karmic agency, śrībhadre, O auspicious, bringing felicity / in auspicious, bringing felicity, O Samantabhadra, Universally Worthy Bodhisattva / in Samantabhadra, Universally Worthy Bodhisattva, O Spirit Born from a Golden Egg / in Spirit Born from a Golden Egg, all aims and benefits + O accomplishing, O stainless, spotless, pure / in stainless, spotless, pure, O lotus blossom / in lotus blossom, pure, O moon, lunar disc / in moon, lunar disc, O moon-like, O sun, solar orb / in sun, solar orb, O the sun-stone / in the sun-stone, O the same / in the same, generosity & self-mastery & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), generosity & self-mastery & selfless great loving-kindness & spiritual strength freeing bonds (vocative invocation), generosity & self-mastery & selfless great loving-kindness & spiritual strength freeing bonds (vocative invocation), making (vocative invocation)

verses.iast: Tadyathā hare khare khure male mile mūle madenti matte maṇḍitike hulu hulu
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：唯愿救苦圣尊（诃利，凶尊，蹄尊，垢染、尘垢瑕疵尊，冥合融摄·无我大慈三昧，以下，无我大慈三昧·施度调伏·离名相假立，贡高尊，无我大慈三昧·离诸诤论无诤·息灭诤怨，再三威猛速疾摄护除灾（呼嚧）
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: O Hari / Remover of Suffering! O harsh, rough, sharp, piercing, O razor / in razor, O stain, impurity, defilement / in stain, impurity, defilement, uniting (vocative invocation), at the door, selfless great loving-kindness & generosity & self-mastery & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), O intoxicated, drunk , excited, in rut / in intoxicated, drunk , excited, in rut, selfless great loving-kindness & conflict-free peace & pacifying conflict & turmoil (vocative invocation), swiftly protect and sweep away calamity! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud, pha), folios 87.b–117.a · 藏文名：རིག་སྔགས་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་མོ་རྨ་བྱ་ཆེན་མོ།

verses.iast: hulu hulu hulu hulu hulu hulu hulu hulu lu lu lu lu
verses.meaningZh: 再三威猛速疾摄护除灾（呼嚧），再三攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·损减除灭忧苦）
verses.meaningEn: Swiftly protect and sweep away calamity! again and again, freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — dispelling sorrow again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud, pha), folios 87.b–117.a · 藏文名：རིག་སྔགས་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་མོ་རྨ་བྱ་ཆེན་མོ།

verses.iast: meḍi meḍi meḍi meḍi siddhi siddhi siddhi siddhi svāhā !
verses.meaningZh: 再三簌簌，再三悉地、妙成就，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Crackling, rustling again and again, Siddhi, spiritual accomplishment/perfection again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud, pha), folios 87.b–117.a · 藏文名：རིག་སྔགས་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་མོ་རྨ་བྱ་ཆེན་མོ།

verses.meaningZh: 再三吉祥安隐、善妙无恙
verses.meaningEn: Well-being, fortune, auspicious safety again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud, pha), folios 87.b–117.a · 藏文名：རིག་སྔགས་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་མོ་རྨ་བྱ་ཆེན་མོ།

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: Tadyathā hili hili hili hili mili mili mili mili mili mili mili
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：再三定慧摄持、心无散乱（希利），再三契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利）
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: meditative absorption & steadfast mindfulness again and again, intimate union with the deity samādhi again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Sanskrit has ten repetitions of hili .

verses.iast: mili mili mili huru huru huru huru huru huru huru huru huru
verses.meaningZh: 再三契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利），再三疾速拔济除障（虎噜）
verses.meaningEn: Intimate union with the deity samādhi again and again, swiftly rescue and dispel all afflictions! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Sanskrit has ten repetitions of hili .

verses.iast: huru ciṭi ciṭi ciṭi ciṭi ciṭi ciṭi ciṭi ciṭi ciṭi ciṭi hikke
verses.meaningZh: 疾速拔济除障（虎噜），再三觉知警策妙音（唧置），饑寒嗝尊
verses.meaningEn: Swiftly rescue and dispel all afflictions! awakening mindfulness mantra-pada again and again, O sobbing / in sobbing
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Sanskrit has ten repetitions of hili .

verses.iast: hikke hikke hikke haḍa havaṭo vakṣe vakṣe vakṣe hora hora dhara dhara
verses.meaningZh: 再三饑寒嗝尊，因缘空寂大乐·息灭诤怨，因缘空寂大乐·最上真言离言说·断除憍慢执障，再三火焰尊，再三因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢，再三请执持、总持护念！
verses.meaningEn: O sobbing / in sobbing again and again, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & pacifying conflict & turmoil, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & supreme ineffable speech & cutting rigid pride, O flame / in flame again and again, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust again and again, hold! bear! sustain! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Sanskrit has ten repetitions of hili .

verses.iast: hara hara cala cala culu culu svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 再三请摄取、遣除苦厄！再三震动警觉、破除昏沉（左攞），再三鼓动法水涤除罪垢（主嚧），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Carry away (suffering)! remove! again and again, stir awake and shake off delusion! again and again, stir the purifying waters of compassion! again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Sanskrit has ten repetitions of hili .

verses.iast: Tadyathā araḍe karaḍe made madavardhani abare śabare ture ture cure cure śabare
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：清净离诸尘垢·息灭诤怨，能作成办·造作离相，傲，傲兴盛尊，解脱系缚大力·清净离诸尘垢，山行，再三迅疾、踊跃尊，再三妙行迁变空·清净离诸尘垢，山行
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: stainless purity free from dust & pacifying conflict & turmoil (vocative invocation), making (vocative invocation), O excitement, inspiration, enthusiasm, intoxication, ardent passion, lust, rut, the rut / in excitement, inspiration, enthusiasm, intoxication, ardent passion, lust, rut, the rut, excitement + O increasing, spiritual strength freeing bonds & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), O of a people / in of a people, O quick, eager, prompt, willing / in quick, eager, prompt, willing again and again, awakened conduct beyond flux & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation) again and again, O of a people / in of a people
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The Sanskrit has the following mantra: araḍe karaḍe maraḍe madavardhane avaśabare ture ture care care śabare parṇaśabare hucu hucu kuci kuci muci muci huci huci huci huci huci huci huci muci muci muci muci svāhā .

verses.iast: parṇaśabare huci huci muci muci svāhā !
verses.meaningZh: 叶衣佛母（除疫山林母）尊，再三因缘空寂大乐·妙行迁变空，再三舍，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: O Parṇaśabarī, Leaf-Clad Healing Goddess / in Parṇaśabarī, Leaf-Clad Healing Goddess, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & awakened conduct beyond flux (vocative invocation) again and again, muci again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The Sanskrit has the following mantra: araḍe karaḍe maraḍe madavardhane avaśabare ture ture care care śabare parṇaśabare hucu hucu kuci kuci muci muci huci huci huci huci huci huci huci muci muci muci muci svāhā .

verses.iast: dumbe dodumbe hili hili kuci kuci muci muci svāhā !

verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery & selfless great loving-kindness & spiritual strength freeing bonds (vocative invocation), generosity & self-mastery & selfless great loving-kindness & spiritual strength freeing bonds (vocative invocation), meditative absorption & steadfast mindfulness again and again, O the female breast again and again, muci again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: Uṣṭigini surapate varti vajra vajra vajra vajra vajra vajrapataye svāhā !
verses.meaningZh: 六度满行清净·断除憍慢执障·妙行趣入，报刊往外絮叨，余下、卧式尊，再三金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），向金刚君，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Perfection of the six pāramitās & cutting rigid pride & awakened spiritual movement (vocative invocation), press out + chatter, O staying, remaining, lying, situated in , engaged in or occupied with , proceeding wit, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt again and again, Vajra + to prince, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: Tadyathā jvala jvalana tapa tapana matha mathana dhama dhamana sara saraṇa kiṭi
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞），炽燃、炽盛，暖气、炽燃，盒子、篮子，摧碎魔军与我慢烦恼（末他），钻，法界总持任持·无我大慈三昧，他麻南，流注周遍、速行护念（萨啰），有诤，造作离相·断除憍慢执障
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: blaze forth with wisdom radiance! burning, flaming, combustible, heating, burning, tormenting, box, churn and crush demonic hindrances! afflicting, injuring, destroying, Dharma-realm retention & selfless great loving-kindness, blowing away, scaring, flow forth and pervade with blessing! affected by impurity, passion, depravity, freedom from karmic agency & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud, pha), folios 87.b–117.a · 藏文名：རིག་སྔགས་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་མོ་རྨ་བྱ་ཆེན་མོ།

verses.iast: kiṭi kuṭi kuṭi muṭi muṭi miṭi miṭi piṭi piṭi sara sara mara
verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·断除憍慢执障，再三庵，再三篮子、袋子尊，再三无我大慈三昧·断除憍慢执障，再三篮子、积集尊，再三流注周遍、速行护念（萨啰），临危、死厄
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation), cottage again and again, O ‘a large measure of grain’ again and again, selfless great loving-kindness & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation) again and again, O basket again and again, flow forth and pervade with blessing! again and again, dying, death
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud, pha), folios 87.b–117.a · 藏文名：རིག་སྔགས་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་མོ་རྨ་བྱ་ཆེན་མོ།

verses.iast: mara hara hara tara tara tiri tiri ṭā ṭā ṭā ṭā ṭā
verses.meaningZh: 临危、死厄，再三请摄取、遣除苦厄！再三弯曲、超群，再三真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，再三吒字门（断除憍慢执障（ṭaṅka）·远离寂静周遍）
verses.meaningEn: Dying, death, carry away (suffering)! remove! again and again, crossing, surpassing, overcoming again and again, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation) again and again, cutting rigid pride (ṭaṅka) — expansive quiescence again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud, pha), folios 87.b–117.a · 藏文名：རིག་སྔགས་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་མོ་རྨ་བྱ་ཆེན་མོ།

verses.iast: dā dā dā dā dā vā vā vā vā vā hala hala
verses.meaningZh: 再三陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，再三或、抑或，再三耕
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — expansive quiescence again and again, or again and again, plough again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud, pha), folios 87.b–117.a · 藏文名：རིག་སྔགས་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་མོ་རྨ་བྱ་ཆེན་མོ།

verses.iast: hala hala hala siddhi siddhi siddhi siddhi siddhi svasti svasti svasti svasti
verses.meaningZh: 再三耕，再三悉地、妙成就，再三吉祥安隐、善妙无恙
verses.meaningEn: Plough again and again, Siddhi, spiritual accomplishment/perfection again and again, well-being, fortune, auspicious safety again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud, pha), folios 87.b–117.a · 藏文名：རིག་སྔགས་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་མོ་རྨ་བྱ་ཆེན་མོ།

verses.meaningZh: 吉祥安隐、善妙无恙
verses.meaningEn: Well-being, fortune, auspicious safety
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud, pha), folios 87.b–117.a · 藏文名：རིག་སྔགས་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་མོ་རྨ་བྱ་ཆེན་མོ།

verses.iast: Tadyathā hiri hiri khiri khiri miri miri phuri phuri suri suri hili
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：再三乐队、斑纹尊，再三等虚空无碍·清净离诸尘垢，再三慈愍覆护一切有情（弭哩），再三妙果圆成·清净离诸尘垢，再三光明善妙、天妙清净！定慧摄持、心无散乱（希利）
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: O band, stripe again and again, space-like boundlessness & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation) again and again, compassionate shelter & soothing grace again and again, fruition of enlightenment & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation) again and again, luminous, celestial purity! again and again, meditative absorption & steadfast mindfulness
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud, pha), folios 87.b–117.a · 藏文名：རིག་སྔགས་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་མོ་རྨ་བྱ་ཆེན་མོ།

verses.iast: hili mili mili siri siri ḍaphu ḍaphu ḍaḍaphu grasani mathani damani dahani
verses.meaningZh: 定慧摄持、心无散乱（希利），再三契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利），再三吉祥福德流注庄严（悉哩，再三息灭诤怨·妙果圆成，息灭诤怨·妙果圆成，妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢·一切诸谛圆满，钻，要胁、调御士马匹尊，炽燃、摧灭尊
verses.meaningEn: Meditative absorption & steadfast mindfulness, intimate union with the deity samādhi again and again, auspicious Śrī fortune & sacred grace again and again, pacifying conflict & turmoil & fruition of enlightenment (imperative seal) again and again, pacifying conflict & turmoil & fruition of enlightenment (imperative seal), awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (vocative invocation), O afflicting, injuring, destroying, O taming, controlling, chastising, O burning, consuming, destroying
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud, pha), folios 87.b–117.a · 藏文名：རིག་སྔགས་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་མོ་རྨ་བྱ་ཆེན་མོ།

verses.iast: ghātani pacani pācani tapani tāpani hanani dahani dāhani dahā dahā dahā dala
verses.meaningZh: 杀害、种类伽驮棒尊，烹调尊，工具烹调、木头尊，盒子、篮子尊，炎热尊，已杀尊，炽燃、摧灭尊，炽燃，再三智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺），碎块、份额
verses.meaningEn: O killing, murder, O cooking, roasting, O means of cooking, O box, O heating, burning, distressing, illumining, O striking down, killing, destroying, O burning, consuming, destroying, burning, incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! again and again, a piece split off, fragment, portion
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud, pha), folios 87.b–117.a · 藏文名：རིག་སྔགས་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་མོ་རྨ་བྱ་ཆེན་མོ།

verses.iast: dala dālani pāṭani mohani stambhani jambhani svayambhu svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 碎块、份额，裂解、刺骨尊，散乱，作昏尊，僵仆尊，令愚尊，一切诸谛圆满·最上真言离言说·一乘如实之道，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: A piece split off, fragment, portion, O splitting, piercing, O splitting, tearing asunder, O stupefying, perplexing, deceiving, O laming, paralyzing, fixing, stopping, restraining, O crushing, destroying, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme ineffable speech & supreme vehicle of awakening (imperative seal), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud, pha), folios 87.b–117.a · 藏文名：རིག་སྔགས་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་མོ་རྨ་བྱ་ཆེན་མོ།

verses.meaningZh: 杀害、种类伽驮棒尊，烹调尊，工具烹调、木头尊，盒子、篮子尊，炎热尊，已杀尊，再三炽燃，再三智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺），碎块、份额
verses.meaningEn: O killing, murder, O cooking, roasting, O means of cooking, O box, O heating, burning, distressing, illumining, O striking down, killing, destroying, burning again and again, incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! again and again, a piece split off, fragment, portion
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud, pha), folios 87.b–117.a · 藏文名：རིག་སྔགས་ཀྱི་རྒྱལ་མོ་རྨ་བྱ་ཆེན་མོ།

verses.meaningZh: 碎块、份额，裂解、刺骨尊，散乱，作昏尊，僵仆尊，令愚尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: A piece split off, fragment, portion, O splitting, piercing, O splitting, tearing asunder, O stupefying, perplexing, deceiving, O laming, paralyzing, fixing, stopping, restraining, O crushing, destroying, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: Ciri ciri viri viri dhiri dhiri vigatāvaraṇe viśodhane vividhāvaraṇavināśani muri muri muci
verses.meaningZh: 再三久远常恒护持不退（唧哩），再三最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，再三禅定坚固总持不失（地利），离障蔽，闢理由，能灭除闢服务天神障蔽，再三清净解脱、无碍妙音！舍
verses.meaningEn: Enduring steadfast protection & mindfulness again and again, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation) again and again, steadfast meditative retention (dhṛti) again and again, lost + O obscuration, settle + O also means of purification, settle + serve a god + O destroyer of obscuration, pure release, unobstructed grace! again and again, muci
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 117.b–138.b · 藏文名：སོ་སོར་འབྲང་བ་ཆེན་མོ།

verses.iast: muci muli muli cili cili kili kili mili mili kamale vimale jaye
verses.meaningZh: 舍，再三无我大慈三昧·离一切相无相，再三积集一切白净善法功德（唧哩），再三金刚橛威神警觉、摧伏魔军（吉栗），再三契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利），妙莲华、红莲尊，毘磨利，胜伏、最胜吉祥！尊
verses.meaningEn: Muci, selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation) again and again, gathering pure Dharmic merits & radiance again and again, vajra-kīla transfixing obstacles & awakening again and again, intimate union with the deity samādhi again and again, O lotus blossom / in lotus blossom, pure, O conquer! victory! / in conquer! victory!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 117.b–138.b · 藏文名：སོ་སོར་འབྲང་བ་ཆེན་མོ།

verses.meaningZh: 最胜尊胜、普胜一切！尊，最胜尊胜·鸿毛·呼唤圣尊叹词，具足胜伏、最胜吉祥！尊，具足异尊
verses.meaningEn: O supreme victory! triumph! / in supreme victory! triumph! supreme victory! triumph! + down + O! Hail! Vocative invocation particle, O one endowed with conquer! victory! O one endowed with distinction, difference, special property, peculiarity
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 117.b–138.b · 藏文名：སོ་སོར་འབྲང་བ་ཆེན་མོ།

provenance.rawSnippet: Oṃ dhuru dhuru svāhā turu turu svāhā muru muru svāhā hana hana sarvaśatrūn svāhā daha daha sarvaduṣṭānāṃ svāhā paca paca sarvapratyarthikapratyamitrānāṃ svāhā

verses.iast: Oṃ dhuru dhuru svāhā turu turu svāhā muru muru svāhā hana hana
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三坚固任持总持法印（度噜），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！再三迅疾度脱一切危厄（都噜），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！再三速疾摧碎烦恼结缚（亩噜），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！再三击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! firmly uphold the dhāraṇī seal! again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! swiftly ferry across all perils! again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! swiftly dissolve karmic knots & obstacles! again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 117.b–138.b · 藏文名：སོ་སོར་འབྲང་བ་ཆེན་མོ།

verses.iast: sarvaśatrūn svāhā daha daha sarvaduṣṭānāṃ svāhā paca paca sarvapratyarthikapratyamitrānāṃ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！再三智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺），一切诸暴恶者，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！再三成熟善根、烧尽业障（跛左），一切·回犯·诸冤家之，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! again and again, all + of all wicked, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! ripen merit and burn away karmic obstructions! again and again, all + enemy, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 117.b–138.b · 藏文名：སོ་སོར་འབྲང་བ་ཆེན་མོ།

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！甘露、不死妙法尊，甘露殊胜，再三殊胜、胜愿、妙好尊，最妙尊，最极清净、究竟净除尊，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！

O ambrosia, nectar of immortality / in ambrosia, nectar of immortality, ambrosia + O choicest, O choicest, supreme boon, excellent / in choicest, supreme boon, excellent again and again, O cover, upper garment / in cover, upper garment, O completely purified, supremely pure / in completely purified, supremely pure, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！再三宝山王安住不动、高胜摄护，再三具歌咏、歌手尊，具足宝山王安住不动、高胜摄护尊，具足功德、殊胜妙德尊，具足虚空界（无碍周遍）尊，虚空界最极清净，一切·罪业·离，虚空界（无碍周遍）尊，穹苍尊，虚空界具伺尊，炽盛燃耀山尖，摩尼宝珠·企求解脱·宝嵌·头冠首严三尖·请执持，报刊往外发尊，报刊往外面目，妙眼尊，真金、妙金色尊，真金娇吠哩尊，过去尊，离名相假立·真如实际·第一义谛，末尊，现在时，归命，湖相，没驮南，炽燃放光·生起不可得·尊胜，佛陀、觉者尊，报刊往外佛陀，世尊佛母！（呼格），报刊往外卫尊，良好安全性尊，好看、英俊尊，报刊往外柔善尊，报刊往外低调，殊胜、胜愿、妙好尊，向幅度汝，世尊佛母！（呼格），具足贤尊，贤尊，善哉、善见尊，毘磨利，胜伏贤尊，转载威猛，威猛、暴烈除障尊，再三转载威猛，金刚威猛，再三大威猛，威怖、猛厉降魔尊，诸人，破暗合集·清净离诸尘垢，贼盗尊，下贱种，下贱种，光明、显色尊，屠家尊，善心、人情，再三本性寂静止息·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，作乐尊，施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧，施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧，具黑心，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，义利成就法，再三击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，再三智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺），一切暴恶者，饿鬼·毗舍遮·诸荼吉尼之，人诸非人之以及再三成熟善根、烧尽业障（跛左），愧划分
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! steadfast sacred mountain peak again and again, O bearer of singing, singer again and again, O one endowed with steadfast sacred mountain peak, O one endowed with virtue, excellence, auspicious quality, O one endowed with space, ether, open sky, space + O completely purified, all + evil + O lost, O space, ether, open sky / in space, ether, open sky, O celestial vault, firmament / in celestial vault, firmament, space + O bearer of proceeding, blazing + O peaked, Maṇi jewel + desirous of emancipation + glittering + head + O hold! bear! sustain! press out + O hair, press out + O meters, O marvelous eye / in marvelous eye, O gold, golden-colored / in gold, golden-colored, gold + O Gauri, O gone away, passed, dead, beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness & ultimate truth (vocative invocation), O future / in future, O present, homage to a lake + work, buddhānām, blazing, O Buddha, the Awakened One / in Buddha, the Awakened One, press out + O Buddha, O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! press out + O guard, O good security, time of peace / in good security, time of peace, O good-looking, handsome, beautiful / in good-looking, handsome, beautiful, press out + O or house, press out + O tamed, O choicest, supreme boon, excellent / in choicest, supreme boon, excellent, width + to Thee, O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! O one endowed with blessed, O blessed, O excellent, beautiful, auspicious, fortunate, pure, conquer! victory! + O blessed, forward + O fierce, O fierce, ardent, wrathful / in fierce, ardent, wrathful, forward + O fierce again and again, Vajra + O fierce, great + O fierce again and again, O formidable, terrific, awe-inspiring, of a people, dissolving dense ignorance & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), O thief, robber, O a Candala or outcast, O elephant, greatest or best of, O light, brightness, colour, O a mixed caste, benevolence, favour, primordial tranquil peace & supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation) again and again, O Sankara, generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), O bearer of relating to Rudra or the Rudras, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), meaning + O accomplishing, strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! again and again, all + wicked, Preta + Piśāca + of Ḍākinī, person + of a non-human and ripen merit and burn away karmic obstructions! again and again, Modesty + divide

verses.iast: namaḥ sarvabuddhabodhisatvebhyaḥ tadyathā oṃ ālo kālo tālo sacchalo saṃpamūrti rakṣa rakṣa māṃ sarvabhayeṣu svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 归命向诸一切佛陀菩提萨埵，即说咒曰：嗡！衍伸、刻毒实物，时，七多罗树，奸滑，一切诸谛圆满·第一义谛·无我大慈三昧，祈请再三拥护、守护于我，于诸一切怖畏，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all + Buddha + to all Bodhisattva, Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! spawn, venomous matter, kālo, tālo, deceitful, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & ultimate truth & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), evermore protect, guard and shelter me, all + among, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：D reads saM pa mUr+ti , S reads sarba mUrd+hi , and N E 1480/9 reads sampra [?] muñcaṭi . This transliteration is based on the reading in D, but the readings in the Tibetan witnesses appear to be corrupted. The tentative reading sampramuñcati in N E 1480/9 might be translated “sets [them] free” (Skt. sampramuñcati ). Mārīcī herself is most likely the implied subject of this verb, but because it is not clear what the opening terms ālo , kālo , and tālo mean, it is not in fact possible to determine the correct subject and object related to this verb with any degree of certainty.

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！不过逮捕七多罗树，演说小溪，殊胜小溪，野猪面门，一切·暴恶者·诸败坏，疙瘩、束缚，我结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! only apprehend + O palm-tree, speaking + small ditch, choicest + small ditch, boar + O face, all + wicked + of all corrupt, knot, tie, joint, I bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Following S ba rA ha mu khi , and N E 1480/9 reads varāhamukhi . D reads bA rA hA mu khi .

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！向摩利支天菩萨（阳焰威光佛母），再三震动警觉、破除昏沉（左攞），再三场景往外、一品离港，趣入通行·本性寂静止息，第一义谛·离一切相无相，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! to Mārīcī, Goddess of Dawn Rays, stir awake and shake off delusion! again and again, setting out again and again, going toward (vocative invocation), ultimate truth & freedom from conditioned marks, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！不过逮捕七多罗树，演说小溪，殊胜小溪，野猪面门，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·破有相福德光，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! only apprehend + O palm-tree, speaking + small ditch, choicest + small ditch, boar + O face, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & blessedness transcending existence, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: oṃ ehy ehi mahābhūtadeva dvijaṛṣisattama parigṛhītvā āhuti mahārasmin sannihito bhava
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！善来（连音式：迎请圣尊速降）！善来降临坛场（翳呬），四大天人，再生·仙人·最好，般在家人已，圣供、护摩供，大于此之中，赢得潜在，愿成、善住
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! come! approach! come forth, O Blessed One! the four great seeds + god, twice-born + Ṛṣi + the best, wisdom + having become a house or habitation, offering, oblation, great + in this, win + laid, be! become!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 158.b–165.b. · 藏文名：སྒྱུ་མའི་འོད་ཟེར་ཅན་འབྱུང་བའི་རྒྱུད་ལས་ཕྱུང་བའི་རྟོག་པའི་རྒྱལ་པོ།

verses.iast: oṃ agnaye dīvyadīpya āviśa mahāśriye havyakavyavāhanāya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！向圣火、智火（火大），施度调伏·最上真言离言说·一乘如实之道，最上真言离言说·本性寂静止息，大广大光华尊，向护摩供婆喝那，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! to fire, sacred flame (Agni), generosity & self-mastery & supreme ineffable speech & supreme vehicle of awakening, supreme ineffable speech & primordial tranquil peace, great + O with great magnificence, sgl + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：D reads hA bya kA bya vA ha nA ya , S reads ha pya ka pya vA ha nA ya , and N E 1480/9 reads havyakavyavāhānāya . This transliteration emends the reading hA bya kA bya in D to havyakavya , based on the reading in N E 1480/9 . This emended reading reflects the correct spelling of this compound describing Agni as the “vehicle” ( vāhana ) for “oblations to the ancestors” ( havyakavya ).

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！奸滑，一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! deceitful, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & stainless purity free from dust, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Following D sa ma sa mU ra tI . S reads sarb+ba mU rti , and N E 1480/9 omits. Although this transliteration follows the reading in D—the meaning of which is not clear and which is likely corrupt—this same phrase has been rendered as sarvasattvamudrati (“she who delights all beings”) in the Sarnath Sanskrit edition of The Mārīcī Dhāraṇī (Toh 564, ), and it is possible that this is the preferred reading here as well. The reading in S might tentatively be translated “she who is an embodiment of all.”

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! come! approach! come forth, O Blessed One! the four great seeds + god + assembly, Ṛṣi + a Brahman, having become a house or habitation, offering, oblation, tower, in this, win + laid, be! become! Oṃ!

verses.meaningEn: To fire, sacred flame (Agni), three + pha + three, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! supreme ineffable speech & primordial tranquil peace again and again, great + O with great magnificence, sgl + to, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: oṃ vaṃ yaṃ raṃ vaṃ maṃ mā me paśyantu sattvā antardhānamasi svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！金刚界大日智法身水轮甘露种子，风大自在除障种子，火大清净智火种子（焚尽罪垢），金刚界大日智法身水轮甘露种子，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），勿、莫令，于我、为我，愿悉了知、聪明，器物盘子已，灭汝即是，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Vajradhātu Mahāvairocana ambrosia seed syllable, Vāyu wind-mandala swiftness seed syllable, Agni wisdom-fire purifying seed syllable, Vajradhātu Mahāvairocana ambrosia seed syllable, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, do not, let not, to me, my, may they looking, knowing, intelligent! having a vessel or dish, Thou art, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Following N E 1480/9 mā me paśyantu satvā , meaning “may beings not see me.” The reading in the Tibetan witnesses appears to be a corruption of this phrase—D and S read ma me pA shAM tu sta swA hA , and Y and K read ma me pA shAM stu swA hA .

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！最上真言离言说·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! supreme ineffable speech & ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Following D and S bi pa ri ma si . N E 1480/9 reads cīramasi [?]. Though this transliteration follows the reading in D and S, this is the only time that the name of this vidyā goddess appears in any of the works devoted to Mārīcī in the Kangyur witnesses. If we follow the (somewhat) standard sequence of these vidyās that is established in The Mārīcī Dhāraṇī (Toh 564), The King of Ritual Manuals from the Tantra of Māyā Mārīcī's Arising (Toh 565), and elsewhere in this text, it is likely that this vidyā should read cīvaramasi . N E 1480/9 is unfortunately not helpful here.

verses.iast: oṃ mārīcyai vipulavare nāge nāgahṛdaya badha jvala jvala sarvanāgahṛdayaṃ kīla nāgakulayavatisvani hana
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！向摩利支天菩萨（阳焰威光佛母），广大殊胜，龙族、大龙王尊，龙族心，杀，再三炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞），一切·龙族·心，杵，离名相假立·妙行趣入·造作离相，击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! to Mārīcī, Goddess of Dawn Rays, vast + O choicest, O Nāga, dragon/serpent deity / in Nāga, dragon/serpent deity, Nāga + heart, badha, blaze forth with wisdom radiance! again and again, all + Nāga, a pointed piece of wood, beyond nominal designation & awakened spiritual movement & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation), strike down afflictions and mara-forces!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Following D and S bi pu la ba re na ge . N E 1480/9 reads vipule pravare nāge , which is most likely the preferred reading.

verses.iast: hana sarvaduṣṭa nāgahṛdayāni daha daha sarvaduṣṭa nāgabhavanāni paca paca pacaya pacaya sarvaduṣṭa
verses.meaningZh: 击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），一切暴恶者，龙族一切心，再三智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺），一切暴恶者，龙族一切住埸，再三成熟善根、烧尽业障（跛左），再三成熟善根、烧尽业障（跛左），一切暴恶者
verses.meaningEn: Strike down afflictions and mara-forces! all + wicked, Nāga + heart, incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! again and again, all + wicked, Nāga + coming into existence, ripen merit and burn away karmic obstructions! again and again, may You ripen merit and burn away karmic obstructions!! again and again, all + wicked
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Following D and S bi pu la ba re na ge . N E 1480/9 reads vipule pravare nāge , which is most likely the preferred reading.

verses.iast: nāgāni akrama akrama sarvamudrāsāgaranirmale vikrama vikrama mahānāgatejavare svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 一切龙族、大龙王，再三需要次第，一切·手印·大海·净无垢秽，再三超，善良·威光·阿婆罗尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Nāga, dragon/serpent deity (plural), want of order again and again, all + Mudrā + ocean + O utterly spotless, surpass again and again, great serpent or elephant + radiance + O lower, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Following D and S bi pu la ba re na ge . N E 1480/9 reads vipule pravare nāge , which is most likely the preferred reading.

verses.meaningZh: 归命向佛法僧三宝，即说咒曰：嗡！清净离诸尘垢·离一切相无相，耕女孩子，奸滑，一切尊身，祈请再三拥护、守护于我，向诸一切怖畏
verses.meaningEn: Homage to to/for the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha), Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! stainless purity free from dust & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), O girl, deceitful, all + embodiment, evermore protect, guard and shelter me, all + to all fear
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：D and S read de ba tA yai , Y and K read de wa ta ye , U reads da ba tA ye , and H reads de bA tA ye . Note that only three of the four goddesses who usually attend Mārīcī in this mantra appear here. It is likely that the term devatāyai has worked its way into this mantra through a scribal error for the goddess Vattāli, who would usually appear here in the mantra.

verses.meaningZh: 归命向佛法僧三宝，无我大慈三昧·一切诸谛圆满·妙行迁变空，鸣呼出，汗栗驮·阿野婆·勇健·麦，于我、为我，即说咒曰：不过逮捕七多罗树，演说小溪，殊胜小溪，野猪面门，一切诸暴恶者
verses.meaningEn: Homage to to/for the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha), selfless great loving-kindness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & awakened conduct beyond flux (vocative invocation), O income, heart + strong + any grain or corn, to me, my, Thus goes the mantra: only apprehend + O palm-tree, speaking + small ditch, choicest + small ditch, boar + O face, all + of all wicked
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Following S ba rA ha mu khi . D reads ba rA hA mu khi .

verses.iast: cakṣurmukhaṃ bandha bandha jambhaya jambhaya stambhaya stambhaya mohaya mohaya hrīḥ hūṃ phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 眼面，再三结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），再三请调伏、摧折憍慢魔障！再三请制止、令暴恶魔障止息不动！再三请令怨魔迷闷失其毒力！莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Eye, bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! again and again, crush! quell jaws of hostility! again and again, immobilize! halt hostile forces! again and again, bewilder hostile forces! again and again, Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Following S ba rA ha mu khi . D reads ba rA hA mu khi .

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Following S ba rA ha mu khi . D reads ba rA hA mu khi .

verses.iast: tadyathā—oṃ prajñe mahāprajñe prajñāvabhāse prajñāvalokite sarvadharmāndhakāravidhamane siddhe susiddhe sidhyantu māṃ bhagavati sarvajñānasaṃdhāre
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！聪明、英明尊，大慧，聪明普光明照，聪明观照，诸法·暗·扇子尊，成就者、已成就尊，善妙成就、最胜悉地尊，愿诸真言章句悉皆成就于我，世尊佛母！（呼格），一切智·气息·持有人尊
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! O intelligent, wise, knowing, mahāprajñe, intelligent + O splendor, intelligent + O beheld, all things + dark + O fan, O accomplished, perfected adept (Siddha) / in accomplished, perfected adept (Siddha), O well-accomplished, supremely perfected / in well-accomplished, supremely perfected, may all mantra-padas succeed me, O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! omniscient + breath + O holding
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：We adopted the reading of the Kauśika here, as the Tibetan prajñāprajñe did not seem satisfactory.

verses.iast: bhagavati vatsale prasāritahaste mama sukara siddhi siddhi buddha buddha kampa kampa pāla
verses.meaningZh: 世尊佛母！（呼格），慈爱，伸手，我之（行者所有），易，再三悉地、妙成就，再三佛陀、觉者，再三疟疾，婆罗
verses.meaningEn: O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! O loving her calf, as subst, extended + O hand, my, of me (the practitioner), easy, Siddhi, spiritual accomplishment/perfection again and again, Buddha, the Awakened One again and again, trembling, shaking, earthquake again and again, warden
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：We adopted the reading of the Kauśika here, as the Tibetan prajñāprajñe did not seem satisfactory.

verses.iast: pāla dhara dhara vara vara garja garja āgaccha āgaccha bhagavati mā vilamba
verses.meaningZh: 婆罗，再三请执持、总持护念！再三殊胜、胜愿、妙好，再三噜噜、音声，再三唯愿降临赴会！世尊佛母！（呼格），勿、莫令，搭拉、垫料
verses.meaningEn: Warden, hold! bear! sustain! again and again, choicest, supreme boon, excellent again and again, roar, noise, thunder again and again, come hither! approach! again and again, O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! do not, let not, hanging down
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：We adopted the reading of the Kauśika here, as the Tibetan prajñāprajñe did not seem satisfactory.

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！般若、超越妙慧，闻，正念、忆持不忘，最胜尊胜、普胜一切！尊，文殊般若心印（甚深智慧总持），陀罗尼此处尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 4 大数据库「84000 藏文大藏经开放 TEI 语料库」（TOH591，部类：Kriyātantra，BDRC: W22084 / MW22084）。梵文经题：Āryatathāgatoṣṇīṣasitātapatrāparājitamahāpratyaṅgiraparamasiddhanāmadhāraṇī；藏文经题：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པའི་གཙུག་ཏོར་ནས་བྱུང་བའི་གདུགས་དཀར་པོ་ཅན་གཞན་གྱིས་མི་ཐུབ་པ་ཕྱིར་ཟློག་པ་ཆེན་མོ་མཆོག་ཏུ་གྲུབ་པ། (de bzhin gshegs pa’i gtsug tor nas byung ba’i gdugs dkar po can gzhan gyis mi thub pa phyir zlog pa chen mo mchog tu grub pa)；英文经题：The Supreme Accomplishment of Invincible Averting, Sitātapatrā Born from the Uṣṇīṣa of the Tathāgata。本经共含 5 则独立真言，此为第 1 则独立真言（一咒一篇严格分立），本篇共 14 句。
recitationTipsZh: 84000 学者团队根据梵藏写本严格校勘还原之古典梵文真言，附有权威英译咒义与校勘记。

verses.iast: oṃ sarvatathāgatoṣṇīṣasitātapatre hūṃ drūṃ hrīḥ ṣṭoṃ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！一切如来·佛顶肉髻相·大白伞盖尊，吽（金刚心印）！佛顶庄严结界心印，莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），吒字门（断除憍慢执障（ṭaṅka）·摄受法流灌顶·大空菩提点摄持）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! all Tathagatas + Uṣṇīṣa + O White Parasol, Hūṃ! adamantine Uṣṇīṣa protection seed syllable, Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, cutting rigid pride (ṭaṅka) — consecrating Dharma-stream sealed with bodhicitta bindu
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：This can be tentatively translated as “ Oṃ , Sitātapatrā born from the uṣṇīṣa of all tathāgatas, hūṃ drūṃ hrīḥ ṣṭoṃ ! Crusher, hūṃ drūṃ hrīḥ ṣṭoṃ ! Paralyzer,

verses.meaningZh: 能作令愚尊，吽（金刚心印）！佛顶庄严结界心印，莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），吒字门（断除憍慢执障（ṭaṅka）·摄受法流灌顶·大空菩提点摄持）
verses.meaningEn: Maker of crushing, destroying, Hūṃ! adamantine Uṣṇīṣa protection seed syllable, Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, cutting rigid pride (ṭaṅka) — consecrating Dharma-stream sealed with bodhicitta bindu

verses.meaningZh: 能作僵仆尊，吽（金刚心印）！佛顶庄严结界心印，莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），吒字门（断除憍慢执障（ṭaṅka）·摄受法流灌顶·大空菩提点摄持）
verses.meaningEn: Maker of laming, paralyzing, fixing, stopping, restraining, Hūṃ! adamantine Uṣṇīṣa protection seed syllable, Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, cutting rigid pride (ṭaṅka) — consecrating Dharma-stream sealed with bodhicitta bindu

verses.meaningEn: Maker of stupefying, perplexing, deceiving, Hūṃ! adamantine Uṣṇīṣa protection seed syllable, Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, cutting rigid pride (ṭaṅka) — consecrating Dharma-stream sealed with bodhicitta bindu

verses.meaningZh: 能作随着星宿一刹那，吽（金刚心印）！佛顶庄严结界心印，莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），吒字门（断除憍慢执障（ṭaṅka）·摄受法流灌顶·大空菩提点摄持）
verses.meaningEn: Along with + star + maker of birth under favorable conditions, Hūṃ! adamantine Uṣṇīṣa protection seed syllable, Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, cutting rigid pride (ṭaṅka) — consecrating Dharma-stream sealed with bodhicitta bindu

verses.meaningZh: 能作系缚、枷锁缠缚尊，吽（金刚心印）！佛顶庄严结界心印，莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），吒字门（断除憍慢执障（ṭaṅka）·摄受法流灌顶·大空菩提点摄持）
verses.meaningEn: Maker of bondage, fetter, imprisonment, Hūṃ! adamantine Uṣṇīṣa protection seed syllable, Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, cutting rigid pride (ṭaṅka) — consecrating Dharma-stream sealed with bodhicitta bindu

verses.meaningZh: 能作愈加不是毒素食尊，吽（金刚心印）！佛顶庄严结界心印，莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），吒字门（断除憍慢执障（ṭaṅka）·摄受法流灌顶·大空菩提点摄持）
verses.meaningEn: Beyond + no poison + maker of alms, Hūṃ! adamantine Uṣṇīṣa protection seed syllable, Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, cutting rigid pride (ṭaṅka) — consecrating Dharma-stream sealed with bodhicitta bindu

verses.iast: sarvaduṣṭapraduṣṭān stambhanakarī hūṃ drūṃ hrīḥ ṣṭoṃ
verses.meaningZh: 一切·暴恶者·败坏，能作僵仆尊，吽（金刚心印）！佛顶庄严结界心印，莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），吒字门（断除憍慢执障（ṭaṅka）·摄受法流灌顶·大空菩提点摄持）
verses.meaningEn: All + wicked + corrupt, maker of laming, paralyzing, fixing, stopping, restraining, Hūṃ! adamantine Uṣṇīṣa protection seed syllable, Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, cutting rigid pride (ṭaṅka) — consecrating Dharma-stream sealed with bodhicitta bindu

verses.iast: sarvayakṣarākṣasagrahāṇāṃ vidhvaṃsanakarī hūṃ drūṃ hrīḥ ṣṭoṃ
verses.meaningZh: 一切·坚持下去·解脱自在·诸曜执，能作摧灭尊，吽（金刚心印）！佛顶庄严结界心印，莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），吒字门（断除憍慢执障（ṭaṅka）·摄受法流灌顶·大空菩提点摄持）
verses.meaningEn: All + press on + free from Rākṣasas + of planet, maker of ruining, spoiling, destroying, violating, Hūṃ! adamantine Uṣṇīṣa protection seed syllable, Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, cutting rigid pride (ṭaṅka) — consecrating Dharma-stream sealed with bodhicitta bindu
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：This can be tentatively translated as “ Oṃ , Sitātapatrā born from the uṣṇīṣa of all tathāgatas, hūṃ drūṃ hrīḥ ṣṭoṃ ! Crusher, hūṃ drūṃ hrīḥ ṣṭoṃ ! Paralyzer,

verses.meaningZh: 能作一切·愈加·无明除断尊，吽（金刚心印）！佛顶庄严结界心印，莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），吒字门（断除憍慢执障（ṭaṅka）·摄受法流灌顶·大空菩提点摄持）
verses.meaningEn: All + beyond + ignorance + maker of removing, Hūṃ! adamantine Uṣṇīṣa protection seed syllable, Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, cutting rigid pride (ṭaṅka) — consecrating Dharma-stream sealed with bodhicitta bindu

verses.iast: caturaśītināṃ grahasahasrāṇāṃ vidhvaṃsanakarī hūṃ drūṃ hrīḥ ṣṭoṃ
verses.meaningZh: 妙行迁变空·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，曜执诸千，能作摧灭尊，吽（金刚心印）！佛顶庄严结界心印，莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），吒字门（断除憍慢执障（ṭaṅka）·摄受法流灌顶·大空菩提点摄持）
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust, planet + of thousand, maker of ruining, spoiling, destroying, violating, Hūṃ! adamantine Uṣṇīṣa protection seed syllable, Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, cutting rigid pride (ṭaṅka) — consecrating Dharma-stream sealed with bodhicitta bindu

verses.iast: aṣṭāviṃśatīnāṃ nakṣatrāṇāṃ prasādanakarī hūṃ drūṃ hrīḥ ṣṭoṃ
verses.meaningZh: 诸二十八之，诸星宿（二十八宿）之，能作一样尊，吽（金刚心印）！佛顶庄严结界心印，莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），吒字门（断除憍慢执障（ṭaṅka）·摄受法流灌顶·大空菩提点摄持）
verses.meaningEn: Of twenty-eight, of constellation, lunar mansion, maker of the same, Hūṃ! adamantine Uṣṇīṣa protection seed syllable, Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, cutting rigid pride (ṭaṅka) — consecrating Dharma-stream sealed with bodhicitta bindu
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：This can be tentatively translated as “ Oṃ , Sitātapatrā born from the uṣṇīṣa of all tathāgatas, hūṃ drūṃ hrīḥ ṣṭoṃ ! Crusher, hūṃ drūṃ hrīḥ ṣṭoṃ ! Paralyzer,

verses.iast: aṣṭānāṃ mahāgrahāṇāṃ vidhvaṃsanakarī hūṃ drūṃ hrīḥ ṣṭoṃ
verses.meaningZh: 诸八（八正道，乐趣诸执拗之，能作摧灭尊，吽（金刚心印）！佛顶庄严结界心印，莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），吒字门（断除憍慢执障（ṭaṅka）·摄受法流灌顶·大空菩提点摄持）
verses.meaningEn: Of all eight, gladden + of niggardliness, maker of ruining, spoiling, destroying, violating, Hūṃ! adamantine Uṣṇīṣa protection seed syllable, Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, cutting rigid pride (ṭaṅka) — consecrating Dharma-stream sealed with bodhicitta bindu
