verses.meaningZh: 嗡！仙人·海会众·善祥尊，一切如来·佛顶肉髻相·大白伞盖尊，吽（金刚心印）！佛顶庄严结界心印
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Ṛṣi + assembly + O cut, all Tathagatas + Uṣṇīṣa + O White Parasol, Hūṃ! adamantine Uṣṇīṣa protection seed syllable
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended based on the Sanskrit, D, F, and S: pra shas+ta .

verses.meaningZh: 能作令愚尊，吽（金刚心印）！佛顶庄严结界心印
verses.meaningEn: Maker of crushing, destroying, Hūṃ! adamantine Uṣṇīṣa protection seed syllable
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended based on the Sanskrit, D, F, and S: pra shas+ta .

verses.meaningZh: 能作僵仆尊，吽（金刚心印）！佛顶庄严结界心印
verses.meaningEn: Maker of laming, paralyzing, fixing, stopping, restraining, Hūṃ! adamantine Uṣṇīṣa protection seed syllable
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended based on the Sanskrit, D, F, and S: pra shas+ta .

verses.meaningZh: 能作大明咒撑杆难尊，吽（金刚心印）！佛顶庄严结界心印
verses.meaningEn: Mahāvidyā + prop + maker of inopportune, Hūṃ! adamantine Uṣṇīṣa protection seed syllable
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended based on the Sanskrit, D, F, and S: pra shas+ta .

verses.meaningZh: 能作愈加·无明·随着·星宿一刹那，吽（金刚心印）！佛顶庄严结界心印
verses.meaningEn: Beyond + ignorance + along with + star + maker of birth under favorable conditions, Hūṃ! adamantine Uṣṇīṣa protection seed syllable
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended based on the Sanskrit, D, F, and S: pra shas+ta .

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸暴恶者，能作僵仆尊，吽（金刚心印）！佛顶庄严结界心印
verses.meaningEn: All + of all wicked, maker of laming, paralyzing, fixing, stopping, restraining, Hūṃ! adamantine Uṣṇīṣa protection seed syllable
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended based on the Sanskrit, D, F, and S: pra shas+ta .

verses.meaningZh: 一切·坚持下去·解脱自在·诸曜执，能作摧灭尊，吽（金刚心印）！佛顶庄严结界心印
verses.meaningEn: All + press on + free from Rākṣasas + of planet, maker of ruining, spoiling, destroying, violating, Hūṃ! adamantine Uṣṇīṣa protection seed syllable
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended based on the Sanskrit, D, F, and S: pra shas+ta .

verses.meaningZh: 谨慎诸洁白青黑之，曜执诸千，能作摧灭尊，吽（金刚心印）！佛顶庄严结界心印
verses.meaningEn: Swift + of white or black, planet + of thousand, maker of ruining, spoiling, destroying, violating, Hūṃ! adamantine Uṣṇīṣa protection seed syllable
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended based on the Sanskrit, D, F, and S: pra shas+ta .

verses.meaningZh: 诸二十八之，诸星宿（二十八宿）之，能作一样尊，吽（金刚心印）！佛顶庄严结界心印
verses.meaningEn: Of twenty-eight, of constellation, lunar mansion, maker of the same, Hūṃ! adamantine Uṣṇīṣa protection seed syllable
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended based on the Sanskrit, D, F, and S: pra shas+ta .

verses.meaningZh: 诸八（八正道，乐趣诸执拗之，能作摧灭尊，吽（金刚心印）！佛顶庄严结界心印
verses.meaningEn: Of all eight, gladden + of niggardliness, maker of ruining, spoiling, destroying, violating, Hūṃ! adamantine Uṣṇīṣa protection seed syllable
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended based on the Sanskrit, D, F, and S: pra shas+ta .

verses.iast: hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ rakṣa rakṣa māṃ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！祈请再三拥护、守护于我，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)! evermore protect, guard and shelter me, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended based on the Sanskrit, D, F, and S: pra shas+ta .

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！阿夷·智慧猛火·阿罗歌花·光明·开·花开·大白伞盖尊
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! dark-coloured + sacred fire + arka flowers + light + suffused + O White Parasol
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended based on the Sanskrit sources as well as Toh 590, wherein this Sanskrit line is translated into Tibetan. D, F, and S read, in transliteration,

verses.iast: oṃ jvala jvala khāda khāda hana hana dara dara vidara vidara chinda
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞），再三请啖食净尽一切毒害魔障！再三击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），再三揭幕、一些，再三闢揭幕，断除烦恼结使缠缚（嗔陀）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! blaze forth with wisdom radiance! again and again, consume! devour obstacles! again and again, strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again, cleaving, rending, opening again and again, settle + cleaving again and again, sever every fetter and hostile spell!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended based on the Sanskrit sources as well as Toh 590, wherein this Sanskrit line is translated into Tibetan. D, F, and S read, in transliteration,

verses.iast: chinda bhinda bhinda bandha bandha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 断除烦恼结使缠缚（嗔陀），再三劈破无明坚固执障（牝陀），再三结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Sever every fetter and hostile spell! cleave asunder stubborn ignorance! again and again, bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! again and again, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 590 and all Sanskrit sources consulted read khakhame khakhame , the meaning of which is ambiguous.

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！再三智慧猛火（净除业障火）尊
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O sacred fire, purifying flame / in sacred fire, purifying flame again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 590 and all Sanskrit sources consulted read khakhame khakhame , the meaning of which is ambiguous.

verses.meaningZh: 再三诸人于我
verses.meaningEn: A degraded Kṣatriya + to me again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 590 and all Sanskrit sources consulted read khakhame khakhame , the meaning of which is ambiguous.

verses.meaningZh: 再三勇猛丈夫、无畏英雄尊尊
verses.meaningEn: O heroic, valiant, fearless hero / in heroic, valiant, fearless hero again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 590 and all Sanskrit sources consulted read khakhame khakhame , the meaning of which is ambiguous.

verses.meaningZh: 再三寂静温和、慈柔如月尊
verses.meaningEn: O gentle, serene, lunar-calm, benign / in gentle, serene, lunar-calm, benign again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 590 and all Sanskrit sources consulted read khakhame khakhame , the meaning of which is ambiguous.

verses.meaningZh: 再三寂静、调柔安稳尊
verses.meaningEn: O peaceful, calm, tranquil / in peaceful, calm, tranquil again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 590 and all Sanskrit sources consulted read khakhame khakhame , the meaning of which is ambiguous.

verses.meaningZh: 再三低调、佛口婆心尊
verses.meaningEn: O tamed, subdued, patient, passionless again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 590 and all Sanskrit sources consulted read khakhame khakhame , the meaning of which is ambiguous.

verses.meaningZh: 再三最上真言离言说·六度满行清净·施度调伏
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & perfection of the six pāramitās & generosity & self-mastery (vocative invocation) again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 590 and all Sanskrit sources consulted read khakhame khakhame , the meaning of which is ambiguous.

verses.meaningZh: 再三怨尊
verses.meaningEn: O enmity / in enmity again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 590 and all Sanskrit sources consulted read khakhame khakhame , the meaning of which is ambiguous.

verses.meaningZh: 天女、佛母明妃尊，持金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊
verses.meaningEn: O goddess, sacred female deity, O bearer of Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 590 and all Sanskrit sources consulted read khakhame khakhame , the meaning of which is ambiguous.

verses.meaningZh: 结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），系缚、枷锁缠缚尊
verses.meaningEn: Bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! O bondage, fetter, imprisonment
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 590 and all Sanskrit sources consulted read khakhame khakhame , the meaning of which is ambiguous.

verses.meaningZh: 金刚手菩萨（执金刚秘密主），泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Vajrapāṇi, Vajra-in-Hand Bodhisattva, Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 590 and all Sanskrit sources consulted read khakhame khakhame , the meaning of which is ambiguous.

verses.iast: oṃ hūṃ drūṃ hrīḥ ṣṭoṃ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！吽（金刚心印）！佛顶庄严结界心印，莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），吒字门（断除憍慢执障（ṭaṅka）·摄受法流灌顶·大空菩提点摄持），泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Hūṃ! adamantine Uṣṇīṣa protection seed syllable, Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, cutting rigid pride (ṭaṅka) — consecrating Dharma-stream sealed with bodhicitta bindu, Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 590 and all Sanskrit sources consulted read khakhame khakhame , the meaning of which is ambiguous.

verses.iast: oṃ vajrapāṇi bandha bandha vajrapāśena sarvaduṣṭavighnān vinyāyakān hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！金刚手菩萨（执金刚秘密主），再三结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），以金刚羂索，一切·暴恶者·障碍，最上真言离言说·离名相假立·一乘如实之道，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Vajrapāṇi, Vajra-in-Hand Bodhisattva, bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! again and again, Vajra + by, all + wicked + obstacle, supreme ineffable speech & beyond nominal designation & supreme vehicle of awakening, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Toh 590 and all Sanskrit sources consulted read khakhame khakhame , the meaning of which is ambiguous.

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：All Sanskrit version consulted, as well as Toh 590, 592, and 593, read dara dara , “Break, break!”

verses.iast: oṃ ṣṭoṃ bandha bandha mama rakṣa rakṣa svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！吒字门（断除憍慢执障（ṭaṅka）·摄受法流灌顶·大空菩提点摄持），再三结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），我之（行者所有），再三拥护、守护，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! cutting rigid pride (ṭaṅka) — consecrating Dharma-stream sealed with bodhicitta bindu, bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! again and again, my, of me (the practitioner), protect, guard and shelter! again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：All Sanskrit version consulted, as well as Toh 590, 592, and 593, read dara dara , “Break, break!”

verses.iast: oṃ ṣṭoṃ bandha bandha vajra mama rakṣa rakṣa vajrapāṇi hūṃ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！吒字门（断除憍慢执障（ṭaṅka）·摄受法流灌顶·大空菩提点摄持），再三结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），我之（行者所有），再三拥护、守护，金刚手菩萨（执金刚秘密主），吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! cutting rigid pride (ṭaṅka) — consecrating Dharma-stream sealed with bodhicitta bindu, bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! again and again, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, my, of me (the practitioner), protect, guard and shelter! again and again, Vajrapāṇi, Vajra-in-Hand Bodhisattva, Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：All Sanskrit version consulted, as well as Toh 590, 592, and 593, read dara dara , “Break, break!”

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！一切如来·佛顶肉髻相·智慧猛火尊，观照、慈悲垂视尊，妙行迁变空·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，帝殊罗施
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! all Tathagatas + Uṣṇīṣa + O sacred fire, O beheld, looked upon with compassion / in beheld, looked upon with compassion, awakened conduct beyond flux & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace, Tejorasi
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：All Sanskrit version consulted, as well as Toh 590, 592, and 593, read dara dara , “Break, break!”

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！再三炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! blaze forth with wisdom radiance! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：All Sanskrit version consulted, as well as Toh 590, 592, and 593, read dara dara , “Break, break!”

verses.meaningZh: 再三法界总持任持·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: Dharma-realm retention & freedom from karmic agency again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：All Sanskrit version consulted, as well as Toh 590, 592, and 593, read dara dara , “Break, break!”

verses.meaningZh: 再三请执持、总持护念！
verses.meaningEn: Hold! bear! sustain! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：All Sanskrit version consulted, as well as Toh 590, 592, and 593, read dara dara , “Break, break!”

verses.meaningZh: 再三闢揭幕
verses.meaningEn: Settle + cleaving again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：All Sanskrit version consulted, as well as Toh 590, 592, and 593, read dara dara , “Break, break!”

verses.meaningZh: 再三断除烦恼结使缠缚（嗔陀）
verses.meaningEn: Sever every fetter and hostile spell! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：All Sanskrit version consulted, as well as Toh 590, 592, and 593, read dara dara , “Break, break!”

verses.iast: bhinda bhinda hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 再三劈破无明坚固执障（牝陀），吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Cleave asunder stubborn ignorance! again and again, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：All Sanskrit version consulted, as well as Toh 590, 592, and 593, read dara dara , “Break, break!”

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！一切如来佛顶肉髻相，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! all Tathagatas + Uṣṇīṣa, Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：All Sanskrit version consulted, as well as Toh 590, 592, and 593, read dara dara , “Break, break!”

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：All Sanskrit version consulted, as well as Toh 590, 592, and 593, read dara dara , “Break, break!”

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！再三智慧猛火（净除业障火）尊
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O sacred fire, purifying flame / in sacred fire, purifying flame again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：All Sanskrit version consulted, as well as Toh 590, 592, and 593, read dara dara , “Break, break!”

verses.meaningZh: 再三诸人于我
verses.meaningEn: A degraded Kṣatriya + to me again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：All Sanskrit version consulted, as well as Toh 590, 592, and 593, read dara dara , “Break, break!”

verses.meaningZh: 再三怨尊
verses.meaningEn: O enmity / in enmity again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：All Sanskrit version consulted, as well as Toh 590, 592, and 593, read dara dara , “Break, break!”

verses.meaningZh: 再三寂静温和、慈柔如月尊
verses.meaningEn: O gentle, serene, lunar-calm, benign / in gentle, serene, lunar-calm, benign again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：All Sanskrit version consulted, as well as Toh 590, 592, and 593, read dara dara , “Break, break!”

verses.meaningZh: 觉悟正觉·一切诸谛圆满，一切如来·佛顶肉髻相·大白伞盖尊，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Awakened (vocative invocation), all Tathagatas + Uṣṇīṣa + O White Parasol, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：All Sanskrit version consulted, as well as Toh 590, 592, and 593, read dara dara , “Break, break!”

verses.iast: hūṃ mama hūṃ ni hūṃ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 吽（金刚心印）！我之（行者所有），吽（金刚心印）！曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·诸根清净自在），吽（金刚心印）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Hūṃ! my, of me (the practitioner), Hūṃ! beyond nominal designation (nāma) — purified faculties, Hūṃ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：All Sanskrit version consulted, as well as Toh 590, 592, and 593, read dara dara , “Break, break!”

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！向仙人海会众善祥，一切如来·佛顶肉髻相·大白伞盖尊，吽（金刚心印）！佛顶庄严结界心印

verses.meaningZh: 能作愈加·无明·随着·食不，吽（金刚心印）！佛顶庄严结界心印

verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：This can be tentatively translated as “ Oṃ , Sitātapatrā born from the uṣṇīṣa of all tathāgatas, praised by the host of ṛṣis, hūṃ drūṃ ! Crusher, hūṃ drūṃ !

verses.meaningZh: 一切·坚持下去·解脱自在·诸曜执，能作摧灭尊，吽（金刚心印）！佛顶庄严结界心印

verses.meaningZh: 谨慎诸洁白青黑之，曜执诸千，能作摧灭尊，吽（金刚心印）！佛顶庄严结界心印
verses.meaningEn: Swift + of white or black, planet + of thousand, maker of ruining, spoiling, destroying, violating, Hūṃ! adamantine Uṣṇīṣa protection seed syllable

verses.meaningZh: 诸二十八之，诸星宿（二十八宿）之，能作一样尊，吽（金刚心印）！佛顶庄严结界心印
verses.meaningEn: Of twenty-eight, of constellation, lunar mansion, maker of the same, Hūṃ! adamantine Uṣṇīṣa protection seed syllable
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：This can be tentatively translated as “ Oṃ , Sitātapatrā born from the uṣṇīṣa of all tathāgatas, praised by the host of ṛṣis, hūṃ drūṃ ! Crusher, hūṃ drūṃ !

verses.meaningZh: 诸八（八正道，乐趣诸执拗之，能作摧灭尊，吽（金刚心印）！佛顶庄严结界心印
verses.meaningEn: Of all eight, gladden + of niggardliness, maker of ruining, spoiling, destroying, violating, Hūṃ! adamantine Uṣṇīṣa protection seed syllable
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：This can be tentatively translated as “ Oṃ , Sitātapatrā born from the uṣṇīṣa of all tathāgatas, praised by the host of ṛṣis, hūṃ drūṃ ! Crusher, hūṃ drūṃ !

verses.meaningZh: 再三拥护、守护，我（宾格：守护
verses.meaningEn: Protect, guard and shelter! again and again, me

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！阿夷·智慧猛火·阿罗歌花·光明·开·花开·大白伞盖尊
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! dark-coloured + sacred fire + arka flowers + light + suffused + O White Parasol
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended based on the Sanskrit sources as well as Toh 590, wherein this Sanskrit line is translated into Tibetan. D and S read, in transliteration,

verses.meaningZh: 再三炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞）
verses.meaningEn: Blaze forth with wisdom radiance! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended based on the Sanskrit sources as well as Toh 590, wherein this Sanskrit line is translated into Tibetan. D and S read, in transliteration,

verses.meaningZh: 再三请啖食净尽一切毒害魔障！
verses.meaningEn: Consume! devour obstacles! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended based on the Sanskrit sources as well as Toh 590, wherein this Sanskrit line is translated into Tibetan. D and S read, in transliteration,

verses.meaningZh: 再三揭幕、一些
verses.meaningEn: Cleaving, rending, opening again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended based on the Sanskrit sources as well as Toh 590, wherein this Sanskrit line is translated into Tibetan. D and S read, in transliteration,

verses.meaningZh: 再三闢揭幕
verses.meaningEn: Settle + cleaving again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended based on the Sanskrit sources as well as Toh 590, wherein this Sanskrit line is translated into Tibetan. D and S read, in transliteration,

verses.meaningZh: 再三断除烦恼结使缠缚（嗔陀）
verses.meaningEn: Sever every fetter and hostile spell! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended based on the Sanskrit sources as well as Toh 590, wherein this Sanskrit line is translated into Tibetan. D and S read, in transliteration,

verses.meaningZh: 再三劈破无明坚固执障（牝陀）
verses.meaningEn: Cleave asunder stubborn ignorance! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended based on the Sanskrit sources as well as Toh 590, wherein this Sanskrit line is translated into Tibetan. D and S read, in transliteration,

verses.meaningZh: 吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended based on the Sanskrit sources as well as Toh 590, wherein this Sanskrit line is translated into Tibetan. D and S read, in transliteration,

verses.meaningZh: 再三呼唤圣尊叹词（咄！圣者！），泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: O! Hail! Vocative invocation particle again and again, Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended based on the Sanskrit sources as well as Toh 590, wherein this Sanskrit line is translated into Tibetan. D and S read, in transliteration,

verses.meaningZh: 再三呼请垂听叹词，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Ho! O Blessed One! again and again, Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended based on the Sanskrit sources as well as Toh 590, wherein this Sanskrit line is translated into Tibetan. D and S read, in transliteration,

verses.meaningZh: 不空、决定成就无虚尊，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: O unfailing, infallible, never in vain / in unfailing, infallible, never in vain, Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended based on the Sanskrit sources as well as Toh 590, wherein this Sanskrit line is translated into Tibetan. D and S read, in transliteration,

verses.meaningZh: 向无碍、无能障碍，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: To/for unobstructed, irresistible, unimpeded, Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended based on the Sanskrit sources as well as Toh 590, wherein this Sanskrit line is translated into Tibetan. D and S read, in transliteration,

verses.meaningZh: 殊胜施物，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Choicest + gift, Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended based on the Sanskrit sources as well as Toh 590, wherein this Sanskrit line is translated into Tibetan. D and S read, in transliteration,

verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness (reverent offering), Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended based on the Sanskrit sources as well as Toh 590, wherein this Sanskrit line is translated into Tibetan. D and S read, in transliteration,

verses.meaningZh: 向阿修罗·闢·经营·寒鸦，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Asura + settle + run, Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended based on the Sanskrit sources as well as Toh 590, wherein this Sanskrit line is translated into Tibetan. D and S read, in transliteration,

verses.meaningZh: 向诸一切天人，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: All + to all god, Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended based on the Sanskrit sources as well as Toh 590, wherein this Sanskrit line is translated into Tibetan. D and S read, in transliteration,

translatorZh: 84000: Translating the Words of the Buddha (Kriyātantra)

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 4 大数据库「84000 藏文大藏经开放 TEI 语料库」（TOH593，部类：Kriyātantra，BDRC: W22084 / MW22084）。梵文经题：Āryatathāgatoṣṇīṣasitātapatrānāmaparājitānāmadhāraṇī；藏文经题：གདུགས་དཀར་གཞན་གྱིས་མི་ཐུབ་པ། (gdugs dkar gzhan gyis mi thub pa)；英文经题：The Invincible Sitātapatrā (2)。本经共含 4 则独立真言，此为第 2 则独立真言（一咒一篇严格分立），本篇共 68 句。

titleZh: 【DB4·84000藏密】Uṣṇīṣavijayādhāraṇīkalpasahitā · 第 1/3 则独立真言 (TOH594 · The Uṣṇīṣavijayā Dhāraṇī with Its Ritual Manual (1))
titleEnglish: The Uṣṇīṣavijayā Dhāraṇī with Its Ritual Manual (1) — Standalone Mantra 1/3 (TOH594)
translatorZh: 84000: Translating the Words of the Buddha (Kriyātantra)
sutraSourceZh: 德格版甘珠尔 (TOH594)《གཙུག་ཏོར་རྣམ་རྒྱལ་གྱི་གཟུངས་རྟོག་པ་དང་བཅས་པ།》(gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi gzungs rtog pa dang bcas pa)
deityZh: Uṣṇīṣavijayādhāraṇīkalpasahitā · གཙུག་ཏོར་རྣམ་རྒྱལ་གྱི་གཟུངས་རྟོག་པ་དང་བཅས་པ།
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 4 大数据库「84000 藏文大藏经开放 TEI 语料库」（TOH594，部类：Kriyātantra，BDRC: W22084 / MW22084）。梵文经题：Sarvatathāgatoṣṇīṣavijayānāmadhāraṇīkalpasahitā；藏文经题：གཙུག་ཏོར་རྣམ་རྒྱལ་གྱི་གཟུངས་རྟོག་པ་དང་བཅས་པ། (gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi gzungs rtog pa dang bcas pa)；英文经题：The Uṣṇīṣavijayā Dhāraṇī with Its Ritual Manual (1)。本经共含 3 则独立真言，此为第 1 则独立真言（一咒一篇严格分立），本篇共 65 句。
recitationTipsZh: 84000 学者团队根据梵藏写本严格校勘还原之古典梵文真言，附有权威英译咒义与校勘记。

verses.iast: oṃ namo bhagavate sarvatrailokyaprativiśiṣṭāya buddhāya te namaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊（薄伽梵）致敬，向一切·三界·对·殊胜，向佛陀、觉者，向汝、彼等，至心归命礼！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, all + the Three Worlds + toward + to, to/for Buddha, the Awakened One, to Thee / they, reverent homage!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kangxi versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kangxi versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！再三一字顶轮王与尊胜佛顶最上心印
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Uṣṇīṣa-cakravartin & Vijayā crown seed syllable again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kangxi versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请净除、涤荡清净！
verses.meaningEn: Purify! cleanse! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kangxi versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请最极净除、彻底涤净一切业障！
verses.meaningEn: Thoroughly purify! cleanse completely! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kangxi versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 无等·普现·遍·趣向·虚空·自性·最极清净

verses.meaningZh: 愿一切如来普施甘露灌顶！于我，诸一切如来，真言宣演·一切诸谛圆满，以诸大手印真言章句

verses.meaningZh: 再三阶位双手尊，大手印、大法契印尊

verses.meaningZh: 金刚身·好好儿编织·不·圆满清净
verses.meaningEn: Vajrakāya + struck together + not + O thoroughly pure
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kangxi versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 一切·业障·最极清净
verses.meaningEn: All + karmic obscuration + O completely purified

verses.meaningZh: 请回遮逆转（灾厄）、令寿复延！瞒·寿命·最极清净
verses.meaningEn: Turn back (evil)! restore! maṃ + life + O completely purified
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kangxi versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 一切如来·三昧耶·加持·所加持

verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kangxi versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！再三牟尼、寂默圣者，大牟尼尊（释迦世尊）

verses.meaningZh: 再三闢牟尼，大·闢·牟尼

verses.meaningZh: 再三慧、正念妙慧，大慧
verses.meaningEn: Intelligence, wisdom, mindfulness again and again, great wisdom
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kangxi versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 我之（行者所有）
verses.meaningEn: My, of me (the practitioner)
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kangxi versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 善心、人情
verses.meaningEn: Benevolence, favour
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kangxi versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 真如·实际·圆满清净
verses.meaningEn: Suchness + limit of reality + O thoroughly pure
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kangxi versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 闢·开·清净尊
verses.meaningEn: Settle + suffused + O pure in heart or intention
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kangxi versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 再三呼唤圣尊叹词（咄！圣者！）
verses.meaningEn: O! Hail! Vocative invocation particle again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kangxi versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 再三胜伏、最胜吉祥！
verses.meaningEn: Conquer! victory! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kangxi versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 再三最胜尊胜、普胜一切！
verses.meaningEn: Supreme victory! triumph! again and again

verses.meaningZh: 再三忆念本誓

verses.meaningZh: 再三请遍满舒光、周遍法界！

verses.meaningZh: 再三请大放光明遍照十方！
verses.meaningEn: Cause to radiate and expand universally! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in the Yongle and Kangxi versions of this text, in Hidas' Sanskrit edition, and in Toh 595, 596, and 598.

verses.meaningZh: 一切·佛陀·加持·所加持
verses.meaningEn: All + Buddha + spiritual blessing + O blessed

verses.iast: oṃ namo bhagavate sarvatrailokyaprativiśiṣṭāya buddhāya te namaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊（薄伽梵）致敬，向一切·三界·对·殊胜，向佛陀、觉者，向汝、彼等，至心归命礼！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, all + the Three Worlds + toward + to, to/for Buddha, the Awakened One, to Thee / they, reverent homage!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：mama is not present in Hidas' edition of the Sanskrit manuscripts.

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：mama is not present in Hidas' edition of the Sanskrit manuscripts.

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！再三一字顶轮王与尊胜佛顶最上心印
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Uṣṇīṣa-cakravartin & Vijayā crown seed syllable again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：mama is not present in Hidas' edition of the Sanskrit manuscripts.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请净除、涤荡清净！
verses.meaningEn: Purify! cleanse! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：mama is not present in Hidas' edition of the Sanskrit manuscripts.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请最极净除、彻底涤净一切业障！
verses.meaningEn: Thoroughly purify! cleanse completely! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：mama is not present in Hidas' edition of the Sanskrit manuscripts.

verses.meaningZh: 无等·普现·遍·趣向·虚空·自性·最极清净
verses.meaningEn: Unequalled + suffusion + course + sky + own-being + O completely purified
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：mama is not present in Hidas' edition of the Sanskrit manuscripts.

verses.meaningZh: 佛顶肉髻相·最胜尊胜·圆满清净
verses.meaningEn: Uṣṇīṣa + supreme victory! triumph! + O thoroughly pure
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：mama is not present in Hidas' edition of the Sanskrit manuscripts.

verses.meaningZh: 愿一切如来普施甘露灌顶！于我，诸一切如来，真言宣演·一切诸谛圆满，以诸大手印真言章句
verses.meaningEn: May all Buddhas consecrate and anoint me, all Tathagatas (plural), uttering, Mahāmudrā + by
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：mama is not present in Hidas' edition of the Sanskrit manuscripts.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请摄召、赐予妙寿福德供养！我之（行者所有），寿命·赢得·陀罗尼
verses.meaningEn: Bring! fetch! bestow! again and again, my, of me (the practitioner), life-force + win + O Dhāraṇī
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：mama is not present in Hidas' edition of the Sanskrit manuscripts.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请净除、涤荡清净！

verses.meaningZh: 再三请最极净除、彻底涤净一切业障！
verses.meaningEn: Thoroughly purify! cleanse completely! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：mama is not present in Hidas' edition of the Sanskrit manuscripts.

verses.meaningZh: 虚空·自性·最极清净
verses.meaningEn: Sky + own-being + O completely purified

verses.meaningZh: 佛顶肉髻相·颤动·出·圆满清净
verses.meaningEn: Uṣṇīṣa + dart up or back + income + O thoroughly pure

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢

verses.meaningZh: 六·波罗蜜多·般·遂尊

verses.meaningZh: 萨嚩怛他蘖多南架子

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说

verses.meaningZh: 金刚身·好好儿编织·不·圆满清净

verses.meaningZh: 一切·业障·最极清净
verses.meaningEn: All + karmic obscuration + O completely purified

verses.meaningZh: 请回遮逆转（灾厄）、令寿复延！瞒·寿命·最极清净

verses.meaningZh: 一切如来·三昧耶·加持·所加持

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！再三牟尼、寂默圣者，大牟尼尊（释迦世尊）

verses.meaningZh: 再三闢牟尼，大·闢·牟尼

verses.meaningZh: 再三慧、正念妙慧，大慧

verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：mama is not present in Hidas' edition of the Sanskrit manuscripts.

verses.meaningZh: 我之（行者所有）
verses.meaningEn: My, of me (the practitioner)
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：mama is not present in Hidas' edition of the Sanskrit manuscripts.

verses.meaningZh: 善心、人情

verses.meaningZh: 真如·实际·圆满清净

verses.meaningZh: 闢·开·清净尊
verses.meaningEn: Settle + suffused + O pure in heart or intention
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：mama is not present in Hidas' edition of the Sanskrit manuscripts.

verses.meaningZh: 再三呼唤圣尊叹词（咄！圣者！）

verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：mama is not present in Hidas' edition of the Sanskrit manuscripts.

verses.meaningZh: 再三胜伏、最胜吉祥！

verses.meaningZh: 再三最胜尊胜、普胜一切！
verses.meaningEn: Supreme victory! triumph! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：mama is not present in Hidas' edition of the Sanskrit manuscripts.

verses.meaningZh: 再三忆念本誓
verses.meaningEn: Remember Your primordial vow! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：mama is not present in Hidas' edition of the Sanskrit manuscripts.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请遍满舒光、周遍法界！

verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：mama is not present in Hidas' edition of the Sanskrit manuscripts.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请大放光明遍照十方！

verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：mama is not present in Hidas' edition of the Sanskrit manuscripts.

verses.meaningZh: 一切·佛陀·加持·所加持
verses.meaningEn: All + Buddha + spiritual blessing + O blessed
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：mama is not present in Hidas' edition of the Sanskrit manuscripts.

verses.meaningZh: 再三清净、纯洁无染尊

verses.meaningZh: 再三佛陀、觉者尊

verses.meaningZh: 再三金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊，大金刚尊

verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：mama is not present in Hidas' edition of the Sanskrit manuscripts.

verses.meaningZh: 勇健金刚杵尊
verses.meaningEn: O having a strong thunderbolt / in having a strong thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：mama is not present in Hidas' edition of the Sanskrit manuscripts.

verses.meaningZh: 金刚藏尊

verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：mama is not present in Hidas' edition of the Sanskrit manuscripts.

verses.meaningZh: 胜伏藏

verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：mama is not present in Hidas' edition of the Sanskrit manuscripts.

verses.meaningZh: 最胜尊胜藏
verses.meaningEn: Supreme victory! triumph! + O womb
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：mama is not present in Hidas' edition of the Sanskrit manuscripts.

verses.meaningZh: 金刚·焰光·藏
verses.meaningEn: Vajra + light + O womb
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：mama is not present in Hidas' edition of the Sanskrit manuscripts.

verses.meaningZh: 金刚氏族
verses.meaningEn: Vajra + O origin
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：mama is not present in Hidas' edition of the Sanskrit manuscripts.

verses.meaningZh: 金刚三婆吠尊
verses.meaningEn: Vajra + O giving rise to
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：mama is not present in Hidas' edition of the Sanskrit manuscripts.

verses.meaningZh: 金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊
verses.meaningEn: O Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt / in Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：mama is not present in Hidas' edition of the Sanskrit manuscripts.

verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢

verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：mama is not present in Hidas' edition of the Sanskrit manuscripts.

verses.iast: vajram bhavatu mama śarīraṃ sarvasatvānāñ ca kāyapariśuddhir bhavatu
verses.meaningZh: 金刚，愿成就、愿悉吉祥，我之（行者所有），躯，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说以及身净，愿成就、愿悉吉祥
verses.meaningEn: Vajram, may it be, let there be! my, of me (the practitioner), śarīraṃ, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech and body, may it be, let there be!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：mama is not present in Hidas' edition of the Sanskrit manuscripts.

verses.meaningZh: 于我、为我，恒常、一切时，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说以及
verses.meaningEn: To me, my, always, evermore, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech and
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：mama is not present in Hidas' edition of the Sanskrit manuscripts.

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说以及我，愿诸如来慈悲安慰授记！
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech and me (the practitioner), may they comfort and encourage!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：mama is not present in Hidas' edition of the Sanskrit manuscripts.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请觉知、垂鉴觉照！

verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：mama is not present in Hidas' edition of the Sanskrit manuscripts.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请成就妙悉地！

verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：mama is not present in Hidas' edition of the Sanskrit manuscripts.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请开晓觉悟、令发菩提觉智！
verses.meaningEn: Awaken! enlighten! illuminate! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：mama is not present in Hidas' edition of the Sanskrit manuscripts.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请令圆满开悟、朗然大觉！

verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：mama is not present in Hidas' edition of the Sanskrit manuscripts.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请解脱、令离系缚！
verses.meaningEn: Liberate! set free! release! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：mama is not present in Hidas' edition of the Sanskrit manuscripts.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请究竟解脱、度脱苦厄！
verses.meaningEn: Thoroughly liberate and emancipate! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：mama is not present in Hidas' edition of the Sanskrit manuscripts.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请净除、涤荡清净！
verses.meaningEn: Purify! cleanse! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：mama is not present in Hidas' edition of the Sanskrit manuscripts.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请最极净除、彻底涤净一切业障！
verses.meaningEn: Thoroughly purify! cleanse completely! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：mama is not present in Hidas' edition of the Sanskrit manuscripts.

verses.meaningZh: 普遍请解脱，请解脱、令离系缚！
verses.meaningEn: Universal + liberate! set free! release! liberate! set free! release!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：mama is not present in Hidas' edition of the Sanskrit manuscripts.

verses.meaningZh: 普遍·光芒·圆满清净
verses.meaningEn: Universal + ray of light + O thoroughly pure
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：mama is not present in Hidas' edition of the Sanskrit manuscripts.

verses.meaningZh: 一切如来·心·加持·所加持
verses.meaningEn: All Tathagatas + heart + spiritual blessing + O blessed
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：mama is not present in Hidas' edition of the Sanskrit manuscripts.

verses.meaningZh: 再三阶位双手尊，大手印、大法契印尊
verses.meaningEn: O position of the hands / in position of the hands again and again, O Mahāmudrā, Great Seal / in Mahāmudrā, Great Seal

verses.meaningZh: 以诸大手印真言章句，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！

titleZh: 【DB4·84000藏密】Uṣṇīṣavijayādhāraṇīkalpasahitā · 第 2/3 则独立真言 (TOH595 · The Uṣṇīṣavijayā Dhāraṇī with Its Ritual Manual (2))
titleEnglish: The Uṣṇīṣavijayā Dhāraṇī with Its Ritual Manual (2) — Standalone Mantra 2/3 (TOH595)
translatorZh: 84000: Translating the Words of the Buddha (Kriyātantra)
sutraSourceZh: 德格版甘珠尔 (TOH595)《གཙུག་ཏོར་རྣམ་རྒྱལ་གྱི་གཟུངས་རྟོག་པ་དང་བཅས་པ།》(gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi gzungs rtog pa dang bcas pa)
deityZh: Uṣṇīṣavijayādhāraṇīkalpasahitā · གཙུག་ཏོར་རྣམ་རྒྱལ་གྱི་གཟུངས་རྟོག་པ་དང་བཅས་པ།

verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas' Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！再三呼唤圣尊叹词（咄！圣者！）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O! Hail! Vocative invocation particle again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas' Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 再三胜伏、最胜吉祥！
verses.meaningEn: Conquer! victory! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas' Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 再三最胜尊胜、普胜一切！
verses.meaningEn: Supreme victory! triumph! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas' Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 再三忆念本誓
verses.meaningEn: Remember Your primordial vow! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas' Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请遍满舒光、周遍法界！
verses.meaningEn: Pervade! radiate forth everywhere! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas' Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请大放光明遍照十方！
verses.meaningEn: Cause to radiate and expand universally! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas' Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 一切·佛陀·加持·所加持
verses.meaningEn: All + Buddha + spiritual blessing + O blessed
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas' Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！再三清净、纯洁无染尊
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O pure, cleansed, bright / in pure, cleansed, bright again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas' Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 再三佛陀、觉者尊
verses.meaningEn: O Buddha, the Awakened One / in Buddha, the Awakened One again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas' Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 再三金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊，大金刚尊
verses.meaningEn: O Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt / in Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt again and again, great + O Vajra
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas' Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 勇健金刚杵尊
verses.meaningEn: O having a strong thunderbolt / in having a strong thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas' Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 金刚藏尊
verses.meaningEn: Vajragarbhe
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas' Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 胜伏藏
verses.meaningEn: Conquer! victory! + O womb
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas' Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 最胜尊胜藏
verses.meaningEn: Supreme victory! triumph! + O womb
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas' Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 金刚·焰光·藏
verses.meaningEn: Vajra + light + O womb
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas' Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 金刚氏族
verses.meaningEn: Vajra + O origin
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas' Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 金刚三婆吠尊
verses.meaningEn: Vajra + O giving rise to
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas' Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊
verses.meaningEn: O Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt / in Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas' Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas' Sanskrit edition.

verses.iast: vajram bhavatu me śarīraṃ sarvasatvānāñ ca kāyapariśuddhir bhavatu
verses.meaningZh: 金刚，愿成就、愿悉吉祥，于我、为我，躯，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说以及身净，愿成就、愿悉吉祥
verses.meaningEn: Vajram, may it be, let there be! to me, my, śarīraṃ, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech and body, may it be, let there be!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas' Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 于我、为我，恒常、一切时，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说以及
verses.meaningEn: To me, my, always, evermore, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech and
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas' Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说以及我，愿诸如来慈悲安慰授记！
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech and me (the practitioner), may they comfort and encourage!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas' Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！再三请觉知、垂鉴觉照！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! awake! perceive! behend! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas' Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请成就妙悉地！
verses.meaningEn: Be accomplished! manifest siddhi! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas' Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请开晓觉悟、令发菩提觉智！
verses.meaningEn: Awaken! enlighten! illuminate! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas' Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请令圆满开悟、朗然大觉！
verses.meaningEn: Fully awaken and enlighten! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas' Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请解脱、令离系缚！
verses.meaningEn: Liberate! set free! release! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas' Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请究竟解脱、度脱苦厄！
verses.meaningEn: Thoroughly liberate and emancipate! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas' Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请净除、涤荡清净！
verses.meaningEn: Purify! cleanse! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas' Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请最极净除、彻底涤净一切业障！
verses.meaningEn: Thoroughly purify! cleanse completely! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas' Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 普遍、周遍十方，再三请解脱、令离系缚！
verses.meaningEn: Universal, all-encompassing, liberate! set free! release! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas' Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 普遍·光芒·圆满清净
verses.meaningEn: Universal + ray of light + O thoroughly pure
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas' Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 一切如来·心·加持·所加持
verses.meaningEn: All Tathagatas + heart + spiritual blessing + O blessed
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas' Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！再三阶位双手尊，大手印、大法契印尊
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O position of the hands / in position of the hands again and again, O Mahāmudrā, Great Seal / in Mahāmudrā, Great Seal
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas' Sanskrit edition.

verses.meaningZh: 以诸大手印真言章句，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Mahāmudrā + by, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase uṣṇīṣavijāyāpariśuddhe follows here in in Toh 595, 596, and 598, and in Hidas' Sanskrit edition.

verses.iast: oṃ traiyadhve sarvatathāgatahṛdayagarbhe jvala dharmadhātugarbhe saṃhāraṇa āyuḥ saṃśodhaya pāpaṃ sarvatathāgatasamantoṣṇīṣavimale viśuddhe svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，一切如来·心·藏，炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞），法界藏，一层深度，寿命、无量寿，桑请净除，罪业、恶不善业，一切如来·普遍·佛顶肉髻相·毘磨利，最极清净、究竟净除尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), all Tathagatas + heart + O womb, blaze forth with wisdom radiance! Dharmadhātu + O womb, layer + depth, life-force, longevity, saṃ + purify! cleanse! evil, karmic sin, unwholesome deed, all Tathagatas + universal + Uṣṇīṣa + pure, O completely purified, supremely pure / in completely purified, supremely pure, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emending the dative saṃśodhāya to the verbal imperative saṃśodhaya . This emendation is made in the subsequent formulas without further notation.

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，一切如来·心·藏，炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞），法界藏，一层深度，寿命、无量寿，桑请净除，罪业、恶不善业
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), all Tathagatas + heart + O womb, blaze forth with wisdom radiance! Dharmadhātu + O womb, layer + depth, life-force, longevity, saṃ + purify! cleanse! evil, karmic sin, unwholesome deed

verses.iast: sarvatathāgatasamantoṣṇīṣavimale viśuddhe mahāvirajera gambhīrasi dharmadhātugarbhe vivisāra a māmaki svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 一切如来·普遍·佛顶肉髻相·毘磨利，最极清净、究竟净除尊，大·嚩啰阇·风息，往·怖畏·多水分，法界藏，闢溶蚀，悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性，自己母，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: All Tathagatas + universal + Uṣṇīṣa + pure, O completely purified, supremely pure / in completely purified, supremely pure, great + free from dust + wind, to go + fear + O juicy, Dharmadhātu + O womb, settle + extending, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, O Mamaki bodhisattva, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 260.a–266.b · 藏文名：མཆོད་རྟེན་གྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: namo ratnatrayāya tadyathā sūkṣme sūkṣme śānte śānte dānte dānte nirākule yaśo yaśovati
verses.meaningZh: 归命向佛法僧三宝，即说咒曰：再三微细尊，再三寂静、调柔安稳尊，再三低调、佛口婆心尊，明白、赊多尊，美称，具足美称
verses.meaningEn: Homage to to/for the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha), Thus goes the mantra: O fine, small, minute, subtile, intangible, inconceivable, atomic / in fine, small, minute, subtile, intangible, inconceivable, atomic again and again, O peaceful, calm, tranquil / in peaceful, calm, tranquil again and again, O tamed, subdued, patient, passionless again and again, O not over-filled, yaśo, yaśovati
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 260.a–266.b · 藏文名：མཆོད་རྟེན་གྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: tejo śuddhe viśuddhe sarvatathāgata adhiṣṭhāna adhiṣṭhite ā namaḥ te hite svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 威光，清净、纯洁无染尊，最极清净、究竟净除尊，一切如来，加持、神力摄持，所加持、安住摄持尊，悉昙「ā」韵字门：远离寂静周遍，归命，向汝、彼等，利尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Tejo, O pure, cleansed, bright / in pure, cleansed, bright, O completely purified, supremely pure / in completely purified, supremely pure, all Tathagatas, spiritual blessing, empowerment,sustaining power, O blessed, empowered, consecrated / in blessed, empowered, consecrated, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'ā': expansive quiescence, homage to to Thee / they, O put, placed, laid, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur vol. 90 (rgyud ’bum, pha), folios 260.a–266.b · 藏文名：མཆོད་རྟེན་གྱི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: oṃ mahākālāya śāsanopakāriṇi eṣa apaścimakālo 'yam idaṃ ratnatrayāya apakāriṇaṃ yadi pratijñāṃ smarasi

verses.iast: tadyathā śavale avale sañjale nirdeśe nirjāte nirukte nirmukhe jvalaparicchedani sukhavatinirdeśe amṛte āyurgarbha
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：优势严，最上真言离言说·离一切相无相，一切诸谛圆满·圣智通达·生起不可得·尊胜，演说尊，揭帝、三婆吠尊，那罗尊，离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧，炽燃光明·品·在于，安乐妙善·一切诸谛圆满，甘露、不死妙法尊，寿命藏
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: superiority, supreme ineffable speech & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & non-dual wisdom awareness & transcending birth & victorious (vocative invocation), O elucidation / in elucidation, O gone or come forth or out, O explained, beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), blaze forth with wisdom radiance! + cutting + in, blissful (vocative invocation), O ambrosia, nectar of immortality / in ambrosia, nectar of immortality, life + womb
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Dege Toh 676, Yongle, Lithang, Kangxi, Chone, and Stok Palace read bha ; Dege Toh 850 reads ba .

verses.iast: nirhāni amṛte ayuḥprasādhane nirbuddhi ākāśanirdeśe ākāśanirjāte ākāśanirkuśale ākāśanirdarśane ākāśādhiṣṭhāne sukhavati ādhiṣṭhāne rūpanirdeśe
verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐，甘露、不死妙法尊，成办悉地·一乘如实之道，缺心眼、矬陋，虚空界演说尊，虚空界揭帝，造作离相·本性寂静止息·离名相假立，造作离相·本性寂静止息·离名相假立，虚空界加持，具足乐尊，法界总持任持·六度满行清净·远离虚妄安立，色演说尊
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy (vocative invocation), O ambrosia, nectar of immortality / in ambrosia, nectar of immortality, accomplishing (vocative invocation), senseless, stupid, ignorant, space + O elucidation, space + O gone or come forth or out, freedom from karmic agency & primordial tranquil peace & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), freedom from karmic agency & primordial tranquil peace & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), space + O spiritual blessing, O one endowed with easy, pleasant, comfortable, happy, Dharma-realm retention & perfection of the six pāramitās & beyond conceptual fabrication (vocative invocation), form + O elucidation
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Dege Toh 676, Yongle, Lithang, Kangxi, Chone, and Stok Palace read bha ; Dege Toh 850 reads ba .

verses.iast: catvāridharmaprasādhane catvāri āryasatyaprasādhane catvārimārgabhavanaprasādhane bala vīryaprasādhane dharmācchedane kuśale kuśalanirdeśe kuśalapratiṣṭhāne buddhākuśale viśuddhaprabhā
verses.meaningZh: 四·正法·庄严具，四，圣谛庄严具，四·圣道·住埸·庄严具，力、十力神通威神力，精进庄严具，驮·勿·除断尊，善、善根功德尊，善演说尊，善依止处，佛陀恶尊，最极清净光明
verses.meaningEn: Dharma + O accomplishing, catvāri, noble truth + O accomplishing, path + coming into existence + O accomplishing, power, strength, spiritual force, heroic energy + O accomplishing, dha + do not + O removing, O wholesome, virtuous, skillful / in wholesome, virtuous, skillful, wholesome + O elucidation, wholesome + O basis, Buddha + O evil, completely purified + light
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Dege Toh 676, Yongle, Lithang, Kangxi, Chone, and Stok Palace read bha ; Dege Toh 850 reads ba .

verses.meaningZh: 彼、此尊（阳性主格），自性不作为尊
verses.meaningEn: He, that one, nature + O non-doing
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Dege Toh 676, Yongle, Lithang, Kangxi, Chone, and Stok Palace read bha ; Dege Toh 850 reads ba .

verses.iast: nirjati nirbuddhe vimale viraje rājase rasāgre rasāgrabale rasāgrādhiṣṭhite kule pratikule vikule dānte
verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢·生起不可得·尊胜，觉悟正觉·离名相假立，毘磨利，嚩啰阇尊，清净离诸尘垢·生起不可得·尊胜·一切诸谛圆满，味儿尊，味儿力，味儿所加持，部族（佛，对部族尊，闢部族尊，低调、佛口婆心尊
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust & transcending birth & victorious (vocative invocation), awakened (vocative invocation), pure, O free from dust, stainless purity free from dust & transcending birth & victorious & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (vocative invocation), O (state of, possessing) excellent taste, excellent taste + O power, excellent taste + O blessed, O buddha-family, lineage / in buddha-family, lineage, toward + O buddha-family, settle + O buddha-family, O tamed, subdued, patient, passionless
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Dege Toh 850 reads dānte sudānta ; Dege Toh 676 and Stok Palace read dante sudante .

verses.iast: sudānta citte supraśāntacitte supratiṣṭhite sule sumukhīdharme ca dharme bale ca bale anuśābale
verses.meaningZh: 报刊往外低调，心、菩提心、心识尊，报刊往外·寂静·心，安住尊，一切诸谛圆满·离一切相无相，持守摄受·一切诸谛圆满以及正法、诸法实相尊，力、十力神通威神力尊以及力、十力神通威神力尊，离名相假立·本性寂静止息·解脱系缚大力
verses.meaningEn: Press out + tamed, O mind, heart, thought, bodhicitta / in mind, heart, thought, bodhicitta, press out + tranquillized + O mind, O well grounded or situated / in well grounded or situated, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), bearing (vocative invocation) and O Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena / in Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena, O power, strength, spiritual force / in power, strength, spiritual force and O power, strength, spiritual force / in power, strength, spiritual force, beyond nominal designation & primordial tranquil peace & spiritual strength freeing bonds (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Dege Toh 850 reads dānte sudānta ; Dege Toh 676 and Stok Palace read dante sudante .

verses.meaningEn: Buddha + space + O virtue, Buddha + not-joy + hail + O virtue, ambrosia + O vowel, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: namo ratnatrayāya namo bhagavate amitabhāya tathāgatāya arhate saṃyaksambuddhāya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝·世尊（薄伽梵）致敬·病人星宿·如来（乘如实道来成正觉）·应供（阿罗汉）致敬·桑·肝脏·随着·佛陀！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha), the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, sick, to, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, the Arhat, Worthy One, saṃ, the liver, along with, to!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：This reading is attested in Toh 851 as well as the Yongle, Narthang, and Lhasa (Zhol) editions of the Kangyur. Toh 679 reads gaganakīrtikari .

verses.iast: tadyathā oṃ amite amitodbhave amitasaṃbhave amitavikrānte amitagamini gaganakīrtikare sarvakleśakṣayaṃkare svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！病人、我身尊，病人氏族，病人三婆婆尊，病人勇健，趣入通行·无我大慈三昧，虚空·誉·掌尊，一切·烦恼·一样尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! O sick, sick + O origin, sick + O Sambhava, sick + O bold, going toward (vocative invocation), sky + renown + O palm, all + affliction + O the same, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: Oṃ , cara cara , ciri ciri , curu curu !
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三行持妙道、周游救护（左啰），再三久远常恒护持不退（唧哩），再三速疾运转妙法加持（祖噜）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , cara cara , ciri ciri , curu curu ! O great compassionate one! Ciri ciri , miri miri , curu curu ! O great compassionate one! Siri siri , ciri ciri , piri piri , viri viri ! O great one with a lotus in your hand! Kala kala , kili kili , kulu kulu ! O great pure being! Awaken, awaken! Cleanse, cleanse! Kaṇa kaṇa , kiṇi kiṇi , kuṇu kuṇu ! O supremely pure being! Kara kara , kiri kiri , kuru kuru ! You who attained great fortitude! Cala cala , saṃcala saṃcala , vicala vicala , eṭṭaṭṭa eṭṭaṭṭa , bhara bhara , bhiri bhiri , bhuru bhuru ! Come, come, O great compassionate one! You who wear the garb of great Paśupati! Wear, wear! Sara sara , cara cara , hara hara , hāhā hāhā , hīhī hīhī , hūhū hūhū ! You who wear the garb of Brahmā, the syllable oṃ ! Dhara dhara , dhiri dhiri , dhuru dhuru , tara tara , sara sara , para para , cara cara ! You with the body adorned with hundreds of thousands of light rays! Shine, shine! Heat up, heat up! O blessed sun and moon! You whose feet are worshiped by the hosts of ṛṣis and gods, by Yama, Varuṇa, Kubera, and Great Indra! Suru suru , curu curu , muru muru , puru puru ! You who wear many various garbs of ṛṣis and gods, of Sanatkumāra, Rudra, Vāsava, Viṣṇu, and Dhanada! Dhara dhara , dhiri dhiri , dhuru dhuru , thara thara , ghara ghara , yara yara , lara lara , hara hara , mara mara , para para , vara vara ! O boon giver who sees all around you! O great lord of the world who perceives precisely! Muhu muhu , muru muru , muya muya ! Save beings, save! You are the lord Noble Avalokiteśvara! Protect, protect me and all beings in the three worlds from every danger, every misfortune, every calamity, and from all grahas! O savior from bondage, imprisonment, beatings, threats, the king, thieves, robbers, fire, water, poison, and weapons! Kaṇa kaṇa , kiṇi kiṇi , kuṇu kuṇu , cara cara ! You teach about the sense faculties, the strengths, the limbs of awakening, and the four truths of the noble ones! Scorch, scorch! Tame, tame! Pacify, pacify! Masa masa ! O great being! Dispeller of darkness! Fulfiller of the six perfections! Mili mili , ṭaṭa ṭaṭa , ṭhaṭha ṭhaṭha , ṭiṭi ṭiṭi , ṭuṭu ṭuṭu ! You who wear a tunic of antelope skin! Come, come! You are the great lord who crushes the hordes of bhūtas! Act, act! Para para , kara kara , kaṭa kaṭa , maṭa maṭa ! You abide in the pure domain, O great compassionate one! You wear a white sacred thread and a diadem with a row of jewels—the diadem of omniscience atop your head. The palms of your hands are adorned with marvelous lotuses. Your meditative concentration, samādhi, and liberation are unshakable. You mature the mindstreams of many beings completely. O great compassionate one! Purifier of all karmic obscurations! Deliverer from all illness! Fulfiller of all wishes! Comforter of all beings! Homage be to you! Svāhā .
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ cara cara ciri ciri curu curu mahākāruṇika .

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , cara cara , ciri ciri , curu curu ! O great compassionate one! Ciri ciri , miri miri , curu curu ! O great compassionate one! Siri siri , ciri ciri , piri piri , viri viri ! O great one with a lotus in your hand! Kala kala , kili kili , kulu kulu ! O great pure being! Awaken, awaken! Cleanse, cleanse! Kaṇa kaṇa , kiṇi kiṇi , kuṇu kuṇu ! O supremely pure being! Kara kara , kiri kiri , kuru kuru ! You who attained great fortitude! Cala cala , saṃcala saṃcala , vicala vicala , eṭṭaṭṭa eṭṭaṭṭa , bhara bhara , bhiri bhiri , bhuru bhuru ! Come, come, O great compassionate one! You who wear the garb of great Paśupati! Wear, wear! Sara sara , cara cara , hara hara , hāhā hāhā , hīhī hīhī , hūhū hūhū ! You who wear the garb of Brahmā, the syllable oṃ ! Dhara dhara , dhiri dhiri , dhuru dhuru , tara tara , sara sara , para para , cara cara ! You with the body adorned with hundreds of thousands of light rays! Shine, shine! Heat up, heat up! O blessed sun and moon! You whose feet are worshiped by the hosts of ṛṣis and gods, by Yama, Varuṇa, Kubera, and Great Indra! Suru suru , curu curu , muru muru , puru puru ! You who wear many various garbs of ṛṣis and gods, of Sanatkumāra, Rudra, Vāsava, Viṣṇu, and Dhanada! Dhara dhara , dhiri dhiri , dhuru dhuru , thara thara , ghara ghara , yara yara , lara lara , hara hara , mara mara , para para , vara vara ! O boon giver who sees all around you! O great lord of the world who perceives precisely! Muhu muhu , muru muru , muya muya ! Save beings, save! You are the lord Noble Avalokiteśvara! Protect, protect me and all beings in the three worlds from every danger, every misfortune, every calamity, and from all grahas! O savior from bondage, imprisonment, beatings, threats, the king, thieves, robbers, fire, water, poison, and weapons! Kaṇa kaṇa , kiṇi kiṇi , kuṇu kuṇu , cara cara ! You teach about the sense faculties, the strengths, the limbs of awakening, and the four truths of the noble ones! Scorch, scorch! Tame, tame! Pacify, pacify! Masa masa ! O great being! Dispeller of darkness! Fulfiller of the six perfections! Mili mili , ṭaṭa ṭaṭa , ṭhaṭha ṭhaṭha , ṭiṭi ṭiṭi , ṭuṭu ṭuṭu ! You who wear a tunic of antelope skin! Come, come! You are the great lord who crushes the hordes of bhūtas! Act, act! Para para , kara kara , kaṭa kaṭa , maṭa maṭa ! You abide in the pure domain, O great compassionate one! You wear a white sacred thread and a diadem with a row of jewels—the diadem of omniscience atop your head. The palms of your hands are adorned with marvelous lotuses. Your meditative concentration, samādhi, and liberation are unshakable. You mature the mindstreams of many beings completely. O great compassionate one! Purifier of all karmic obscurations! Deliverer from all illness! Fulfiller of all wishes! Comforter of all beings! Homage be to you! Svāhā .
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ cara cara ciri ciri curu curu mahākāruṇika .

O great lord of the world who perceives precisely! Muhu muhu , muru muru , muya muya ! Save beings, save! You are the lord Noble Avalokiteśvara! Protect, protect me and all beings in the three worlds from every danger, every misfortune, every calamity, and from all grahas! O savior from bondage, imprisonment, beatings, threats, the king, thieves, robbers, fire, water, poison, and weapons! Kaṇa kaṇa , kiṇi kiṇi , kuṇu kuṇu , cara cara ! You teach about the sense faculties, the strengths, the limbs of awakening, and the four truths of the noble ones! Scorch, scorch! Tame, tame! Pacify, pacify! Masa masa ! O great being! Dispeller of darkness! Fulfiller of the six perfections! Mili mili , ṭaṭa ṭaṭa , ṭhaṭha ṭhaṭha , ṭiṭi ṭiṭi , ṭuṭu ṭuṭu ! You who wear a tunic of antelope skin! Come, come! You are the great lord who crushes the hordes of bhūtas! Act, act! Para para , kara kara , kaṭa kaṭa , maṭa maṭa ! You abide in the pure domain, O great compassionate one! You wear a white sacred thread and a diadem with a row of jewels—the diadem of omniscience atop your head. The palms of your hands are adorned with marvelous lotuses. Your meditative concentration, samādhi, and liberation are unshakable. You mature the mindstreams of many beings completely. O great compassionate one! Purifier of all karmic obscurations! Deliverer from all illness! Fulfiller of all wishes! Comforter of all beings! Homage be to you! Svāhā .

verses.iast: oṃ padmapāśadhara amogha varada sañcodaya hūṃ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！莲华持羂索尊，不空、决定成就无虚，施愿者、满善愿尊，一切诸谛圆满·圣智通达·妙行迁变空，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , O holder of a lotus noose who grants amogha boons! Arouse the buddhas, hūṃ !

verses.iast: Suru suru suru ! | O pure being, hūṃ !

verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ amogha pāśa padmottara siṃhāsana oṭi miri miri hūṃ .

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , amogha-settle within the circumference of the great lotus, hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：“Amogha” could be an adverb here qualifying “settle,” with the meaning “please settle the amogha way.”

verses.meaningZh: 再三迅疾度脱一切危厄（都噜）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , amogha lotus in the topknot! Turu turu ! Remain in the vajra knot, svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：“Amogha lotus” ( amoghapadma ) could also be an epithet of Amoghapāśa.

verses.meaningZh: 再三无畏威神震伏魔怨（毗利），吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , toss the lotus water of Amogha ! Bhiri bhiri , hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ amogha padmajalotkṣepa bhiri bhiri hūṃ .

verses.meaningZh: 再三多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·本不生体性），吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , amogha deformed water-container on a lotus seat! Full of water! Act, act, hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase amogha vikaṭasambhara is difficult to unravel.

verses.meaningZh: 再三耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , amogha purity within the expanse of the lotus! Carry, carry, svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ padmaprasare amogha vimale bhara bhara svāhā .

verses.meaningZh: 再三最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , amogha lotus, the auspicious pure lotus that brings fulfillment! Viri viri , svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Again, “amogha lotus” ( amoghapadma ) could be an epithet of Amoghapāśa.

verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·第一义谛，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·诸根清净自在），彼、彼尊（连音式），造作离相·第一义谛
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , amogha purity that purifies the tip of the tongue! Tender as lotus, please purify the tongue! Keep it so, keep! Auspicious purity, svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ amogha vimale jihvāgraṃ saṃśodhani padmakomalajihvā saṃśodhaya dhara dhara suvimale svāhā .

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , you with amogha lotus eyes and divine vision, completely pure! Suru suru ! O lotus-eyed one, bhuru bhuru ! You direct your gaze everywhere! Svāhā !

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！造作离相，跛字门（第一义谛（paramārtha）·损减除灭忧苦），造作离相，跛字门（第一义谛（paramārtha）·损减除灭忧苦），造作离相，跛字门（第一义谛（paramārtha）·损减除灭忧苦），离一切相无相·妙行迁变空·施度调伏
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation), ultimate truth (paramārtha) — dispelling sorrow, freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation), ultimate truth (paramārtha) — dispelling sorrow, freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation), ultimate truth (paramārtha) — dispelling sorrow, freedom from conditioned marks & awakened conduct beyond flux & generosity & self-mastery

verses.iast: Oṃ , amogha protection! Take effect, do!
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！不空、决定成就无虚，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，长柄、融通尊，妙行迁变空·真如实际，陀字门（施度调伏（dāna
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! unfailing, infallible, never in vain, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, O stem, demin, awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness, generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — consecrating Dharma-stream
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ amogha rakṣiṇi kuru kuru svāhā .

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！不空、决定成就无虚，三昧耶（本誓、平等契合、时际）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , amogha samaya! Remain within the great lotus, hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ amogha samaya mahāpadme tiṣṭha tiṣṭha hūṃ .

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , you who never fail in any way! Remain and protect, hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ sarvvatra amoghavati tiṣṭha rakṣatu hūṃ .

verses.meaningZh: 再三契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , you who overstep the three worlds with amogha lotus steps! Mili mili , svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ trailokya padmāmoghakramiṇi mili mili svāhā .

verses.meaningZh: 再三疾速拔济除障（虎噜），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , unfold within the lotus, the great lotus! Surround everything with the unfailing noose! Huru huru , svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ padme mahāpadme sara sara samantena pariveṣṭayāmoghapāśena huru huru svāhā .

verses.iast: Oṃ , bright multicolored amogha cloth! Effect purification! kiṇi kiṇi , hūṃ !
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·诸根清净自在），无我大慈三昧·离一切相无相·真如实际，不空、决定成就无虚，他字门（无住安立（sthāna）·摄受法流灌顶），妙行迁变空·真如实际，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·妙行迁变空，再三痕迹尊，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! immutable Suchness (tathatā) — purified faculties, selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from conditioned marks & immutable Suchness, unfailing, infallible, never in vain, non-abiding equipoise (sthāna) — consecrating Dharma-stream, awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & awakened conduct beyond flux, O thick hard skin, callosity, scar again and again, Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The page marker here reads [A.10.a] instead of the expected [A.9.b] because of the omission of an interpolated passage that is repeated later on, from A.16.b.4 to A.17.a.2 , where it contextually belongs.

Oṃ , diamond-tipped amogha arrow! Thara thara , svāhā !
Siri siri , svāhā !
Para para , hūṃ !
Shine, shine, svāhā !
Tuṭi tuṭi , svāhā !

verses.iast: Oṃ , diamond-tipped amogha arrow! Thara thara , svāhā !
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！施度调伏·无我大慈三昧·离名相假立，真如实际·第一义谛·施度调伏，不空、决定成就无虚，清净离诸尘垢，再三无住安立·清净离诸尘垢，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! generosity & self-mastery & selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation, immutable Suchness & ultimate truth & generosity & self-mastery, unfailing, infallible, never in vain, stainless purity free from dust, non-abiding equipoise & stainless purity free from dust again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ amogha śara vajra tuṇḍa thara thara svāhā .

verses.meaningZh: 再三吉祥福德流注庄严（悉哩，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , the great, completely pure, broad amogha gate! Siri siri , svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ vipulāmoghamahādvāraviśuddhe siri siri svāhā .

verses.meaningZh: 再三他人，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , you are filled and surrounded with various splendid amogha flowers and fruits! Para para , hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ nānāvicitra• amogha puṣpaphalatākīrṇapūrṇa para para hūṃ .

verses.meaningZh: 再三一切诸谛圆满·因缘空寂大乐·离名相假立，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , jewel amogha palace, consecrated with the sacrificial vessel, you are divinely fragrant and radiating light everywhere! Shine, shine, svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：It is not clear what kind of vessel it is. Kaṭaccha normally means “ladle,” but the context seems to indicate that itis a vessel for holding incense or a censer.

verses.meaningZh: 再三真如实际·断除憍慢执障，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , shining water jar, you cause the flow! Tuṭi tuṭi , svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ jvalavati ratnaghaṭa sāriṇi tuṭi tuṭi svāhā .

verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ amogha ratnasūtravare kiṇi kiṇi svāhā .

Amogha power! | Hold, hold, svāhā !

verses.iast: Oṃ , divine silver dish, fully filled!
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！放光勇健，一切诸谛圆满·离一切相无相·最上真言离言说，贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·损减除灭忧苦），离一切相无相·施度调伏
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , divine silver dish, fully filled! O amogha lotus, svāha !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ sampūrṇarūpyadivyabhājane 'moghapadme svāha .

verses.iast: oṃ vividharūpopahāropakaraṇa cala cala amoghavati svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！各个·色·施物·器皿，再三震动警觉、破除昏沉（左攞），具足不空、决定成就无虚尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , oblatory foods and implements! Move, move! You are not subject to failure, svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ vividharūpopahāropakaraṇa cala cala amoghavati svāhā .

verses.meaningZh: 不空、决定成就无虚，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢；再三陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , you serve with divine fragrances! Amogha power! Hold, hold, svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ divyagandhānusāriṇi amogha bale dhara dhara svāhā .

verses.meaningZh: 不空、决定成就无虚，一切诸谛圆满·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·诸根清净自在），最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , you spread fragrance! Amogha-spread it everywhere, hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ gandhaspharaṇi samantāmogha prasphura hūṃ .

verses.meaningZh: 攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·诸根清净自在），多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·诸根清净自在），攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·诸根清净自在），吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , you purify the body, making it immaculate! You fill it with divine fragrance! Fill it, fill, hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ nirmalakāyaśodhani divyagandhaprapūraṇi pūraya pūraya hūṃ .

verses.meaningZh: 再三速疾运转妙法加持（祖噜），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , you provide the full measure of scented powders! Curu curu , svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ gandhacūrṇaprapūraṇi curu curu svāhā .

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , supreme pure fragrance that evenly spreads everywhere! Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ samasamantena vimale gandhottare svāhā .

verses.iast: Fill it, O bringer of victory, svāhā !
verses.meaningZh: 攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·诸根清净自在），多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·诸根清净自在），悉昙「o」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，解脱系缚大力·清净离诸尘垢·离名相假立，悉昙「of」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，最上真言离言说·妙行迁变空·真如实际，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , you provide the full measure of divine fragrance! Divinely consecrated as the water of the ocean, you fill the interior of the water pitcher! Fill it, O bringer of victory, svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ divyagandhaprapūraṇi sāgara jaladivyādhiṣṭhite kalaśodaripūrṇa pūraya jayasiddhe svāhā .

verses.meaningZh: 解脱系缚大力·妙行迁变空·无我大慈三昧，妙行迁变空·无我大慈三昧·第一义谛，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , you possess the most exquisite of flavors! Blessed by all the vidyās! Become complete, hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ rasarasāgravati sarvvavidyādhiṣṭhita saṃpūraya hūṃ .

Oṃ , divine food of great splendor!
Sura prasura , hūṃ !
Tara tara , tuni , svāhā !
Stay on, stay! | Svāhā !
Svāhā !

verses.iast: Oṃ , divine food of great splendor!
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！放光勇健，施度调伏，悉昙「of」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，一切诸谛圆满·第一义谛·离一切相无相
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , divine food of great splendor! Fill the stomach, svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ divyabhojana saṃpūraya vipulaprabhe svāhā .

verses.meaningZh: 天神、天女，转载天神，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , the three “white” foods! Bali with a broad range of exquisite tastes! Sura prasura , hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ triśuklabhojana balivipularasāgravati sura prasura hūṃ .

verses.meaningZh: 再三弯曲、超群，真如实际·离名相假立，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , divine tree of the forest, rich in fruit and sap! Tara tara , tuni , svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ phalavati sāravati divyavanaspati tara tara tuni svāhā .

verses.meaningZh: 耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·摄受法流灌顶），耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性）；圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , you rain down various flowers such as celestial water lilies! Stay on, stay! Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ divyakusumotpalanānāpuṣpapravarṣaṇi bhava bhava svāhā .

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , forest tree overhung with various vines and flowers! Jar filled with food! Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：There may be some corruption here, as the second phrase in this mantra does not seem to belong with the first, or, possibly, the vines and flowers are meant to decorate the “jar filled with food.”

verses.iast: Oṃ , great cloud of incense! Envelope everything around! Hūṃ hūṃ , svāhā !
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，妙行迁变空·离一切相无相·施度调伏，悉昙「of」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，离名相假立·妙行迁变空·一切诸谛圆满，离名相假立·最上真言离言说·离一切相无相，最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，清净离诸尘垢·离名相假立·施度调伏，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, awakened conduct beyond flux & freedom from conditioned marks & generosity & self-mastery, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'of': consecrating Dharma-stream, beyond nominal designation & awakened conduct beyond flux & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (vocative invocation), beyond nominal designation & supreme ineffable speech & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening, stainless purity free from dust & beyond nominal designation & generosity & self-mastery, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ mahādhūpameghapaṭala saṃcchādaya samantena hūṃ hūṃ svāhā .

verses.iast: oṃ atharvaṇi jvala jvala deva mukhe svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！邪术、青黑魔法尊，再三炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞），天人、诸天护法，面门、尊颜、法门入口尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , magical being! Blaze, blaze! You are the face of the gods! Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ atharvaṇi jvala jvala deva mukhe svāhā .

Oṃ , various jewels! | Jewel, jewel, amogha jewel! | Svāhā !
Sama sama ! | Svāhā !
Mili mili , turiṇi , svāhā !
Hūṃ !
Ring, ring, hūṃ !

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·一切诸谛圆满，生起不可得·尊胜·离一切相无相·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , various jewels! Shining adornments of gold and precious stone! Jewel, jewel, amogha jewel! Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ vividhamaṇi kanakaratnojjvalabhūṣaṇa maṇi maṇi amogha maṇi svāhā .

verses.meaningZh: 再三生起不可得·尊胜·离一切相无相，不空、决定成就无虚，生起不可得·尊胜·离一切相无相
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , various jewels! Shining adornments of gold and precious stone! Jewel, jewel, amogha jewel! Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ vividhamaṇi kanakaratnojjvalabhūṣaṇa maṇi maṇi amogha maṇi svāhā .

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , various jewels! Shining adornments of gold and precious stone! Jewel, jewel, amogha jewel! Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ vividhamaṇi kanakaratnojjvalabhūṣaṇa maṇi maṇi amogha maṇi svāhā .

verses.meaningZh: 再三平；圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ oṃ , lotus hands! Sama sama ! Fingers with broad fingernails! Blessed by all the tathāgatas! Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ oṃ padmakare vipulanakhāṅguli sama sama sarvatathāgatādhiṣṭhite svāhā .

verses.meaningZh: 再三契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利），具迅疾、踊跃尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , bowing my head, I pay homage to the perfect one with all the qualities! Mili mili , turiṇi , svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ sarvaguṇāpratihataśirovandanayā namaskaromi mili mili turiṇi svāhā .

verses.meaningZh: 吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , may my homage extend through the ten directions! Hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ daśadiśābhivandanaprasaratu hūṃ .

verses.meaningZh: 再三誐字门（妙行趣入（gati）·诸根清净自在），吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , you with the divine amogha sound that spreads far and wide! You with a sweet tone! Ring, ring, hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ divyāmoghavipulasvare madhuranighoṣarute raṇa raṇa hūṃ .

verses.iast: Oṃ , dhuru dhuru ! Bring over! O speedy one, hūṃ !
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三坚固任持总持法印（度噜），誐字门（妙行趣入（gati）·诸根清净自在），最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，悉昙「o」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，一切诸谛圆满·第一义谛·施度调伏，离名相假立，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! firmly uphold the dhāraṇī seal! again and again, awakened spiritual movement (gati) — purified faculties, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'o': consecrating Dharma-stream, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & ultimate truth & generosity & self-mastery, beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ dhuru dhuru āvāhaya śīghrajave hūṃ .

verses.iast: oṃ duṣṭasattvavibodhani sama samaya dhare svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！暴恶者·有情·闢·带劲，平，三昧耶（本誓、平等契合、时际），请执持、总持护念！尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , you bring realization to wicked beings! Sama , holder of the samaya, svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Possibly, sama was added before samaya ( sama samaya ˚) for the sake of alliteration and rhythm, as is common in mantras.
