provenance.rawSnippet: Oṃ , bright jewels, turned many times, hūṃ !

verses.iast: Oṃ , bright jewels, turned many times, hūṃ !
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·诸根清净自在），生起不可得·尊胜·离一切相无相·一切诸谛圆满，敦促溢出，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），真如实际·无我大慈三昧·一切诸谛圆满，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! immutable Suchness (tathatā) — purified faculties, transcending birth & victorious & freedom from conditioned marks & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, hasten + overflow, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, immutable Suchness & selfless great loving-kindness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ vicitramaṇi vipulapravartani hūṃ .

provenance.rawSnippet:
Oṃ , divine, unfailing eye!
Tara tara !
oṃ divyasaṃpūraṇi nāga vilokani hūṃ
Fill it up!
Spread! | Sura sura !
Blazing flames! | Svāhā !

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！放光勇健，离名相假立·离一切相无相·妙行趣入，一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , divine, unfailing eye! Supreme and perfect! Blessed by all the vidyās! Your perception is pure, svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ divyalocane amoghe pravare sarvavidyādhiṣṭhitasiddhe śuddhavilokite svāhā .

verses.meaningZh: 再三弯曲、超群
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , amogha lotus, you are an all-encompassing residence! Tara tara ! Depart to your homes, svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ amogha padme samantabhuvane tara tara gacchasva bhavanaṃ svāhā .

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！天妙·桑·遂尊，龙族、大龙王，模样、转眼尊，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , divine fulfiller with an elephant's gaze, hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：“Elephant's gaze” is a type of gazing. For example, the Buddha gazed at the city of Vaiśālī before he died with an “elephant's gaze.” It is not clear though how this relates to the monk's staff.

verses.meaningZh: 攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·诸根清净自在），多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·诸根清净自在），跛字门（第一义谛（paramārtha）·损减除灭忧苦）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , filler of the alms bowl! Fill it up! You with a radiating halo who never fails, svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ pātrapūraṇi pūraya amogha vati samantaprabhe svāhā .

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢；再三天神、天女
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , the bed of darbha grass blessed by the vidyās! Spread! Sura sura ! You are worshiped by sages, svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ darbharasaṃstara vidyādhiṣṭhita prasara sura sura ṛṣi pūjite svāhā (after emending durbha ˚ to darbha ˚).

verses.meaningZh: 解脱系缚大力·离一切相无相·离名相假立，离一切相无相·无我大慈三昧·一切诸谛圆满；圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , fire and smoke! Blazing flames! Impregnated with light! Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ jvaladhūmajvālaśikhiraśmigarbhe svāhā .

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！第一义谛·施度调伏·无我大慈三昧，莲花座尊，殊胜最妙尊，龙族、大龙王，世间、法界刹土尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！

Oṃ , sky traveler!
oṃ sarvatrāmoghābhiṣekamahācūḍāvimale abhiṣiñcantu māṃ pravarapāṇibhuje padmadhvaje svāhā

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , sky traveler! Move and make move! You make the feet move, hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ khacāriṇi gama gamaya pādapracāriṇi hūṃ .

verses.iast: oṃ sarvatrāmoghābhiṣekamahācūḍāvimale abhiṣiñcantu māṃ pravarapāṇibhuje padmadhvaje svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！一切处·不空·灌顶·大·髻·毘磨利，愿一切如来普施甘露灌顶！于我，最妙·手掌·臂，莲华宝幢，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , the pure, universal amogha empowerment applied to the top of the head! O holder of a lotus banner with fine arms and hands, consecrate me, svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ sarvatrāmoghābhiṣekamahācūḍāvimale abhiṣiñcantu māṃ pravarapāṇibhuje padmadhvaje svāhā .

oṃ amogha vikurvitasamantāvalokāya namas | tryadhvādhiṣṭhitā · amogha padme cara vicara sañcara hūṃ hūṃ
Hold it, hold! | O great being, hūṃ !
Ciri ciri ciri !
Curu curu , hūṃ phaṭ !

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！不空、决定成就无虚，向神变普遍观，至心归命礼！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , homage to you with a miraculous panoptic amogha vision! O amogha lotus of the tathāgatas who are established throughout the three times! Be active, diffuse, and unite, hūṃ hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ amogha vikurvitasamantāvalokāya namas | tryadhvādhiṣṭhitā · amogha padme cara vicara sañcara hūṃ hūṃ .

verses.iast: tryadhvādhiṣṭhitā · amogha padme cara vicara sañcara hūṃ hūṃ
verses.meaningZh: 三世所加持，不空、决定成就无虚，莲华（出淤泥而不染清净心）尊，行持妙道、周游救护（左啰），闢行持妙道，妙行流布·一切诸谛圆满，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , homage to you with a miraculous panoptic amogha vision! O amogha lotus of the tathāgatas who are established throughout the three times! Be active, diffuse, and unite, hūṃ hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ amogha vikurvitasamantāvalokāya namas | tryadhvādhiṣṭhitā · amogha padme cara vicara sañcara hūṃ hūṃ .

verses.iast: Hold it, hold! | O great being, hūṃ !
verses.meaningZh: 陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·诸根清净自在），陀字门（施度调伏（dāna；悉昙「o」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，解脱系缚大力·离名相假立·妙行趣入，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , amogha lotus-goad! Catch, catch the samaya! Hold it, hold! O great being, hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：“Amogha lotus-goad” ( amogha padmāṅkuśa ) should be interpreted here in the literal sense of a goad or hook that catches and holds the samaya, and also as the name of the deity Amoghapadmāṅkuśa.

verses.meaningZh: 再三久远常恒护持不退（唧哩）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , Amoghapadma, the great being! Please come into this maṇḍala! Ciri ciri ciri ! You with the lotus in your hand, svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ amogha padma mahāsattva āyātu-m-iha maṇḍale ciri ciri ciri padmabhuje svāhā .

verses.meaningZh: 再三速疾运转妙法加持（祖噜），吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , great boundary, formed around [this place] as the diamond-hard amogha lotus! Protect me! Curu curu , hūṃ phaṭ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ amogha vajra dṛḍhapadmabandha samantena mahāsīmā rakṣantu māṃ curu curu hūṃ phaṭ .

Oṃ , vajra! | Assume, assume it, hūṃ ! | Dhiri tuṭi , svāhā !
Viri viri , O pure one, svāhā !
Hūṃ !
Conferrer of amogha boons! | Bhiri bhiri , svāhā !

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , vajra! Vajra-blessed lotus that assumes the universal form! Assume, assume it, hūṃ ! Enter the course of the three times! Dhiri tuṭi , svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：In the iconography of the lotus, “universal” form implies a multicolored double lotus.

verses.meaningZh: 再三一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·诸根清净自在），吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , vajra! Vajra-blessed lotus that assumes the universal form! Assume, assume it, hūṃ ! Enter the course of the three times! Dhiri tuṭi , svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：In the iconography of the lotus, “universal” form implies a multicolored double lotus.

verses.meaningZh: 禅定坚固总持不失（地利），真如实际·断除憍慢执障，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , vajra! Vajra-blessed lotus that assumes the universal form! Assume, assume it, hūṃ ! Enter the course of the three times! Dhiri tuṭi , svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：In the iconography of the lotus, “universal” form implies a multicolored double lotus.

verses.iast: Viri viri , O pure one, svāhā !
verses.meaningZh: 再三最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，悉昙「o」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，原来、之前，离名相假立，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , the water of amogha lotus, purify, hūṃ ! Viri viri , O pure one, svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ amogha padmajale viśodhaya hūṃ viri viri vimale svāhā .

verses.meaningZh: 吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , amogha lotus lord, firm as diamond! Hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ amogha vajra dṛḍha padmeśvara hūṃ .

verses.iast: Conferrer of amogha boons! | Bhiri bhiri , svāhā !
verses.meaningZh: 妙行迁变空·离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢，悉昙「of」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，不空、决定成就无虚，解脱系缚大力·离名相假立·一切诸谛圆满；再三无畏威神震伏魔怨（毗利），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , lotus lord! Conferrer of amogha boons! Bhiri bhiri , svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ padmeśvara amogha varada bhiri bhiri svāhā .

Oṃ , turu turu !
oṃ amogha hṛdayapadme dhara dhara padmadhara mahā maṇḍala hṛdaya hūṃ
Bhuru bhuru !
O jewel among lotuses! | Hūṃ !

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！再三迅疾度脱一切危厄（都噜）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , turu turu ! The lotus-related amogha accomplishment, hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ turu turu padme amogha siddhiṃ hūṃ .

verses.iast: oṃ amogha hṛdayapadme dhara dhara padmadhara mahā maṇḍala hṛdaya hūṃ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！不空、决定成就无虚，心莲华尊，再三请执持、总持护念！持莲华（出淤泥而不染清净心）尊，大、摩诃（广大无边），曼荼罗、坛城轮圆具足，心、心髓、根本心咒，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , the lotus with an amogha heart essence! Hold it, hold, O lotus holder! The essence of the great maṇḍala, hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ amogha hṛdayapadme dhara dhara padmadhara mahā maṇḍala hṛdaya hūṃ .

verses.meaningZh: 再三破有相福德光·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , O noose-holding lord of unfree beings, with a body adorned with hundreds of thousands of light rays! Pull them in! Awaken them, awaken them fully! Bhuru bhuru ! You are the master of the unfailing noose, hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ paśupati pāśadharaḥ śatasahasraraśmipratimaṇḍitakāya ākarṣaṇi bodhani saṃbodhani bhuru bhuru amogha pāśasiddhe hūṃ .

verses.meaningZh: 悉昙「o」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，生起不可得·尊胜·离一切相无相，无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·妙行趣入，离一切相无相·真如实际·一切诸谛圆满；吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , you who abide in the three times, consecrate me with all the consecrations of the three times! O jewel among lotuses! Auspicious amogha lotus, blessed by all the tathāgatas! Hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ tryadhvānugatābhiṣiñcatu sarvvatryadhvābhiṣekaiḥ padmamaṇi supadme amoghe sarvatathāgatādhiṣṭhite hūṃ .

oṃ krodha rāja mahāmogha hana hana sarvvaduṣṭān hūṃ
Turu turu , hūṃ !
Huru huru , svāhā !
Tara tara , hūṃ !
Kuṇḍa kuṇḍa , svāhā !
Succeed, succeed, hūṃ !
Hūṃ !

verses.iast: oṃ krodha rāja mahāmogha hana hana sarvvaduṣṭān hūṃ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！忿，王，大没用，再三击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），一切暴恶者，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , Krodharāja, great and unfailing! Strike, strike all the villains, hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ krodha rāja mahāmogha hana hana sarvvaduṣṭān hūṃ .

verses.meaningZh: 再三迅疾度脱一切危厄（都噜），吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , lotus-like Tārā! Turu turu , hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ padmatāre turu turu hūṃ .

verses.meaningZh: 再三疾速拔济除障（虎噜），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , great lotus-like, white-bodied goddess! Huru huru , svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ mahāpadme śvetāṅge huru huru svāhā .

verses.meaningZh: 再三弯曲、超群，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , lotus-like Bhṛkuṭī! Tara tara , hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ bhṛkuṭi padme tara tara hūṃ .

verses.meaningZh: 再三手残者，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , lotus-like Pāṇḍaravāsinī! Kuṇḍa kuṇḍa , svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ padme pāṇḍaravāsini kuṇḍa kuṇḍa svāhā .

verses.meaningZh: 再三高显超胜·一切诸谛圆满，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , the giver of the boons of Amoghapadma! Succeed, succeed, hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ amogha padmavarade sidhya sidhyatu hūṃ .

verses.meaningZh: 吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , you visit everywhere! Bring them here, O fierce goddess! Hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ sarvatra gāmini āvāhaya raudriṇi hūṃ .

Oṃ , Amoghinī! | Harlot!
Oṃ , dāru ! | Amogha , hūṃ !

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！具不空、决定成就无虚佛母；因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢·离一切相无相
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , Amoghinī! Harlot! Deliver beings! O lotus-armed one, hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ amoghini vāre tāraya padmabhuje hūṃ .

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！宝树；不空、决定成就无虚，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , dāru ! Fresh lotus! Amogha , hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Reading tarula as taruṇa (the letters la and ṇa look similar in the Māgadhī script). The original tarula could mean “small tree,” which is also possible, as the preceding dāru means “tree.”

verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ padmeśvari sādhaya hūṃ .

Oṃ , Samarī! Ture ture , hūṃ !
Hūṃ !
Muru muru , hūṃ !
Hūṃ !
Hūṃ !
Svāhā !

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！遭遇、战斗佛母，再三迅疾、踊跃尊，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! encounter, fight (feminine), O quick, eager, prompt, willing / in quick, eager, prompt, willing again and again, Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ samari ture ture hūṃ .

verses.meaningZh: 吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , lotus goddess of the nāgas! Hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The meaning of this phrase is unclear, but this mantra seems to be associated with the mudrā of Varuṇa (in the list of mudrās above), which was for controlling the nāgas.

verses.meaningZh: 再三速疾摧碎烦恼结缚（亩噜），吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , general of the yakṣas! Muru muru , hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ yakṣādhipati muru muru hūṃ .

verses.meaningZh: 吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , Amogha , you are Brahmā's delight! Hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The Skt. compound brahmārate could be translated in more than one way. If dissolved as brahma - a - rate , it could mean “unceasing as brahman” etc.

verses.meaningZh: 吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , amogha-armed, you grant the boons of the ṛṣis! Hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：This could be “of the ṛṣis” or “to the ṛṣis.”

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , King Amogha-Viṣṇu with a lotus growing out of your navel and arms surrounded by water! Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ amogha viṣṇu rājapadmanābhe sarasamantabhuje svāhā .

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！无住安立·一切诸谛圆满·离名相假立，清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·施度调伏，离名相假立，吽（金刚心印）！梭，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！

verses.meaningZh: 吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , the light of Soma! Hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ soma prabhe hūṃ .

verses.iast: Oṃ , fearless boon giver! Tuṭi , hūṃ !
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！清净离诸尘垢·离一切相无相·一切诸谛圆满，解脱系缚大力·离名相假立，妙行趣入·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，真如实际·断除憍慢执障，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! stainless purity free from dust & freedom from conditioned marks & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, spiritual strength freeing bonds & beyond nominal designation, awakened spiritual movement & supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust, immutable Suchness & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation), Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ abhayavarade tuṭi hūṃ .

verses.meaningZh: 再三无畏威神震伏魔怨（毗利），吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , blessed by all the tathāgatas! Bhiri bhiri , hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ sarvatathāgatādhiṣṭhite bhiri bhiri hūṃ .

verses.meaningZh: 吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , the lotus-essence fist! Hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ padmahṛdayamuṣṭi hūṃ .

verses.meaningZh: 无住安立·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际；吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , remove, remove all impurities! Threaten! Hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ visara visara sarvamalān tarjaya hūṃ .

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！再三生起不可得·尊胜·离一切相无相，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! transcending birth & victorious & freedom from conditioned marks again and again, Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ maṇi maṇi hūṃ .

verses.meaningZh: 吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , the victory abounding in flowers! Hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ puṣpavati jaye hūṃ .

verses.meaningZh: 吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , you who hold the noose of compassion, hold it! Hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ bodhicittapāśadhara dhara hūṃ .

verses.meaningZh: 吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , you with the lotus noose, completely pure! Hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ padmapāśaviśuddhe hūṃ .

verses.meaningZh: 再三速疾摧碎烦恼结缚（亩噜），吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , you with the vajra noose, may you be so! Muru muru , hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ vajra pāśe bhavatu muru muru hūṃ .

verses.meaningZh: 吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , you with the noose that is like a wish-fulfilling jewel, the giver of boons! Hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ cintāmaṇipāśavarade hūṃ .

verses.meaningZh: 再三坚固任持总持法印（度噜），吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , you with the discus-noose, the crusher! Dhuru dhuru , hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ cakrapāśāsuranirghātaka dhuru dhuru hūṃ .

verses.meaningZh: 吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , you with the trident noose! Watch over me and deliver me from suffering! Hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ triśūlīpāśa vilokaya tāraya hūṃ .

verses.meaningZh: 吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , you with the noose that binds nāgas! Bind and pull them in! Bring down the wicked nāgas with your noose! Hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ nāga pāśa bandhayākaḍḍhaya duṣṭa nāga pāśa pātaya hūṃ .

verses.meaningZh: 吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , you who originate in the waters! Tear them, tear apart! Hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ jalodbhava dara dāraya hūṃ .

verses.meaningZh: 吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , pure as the moon! Dispel the darkness, O supreme light! Hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Reading (on the authority of the Tib. transliteration) raśmidhare as raśmivare .

provenance.rawSnippet:
Oṃ , universal Amogha ! | Hūṃ !
Act, act, be active! | Be victorious, be! | Assail evil, assail, assail! | Hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ , phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ ! | O compassionate one, be awake, be! | Awaken, awaken others! | O great Amoghasiddhi, hūṃ hūṃ ! | Give me an initiation! | Bhuva svāhā ! | Bhūr bhuva svāhā ! | Svāhā to Amoghavipula! | O great Amoghasiddhi! | Hūṃ phaṭ , svāhā !
Hūṃ phaṭ , svāhā !

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！离名相假立·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，不空、决定成就无虚；吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , universal Amogha ! Succeed, succeed, and bring success! Hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ sarvatrāmogha sidhya sidhya sādhaya hūṃ .

verses.meaningZh: 再三多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·本不生体性），跋字门（解脱系缚大力（bala，妙行迁变空·真如实际·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , the great wish-fulfilling jewel in the lotus! Jewel, jewel, the amogha jewel, the good jewel, the great jewel! The great amogha jewel that adorns all the tathāgatas! Act, act, be active! O lord of spirits that roam at night! The great lotus-armed one! The most compassionate boon giver! The great and most excellent bodhisattva who can assume any form! You hold a lotus, sit on a lotus seat, wear a lotus diadem and garland, and are adorned with many lotuses. You have a thousand arms, a thousand eyes, and various magical implements, and your thousand arms are adorned with mudrā gestures. Be victorious, be! Your body is adorned with hundreds of thousands of light rays. O wearer of fine adornments, wear them, wear! Your body is adorned with jewels, gold, diamonds, beryls, emeralds, sapphires, and corals, ciri ciri ! You are a great boon-granting bodhisattva of illustrious conduct. You assume the forms of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara. You take on the form of the lotus lord, the lokeśvara, and the eternal lord. You wear the garb of Yama, Varuṇa, Kubera, the sages, and the general Kumāra, dhara dhara , dhiri dhiri , dhūra dhūra ! You, consecrated by all the tathāgatas, assume the form of the four great elements. Remember your samaya, O lord! Make the moon full! Ferry beings to the other shore! Train the beings! Threaten the wicked ones! Bring down the vighnas! Kill those who are stained by the three faults! Assail evil, assail, assail! Hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ , phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ ! Succeed, succeed, O holder of the unfailing noose with its great wish-fulfilling jewel! Bring accomplishment! Grant me the great accomplishment of the goddess of the threefold universe! O compassionate one, be awake, be! Awaken, awaken others! Awaken them fully! You wear the garb of the great Paśupati. Please display your infinite power of magical transformation! Turū turū , you travel across the sky. Homage to you who are seen inside a grand palace! You hold a large treasure trove of merit. O great Amoghasiddhi, hūṃ hūṃ ! Give me an initiation! You confer great fame of the goddess of the threefold universe, svāhā ! Bhuva svāhā ! Bhūr bhuva svāhā ! Svāhā to Amoghavipula! Svāhā to the one who grants the accomplishment of the wish-fulfilling jewel! Svāhā to him who grants all the supreme accomplishments! Oṃ , majestic lord, lord of the world, great lord, you are a great wish-fulfilling jewel! O great Amoghasiddhi! Hūṃ phaṭ , svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Reading nisā ° as niśā ° (“night”); however, this translation is dubious.

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , the great wish-fulfilling jewel in the lotus! Jewel, jewel, the amogha jewel, the good jewel, the great jewel! The great amogha jewel that adorns all the tathāgatas! Act, act, be active! O lord of spirits that roam at night! The great lotus-armed one! The most compassionate boon giver! The great and most excellent bodhisattva who can assume any form! You hold a lotus, sit on a lotus seat, wear a lotus diadem and garland, and are adorned with many lotuses. You have a thousand arms, a thousand eyes, and various magical implements, and your thousand arms are adorned with mudrā gestures. Be victorious, be! Your body is adorned with hundreds of thousands of light rays. O wearer of fine adornments, wear them, wear! Your body is adorned with jewels, gold, diamonds, beryls, emeralds, sapphires, and corals, ciri ciri ! You are a great boon-granting bodhisattva of illustrious conduct. You assume the forms of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara. You take on the form of the lotus lord, the lokeśvara, and the eternal lord. You wear the garb of Yama, Varuṇa, Kubera, the sages, and the general Kumāra, dhara dhara , dhiri dhiri , dhūra dhūra ! You, consecrated by all the tathāgatas, assume the form of the four great elements. Remember your samaya, O lord! Make the moon full! Ferry beings to the other shore! Train the beings! Threaten the wicked ones! Bring down the vighnas! Kill those who are stained by the three faults! Assail evil, assail, assail! Hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ , phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ ! Succeed, succeed, O holder of the unfailing noose with its great wish-fulfilling jewel! Bring accomplishment! Grant me the great accomplishment of the goddess of the threefold universe! O compassionate one, be awake, be! Awaken, awaken others! Awaken them fully! You wear the garb of the great Paśupati. Please display your infinite power of magical transformation! Turū turū , you travel across the sky. Homage to you who are seen inside a grand palace! You hold a large treasure trove of merit. O great Amoghasiddhi, hūṃ hūṃ ! Give me an initiation! You confer great fame of the goddess of the threefold universe, svāhā ! Bhuva svāhā ! Bhūr bhuva svāhā ! Svāhā to Amoghavipula! Svāhā to the one who grants the accomplishment of the wish-fulfilling jewel! Svāhā to him who grants all the supreme accomplishments! Oṃ , majestic lord, lord of the world, great lord, you are a great wish-fulfilling jewel! O great Amoghasiddhi! Hūṃ phaṭ , svāhā !

verses.meaningZh: 吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , I salute you, O blazing fire, blazing brightly with large flames and a halo of light. You are the omniscient fire of sacrificial oblations, burning hot with smoke and hissing sounds; the flames are your face. As hot and bright as a forest fire or lightning, your main function is to consume oblations. You are the great energy, the great victory, the great power, and the destructive ability of all gods and yakṣas. Burning everything, you freely expand through space in cloud-like swirls. You are universally worshiped and honored as a fearless form of the divine. You are a bringer of winds and the oblation-eating god, Hutāśana. When there is darkness, you dispel it by radiating light. You have the fragrance of beautyberry and are born from the tastes of the best of fruits and food. Beloved, you are subtle, very sharp, and a reviver of the dead. Ashes for flowers and ashes for clothing, ashes are useful—they are always used to cover. You arise within the billows of smoke. Accomplished in cooking, you bring out the best of flavors. You run everywhere, wiping out everything. Once you touch and sting, you don't want to let go. Among the gods of the thirty-two abodes, you are the chief god of fire. You give vitality and strength to those without appetite. You are a great fire priest, the fearless god of gods, always the most noble. Swiftly make the rites truly successful! Oṃ , burn, burn! Remain! Huru , huru the samaya! Hūṃ phaṭ , svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Hutāśana, another name of Agni, the god of fire, simply means “oblation eater.” It is repeated twice in the text, once as the name and once meant literally, though it could also be an instance of dittography.

verses.iast: Oṃ , cara cara , ciri ciri , curu curu , O greatly compassionate!
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三行持妙道、周游救护（左啰），再三久远常恒护持不退（唧哩），再三速疾运转妙法加持（祖噜），悉昙「o」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，妙行迁变空·无我大慈三昧·第一义谛
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , cara cara , ciri ciri , curu curu , O greatly compassionate! Viri viri , piri piri , ciri ciri , O supremely compassionate! Siri siri , piri piri , ciri ciri , O great one with the lotus in your hand! Kala kala , kili kili , kulu kulu , O great pure being! Come, come! Awaken, awaken! Cleanse, cleanse! Kaṇa kaṇa , kiṇi kiṇi , kuṇu kuṇu , O supremely pure being! Kara kara , kiri kiri , kuru kuru , you of great tenacity! Cala cala , sañcala sañcala , vicala vicala , eṭaṭa eṭaṭa , bhara bhara , bhiri bhiri , bhuru bhuru , come, come, O greatly compassionate! You wear the garb of the great Paśupati, wear, wear, sara sara , cara cara , hara hara ! Hā hā hā hā ! Hī hī hī hī ! Hū hū hū hū ! You wear the garb of Oṃkāra Brahmā, wear, wear, dhiri dhiri , dhuru dhuru , tara tara , sara sara , para para , cara cara , vara vara ! Your body is adorned with hundreds of thousands of beautiful rays of light! Blaze, blaze, heat up, heat up! O lord whose feet are worshiped by Soma, Āditya, Yama, Varuṇa, Kubera, Brahmā, Indra, and the hosts of ṛṣis and gods, suru suru , curu curu , puru puru , muru muru ! You are the leader of sages and gods such as Sanatkumāra, Rudra, Vāsava, Viṣṇu, and Dhanada! You wear many garbs, wear, wear, dhiri dhiri , dhuru dhuru , thara thara , ghara ghara , yara yara , lara lara , hara hara , mara mara , vara vara ! You, the great boon-granting lokeśvara lord with panoptic vision, muhu muhu , muru muru , muya muya , liberate, liberate! Noble Lord Avalokiteśvara, protect me, protect me and all beings from all dangers, misfortunes, and disasters, and from all the grahas and diseases! You deliver from all killings, imprisonment, abuses by the kings, thieves, bandits, fires, floods, poisons, and weapons! Kaṇa kaṇa , kiṇi kiṇi , kuṇu kuṇu , cara cara ! You teach about the sense faculties, the strengths, the limbs of awakening, and the four truths of the noble ones! Tama tama , dama dama , sama sama , masa masa ! You are the great being who dispels darkness and grants the fulfillment of the six perfections! Mili mili , taṭa taṭa , ṭhaṭha ṭhaṭha , ṭiṭi ṭiṭi , ṭuṭu ṭuṭu , ṭhiṭhi ṭhiṭhi , ṭhuṭhu ṭhuṭhu ! You who wear a sash made from the skin of black antelope, come, come! You who crush Īśvara, Maheśvara, and the hordes of the great bhūtas, act, act, para para , kaṭa kaṭa , maṭa maṭa ! You, greatly compassionate, abide in the pure sphere! You wear a white sacred thread, a jewel diadem, and a rosary! Your head is crowned with the omniscient one, and the extraordinary palms of your hands are like lotuses! Being unshakeable, you produce meditative absorption, one-pointed concentration, and liberation! You bring the mindstreams of many beings to maturity. Being very compassionate, you purify all the karmic obscurations! You save from all diseases, you fulfill all hopes, and you bring comfort to all beings! Homage be to you! Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Reading saṃvicala as vicala following the Tib.

Kaṇa kaṇa , kiṇi kiṇi , kuṇu kuṇu , O supremely pure being! Kara kara , kiri kiri , kuru kuru , you of great tenacity! Cala cala , sañcala sañcala , vicala vicala , eṭaṭa eṭaṭa , bhara bhara , bhiri bhiri , bhuru bhuru , come, come, O greatly compassionate! You wear the garb of the great Paśupati, wear, wear, sara sara , cara cara , hara hara ! Hā hā hā hā ! Hī hī hī hī ! Hū hū hū hū ! You wear the garb of Oṃkāra Brahmā, wear, wear, dhiri dhiri , dhuru dhuru , tara tara , sara sara , para para , cara cara , vara vara ! Your body is adorned with hundreds of thousands of beautiful rays of light! Blaze, blaze, heat up, heat up! O lord whose feet are worshiped by Soma, Āditya, Yama, Varuṇa, Kubera, Brahmā, Indra, and the hosts of ṛṣis and gods, suru suru , curu curu , puru puru , muru muru ! You are the leader of sages and gods such as Sanatkumāra, Rudra, Vāsava, Viṣṇu, and Dhanada! You wear many garbs, wear, wear, dhiri dhiri , dhuru dhuru , thara thara , ghara ghara , yara yara , lara lara , hara hara , mara mara , vara vara ! You, the great boon-granting lokeśvara lord with panoptic vision, muhu muhu , muru muru , muya muya , liberate, liberate! Noble Lord Avalokiteśvara, protect me, protect me and all beings from all dangers, misfortunes, and disasters, and from all the grahas and diseases! You deliver from all killings, imprisonment, abuses by the kings, thieves, bandits, fires, floods, poisons, and weapons! Kaṇa kaṇa , kiṇi kiṇi , kuṇu kuṇu , cara cara ! You teach about the sense faculties, the strengths, the limbs of awakening, and the four truths of the noble ones! Tama tama , dama dama , sama sama , masa masa ! You are the great being who dispels darkness and grants the fulfillment of the six perfections! Mili mili , taṭa taṭa , ṭhaṭha ṭhaṭha , ṭiṭi ṭiṭi , ṭuṭu ṭuṭu , ṭhiṭhi ṭhiṭhi , ṭhuṭhu ṭhuṭhu ! You who wear a sash made from the skin of black antelope, come, come! You who crush Īśvara, Maheśvara, and the hordes of the great bhūtas, act, act, para para , kaṭa kaṭa , maṭa maṭa ! You, greatly compassionate, abide in the pure sphere! You wear a white sacred thread, a jewel diadem, and a rosary! Your head is crowned with the omniscient one, and the extraordinary palms of your hands are like lotuses! Being unshakeable, you produce meditative absorption, one-pointed concentration, and liberation! You bring the mindstreams of many beings to maturity. Being very compassionate, you purify all the karmic obscurations! You save from all diseases, you fulfill all hopes, and you bring comfort to all beings! Homage be to you! Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Reading saṃvicala as vicala following the Tib.

verses.iast: Oṃ , cara cara , curu curu , O most compassionate!
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三行持妙道、周游救护（左啰），再三速疾运转妙法加持（祖噜），悉昙「o」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·摄受法流灌顶），妙行迁变空·无我大慈三昧·第一义谛
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , cara cara , curu curu , O most compassionate! Ciri ciri , biri biri , O great one with a lotus in your hand! Kala kala , kulu kulu , you of great tenacity! Cara cara , cara cara , O Lord of the creatures of the night! Come, come! Grant accomplishment, grant! Awaken, awaken! Cleanse, cleanse! Kiṇi kiṇi , O supremely pure being! Kara kara , kiri kiri , kuru kuru , O wearer of the garb of the great Paśupati! Hā hā , hī hī , hū hū , O wearer of the garb of Oṃkāra Brahmā! Sara sara , vara vara , you with the body adorned with hundreds of thousands of beautiful rays of light! Blaze, blaze, heat up, heat up, O Lord whose feet are worshiped by Soma, Āditya, Yama, Varuṇa, Kubera, Brahmā, Indra, and the hosts of ṛṣis and gods! Suru suru , muru muru , O leader of sages and gods such as Sanatkumāra, Rudra, Viṣṇu, Vāsava, and Dhanada! You wear many garbs! Wear, wear! You, the great boon-granting lokeśvara lord with panoptic vision! Muya muya , save, save, O savior from killings, imprisonment, beatings, abuses by kings, bandits, fires, floods, poison, and weapons! Kaṇa kaṇa , O teacher of the strengths, the limbs of awakening, and the four truths of the noble ones! Tame, tame! Pacify, pacify, O great pacifier and remover of the darkness of ignorance! Mili mili , O wearer of a sash made from the skin of black antelope! Come, come! Maṭa maṭa , O compassionate one who abides in the pure realm! You wear a white sacred thread, a jewel diadem, and a rosary! Your head is crowned with the omniscient one, and your hands are cupped! You, the unshakeable one, produce meditative absorption, one-pointed concentration, and liberation! You help accomplish the six perfections and bring the mindstreams of many beings to maturity! You crush all the wicked ones, including all māras! You grant every accomplishment and fulfill every hope! Please consecrate me, O Blessed Amogharāja! Grant me the empowerment of all the tathāgatas! Hūṃ phaṭ ! Homage be to you! Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：In the Tib., the short and long vowels alternate: “ ha hā hi hī hu hū .”

verses.meaningZh: 再三妙行迁变空·无我大慈三昧，悉昙「o」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，陀字门（施度调伏（dāna
verses.meaningEn: Come, come, O Lord ! You, with the lotus in your hand, whose fingers form the boon-granting gesture! You, with the lotus-like arm, who wear the garb of the great Paśupati! Please be kind and arrive soon! You move with great speed, adorned with light rays! Laugh, laugh, O pure amogha being! Move, move! Proceed, proceed! Come, come, O Blessed Avalokiteśvara! Accept these fragrant flowers I have gathered! Svāhā to you, Unfailing Accomplishment through the truth of the Three Jewels!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Padmabhuja could also mean “[you with] the lotus [around] your arm,” as seen in some iconographic forms of both Avalokiteśvara and Amoghapāśa.

verses.iast: Laugh, laugh, O pure amogha being!

verses.iast: Vara vara , O boon granter! | Svāhā !
verses.meaningZh: 再三殊胜、胜愿、妙好，悉昙「o」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，解脱系缚大力·离名相假立，妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢·离名相假立；圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: You are delightfully adorned with fragrant garlands and beautified by the crescent moon on your head. Please accept these fragrances, flowers, and scented unguents from me! Vara vara , O boon granter! Svāhā !

verses.iast: Hara hara , mara mara , turu turu !
verses.meaningZh: 再三请摄取、遣除苦厄！再三临危、死厄，再三迅疾度脱一切危厄（都噜）
verses.meaningEn: Hili hili , mili mili , O great luminous and immaculate one who wears the garb of Brahmā and grants the boon of kind disposition! Turu turu , O one adorned with colorful garlands! Hara hara , mara mara , turu turu ! Take delight in the essence of Amogha ! Accept from me these fine flowers! Svāhā !

verses.iast: Dhure dhure , vajra dhara padmajaye vigatavāvarade !
verses.meaningZh: 再三勤爱尊，金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），请执持、总持护念！向梵行，离·想必·齿相尊
verses.meaningEn: Dhure dhure , vajra dhara padmajaye vigatavāvarade ! Vega vega , dhuṭa dhuṭa , sarvabījapriye ! By the truth of the Buddha, the Dharma, and the Saṅgha, mili mili ! Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：While the words vajra dhara , padmajaye , and varade could be translated as “vajra holder,” “lotus victory,” and “boon granter,” respectively, the meaning of vigatavā is not immediately obvious; it could be a Buddhist Hybrid Sanskrit form of the past active participle meaning “you who (had) departed.” The Tibetan variant vigatā , which presumes that the deity is female, could have a similar meaning.

verses.meaningZh: 再三请摄召、赐予妙寿福德供养！再三法界总持任持·无我大慈三昧；圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: O Lord with the indestructible wisdom-body of a tathāgata! Āhara āhara ! You on a lotus seat, with lotus-like arms, a white body, and white arms, adorned with white garlands! Dhuma dhuma ! Burn! By the truth of the Buddha, the Dharma, and the Saṅgha! Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The form āhara is probably the second person imperative singular of ā + √ hṛ , meaning either “to bring” or “to deliver/convey” (the latter usually being the function of fire). It is not clear who is addressed here.

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , Hero! Hero Padmapāṇi! Come, come! You have accomplished the amogha nature. You are impelled by the rays of light in the sky of all the tathāgatas. You purify all the vidyā holders. You have accomplished the blazing amogha light. Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ vīra vīra padmapāṇi | āgama • āgama • amogha tattvasiddhe sarva tathāgata gaganaraśmisaṃcodite sarvavidyādharaviśodhane • amoghajvalasiddhe svāhā ||

verses.meaningZh: 因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢，莲华手菩萨

verses.meaningZh: 再三法界总持任持·无我大慈三昧；圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Dhume dhume ! O dhudhuma lotus! You are pure like a lotus, pure and immaculate with a golden hue. You are the purity of pure essences, the purity within the pure sphere! O lotus-limbed one! You clothe beings in clothes. Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Again, the feminine endings indicate that it is the vidyā of clothing herself who is being addressed.

verses.iast: śāme śāmaya śānti me śrī tribhuvanadevy ārakṣasvastyayanaṃ kuru
verses.meaningZh: 答摩尊，祈请答摩，息灾、寂静、安隐，于我、为我，吉祥、圣德威光，真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·破有相福德光，卫成妙善乐，祈请成办羯磨事业（俱噜）
verses.meaningEn: O bringer of peace, please pacify! Bring me peace, O venerable goddess of the three worlds! Give me protection and well-being! You bring me joy. Please purify all my wrongdoings! You are peaceful, pure, auspicious, and immaculate! You win through peace; yours is the perfect victory! O Noble Lord Avalokiteśvara, move, move! Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：“O venerable goddess of the three worlds! Give me protection” is omitted in the Tib. transliteration.

verses.iast: sāntoṣi me sarvapāpaṃ śāntaśuddhakalyāṇaviraje śāntivijaye jayasiddhe
verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·离名相假立·真如实际，于我、为我，一切罪业，寂静·清净·善妙·嚩啰阇尊，息灾最胜尊胜，胜伏成就者
verses.meaningEn: O bringer of peace, please pacify! Bring me peace, O venerable goddess of the three worlds! Give me protection and well-being! You bring me joy. Please purify all my wrongdoings! You are peaceful, pure, auspicious, and immaculate! You win through peace; yours is the perfect victory! O Noble Lord Avalokiteśvara, move, move! Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：“O venerable goddess of the three worlds! Give me protection” is omitted in the Tib. transliteration.

verses.meaningZh: 破有相福德光·妙行趣入·最上真言离言说，圣观自在菩萨，再三流注周遍、速行护念（萨啰），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: O bringer of peace, please pacify! Bring me peace, O venerable goddess of the three worlds! Give me protection and well-being! You bring me joy. Please purify all my wrongdoings! You are peaceful, pure, auspicious, and immaculate! You win through peace; yours is the perfect victory! O Noble Lord Avalokiteśvara, move, move! Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：“O venerable goddess of the three worlds! Give me protection” is omitted in the Tib. transliteration.

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: O divine water, distinguished by the presence of the nāgas! O carrier of water! You purge the water of serpent-demons and remove the danger of rough waters. You are the water in the lotus pond, pure as lotuses! You are the water for the hands. Please purify the body! Vara vara , O water! Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：“The danger of rough waters” ( jalasaṃkṣobhabhaya ) is the Tib. reading. The mantra quoted in the note has been emended accordingly. The Skt. reads jalasaṃkhyābhaya , which is difficult to interpret.

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: O goddess of the entire world! You purify the world and satiate it, O pure, most eminent one! Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. sakalabhuvane bhuvanaviśodhani santarpya pravara viśuddhe svāhā ||

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: You are worshiped by all gods and asuras! You fill up the space! You are perfumed with every fragrance! You possess the purity of the sky! You are the light of liberation! O victorious goddess of victory, the provider of discarded garlands! You purify the scent of flowers in the discarded garlands; purify it! You are the purity of all the tathāgatas, the lotus-like purifier! Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Again, the feminine endings indicate that it is the vidyā herself who is addressed in this mantra.

verses.iast: Arrest it, arrest, O semen purifier! | Svāhā !
verses.meaningZh: 清净离诸尘垢·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·诸根清净自在），清净离诸尘垢·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，悉昙「o」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·离名相假立，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢；圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: You possess the ability to contain and the ability to arrest. Arrest it, arrest, O semen purifier! Marked with a white garland, you are the purifier of semen. O purity of the semen! Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The epithet “marked with a white garland” ( śuklamāliliṅginī ) entails a pun because of the double meaning of the Sanskrit words. Śukla (“white”) can be a variant spelling of śukra (“semen”), and liṅga , apart from “mark,” can mean “penis.” Because of its feminine ending, the epithet, derived thus from the three-word phrase (“semen-garlanded penis”), seems to be addressing the vidyā of arresting the semen, asking her to arrest the semen.

verses.iast: jvalajvale vimalo jvale prabhāvaviraje sūryavati | jaya padmamālādhare svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 炽燃光明炽燃光明，离垢、清净无瑕，炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞）尊，威嚩啰阇尊，具足日轮、太阳光明尊；胜伏、最胜吉祥！壤·衍伸·下尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: O blazing blaze! O immaculate blaze! You are like the sun, powerful and pure! Be victorious, O wearer of lotus garlands! Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Again, the feminine endings indicate that it is the vidyā herself who is addressed in this mantra.

verses.meaningZh: 再三契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利）；圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Water, water! Rich in water! Source of water! The swimming place of nāgas! O divine water! Mili mili ! Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. jale jale jalavati jalaprabhāvani nāga sraviṇi divyavāriṇi mili mili svāhā ||

verses.iast: O captivating one of yellow color! | Hiri hiri !
verses.meaningZh: 悉昙「o」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，妙行迁变空·第一义谛·真如实际，离名相假立，悉昙「of」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，一乘如实之道·离一切相无相，妙行迁变空·离一切相无相·清净离诸尘垢；再三乐队、斑纹尊
verses.meaningEn: O captivating one of yellow color! Yellow like piṅgala ! Hiri hiri ! Stir, O Lord, stir and remain! Protect me, protect! By the truth of the Buddha, Dharma, and Saṅgha, svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The Sanskrit uses here a word with a double meaning: hāriṇi (vocative, feminine form) means “captivating” and can also mean “yellow,” referring to the color of the kuśa-grass straw used for making the ritual seat. This word is repeated twice.

verses.iast: ehi bhagavati padmasundari mahā vidyā devati
verses.meaningZh: 善来降临坛场（翳呬），世尊佛母！（呼格），莲华孙陀利尊，大、摩诃（广大无边），明咒、真言明妃、圣智明，天人、诸天护法
verses.meaningEn: Come, Blessed Padmasundarī! Great vidyā goddess! Move, move, O swift Padmasundarī! Huru huru ! Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. ehi bhagavati padmasundari mahā vidyā devati | cala cala padmasundari vegavati | huru huru svāhā ||

verses.meaningZh: 再三震动警觉、破除昏沉（左攞），莲华孙陀利尊，具足余力
verses.meaningEn: Come, Blessed Padmasundarī! Great vidyā goddess! Move, move, O swift Padmasundarī! Huru huru ! Svāhā !

verses.meaningZh: 再三疾速拔济除障（虎噜），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Come, Blessed Padmasundarī! Great vidyā goddess! Move, move, O swift Padmasundarī! Huru huru ! Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. ehi bhagavati padmasundari mahā vidyā devati | cala cala padmasundari vegavati | huru huru svāhā ||

verses.meaningZh: 耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），妙行迁变空·清净离诸尘垢·一切诸谛圆满，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），妙行迁变空·清净离诸尘垢·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: You possess the majestic power of the amogha essence! You pacify all vighnas! Bring them over! Bring them together! You sit on a lotus seat, your lotus arms adorned with jewels and gold! Carry across, carry across! Deliver from evil! You are the victorious amogha essence! O three-eyed one with hands that grant boons! Remember, remember the samaya of all the blessed tathāgatas! Wear, wear, bhuru bhuru , O wearer of the garb of Brahmā whose body is adorned! You are the great remover of fear! Look at and watch over them, you who watch over all beings! Vara vara , O boon giver! Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Again, this part of the mantra addresses a female vidyā. The gender changes from “wearer of the garb of Brahmā,” which is masculine.

verses.meaningZh: 再三殊胜、胜愿、妙好，悉昙「o」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，解脱系缚大力·离名相假立，妙行趣入·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢

verses.iast: Muru muru , suru suru , turu turu !
verses.meaningZh: 再三速疾摧碎烦恼结缚（亩噜），再三甘露妙流普润群生（素噜），再三迅疾度脱一切危厄（都噜）
verses.meaningEn: You bind the directions, O unfailing and perfect one! Muru muru , suru suru , turu turu ! O destroyer of all vighnas, adorned with lotus ponds! By the truth of the Buddha, the Dharma, and the Saṅgha, please bind, O unconquerable giver of boons! Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. diśabandhani • amoghe • apratihate muru muru suru suru turu turu sarva vighna vināśanapadmasarabhūṣite | buddha dharma saṅgha satyena bandha • ajinavarade svāhā ||

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Hili hili , mili mili , siri siri , piri piri , move, move, move fast, O driver of the best of chariots! Dara dara , go, go to the abode of Noble Lord Avalokiteśvara! Hurry, hurry, O bearer of the amogha lotus! Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. hili hili mili mili siri siri piri piri cara cara pracara vimānadhara | dara dara gaccha gaccha bhagavān āryāvalokiteśvara svabhavanam | turu turu amogha padme svāhā ||

verses.meaningZh: 悉昙「o」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·摄受法流灌顶），妙行迁变空·无我大慈三昧·第一义谛，离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , lotus, lotus! Your arms are adorned with the lotuses you hold. O wearer of the garb of Brahmā, wear, wear! You have a bright diadem on your head, and your body is adorned with jewelry, gold, diamonds, and beryl stones. Please ferry us, ferry, O Blessed Lord and Lady! Help us cross to the other shore! Dhūru dhūru , you with the noose of Amogha in your hand! Vara vara , O boon giver with panoptic vision! O great bodhisattva who grants boons, white as lotus and sitting on a lotus seat! Blaze, blaze! You are consecrated by all the tathāgatas. O most compassionate one! O strength, strength, great strength! O swift one! With your face contorted in anger and fangs protruding, you possess great fiery energy. Yours is a vast knowledge, O boon giver! Yours is great compassion, O wearer of the garb of the great Paśupati! Move, move! You are the best means of accumulating merit. Endowed with the meditative concentration and samādhi of a sugata, you can see everywhere! You are Īśvara and Maheśvara, the tamer of wicked beings! You are the fierce tamer of the deities of dissolution, the great wearer of the garb of the lord of wrath! Sama sama ! You possess great tenacity, and your splendor exceeds that of the moon and the sun. Mala mala , you purify all impurities. You are the wearer of the great garb of Maheśvara surrounded by multitudes of gaṇas and ṛṣis. Your topknots are adorned with the victorious Amitābha, your right head with the moon. Crush them, crush, O destroyer of the hordes of all yakṣas, rākṣasas, and bhūtas. Ferry across, ferry across, you who are adorned with a multitude of stars and garlanded with constellations! O you whose thoughts are filled with supreme love, who has great compassion, and who is the bringer of ruin upon all the vighnas. Para para , you who comprise the full maṇḍala! Happy and at ease, you fully accomplish the six perfections. Mili mili ! O wearer of the tunic made from the skin of a black antelope and an upper garment made of a tiger skin, wear, wear! Your gaze, O three-eyed one, is that of all the tathāgatas. You carry a trident, a blazing vajra, and an unfailing noose in your hand. You assume the forms of Yama, Varuṇa, and Kubera, and also of the nāga kings. Your body is immaculately pure, and you pacify all nonvirtue, purify all obscurations, and remove all evil. You enthrall the three worlds and purify all beings. Blessed by all tathāgatas, you grant the bodhisattva boon of awakening. Oṃ , O pure one adorned with lotuses! Dhiri dhiri ! Watch over me! Sama sama , accomplish all my activities! You are the perfect essence of Amoghapāśa. You live in a secret dwelling, O boon giver, hūṃ phaṭ ! Homage to you, svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The Sanskrit could also be translated as “You tame Īśvara and Maheśvara.”

verses.iast: Huru huru , O fine bodied one!
verses.meaningZh: 再三疾速拔济除障（虎噜），悉昙「o」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，离名相假立，解脱系缚大力·施度调伏，离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , O lotus-eyed lotus lady sitting on a lotus seat and holding a lotus! O Padmāvatī, fond of lotuses, lotus white with a lotus glow, seated upon a lotus seat! Fond of Avalokiteśvara, you grant boons and facilitate boons. Please be kind and inspire with kindness! Act, act, O bestower of the boons of Noble Avalokiteśvara! Huru huru , O fine bodied one! Move, move, O lotus lover adorned with flowers! Owner of fine chariots, carry, carry! Bring together! Remember your samaya! You are the same as Noble Avalokiteśvara, O goddess established in the truth who grants amogha boons! Hūṃ ! Homage be to you, svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The Skt. pratiṣṭhita does not indicate whether she is sitting or standing.

verses.meaningZh: 吽（金刚心印）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , fragrant lake where lotuses are seen, reservoir of amogha water, gathering of lotuses! Save us, save, O joyful one! Hūṃ , svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ puṣpavilokite gandhasare amogha jalasambharaṇi padmasambhari tara tara mudite hūṃ svāhā ||

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , O boon-granting lotus lady, the heart essence of Amoghapāśa, blaze, blaze! You, with your lotus arms extended forth! Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ amogha pāśahṛdayapadmini varade jvala jvala prasāritapadmabhuje svāhā ||

verses.meaningZh: 再三迅疾度脱一切危厄（都噜）；吽（金刚心印）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , O lady with a lotus gaze and a perfect body! Turu turu ! Hūṃ , svāhā !

verses.iast: oṃ sarvatathāgatāvalokita amogha hṛdaya cara cara mahākāruṇika sādhaya hūṃ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！一切如来观照，不空、决定成就无虚，心、心髓、根本心咒，再三行持妙道、周游救护（左啰），大悲圣尊、具足大悲心者，请成办、令速成就！吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , you are the gaze of all the tathāgatas, the amogha essence! Move, move, O most compassionate one! Hūṃ ! Consecrate me! The holder of the unfailing noose, svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ sarvatathāgatāvalokita amogha hṛdaya cara cara mahākāruṇika sādhaya hūṃ | abhiśiñcaya • amogha pāśahaste svāhā ||

verses.meaningZh: 破有相福德光·本性寂静止息·圣智通达，不空、决定成就无虚，阎王尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , you are the gaze of all the tathāgatas, the amogha essence! Move, move, O most compassionate one! Hūṃ ! Consecrate me! The holder of the unfailing noose, svāhā !

verses.meaningZh: 再三妙行迁变空·离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢；圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , O great torrent of the gaze of all the tathāgatas! Conquer, conquer! Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ sarvatathāgatāvalokitamahaugha jaya jaya svāhā ||

verses.meaningZh: 吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , O wrathful one with the amogha lotus noose! Pull them in and make them enter! You wear the garb of the great Paśupati and of Yama, Varuṇa, Kubera, and Brahmā. You are the amogha essence! Hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ , phaṭ phaṭ ! Svāhā to you, the samaya of the lotus family!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ amogha padmapāśa krodha ākarṣaya praveśaya | mahā paśupati yama varuṇa kubera brahmaveṣadharaḥ | amogha hṛdayapadmakulasamayāya hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā ||

verses.iast: O pure bodhisattva being, bhuru bhuru !
verses.meaningZh: 悉昙「o」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，原来、之前，菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情），解脱系缚大力·离名相假立·妙行趣入，再三破有相福德光·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , the heart essence of the noose gaze of all the tathāgatas, blaze, blaze! Born from the dharmadhātu, move, move! O great one with lotus arms, carry, carry! O bearer of the great noose, hold captive, hold! With your body adorned with hundreds of thousands of beautiful light rays, pass through, pass! You are endowed with the great fiery energy, bear, bear! You fulfill the six perfections, kala kala ! O wearer of the great garb of Brahmā, mala mala ! You remove all evil, obscurations, and nonvirtue, dhuru dhuru ! O pure bodhisattva being, bhuru bhuru ! O beloved great being! You are revered by Yama, Varuṇa, and Kubera, huru huru ! You are revered and adored by the gods Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Maheśvara, Kumāra, Nandikeśvara, Īśvara, and Maheśvara! You wear various jewels in your diadem, which is crowned with the victorious Amitābha! Your body is adorned with divine jewels, gold, diamonds, beryls, emeralds, rubies, sapphires, and divine pearls! You are invested with the white sacred thread! Your topknot is adorned with a diadem and a new moon! You hold a lotus, sit on a lotus seat, and have lotus arms. O three-eyed one with a trident and a noose! You are consecrated by all the tathāgatas, sara sara ! You pacify all evil! O most compassionate one, turu turu ! You grant every boon! O bodhi, bodhi! Yours is the gaze of all the tathāgatas, the gaze that is the essence of awakening! O great lord of the world, holder of the wish-fulfilling jewel, one that assumes all forms! With a sweet expression on your face and great compassion, maintain your wakefulness, maintain! Awaken them, awaken! O Blessed Lord , you are the essence of all the tathāgatas' enlightenment ( āloka ). You possess great merit and great brilliance! You bring the most excellent accomplishment! You remove every disease! Loving care for all beings is your highest commitment! You release them from all suffering, O most compassionate one! Homage be to you, svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Reading (on the authority of the Tib.) bhaga ˚ as bhara . The Sanskrit text of the mantra quoted in the note has been emended accordingly.

verses.iast: oṃ padmapāṇi dhara dhara padmabhuje jvala jvala hutāśane bhuru bhuru vimokṣabhuje daha daha sarvamalān amogha pāṇivarade hūṃ hūṃ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！莲华手菩萨，再三请执持、总持护念！莲华臂，再三炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞），火，再三破有相福德光·清净离诸尘垢，解脱臂，再三智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺），一切垢染，不空、决定成就无虚，手掌施愿者，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , Padmapāṇi! Hold, hold, O lotus-armed one! Blaze, blaze, O oblation eater! Flicker, flicker! Your arms grant liberation. Burn, burn all the impurities! Your hand displays the amogha boon-granting gesture, hūṃ hūṃ ! Burn all evil! Pacify, O pacifier who saves the world! O boon granter, immersed in light, make haste, make haste! Your amogha accomplishment is awesome. Oṃ bhūr bhuva ! Homage to you! Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Oṃ bhūr bhuva (also oṃ bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ ) is the famous Gāyatrī mantra found in the Ṛgveda (3.62.10).

verses.iast: nirdaha pāpān śama śamani lokottāraṇi samantaraśmivarade turu turu pravara· amogha siddhiḥ
verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢·施度调伏，罪业、恶不善业，息，寂静息灭、止息灾障（古译「奢摩奴」）尊，救度超脱·离一切相无相，普遍·光芒·施愿者，再三迅疾度脱一切危厄（都噜），最妙，不空、决定成就无虚，成就

Your hand displays the amogha boon-granting gesture, hūṃ hūṃ ! Burn all evil! Pacify, O pacifier who saves the world! O boon granter, immersed in light, make haste, make haste! Your amogha accomplishment is awesome. Oṃ bhūr bhuva ! Homage to you! Svāhā !

verses.iast: oṃ bhūr bhuva namo 'stu te svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！地界（初禅大地光明），破有相福德光·最上真言离言说，归命，愿得成就、当如是，向汝、彼等，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！

verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·第一义谛，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·诸根清净自在），造作离相·第一义谛
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , O great lotus maṇḍala of the amogha gaze! You are honored by all the bodhisattvas. Keep it, keep! You can see everywhere, O amogha wearer of the great garb of Brahmā! Wear it, wear, O most compassionate one! Awaken them, awaken, O great awakener! O awakening, awakening! O lotus awakener, you pacify all the darkness produced by evil. You block all unhappy destinies, O most compassionate one! You take on many appearances and yet retain the essence of a tathāgata. Huru huru , O amogha essence! Turu turu , O Amoghapāśa with a noose in your hand! Muru muru , you whose arms grant liberation! Diminish them, diminish, O purifier of all obscurations! You fully embody every tathāgata—carry them in you, carry! Gaze, one with lotus-like arms, adorned with jewels and gold! Tame, tame those difficult to tame, O great bodhisattva! O most compassionate granter of boons, honored by all gods and praised by all ṛṣis! You are radiant with light brighter than a hundred thousand suns and moons. You wear the great garb of Paśupati, O supremely pure being! You are the lokeśvara of compassionate gazing, a great lord, the supremely compassionate lord of the maṇḍala, the fully awakened one! O great lord with a lotus in your hand, the great lord of vidyādhara s! Be steadfast, be steadfast, O great steadfast being! You are the most compassionate upholder of great maṇḍalas of liberation. You keep the samaya of the secret seat of all the tathāgatas. You possess great energy and strength. You wear a jeweled diadem upon your head crowned with Amitābha. Wear it, wear! O lord with panoptic vision! O great lord who carries the noose! O supreme, supreme, supremely compassionate being who gazes with great compassion and delivers all beings from suffering! O accomplishment, accomplishment, you fulfill all hopes! O great granter of boons, homage to you! Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：This phrase, which addresses Amoghapāśa, is a somewhat arbitrary rendering of the Sanskrit compound amoghāvalokitamahā maṇḍala padma .

Oṃ , your form is infinite, O great Amoghapāśa! Hūṃ hūṃ , phaṭ phaṭ ! You gaze at all beings. O generous granter of boons, homage be to you! Svāhā !

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , awaken them, awaken, awaken, O most compassionate one! Ferry, ferry! Take beings across the great ocean to the other shore! O strong-armed one, look on with compassion! Hūṃ phaṭ , svāhā !

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , you with lotus-like arms! oṃ amogha vividharūpavicitragandharasabharapravarabhuje svāhā
Hūṃ !
Dhuru dhuru , hūṃ phaṭ , svāhā !
Bhuru bhuru , svāhā !
Huru huru ! | Hūṃ , svāhā !
Bhuru bhuru , svāhā !
Suru suru , svāhā !
Act, act! | Svāhā !

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！不空、决定成就无虚，各个·色·斑驳陆离·香·味·方位·最妙·臂，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , you possess various amogha forms and colors; you bring various scents and flavors; you hold various implements in your hands, svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ amogha vividharūpavicitragandharasabharapravarabhuje svāhā ||

verses.meaningZh: 吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , you bind the full circle of the maṇḍala with the noose. Hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ amogha samantaparimaṇḍalapāśabaddhe hūṃ ||

verses.meaningZh: 再三坚固任持总持法印（度噜），吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , create a great amogha-boundary encompassing in the ten directions! Dhuru dhuru , hūṃ phaṭ , svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ amogha samantadaśadigmahāsīmā[ṃ] bandhaya dhuru dhuru hūṃ phaṭ svāhā ||

verses.meaningZh: 再三破有相福德光·清净离诸尘垢，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , you hold in your hand the protecting, unfailing noose. Bhuru bhuru , svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ amogha rakṣaṇapāśahaste bhuru bhuru svāhā ||

verses.meaningZh: 再三疾速拔济除障（虎噜）；吽（金刚心印）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , you carry the amogha jewel in your topknot. Huru huru ! You bind the nāgas with the noose! Hūṃ , svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ amogha cūḍāmaṇi huru huru nāga pāśabaddhe hūṃ svāhā ||

verses.meaningZh: 再三破有相福德光·清净离诸尘垢，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , you create amogha protection everywhere with the great noose. Bhuru bhuru , svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ amogha rakṣā samantena mahāpāśe bhuru bhuru svāhā ||

verses.meaningZh: 再三甘露妙流普润群生（素噜），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , pure amogha water! Suru suru , svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ amogha jalavimale suru suru svāhā ||

verses.meaningZh: 再三多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·本不生体性）；圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , the drop of amogha nectar! Act, act! Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ amogha ·amṛta bindu cara cara svāhā ||

Oṃ , O divine amogha clothes! Curu curu , svāhā !
Ciri ciri , svāhā !
Svāhā !
O jewel, jewel, svāhā !
Support, support!

verses.iast: Oṃ , O divine amogha clothes! Curu curu , svāhā !
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！悉昙「o」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，放光勇健，不空、决定成就无虚，妙行迁变空·离一切相无相·无住安立，再三速疾运转妙法加持（祖噜），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'o': consecrating Dharma-stream, shine + O strong, unfailing, infallible, never in vain, awakened conduct beyond flux & freedom from conditioned marks & non-abiding equipoise, swiftly set sacred blessings in motion! again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ amogha vidyāvastre curu curu svāhā ||

verses.meaningZh: 再三久远常恒护持不退（唧哩），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , you provide the best armor with your amogha arms. Ciri ciri , svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ amogha bhujakavacavarade ciri ciri svāhā ||

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , please extend your great amogha arms far and wide! Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ amogha brahmabhuje paryantena prasara svāhā ||

verses.meaningZh: 悉昙「o」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，再三生起不可得·尊胜·离一切相无相，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , Amoghapadma with a jewel upon your topknot, consecrate me! Grant me the empowerment of all the tathāgatas! O jewel, jewel, svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ amogha cūḍāmaṇipadme · abhiṣiñcaya mama sarvatathāgatābhiṣekair maṇi maṇi svāhā ||

verses.meaningZh: 再三一切诸谛圆满·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , Amoghapadma, you are the supporting earth! Support, support! You are the earth seat, hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The mantra has been emended here (on the authority of the Tib.) from dhare dhara to dhara dhara .

Oṃ , amogha circuit! Duru duru praduru ! Svāhā !
Dwell here, dwell! | Svāha !
Assemble, assemble! | Svāhā !
Svāhā !

verses.iast: Oṃ , amogha circuit! Duru duru praduru ! Svāhā !
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！不空、决定成就无虚，妙行迁变空·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，再三施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·施度调伏，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! unfailing, infallible, never in vain, awakened conduct beyond flux & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust (imperative seal) again and again, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & generosity & self-mastery (imperative seal), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ amogha cakre duru duru praduru svāhā ||

verses.meaningZh: 攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·钩召发起三昧），因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢，攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·钩召发起三昧）；自如是宣说
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , come to the amogha dwelling! Dwell here, dwell! Svāha !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ amogha samanta yāntu bhavane bhava bhava svāha ||

verses.meaningZh: 再三一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·解脱系缚大力；圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , inviting you into the amogha maṇḍala of liberation! Assemble, assemble! Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ amoghanimantraṇavimokṣamaṇḍale mili mili svāhā ||

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , O great amogha light, the thousandfold blaze! Blaze, blaze all around! Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ amogha mahāraśmijvālasahasre jvala jvala samante svāhā ||

Cara cara , ciri ciri , curu curu , O most compassionate! | Ciri ciri , piri piri , ciri ciri , O supremely compassionate! | Kala kala , kili kili , kulu kulu , O great pure being! | Come, come! | Awaken, awaken! | Run, run! | Kaṇa kaṇa , kiṇi kiṇi , kuṇu kuṇu , O supremely pure being! | Heat up, heat up! | Muhu muhu , muru muru , muya muya , muñca muñca , O Noble Lord Avalokiteśvara, stand guard! | Stand guard to keep me protected by my treasure trove of morality! | Tama tama ! | Tame, tame! | Sama sama ! | O great lord of siddhas! | Act, act! | Svāhā !
Hūṃ hūṃ !

verses.iast: oṃ avalokita mahāśuddhasattvaḥ sara sara samantāvabhāsakuṇḍaladharaḥ · amitābha makuṭadhara jaṭāmakuṭanavavajrendumaṇḍita cara cara sambhara bhuvaneśvarapadmabhuje svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！观照、慈悲垂视，大清净尊者，再三流注周遍、速行护念（萨啰），普现·耳镮·请执持，阿弥陀佛（无量光如来），持天冠、宝冠尊，生起不可得·尊胜·断除憍慢执障·无我大慈三昧，再三行持妙道、周游救护（左啰），参婆啰，大王·莲华·臂，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , great, pure being with a compassionate gaze! Move around, move around! You wear earrings that radiate light everywhere. Your crown jewel is Amitābha, and your topknot is adorned with the crescent of the vajra moon. Act, act! Please help to accumulate provisions, O being with the lotus of the lord of the worlds in your hand! Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ avalokita mahāśuddhasattvaḥ sara sara samantāvabhāsakuṇḍaladharaḥ · amitābha makuṭadhara jaṭāmakuṭanavavajrendumaṇḍita cara cara sambhara bhuvaneśvarapadmabhuje svāhā ||

verses.iast: Cara cara , ciri ciri , curu curu , O most compassionate!
verses.meaningZh: 再三行持妙道、周游救护（左啰），再三久远常恒护持不退（唧哩），再三速疾运转妙法加持（祖噜），悉昙「o」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·摄受法流灌顶），妙行迁变空·无我大慈三昧·第一义谛
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , Padmoṣṇīṣa, the granter of boons, Hūṃ ! Cara cara , ciri ciri , curu curu , O most compassionate! Ciri ciri , piri piri , ciri ciri , O supremely compassionate! Siri siri , ciri ciri , piri piri , viri viri , O great one with a lotus in your hand! Kala kala , kili kili , kulu kulu , O great pure being! Come, come! Awaken, awaken! Run, run! Kaṇa kaṇa , kiṇi kiṇi , kuṇu kuṇu , O supremely pure being! Kara kara , kiri kiri , kuru kuru , you have attained great strength! Move, move! Move together and move separately! Eṭaṭa eṭaṭa , bhara bhara , bhiri bhiri , bhuru bhuru , great Padmoṣṇīṣa, stainless and immaculately pure! Accomplish your activities, hūṃ hūṃ ! Come, come, O most compassionate being who wears the garb of the great Paśupati! Wear it, wear, you who wear the great lotus-uṣṇīṣa! Flow, flow, O remover of all obscurations! Act, act, you who are honored by all the vidyā holders! Remove them, remove, O remover of all vices! Hā hā , hā hā , hī hī , hī hī , hūṃ hūṃ , hūṃ hūṃ , you who wear the garb of Oṃkāra Brahmā! verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , Padmoṣṇīṣa, the heart essence of Amoghapāśa in the garb of a divine youth! O lotus lord, please enter! Please amogha-grant the complete accomplishment that is the samaya essence of the entire amogha family! O lotus, lotus! Hūṃ hūṃ ! Homage be to you, svāhā !

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，不空·莲华·佛顶肉髻相；悉昙「o」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，观自在菩萨（观世音），吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , Lord Amoghapadmoṣṇīṣa! O lotus lord, please invite all the tathāgatas! Summon the samaya circle of Amoghapadmoṣṇīṣa and cause them to enter! Grant me the accomplishment of all my activities and help me guard my treasure trove of morality! O Avalokiteśvara, hūṃ hūṃ ! O lord with the lotus uṣṇīṣa in his hand, svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Reading śilākara ˚ as śīlākara ˚. The mantra cited below has been emended accordingly. The phrase “make me a receptacle of morality” is missing from the Tib. transliteration of the mantra.

verses.meaningZh: 觉知警策妙音（唧置），法界总持任持·断除憍慢执障，吽（金刚心印）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , O very fierce lotus lord! You assume various monstrous forms. Your lotus mouth with protruding fangs is very frightening. Please devour all vighnas who are evil at heart, O lotus holder! Ciṭi dhṛṭi , hūṃ , svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ mahācaṇḍa padmeśvara vividharūpavikaṭapadmadaṃṣṭrākarālabhīṣaṇavaktra sarvaṃ duṣṭahṛdayān khādaya vighnān padmadhṛk ciṭi dhṛṭi hūṃ svāhā ||

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！不空·莲华·佛顶肉髻相，大红莲华羂索，忿，请钩召、慈悲摄引善法！请令契入、引入坛城三昧！大、摩诃（广大无边），畜主，狱王，水神，俱吠滥、上首

verses.iast: Oṃ , O samaya of Padmoṣṇīṣa, great amogha samaya, hūṃ !
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！悉昙「o」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，三昧耶（本誓、平等契合、时际），悉昙「of」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，莲华佛顶肉髻相，妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，不空、决定成就无虚，三昧耶（本誓、平等契合、时际），吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'o': consecrating Dharma-stream, Samaya, sacred vow, pledge, union, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'of': consecrating Dharma-stream, lotus flower + Uṣṇīṣa, awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, unfailing, infallible, never in vain, Samaya, sacred vow, pledge, union, Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ padmasamayoṣṇīṣa mahāmogha samaya hūṃ ||

Oṃ , dhuru dhuru , stretch forth, O grey-colored one, svāhā !
Samaya, hūṃ !

verses.iast: Oṃ , dhuru dhuru , stretch forth, O grey-colored one, svāhā !
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三坚固任持总持法印（度噜），侘字门（离覆障清凉（chāyā）·钩召发起三昧），他字门（无住安立（sthāna）·摄受法流灌顶），悉昙「o」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·钩召发起三昧），妙行迁变空·离一切相无相·清净离诸尘垢，离名相假立，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! firmly uphold the dhāraṇī seal! again and again, coolness free of obscuration (chāyā) — samādhi invocation, non-abiding equipoise (sthāna) — consecrating Dharma-stream, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'o': consecrating Dharma-stream, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — samādhi invocation, awakened conduct beyond flux & freedom from conditioned marks & stainless purity free from dust, beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ dhuru dhuru prasāra dhūsarimantre svāhā || It is not clear how the word mantre at the end of this mantra should be translated.

verses.meaningZh: 三昧耶（本誓、平等契合、时际），吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , O intellect, blazing brightly in all directions! Samaya, hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ samantaprajvalite buddhe samaya hūṃ ||

verses.meaningZh: 再三陀字门（施度调伏（dāna
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , homage to the lord of the three worlds! O Lokeśvara, the great lord! Hold, hold! You possess the secret panoptic gaze. Come, O Lord ! Hero, hero, great hero! Your body is adorned with jewels, gold, diamonds, beryl, emeralds, coral, sapphires, and precious pearls. You have fine lotus arms, O holder of the unfailing noose! Your gaze is directed in all directions. You grant boons, O boon giver! Blaze, blaze with light, O lord with a panoptic vision! Come swiftly and enter the house! Remember your samaya, O wearer of many garbs! Yama, Varuṇa, and Kubera pay homage to you. Come swiftly, O Lord , come! Remember the samaya of the maṇḍala of all the vidyās! Show your own form, O holder of manifold splendor! Your body, infused with light, radiates light everywhere. You have great compassion, your countenance is gentle, and your face is round like the full moon. You wear the crescent of the new moon in your topknot, and Amitābha upon your diadem. O wearer of the great garb of Brahmā, the three-eyed granter of amogha boons! Suru suru ! O most compassionate, pure being with the lotus noose and compassionate gaze! O boon giver, homage be to you!

O lotus being with your hair in a topknot crowned by a diadem, dhuru dhuru ! With the lotus noose in your hand, the unfailing noose, please rescue beings! O highly accomplished blessed lady! O boon giver, make haste, make haste! O great savioress! O boon giver, be successful, be successful! O accomplished one, the giver of amogha boons, svāhā !

verses.iast: Oṃ , cara cara , ciri ciri , curu curu , O most compassionate one!
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三行持妙道、周游救护（左啰），再三久远常恒护持不退（唧哩），再三速疾运转妙法加持（祖噜），悉昙「o」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·摄受法流灌顶），妙行迁变空·无我大慈三昧·第一义谛，离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , cara cara , ciri ciri , curu curu , O most compassionate one! Ciri ciri , piri piri , ciri ciri , O most compassionate one! Siri siri , ciri ciri , piri piri , ciri ciri , O great being with a lotus in your hand! Kala kala , kili kili , kulu kulu , O great pure being! Come, come! Awaken, awaken! Run, run! Kala kala , kili kili , kulu kulu , O supremely pure being! Kara kara , kiri kiri ! Act, act, you who attained great fortitude! Move, move! Move together and move separately! Move forward, move forward! Bhara bhara , bhiri bhiri , bhuru bhuru ! Come, come, O most compassionate one! O wearer of the great garb of Paśupati, wear, wear! Move, move! Act, act! Seize, seize! Hā hā , hā hā , hī hī , hī hī , hūṃ hūṃ , hūṃ hūṃ ! O wearer of the garb of Oṃkāra Brahmā, dhara dhara , dhiri dhiri , dhuru dhuru ! Cross, cross! Move, move! Para para ! Act, act! Vara vara ! To you, whose body is beautifully adorned with hundreds of thousands of lovely light rays, blaze, blaze! Heat up, heat up, O Lord! Your feet are worshiped by Soma, Āditya, Yama, Varuṇa, Kubera, Brahmā, Indra, and the hosts of divine sages. Muka muka , cuka cuka , puru puru , muru muru ! You wear a great variety of guises, such as those of Sanatkumāra, Rudra, Vāsava, Viṣṇu, Dhanada, and Vināyaka , the leader of celestial sages. Dhara dhara , dhiri dhiri , dhuru dhuru ! Thara thara , ghara ghara , yara yara , lara lara ! Seize, seize! Mara mara , para para ! Act, act! Vara vara , O boon giver! O lokeśvara with panoptic vision, the great lord of gazes, muku muku , muru muru , muya muya , rescue, rescue, O Lord ! O Noble Avalokiteśvara! Protect, protect me and all beings who guard their treasure trove of morality! Protect them from all dangers, misfortunes, calamities, grahas, and disease! You rescue beings from killing, imprisonment, beatings, threats, king's villains, robbers, fire, water, poison, and weapons. Kaṇa kaṇa , kiṇi kiṇi , kuṇu kuṇu , act, act! You teach about the sense faculties, the strengths, the limbs of awakening, and the four truths of the noble ones. Tama tama ! Tame, tame! Sama sama , masa masa ! O great being who dispels the darkness of ignorance and fulfills the six perfections, mili mili , ṭaṭa ṭaṭa , ṭhaṭha ṭhaṭha , ṭiṭi ṭiṭi , ṭuṭu ṭuṭu , ṭhiṭhi ṭhiṭhi , ṭhuṭhu ṭhuṭhu ! You who wear a tunic of black antelope skin, come, come! You crush the hosts of great bhūtas, including Īśvara and Maheśvara. Act, act! Para para , kaṭa kaṭa , maṭa maṭa ! You inhabit the pure domain, O most compassionate one! You wear a white sacred thread and a crown adorned with a row of jewels. O omniscient one with a diadem upon your head! The palms of your exquisite hands are like lotuses. O diamond being, unshakable in your liberating meditative concentration and samādhi! You mature the mindstream of beings, you purify all their karmic obscurations, you release them from all disease, and you fulfill all their wishes. O comforter of all beings, homage be to you, svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：In place of ciri ciri , the Tib. reads (in transliteration) viri viri . The letters ca and va are easily confused in manuscripts.

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , cara cara , ciri ciri , curu curu , O most compassionate one! Ciri ciri , piri piri , ciri ciri , O most compassionate one! Siri siri , ciri ciri , piri piri , ciri ciri , O great being with a lotus in your hand! Kala kala , kili kili , kulu kulu , O great pure being! Come, come! Awaken, awaken! Run, run! Kala kala , kili kili , kulu kulu , O supremely pure being! Kara kara , kiri kiri ! Act, act, you who attained great fortitude! Move, move! Move together and move separately! Move forward, move forward! Bhara bhara , bhiri bhiri , bhuru bhuru ! Come, come, O most compassionate one! O wearer of the great garb of Paśupati, wear, wear! Move, move! Act, act! Seize, seize! Hā hā , hā hā , hī hī , hī hī , hūṃ hūṃ , hūṃ hūṃ ! O wearer of the garb of Oṃkāra Brahmā, dhara dhara , dhiri dhiri , dhuru dhuru ! Cross, cross! Move, move! Para para ! Act, act! Vara vara ! To you, whose body is beautifully adorned with hundreds of thousands of lovely light rays, blaze, blaze! Heat up, heat up, O Lord! Your feet are worshiped by Soma, Āditya, Yama, Varuṇa, Kubera, Brahmā, Indra, and the hosts of divine sages. Muka muka , cuka cuka , puru puru , muru muru ! You wear a great variety of guises, such as those of Sanatkumāra, Rudra, Vāsava, Viṣṇu, Dhanada, and Vināyaka , the leader of celestial sages. Dhara dhara , dhiri dhiri , dhuru dhuru ! Thara thara , ghara ghara , yara yara , lara lara ! Seize, seize! Mara mara , para para ! Act, act! Vara vara , O boon giver! O lokeśvara with panoptic vision, the great lord of gazes, muku muku , muru muru , muya muya , rescue, rescue, O Lord ! O Noble Avalokiteśvara! Protect, protect me and all beings who guard their treasure trove of morality! Protect them from all dangers, misfortunes, calamities, grahas, and disease! You rescue beings from killing, imprisonment, beatings, threats, king's villains, robbers, fire, water, poison, and weapons. Kaṇa kaṇa , kiṇi kiṇi , kuṇu kuṇu , act, act! You teach about the sense faculties, the strengths, the limbs of awakening, and the four truths of the noble ones. Tama tama ! Tame, tame! Sama sama , masa masa ! O great being who dispels the darkness of ignorance and fulfills the six perfections, mili mili , ṭaṭa ṭaṭa , ṭhaṭha ṭhaṭha , ṭiṭi ṭiṭi , ṭuṭu ṭuṭu , ṭhiṭhi ṭhiṭhi , ṭhuṭhu ṭhuṭhu ! You who wear a tunic of black antelope skin, come, come! You crush the hosts of great bhūtas, including Īśvara and Maheśvara. Act, act! Para para , kaṭa kaṭa , maṭa maṭa ! You inhabit the pure domain, O most compassionate one! You wear a white sacred thread and a crown adorned with a row of jewels. O omniscient one with a diadem upon your head! The palms of your exquisite hands are like lotuses. O diamond being, unshakable in your liberating meditative concentration and samādhi! You mature the mindstream of beings, you purify all their karmic obscurations, you release them from all disease, and you fulfill all their wishes. O comforter of all beings, homage be to you, svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：In place of ciri ciri , the Tib. reads (in transliteration) viri viri . The letters ca and va are easily confused in manuscripts.

verses.iast: Muka muka , cuka cuka , puru puru , muru muru !

Protect, protect me and all beings who guard their treasure trove of morality! Protect them from all dangers, misfortunes, calamities, grahas, and disease! You rescue beings from killing, imprisonment, beatings, threats, king's villains, robbers, fire, water, poison, and weapons. Kaṇa kaṇa , kiṇi kiṇi , kuṇu kuṇu , act, act! You teach about the sense faculties, the strengths, the limbs of awakening, and the four truths of the noble ones. Tama tama ! Tame, tame! Sama sama , masa masa ! O great being who dispels the darkness of ignorance and fulfills the six perfections, mili mili , ṭaṭa ṭaṭa , ṭhaṭha ṭhaṭha , ṭiṭi ṭiṭi , ṭuṭu ṭuṭu , ṭhiṭhi ṭhiṭhi , ṭhuṭhu ṭhuṭhu ! You who wear a tunic of black antelope skin, come, come! You crush the hosts of great bhūtas, including Īśvara and Maheśvara. Act, act! Para para , kaṭa kaṭa , maṭa maṭa ! You inhabit the pure domain, O most compassionate one! You wear a white sacred thread and a crown adorned with a row of jewels. O omniscient one with a diadem upon your head! The palms of your exquisite hands are like lotuses. O diamond being, unshakable in your liberating meditative concentration and samādhi! You mature the mindstream of beings, you purify all their karmic obscurations, you release them from all disease, and you fulfill all their wishes. O comforter of all beings, homage be to you, svāhā !
