verses.iast: oṃ brahmaveṣadhara dhara dhara dhiri dhiri dhuru dhuru samantajvālāmogha hūṃ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！神父持相，再三请执持、总持护念！再三禅定坚固总持不失（地利），再三坚固任持总持法印（度噜），普遍·光焰·没用，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , O wearer of the garb of Brahmā, dhara dhara , dhiri dhiri , dhuru dhuru ! You radiate amogha light all around, hūṃ !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Skt. oṃ brahmaveṣadhara dhara dhara dhiri dhiri dhuru dhuru samantajvālāmogha hūṃ ||

verses.meaningZh: 再三多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , pure lotus, innately pure, born in pure water, bright as the sun with one thousand rays, ablaze with a great mass of rays! Act, act! Act, act! Be alive! Lotus beyond and lotus within! You have two lotus arms. Your body, pure as a lotus born in crystal-clear water, is adorned with jewels, gold, diamonds, beryls, sapphires, emeralds, coral, and various other great jewels and gems. Hold it, hold, O great lotus holder! Para para , O holder of an axe and a noose! Expand, expand, you whose light penetrates everywhere! You are a recipient of the secret blessing of all the tathāgatas! You fulfill the samayas of the families! Vara vara ! You are enveloped by a vajra blaze. O vajra, vajra! O lotus, blessed by the vajra, hūṃ hūṃ ! O jewel, jewel, great jewel! O holder of the wish-fulfilling jewel noose, act, act! O lotus, lotus-white! You hold a lotus in one hand and display the boon-granting mudrā with the other. O amogha lotus! Oṃ , lotus lady, holder of a lotus, jewel, and vajra scepter! You are established in the samaya bond with all tathāgata families equally. You whose arms have a wide reach, carry, carry! Bring together! Bhuru bhuru , bhūraṇi ! Bhiri bhiri , O king of vidyās with panoptic vision! Expand, expand! O pure expanse! You are honored by all the deities of the vidyā maṇḍala. Cross, cross! Rescue, rescue! You make everything complete. You consecrate all bodhisattvas and are yourself amogha-consecrated by all the tathāgatas. Please consecrate me! You are invested with the samaya of all the families of vidyā maṇḍalas. Your hand displays the boon-granting mudrā of all the tathāgatas. O lotus white, lotus hued, you are like the interior of a half-opened lotus, hūṃ hūṃ ! O vajra, vajra! O vajra, O lotus, blessed by tathāgata families! You grant amogha boons. You fulfill all wishes. You pacify all evil and all suffering. Please bring the accomplishment of the amogha essence! O pure being, hūṃ phaṭ ! Oṃ , granter of boons with lotus-like arms, homage be to you! O inner lotus space, svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：There appears to be an inconsistency here, as the deity whose formula this is has not two but four hands, judging by the number of implements held in its hands.

Your body, pure as a lotus born in crystal-clear water, is adorned with jewels, gold, diamonds, beryls, sapphires, emeralds, coral, and various other great jewels and gems. Hold it, hold, O great lotus holder! Para para , O holder of an axe and a noose! Expand, expand, you whose light penetrates everywhere! You are a recipient of the secret blessing of all the tathāgatas! You fulfill the samayas of the families! Vara vara ! You are enveloped by a vajra blaze. O vajra, vajra! O lotus, blessed by the vajra, hūṃ hūṃ ! O jewel, jewel, great jewel! O holder of the wish-fulfilling jewel noose, act, act! O lotus, lotus-white! You hold a lotus in one hand and display the boon-granting mudrā with the other. O amogha lotus! Oṃ , lotus lady, holder of a lotus, jewel, and vajra scepter! You are established in the samaya bond with all tathāgata families equally. You whose arms have a wide reach, carry, carry! Bring together! Bhuru bhuru , bhūraṇi ! Bhiri bhiri , O king of vidyās with panoptic vision! Expand, expand! O pure expanse! You are honored by all the deities of the vidyā maṇḍala. Cross, cross! Rescue, rescue! You make everything complete. You consecrate all bodhisattvas and are yourself amogha-consecrated by all the tathāgatas. Please consecrate me! You are invested with the samaya of all the families of vidyā maṇḍalas. Your hand displays the boon-granting mudrā of all the tathāgatas. O lotus white, lotus hued, you are like the interior of a half-opened lotus, hūṃ hūṃ ! O vajra, vajra! O vajra, O lotus, blessed by tathāgata families! You grant amogha boons. You fulfill all wishes. You pacify all evil and all suffering. Please bring the accomplishment of the amogha essence! O pure being, hūṃ phaṭ ! Oṃ , granter of boons with lotus-like arms, homage be to you! O inner lotus space, svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：There appears to be an inconsistency here, as the deity whose formula this is has not two but four hands, judging by the number of implements held in its hands.

verses.iast: namo ratna trayāya | nama āryāvalokiteśvarāya bodhisattvāya mahasattvāya mahākāruṇikāya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼珍宝、摩尼宝·三重、三合会！归命顶礼圣观自在菩萨·菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情）·乐趣非情·大悲圣尊、具足大悲心者！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to jewel, precious gem, treasure, triple, threefold! Homage to Noble Avalokiteśvara, Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, gladden, to, Greatly Compassionate One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 93 (rgyud, rtsa), folios 163.b–164.b · 藏文名：སེང་གེ་སྒྲའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.iast: oṃ akaṭe vikaṭe nikaṭe kaṭaṃkaṭe karoṭe karokaṃṭe vīryai svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！造作离相·断除憍慢执障，巨大、怪异尊，比邻、边儿尊，造作离相·断除憍慢执障，杯子、盆地尊，能作成办·造作离相，最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! freedom from karmic agency & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation), O exceeding the usual measure, huge, monstrous, hideous, wicked, bad, O near, freedom from karmic agency & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation), O cup, basin, making (vocative invocation), supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！语金刚种子字（一切法本不生清净妙语），莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），师子吼，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! speech-vajra seed syllable Āḥ (non-arising), Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, lion’s roar, Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.meaningZh: 啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·损减除灭忧苦·大空菩提点摄持），悉昙「āṃ」韵字门：远离寂静周遍·大空菩提点摄持，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·禅定三昧总持·大空菩提点摄持），大空无碍法界虚空种子，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — dispelling sorrow sealed with bodhicitta bindu, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'āṃ': expansive quiescence sealed with bodhicitta bindu, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — deep samādhi retention sealed with bodhicitta bindu, boundless Dharmadhātu sky seed syllable, Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！语金刚种子字（一切法本不生清净妙语），吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! speech-vajra seed syllable Āḥ (non-arising), Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.iast: oṃ balīn bhuñja jiva puśpe dhūpe hūṃ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！解脱系缚大力·离一切相无相·离名相假立，破有相福德光·圣智通达·生起不可得·尊胜，生起不可得·尊胜·最上真言离言说，第一义谛·本性寂静止息，烧香尊，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! spiritual strength freeing bonds & freedom from conditioned marks & beyond nominal designation, blessedness transcending existence & non-dual wisdom awareness & transcending birth & victorious, transcending birth & victorious & supreme ineffable speech, ultimate truth & primordial tranquil peace (vocative invocation), O to burn incense / in to burn incense, Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.meaningZh: 一切甘露，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: All + O ambrosia, Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.iast: oṃ vatali mahāvatali hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ jaḥ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！不过逮捕蜜蜂，酒席·鸿毛·表面地面尊，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！金刚钩召摄引入坛种子，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! only apprehend + bee, feast + down + O surface of the ground, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Vajra-hook summoning seed syllable (ākarṣaṇa), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.iast: oṃ bhakṣa bhakṣa samaya tiṣṭha jaṃ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三食，三昧耶（本誓、平等契合、时际），祈请安住加持，惹字门（生起不可得·尊胜（jāti，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! alms again and again, Samaya, sacred vow, pledge, union, abide steadfastly & bestow grace! transcending birth & victorious (jaya) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！燋，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! to heat, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.meaningZh: 能作成办·一切诸谛圆满，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Making, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.iast: oṃ varuṇa āgacchaya āgacchaya mahānāga gisati sarve bhuraḥ phuḥ phuḥ phuḥ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！水神，再三唯愿降临赴会！善良，妙行趣入·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，一切、普皆遍满尊，抖瑟、猪头，再三颇字门（妙果圆成（phala）·损减除灭忧苦·涅槃除障点证入），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! the All-encompasser, of a god, may You come hither! approach!! again and again, great serpent or elephant, awakened spiritual movement & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), O all, every, complete / in all, every, complete, quiver, jerk, struggle, stir, flash, fruition of enlightenment (phala) — dispelling sorrow with nirvāṇic visarga release again and again, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.iast: oṃ bhagavati śrutismṛtisamavati saramati siddhi svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！世尊佛母！（呼格），具足闻正念平尊，彼喜，悉地、妙成就，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! hearing + mindfulness + O one endowed with equal, he + a pleasant abode, Siddhi, spiritual accomplishment/perfection, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！语金刚种子字（一切法本不生清净妙语），莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），吽（金刚心印）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! speech-vajra seed syllable Āḥ (non-arising), Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, Hūṃ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.meaningZh: 颇字门（妙果圆成（phala）·损减除灭忧苦·涅槃除障点证入），莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子）
verses.meaningEn: Fruition of enlightenment (phala) — dispelling sorrow with nirvāṇic visarga release, Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！师子吼，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! lion’s roar, Hūṃ! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·妙行趣入·施度调伏，祈请魔、天魔烦恼障，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & awakened spiritual movement & generosity & self-mastery (vocative invocation), may You Māra, demon, obstacle to awakening! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.meaningZh: 再三焰光，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Light, flame again and again, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！语金刚种子字（一切法本不生清净妙语），障碍·一极·断除，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! speech-vajra seed syllable Āḥ (non-arising), obstacle + ultimate + cut, Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.iast: oṃ agnaye ativya abhisamayaviśa mahāśriye havyakavyam ahanīya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！向圣火、智火（火大），真如实际·最上真言离言说·一乘如实之道，破有相福德光·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧，大广大光华尊，护摩供，因缘空寂大乐·离名相假立·一乘如实之道，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! to fire, sacred flame (Agni), immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech & supreme vehicle of awakening, blessedness transcending existence & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness, great + O with great magnificence, sgl, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & beyond nominal designation & supreme vehicle of awakening, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.iast: oṃ bhavaka agnaye śāntiṃ kuru svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！星宿寒鸦，向圣火、智火（火大），息灾、寂静、安隐，祈请成办羯磨事业（俱噜），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! star + trickster, to fire, sacred flame (Agni), peace, pacification, tranquility, accomplish & enact this sacred work! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.iast: oṃ hrīḥ siṃhanāda vajracakravartalokika bruṃ bruṃ bruṃ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），师子吼，最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢，再三啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·损减除灭忧苦·大空菩提点摄持）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, lion’s roar, supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious & stainless purity free from dust, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — dispelling sorrow sealed with bodhicitta bindu again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

verses.iast: lokottarāṇi siṃhanāda bruṃ bruṃ bruṃ hūṃ na hūṃ na siṃhanāda bruṃ bruṃ bruṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 一切出世，师子吼，再三啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·损减除灭忧苦·大空菩提点摄持），吽（金刚心印）！不、非、无，吽（金刚心印）！不、非、无，师子吼，再三啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·损减除灭忧苦·大空菩提点摄持），吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Transcendental (plural), lion’s roar, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — dispelling sorrow sealed with bodhicitta bindu again and again, Hūṃ! not, non-, Hūṃ! not, non-, lion’s roar, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — dispelling sorrow sealed with bodhicitta bindu again and again, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Emended. D reads ba li na .

titleZh: 【DB4·84000藏密】Āvalokiteśvarasiṃhanādadhāraṇī · 第 1/5 则独立真言 (TOH703 · The Dhāraṇī of Avalokiteśvara Siṃhanāda)
titleEnglish: The Dhāraṇī of Avalokiteśvara Siṃhanāda — Standalone Mantra 1/5 (TOH703)
translatorZh: 84000: Translating the Words of the Buddha (Kriyātantra)
sutraSourceZh: 德格版甘珠尔 (TOH703)《སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས་དབང་ཕྱུག་སེང་གེ་སྒྲའི་གཟུངས།》(spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug seng ge sgra’i gzungs)
deityZh: Āvalokiteśvarasiṃhanādadhāraṇī · སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས་དབང་ཕྱུག་སེང་གེ་སྒྲའི་གཟུངས།
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 4 大数据库「84000 藏文大藏经开放 TEI 语料库」（TOH703，部类：Kriyātantra，BDRC: W22084 / MW22084）。梵文经题：Āryāvalokiteśvarasiṃhanādadhāraṇī；藏文经题：སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས་དབང་ཕྱུག་སེང་གེ་སྒྲའི་གཟུངས། (spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug seng ge sgra’i gzungs)；英文经题：The Dhāraṇī of Avalokiteśvara Siṃhanāda。本经共含 5 则独立真言，此为第 1 则独立真言（一咒一篇严格分立），本篇共 4 句。
recitationTipsZh: 84000 学者团队根据梵藏写本严格校勘还原之古典梵文真言，附有权威英译咒义与校勘记。

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：This transliteration follows C, L, and K, as well as the Sanskrit reported in the Siṃhanādadhāraṇī from the Sādhanamālā in reading karoṭa . D reads karoti .

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼圣观自在菩萨·菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情）·摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨）·大悲圣尊、具足大悲心者！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Noble Avalokiteśvara, Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero, Greatly Compassionate One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：This transliteration follows C, L, and K, as well as the Sanskrit reported in the Siṃhanādadhāraṇī from the Sādhanamālā in reading karoṭa . D reads karoti .

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：This transliteration follows C, L, and K, as well as the Sanskrit reported in the Siṃhanādadhāraṇī from the Sādhanamālā in reading karoṭa . D reads karoti .

verses.iast: oṃ akaṭe vikaṭe nikaṭe kaṭaṃkaṭe karoṭe citijvalakaroṭa vīrye svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！造作离相·断除憍慢执障，巨大、怪异尊，比邻、边儿尊，造作离相·断除憍慢执障，杯子、盆地尊，炽燃放光·能作成办·妙行迁变空，精进、勇猛无畏力尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! freedom from karmic agency & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation), O exceeding the usual measure, huge, monstrous, hideous, wicked, bad, O near, freedom from karmic agency & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation), O cup, basin, blazing, making, O heroic energy, diligence / in heroic energy, diligence, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：This transliteration follows C, L, and K, as well as the Sanskrit reported in the Siṃhanādadhāraṇī from the Sādhanamālā in reading karoṭa . D reads karoti .

verses.iast: namo ratna trayāya | namo hayagrīvāya | namo lokesvarāya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼珍宝、摩尼宝·三重、三合会！归命顶礼马头明王（马头观音迅速啖障尊）！归命顶礼离一切相无相·造作离相·一切诸谛圆满！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to jewel, precious gem, treasure, triple, threefold! Homage to Hayagrīva, Horse-Necked Wrathful Vidyārāja! Homage to freedom from conditioned marks & freedom from karmic agency & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (reverent offering)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 93 (rgyud, rtsa), folios 165.b–171.a · 藏文名：སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས་དབང་ཕྱུག་སེང་གེ་སྒྲའི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:

verses.iast: oṃ hrīḥ kulu yulu nīlakaṇṭha hulu hulu tiṣṭha tiṣṭha bandha bandha māraya
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），造作离相·离一切相无相，一乘如实之道·离一切相无相，青颈观自在（吞摄诸毒大悲相），再三威猛速疾摄护除灾（呼嚧），再三安住加持，再三结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），祈请魔、天魔烦恼障
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal), supreme vehicle of awakening & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal), Nīlakaṇṭha, Blue-Throated Compassionate One, swiftly protect and sweep away calamity! again and again, abide steadfastly & bestow grace! again and again, bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary! again and again, may You Māra, demon, obstacle to awakening!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 93 (rgyud, rtsa), folios 165.b–171.a · 藏文名：སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས་དབང་ཕྱུག་སེང་གེ་སྒྲའི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: māraya hā hā hā hā vajrakrodha hayagrīva hṛḥ hūṃ phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 祈请魔、天魔烦恼障，再三贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，金刚忿，马头明王（马头观音迅速啖障尊），贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: May You Māra, demon, obstacle to awakening! causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — expansive quiescence again and again, Vajra + wrath, Hayagrīva, Horse-Necked Wrathful Vidyārāja, causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — miraculous skillful manifestation with nirvāṇic visarga release, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 93 (rgyud, rtsa), folios 165.b–171.a · 藏文名：སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས་དབང་ཕྱུག་སེང་གེ་སྒྲའི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: ā hrīḥ hri paṃ taṃ naṃ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 悉昙「ā」韵字门：远离寂静周遍，莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·诸根清净自在），跛字门（第一义谛（paramārtha）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），彼（宾格），曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'ā': expansive quiescence, Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — purified faculties, ultimate truth (paramārtha) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, him, that, beyond nominal designation (nāma) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 93 (rgyud, rtsa), folios 165.b–171.a · 藏文名：སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས་དབང་ཕྱུག་སེང་གེ་སྒྲའི་གཟུངས།

verses.iast: hrīḥ nāga lele nāga dumva lele nāga phut phut hale hale hāla hāla sphuṭa sphuṭa nāga bright flickering svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），龙族、大龙王，离一切相无相，龙族、大龙王，施度调伏·无我大慈三昧·最上真言离言说，离一切相无相，龙族、大龙王，再三多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·损减除灭忧苦），再三耕，再三大王诗人，再三开，龙族、大龙王，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·诸根清净自在），离一切相无相·妙行迁变空·造作离相，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, Nāga, dragon/serpent deity, freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), Nāga, dragon/serpent deity, generosity & self-mastery & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme ineffable speech, freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), Nāga, dragon/serpent deity, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — dispelling sorrow again and again, O plough / in plough again and again, of a king and poet again and again, suffused again and again, Nāga, dragon/serpent deity, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — purified faculties, freedom from conditioned marks & awakened conduct beyond flux & freedom from karmic agency, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Unlike the rest of the mantra, this phrase is in Tibetan rather than transliterated Sanskrit.

verses.meaningZh: 啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·诸根清净自在·涅槃除障点证入），啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·损减除灭忧苦·大空菩提点摄持），嗡！吽（金刚心印）！大空无碍法界虚空种子
verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — purified faculties with nirvāṇic visarga release, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — dispelling sorrow sealed with bodhicitta bindu, Oṃ! Hūṃ! boundless Dharmadhātu sky seed syllable

verses.meaningZh: 法界平等摄持心印（伊利），契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利）

verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 200.b–202.a · 藏文名：སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས་ཡུམ་གི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 积集一切白净善法功德（唧哩），契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利）
verses.meaningEn: Gathering pure Dharmic merits & radiance, intimate union with the deity samādhi
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 200.b–202.a · 藏文名：སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས་ཡུམ་གི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 再三造作离相·离名相假立·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation) again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 200.b–202.a · 藏文名：སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས་ཡུམ་གི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 头尊，冬尽尊，闢头尊
verses.meaningEn: Śire, O the cool or dewy season, hoar, frost, dew, settle
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 200.b–202.a · 藏文名：སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས་ཡུམ་གི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，娇吠哩尊，诸人，施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧，下贱种，屠家尊，祈请糟糕、恶障于我
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), O Gauri, of a people, generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), O elephant, greatest or best of, O a mixed caste, may You bad, evil, painful, rough, constrained, affected, unnatural me
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 200.b–202.a · 藏文名：སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས་ཡུམ་གི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 下贱种，火供净施·因缘空寂大乐，无我大慈三昧·离一切相无相·离名相假立，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: O a Candala or outcast, sacred offering (imperative seal), selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from conditioned marks & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 200.b–202.a · 藏文名：སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས་ཡུམ་གི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 再三驮字门（法界总持任持（dhātu，无我大慈三昧·离一切相无相·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Dharma-realm retention (dhātu) — dispelling sorrow again and again, selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from conditioned marks & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 200.b–202.a · 藏文名：སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས་ཡུམ་གི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 妙行迁变空·离一切相无相，冥合融摄·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), uniting (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 200.b–202.a · 藏文名：སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས་ཡུམ་གི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 妙行趣入·因缘空寂大乐·离诸诤论无诤，慈柔方面尊
verses.meaningEn: Awakened spiritual movement & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & conflict-free peace, O of gentle aspect
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 200.b–202.a · 藏文名：སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས་ཡུམ་གི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 祈请成办羯磨事业（俱噜），月轮罐子
verses.meaningEn: Accomplish & enact this sacred work! moon or god of the moon + O pot
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 200.b–202.a · 藏文名：སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས་ཡུམ་གི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 向轻·慢·假定今日·汝，圣·右·臂
verses.meaningEn: Light + opinion + suppose now + to Thee, noble + right + O arm
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 200.b–202.a · 藏文名：སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས་ཡུམ་གི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 诸一切圣智之，庄严具、穿戴尊
verses.meaningEn: Of all all knowledge, O accomplishing
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 200.b–202.a · 藏文名：སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས་ཡུམ་གི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 诸一切圣智之，自在主、主宰尊尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Of all all knowledge, O Īśvara, Sovereign Lord, Master, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 200.b–202.a · 藏文名：སྤྱན་རས་གཟིགས་ཡུམ་གི་གཟུངས།

verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: namaḥ sarva-tathāgatānāṃ tadyathā oṃ namaḥ sūkasaṃ namaḥ tārāyai tāramātā
verses.meaningZh: 归命一切、普皆遍满，诸如来（乘如实道来成正觉）之，即说咒曰：嗡！归命，一切诸谛圆满·造作离相，归命，救度超脱·真如实际，星母
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, every, complete, of all Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! homage to all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from karmic agency, homage to ferrying across (vocative invocation), a star
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：It is unclear what the correct Sanskrit for the Tibetan transliteration sūkasam might have been.

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼星尊·迅疾、踊跃尊·勇猛丈夫、无畏英雄尊尊·造作离相·六度满行清净·离名相假立·明·一样模样·三界、三千世界·依·最上真言离言说·造作离相·真如实际·最上真言离言说·造作离相·一切诸谛圆满·众华氏族！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to O a star / in a star, O quick, eager, prompt, willing / in quick, eager, prompt, willing, O heroic, valiant, fearless hero / in heroic, valiant, fearless hero, freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās & beyond nominal designation, splendour, beauty, majesty, like, O look, the Three Worlds (Trailokya), refuge, aid, supreme ineffable speech & freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness, supreme ineffable speech & freedom from karmic agency & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, pollen, O origin!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：Reading kṣana-dyuti-nibhekṣaṇe for kṣanair dyuti-nibhekṣaṇe , as the former rendering appears below and is supported by the published Sanskrit editions.

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼百·本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·妙行迁变空·月轮、清凉满月·充分、欲滴·分次第口门·圣救度佛母（度母）·千、千手千眼·积修、一堆·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐·作紊炽盛！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to hundred, primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & awakened conduct beyond flux, moon, lunar disc, full, replete, filled or richly furnished with, cover, O mouth, Tārā, Savioress Goddess, thousand, heap, pile, mass, abundance, multitude, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, a pig, O flaming!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼黄金、纯金光明·青莲·手掌、执持尊手·莲华（出淤泥而不染清净心）·光华、光彩尊·布施、法施檀那·精进、勇猛无畏力·暖气、炽燃·息灾、寂静、安隐·耐力、忍辱·禅那、静虑禅定·行境尊！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to gold, golden, blue lotus, hand, palm, lotus flower (pure, unstained), O magnificence, splendor, ornate condition, generosity, giving, gift, heroic energy, diligence, heating, burning, tormenting, peace, pacification, tranquility, endurance, patience, meditative concentration (Dhyāna), O scope, range!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼如来佛顶肉髻相·最胜尊胜无边·具监狱尊·周遍、圆满全体·波罗蜜多（度彼岸、究竟圆满）·得·胜者、最胜诸佛·子·得近尊！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Tathāgata, Uṣṇīṣa, supreme victory! triumph!, boundless, O bearer of prison, no rest or remainder, Pāramitā, perfection, gone to the beyond, filled with astonishment and wonder, Victor, Conqueror (Buddha), son, child, the young of an animal, O inhabited, frequented, tenanted, occupied, approached, enjoyed / in inhabited, frequented, tenanted, occupied, approached, enjoyed!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼救度超脱·真如实际·金刚不坏菩提心印、摧破诸障·偈子赞叹、敬礼·圆满充盈·第一义谛·誐字门（妙行趣入（gati）·诸根清净自在）·之间·七（七佛·世间、世界·踏步初升·不是剩余·召请·堪尊！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to ferrying across, adamantine bodhicitta seed syllable, hymn of praise, fulfilling, awakened spiritual movement (gati) — purified faculties, between, seven, world, realm, stride, ascending, having no remainder, the same as, O enduring!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼帝释天主智慧猛火·神父·无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢·施度调伏·遍一切·自在主·宝嵌·部多鬼神、一切生类、真实·起尸·乾闼婆（香音神）·海会众、圣众眷属·药叉（夜叉护法捷疾神）·阵地、转载·所作、已成办尊！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to powerful, sacred fire, priest, selfless great loving-kindness & stainless purity free from dust & generosity & self-mastery, all-pervading, Īśvara, O beset, spirit, living being, true/existent, a kind of goblins or vampires, Gandharva, celestial musician, assembly, host,retinue, Yakṣa, nature/wealth guardian spirit, in front, forward, before, O done, made, accomplished / in done, made, accomplished!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: namas traḍ iti phaṭ-kāra-para-yantra-pramardini pratyālīḍha-pada-nyāse śikhi-jvālākulekṣane
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼荼字门（息灭诤怨（ḍamara）·本不生体性）·如是（结句印定）·顿断魔障、摧破无明·偈子赞叹、敬礼·他人·机·调伏碾碎·第一义谛·展左·句、足迹、法位·门限尊·孔雀尊·光焰·部族·模样·自然！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to pacifying conflict & turmoil — primordial non-arising, thus, so it is stated, shatter obstacles and ignorance!, hymn of praise, someone else, apparatus, subduing (vocative invocation), left foot forward, right drawn back, word, verse-foot, step, abode, O threshold, door-sill, O Sikhin, blaze, buddha-family, look, O certainly!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼迅疾、踊跃尊·大、摩诃（广大无边）·威怖、猛厉降魔尊·魔、天魔烦恼障·勇猛丈夫、无畏英雄尊·闢摧灭·颦眉观音母（忿怒除障度母）·所作、已成办·最上真言离言说·造作离相·真如实际·一切、普皆遍满·怨敌、仇害违缘·杀手、驱逐舰尊！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to O quick, eager, prompt, willing / in quick, eager, prompt, willing, great, vast, supreme, O formidable, terrific, awe-inspiring / in formidable, terrific, awe-inspiring, Māra, demon, obstacle to awakening, heroic, valiant, fearless hero, settle, O destroying, Bhṛkuṭī, Frown-Browed Protective Tārā, done, made, accomplished, supreme ineffable speech & freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness, all, every, complete, enemy, adversary, hostile force, O killer, destroyer!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼三·珍宝、摩尼宝·密闭·心友指甲·光华、光彩尊·繁忙来讲·趣往·周遍·迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·诸根清净自在）·法轮、金轮、脉轮·积修、一堆·自我糊涂！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to three, jewel, precious gem, treasure, stamped, sealed, marked with, being in the heart, finger or toe, O magnificence, splendor, ornate condition, be busy for, going, no rest or remainder, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — purified faculties, wheel, Dharma-wheel, discus, heap, pile, mass, abundance, multitude, self, O confounded!

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼欢喜自尊·顶严·打击、染污·无我大慈三昧·离一切相无相·离名相假立·因缘空寂大乐·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·转载笑声·救度超脱·真如实际·魔、天魔烦恼障·世间、世界·踊跃·弯子·踊跃！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to glad, puffing up, diadem, crown, thrown, tossed, hit, afflicted, selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from conditioned marks & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), causal emptiness & spiritual joy & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness, forward, laughter, ferrying across (vocative invocation), Māra, demon, obstacle to awakening, world, realm, be eager, bend, eager!

verses.meaningEn: Homage to universal, all-encompassing, earth-protector, spawn, cover, the same as, O enduring / in enduring, stirring, contraction of the eyebrows, a frown, adamantine bodhicitta seed syllable, hymn of praise, all, trackless, O unharnessing, loosening, freeing from!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼本性寂静止息·等虚空无碍·离诸诤论无诤·等虚空无碍·离诸诤论无诤·息灭诤怨·顶严·璎络·炽盛·阿弥陀佛（无量光如来）·生起不可得·尊胜·断除憍慢执障·破有相福德光·光净天神·作紊·是么尊！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to primordial tranquil peace & space-like boundlessness & conflict-free peace, space-like boundlessness & conflict-free peace & pacifying conflict & turmoil (imperative seal), diadem, ornament, O flaming, Amitābha, Buddha of Infinite Light, transcending birth & victorious & cutting rigid pride & blessedness transcending existence, be bright, O god, a pig, O steady, firm, constant, certain, safe!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼究竟劫波·火供净施·因缘空寂大乐·光焰、智慧炽盛火焰·花鬘内部·立尊·展右·喜·结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮）·奸滑、奸诈·法轮、金轮、脉轮·闢摧灭！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the end of a Kalpa, destruction of the world, sacred offering, blaze, flame, radiant fire, garland, interior, O standing, abiding, remaining, not tasted, joy, bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary!, deceitful, treacherous, wheel, Dharma-wheel, discus, settle, O destroying!

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼掌·表面地面嫌恨·杂罗南弄伤·地表尊·颦眉观音母（忿怒除障度母）·所作、已成办·金刚不坏菩提心印、摧破诸障·偈子赞叹、敬礼·七（七佛·降低世间、住地·破有相福德光·施度调伏·离名相假立！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to palm, surface of the ground, malicious feeling, residence, beaten, O the surface of the earth / in the surface of the earth, Bhṛkuṭī, Frown-Browed Protective Tārā, done, made, accomplished, adamantine bodhicitta seed syllable, hymn of praise, seven, lower world, abode of serpents or demons, also a hell, blessedness transcending existence & generosity & self-mastery & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation)!

verses.meaningEn: Homage to O kind, friendly, mild, gracious, lovely, auspicious, fortunate, to, O peaceful, calm, tranquil / in peaceful, calm, tranquil, peaceful, calm, tranquil, Nirvāṇa, ultimate peace/extinction of suffering, O scope, range, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! the sacred syllable Om, saṃ + O yoked, great, vast, supreme, causing to fall, O destroying, removing

verses.meaningEn: Homage to bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary!, deceitful, treacherous, a limb of the body, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & blessedness transcending existence (vocative invocation), fringe of a garment, a saw, word, verse-foot, step, abode, O threshold, door-sill, Vidyā, sacred wisdom-spell, illumination, adamantine bodhicitta seed syllable, hymn of praise, ), O going!

verses.meaningEn: Homage to O quick, eager, prompt, willing / in quick, eager, prompt, willing, fall, malicious feeling, adamantine bodhicitta seed syllable, prison, hymn of praise, spiritual strength freeing bonds & transcending birth & victorious & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), Mount Meru, cosmic axis mountain, a sacred mountain, a tree in paradise, men, a mountain, the seat of Śiva and Kubera, world, realm of beings, triple, threefold, awakened conduct beyond flux & freedom from conditioned marks & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation)!

sutraSourceZh: 德格版甘珠尔 (TOH726)《དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།》(de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yum sgrol ma las sna tshogs ’byung ba zhes bya ba’i rgyud)
deityZh: Sarvatathāgatamātṛtārāviśvakarmabhavatantranāma · དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 4 大数据库「84000 藏文大藏经开放 TEI 语料库」（TOH726，部类：Kriyātantra，BDRC: W22084 / MW22084）。梵文经题：Namastāraikaviṃśatistotraguṇahitasahita；藏文经题：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད། (de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yum sgrol ma las sna tshogs ’byung ba zhes bya ba’i rgyud)；英文经题：The Tantra on the Origin of All Rites of Tārā, Mother of All the Tathāgatas。本经共含 43 则独立真言，此为第 11 则独立真言（一咒一篇严格分立），本篇共 12 句。
recitationTipsZh: 84000 学者团队根据梵藏写本严格校勘还原之古典梵文真言，附有权威英译咒义与校勘记。

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼天神、天女·海会众眼目·天神、天女·紧那罗（歌神）·住宿截至趣往·束缚缠缚·喜·蛇盘身·罪垢、魔掌·恶梦、不祥梦境·摧灭、除断尊！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to god, goddess, assembly, eye-witness or superintendent, god, goddess, Kinnara, celestial song-spirit, stay by, O going, tie or bond, joy, winding, curve, coil, sin, depravity, bad dream, nightmare, evil omen, O destroying, removing!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 归命敬礼·离名相假立，月轮阿罗歌花，随着富楼那，领军、作法，明，光净天神，请摄取、遣除苦厄！啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·诸根清净自在），曰，救度超脱·真如实际，危，瘟疫，摧灭、除断尊
verses.meaningEn: Bowing, moon + arka flowers, along with + Purna, a man's name, splendour, beauty, majesty, be bright + O god, carry away (suffering)! remove! stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — purified faculties, said, ferrying across (vocative invocation), perilous, fever, pain, grief, sorrow, O destroying, removing
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼三·真性·布局、次第·寂静·威·辅以、充分魔怔尊·曜执、星曜鬼神执障·起尸·坚持下去洪水·摧灭、除断尊·最妙尊·迅疾、踊跃尊！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to three, the state of being that, the true state or real nature, putting down or on placing, distributing, arrangement, order, disposition, kind, friendly, mild, gracious, lovely, auspicious, fortunate, ability, power, capacity of, O accompanied by, joined or connected with, full or possessed of / in accompanied by, joined or connected with, full or possessed of, planet, seizing spirit/graha, a kind of goblins or vampires, press on, a flood, O destroying, removing, O cover, upper garment / in cover, upper garment, O quick, eager, prompt, willing / in quick, eager, prompt, willing!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: mantra-mūlam idaṃ stotraṃ namas-kāraika-viṃśakam yaḥ paṭhet prayato dhīmān devyām bhakti-samanvitaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 真言、密咒（护心密语），尾，此、此法门，赞叹、偈子，归命，造作离相·清净离诸尘垢，二十，凡彼…者，第一义谛·远离虚妄安立·真如实际，深远，成就觉慧，施度调伏·最上真言离言说·一乘如实之道，物流、瓜分，辅以、充分魔怔
verses.meaningEn: Mantra, sacred formula, to (the neighborhood of), this, here, praise, hymn, homage to freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust, accompanied or increased by twenty, whoever, he who, ultimate truth & beyond conceptual fabrication & immutable Suchness, stretched or held out, far-reaching, dhīmān, generosity & self-mastery & supreme ineffable speech & supreme vehicle of awakening, distribution, partition, division, portion, share, accompanied by, joined or connected with, full or possessed of
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: sāyaṃ vā prātar utthāya smaret sarvābhaya-pradam sarva-pāpa-praśamanaṃ sarva-durgati-nāśanam
verses.meaningZh: 晚，或、抑或，及早、初日分，立起，忆念本誓·一切诸谛圆满，一切无畏，施予，一切、普皆遍满，罪业、恶不善业，疗，一切、普皆遍满，恶趣，摧灭、除断
verses.meaningEn: Evening, or, early, in the morning, to-morrow, utthāya, recalling, all + non-fear, giving, uttering, causing, all, every, complete, evil, karmic sin, unwholesome deed, heal, all, every, complete, evil destiny, destroying, removing
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: abhiṣikto bhavet tūrṇaṃ saptabhir jina-koṭibhiḥ asmin mahattvam āsādya so 'nte bauddha-padaṃ vrajet
verses.meaningZh: 灌顶，当得成就、若成，迅疾、疾速，萨钵多融通，胜者、最胜诸佛，以诸俱胝（千万，于此之中，酒席汝，倚，彼、彼尊（连音式），以内，佛驮，言，最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·生起不可得·尊胜
verses.meaningEn: Abhiṣikto, may be, would become, quick, swift, seven + to, Victor, Conqueror (Buddha), with ten million, myriad (koṭi), in this, feast + Thou, to be got or obtained, he, that one, within, of (a) Buddha, padaṃ, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & transcending birth & victorious
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: viṣaṃ tasya mahā-ghoraṃ sthāvaraṃ cātha jaṅgamam smaraṇāt pralayaṃ yāti khāditam pītam eva vā
verses.meaningZh: 箭毒，彼之、其（属格），大、摩诃（广大无边），威怖、猛厉降魔，住，妙行迁变空·无住安立，行，从记忆、传统，转载惛沈，揭帝、步调尊，嚼，黄，唯、正是、决定，或、抑或
verses.meaningEn: Viṣaṃ, his, of that, great, vast, supreme, formidable, terrific, awe-inspiring, standing, immovable, firm, lasting, constant, awakened conduct beyond flux & non-abiding equipoise, going, moving, living, from remembrance, memory, tradition, forward + dulling or hebetating the mind, O gone, passed,, chew, pītam, indeed, verily, alone, or
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: graha-jvara-viṣārtānām paramārti-vināśanam anyeṣāṃ caiva sattvānāṃ dvis-tri-saptābhivartanam
verses.meaningZh: 曜执、星曜鬼神执障，瘟疫，搅拌诸辛苦之，最胜意外，闢摧灭，他轴，以及、亦复如是（ca + eva），诸有情、众生、勇猛心之，娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·诸根清净自在），三，七·融通·轰隆
verses.meaningEn: Planet, seizing spirit/graha, fever, pain, grief, sorrow, stir + of all fallen into, supreme + mishap, settle + destroying, other + the pole of a carriage, and indeed, likewise, of all sentient being, living creature, courage, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — purified faculties, three, seven + to + causing to move or live
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: putra-kāmo labhet putraṃ dhana-kāmo labhed dhanam sarva-kāmān avāpnoti na vighnaiḥ pratihanyate
verses.meaningZh: 子，希，离一切相无相·破有相福德光·真如实际，子，财，希，离一切相无相·破有相福德光·施度调伏，财，一切、普皆遍满，希，最上真言离言说·第一义谛·离名相假立，不、非、无，以诸障碍、毗那夜迦魔障，对打
verses.meaningEn: Son, child, the young of an animal, wish, freedom from conditioned marks & blessedness transcending existence & immutable Suchness, son, child, the young of an animal, treasure, wish, freedom from conditioned marks & blessedness transcending existence & generosity & self-mastery, dhanam, all, every, complete, wish, supreme ineffable speech & ultimate truth & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), not, non-, by/with obstacle, impediment, obstructing spirit, toward
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 圣救度佛母（度母），世尊佛母！此圣女，界线，权利、正确，随着佛陀，妙语、语言
verses.meaningEn: Tārā, Savioress Goddess, O Blessed Goddess + this, sūtraṃ, right, proper, along with + Buddha, spoken, told, uttered
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：“This sūtra of Blessed Lady Tārā was spoken by the completely perfect Buddha.”

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，掌
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, palm
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The Sanskrit underlying what we have rendered here as samayā ulakaraye is unclear.

verses.iast: samayā ulakaraye buddhaṃ ca dharmaṃ ca saṅghaṃ ca tāraye svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 中间、比邻，能作成办·离一切相无相，佛陀、觉者以及正法、诸法实相以及圣僧伽、和合众以及向星，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: In the middle of, betwixt, making (reverent offering), Buddha, the Awakened One and Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena and Saṃgha, noble assembly and to a star, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The Sanskrit underlying what we have rendered here as samayā ulakaraye is unclear.

verses.iast: namaḥ sarva-tathāgata-samyak-sambuddhāya trāyate tārate tu tāra
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切、普皆遍满·如来（乘如实道来成正觉）·权利、正确·随着佛陀·守护掩蔽拘牵尊·星·然而、而、实则·星！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, every, complete, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, right, proper, along with, to, protect shelter, O held, a star, but, indeed, moreover, a star!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.iast: oṃ vajra jvala vajra tana hūṃ phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞），金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），裔胄、童子，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, blaze forth with wisdom radiance! Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, offspring, child, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！法界（清净真如界），最极清净、究竟净除，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Dharmadhātu, realm of ultimate reality, completely purified, supremely pure, Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：This reading follows H and N: pakṣa-viśuddha . D has prakṣa-viśuddha .

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！悉昙「aṃ」韵字门：本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持，界、法界、佛舍利界，最极清净、究竟净除，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'aṃ': primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, realm, element, sphere, relic-essence, completely purified, supremely pure, Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：This reading follows H and N: pakṣa-viśuddha . D has prakṣa-viśuddha .

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！普遍、周遍十方，最极清净、究竟净除，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! universal, all-encompassing, completely purified, supremely pure, Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：This reading follows H and N: pakṣa-viśuddha . D has prakṣa-viśuddha .

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！羽，最极清净、究竟净除，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! feather, completely purified, supremely pure, Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：This reading follows H and N: pakṣa-viśuddha . D has prakṣa-viśuddha .

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！肺痄，菩提、初升，最极清净、究竟净除，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! hurt, wounded, destroyed, violated, awakening, rising, completely purified, supremely pure, Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：This reading follows H and N: pakṣa-viśuddha . D has prakṣa-viśuddha .

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，一切、普皆遍满，如来（乘如实道来成正觉），曼荼罗、坛城轮圆具足，普遍、周遍十方，最极清净、究竟净除，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to all, every, complete, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, Maṇḍala, sacred cosmogram/circle, universal, all-encompassing, completely purified, supremely pure, Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：This reading follows H and N: pakṣa-viśuddha . D has prakṣa-viśuddha .

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！一切、普皆遍满，如来（乘如实道来成正觉），如意摩尼宝珠（随心满愿宝），炽燃、炽盛尊，一切、普皆遍满，如来（乘如实道来成正觉），我、真我自性，清净、纯洁无染，向圆满清净、周遍无垢，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，珍宝、摩尼宝，向三重、三合会；归命顶礼真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·一切、普皆遍满·诸如来（乘如实道来成正觉）·救度超脱·真如实际！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to jewel, precious gem, treasure, to/for triple, threefold Homage to immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening, all, every, complete, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, ferrying across (vocative invocation)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼星尊·迅疾、踊跃尊·勇猛丈夫、无畏英雄尊尊·一刹那·明·一样·模样·自然·三界、三千世界·依·最上真言离言说·造作离相·真如实际·最上真言离言说·造作离相·一切诸谛圆满·众华氏族！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to O a star / in a star, O quick, eager, prompt, willing / in quick, eager, prompt, willing, O heroic, valiant, fearless hero / in heroic, valiant, fearless hero, birth under favorable conditions, splendour, beauty, majesty, like, look, O certainly, the Three Worlds (Trailokya), refuge, aid, supreme ineffable speech & freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness, supreme ineffable speech & freedom from karmic agency & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, pollen, O origin!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼百·本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·妙行迁变空·月轮、清凉满月·随着富楼那·分次第口门·圣救度佛母（度母）·千、千手千眼·积修、一堆·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐·作紊炽盛！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to hundred, primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & awakened conduct beyond flux, moon, lunar disc, along with, Purna, cover, O mouth, Tārā, Savioress Goddess, thousand, heap, pile, mass, abundance, multitude, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, a pig, O flaming!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 星尊，救度超脱·真如实际，迅疾、踊跃尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: O a star / in a star, ferrying across (vocative invocation), O quick, eager, prompt, willing / in quick, eager, prompt, willing, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 202.a–217.a · 藏文名：དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡུམ་སྒྲོལ་མ་ལས་སྣ་ཚོགས་འབྱུང་བ་ཞེས་བྱ་བའི་རྒྱུད།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三星尊，救度超脱·真如实际，吽（金刚心印）！偈子赞叹、敬礼，圆满充盈·第一义谛，誐字门（妙行趣入（gati）·诸根清净自在），之间；七（七佛，世间、世界，踏步初升；周遍召请，一样尊，莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O a star / in a star again and again, ferrying across (vocative invocation), Hūṃ! hymn of praise, fulfilling, awakened spiritual movement (gati) — purified faculties, between Seven, world, realm, stride + ascending No rest or remainder + the same as, O the same, Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：This mantra has been emended based on the reading in N and H: kramakrānti ; S: kramakranti ; as well as a similar reading in D below. Here, D reads tramātrānti .

verses.meaningEn: Powerful + sacred fire, priest, stainless purity free from dust & generosity & self-mastery & primordial tranquil peace, awakened conduct beyond flux & primordial tranquil peace & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), spirit, living being, true/existent, a kind of goblins or vampires, Gandharva, celestial musician, assembly, host,retinue, Yakṣa, nature/wealth guardian spirit, in front, forward, before, O done, made, accomplished / in done, made, accomplished

verses.meaningEn: Phaṭ! hymn of praise, someone else + apparatus, O crushing, destroying, left foot forward, right drawn back, word, verse-foot, step, abode, threshold, door-sill, O Sikhin, blaze + buddha-family + O look

verses.meaningEn: Great, vast, supreme, O formidable, terrific, awe-inspiring, Māra, demon, obstacle to awakening, heroic, valiant, fearless hero, settle + O destroying, Bhṛkuṭī, Frown-Browed Protective Tārā, done, made, accomplished, supreme ineffable speech & freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness, all, every, complete, enemy, adversary, hostile force, O killer, destroyer

verses.meaningEn: Jewel, precious gem, treasure, stamped, sealed, marked with, being in the heart + finger or toe, O magnificence, splendor, ornate condition, be busy for + going + no rest or remainder, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — purified faculties, wheel, Dharma-wheel, discus, heap, pile, mass, abundance, multitude, supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — primordial non-arising, action + O confounded

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！因陀逻，向婆罗
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Śakra king of the gods, to/for warden
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The reading udaya-bhūmaye is conjectural. D has u ti a ya bu mi ye , while S reads u ti a ya b+hu mi ye .

verses.meaningZh: 向日轮、太阳光明，向月轮、清凉满月
verses.meaningEn: To/for sun, solar orb, to/for moon, lunar disc
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The reading udaya-bhūmaye is conjectural. D has u ti a ya bu mi ye , while S reads u ti a ya b+hu mi ye .

verses.meaningZh: 出现，向地、菩萨十地
verses.meaningEn: To manifest, to ground, stage (bodhisattva bhūmi)
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The reading udaya-bhūmaye is conjectural. D has u ti a ya bu mi ye , while S reads u ti a ya b+hu mi ye .

verses.meaningZh: 悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性，偈子赞叹、敬礼，面，一切、普皆遍满，诸正法、诸法实相之
verses.meaningEn: Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, hymn of praise, mukhaṃ, all, every, complete, of all Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The reading udaya-bhūmaye is conjectural. D has u ti a ya bu mi ye , while S reads u ti a ya b+hu mi ye .

verses.iast: ādyanutpannatvāt oṃ āḥ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 施度调伏·一乘如实之道·离名相假立，嗡！语金刚种子字（一切法本不生清净妙语），吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery & supreme vehicle of awakening & beyond nominal designation, Oṃ! speech-vajra seed syllable Āḥ (non-arising), Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The reading udaya-bhūmaye is conjectural. D has u ti a ya bu mi ye , while S reads u ti a ya b+hu mi ye .

verses.iast: oṃ amukam me vaśam ānaya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！某甲，于我、为我，因为、截至所以，离名相假立·一乘如实之道，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! a certain person, to me, my, on account of, for the sake of, by reason of, beyond nominal designation & supreme vehicle of awakening, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! a certain person + of all surrounding, freedom from karmic agency & selfless great loving-kindness & stainless purity free from dust, to me, for me, by/through leading home, marriage, his, of that, father, pleasure + may it close by, Hūṃ! Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara

verses.meaningEn: Own-being + O pure, O completely purified, supremely pure / in completely purified, supremely pure, purify! cleanse! thoroughly purify! cleanse completely! Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 归命向圣观自在菩萨，最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢，嗡！造作离相·清净离诸尘垢·第一义谛，世尊佛母！（呼格），佛陀、觉者尊，惺忪、开明尊，清净、纯洁无染尊，息灾舒散光明，再三击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），我之（行者所有），罪业、恶不善业
verses.meaningEn: Homage to to/for Noble Avalokiteśvara, supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious & stainless purity free from dust, Oṃ! freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust & ultimate truth (vocative invocation), O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! O Buddha, the Awakened One / in Buddha, the Awakened One, O awakened, awake, O pure, cleansed, bright / in pure, cleansed, bright, peace + scatter rays of blessing! strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again, my, of me (the practitioner), evil, karmic sin, unwholesome deed

verses.meaningZh: 再三智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺），我之（行者所有），罪业调，再三成熟善根、烧尽业障（跛左），我之（行者所有），糟糕、恶障
verses.meaningEn: Incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! again and again, my, of me (the practitioner), evil + tame, ripen merit and burn away karmic obstructions! again and again, my, of me (the practitioner), bad, evil
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 224.b–225.a · 藏文名：གྲགས་ལྡན་མའི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！那罗尊，再三妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢·一切诸谛圆满，再三流畅瘖尊，本性寂静止息·离名相假立·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O of a man / in of a man, awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness again and again, flowing + O deaf again and again, primordial tranquil peace & beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: 德格版甘珠尔 Degé Kangyur, vol. 94 (rgyud ’bum, tsha), folios 224.b–225.a · 藏文名：གྲགས་ལྡན་མའི་གཟུངས།

verses.meaningZh: 能作成办·造作离相，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！清净吉祥·能作成办·本性寂静止息，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！能作成办·造作离相，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Making, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Auspicious, making, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Making, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ hūṃ ! Summon them, summon! Guard the pledge of all female spirits! Kill, kill! Bind, bind! Trample them, trample them! Hey! Hey you, great wild one who inhabits charnel grounds, please come swiftly! Dhruṃ phaṭ !

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！腐朽面门
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , Jarjaramukhī! Harm, harm! Overwhelm them with sorrow! You inspire fear in all enemies! Strike, strike! Burn, burn! Cook, cook! Murder, murder! You diminish the chances of my untimely death. You instill fear in all nāgas. You are the loud-laughing queen of all the spirits. Thā thā thā thā ! Dhā dhā dhā dhā ! Oṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ ! Svāhā !
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The Tib. transliteration of the Skt. term, cintāveśa , suggests either being overcome with sorrow or being full of care. The Skt. seems to be saying “you who are worthy of worship in poetry.”

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！再三呼唤圣尊叹词（咄！圣者！），泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara again and again, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! O! Hail! Vocative invocation particle again and again, Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，离名相假立，悉昙「of」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·摄受法流灌顶）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ , you who spread wild panic! Loud-laughing one who is fond of practitioners! Great one of many forms! Source of gems! One with gold in her hands! Destroyer of Yama! verses.meaningEn: O great spirits, go to your respective abodes—to charnel grounds, shrines, solitary trees, riverbanks, crossroads, solitary Śiva liṅgas, or temples. You will be dispatched to the terrible hell of spirits. Go to your respective places as you please! Svāhā !

verses.meaningZh: 此等诸尊，无我大慈三昧·真如实际，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧，大瓶尊，最上真言离言说·离一切相无相，离一切相无相·最上真言离言说·一切诸谛圆满，无我大慈三昧·真如实际，句、足迹、法位，等虚空无碍·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，虚空深度，歌咏·宝树宝山·气息尊，离名相假立·妙行趣入·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: These, selfless great loving-kindness & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness, O bottle, supreme ineffable speech & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), freedom from conditioned marks & supreme ineffable speech & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness (vocative invocation), selfless great loving-kindness & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), word, verse-foot, step, abode, space-like boundlessness & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), hole + O depth, singing + tree or mountain + O breath, beyond nominal designation & awakened spiritual movement & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase sarva abhaya pradai has been emended here to sarvābhayaprade .

verses.meaningEn: Selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), toward + this + O deficient, O black, forward + O black, O fierce, ardent, wrathful / in fierce, ardent, wrathful, great + O fierce, toward + O fierce, dog, dispelling delusion, forward + delusion, great + mota, forward + mota
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase sarva abhaya pradai has been emended here to sarvābhayaprade .

verses.meaningZh: 摧灭、除断尊，转载·摧灭·控制器，一切春天、跳跃，转载一切春天，离名相假立·施度调伏·一乘如实之道，第一义谛·离名相假立·远离虚妄安立，一切忿，对一切忿，再三击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），再三闢击破怨魔与无明惑
verses.meaningEn: O destroying, removing, forward + destroying + controller, spring, jump, forward + spring, beyond nominal designation & generosity & self-mastery & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), ultimate truth & beyond nominal designation & beyond conceptual fabrication (vocative invocation), wrath (plural), toward + wrath, strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again, settle + strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase sarva abhaya pradai has been emended here to sarvābhayaprade .

verses.meaningZh: 一切·暴恶者·败坏，请除灭、遣散灾厄！一切施予安全性尊，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: All + wicked + corrupt, dispel! destroy! all + O giving safety, Hūṃ! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 84000 校勘注：The phrase sarva abhaya pradai has been emended here to sarvābhayaprade .

verses.meaningEn: Particle emphasizing the preceding word or merely expletive + eye + origin, be! become! + left + O gay, blessedness transcending existence & immutable Suchness, freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās & selfless great loving-kindness, Dharma-realm retention & supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious, supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious & pacifying conflict & turmoil, stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation (imperative seal), unfailing, infallible, never in vain, ultimate truth & conflict-free peace
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Dhāraṇīsaṃgraha (Nepalese Compendium, 535 Folios, 113+ samāpta/samāptā colophons)》(K12n2949u)（第 7 句）

verses.meaningZh: 离一切相无相·断除憍慢执障·清净离诸尘垢，第一义谛·本性寂静止息·妙行迁变空，阿弥陀，左勇健，不空成就如来
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from conditioned marks & cutting rigid pride & stainless purity free from dust, ultimate truth & primordial tranquil peace & awakened conduct beyond flux, amitābhaḥ, left + strong, Amoghasiddhi, Unfailing Accomplishment Buddha
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Dhāraṇīsaṃgraha (Nepalese Compendium, 535 Folios, 113+ samāpta/samāptā colophons)》(K12n2949u)（第 8 句）

verses.meaningZh: 毗卢遮那佛·酒席·来诣·正勤，广大殊胜·本性寂静止息，本性寂静止息·最上真言离言说·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Vairocana + feast + coming from or belonging to goats + effort, great, primordial tranquil peace & supreme ineffable speech & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Dhāraṇīsaṃgraha (Nepalese Compendium, 535 Folios, 113+ samāpta/samāptā colophons)》(K12n2949u)（第 9 句）

verses.meaningZh: 守护我等得究竟，妙行迁变空·真如实际·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: Protect + we attain, awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Dhāraṇīsaṃgraha (Nepalese Compendium, 535 Folios, 113+ samāpta/samāptā colophons)》(K12n2949u)（第 10 句）

verses.meaningZh: 管保贫苦，清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜，持守摄受·最上真言离言说，清净吉祥、善妙庄严
verses.meaningEn: Assuredly + having no cows, stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious, bearing, auspicious, pure, bright, virtuous
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Dhāraṇīsaṃgraha (Nepalese Compendium, 535 Folios, 113+ samāpta/samāptā colophons)》(K12n2949u)（第 11 句）

verses.meaningZh: 般若、超越妙慧，圣智·时候·由诬蔑，一切如来氏族
verses.meaningEn: Prajñā, transcendent wisdom, primordial wisdom + half-year + from smear, all Tathagatas + origin

verses.meaningZh: 马头明王明咒
verses.meaningEn: Hayagrīva + Vidyā
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Hayagrīvavidyā (Gilgit Manuscript Edition)》(K12Xbsu017_u)（第 1 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Hayagrīvavidyā (Gilgit Manuscript Edition)》(K12Xbsu017_u)（第 2 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼圣观自在菩萨·菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情）·摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨）·大悲圣尊、具足大悲心者！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Noble Avalokiteśvara, Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero, Greatly Compassionate One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Hayagrīvavidyā (Gilgit Manuscript Edition)》(K12Xbsu017_u)（第 3 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Hayagrīvavidyā (Gilgit Manuscript Edition)》(K12Xbsu017_u)（第 4 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切众生·怖畏·疗·掌！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all sentient beings, fear, heal, to!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Hayagrīvavidyā (Gilgit Manuscript Edition)》(K12Xbsu017_u)（第 5 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼救度超脱·能作成办·一切诸谛圆满！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to ferrying across, making (reverent offering)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Hayagrīvavidyā (Gilgit Manuscript Edition)》(K12Xbsu017_u)（第 6 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切圣智容器去！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all knowledge, receptacle, to!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Hayagrīvavidyā (Gilgit Manuscript Edition)》(K12Xbsu017_u)（第 7 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切圣智·不是规定·去·尊身·大悲圣尊、具足大悲心者！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all knowledge, no rule, understood, to embodiment, Greatly Compassionate One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Hayagrīvavidyā (Gilgit Manuscript Edition)》(K12Xbsu017_u)（第 8 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼大明咒在位非得·广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Mahāvidyā, reign, great (vocative invocation)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Hayagrīvavidyā (Gilgit Manuscript Edition)》(K12Xbsu017_u)（第 9 句）

verses.iast: tasmai namaskṛtvā idamāryāvalokiteśvaramukhodgīrṇaṃ vajradharamahīyaṃ hayagrīvaṃ nāma paramahṛdayamāvartayiṣyāmisarvakarmārthasādhakam
verses.meaningZh: 向彼尊（为格），顶礼敬拜已，此·圣观自在菩萨·面门·吐痰往外，金刚总持广大，马头明王（马头观音迅速啖障尊），名为、号曰，广大殊胜·能作成办·成办悉地·第一义谛
verses.meaningEn: To him, to that one, having paid homage/salutation, this + Noble Avalokiteśvara + face + spit out, Vajradhara + be great, Hayagrīva, Horse-Necked Wrathful Vidyārāja, by name, called, great, making, accomplishing
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Hayagrīvavidyā (Gilgit Manuscript Edition)》(K12Xbsu017_u)（第 10 句）

verses.meaningZh: 难熬、不能抵抗，诸一切处、到处可见之，诸药叉（夜叉护法捷疾神）之，摧灭除遣·妙行迁变空
verses.meaningEn: Unendurable, insupportable, of all being everywhere, ubiquitous, of Yakṣa, nature/wealth guardian spirit, destroying obstacles
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Hayagrīvavidyā (Gilgit Manuscript Edition)》(K12Xbsu017_u)（第 11 句）

verses.iast: amoghaṃ sarvakarmaṇāṃ viṣāṇāṃ ca nāśakam | tadyathā
verses.meaningZh: 不空、决定成就无虚，一切称计粒子，诸毒害、蛇毒与三毒之以及失之后；即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Unfailing, infallible, never in vain, all + a measure of grain, of poison, venom, toxin and loss + or emphasizing particle Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Hayagrīvavidyā (Gilgit Manuscript Edition)》(K12Xbsu017_u)（第 12 句）

verses.meaningZh: 燋此间
verses.meaningEn: To heat + here
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Āryatathāgatoṣṇīṣasitātapatrāparājitāmahāpratyaṅgirādhāraṇī (Sitātapatrā)》(K12bsu004_u)（第 1 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！归命，向诸吉祥·一切·佛陀·菩提萨埵
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to auspiciousness + all + Buddha + to all Bodhisattva
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Āryatathāgatoṣṇīṣasitātapatrāparājitāmahāpratyaṅgirādhāraṇī (Sitātapatrā)》(K12bsu004_u)（第 2 句）

verses.iast: evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān deveṣu trāyastriṃśeṣu viharati sma
verses.meaningZh: 如是、如此，由我（具格：如是我闻），闻，一时，向平，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，神圣宝箭，于诸忉利天中，一切，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in this way, by me, heard, at one time, to equal, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, a divine arrow, among/in Trayastrimsa Heaven, lives, dwells, spends oneʼs time, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Āryatathāgatoṣṇīṣasitātapatrāparājitāmahāpratyaṅgirādhāraṇī (Sitātapatrā)》(K12bsu004_u)（第 3 句）

verses.iast: sudharmāyāṃ devasabhāyāṃ mahatā bhikṣusaṃghena mahatā ca bodhisattvasaṃghena bhikṣuśataiḥ śakreṇa ca devatānāmindreṇa sārdham
verses.meaningZh: 于正义中，于天堂，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，以比丘圣僧伽，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧以及以菩提萨埵圣僧伽，以诸比丘百，以帝释天主以及以天神名因陀逻，俱
verses.meaningEn: In justice, righteousness, devasabhāyāṃ, great, beggar + by, great and Bodhisattva + by, beggar + by, by/through powerful, mighty, strong and a god + name + by, together
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Āryatathāgatoṣṇīṣasitātapatrāparājitāmahāpratyaṅgirādhāraṇī (Sitātapatrā)》(K12bsu004_u)（第 4 句）

verses.iast: tatra khalu bhagavān prajñapta evāsane niṣadya uṣṇīṣamavalokitaṃ nāma samādhiṃ samāpadyate sma
verses.meaningZh: 于彼处、其中，诚然、确实，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，摆，如此古老尊，离名相假立·六度满行清净·施度调伏，六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤·无我大慈三昧，名为、号曰，三摩地、正定等持，时候造偈句，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: There, therein, indeed, verily, certainly, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, arranged, so + O old, beyond nominal designation & perfection of the six pāramitās & generosity & self-mastery, perfection of the six pāramitās & conflict-free peace & selfless great loving-kindness, by name, called, Samādhi, meditative absorption, half-year + way, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Āryatathāgatoṣṇīṣasitātapatrāparājitāmahāpratyaṅgirādhāraṇī (Sitātapatrā)》(K12bsu004_u)（第 5 句）

verses.iast: samanantarasamāpannasya bhagavata uṣṇīṣamadhyādimāni mantrapadāni niścaranti sma
verses.meaningZh: 弹指成就之，才鸣呼，佛顶肉髻相·中·一切第一，一切真言秘密章句，晚上诸尊行持妙道，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Immediately adjoining + of attained, excellence, Uṣṇīṣa + neutral + first, sacred mantra words and phrases, night + they move forth in compassionate activity! selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Āryatathāgatoṣṇīṣasitātapatrāparājitāmahāpratyaṅgirādhāraṇī (Sitātapatrā)》(K12bsu004_u)（第 6 句）

verses.iast: namo bhagavate uṣṇīṣāya śuddhe viraje vimale svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 归命向世尊（薄伽梵）致敬，向佛顶肉髻相、无见顶相，清净、纯洁无染尊，嚩啰阇尊，毘磨利，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, to/for Uṣṇīṣa, Buddha's crown protuberance, O pure, cleansed, bright / in pure, cleansed, bright, O free from dust, pure, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Āryatathāgatoṣṇīṣasitātapatrāparājitāmahāpratyaṅgirādhāraṇī (Sitātapatrā)》(K12bsu004_u)（第 7 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊（薄伽梵）致敬·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤·佛顶肉髻相、无见顶相！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace, Uṣṇīṣa, Buddha's crown protuberance!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Āryatathāgatoṣṇīṣasitātapatrāparājitāmahāpratyaṅgirādhāraṇī (Sitātapatrā)》(K12bsu004_u)（第 8 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛陀、觉者！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Buddha, the Awakened One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Āryatathāgatoṣṇīṣasitātapatrāparājitāmahāpratyaṅgirādhāraṇī (Sitātapatrā)》(K12bsu004_u)（第 9 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼正法、诸法实相！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Āryatathāgatoṣṇīṣasitātapatrāparājitāmahāpratyaṅgirādhāraṇī (Sitātapatrā)》(K12bsu004_u)（第 10 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼圣僧伽、清净海众！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Saṃgha, noble spiritual community!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Āryatathāgatoṣṇīṣasitātapatrāparājitāmahāpratyaṅgirādhāraṇī (Sitātapatrā)》(K12bsu004_u)（第 11 句）

verses.iast: atha khalu śakro devānām indro 'surair jitaḥ parājitaḥ satvaraṃ tvaramāṇarūpo yena bhagavāṃs tenopasaṃkrāntaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 尔时、次复吉祥启白，诚然、确实，帝释天主，诸天人、诸天护法之，印达罗，气息所有权，由克服、赢得，被他所胜，迅疾，真如实际·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，借由彼因缘，星宿诸特，借由彼力·愈加·汇聚
verses.meaningEn: Now, thereupon, auspiciously, indeed, verily, certainly, śakro, of all god, celestial deity (Deva), indro, vital spirit + possession, from conquer, win, subdue, overcome, suppress, expel from , deprive of, conquered, overthrown, hastening, quick, immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust, by which, whereby, star + bull, by that truth + thereto + come together
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Āryadhvajāgrakeyūrānāmadhāraṇī》(K12dhvajkdu)（第 3 句）

verses.iast: upasaṃkramya bhagavataḥ pādau śirasābhivandya bhagavantam etad avocat
verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·一切诸谛圆满·造作离相，世尊、薄伽梵（具六德圣尊），第一义谛·施度调伏，礼敬赞叹·本性寂静止息，若衍底，此、此事，宣说、开示教敕
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from karmic agency, Bhagavān, the Blessed/World-Honored One, ultimate truth & generosity & self-mastery (imperative seal), venerating, victorious(-ly) passed beyond, this, spoke, proclaimed
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Āryadhvajāgrakeyūrānāmadhāraṇī》(K12dhvajkdu)（第 4 句）

verses.iast: ihāhaṃ bhagavan vemacitriṇāsurendreṇa jitaḥ parājito devās trayastriṃśāś ca jitāḥ parājitāḥ
verses.meaningZh: 于此如是宣说，出有坏，最上真言离言说·无我大慈三昧·妙行迁变空，由克服、赢得，被他所胜，施度调伏·最上真言离言说·一切诸谛圆满，真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道以及诸摧，诸被他所胜
verses.meaningEn: Here + spoke, bhagavan, supreme ineffable speech & selfless great loving-kindness & awakened conduct beyond flux (by spiritual power), from conquer, win, subdue, overcome, suppress, expel from , deprive of, conquered, overthrown, generosity & self-mastery & supreme ineffable speech & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening and to conquer (plural), conquered, overthrown
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Āryadhvajāgrakeyūrānāmadhāraṇī》(K12dhvajkdu)（第 5 句）

verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·一切诸谛圆满，出有坏，如何，因为
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, bhagavan, how? in what way? whence?, on account of
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Āryadhvajāgrakeyūrānāmadhāraṇī》(K12dhvajkdu)（第 6 句）

verses.meaningZh: 世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，如是宣说、佛言
verses.meaningEn: The World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, spoke, declared thus
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Āryadhvajāgrakeyūrānāmadhāraṇī》(K12dhvajkdu)（第 7 句）

verses.iast: udgṛhṇa tvaṃ devendra dhvajāgrakeyūrānāmadhāriṇīm aparājitāṃ yā mayā pūrvaṃ bodhisatvabhūtenāparājitadhvajasya tathāgatasyāntikād udgṛhītā
verses.meaningZh: 施度调伏·妙行趣入·因缘空寂大乐，汝、圣尊您，诸天王，总持任持·法界总持任持，无能胜佛母，凡彼（阴性关系代词），由我（具格：如是我闻），元，菩提萨埵·部多鬼神·勇健·无能胜·宝幢，真如实际·无住安立·妙行趣入，施度调伏·妙行趣入·因缘空寂大乐
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery & awakened spiritual movement & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, Thou, You, lord of devas, upholding, Aparājitā, the Unconquerable Goddess, who, whichever (f.), by me, first, Bodhisattva + spirit + strong + invincible + of victory banner, immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise & awakened spiritual movement, generosity & self-mastery & awakened spiritual movement & causal emptiness & spiritual joy
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Āryadhvajāgrakeyūrānāmadhāraṇī》(K12dhvajkdu)（第 8 句）

verses.meaningZh: 施度调伏·妙行趣入·因缘空寂大乐，向诸之后、未来世，以广说，一切诸谛圆满·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery & awakened spiritual movement & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, to/from later, in future, by/through to explain, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Āryadhvajāgrakeyūrānāmadhāraṇī》(K12dhvajkdu)（第 9 句）

verses.iast: nābhijānāmi tato 'rvāg bhayaṃ vā stambhitatvaṃ vā romaharṣanimittaṃ vāntaśaḥ kṣaṇikām api kāyapīḍām
verses.meaningZh: 脐我了知，次，清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说·妙行趣入，怖畏、灾难惊恐，或、抑或，瘫痪汝，或、抑或，毛发竖然相，最上真言离言说·离名相假立·真如实际，刹那住，亦、虽、乃至，身逼迫
verses.meaningEn: The navel or any navel-like cavity + I knowing, secondary, stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech & awakened spiritual movement, fear, peril, danger, dread, or, paralysis + Thou, or, the erection of the hair on the body, supreme ineffable speech & beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness, empty, even, also, body + violation
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Āryadhvajāgrakeyūrānāmadhāraṇī》(K12dhvajkdu)（第 10 句）

verses.iast: tat katamā sā bhagavan dhvajāgrakeyūrā nāma dhāriṇī aparājitā
verses.meaningZh: 彼、真如彼岸，哪些哪些，彼、彼圣母（阴性主格），出有坏，胜幢臂印陀罗尼经，名为、号曰，具方位佛母，无能胜佛母
verses.meaningEn: That (ultimate reality), who or which ?, she, that, bhagavan, Sheng Chuang Bi Yin Tuoluoni Jing, by name, called, goddess possessing holding, bearing, Aparājitā, the Unconquerable Goddess
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Āryadhvajāgrakeyūrānāmadhāraṇī》(K12dhvajkdu)（第 11 句）

verses.iast: tadyathā oṃ jaya vijaya jayavāhini śaṅkari bhayaṅkari prabhañjani rakṣa rakṣa āvadhūtaśrīālakhavajraṃ saparivāraṃ sarvasatvāṃś ca
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！胜伏、最胜吉祥！最胜尊胜、普胜一切！尊胜降伏·生起不可得·尊胜，作乐尊，能作成办·破有相福德光，风息、暴雨尊，再三拥护、守护，吉祥庄严·最上真言离言说，彼眷属，诸一切众生、普皆有情以及
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! conquer! victory! supreme victory! triumph! conquering (vocative invocation), O Sankara, making (vocative invocation), O wind, storm, protect, guard and shelter! again and again, glorious, he + accessory, all sentient beings and
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Āryadhvajāgrakeyūrānāmadhāraṇī》(K12dhvajkdu)（第 12 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！归命，向诸一切佛陀菩提萨埵
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to all + Buddha + to all Bodhisattva
