verses.iast: ñ evaṃ mayā śru tam eka ?
verses.meaningZh: 孃字门（圣智通达（jñāna）·本不生体性），如是、如此，由我（具格：如是我闻），啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·损减除灭忧苦），彼（宾格），一、唯一不二
verses.meaningEn: Non-dual wisdom awareness (jñāna) — primordial non-arising, thus, in this way, by me, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — dispelling sorrow, him, that, one, single, non-dual
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Ekādaśamukhahṛdayadhāraṇī》(K12ekmuhr_u)（第 2 句）

verses.meaningZh: 向平，世尊、薄伽梵（具六德尊），妙行迁变空·离覆障清凉·清净离诸尘垢，一切，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: To equal, the Blessed One, Bhagavān, awakened conduct beyond flux & coolness free of obscuration & stainless purity free from dust, lives, dwells, spends oneʼs time, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Ekādaśamukhahṛdayadhāraṇī》(K12ekmuhr_u)（第 3 句）

verses.meaningZh: 掌佛母，吒字门（断除憍慢执障（ṭaṅka）·钩召发起三昧），苑园尊
verses.meaningEn: Palm, cutting rigid pride (ṭaṅka) — samādhi invocation, O garden? / in garden?
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Ekādaśamukhahṛdayadhāraṇī》(K12ekmuhr_u)（第 4 句）

verses.meaningZh: 掌佛母，曼荼罗、坛城轮圆具足尊以及
verses.meaningEn: Palm, O Maṇḍala, sacred cosmogram/circle / in Maṇḍala, sacred cosmogram/circle and
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Ekādaśamukhahṛdayadhāraṇī》(K12ekmuhr_u)（第 5 句）

verses.iast: ñ atha khalv āryāvalokiteśvaro bodhisa ttvo mahāsattvo 'nekavidyādharakoṭīniyutaśatasaha sreṇa parivṛto yena bhagavāṃs tenopasamakrāmad
verses.meaningZh: 孃字门（圣智通达（jñāna）·本不生体性），尔时、次复吉祥启白，嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，圣观自在菩萨，菩提彼，嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，大菩萨，多·持明仙·魔爪·那由他·因缘·无法方位，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，围绕，借由彼因缘，星宿诸特，真如实际·离名相假立·第一义谛
verses.meaningEn: Non-dual wisdom awareness (jñāna) — primordial non-arising, now, thereupon, auspiciously, supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — primordial non-arising, Noble Avalokiteśvara, Bodhi + he, supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — consecrating Dharma-stream, mahāsattvo, not one + Vidyādhara + the curved end of the bow + tied on + cut in pieces + incapable of bearing, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace (by spiritual power), parivṛto, by which, whereby, star + bull, immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation & ultimate truth
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Ekādaśamukhahṛdayadhāraṇī》(K12ekmuhr_u)（第 6 句）

verses.iast: ñ upasaṃkramya bhagavataḥ pādau śirasā vanditvā bhagavantaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtvā
verses.meaningZh: 孃字门（圣智通达（jñāna）·本不生体性），第一义谛·一切诸谛圆满·造作离相，世尊、薄伽梵（具六德圣尊），第一义谛·施度调伏，本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·一切诸谛圆满，礼敬赞叹·最上真言离言说，若衍底，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·施度调伏
verses.meaningEn: Non-dual wisdom awareness (jñāna) — primordial non-arising, ultimate truth & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from karmic agency, Bhagavān, the Blessed/World-Honored One, ultimate truth & generosity & self-mastery (imperative seal), primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, venerating, victorious(-ly) passed beyond, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & generosity & self-mastery
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Ekādaśamukhahṛdayadhāraṇī》(K12ekmuhr_u)（第 7 句）

verses.iast: kṛtya kānte nyasīda bhagavantam etad avocat
verses.meaningZh: 业行，相亲尊，离名相假立·一乘如实之道·一切诸谛圆满，若衍底，此、此事，宣说、开示教敕
verses.meaningEn: Actions, O desired, loved, lovely, beautiful, beyond nominal designation & supreme vehicle of awakening & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, victorious(-ly) passed beyond, this, spoke, proclaimed
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Ekādaśamukhahṛdayadhāraṇī》(K12ekmuhr_u)（第 8 句）

verses.iast: ñ idaṃ mama bhagavann ekādaśamukhaṃ nāma hṛdayam ekādaśabhi kalpako ṭībhir bhāṣitam
verses.meaningZh: 孃字门（圣智通达（jñāna）·本不生体性），此、此法门，我之（行者所有），破有相福德光·妙行趣入·最上真言离言说，十一面，名为、号曰，心，十一融通，剃头匠，断除憍慢执障·破有相福德光·清净离诸尘垢，妙语、语言
verses.meaningEn: Non-dual wisdom awareness (jñāna) — primordial non-arising, this, here, my, of me (the practitioner), blessedness transcending existence & awakened spiritual movement & supreme ineffable speech, the eleventh, by name, called, hṛdayam, eleven + to, barber, cutting rigid pride & blessedness transcending existence & stainless purity free from dust, spoken, told, uttered
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Ekādaśamukhahṛdayadhāraṇī》(K12ekmuhr_u)（第 9 句）

verses.meaningZh: 孃字门（圣智通达（jñāna）·本不生体性），我、真我自性，妙行迁变空·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Non-dual wisdom awareness (jñāna) — primordial non-arising, I, the awakened self, awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Ekādaśamukhahṛdayadhāraṇī》(K12ekmuhr_u)（第 10 句）

verses.iast: cet tarhi bhāṣiṣyāmi sarva sattvānā m arthāya hitāya sukhāya sarvavyādhipraśa ma nāya
verses.meaningZh: 多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·钩召发起三昧），若尔，我当宣说、讲话，一切、普皆遍满，有情自然，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），向义利、所求善愿、胜义，向利，向乐，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），导师、指导
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness (tathatā) — samādhi invocation, then, I shall speak, talk, say, tell, all, every, complete, sentient being + certainly, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, to/for meaning, benefit, aim, welfare, to/for put, placed, laid, to/for easy, pleasant, comfortable, happy, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, leader, guide
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Ekādaśamukhahṛdayadhāraṇī》(K12ekmuhr_u)（第 11 句）

verses.meaningZh: 守护养育·一切诸谛圆满，向一切·非时横死·对·断，诸信根之
verses.meaningEn: Guarding (reverent offering), all + untimely + toward + to, of all unbelief
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Ekādaśamukhahṛdayadhāraṇī》(K12ekmuhr_u)（第 12 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切佛陀菩提萨埵！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, Buddha, Bodhisattva!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Mahādaṇḍadhāraṇī》(K12madadh_u)（第 2 句）

verses.iast: evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān rājagṛhe viharati sma
verses.meaningZh: 如是、如此，由我（具格：如是我闻），闻，一时，向平，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，王舍城尊，一切，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in this way, by me, heard, at one time, to equal, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, O a king's house, palace, lives, dwells, spends oneʼs time, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Mahādaṇḍadhāraṇī》(K12madadh_u)（第 3 句）

verses.meaningZh: 尸陀林尊，大恐毘林尊，支分寂静·破暗合集·造作离相
verses.meaningEn: O sitavana, great + O smasana, quiescence of perceptual limbs & dissolving dense ignorance & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Mahādaṇḍadhāraṇī》(K12madadh_u)（第 4 句）

verses.iast: tatrāyuṣmān rāhulo 'tīva viheṭhyate devagrahair nāgagrahair yakṣagrahai rākṣasagrahaiḥ
verses.meaningZh: 彼具寿，罗怙罗，很，最上真言离言说·因缘空寂大乐·远离虚妄安立，施度调伏·最上真言离言说·妙行趣入，离名相假立·妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢，坚持下去·尊·呼格极微，以诸罗刹曜执
verses.meaningEn: That, rāhulo, very, supreme ineffable speech & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & beyond conceptual fabrication (vocative invocation), generosity & self-mastery & supreme ineffable speech & awakened spiritual movement, beyond nominal designation & awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust, press on + first + vocative particle, Rākṣasa + by
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Mahādaṇḍadhāraṇī》(K12madadh_u)（第 5 句）

verses.iast: kinnaragrahair garuḍagrahair mahoragagrahair manuṣyagrahair amanuṣyagrahaiḥ pretagrahair
verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢，妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢·息灭诤怨，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·六度满行清净，以诸非人曜执，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust, awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust & pacifying conflict & turmoil, great, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & perfection of the six pāramitās, a non-human + by, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Mahādaṇḍadhāraṇī》(K12madadh_u)（第 6 句）

verses.iast: bhūtagrahaiḥ piśācagrahaiḥ kumbhāṇḍagrahair dvīpibhiḥ kākair ulūkaiḥ kīṭaiḥ sarīsṛpaiṛ
verses.meaningZh: 以诸部多鬼神曜执，以诸毗舍遮曜执，造作离相·无我大慈三昧·破有相福德光，施度调伏·最上真言离言说·第一义谛，造作离相·清净离诸尘垢，以诸鸱枭，以诸蚓，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·第一义谛
verses.meaningEn: Spirit + by, Piśāca + by, freedom from karmic agency & selfless great loving-kindness & blessedness transcending existence, generosity & self-mastery & supreme ineffable speech & ultimate truth, freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust, by/with owl, by/with a worm, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & ultimate truth
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Mahādaṇḍadhāraṇī》(K12madadh_u)（第 7 句）

verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·一乘如实之道·本性寂静止息以及以诸人非人，以诸有情、众生、勇猛心
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & supreme vehicle of awakening & primordial tranquil peace and person + by, by/with sentient being, living creature, courage
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Mahādaṇḍadhāraṇī》(K12madadh_u)（第 8 句）

verses.iast: athāyuṣmān rāhulo yena bhagavāṃs tenopasaṃkrānta upasaṃkramya bhagavataḥ pādau
verses.meaningZh: 即时汝等，罗怙罗，借由彼因缘，星宿诸特，借由彼力·愈加·汇聚，第一义谛·一切诸谛圆满·造作离相，世尊、薄伽梵（具六德圣尊），第一义谛·施度调伏
verses.meaningEn: Then + you [plural], rāhulo, by which, whereby, star + bull, by that truth + thereto + come together, ultimate truth & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from karmic agency, Bhagavān, the Blessed/World-Honored One, ultimate truth & generosity & self-mastery (imperative seal)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Mahādaṇḍadhāraṇī》(K12madadh_u)（第 9 句）

verses.iast: śirasābhivanditvā bhagavantaṃ tripradakṣiṇīkṛtya bhagavataḥ purato rudann aśrūṇi pravartayati sma
verses.meaningZh: 礼敬赞叹·本性寂静止息，若衍底，真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·第一义谛，世尊、薄伽梵（具六德圣尊），阵地、之前，清净离诸尘垢·施度调伏·离名相假立，本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，转起妙法·第一义谛，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Venerating, victorious(-ly) passed beyond, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & ultimate truth, Bhagavān, the Blessed/World-Honored One, in front, before , in presence of, stainless purity free from dust & generosity & self-mastery & beyond nominal designation, primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation), turning forth (vocative invocation), selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Mahādaṇḍadhāraṇī》(K12madadh_u)（第 10 句）

verses.iast: atha bhagavān jānann eva rāhulam āmantrayate sma
verses.meaningZh: 尔时、次复吉祥启白，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，生起不可得·尊胜·离名相假立，唯、正是、决定，罗喉罗，妙意三重，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Now, thereupon, auspiciously, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, transcending birth & victorious & beyond nominal designation, indeed, verily, alone, Rahula, benevolent + triple, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Mahādaṇḍadhāraṇī》(K12madadh_u)（第 11 句）

verses.iast: kiṃ tvaṃ rāhula mama purataḥ sthitvā aśrūṇi pravartayasi
verses.meaningZh: 迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·诸根清净自在·大空菩提点摄持），汝、圣尊您，罗喉罗，我之（行者所有），由城邑，一切诸谛圆满·无住安立·真如实际，本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，转起妙法·第一义谛
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — purified faculties sealed with bodhicitta bindu, Thou, You, Rahula, my, of me (the practitioner), from city, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & non-abiding equipoise & immutable Suchness, primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace (vocative invocation), turning forth (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Mahādaṇḍadhāraṇī》(K12madadh_u)（第 12 句）

verses.meaningZh: 尔时、次复吉祥启白，持明仙劫波，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，以有情日复一日疟疾

verses.iast: namo buddhāya namo dharmāya namaḥ saṃghāya
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛陀、觉者·正法、诸法实相·圣僧伽、清净海众！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Buddha, the Awakened One, Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena, Saṃgha, noble spiritual community!

verses.iast: namo bhagavate śākyamunaye mahākāruṇikāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya

verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, Śākyamuni Buddha, Sage of the Śākyas, Greatly Compassionate One, Tathāgata, income, Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Pañcarakṣādhāraṇī》(T02psarkdhu)（第 3 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切普遍、周遍十方·一切正等正觉、正遍知！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to universal, all-encompassing, Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 BuddhaNexus 分词梵本《Pañcarakṣādhāraṇī》(T02psarkdhu)（第 4 句）

verses.iast: oṃ giri giri giriṇi giriṇi girivati guṇavati ākāśavati ākāśaviśuddhe sarvapāpavigate

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! steadfast sacred mountain peak again and again, O bearer of singing, singer again and again, O one endowed with steadfast sacred mountain peak, O one endowed with virtue, excellence, auspicious quality, O one endowed with space, ether, open sky, space + O completely purified, all + evil + O lost

verses.iast: ākāśe gaganatale ākāśavicāriṇi maṇidhari vajriṇi jvalitaśikhare maṇimuktākhacitamaulidhare
verses.meaningZh: 虚空界（无碍周遍）尊，穹苍尊，虚空界具伺尊，持摩尼宝珠（如意离垢宝）尊，具金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊，炽盛燃耀山尖，摩尼宝珠·真珠·宝嵌·头冠首严三尖·请执持
verses.meaningEn: O space, ether, open sky / in space, ether, open sky, O celestial vault, firmament / in celestial vault, firmament, space + O bearer of proceeding, O bearer of Maṇi jewel, luminous gem, O bearer of Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, blazing + O peaked, Maṇi jewel + pearl + glittering + head + O hold! bear! sustain!

verses.meaningZh: 报刊往外发尊，善见穿戴尊，报刊往外面目，妙眼尊，真金洁白，过去尊，离名相假立·真如实际·第一义谛，末尊，现在时
verses.meaningEn: Press out + O hair, O a beautiful dress / in a beautiful dress, press out + O meters, O marvelous eye / in marvelous eye, gold + O white, O gone away, passed, dead, beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness & ultimate truth (vocative invocation), O future / in future, O present

verses.iast: namaḥ sarvabuddhānāṃ jvalitaujasāṃ buddhe subuddhe bhagavati surakṣaṇi akṣaya sukṣaya

verses.iast: sūkṣme suprabhe sudame sudānte suvrate varade pravare bhagavati bhadravati subhadravati

verses.meaningEn: O fine, small, minute, subtile, intangible, inconceivable, atomic / in fine, small, minute, subtile, intangible, inconceivable, atomic, O good-looking, handsome, beautiful / in good-looking, handsome, beautiful, press out + O or house, press out + O tamed, O ruling well, O boon-granting, wish-bestowing / in boon-granting, wish-bestowing, O cover, upper garment / in cover, upper garment, O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! verses.iast: bhadre subhadre vimale jayabhadre caṇḍi pracaṇḍi caṇḍe vajracaṇḍe mahācaṇḍe gauri
verses.meaningZh: 贤尊，善哉、善见尊，毘磨利，胜伏贤尊，威猛、暴烈除障尊，转载威猛，威猛、暴烈除障尊，金刚威猛，大威猛，娇吠哩尊

verses.meaningZh: 诸人，下贱种，下贱种，真言宣演·最上真言离言说，善心、人情，屠家尊，善见口门尊，山行，本性寂静止息·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，作乐，经营那么卵尊

verses.meaningEn: Thus, in this way, by me, heard, at one time, to equal, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, freedom from karmic agency & primordial tranquil peace & selfless great loving-kindness, great, lives, dwells, spends oneʼs time, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising

verses.meaningEn: Beggar + by, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & spiritual strength freeing bonds & causal emptiness & spiritual joy and primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & space-like boundlessness & supreme vehicle of awakening and by/with Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, all + Buddha + virtue + by

verses.meaningEn: There, therein, indeed, verily, certainly, star + bull, his, of that, indeed, verily, alone, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & perfection of the six pāramitās (vocative invocation), stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — sovereign spiritual mastery, indeed, verily, alone, parivṛtaḥ, puraskṛtaḥ, all + poverty + of the ocean + wisdom + exsiccation, by name, called, device, means of, communicates, teaches, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising

verses.meaningZh: 借由彼力、以是因缘，诚然、确实，复次、再三，以三昧耶（本誓、平等契合、时际），借由彼因缘，星宿诸特，借由彼力·愈加·汇聚，第一义谛·一切诸谛圆满·造作离相，世尊、薄伽梵（具六德圣尊），第一义谛·施度调伏，本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·一切诸谛圆满，礼敬赞叹·最上真言离言说，若衍底，多百千，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·施度调伏，一面，离名相假立·一乘如实之道·六度满行清净

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼善见·如来·出·堪敬尊·正等正觉、正遍知！即说咒曰：嗡！再三甘露妙流普润群生（素噜），再三转载甘露妙流普润群生，再三弯曲、超群，再三方位、战斗，再三桑方位，再三忆念本誓，再三一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，一切诸饿鬼，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！此，放置·愉快·浮肿·一连，饼，七（七佛，人群、海众，般一样，左·手·勇健·弹指·三重，齿已，向诸湖剪切力此等诸尊，远离尊，所尊，施予；如是、如此以及宣说演畅·破有相福德光；第一义谛·一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢，生事，施予饶益·施度调伏，我、真我自性，世界·界·天衣·勇健，诸饿鬼、薜荔多之，楼阁，如是（结句印定）；破有相福德光·造作离相·真如实际，任务；如是、如此，一切诸饿鬼，水稻·斗斛·饼，别主，施度调伏·真如实际，成办、生起、安住；如是、如此，成办作持·造作离相，不、非、无，弱，成办、生起、安住，不、非、无，流浪者、贫苦，破有相福德光·最上真言离言说·真如实际，亦、虽、乃至，然而、而、实则，再三生起不可得·尊胜·真如实际，大力，颜容殊妙，众所乐见，富，广大规模，成办、生起、安住，长寿，无病佛母，疾，妙行迁变空·离名相假立·真如实际，三耶三佛，破有相福德光·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际；妙行迁变空·一乘如实之道·真如实际以及乐·鸿毛·那个，离一切相无相·造作离相·法界总持任持，愈加造偈句；如是（结句印定），善见，名为、号曰，陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义）
verses.meaningEn: Homage to handsome-figured, beautiful, Tathāgata, income, Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha! Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! stream forth auspicious ambrosia! again and again, forward + stream forth auspicious ambrosia! again and again, crossing, surpassing, overcoming again and again, bearing, carrying again and again, saṃ + bearing again and again, remember Your primordial vow! again and again, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust again and again, all + of all Preta, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! Anayā, put + delightful + dropsy + connected, bhaktaṃ, seven, crowd, multitude, wisdom + the same, left + hand + strong + snap of the fingers + triple, dattvā, a lake + shear + to, O detached / in detached, O place / in place, give Thus, in this way and speaking Ultimate truth & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust, avatāraprekṣiṇo, granting, I, the awakened self, the universe + realm + garment + strong, of all Preta, hungry ghost/departed spirit, tower, thus, so it is stated Blessedness transcending existence & freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness, to be made or done Thus, in this way, all + of all Preta, grain + valley, pratyekaṃ, generosity & self-mastery & immutable Suchness, becomes, arises, is Thus, in this way, enacting, not, non-, weak, becomes, arises, is, not, non-, vagrant, strolling, poor, needy, beggar, blessedness transcending existence & supreme ineffable speech & immutable Suchness, even, also, but, indeed, moreover, transcending birth & victorious & immutable Suchness (imperative seal) again and again, mahābalaḥ, prāsādiko, = + to be shown, to be made to appear, āḍhyo, of great extent, becomes, arises, is, long-lived, free from disease, healthy, speedy, awakened conduct beyond flux & beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness, unsurpassed complete perfect enlightenment, blessedness transcending existence & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation) Awakened conduct beyond flux & supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness and easy + down + that, freedom from conditioned marks & freedom from karmic agency & Dharma-realm retention, thereto + way Thus, so it is stated, handsome-figured, beautiful, by name, called, Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell

atha bhagavān sarvatathāgatān sarvabodhisattvāṃś ca tathaīva ca praviśya toṣanārthāya tathāgatādhipater daśavāyūn āha
prāṇāpānasamānākhyān udānavyānasañjñakān
nāgakūrmakṛkarāṃś ca devadattadhanañjayān
kṛtvaītān ātmano bimbaṃ strītvaṃ nirmāyate punar iti
ete daśa vāyavaḥ śrīsarvabuddhasamāyogaḍākinījālasaṃvara naye yena yena rutenoktās tāṃs tān apy āha
koṭākhyaḥ koṭavaḥ koṭaḥ koṭābhaś ca kaṭīrakaḥ
kolākhyaḥ kolavaḥ kolaḥ kolābhaś ca kalis tathā
etāni daśa nāmāni vajramukhīmahāyogatantre 'pi yathārutārthena daśavāyūn prāha | prāṇāpānodānasamānavyānodvāhavivāhasaṃvāhapravāhanirvāhāś ceti
vajraśiṣya uvāca | prāṇādidaśavāyavo 'smin kāye kutra prativasanti | kiṃ kurvanti ca brūhi bhagavan vajraguruḥ śāstā
vajragurur āha | pañca vāyavaḥ kāyavibhāge sthitvā kāyavyāpāraṃ kurvanti | pañca vāyavaś cakṣurādyāyatane sthitvā indriyavyāpāraṃ kurvanti
tatra prāṇo hṛdistho 'kṣobhyas tathāgataḥ | apāno gudastho ratnasambhavas tathāgataḥ | udānaḥ kaṇṭhastho 'mitābhas tathāgataḥ | samāno nābhistho 'moghasiddhis tathāgataḥ | vyānaḥ sarvasandhistho vairocanas tathāgata iti | udvāho rūpam | vivāhaḥ śabdaḥ | saṃvāho gandhaḥ | pravāho rasaḥ | nirvāhaḥ sparśaś ceti
ete daśa vāyavaḥ punar ucchvāsapraśvāsā bhavanti | te ca punar vāyavyādicaturmaṇḍalātmakā bhavanti | te ca punaś caturdevyātmakā bhavanti | te ca punaḥ pañcabhūtātmakā bhavanti | te ca punar ādarśādipañcajñānātmakā bhavanti | te ca punaḥ sitādipañcaraśmyātmakā bhavanti | te ca punaḥ pañcatathāgatātmakā bhavanti | te ca punas tryakṣarādhāro bhūtvā praveśasthitivyutthānakrameṇa vajrajāpaṃ kārayanti | te ca punar vāyavo 'kārasyādhāro bhūtvā aśeṣavākpravyāhāraṃ kārayanti | te ca punar anāhataṃ vyāpya niḥsvabhāvā bhavanti
vajraśiṣya uvāca | kathaṃ bhagavann ete daśa vāyava ekānekasvabhāvena divārātrau svakāye spharaṇasaṃharaṇaṃ kurvanti | brūhi bhagavān vajraguruḥ śāstā
vajragurur āha | sādhu sādhu mahāsattva śrītattvasaṅgrahā dau mūlatantre cottaratantre ca vāyutattvaṃ na vispaṣṭenoktam | sandhyāyabhāṣitatvāt | vyākhyātantre tu yathārutena bhāṣitaṃ tad avatāryate
nāsikācchidrasambhūtaḥ pañcabuddhakulasthitaḥ
pañcavāyūrdhvasañcāro dehe carati nityaśaḥ
saṃvṛtighrāṇasañcāro dvārāt tasya viniḥsṛtaḥ
vāmadakṣiṇadvandvāś ca stabdhaś caīte caturvidhāḥ
dakṣiṇāt prasaro dhātur hutabhugmaṇḍalaṃ ca vai
raktavarṇam idaṃ vyaktaṃ padmanāthasya sañcaret
vāmāc ca prasaro dhātur vāyumaṇḍalaniḥsṛtaḥ
haritaśyāmasaṅkāśaṃ karmanāthasya sañcaret
dvandvasya prasaro dhātuḥ kanakavarṇasannibhaḥ
māhendramaṇḍalaṃ caīva ratnanāthasya sañcaret
stabdho na prasaro dhātuḥ kṣaṇād vāruṇamaṇḍalam
śuddhasphaṭikasaṅkāśaṃ vajranāthasya sañcaret
sarvadhātūn samuddhṛtya hy ādhārādheyadhāritaḥ
vairocanamahākāyo maraṇānte viniścaret
caturmaṇḍalam etadd hi japen nityaṃ samāhitaḥ
ahorātraṃ sadā jāpyo mantriṇāṃ japasaṅkhyayā
ity uktaṃ bhagavatā vajramālāmahāyogatantre | asyāyam arthaḥ | vajrapadmayor nāsikābhyāṃ raśmiṃ viniścaret | ūrdhvagataḥ saṃvṛtināsāgrād vāmadakṣiṇadvandvastabdhakrameṇa niścarati
tatrāyaṃ kramaḥ | vāmaghrāṇād vinirgato vāyur amoghasiddhis tathāgataḥ | vāyusvabhāvo vāyavyamaṇḍalaṃ haritaśyāmaraśmisvarūpam iti | dakṣiṇaghrāṇāt sañcarito vāyur amitābhas tathāgataḥ | tejaḥsvabhāvo 'gnimaṇḍalaṃ raktaraśmisvabhāvam | ghrāṇadvandvād vinirgato vāyū ratnasambhavo māhendramaṇḍalaṃ pītaraśmisvabhāvam | stabdho mandapracāro vāyur akṣobhyaḥ | svacchābdhatusvabhāvo vāruṇamaṇḍalaṃ śvetaraśmisvabhāvam | catvāri dhātumaṇḍalāni vyāno vyāpto vāyur na niścarati raśmiḥ śrīvairocanas tathāgataḥ khasamasvabhāvaḥ
kintv ekaiko raśmir viniścaret | pañcapañcaraśmir vinirgacchati | ekena dhātumaṇḍalena catvāro dhātavo vyāptā iti | ekaikasminn api maṇḍale tryakṣaramantrādhipatiḥ praveśādikrameṇa svayam eva satataṃ japed iti | saṅkṣepato vāyutattvam uktaṃ
vajraśiṣya uvāca | gurupādaprasādād vāyutattvam āgamādhigamābhyāṃ suśikṣito 'ham | adhunā mantratattvasya lakṣaṇaṃ jñātum icchāmi | anukampām upādāya nirdiśatu bhagavān vajraguruḥ śāstā
vajragurur āha | sādhu sādhu mahāsattva mantratattvaṃ nāma tattvasaṅgrahādau mūlatantre cottaratantre ca kevalaṃ mantramātram udīritaṃ mantroddhāro na pradarśitaḥ | vyākhyātantre tu mantroddhāro mantrasaṅketo mantrārtho mantratattvaṃ ca bhagavatā sadbhāvena vivṛtam | ato vyākhyātantram anadhigatā bāhyamantraparāyaṇā na prajānanti | tasmād yatnataḥ śṛṇu vyākhyātantrā nusāreṇa mantratattvaṃ te pratibodhayāmi
tatra sarpādimantrā ālikālisamudbhavāḥ | teṣāṃ tattvam anāhatodbhavaṃ tryakṣaram | yasmāt sarvamantrāḥ strīpunnapuṃsakasvabhāvā yathālabdhopadeśena tryakṣare praviśanti | tena tryakṣaraḥ sarvamantrādhipatiḥ | te ca punar ekaikaśo 'nāhatena saha tribhis tribhir akṣarair niṣpannāḥ
adhunā 'kṣaratrayasya vyāpāro nirdiśyate | tatra tāvat trisaṃyogād devatāmūrtiṃ niṣpādayati | sa eva praveśasthitivyutthānakrameṇa deham aharniśaṃ dhārayati | sa evālikālibhiḥ saha dvayendriyasamāpattikāle 'dhomukho bhūtvā guhyanāsikācchidrāc chukrarūpeṇa vinirgatya sattvadhātūn utpādayati | sa eva prāṇāyāmena saha punar ūrdhvaṃ gatvā indriyadvāraṃ prabodhya saṃvṛtighrāṇa- dvārād vāmadakṣiṇādikrameṇa nirgatyānābhogena vajrajāpaṃ kṛtvā pūrvakarmāvaraṇaṃ viśodhayati | sa evāhorātrakrameṇa japasaṅkhyām upalakṣya vāruṇādimaṇḍalodaye sitādivarṇam āśritya śāntikādisarvakarmāṇi karoti | sa evākṣararūpeṇa parikalpito nābhiṣpanditajihvāgretyādivāgjāpalakṣaṇena jāpaṃ kṛtvā bāhyavarṇādikriyām āśritya śāntikādisarvakarmāṇi karoti | sa eva tryakṣaraśodhanabodhanajvalanakrameṇāhāraṃ viśodhya nirāmayaṃ karoti | evaṃ kaḍevarāvasthāyāṃ sarvaṃ kṛtvā paryante 'nāhate praviśya punar api prākṛtadeham āśritya tathaīva sarvaṃ karoti
idānīṃ tryakṣarotpattim āha | bhagavān sandhyāvyākaraṇamahāyogatantre
ekādir navamadhye tu daśabhir yo na badhyate
tam abaddhaṃ vijānīyāt sa vetti paramaṃ padam
svaravyañjanavarṇāś ca navasaṅkhyānuvartinaḥ
abaddhānyonyasaṃyogād yo vetti sa jagadguruḥ
yo buddhvā vāñchayet siddhiṃ vimuktiphalasampadam
sa tad eva samāpnoti arūpād rūpavarjitam
bhūtāntena samāyuktaṃ kalādiṣoḍaśe sthitam
pañcapañcakasaṃyuktaṃ catustrayaniyojitam
sānusvāraṃ sadīrghaṃ ca guṇasaṃyogalopavat
hrasvaṃ samastavākyaṃ syān na cānekaṃ na caīkakam
yakārārthena yat kiñcit kartavyaṃ siddhim icchatā
rephāditritayenaīva jagatkāryaṃ pravartate
ye varṇāḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ proktā abhimukhāś ca ye punaḥ
strīpunnapuṃsakās te ca dhātvādiparikalpitāḥ
adhaūrdhvasamāyuktā jñātvā buddhyā niyojitāḥ
ṣaḍbhir uktaṃ catustryaikān niḥsvabhāvaikabhāvajām
tān yādyarthe samāyojya tryadhvajñānaṃ tu jāyate
svapnendrajālavad vidvān kuryāj jagat tridhātuke
pravyāhāram idaṃ mantraṃ niḥsvabhāvasvabhāvajam
tataḥ pariṇataṃ rūpaṃ yad devatopalambhakam
sāṅketikaṃ tritattvasthaṃ prakṛtijāpalakṣaṇam
anākhyeyam anuccāryaṃ bodhicittam idaṃ param
tad eva tritayaikaṃ syād anirgamam anāgamam
anirodhaṃ praśāntaṃ ca śāśvatocchedavarjitam
tryadhvavidākṛtasaṅkalpam ākāśābhedalakṣaṇam
pāramārthikam evedaṃ pratyātmavedyalakṣaṇam
sarvāsv api kriyāsv eva niṣadyādiṣu yogavit
anākhyeyam anuccāryaṃ tryadhvātītaṃ japet sadā
pāṇḍarādijapaḥ proktaḥ pañcaviṃśacchatadvayam
caturbhir guṇitaṃ samyak caturyogaṃ śataṃ nava
navaśataṃ tu yad dṛṣṭaṃ caturviṃśatiparikramaiḥ
pratyutpādād bhavet tac ca dvyayutaṃ śataṣoḍaśam
tad itthaṃ guhyasandhyāyāṃ sūkṣmayogaṃ prakāśitam
dhyānādhyayanavītaṃ tu tathāpi japa ucyate
ity adhyātmamantratattvam ucyate
vajraśiṣya uvāca | ādhyātmikavāgakṣarapravṛttikāraṇe 'pagatasaṃśayaḥ | api ca hrasvaṃ samastavākyaṃ syād ity uktaṃ bhagavatā tat kathaṃ hrasvo 'kāraḥ samastavākpravṛtteḥ kāraṇaṃ bhavati
vajragurur āha | sādhu sādhu mahāsattva | iha prāvacanikā vyākaraṇaṃ puraskṛtya kevalaśabdārthamātram anusmaranti | na tu punar akṣaram abhilāpaś ca kutra kasmāt kathaṃ pravartata iti | yathābhūtākṣaratattvaṃ na prajānanti buddhagocaratvāt | śṛṇu deśanānusāreṇa te pratibodhayāmi
śabdas tāvad ālikālimayaḥ | ālīty akārādiṣoḍaśasvarāḥ | kālīti kakārādivarṇās trayastriṃśat | ṣoḍaśasvarasaṃyuktam ekonapañcāśallipikaṃ sarvam astavyastasamastasvaravyañjanabinduvisargasaṃhitādhātuvibhaktisamāsapadavigrahastrīliṅgatiṅantakṛttaddhitapratyayādibhir bhāṣyaparyantaṃ vyākaraṇam iti nāma saṅketakena paribhāṣaṇena jñāyate | atas tasya padavākyacchandovṛttaślokagāthādaṇḍakādibhiś caturaśītisāhasradharmaskandhasūtrāntatantrakalpatripiṭakakāvyanāṭakādayo laukikalokottaraśāstrāṇi sambhavanti | śāstram āśritya sarvasiddhayaḥ sampadyante | yathoktaṃ bhagavatā laṅkāvatārasūtre
tadyathā mahāmate kaścid eva puruṣaḥ pradīpaṃ gṛhya dhanam anveṣayati | evam eva mahāmate vāgvikalparutapradīpena bodhisattvā mahāsattvā vāgvikalparahitāṃ svapratyātmagatim anupraviśantīti
kintu teṣāṃ padavākyādigatavarṇaviśeṣāṇāṃ vijñānabhūto 'yam akāraḥ | yasmād akārasvaraviyuktā na santi kakārādayo varṇāḥ | halantatvān na bhavanti vācyāḥ | yathoktaṃ bhagavatā nāmasaṅgītikāyām
akāraḥ sarvavarṇāgryo mahārthaḥ paramākṣaraḥ
mahāprāṇo hy anutpādo vāgudāhāravarjitaḥ
sarvābhilāpahetvagryaḥ sarvavāksuprabhāsvara iti
tenoktaṃ bhagavatā sakaladhyānamukhabījapadam | akāro mukhaṃ sarvadharmāṇām ādyanutpannatvād iti | sahajākṣaraṃ tu punar ucyate | vajramaṇḍalālaṅkāratantre 'py akāraṃ dyotayann āha
jvalantaṃ dīpasadṛśaṃ hṛdi madhyam anāhatam
akṣaraṃ paramaṃ sūkṣmam akāraṃ paramaṃ prabhum iti
evaṃ sarvatathāgatā akārānvayam akārahetubhūtam akāranirjātam uccaritapradhvansisvabhāvaṃ vāgvikalpalakṣaṇaṃ yathā- bhūtaṃ jñātvā śabdāpaśabdanirapekṣaṃ sattvāśayānuśayabhedena vineyajanebhyo dharmaṃ deśayantīti
ata evoktaṃ bhagavatā laṅkāvatārasūtre
arthapratiśaraṇena mahāmate bodhisattvena mahāsattvena bhavitavyaṃ | na vyañjanapratiśaraṇena | vyañjanānusārī mahāmate kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā svam ātmānaṃ ca nāśayati | paramārthaṃ ca paraṃ nāvabodhayati
tadyathā mahāmate aṅgulyā kaścit kasyacit kiñcid darśayet | sa cāpy aṅgulyagram eva pratisared vīkṣitum | evam eva mahāmate bālajātīyā iva bālapṛthagjanavargā yathārutāṅgulyagrābhiniveśābhiniviṣṭā evaṃ kālaṃ kariṣyanti | na yathārutāṅgulyagrārthaṃ hitvā paramārtham anveṣayanti
tasmād arthakāmena te sevanīyāḥ | ato viparītā ye yathārutārthābhiniviṣṭās te varjanīyā arthānveṣiṇeti
vākpravṛttir api caturvidhety uktaṃ bhagavatā atraīva sūtre
caturvidhaṃ mahāmate vāgvikalpalakṣaṇaṃ bhavati | yad uta lakṣaṇavāk svapnavāk dauṣṭhulyābhiniveśavāk | anādikālavikalpavāk | tatra mahāmate lakṣaṇavāk svavikalparūpanimittābhiniveśāt pravartate | svapnavāk punar mahāmate pūrvānubhūtaviṣayānusmaraṇāt pratinibaddhaviṣayābhāvāc ca pravartate | dauṣṭhulyavikalpābhiniveśavāk punar mahāmate sattvapūrvakṛtakarmānusmaraṇāt pravartate | anādikālavikalpavāk punar mahāmate anādikālaprapañcābhiniveśadauṣṭhulyasvabījavāsanātaḥ pravartate | etadd hi mahāmate caturvidhaṃ vāgvikalpalakṣaṇam iti
anena nyāyena śabdo 'kārodbhavatvād akṣaraḥ | kṣaraṃ vināśo 'kṣaram avināśaḥ | khasamasvabhāvaṃ yac chabdadvāreṇa pratipādyate | niṣpannakramaṃ tad apy akṛtakam anādinidhanasvabhāvam iti | yathoktam ekanayanirdeśasūtre
dharmā ime śabdarutena vyākṛtā dharmāś ca śabdaś ca hi nātra labhyate
nayaikatāṃ cāpy avatīrya dharmatām anuttarāṃ kṣāntivarāṃ spṛśiṣyata iti
yathoktaṃ vairocanābhisambodhicaryātantre
api tu guhyakādhipate mantrāṇāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ sarvabuddhair na kṛtaṃ na kāritaṃ nānumoditam
tat kasya hetoḥ | eṣāṃ dharmāṇāṃ dharmatā yad uta utpādād vā tathāgatānām anutpādād vā tathāgatānāṃ sthitaīvaīṣāṃ dharmāṇāṃ dharmatā yad uta mantrāṇāṃ mantradharmatā
tatra guhyakādhipate 'sti kāmadhātvīśvarasya madayantikā nāma vidyā | tayā sarvān kāmāvacarān devaputrān madena mūrcchayati | vividhavicitraramaṇīyāṃś ca pradeśān darśayati | vividhavicitraparibhogāṃś cābhinirmāya paranirmitavaśavartibhyo devebhyaḥ prayacchaty ātmanā ca paribhuṅkte
tadyathāsti maheśvarasya devaputrasya manojavā nāma vidyā | tayā trisāhasramahāsāhasre lokadhātau sarvakāryaṃ karoti | sarvopabhogaparibhogāṃś cābhinirmāya śuddhāvāsakāyikebhyo devebhyaḥ prayacchaty ātmanā ca paribhuṅkte
tadyathā māhendrajāliko mantrair vividhavicitrārthān manuṣyādikān darśayati | tadyathāpi nāma mantrair māyāṃ darśayati | tadyathāpi nāma mantrair viṣam apanayati jvarādikaṃ ca | tadyathāpi nāma mantrakalpikā devatā mantraiḥ śreyaḥ sattvebhyaḥ prayacchati | tadyathāpi nāma mantrair agner uṣṇatā naśyati śītatā ca sambhavati
ebhir nidarśanapadair mantraprabhāvo 'bhiśraddhātavya iti | sa ca mantraprabhāvo hi na mantrato niṣkrāmati | na sattveṣu praviśati | na prayoktṛta upalabhyate | atha ca kulaputra mantrādhiṣṭhānadharmatā sambhavaṃ nātikrāmati | kālatrayātītatvāt | sarvathācintyapratītyasamutpādābhinivartitatvāc ca
tasmāt tarhi kulaputrācintyadharmatāsvabhāvagatiṅgatena satatasamitaṃ mantranayo 'nugantavya iti
evam ādhyātmikabāhyamaṇimantrauṣadhīnām acintyaprabhāvam āgamādhigamābhyāṃ pratipādya | idānīṃ niṣpannāniṣpannasattvadhātūnāṃ yathābhūtavāgviśuddhiṃ darśayann āha | kinnararājaparipṛcchāsūtre
kutaḥ punaḥ kinnarādhipate sarvasattvānāṃ rutaghoṣā niścaranti
āha | ākāśāt kulaputra sarvasattvānāṃ rutaghoṣā niścaranti
āha | na punaḥ kinnarādhipate adhyātmikakoṣṭhāt sarvasattvānāṃ rutaghoṣā niścaranti
āha | tat kiṃ manyase kulaputra kāyābhyantarakoṣṭhāt sarvasattvānāṃ rutaghoṣā niścaranti | āhosvic cittāt
āha | kinnarādhipate na kāyān na cittāt | tat kasmādd hetoḥ | kāyo hi jaḍo niśceṣṭas tṛṇakuḍyakāṣṭhapratibhāsopamaḥ | cittaṃ cāpy anidarśanaṃ māyopamam apratigham avijñaptikam
āha | kāyacittavinirmuktāni punaḥ kulaputra kuto 'nyato rutāni niścaranti
āha | ākāśād amanaskārāt sambhavati kinnarādhipate sarvasattvānāṃ rutavijñaptiḥ
āha | tat kiṃ manyase kulaputra yady ākāśaṃ na bhavet kuto rutāni niścareyuḥ
āha | nākāśavinirmuktaḥ kinnarādhipate kaścid rutaniścāraḥ

verses.tangNoteZh: SARIT 单元：Chapter 3: Vāgviveka / Mantratattva (Guhyasamāja Vajrajāpa & Mantroddhāra) · CMP03.149（叶码：校勘底本）

verses.iast: āha | kinnarādhipate na kāyān na cittāt | tat kasmādd hetoḥ | kāyo hi jaḍo niśceṣṭas tṛṇakuḍyakāṣṭhapratibhāsopamaḥ | cittaṃ cāpy anidarśanaṃ māyopamam apratigham avijñaptikam
verses.meaningZh: 如是宣说、佛言；紧那罗自在主，不、非、无，身、佛身法身，不、非、无，从心、菩提心、心识；彼、真如彼岸，造作离相·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧，因之；身，诚然、因为、实乃，癡，离名相假立·本性寂静止息·妙行迁变空，卉·墙·薪·光影·泮；心、菩提心、心识，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·远离寂静周遍），无指示，花样泮，无对，无解脱自在、合格
verses.meaningEn: Spoke, declared thus Kinnara + lord, not, non-, body, kāya (sacred dimension), not, non-, from mind, heart, thought, bodhicitta That (ultimate reality), freedom from karmic agency & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness, of cause Kāyo, for, indeed, surely, jaḍo, beyond nominal designation & primordial tranquil peace & awakened conduct beyond flux, grass + wall + firewood + paṃ Mind, heart, thought, bodhicitta, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — expansive quiescence, anidarśanaṃ, trick + paṃ, not to be kept off, irresistible, non-without any making known
verses.tangNoteZh: SARIT 单元：Chapter 3: Vāgviveka / Mantratattva (Guhyasamāja Vajrajāpa & Mantroddhāra) · CMP03.150（叶码：[A:25b]）

verses.iast: āha | kāyacittavinirmuktāni punaḥ kulaputra kuto 'nyato rutāni niścaranti
verses.meaningZh: 如是宣说、佛言；造作离相·一乘如实之道·妙行迁变空，复次、再三，善男子，为谁的，否则，一切梵音、号啕，晚上诸尊行持妙道
verses.meaningEn: Spoke, declared thus Freedom from karmic agency & supreme vehicle of awakening & awakened conduct beyond flux (vocative invocation), again, furthermore, a good man, kuto, from elsewhere, elsewhere, otherwise, else, voice, cry, sound, night + they move forth in compassionate activity!
verses.tangNoteZh: SARIT 单元：Chapter 3: Vāgviveka / Mantratattva (Guhyasamāja Vajrajāpa & Mantroddhāra) · CMP03.151（叶码：校勘底本）

verses.iast: āha | ākāśād amanaskārāt sambhavati kinnarādhipate sarvasattvānāṃ rutavijñaptiḥ
verses.meaningZh: 如是宣说、佛言；造作离相·本性寂静止息·施度调伏，无从三昧身心识、心理申请，出有，紧那罗自在主，诸一切众生、普皆有情之，梵音相貌
verses.meaningEn: Spoke, declared thus Freedom from karmic agency & primordial tranquil peace & generosity & self-mastery, non-from concentration of mind, mental application, sambhavati, Kinnara + lord, of all all sentient beings, voice
verses.tangNoteZh: SARIT 单元：Chapter 3: Vāgviveka / Mantratattva (Guhyasamāja Vajrajāpa & Mantroddhāra) · CMP03.152（叶码：校勘底本）

verses.iast: āha | tat kiṃ manyase kulaputra yady ākāśaṃ na bhavet kuto rutāni niścareyuḥ
verses.meaningZh: 如是宣说、佛言；彼、真如彼岸，迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·诸根清净自在·大空菩提点摄持），认为，善男子，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），虚空，不、非、无，当得成就、若成，为谁的，一切梵音、号啕，妙行流布·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Spoke, declared thus That (ultimate reality), freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — purified faculties sealed with bodhicitta bindu, think, a good man, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, ākāśaṃ, not, non-, may be, would become, kuto, voice, cry, sound, practicing
verses.tangNoteZh: SARIT 单元：Chapter 3: Vāgviveka / Mantratattva (Guhyasamāja Vajrajāpa & Mantroddhāra) · CMP03.153（叶码：校勘底本）

verses.meaningZh: 如是宣说、佛言；离名相假立·造作离相·本性寂静止息，紧那罗自在主，造作离相·本性寂静止息·妙行迁变空，梵音·晚上·监狱
verses.meaningEn: Spoke, declared thus Beyond nominal designation & freedom from karmic agency & primordial tranquil peace, Kinnara + lord, freedom from karmic agency & primordial tranquil peace & awakened conduct beyond flux, voice + night + prison
verses.tangNoteZh: SARIT 单元：Chapter 3: Vāgviveka / Mantratattva (Guhyasamāja Vajrajāpa & Mantroddhāra) · CMP03.154（叶码：校勘底本）

verses.iast: āha | ) tad anena te kulaputra paryāyeṇaīvaṃ veditavyam | ye kecid rutavyāpārā niścaranti | sarve te ākāśān niścarantīti | ākāśasvabhāvāni hi rutāni samanantaraniryātāni ca niruddhyante | niruddhāni cākāśasvabhāvatāyām eva santiṣṭhante
verses.meaningZh: 如是宣说、佛言；彼、如是真实，以此（真言功德力），向汝、彼等，善男子，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，乃是已知；凡彼等诸有情，造作离相·妙行迁变空·施度调伏，梵音职业，晚上诸尊行持妙道；一切、普皆遍满尊，向汝、彼等，虚空界（无碍周遍），晚上·动着·对治·如是；虚空界一切自性，诚然、因为、实乃，一切梵音、号啕，弹指一切定出现以及离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢·施度调伏；一切灭，妙行迁变空·造作离相·本性寂静止息，唯、正是、决定，一切诸谛圆满·离名相假立·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Spoke, declared thus That, thus, by this, to Thee / they, a good man, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening, to be known Those who, whoever (pl.), freedom from karmic agency & awakened conduct beyond flux & generosity & self-mastery, voice + occupation, night + they move forth in compassionate activity! O all, every, complete / in all, every, complete, to Thee / they, space, ether, open sky, night + move + opposite + thus Space + own-being, for, indeed, surely, voice, cry, sound, immediately adjoining + property and beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust & generosity & self-mastery (vocative invocation) Held back, obstructed, awakened conduct beyond flux & freedom from karmic agency & primordial tranquil peace, indeed, verily, alone, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: SARIT 单元：Chapter 3: Vāgviveka / Mantratattva (Guhyasamāja Vajrajāpa & Mantroddhāra) · CMP03.155（叶码：校勘底本）

verses.iast: ākāśasvabhāvāḥ sarvadharmās te udāhṛtā anudāhṛtā vā | tām evākāśakoṭisamatāṃ na vijahati | rutamātrā hi kulaputra sarvadharmā avijñaptivijñapanīyās te tu saṅketena vyavahriyante | sa ca vyavahāro 'vyavahāraḥ | yo hi rutasaṅketena vyavahāraḥ sa na ca kvacid dharme 'bhiniviśata iti
verses.meaningZh: 虚空界诸自性，湖·飞奔·莽娑，向汝、彼等，施度调伏·因缘空寂大乐·真如实际，离名相假立·施度调伏·因缘空寂大乐，或、抑或；救度佛母（绿度母）根本种子字，如此·种类草本·俱胝·萨麻丹，不、非、无，闢弃捨；梵音称计，诚然、因为、实乃，善男子，诸法，明了觉识·最上真言离言说，向汝、彼等，然而、而、实则，以作战趣往，最上真言离言说·一乘如实之道·因缘空寂大乐；彼、此尊（阳性主格）以及言说，不可言说；凡彼圣尊、能…者，诚然、因为、实乃，以梵音作战趣往，言说，彼、此尊（阳性主格），不、非、无以及往往一连就是，正法、诸法实相尊，融通·在于·闢·百，如是（结句印定）
verses.meaningEn: Space + own-being, a lake + dart + flesh, to Thee / they, generosity & self-mastery & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & immutable Suchness, beyond nominal designation & generosity & self-mastery & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, or Tārā root seed syllable Tāṃ / her, so + a kind of grass + ten million + to, not, non-, settle + abandoning Voice + measure, for, indeed, surely, a good man, all things, discerning, to Thee / they, but, indeed, moreover, combat + by, supreme ineffable speech & supreme vehicle of awakening & causal emptiness & spiritual joy (vocative invocation) He, that one and vyavahāro, inexpressible Who, whichever, for, indeed, surely, voice + combat + by, vyavahāraḥ, he, that one, not, non- and where? wither? how? Used also as of + even, O Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena / in Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena, to + in + settle + hundred, thus, so it is stated
verses.tangNoteZh: SARIT 单元：Chapter 3: Vāgviveka / Mantratattva (Guhyasamāja Vajrajāpa & Mantroddhāra) · CMP03.156（叶码：[A:26a]）

verses.iast: evaṃ vāgvajrasamādhistho mahāyogī niṣpannāniṣpannasattvadhātūnāṃ doṣaguṇavarṇanātmakavākyaṃ śrutvā nānulīyate | na saṃhriyate | nottrasyati | na santrasati | na vicikitsati | tathaīva laukikalokottaraśāstradaṇḍakatroṭakādiśabdaracanāviśeṣaṃ śrutvā na rajyati na duṣyati na muhyati sarvaśabdānāṃ gatiṅgatatvāt | yathoktaṃ bhagavatā sarvadharmāpravṛttinirdeśasūtre
verses.meaningZh: 如是、如此，最上真言离言说·妙行趣入·生起不可得·尊胜，乐趣所行佛母，熟透·不是熟透·诸有情界之，施度调伏·六度满行清净·妙行趣入，听已，离名相假立·离一切相无相·一乘如实之道；不、非、无，一切诸谛圆满·因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢；几乎·颤动·戒精进；不、非、无，赢得活动；不、非、无，闢·有形·器物盘子尊；彼·呼格极微·犹如，离一切相无相·造作离相·真如实际，听已，不、非、无，尘戒精进，不、非、无，恶障，不、非、无，无我大慈三昧·因缘空寂大乐·一乘如实之道，一切诸声之，妙行趣入·真如实际·支分寂静；也他，才鸣呼，诸法·活跃·疏·演说·契经
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in this way, supreme ineffable speech & awakened spiritual movement & transcending birth & victorious, gladden + Bienenschwarm, come forth + not ripened + of the universe of beings, generosity & self-mastery & perfection of the six pāramitās & awakened spiritual movement, having to listen, beyond nominal designation & freedom from conditioned marks & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation) Not, non-, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation) Almost + tremble + as many Not, non-, win + movable Not, non-, settle + visible + O a vessel or dish That + vocative particle + like, freedom from conditioned marks & freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness, having to listen, not, non-, dust + as many, not, non-, evil, not, non-, selfless great loving-kindness & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), all + of all sound, awakened spiritual movement & immutable Suchness & quiescence of perceptual limbs As aforesaid or mentioned above, excellence, all things + active + turning + elucidation + O discourse
verses.tangNoteZh: SARIT 单元：Chapter 3: Vāgviveka / Mantratattva (Guhyasamāja Vajrajāpa & Mantroddhāra) · CMP03.157（叶码：[C:54a]）

verses.iast: śabdarutapraveśapratiṣṭho devaputra bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ | saced gaṅgānadīvālukāsamān kalpān ākruṣyet paribhāṣyet vitathair asadbhūtaiḥ padair na tasya tatra pratighacittam utpadyate | saced gaṅgānadīvālukāsamān kalpān satkriyed gurukriyed mānyet pūjyet sarvasukhopadhānaiś cīvarapiṇḍapātaśayanāsanaglānapratyayabhaiṣajyapariṣkārair na tasya tatrānunayacittam utpadyate
verses.meaningZh: 音·以及·入·稳定，天子，菩提萨埵，大菩萨；以彼及恒河沙无等，细轨，造作离相·清净离诸尘垢·六度满行清净，宣说演畅·第一义谛，闢·彼·呼格极微，无以诸定，第一义谛·施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢，不、非、无，彼之、其（属格），于彼处、其中，忿怒心，迸今日；以彼及恒河沙无等，细轨，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·造作离相，妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢·造作离相，无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·一乘如实之道，供养礼赞·第一义谛，安乐妙善·一切诸谛圆满，妙行迁变空·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，不、非、无，彼之、其（属格），于彼处·随贪·心，迸今日
verses.meaningEn: Sound + and + entering + steady, the son of a god, bodhisattvo, mahāsattvaḥ He + and the sand of the River Ganges + unequalled, style, manner, fashion, freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust & perfection of the six pāramitās, speaking, settle + That + vocative particle, non-by/with real, ultimate truth & generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust, not, non-, his, of that, there, therein, resistance + mind, burst forth + now He + and the sand of the River Ganges + unequalled, style, manner, fashion, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & freedom from karmic agency, awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from karmic agency, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & supreme vehicle of awakening, worshipping, blissful, awakened conduct beyond flux & supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust, not, non-, his, of that, there + propitiation + mind, burst forth + now
verses.tangNoteZh: SARIT 单元：Chapter 3: Vāgviveka / Mantratattva (Guhyasamāja Vajrajāpa & Mantroddhāra) · CMP03.158（叶码：校勘底本）

verses.iast: evaṃ vāgvajrasamādhistho 'ṣṭamīśvāro mantrī sarvalābhālābhayaśo.'yaśonindāpraśaṃsāsukhaduḥkhair na bādhyate na saṃhriyate | ataḥ sarvāṃś ca lokadharmān abhibhūyotpattikramam atikramya cittavivekam anveṣayitukāmaḥ kalyāṇamitraṃ paryupāste
verses.meaningZh: 如是、如此，最上真言离言说·妙行趣入·生起不可得·尊胜，六度满行清净·断除憍慢执障·无我大慈三昧，密咒，一切·利养损失·美称，安乐妙善·一乘如实之道，不、非、无，拒拘牵尊，不、非、无，一切诸谛圆满·因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢；走道那么、游方，诸一切、普皆遍满以及世间法，融通·又么·三摩耶·次第，真如实际·造作离相·清净离诸尘垢，心明知，离名相假立·最上真言离言说·六度满行清净，善知识，向承事供养汝
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in this way, supreme ineffable speech & awakened spiritual movement & transcending birth & victorious, perfection of the six pāramitās & cutting rigid pride & selfless great loving-kindness, mantrī, all + sgl, blissful, not, non-, to drive away + O held, not, non-, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation) Walk about, wander, run, all, every, complete and world law, to + occurrence + step, immutable Suchness & freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust, mind + true knowledge, beyond nominal designation & supreme ineffable speech & perfection of the six pāramitās, Dharma Friends, to present + to Thee
verses.tangNoteZh: SARIT 单元：Chapter 3: Vāgviveka / Mantratattva (Guhyasamāja Vajrajāpa & Mantroddhāra) · CMP03.159（叶码：[A:26b]）

verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·妙行趣入·造作离相，第三；心·明知·谜罗·阿波南·疑惑·品

nanu prayojanaviśeṣārthitaiva puṃsaḥ prayojanaviśeṣasaṃśayotpattihetuḥ prāgvidyata eva | tathāhi prayojanaviśeṣākāṅkṣāparigatamanasaḥ prathamataramevaṃ bhavatyeva, kimidamasmadadhi gataprayojanena saprayojanam ? āhosvidanyena ? kiṃ vā niṣprayojanamiti; tatsādhaka bādhakapramāṇābhāve tasya nyāyaprāptatvāt | prayojanaviśeṣapratipādakaśāstrāntaropalabdheśca | ato bhavatyeva prāgapi prayojanaviśeṣaviṣayasaṃśaya iti vyarthaḥ prayojanavākyo panyāsaḥ | naitadasti | yadyapi prayojanaviśeṣārthitāpi saṃśayaviśeṣaheturbhavati | ta thāpi na sā sarveṣāṃ saṃmukhībhavati | avyutpannapuruṣārthānāṃ mūḍhadhiyāṃ keṣāṃcidasaṃmu khībhāvāt | tathāhi—mokṣaḥ paramapuruṣārthatayā siddhaḥ, atha ca santi kecidavyu tpannā ye tamapi paramapuruṣārthaṃ puruṣārthatayā na jānanti | prāgye na taṃ prārthayiṣyante te | na vā saṃmukhībhūtā prayojanaviśeṣākāṅkṣā prayojanaviśeṣaviṣayasandehotpattiheturyuktā, kāraṇasattādhīnatvātkāryāṇām | yadi nāma sā keṣāṃcidapi saṃmukhībhavati, tathāpyasau sādhanāntaraparityāgena pratiniyatasādhanopādānahetoḥ saṃśayaviśeṣasya heturna bhavati; sarvatra sādhakabādhakapramāṇābhāvena tasyāstaddhetutvena nyāyaprāptatvāt | na cai tāvanmātreṇa pravṛttiryuktā | sarvatra pravṛttiprasaṅgāt | na ca śakyaṃ kenacitsarvatra pravartti tumityataḥ phalaviśeṣārthino'pi pratiniyatasādhanaparigrahanibandhanābhāvādudāsīran | tasmātpratiniyatasādhanaparigrahahetuprayojanaviśeṣaviṣayasaṃśayotpādanāyātyantaparokṣārtha viṣayāgamapraṇayanavat phalaviśeṣārthinā pratiniyatasādhanaparigrahāyābhidhānīyameva prayo janavākyam | tathā hi tenāsyaiva śāstrasyārthaviśeṣa upadarśyate nānyasya | ato'nena pratiniyatasādhanasādhyaphalaviśeṣaviṣayaḥ saṃśayo janyate | sa ca śrotā kadācinma māyamarthaviśeṣo niṣpatsyata iti prayojanavākyopajanitāt prayojanaviśeṣaviṣayādatyantaparokṣārthaviṣayāgamopajanitādiva saṃśayātpravarttetāpītyataḥ prayojanavākyopanyāsaḥ
avaśyaṃ caitadevaṃ vijñeyam, anyathā'tyantaparokṣārthaviṣayāgamapraṇayanamapi vyarthaṃ syāt; prāgapyāgamapraṇayanāddānādiṣu phalaviśeṣārthināṃ sādhakabādhakapramāṇābhāvena ta tsaṃśayasya vidyamānatvāt | kiṃ tvasāvavyutpannasvargādiphalānāṃ naivotpadyate | tatkāraṇabhūtāyāḥ phalaviśeṣārthitāyā asaṃmukhībhāvāt | yeṣāṃ copajāyate teṣāmapi sarva tropalādibhakṣaṇe'pi pravṛttihetutayā sādhāraṇatvādupalādibhakṣaṇaparihāreṇa (na) prati niyatadānādiparigrahaheturbhavatīti matvā tadarthamāgamapraṇetṛbhirāgamaḥ praṇīyate tadvatprayo janavākyamapi śāstrakārairityacodyametat | na cāpi jijñāsitaprayojanaviśeṣapratipādakaṃ śāstrāntaramupalabdham, yena tadupalabdhibalādabhimataprayojanaviśeṣaviṣayaḥ sandeho bha vet | na hyabhimataprayojanaviśeṣasādhane śāstrāntare sambhavati kaścitprekṣāvān paraṃ śā strāntaramārabhate | prekṣāvattvahāniprasaṅgāt | ato na śāstrāntaropalabdhirapi vivakṣi taprayojanaviśeṣasandehaheturbhavati | tasmācchrotṛjanapravṛttyarthaḥ prayojanādivākyopanyāsa iti sthitam
yastu manyate na śrotṛjanapravṛttyarthaṃ prayojanādikathanam, tataḥ saṃśayotpatteḥ; saṃ śayena tu prekṣāvataḥ pravṛttyasambhavāt | kiṃtu yatprayojanarahitamanarthakaṃ vā tannārabdha vyam, yathā kākadantaparīkṣonmattādivākyam; prayojanarahitaṃ cedaṃ śāstramato na śrotuṃ karttuṃ vā prārabdhavyamityevaṃ vyāpakānupalabdhyā yaḥ pratyavatiṣṭhate tasya hetorasiddhatodbhā vanārthamādau prayojanādivākyopanyāsa iti | tadasamyagiva lakṣyate | saṃśayenāpi pravṛtteḥ prasādhitatvāt | asiddhatodbhāvanasya ca vaiyarthyāt | evaṃ hi tadarthavadbhavet | yadi tasya parasyāto vākyātpravṛttirbhavet | yāvatodbhāvitāyāmapyanena vākyenāsiddha tāyāṃ nāto vākyātprekṣāvato yathoktavyāpakāttatvaniścayaḥ samutpadyate yenāsau pravarttito bhavet | pūrvavadvākyasyāsyāpramāṇatvāt | saṃśayena ca prekṣāpūrvakāriṇo bhavanma tena pravṛttyasambhavāt | ato viphalamevāsiddhatodbhāvanam | nāpi kaścitprekṣāvānavi ditaśāstraśarīro'kasmādvyāpakābhāvaṃ niścityānena pratyavatiṣṭhate | nāpi tatpratyavasthā nāt svayaṃ viditaśāstraprayojano'pi śāstrakṛnnārabheta kartuṃ śrotā vā prekṣāpūrvakārī nirnibandhanādvākyānnivarttate yena tayoḥ pravṛttyarthamasiddhatodbhāvanaṃ syāt | athāpi syādyo'prekṣāpūrvakārī so'nibandhanamakasmādapi yathoktavyāpakābhāvaṃ gṛhṇīyāt | paraiśca grāhayedapi, atastaṃ pratyasiddhatodbhāvanaṃ kriyata ityetadapyayuktam

verses.meaningEn: There, therein, freedom from karmic agency & awakened conduct beyond flux & generosity & self-mastery, causal emptiness & spiritual joy Beyond nominal designation & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), sarvajñaḥ, authority + from not being Not, non-, for, indeed, surely, omniscient + existence + accomplishing, pratyakṣam, anumānaṃ, sound, or, pramāṇam, is, truly exists

na syāttadanyavat | tasmātsvabhāva kāraṇabhūtasādhyabhedāt | dvidhaiva vidhirūpaṃ sādhyaṃ tatraiva hetoḥ pratibandhāt | svabhāvabhūtañca sādhyaṃ svabhāvahetuḥ sādhayati | kāraṇabhūtañca kāryahetu rityabhyupeyaṃ | pratiṣedhamapyupalabdhilakṣaṇaprāptānupalabdhireva sādhayati | nānyā yathā tathā vistareṇa pratipādayiṣyati | tadidamiha saṃkṣiptamartha tattvaṃ viṣayavyapekṣayā viṣayiṇo liṃgasya verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！归命，无我大慈三昧·离诸诤论无诤·破有相福德光

verses.iast: evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavāñ śrāvastyāṃ viharati sma jetavane 'nāthapiṇḍadasyārāme
verses.meaningZh: 如是、如此，由我（具格：如是我闻），闻，一时，向平，破有相福德光·妙行趣入·最上真言离言说，那罗凝聚，一切，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），祇树林尊，给孤独园尊
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in this way, by me, heard, at one time, to equal, blessedness transcending existence & awakened spiritual movement & supreme ineffable speech, of a man + coagulate, lives, dwells, spends oneʼs time, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, O the grove called Jeta / in the grove called Jeta, 'nāthapiṇḍadasyārāme
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326, p. 146 (no. 73) · CUL MS Add. 1680.8.3

verses.iast: atha khalu māṇibhadro mahāyakṣasenāpatir yena bhagavāṃs tenopasaṃkrāntaḥ

verses.meaningEn: Now, thereupon, auspiciously, indeed, verily, certainly, selfless great loving-kindness & conflict-free peace & blessedness transcending existence, mahāyakṣasenāpatir, by which, whereby, star + bull, by that truth + thereto + come together

verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·一切诸谛圆满·造作离相，世尊、薄伽梵（具六德圣尊），第一义谛·施度调伏，本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·一切诸谛圆满，礼敬赞叹·最上真言离言说，无从依止处、活生生
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from karmic agency, Bhagavān, the Blessed/World-Honored One, ultimate truth & generosity & self-mastery (imperative seal), primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, venerating (vocative invocation), non-from standing, living, being in, occupied with, devoted to

verses.iast: ekānte sthito māṇibhadro mahāyakṣasenāpatir bhagavantam etad avocat

verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326, p. 146 (no. 73) · CUL MS Add. 1680.8.3

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼圣观自在菩萨·菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情）·摩诃萨埵（大心有情、大菩萨）·大悲圣尊、具足大悲心者！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Noble Avalokiteśvara, Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, Mahāsattva, Great Spiritual Hero, Greatly Compassionate One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.iast: oṃ jaye mahājaye jayavāhini jayottari kala mala cala hulu chiṇi sarvakarmāvaraṇāni mama bhagavati sahasrāvarte sarvabuddhāvalokite cakṣuḥśrotaghrāṇajihvākāyamanovijñānaviśodhani
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！胜伏、最胜吉祥！尊，向乐趣种姓，尊胜降伏·生起不可得·尊胜，胜伏愈加，尊手，垢染、尘垢瑕疵，震动警觉、破除昏沉（左攞），威猛速疾摄护除灾（呼嚧），具车尊，一切一切业障，我之（行者所有），世尊佛母！（呼格），千绕母尊，一切·佛陀·观照，明了觉识·净治清净·妙行迁变空
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O conquer! victory! / in conquer! victory! gladden + to running or fighting match, conquering (vocative invocation), conquer! victory! + further, hand, stain, impurity, defilement, stir awake and shake off delusion! swiftly protect and sweep away calamity! O bearer of cha, all + karmic obscuration, my, of me (the practitioner), O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! sahasrāvarte, all + Buddha + O beheld, discerning, purifying (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.iast: oṃ suru prasuru bhara saṃbhara hara smara oṃ sarvabuddhādhiṣṭhite svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！甘露妙流普润群生（素噜），转载甘露妙流普润群生，方位、战斗，桑方位，请摄取、遣除苦厄！祈请忆念本誓，嗡！一切·佛陀·所加持，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! stream forth auspicious ambrosia! forward + stream forth auspicious ambrosia! bearing, carrying, saṃ + bearing, carry away (suffering)! remove! remember Your primordial vow! Oṃ! all + Buddha + O blessed, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！一切·佛陀·观照，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! all + Buddha + O beheld, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！法界藏，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Dharmadhātu + O womb, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！无物·自性·正法·鸿毛·带劲，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! not being + own-being + Dharma + down + O causing to expand or blossom, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 此尊母之（连音省尾式），以陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义），此尊、此法，仪轨
verses.meaningEn: Of her, of this deity, with/by Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell, this one, upacāraḥ
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 细轨·千·集，业障（宿世恶业障蔽），以一·人群·在高处·流畅，销，行
verses.meaningEn: Style + thousand + collected, karmic obscuration/obstacle, one + crowd + aloft + by, to dissolve, exists, carries on
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 佛陀·千·鸿毛·绞痛·彼，善根，成办、生起、安住
verses.meaningEn: Buddha + thousand + down + pain in the bowels + him, virtuous roots, becomes, arises, is
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 以换世，妙行迁变空·造作离相·清净离诸尘垢，百千，对获
verses.meaningEn: Jātiparivartena, awakened conduct beyond flux & freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust, sgl, toward + to take
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 死时尊以及佛陀千，了知、聪明
verses.meaningEn: To die + O black and Buddha, looking, knowing, intelligent
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.iast: pratidinaṃ sahasrāvartaṃ kurvann ekaviṃśatidivasena bodhisattvasaṃkhyāṃ gacchati
verses.meaningZh: 日益、日常，威势绕，成办作持·造作离相，以二十一日，菩提萨埵僧祇，行
verses.meaningEn: Day by day, daily, powerful + circumambulate, enacting, twenty-one + by, Bodhisattva + reckoning up, exists, carries on
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 于诸圆满清净、周遍无垢中，佛土·宝箭·愈加·造偈句
verses.meaningEn: Among/in thoroughly pure, utterly cleansed, Buddha-field + arrow + thereto + way
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·六度满行清净，清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·六度满行清净，日之，生起不可得·尊胜·第一义谛·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & perfection of the six pāramitās, stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness (imperative seal), immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & perfection of the six pāramitās, of heaven or day, transcending birth & victorious & ultimate truth & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 犹如一切所愿，一切梦，了知、聪明
verses.meaningEn: Just as + wished, sleep, dream (plural), looking, knowing, intelligent
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 真金·显色·如来，了知、聪明
verses.meaningEn: Gold + color + Tathāgata, looking, knowing, intelligent
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 无限量利益，菩提觉知·解脱系缚大力，本性寂静止息·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，向不过假定今日汝
verses.meaningEn: Unmeasured + benefit, awakening, primordial tranquil peace & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), only + suppose now + to Thee
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 永不断，事关，任务
verses.meaningEn: Satatasamitaṃ, concentrates the mind on, reflects, to be made or done
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 圣·千绕母·名为·陀罗尼，用完、圆满
verses.meaningEn: Noble + by name + Dhāraṇī, finished, perfect
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼善见·如来·出·堪敬尊·正等正觉、正遍知！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to handsome-figured, beautiful, Tathāgata, income, Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha!
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.iast: oṃ suru suru prasuru prasuru tara tara bhara bhara saṃbhara saṃbhara smara smara saṃtarpaya saṃtarpaya sarvapretānāṃ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三甘露妙流普润群生（素噜），再三转载甘露妙流普润群生，再三弯曲、超群，再三方位、战斗，再三桑方位，再三忆念本誓，再三一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，一切诸饿鬼，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! stream forth auspicious ambrosia! again and again, forward + stream forth auspicious ambrosia! again and again, crossing, surpassing, overcoming again and again, bearing, carrying again and again, saṃ + bearing again and again, remember Your primordial vow! again and again, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust again and again, all + of all Preta, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.iast: anayā dhāraṇyodakasahitaṃ bhaktaṃ sapta vārān parijapya vāmahastenācchaṭātrayaṃ dattvā sarvapretebhyo vivikte pradeśe dātavyam
verses.meaningZh: 此，放置·愉快·浮肿·一连，饼，七（七佛，人群、海众，般一样，左·手·勇健·弹指·三重，齿已，向诸湖剪切力此等诸尊，远离尊，所尊，施予
verses.meaningEn: Anayā, put + delightful + dropsy + connected, bhaktaṃ, seven, crowd, multitude, wisdom + the same, left + hand + strong + snap of the fingers + triple, dattvā, a lake + shear + to, O detached / in detached, O place / in place, give
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 如是、如此以及宣说演畅·破有相福德光
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in this way and speaking
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.iast: apasarantv avatāraprekṣiṇo dadāmy ahaṃ sarvalokadhātuvāsināṃ pretānām āhāram iti
verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢，生事，施予饶益·施度调伏，我、真我自性，世界·界·天衣·勇健，诸饿鬼、薜荔多之，楼阁，如是（结句印定）
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust, avatāraprekṣiṇo, granting, I, the awakened self, the universe + realm + garment + strong, of all Preta, hungry ghost/departed spirit, tower, thus, so it is stated
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 破有相福德光·造作离相·真如实际，任务
verses.meaningEn: Blessedness transcending existence & freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness, to be made or done
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.iast: evaṃ sarvapretānāṃ taṇḍuladroṇabhaktaṃ pratyekaṃ dattaṃ bhavati
verses.meaningZh: 如是、如此，一切诸饿鬼，水稻·斗斛·饼，别主，施度调伏·真如实际，成办、生起、安住
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in this way, all + of all Preta, grain + valley, pratyekaṃ, generosity & self-mastery & immutable Suchness, becomes, arises, is
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.iast: evaṃ kurvan na durbalo bhavati na daridro bhavaty api tu jātau
verses.meaningZh: 如是、如此，成办作持·造作离相，不、非、无，弱，成办、生起、安住，不、非、无，流浪者、贫苦，破有相福德光·最上真言离言说·真如实际，亦、虽、乃至，然而、而、实则，生起不可得·尊胜·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in this way, enacting, not, non-, weak, becomes, arises, is, not, non-, vagrant, strolling, poor, needy, beggar, blessedness transcending existence & supreme ineffable speech & immutable Suchness, even, also, but, indeed, moreover, transcending birth & victorious & immutable Suchness (imperative seal)
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.iast: jātau mahābalaḥ prāsādiko darśanīya āḍhyo mahābhogo bhavati dīrghāyur arogī kṣipraṃ cānuttarāṃ
verses.meaningZh: 生起不可得·尊胜·真如实际，大力，颜容殊妙，众所乐见，富，广大规模，成办、生起、安住，长寿，无病佛母，疾，妙行迁变空·离名相假立·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Transcending birth & victorious & immutable Suchness (imperative seal), mahābalaḥ, prāsādiko, = + to be shown, to be made to appear, āḍhyo, of great extent, becomes, arises, is, long-lived, free from disease, healthy, speedy, awakened conduct beyond flux & beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 三耶三佛，破有相福德光·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Unsurpassed complete perfect enlightenment, blessedness transcending existence & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1680.8

verses.meaningZh: 妙行迁变空·一乘如实之道·真如实际以及乐·鸿毛·那个，离一切相无相·造作离相·法界总持任持，愈加造偈句

verses.meaningZh: 悉昙，归命，向佛法僧三宝
verses.meaningEn: Siddham, homage to to/for the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊（薄伽梵）致敬·没驮南！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, buddhānām!
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊（薄伽梵）致敬·释迦牟尼来诣！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, to!
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.iast: oṃ jvala jvala giri bhavanaṃ dīptavega mahācaṇḍahṛdayasphālani
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞），宝山王安住不动、高胜摄护，住埸，炽耀余力，大·威猛·心·犁铁·在于
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! blaze forth with wisdom radiance! again and again, steadfast sacred mountain peak, bhavanaṃ, blazing + jerk, great + fierce + heart + plowshare + in
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.iast: huru huru hana hana daha daha paca paca pācaya sarvasasyanāśakanāgakulavaṃśam
verses.meaningZh: 再三疾速拔济除障（虎噜），再三击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），再三智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺），再三成熟善根、烧尽业障（跛左），第一义谛·妙行迁变空·一乘如实之道，一切·稼·失·女孩子·宝树宝山·部族·笛
verses.meaningEn: Swiftly rescue and dispel all afflictions! again and again, strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again, incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! again and again, ripen merit and burn away karmic obstructions! again and again, ultimate truth & awakened conduct beyond flux & supreme vehicle of awakening, all + grain + loss + a girl + tree or mountain + buddha-family + tradition
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.meaningZh: 再三请执持、总持护念！最妙·威猛·余力，大力威神勇调伏镇被处，叫声·黑心·面目
verses.meaningEn: Hold! bear! sustain! again and again, cover + fierce + jerk, of great power and might + sgl, thundering + relating to Rudra or the Rudras + meters
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.iast: matha matha jvālāmālādhāriṇi caṇḍavegavati pravaravimānadhāraṇi hūṃ hūṃ balavati vegavati visara visara visaranti sarvasasyatṛṇagulmoṣadhivanaspatipuṣpaphalapatrasaṃdhāraṇi
verses.meaningZh: 再三摧碎魔军与我慢烦恼（末他），执持光焰鬘，具足威猛余力，最妙·宫·陀罗尼，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！具足力、十力神通威神力尊，具足余力，再三毘萨罗，诸尊毘萨罗，滋养增益·总持任持·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: Churn and crush demonic hindrances! again and again, blaze + O holder of garland, fierce + O one endowed with jerk, cover + palace + O Dhāraṇī, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! O one endowed with power, strength, spiritual force, O one endowed with jerk, wrench, shock, plenty, abundance again and again, they plenty, abundance, nourishing, upholding (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.meaningZh: 事业愿悉辐条，一切·龙族·诸罪过
verses.meaningEn: Work + may they spoke of a wheel! all + Nāga + hatred
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.meaningZh: 具足一切·住埸·离余力，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: All + coming into existence + lost + O one endowed with jerk, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.meaningZh: 吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.meaningZh: 龙族·闢·具出租尊，泮吒（摧破魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Nāga + settle + O bearer of rent, Phaṭ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.meaningZh: 焰光·是的·小溪·在于，泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Light + yes + small ditch + in, Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛陀、觉者！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Buddha, the Awakened One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.iast: ili mili caṇḍo micili caṇḍa caṇḍa caṇḍe bandhaya svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 法界平等摄持心印（伊利），契合本尊三昧、慈悲冥合（弥利），暴恶，无我大慈三昧·妙行迁变空·离一切相无相，再三威猛、暴烈除障，威猛、暴烈除障尊，祈请结界系缚邪魔外障（满驮），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Primordial Dharma-realm equipoise, intimate union with the deity samādhi, caṇḍo, selfless great loving-kindness & awakened conduct beyond flux & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), fierce, ardent, wrathful again and again, O fierce, ardent, wrathful / in fierce, ardent, wrathful, may You bind obstructive spirits & seal the boundary!! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊（薄伽梵）致敬·释迦牟尼佛（能仁寂默）·如来（乘如实道来成正觉）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, Śākyamuni Buddha, Sage of the Śākyas, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼圣仙·大仙！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to of a sage, great Ṛṣi!
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.meaningZh: 虫
verses.meaningEn: Glow-worm
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.meaningZh: 妙行迁变空·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.meaningZh: 妙行迁变空·无我大慈三昧·离一切相无相
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux & selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.meaningZh: 再三殊胜、胜愿、妙好
verses.meaningEn: Choicest, supreme boon, excellent again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.meaningZh: 呼唤圣尊叹词（咄！圣者！），最上真言离言说·离一切相无相
verses.meaningEn: O! Hail! Vocative invocation particle, supreme ineffable speech & freedom from conditioned marks
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.meaningZh: 系缚、枷锁缠缚尊，摧灭、除断尊
verses.meaningEn: O bondage, fetter, imprisonment, O destroying, removing
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.meaningZh: 再三智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺）
verses.meaningEn: Incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.meaningZh: 报刊往外清净解脱
verses.meaningEn: Press out + pure release
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.meaningZh: 经过作法
verses.meaningEn: Course of conduct, regular system of action
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.meaningZh: 一切·暴恶者·系缚，觜系缚，一切途径
verses.meaningEn: All + wicked + O bondage, beak + O bondage, all + way
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.meaningZh: 再三乞洒字门（尽诸漏障究竟寂灭（kṣaya）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Exhaustion of all karmic outflows (kṣaya) — primordial non-arising again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.meaningZh: 摩尼宝珠（如意离垢宝）
verses.meaningEn: Maṇi jewel, luminous gem
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·六度满行清净·清净离诸尘垢，你们踊跃
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), you + eager
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.meaningZh: 妙果圆成·离一切相无相，再三充分尊，一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Fruition of enlightenment & freedom from conditioned marks (vocative invocation), O full again and again, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.meaningZh: 愿悉流注周遍、速行护念（萨啰），一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: May they flow forth and pervade with blessing!! all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.meaningZh: 断除定慧摄持，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Cut + meditative absorption & steadfast mindfulness, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.meaningZh: 蛩速疾摧碎烦恼结缚，震动警觉、破除昏沉（左攞）尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Ghu + swiftly dissolve karmic knots & obstacles! O stir awake and shake off delusion! / in stir awake and shake off delusion! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！广大最妙尊
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! vast + O cover
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.meaningZh: 龙族、大龙王尊，善良，龙族·心·绕尊
verses.meaningEn: O Nāga, dragon/serpent deity / in Nāga, dragon/serpent deity, O great serpent or elephant / in great serpent or elephant, Nāga + heart + O circumambulate
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.meaningZh: 再三炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞），一切·龙族·一切心
verses.meaningEn: Blaze forth with wisdom radiance! again and again, all + Nāga + heart
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.meaningZh: 再三虫子
verses.meaningEn: Glow-worm again and again
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.meaningZh: 龙族·部族·摧灭尊
verses.meaningEn: Nāga + buddha-family + O ruining
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.meaningZh: 再三击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），一切·暴恶者·龙族·一切心
verses.meaningEn: Strike down afflictions and mara-forces! again and again, all + wicked + Nāga + heart
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.meaningZh: 再三智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺），一切·龙族·一切住埸
verses.meaningEn: Incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! again and again, all + Nāga + coming into existence
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.meaningZh: 再三成熟善根、烧尽业障（跛左），再三第一义谛·妙行迁变空·一乘如实之道，一切·暴恶者·诸龙族
verses.meaningEn: Ripen merit and burn away karmic obstructions! again and again, ultimate truth & awakened conduct beyond flux & supreme vehicle of awakening again and again, all + wicked + of all Nāga
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.meaningZh: 再三邻近、攻击，一切·大海·大海·离垢·超尊，善良·威光·阿婆罗尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Approach, attack again and again, all + ocean + ocean + immaculate + O surpass, great serpent or elephant + radiance + O lower, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.iast: oṃ caṭa caṭa vicaṭa vicaṭa śletha śletha śavari ciṭi svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三妙行迁变空·断除憍慢执障，再三最上真言离言说·妙行迁变空·断除憍慢执障，再三本性寂静止息·离一切相无相·无住安立，优势踊跃，觉知警策妙音（唧置），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! awakened conduct beyond flux & cutting rigid pride again and again, supreme ineffable speech & awakened conduct beyond flux & cutting rigid pride again and again, primordial tranquil peace & freedom from conditioned marks & non-abiding equipoise again and again, superiority + eager, awakening mindfulness mantra-pada, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 剑桥写本证本：CUL MS Add. 1326 · CUL MS Add. 1708

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！归命，向诸一切佛陀菩提萨埵
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to all + Buddha + to all Bodhisattva
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1485 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 1 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1485 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 2 句）

verses.iast: tadyathā — oṃ vajradharma-hṛdaya-garbhe sarvapāpa-āvaraṇa-viśodhani sarvabuddha-adhiṣṭhāna-adhiṣṭhite samanta-avabhāsa-vijaye svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！金刚正法，心、心髓、根本心咒，藏、胎藏、心髓宝藏尊，一切罪业，障蔽、烦恼所知障，闢理由，一切佛陀，加持、神力摄持，所加持、安住摄持尊，普遍、周遍十方，普光明照、遍照瑞光，最胜尊胜、普胜一切！尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! Vajra + Dharma, heart, core essence, heart-mantra, O womb, treasury, essence, matrix / in womb, treasury, essence, matrix, all + evil, obscuration, covering, hindrance, settle + O also means of purification, all + Buddha, spiritual blessing, empowerment,sustaining power, O blessed, empowered, consecrated / in blessed, empowered, consecrated, universal, all-encompassing, splendor, universal illumination, O supreme victory! triumph! / in supreme victory! triumph! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1485 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 3 句）

verses.iast: oṃ maṇidhari vajriṇi mahāpratisare sarvavighna-vināyakān vidhvaṃsaya rakṣa rakṣa māṃ sarvasattvāṃś ca hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！持摩尼宝珠（如意离垢宝）尊，具金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊，大随求佛母（随愿即得大明王母）尊，一切障碍，毗那夜迦（常随障难鬼王），请彻底摧毁、令其坏散无余！祈请再三拥护、守护于我，诸一切众生、普皆有情以及吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O bearer of Maṇi jewel, luminous gem, O bearer of Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, O Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess / in Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess, all + obstacle, Vināyaka, obstacle-creating/removing spirit, utterly demolish and disperse! evermore protect, guard and shelter me, all sentient beings and Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1485 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 4 句）

Incipit: [1v1] evam mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān mahāvajramerusikharakūṭāgāre viharati sma || mahā[1v2]vajrasamādhibhūmipratiṣṭhāne mahāvajrakalpavṛkṣasamalaṃkṛte |
