verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊佛母顶礼，广大殊胜·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed Mother / Lady Bhagavatī, great (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1325 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 1 句）

verses.iast: evam mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān mahāvajramerusikharakūṭāgāre viharati sma
verses.meaningZh: 如是（如《如是我闻》evam mayā śrutam），由我（具格：如是我闻），闻，一时，向平，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，一切，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性）
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in this manner, by me, heard, at one time, to equal, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, great (vocative invocation), lives, dwells, spends oneʼs time, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1325 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 2 句）

verses.meaningZh: 大、摩诃（广大无边），金刚三昧经·地·依止处，大·金刚·细轨·茂盛树·随着·严尊
verses.meaningEn: Great, vast, supreme, Vajrasamādhi + ground + O basis, great + Vajra + style + tree + along with + O adornment
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1325 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 3 句）

verses.meaningZh: 广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，第一，三磨钵耽
verses.meaningEn: Great, first or primary rule, finished, complete, perfect
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1325 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 4 句）

verses.meaningZh: 圣·大随求佛母·即是，大明咒不是了知，守护·法事·劫，明咒·驮·好吃·出，三磨钵耽
verses.meaningEn: Noble + Mahāpratisarā + thus, Mahāvidyā + not knowing, protection + arrangement, Vidyā + dha + palatable + income, finished, complete, perfect
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1325 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 5 句）

verses.meaningZh: 圣·大·因达罗·转载·具调伏摧碾一切恶障佛母，名为、号曰，大·不·界线，三磨钵耽
verses.meaningEn: Noble + great + consisting of 1000 + forward + possessing subdue and pulverize all evil forces! by name, called, great + not, finished, complete, perfect
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1325 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 6 句）

verses.iast: ārya mahāmāyūrī vidyārājñī a yamu pacāravidhi samāpta
verses.meaningZh: 圣、尊贵圣者，孔雀明王，明妃，悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性，一乘如实之道·无我大慈三昧，成熟善根·此边·法事，三磨钵耽
verses.meaningEn: Noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), Peahen Queen, wise consort, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, supreme vehicle of awakening & selfless great loving-kindness (imperative seal), ripen merit and burn away karmic obstructions! + the hither + way, finished, complete, perfect
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1325 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 7 句）

verses.meaningZh: 具足圣大冷尊，名为、号曰，明咒不是了知，三磨钵耽
verses.meaningEn: Noble + great + endowed with sail, by name, called, Vidyā + not knowing, finished, complete, perfect
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1325 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 8 句）

verses.iast: jānīha bhūtāti samāgatāni sthitāni bhūmav athavāntarīkṣe
verses.meaningZh: 婆利耶于此，部多鬼神太，随着一切来，一切立，破有相福德光·无我大慈三昧·最上真言离言说，尔时·吐·现见
verses.meaningEn: Wife + here, spirit + very, along with + to come, standing, abiding, remaining, blessedness transcending existence & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme ineffable speech, now + to vomit + O looking
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1325 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 9 句）

verses.iast: kurvantu maitrī satataṃ prajāsu divā ca rātrau ca carantu dharmam
verses.meaningZh: 愿一切诸尊普皆施作护持！慈心（与乐大慈），不已、从来，于诸裔胄、孩子们中，截至日子以及清净离诸尘垢·真如实际以及愿悉行持妙道、周游救护（左啰），正法、诸法实相
verses.meaningEn: May they all perform/grant! loving-kindness, benevolence (Maitrī), continual, in bringing forth, by day and stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness (imperative seal) and may they move forth in compassionate activity!! Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1325 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 10 句）

verses.iast: iti tatra buddhānubhāvena devatānubhāvena mahāti itiryyu paśānteti
verses.meaningZh: 如是（结句印定），于彼处、其中，以佛陀体面，以何为体面，酒席太，真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，不过·一极·瘟疫
verses.meaningEn: Thus, so it is stated, there, therein, Buddha + by, divinity + by, feast + very, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening (imperative seal), only + ultimate + plague
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1325 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 11 句）

verses.meaningZh: 如是（结句印定），无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·真如实际，用完、圆满
verses.meaningEn: Thus, so it is stated, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness, finished, perfect
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1325 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 12 句）

verses.iast: āryaśrimahāpratiśarā, mahāsāhasrapramardinī, mahāmāyurī, mahāśitavatī, mahāmantrānusāranī etāni paṃ mahārakṣāsutrāṇi samāpta
verses.meaningZh: 圣·清癯·大·对·箭，大·因达罗·转载·具调伏摧碾一切恶障佛母，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，具足乐趣充填，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，一切长柄、本刹，跛字门（第一义谛（paramārtha）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），大·守护·一切迫切往外，三磨钵耽
verses.meaningEn: Noble + lean + great + toward + reed, great + consisting of 1000 + forward + possessing subdue and pulverize all evil forces! great, gladden + endowed with eaten, great, stem, sgl, ultimate truth (paramārtha) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, great + protection + pressing out, finished, complete, perfect
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1325 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 13 句）

verses.iast: ye dharmā hetuprabhāvā hetu teṣān tathāgata hy a teṣāṃ ca yo nirodha evaṃ vādī mahāśramaṇaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 凡彼等诸有情，正法、诸法实相，因威，因，真如实际·六度满行清净·离名相假立，如来（乘如实道来成正觉），耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性，彼等一切之以及凡彼圣尊、能…者，灭谛，如是、如此，论者，大沙弥
verses.meaningEn: Those who, whoever (pl.), Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena, cause + might, cause, immutable Suchness & perfection of the six pāramitās & beyond nominal designation, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, of them, their and who, whichever, suppression, thus, in this way, vādī, great + ascetic
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1325 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 14 句）

verses.meaningZh: 随着不过逮捕
verses.meaningEn: Along with + only apprehend
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1325 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 15 句）

verses.meaningZh: 彼·不已·慈父·战士·战士·星宿·星宿·星宿·星宿
verses.meaningEn: He + continual + father + warrior + warrior + star + star + star + star
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1325 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 16 句）

verses.iast: oṃ namo bhagavate sarvatrailokyaprativiśiṣṭāya buddhāya te namaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊（薄伽梵）致敬，向一切·三界·对·殊胜，向佛陀、觉者，向汝、彼等，至心归命礼！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, all + the Three Worlds + toward + to, to/for Buddha, the Awakened One, to Thee / they, reverent homage!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1447 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 1 句）

verses.iast: tadyathā — oṃ bhrūṃ bhrūṃ bhrūṃ śodhaya śodhaya viśodhaya viśodhaya asama-samanta-avabhāsa-spharaṇa-gati-gagana-svabhāva-viśuddhe
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！再三一字顶轮王与尊胜佛顶最上心印，再三请净除、涤荡清净！再三请最极净除、彻底涤净一切业障！无等、无比伦，普遍、周遍十方，普光明照、遍照瑞光，遍，趣向、六趣、妙行，虚空、清净苍穹，自性、本然体性，最极清净、究竟净除尊
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! Uṣṇīṣa-cakravartin & Vijayā crown seed syllable again and again, purify! cleanse! again and again, thoroughly purify! cleanse completely! again and again, unequalled, peerless, matchless, universal, all-encompassing, splendor, universal illumination, suffusion, pervasion, course, path, realm of rebirth, sky, boundless space, firmament, own-being, intrinsic nature, O completely purified, supremely pure / in completely purified, supremely pure
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1447 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 2 句）

verses.meaningZh: 愿一切如来普施甘露灌顶！于我，诸一切如来，善逝、好去（妙往涅槃），殊胜、胜愿、妙好，言，甘露、不死妙法，破有相福德光·六度满行清净·造作离相，大手印、大法契印，真言、密咒（护心密语），以诸句、足迹、法位
verses.meaningEn: May all Buddhas consecrate and anoint me, all Tathagatas (plural), Sugata, Well-Gone Blissful One, choicest, supreme boon, excellent, word, ambrosia, nectar of immortality, blessedness transcending existence & perfection of the six pāramitās & freedom from karmic agency, Mahāmudrā, Great Seal, Mantra, sacred formula, by/with word, verse-foot, step, abode
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1447 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 3 句）

verses.iast: oṃ āhara āhara mama āyuḥ-saṃdhāraṇi śodhaya śodhaya viśodhaya viśodhaya gagana-svabhāva-viśuddhe
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三请摄召、赐予妙寿福德供养！我之（行者所有），寿命、无量寿，擎尊，再三请净除、涤荡清净！再三请最极净除、彻底涤净一切业障！虚空、清净苍穹，自性、本然体性，最极清净、究竟净除尊
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! bring! fetch! bestow! again and again, my, of me (the practitioner), life-force, longevity, O supporting, purify! cleanse! again and again, thoroughly purify! cleanse completely! again and again, sky, boundless space, firmament, own-being, intrinsic nature, O completely purified, supremely pure / in completely purified, supremely pure
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1447 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 4 句）

verses.iast: uṣṇīṣavijaya-pariśuddhe sahasra-raśmi-saṃcodite sarvatathāgata-avalokini ṣaṭ-pāramitā-paripūraṇi sarvatathāgata-māte daśa-bhūmi-pratiṣṭhite sarvatathāgata-hṛdaya-adhiṣṭhāna-adhiṣṭhite
verses.meaningZh: 佛顶肉髻相最胜尊胜，圆满清净、周遍无垢尊，千、千手千眼，光芒、百千光明聚，一切诸谛圆满·妙行迁变空·施度调伏，一切如来，最上真言离言说·离一切相无相·造作离相，六（六度，波罗蜜多（度彼岸、究竟圆满），般遂尊，一切如来，母尊，十（十方，地、菩萨十地，踞尊，一切如来，心、心髓、根本心咒，加持、神力摄持，所加持、安住摄持尊
verses.meaningEn: Uṣṇīṣa + supreme victory! triumph! O thoroughly pure, utterly cleansed / in thoroughly pure, utterly cleansed, thousand, ray of light, beam, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & awakened conduct beyond flux & generosity & self-mastery (vocative invocation), all Tathagatas, supreme ineffable speech & freedom from conditioned marks & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation), six, Pāramitā, perfection, gone to the beyond, wisdom + O satisfy, all Tathagatas, māte, ten, ground, stage (bodhisattva bhūmi), O squat / in squat, all Tathagatas, heart, core essence, heart-mantra, spiritual blessing, empowerment,sustaining power, O blessed, empowered, consecrated / in blessed, empowered, consecrated
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1447 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 5 句）

verses.iast: oṃ mudre mudre mahāmudre vajra-kāya-saṃhatana-pariśuddhe sarvakarmāvaraṇa-viśuddhe pratinivartaya mama āyur-viśuddhe sarvatathāgata-samaya-adhiṣṭhāna-adhiṣṭhite oṃ muni
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三阶位双手尊，大手印、大法契印尊，金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），身、佛身法身，好好儿编织不，圆满清净、周遍无垢尊，一切业障，最极清净、究竟净除尊，请回遮逆转（灾厄）、令寿复延！我之（行者所有），寿命（连音式），最极清净、究竟净除尊，一切如来，三昧耶（本誓、平等契合、时际），加持、神力摄持，所加持、安住摄持尊，嗡！牟尼、寂默圣者
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O position of the hands / in position of the hands again and again, O Mahāmudrā, Great Seal / in Mahāmudrā, Great Seal, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, body, kāya (sacred dimension), struck together + not, O thoroughly pure, utterly cleansed / in thoroughly pure, utterly cleansed, all + karmic obscuration, O completely purified, supremely pure / in completely purified, supremely pure, turn back (evil)! restore! my, of me (the practitioner), life, longevity, O completely purified, supremely pure / in completely purified, supremely pure, all Tathagatas, Samaya, sacred vow, pledge, union, spiritual blessing, empowerment,sustaining power, O blessed, empowered, consecrated / in blessed, empowered, consecrated, Oṃ! Muni, silent sage
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1447 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 6 句）

verses.iast: muni mahāmuni vimuni mahāvimuni mati mati mahāmati mamati sumati tathatā-bhūtakoṭi-pariśuddhe visphuṭa-buddhi-śuddhe he
verses.meaningZh: 牟尼、寂默圣者，大牟尼尊（释迦世尊），闢牟尼，大·闢·牟尼，再三慧、正念妙慧，大慧，我之（行者所有），善心、人情，真如、如实法性，实际、真如本际，圆满清净、周遍无垢尊，闢开，觉慧、明觉，清净、纯洁无染尊，呼唤圣尊叹词（咄！圣者！）
verses.meaningEn: Muni, silent sage, Great Sage (Mahāmuni), settle + Muni, great + settle + Muni, intelligence, wisdom, mindfulness again and again, great wisdom, my, of me (the practitioner), benevolence, favour, Suchness, ultimate reality (Tathatā), limit of reality, ultimate truth (Bhūtakoṭi), O thoroughly pure, utterly cleansed / in thoroughly pure, utterly cleansed, settle + suffused, awakened intellect, comprehension, O pure, cleansed, bright / in pure, cleansed, bright, O! Hail! Vocative invocation particle

verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1355 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 13 句）

verses.iast: yamātāpitṛpurvaṅgamaṅ kṛtvā sakalasatvarāśe r anuttarajñānaphalam avāpnuyād iti
verses.meaningZh: 趣入通行·一乘如实之道，既作已、行持已，全部·迅疾·望尊，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性），无上·圣智·果，最上真言离言说·第一义谛·离名相假立，如是（结句印定）
verses.meaningEn: Going toward, having done, having performed, entire + hastening + O hope, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising, unsurpassed + primordial wisdom + direct effect, supreme ineffable speech & ultimate truth & beyond nominal designation, thus, so it is stated
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1355 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 14 句）

verses.iast: samvat jeṣṭamāśe kṛṣṇapakṣe caturthyāyāṃ tithau bṛhaspativārasare
verses.meaningZh: 随着不过逮捕，生起不可得·尊胜·六度满行清净·断除憍慢执障，下半月尊，妙行迁变空·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，真如实际·无住安立，木星·人群·流注周遍
verses.meaningEn: Along with + only apprehend, transcending birth & victorious & perfection of the six pāramitās & cutting rigid pride (vocative invocation), O second half of the month / in second half of the month, awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust, immutable Suchness & non-abiding equipoise (imperative seal), of a god + crowd + O flow forth and pervade with blessing!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1355 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 15 句）

verses.meaningZh: 大王·大自在·童子大王·最胜·尊神，吉祥·吉祥·胜伏·恒常·寂静·大勇力士·天人，最胜尊胜油脂乳糜尊
verses.meaningEn: Great king + supreme ruler + a rich or noble lord + supreme + lord, auspiciousness + auspiciousness + conquer! victory! + always + kind + mighty champion + of god, supreme victory! triumph! + O melted or clarified butter
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1355 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 16 句）

verses.meaningZh: 清净吉祥、善妙庄严，愿得成就、当如是
verses.meaningEn: Auspicious, pure, bright, virtuous, may it be so, let it be!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1355 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 17 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊佛母顶礼，圣、尊贵圣者，圣智了知·第一义谛
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed Mother / Lady Bhagavatī, noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), knowing (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1554 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 1 句）

verses.iast: evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān rājagṛhe viharati sma gṛdhrakūṭe parvate mahatā bhikṣusaṃghena sārdham
verses.meaningZh: 如是、如此，由我（具格：如是我闻），闻，一时，向平，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，王舍城尊，一切，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），灵鸟顶山尊，时节，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，以比丘圣僧伽，俱
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in this way, by me, heard, at one time, to equal, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, O a king's house, palace, lives, dwells, spends oneʼs time, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, O Vulture Peak / in Vulture Peak, parvate, great, beggar + by, together
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1554 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 2 句）

verses.iast: tasmāj jñātavyam — prajñāpāramitā mahāmantro mahāvidyāmantro 'nuttaramantro 'samasamamantraḥ sarvaduḥkhapraśamanaḥ satyam amithyatvāt
verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧，觉知勇健，般若波罗蜜多（智慧度彼岸），贡高大方颤动，大明咒真言，无上真言，无等等真言，一切·苦·疗，谛、真实不虚语，从不虚
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness, know + strong, Perfection of Wisdom (Prajñāpāramitā), high-minded + tremble, Mahāvidyā + Mantra, unsurpassed + Mantra, without a peer + Mantra, all + suffering + heal, truth, reality, veracity, from not false
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1554 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 3 句）

verses.iast: tadyathā — oṃ gate gate pāragate pārasaṃgate bodhi svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！再三度越吧、已往彼岸尊！度向彼岸吧、已达究竟彼岸！普同度至彼岸吧（圆证菩提）！菩提、无上正觉，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! gone, O One gone beyond! again and again, gone all the way to the other shore! gone completely altogether beyond! Bodhi, awakening, enlightenment, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1554 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 4 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！文殊般若心印（甚深智慧总持），闻，正念、忆持不忘，最胜尊胜、普胜一切！尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Mañjuśrī wisdom seed syllable (prajñā), hearing, ear, sound, noise, report, hearsay, news, tidings, utterance or prescription, mindfulness, recollection, O supreme victory! triumph! / in supreme victory! triumph! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1554 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 5 句）

namaḥ saptānāṃ samyaksaṃbuddhakoṭīnāṃ | namaḥ sarvabuddhabodhisattvebhyaḥ | oṃ vipulagarbhe vipulavimale jayagarbhe vajrajvālāgarbhe gatigahane gaganaviśodhani sarvapāpaviśodhani oṃ guṇavati gaganavicāriṇi giri giri gamari gamari gaha gaha gārgari gārgari gagari gagari gambhāri gambhāri gabhi gabhi gahi gahi gamani gamani gare gurubhāri gurubhāri gaganabhāri svāhā ||

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼诸七（七佛·正等正觉诸俱胝！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to seven, Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha, of ten million!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 FG.870.1-4 (770 CE (Nara Period, Empress Shōtoku)) 外交转写（第 1 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切佛陀菩提萨埵！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, Buddha, Bodhisattva!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 FG.870.1-4 (770 CE (Nara Period, Empress Shōtoku)) 外交转写（第 2 句）

verses.iast: oṃ vipulagarbhe vipulavimale jayagarbhe vajrajvālāgarbhe gatigahane gaganaviśodhani sarvapāpaviśodhani oṃ guṇavati gaganavicāriṇi giri
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！广大藏，广大毘磨利，胜伏藏，金刚·光焰·藏，趣向稠林尊，虚空·闢·理由，一切·罪业·闢·理由，嗡！具足功德、殊胜妙德尊，虚空具伺尊，宝山王安住不动、高胜摄护
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! vast + O womb, vast + pure, conquer! victory! + O womb, Vajra + blaze + O womb, course + O guilelessness among the guileful, sky + settle + O also means of purification, all + evil + settle + O also means of purification, Oṃ! O one endowed with virtue, excellence, auspicious quality, sky + O bearer of proceeding, steadfast sacred mountain peak
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 FG.870.1-4 (770 CE (Nara Period, Empress Shōtoku)) 外交转写（第 3 句）

verses.iast: giri gamari gamari gaha gaha gārgari gārgari gagari gagari gambhāri gambhāri gabhi
verses.meaningZh: 宝山王安住不动、高胜摄护，再三无碍周遍通行十方（誐么哩），再三摄持容受甚深法藏，再三妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢，再三虚空周遍清净自在，再三往方位尊，甚深胎藏秘要安住
verses.meaningEn: Steadfast sacred mountain peak, unobstructed traversal across realms again and again, grasping & retaining profound Dharma again and again, awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation) again and again, pervading boundless sky-like purity again and again, to go + O bearing again and again, abiding in deep matrix mystery
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 FG.870.1-4 (770 CE (Nara Period, Empress Shōtoku)) 外交转写（第 4 句）

verses.iast: gabhi gahi gahi gamani gamani gare gurubhāri gurubhāri gaganabhāri svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 甚深胎藏秘要安住，再三深密摄受护念不失，再三自在趣入菩提胜道，除毒清凉护命尊，再三上师方位尊，虚空方位尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Abiding in deep matrix mystery, holding & safeguarding esoteric grace again and again, guiding swiftly onto the path of awakening again and again, neutralizing poison & granting vitality, lama + O bearing again and again, sky + O bearing, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 FG.870.1-4 (770 CE (Nara Period, Empress Shōtoku)) 外交转写（第 5 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！一切如来·广大·杖·摩尼宝珠·黄金·白银，闢·繁忙来讲·趣往·火供祀施尊，再三坚固任持总持法印（度噜），普遍兴盛尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! all Tathagatas + vast + sacrifice + Maṇi jewel + gold + silver, settle + be busy for + going + O sacrifice, firmly uphold the dhāraṇī seal! again and again, universal + O increasing, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 FG.870.1-4 (770 CE (Nara Period, Empress Shōtoku)) 外交转写（第 6 句）

verses.iast: oṃ sarvatathāgatādhiṣṭhānādhiṣṭhite mahāmudre vajrakāyasaṃhatanaviśuddhe sarvāvaraṇaviśodhani pratinivartaya mamāyurviśuddhe samayādhiṣṭhite maṇi maṇi mahāmaṇi tathatābhūtakoṭipariśuddhe visphuṭabuddhiśuddhe svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！一切如来·加持·所加持，大手印、大法契印尊，金刚身·好好儿编织·不·最极清净，一切·障蔽·闢·理由，请回遮逆转（灾厄）、令寿复延！瞒·寿命·最极清净，中间依止处，再三摩尼宝珠（如意离垢宝），广大，真如·实际·圆满清净，闢·开·清净尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! all Tathagatas + spiritual blessing + O blessed, O Mahāmudrā, Great Seal / in Mahāmudrā, Great Seal, vajrakāya + struck together + not + O completely purified, all + obscuration + settle + O also means of purification, turn back (evil)! restore! maṃ + life + O completely purified, in the middle of + O standing, Maṇi jewel, luminous gem again and again, great or precious jewel, Suchness + limit of reality + O thoroughly pure, settle + suffused + O pure in heart or intention, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 FG.870.1-4 (770 CE (Nara Period, Empress Shōtoku)) 外交转写（第 7 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊佛母顶礼，圣、尊贵圣者，一切诸谛圆满·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed Mother / Lady Bhagavatī, noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.875 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 1 句）

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！吉祥、圣德威光，摩诃室利此处尊，吉祥相，孵化尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, Mahādevī, mark, sign, O increasing, augmenting, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.875 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 2 句）

verses.iast: tadyathā — siddhe susiddhe mocani mokṣaṇi mukte vimukte amale vimale nirmale maṅgalye hiraṇyagarbhe ratnagarbhe sarvārthasādhani svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：成就者、已成就尊，善妙成就、最胜悉地尊，解放尊，自由化尊，除此之外，究竟解脱、离诸系缚尊，无垢、离染清净尊，毘磨利，净无垢秽、纤尘不染尊，最极吉祥、致福清净尊，金胎神尊，宝藏尊，一切义利成就法，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: O accomplished, perfected adept (Siddha) / in accomplished, perfected adept (Siddha), O well-accomplished, supremely perfected / in well-accomplished, supremely perfected, O delivering from, hurling, O freeing, delivering, except, O completely liberated, emancipated / in completely liberated, emancipated, O stainless, spotless, pure / in stainless, spotless, pure, pure, O utterly spotless, taintless / in utterly spotless, taintless, O auspicious, bringing felicity / in auspicious, bringing felicity, O Spirit Born from a Golden Egg / in Spirit Born from a Golden Egg, O filled with jewels, all aims and benefits + O accomplishing, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.875 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 3 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊佛母顶礼，圣、尊贵圣者，五眼目，向诸天神
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed Mother / Lady Bhagavatī, noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), five + eye, to all a god
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1164.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 1 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切如来·一切·怖畏·诸离！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all Tathagatas, all, fear, of all lost!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1164.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 2 句）

verses.iast: tadyathā — oṃ maṇidhari vajriṇi mahāpratisare rakṣa rakṣa māṃ sarvasattvāṃś ca svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！持摩尼宝珠（如意离垢宝）尊，具金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊，大随求佛母（随愿即得大明王母）尊，祈请再三拥护、守护于我，诸一切众生、普皆有情以及圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! O bearer of Maṇi jewel, luminous gem, O bearer of Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, O Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess / in Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess, evermore protect, guard and shelter me, all sentient beings and Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1164.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 3 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！孔雀措施尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! peacock or hen + O step, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1164.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 4 句）

verses.iast: oṃ mahāsāhasrapramardani sarvagraha-nakṣatra-vidhvaṃsani hūṃ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！大·因达罗·摧碎，一切曜执，星宿（二十八宿），摧灭尊，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! great + consisting of 1000 + O crushing, all + planet, constellation, lunar mansion, O ruining, spoiling, destroying, violating, Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1164.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 5 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！具足大冷尊，一切、普皆遍满，灾横、恼害横祸，疗尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! great + O one endowed with sail, all, every, complete, calamity, affliction, sudden disaster, O heal, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1164.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 6 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！贡高大方·守护掩蔽·具一样，一切罪业，闢理由，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! high-minded + protect shelter + O bearer of the same, all + evil, settle + O also means of purification, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1164.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 7 句）

verses.meaningZh: 如是（结句印定），吉祥、圣德威光，五眼目，大明妃，陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义），三磨钵耽
verses.meaningEn: Thus, so it is stated, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, five + eye, great + wise consort, Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell, finished, complete, perfect
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1164.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 8 句）

tadyathā — siddhe susiddhe mocani mokṣaṇi mukte vimukte amale vimale nirmale maṅgalye hiraṇyagarbhe ratnagarbhe sarvārthasādhani svāhā ||

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊佛母顶礼，圣、尊贵圣者，一切诸谛圆满·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed Mother / Lady Bhagavatī, noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1342.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 1 句）

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！吉祥、圣德威光，摩诃室利此处尊，吉祥相，孵化尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, Mahādevī, mark, sign, O increasing, augmenting, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1342.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 2 句）

verses.iast: tadyathā — siddhe susiddhe mocani mokṣaṇi mukte vimukte amale vimale nirmale maṅgalye hiraṇyagarbhe ratnagarbhe sarvārthasādhani svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：成就者、已成就尊，善妙成就、最胜悉地尊，解放尊，自由化尊，除此之外，究竟解脱、离诸系缚尊，无垢、离染清净尊，毘磨利，净无垢秽、纤尘不染尊，最极吉祥、致福清净尊，金胎神尊，宝藏尊，一切义利成就法，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: O accomplished, perfected adept (Siddha) / in accomplished, perfected adept (Siddha), O well-accomplished, supremely perfected / in well-accomplished, supremely perfected, O delivering from, hurling, O freeing, delivering, except, O completely liberated, emancipated / in completely liberated, emancipated, O stainless, spotless, pure / in stainless, spotless, pure, pure, O utterly spotless, taintless / in utterly spotless, taintless, O auspicious, bringing felicity / in auspicious, bringing felicity, O Spirit Born from a Golden Egg / in Spirit Born from a Golden Egg, O filled with jewels, all aims and benefits + O accomplishing, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1342.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 3 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊佛母顶礼，圣、尊贵圣者，吉祥、圣德威光，总持任持·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed Mother / Lady Bhagavatī, noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, upholding (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1400 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 1 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1400 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 2 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊（薄伽梵）致敬·金刚总持、执金刚尊·大海、功德海·责任、责难·如来·出·堪敬尊·正等正觉、正遍知！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, Vajradhara, Holder of the Vajra, ocean, sea, blame, censure, Tathāgata, income, Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1400 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 3 句）

verses.iast: tadyathā — oṃ surūpe bhadravati maṅgale acale acapale ughātini ubhedini sasyavati dhānyavati
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！善见尊，具足贤尊，吉祥、胜妙瑞相尊，不动明王、不动摇尊，无动摇尊，破暗合集·真如实际·离名相假立，破有相福德光·施度调伏·离名相假立，具足稼尊，具足驮他尊
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! O handsome-figured, beautiful, O one endowed with blessed, O auspiciousness, blessing, good fortune / in auspiciousness, blessing, good fortune, O Acala, Immovable Wisdom King / steadfast / in Acala, Immovable Wisdom King / steadfast, acapale, dissolving dense ignorance & immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), blessedness transcending existence & generosity & self-mastery & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), O one endowed with grain, dha + O one endowed with other
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1400 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 4 句）

verses.iast: dhanavati śrīmati prabhāvati amale vimale nirmale ruru surūpe vimale
verses.meaningZh: 具足财尊，吉祥宝部心印（福德庄严总持），威，无垢、离染清净尊，毘磨利，净无垢秽、纤尘不染尊，大悲流注、光明赫奕！善见尊，毘磨利
verses.meaningEn: O one endowed with treasure, auspicious Lakṣmī/Ratna-family seed syllable, might, majesty, superhuman strength, power over, O stainless, spotless, pure / in stainless, spotless, pure, pure, O utterly spotless, taintless / in utterly spotless, taintless, radiate compassionate light! O handsome-figured, beautiful, pure
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1400 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 5 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！吉祥、圣德威光，财源佛母（持世丰饶母），珍宝、摩尼宝，藏，田尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, Vasudhārā, Stream of Gems Goddess, jewel, precious gem, treasure, laying down, depositing, keeping, preserving, O field / in field, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1400 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 6 句）

verses.iast: oṃ vasudhariṇi mahā-vasu-vṛṣṭi-nipātini sarvasattvānāṃ dāridrya-duḥkha-praśamani svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！财物具请执持，大、摩诃（广大无边），财物，一雨，上首·太·在于，诸一切众生、普皆有情之，乏，苦、一切逼恼苦厄，疗尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! good + O bearer of hold! bear! sustain! great, vast, supreme, good, wholesome, rain, chief + very + in, of all all sentient beings, poverty, suffering, pain, sorrow, distress, O heal, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1400 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 7 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！吉祥、圣德威光，财物面门，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, good + O face, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1400 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 8 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！柔顺良好、优渥尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O yielding good, liberal, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1400 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 9 句）

verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1449 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 2 句）

verses.iast: tadyathā — oṃ vajradharma-hṛdaya-garbhe sarvapāpa-āvaraṇa-viśodhani sarvabuddha-adhiṣṭhāna-adhiṣṭhite samanta-avabhāsa-vijaye svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！金刚正法，心、心髓、根本心咒，藏、胎藏、心髓宝藏尊，一切罪业，障蔽、烦恼所知障，闢理由，一切佛陀，加持、神力摄持，所加持、安住摄持尊，普遍、周遍十方，普光明照、遍照瑞光，最胜尊胜、普胜一切！尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! Vajra + Dharma, heart, core essence, heart-mantra, O womb, treasury, essence, matrix / in womb, treasury, essence, matrix, all + evil, obscuration, covering, hindrance, settle + O also means of purification, all + Buddha, spiritual blessing, empowerment,sustaining power, O blessed, empowered, consecrated / in blessed, empowered, consecrated, universal, all-encompassing, splendor, universal illumination, O supreme victory! triumph! / in supreme victory! triumph! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1449 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 3 句）

verses.iast: oṃ maṇidhari vajriṇi mahāpratisare sarvavighna-vināyakān vidhvaṃsaya rakṣa rakṣa māṃ sarvasattvāṃś ca hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！持摩尼宝珠（如意离垢宝）尊，具金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊，大随求佛母（随愿即得大明王母）尊，一切障碍，毗那夜迦（常随障难鬼王），请彻底摧毁、令其坏散无余！祈请再三拥护、守护于我，诸一切众生、普皆有情以及吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O bearer of Maṇi jewel, luminous gem, O bearer of Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, O Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess / in Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess, all + obstacle, Vināyaka, obstacle-creating/removing spirit, utterly demolish and disperse! evermore protect, guard and shelter me, all sentient beings and Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1449 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 4 句）

Vajra + Dharma, heart, core essence, heart-mantra, O womb, treasury, essence, matrix / in womb, treasury, essence, matrix, all + evil, obscuration, covering, hindrance, settle + O also means of purification, all + Buddha, spiritual blessing, empowerment,sustaining power, O blessed, empowered, consecrated / in blessed, empowered, consecrated, universal, all-encompassing, splendor, universal illumination, O supreme victory! triumph! / in supreme victory! triumph! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1455 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 3 句）

verses.iast: oṃ maṇidhari vajriṇi mahāpratisare sarvavighna-vināyakān vidhvaṃsaya rakṣa rakṣa māṃ sarvasattvāṃś ca hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！持摩尼宝珠（如意离垢宝）尊，具金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊，大随求佛母（随愿即得大明王母）尊，一切障碍，毗那夜迦（常随障难鬼王），请彻底摧毁、令其坏散无余！祈请再三拥护、守护于我，诸一切众生、普皆有情以及吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O bearer of Maṇi jewel, luminous gem, O bearer of Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, O Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess / in Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess, all + obstacle, Vināyaka, obstacle-creating/removing spirit, utterly demolish and disperse! evermore protect, guard and shelter me, all sentient beings and Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1455 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 4 句）

verses.meaningZh: 誐那鉢底心

verses.meaningZh: 佛顶尊胜佛母

verses.meaningZh: 叶衣菩萨

verses.meaningZh: 摩利支天菩萨（阳焰威光佛母）

verses.meaningZh: 曜执摩怛理迦

verses.meaningZh: 归命敬礼·离名相假立，向威猛金刚手菩萨，向大药叉军主
verses.meaningEn: Bowing, fierce + to Vajrapāṇi, mahāyakṣasenāpataye
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1476.2 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 9 句）

verses.iast: tadyathā — oṃ truṭa truṭa troṭaya troṭaya sphuṭa sphuṭa sphoṭaya sphoṭaya ghūrṇa
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！再三真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·断除憍慢执障，再三真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·断除憍慢执障，再三开，再三请击碎、破除一切结缚！索索、滴溜溜
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & cutting rigid pride again and again, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & cutting rigid pride again and again, suffused again and again, shatter! split open! again and again, moving to and fro, trembling, whirling
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1476.2 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 10 句）

verses.iast: ghūrṇa ghūrṇāpaya ghūrṇāpaya sarvasattvāni bodhaya saṃbodhaya hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ
verses.meaningZh: 索索、滴溜溜，再三令索索、滴溜溜，一切一切众生、普皆有情，请开晓觉悟、令发菩提觉智！祈请理解、聪慧，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Moving to and fro, trembling, whirling, cause to moving to and fro, trembling, whirling! again and again, all sentient beings (plural), awaken! enlighten! illuminate! may You understanding, intelligence! Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1476.2 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 11 句）

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1476.2 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 12 句）

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to all + Buddha + to all Bodhisattva
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1546.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 1 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1546.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 2 句）

verses.iast: tadyathā — oṃ vajradharma-hṛdaya-garbhe sarvapāpa-āvaraṇa-viśodhani sarvabuddha-adhiṣṭhāna-adhiṣṭhite samanta-avabhāsa-vijaye svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！金刚正法，心、心髓、根本心咒，藏、胎藏、心髓宝藏尊，一切罪业，障蔽、烦恼所知障，闢理由，一切佛陀，加持、神力摄持，所加持、安住摄持尊，普遍、周遍十方，普光明照、遍照瑞光，最胜尊胜、普胜一切！尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! Vajra + Dharma, heart, core essence, heart-mantra, O womb, treasury, essence, matrix / in womb, treasury, essence, matrix, all + evil, obscuration, covering, hindrance, settle + O also means of purification, all + Buddha, spiritual blessing, empowerment,sustaining power, O blessed, empowered, consecrated / in blessed, empowered, consecrated, universal, all-encompassing, splendor, universal illumination, O supreme victory! triumph! / in supreme victory! triumph! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1546.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 3 句）

verses.iast: oṃ maṇidhari vajriṇi mahāpratisare sarvavighna-vināyakān vidhvaṃsaya rakṣa rakṣa māṃ sarvasattvāṃś ca hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！持摩尼宝珠（如意离垢宝）尊，具金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊，大随求佛母（随愿即得大明王母）尊，一切障碍，毗那夜迦（常随障难鬼王），请彻底摧毁、令其坏散无余！祈请再三拥护、守护于我，诸一切众生、普皆有情以及吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O bearer of Maṇi jewel, luminous gem, O bearer of Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, O Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess / in Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess, all + obstacle, Vināyaka, obstacle-creating/removing spirit, utterly demolish and disperse! evermore protect, guard and shelter me, all sentient beings and Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1546.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 4 句）

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！金刚正法，心、心髓、根本心咒，藏、胎藏、心髓宝藏尊，一切罪业，障蔽、烦恼所知障，闢理由，一切佛陀，加持、神力摄持，所加持、安住摄持尊，普遍、周遍十方，普光明照、遍照瑞光，最胜尊胜、普胜一切！尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! Vajra + Dharma, heart, core essence, heart-mantra, O womb, treasury, essence, matrix / in womb, treasury, essence, matrix, all + evil, obscuration, covering, hindrance, settle + O also means of purification, all + Buddha, spiritual blessing, empowerment,sustaining power, O blessed, empowered, consecrated / in blessed, empowered, consecrated, universal, all-encompassing, splendor, universal illumination, O supreme victory! triumph! / in supreme victory! triumph! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: oṃ maṇidhari vajriṇi mahāpratisare sarvavighna-vināyakān vidhvaṃsaya rakṣa rakṣa māṃ sarvasattvāṃś ca hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！持摩尼宝珠（如意离垢宝）尊，具金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊，大随求佛母（随愿即得大明王母）尊，一切障碍，毗那夜迦（常随障难鬼王），请彻底摧毁、令其坏散无余！祈请再三拥护、守护于我，诸一切众生、普皆有情以及吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O bearer of Maṇi jewel, luminous gem, O bearer of Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, O Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess / in Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess, all + obstacle, Vināyaka, obstacle-creating/removing spirit, utterly demolish and disperse! evermore protect, guard and shelter me, all sentient beings and Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

oṃ namo bhagavatyai ārya-śrī-vasudhārāyai | namo ratnatrayāya | namo bhagavate vajradhara-sāgara-nirghoṣāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya ||
tadyathā — oṃ surūpe bhadravati maṅgale acale acapale ughātini ubhedini sasyavati dhānyavati dhanavati śrīmati prabhāvati amale vimale nirmale ruru surūpe vimale ||
oṃ śrī-vasudhārā-ratna-nidhāna-kṣetre svāhā | oṃ vasudhariṇi mahā-vasu-vṛṣṭi-nipātini sarvasattvānāṃ dāridrya-duḥkha-praśamani svāhā | oṃ śrī-vasumukhi svāhā | oṃ vasudhe svāhā ||

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊佛母顶礼，圣、尊贵圣者，吉祥、圣德威光，总持任持·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed Mother / Lady Bhagavatī, noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, upholding (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1680.14.3 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 1 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1680.14.3 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 2 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊（薄伽梵）致敬·金刚总持、执金刚尊·大海、功德海·责任、责难·如来·出·堪敬尊·正等正觉、正遍知！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, Vajradhara, Holder of the Vajra, ocean, sea, blame, censure, Tathāgata, income, Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1680.14.3 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 3 句）

verses.iast: tadyathā — oṃ surūpe bhadravati maṅgale acale acapale ughātini ubhedini sasyavati dhānyavati
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！善见尊，具足贤尊，吉祥、胜妙瑞相尊，不动明王、不动摇尊，无动摇尊，破暗合集·真如实际·离名相假立，破有相福德光·施度调伏·离名相假立，具足稼尊，具足驮他尊
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! O handsome-figured, beautiful, O one endowed with blessed, O auspiciousness, blessing, good fortune / in auspiciousness, blessing, good fortune, O Acala, Immovable Wisdom King / steadfast / in Acala, Immovable Wisdom King / steadfast, acapale, dissolving dense ignorance & immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), blessedness transcending existence & generosity & self-mastery & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), O one endowed with grain, dha + O one endowed with other
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1680.14.3 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 4 句）

verses.iast: dhanavati śrīmati prabhāvati amale vimale nirmale ruru surūpe vimale
verses.meaningZh: 具足财尊，吉祥宝部心印（福德庄严总持），威，无垢、离染清净尊，毘磨利，净无垢秽、纤尘不染尊，大悲流注、光明赫奕！善见尊，毘磨利
verses.meaningEn: O one endowed with treasure, auspicious Lakṣmī/Ratna-family seed syllable, might, majesty, superhuman strength, power over, O stainless, spotless, pure / in stainless, spotless, pure, pure, O utterly spotless, taintless / in utterly spotless, taintless, radiate compassionate light! O handsome-figured, beautiful, pure
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1680.14.3 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 5 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！吉祥、圣德威光，财源佛母（持世丰饶母），珍宝、摩尼宝，藏，田尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, Vasudhārā, Stream of Gems Goddess, jewel, precious gem, treasure, laying down, depositing, keeping, preserving, O field / in field, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1680.14.3 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 6 句）

verses.iast: oṃ vasudhariṇi mahā-vasu-vṛṣṭi-nipātini sarvasattvānāṃ dāridrya-duḥkha-praśamani svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！财物具请执持，大、摩诃（广大无边），财物，一雨，上首·太·在于，诸一切众生、普皆有情之，乏，苦、一切逼恼苦厄，疗尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! good + O bearer of hold! bear! sustain! great, vast, supreme, good, wholesome, rain, chief + very + in, of all all sentient beings, poverty, suffering, pain, sorrow, distress, O heal, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1680.14.3 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 7 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！吉祥、圣德威光，财物面门，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, good + O face, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1680.14.3 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 8 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！柔顺良好、优渥尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O yielding good, liberal, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1680.14.3 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 9 句）

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！持摩尼宝珠（如意离垢宝）尊，具金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊，大随求佛母（随愿即得大明王母）尊，祈请再三拥护、守护于我，诸一切众生、普皆有情以及圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! O bearer of Maṇi jewel, luminous gem, O bearer of Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, O Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess / in Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess, evermore protect, guard and shelter me, all sentient beings and Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！孔雀措施尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! peacock or hen + O step, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: oṃ mahāsāhasrapramardani sarvagraha-nakṣatra-vidhvaṃsani hūṃ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！大·因达罗·摧碎，一切曜执，星宿（二十八宿），摧灭尊，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! great + consisting of 1000 + O crushing, all + planet, constellation, lunar mansion, O ruining, spoiling, destroying, violating, Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1688 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 5 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！具足大冷尊，一切、普皆遍满，灾横、恼害横祸，疗尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! great + O one endowed with sail, all, every, complete, calamity, affliction, sudden disaster, O heal, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1688 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 6 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！贡高大方·守护掩蔽·具一样，一切罪业，闢理由，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! high-minded + protect shelter + O bearer of the same, all + evil, settle + O also means of purification, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 如是（结句印定），吉祥、圣德威光，五眼目，大明妃，陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义），三磨钵耽
verses.meaningEn: Thus, so it is stated, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, five + eye, great + wise consort, Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell, finished, complete, perfect
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1688 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 8 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊（薄伽梵）致敬·金刚总持、执金刚尊·大海、功德海·责任、责难·如来·出·堪敬尊·正等正觉、正遍知！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, Vajradhara, Holder of the Vajra, ocean, sea, blame, censure, Tathāgata, income, Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha!

verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! O handsome-figured, beautiful, O one endowed with blessed, O auspiciousness, blessing, good fortune / in auspiciousness, blessing, good fortune, O Acala, Immovable Wisdom King / steadfast / in Acala, Immovable Wisdom King / steadfast, acapale, dissolving dense ignorance & immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), blessedness transcending existence & generosity & self-mastery & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), O one endowed with grain, dha + O one endowed with other
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1690.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 4 句）

verses.iast: dhanavati śrīmati prabhāvati amale vimale nirmale ruru surūpe vimale
verses.meaningZh: 具足财尊，吉祥宝部心印（福德庄严总持），威，无垢、离染清净尊，毘磨利，净无垢秽、纤尘不染尊，大悲流注、光明赫奕！善见尊，毘磨利
verses.meaningEn: O one endowed with treasure, auspicious Lakṣmī/Ratna-family seed syllable, might, majesty, superhuman strength, power over, O stainless, spotless, pure / in stainless, spotless, pure, pure, O utterly spotless, taintless / in utterly spotless, taintless, radiate compassionate light! O handsome-figured, beautiful, pure
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1690.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 5 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！吉祥、圣德威光，财源佛母（持世丰饶母），珍宝、摩尼宝，藏，田尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, Vasudhārā, Stream of Gems Goddess, jewel, precious gem, treasure, laying down, depositing, keeping, preserving, O field / in field, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1690.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 6 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！财物具请执持，大、摩诃（广大无边），财物，一雨，上首·太·在于，诸一切众生、普皆有情之，乏，苦、一切逼恼苦厄，疗尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! good + O bearer of hold! bear! sustain! great, vast, supreme, good, wholesome, rain, chief + very + in, of all all sentient beings, poverty, suffering, pain, sorrow, distress, O heal, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1690.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 7 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！吉祥、圣德威光，财物面门，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, good + O face, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1690.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 8 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！柔顺良好、优渥尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O yielding good, liberal, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Add.1690.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 9 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊（薄伽梵）致敬·金刚总持、执金刚尊·大海、功德海·责任、责难·如来·出·堪敬尊·正等正觉、正遍知！

O handsome-figured, beautiful, O one endowed with blessed, O auspiciousness, blessing, good fortune / in auspiciousness, blessing, good fortune, O Acala, Immovable Wisdom King / steadfast / in Acala, Immovable Wisdom King / steadfast, acapale, dissolving dense ignorance & immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), blessedness transcending existence & generosity & self-mastery & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), O one endowed with grain, dha + O one endowed with other

verses.meaningEn: O one endowed with treasure, auspicious Lakṣmī/Ratna-family seed syllable, might, majesty, superhuman strength, power over, O stainless, spotless, pure / in stainless, spotless, pure, pure, O utterly spotless, taintless / in utterly spotless, taintless, radiate compassionate light! O handsome-figured, beautiful, pure

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！吉祥、圣德威光，财源佛母（持世丰饶母），珍宝、摩尼宝，藏，田尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, Vasudhārā, Stream of Gems Goddess, jewel, precious gem, treasure, laying down, depositing, keeping, preserving, O field / in field, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！财物具请执持，大、摩诃（广大无边），财物，一雨，上首·太·在于，诸一切众生、普皆有情之，乏，苦、一切逼恼苦厄，疗尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! good + O bearer of hold! bear! sustain! great, vast, supreme, good, wholesome, rain, chief + very + in, of all all sentient beings, poverty, suffering, pain, sorrow, distress, O heal, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！归命，向诸一切佛陀菩提萨埵
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to all + Buddha + to all Bodhisattva
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Corpus Christi 37 Add.B.5 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 1 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Corpus Christi 37 Add.B.5 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 2 句）

verses.iast: tadyathā — oṃ vajradharma-hṛdaya-garbhe sarvapāpa-āvaraṇa-viśodhani sarvabuddha-adhiṣṭhāna-adhiṣṭhite samanta-avabhāsa-vijaye svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！金刚正法，心、心髓、根本心咒，藏、胎藏、心髓宝藏尊，一切罪业，障蔽、烦恼所知障，闢理由，一切佛陀，加持、神力摄持，所加持、安住摄持尊，普遍、周遍十方，普光明照、遍照瑞光，最胜尊胜、普胜一切！尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! Vajra + Dharma, heart, core essence, heart-mantra, O womb, treasury, essence, matrix / in womb, treasury, essence, matrix, all + evil, obscuration, covering, hindrance, settle + O also means of purification, all + Buddha, spiritual blessing, empowerment,sustaining power, O blessed, empowered, consecrated / in blessed, empowered, consecrated, universal, all-encompassing, splendor, universal illumination, O supreme victory! triumph! / in supreme victory! triumph! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Corpus Christi 37 Add.B.5 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 3 句）

verses.iast: oṃ maṇidhari vajriṇi mahāpratisare sarvavighna-vināyakān vidhvaṃsaya rakṣa rakṣa māṃ sarvasattvāṃś ca hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！持摩尼宝珠（如意离垢宝）尊，具金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊，大随求佛母（随愿即得大明王母）尊，一切障碍，毗那夜迦（常随障难鬼王），请彻底摧毁、令其坏散无余！祈请再三拥护、守护于我，诸一切众生、普皆有情以及吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O bearer of Maṇi jewel, luminous gem, O bearer of Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, O Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess / in Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess, all + obstacle, Vināyaka, obstacle-creating/removing spirit, utterly demolish and disperse! evermore protect, guard and shelter me, all sentient beings and Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Corpus Christi 37 Add.B.5 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 4 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊佛母顶礼，圣、尊贵圣者，吉祥、圣德威光，总持任持·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed Mother / Lady Bhagavatī, noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, upholding (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.117 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 1 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.117 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 2 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊（薄伽梵）致敬·金刚总持、执金刚尊·大海、功德海·责任、责难·如来·出·堪敬尊·正等正觉、正遍知！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, Vajradhara, Holder of the Vajra, ocean, sea, blame, censure, Tathāgata, income, Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.117 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 3 句）

verses.iast: tadyathā — oṃ surūpe bhadravati maṅgale acale acapale ughātini ubhedini sasyavati dhānyavati
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！善见尊，具足贤尊，吉祥、胜妙瑞相尊，不动明王、不动摇尊，无动摇尊，破暗合集·真如实际·离名相假立，破有相福德光·施度调伏·离名相假立，具足稼尊，具足驮他尊
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! O handsome-figured, beautiful, O one endowed with blessed, O auspiciousness, blessing, good fortune / in auspiciousness, blessing, good fortune, O Acala, Immovable Wisdom King / steadfast / in Acala, Immovable Wisdom King / steadfast, acapale, dissolving dense ignorance & immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), blessedness transcending existence & generosity & self-mastery & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), O one endowed with grain, dha + O one endowed with other
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.117 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 4 句）

verses.iast: dhanavati śrīmati prabhāvati amale vimale nirmale ruru surūpe vimale
verses.meaningZh: 具足财尊，吉祥宝部心印（福德庄严总持），威，无垢、离染清净尊，毘磨利，净无垢秽、纤尘不染尊，大悲流注、光明赫奕！善见尊，毘磨利
verses.meaningEn: O one endowed with treasure, auspicious Lakṣmī/Ratna-family seed syllable, might, majesty, superhuman strength, power over, O stainless, spotless, pure / in stainless, spotless, pure, pure, O utterly spotless, taintless / in utterly spotless, taintless, radiate compassionate light! O handsome-figured, beautiful, pure
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.117 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 5 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！吉祥、圣德威光，财源佛母（持世丰饶母），珍宝、摩尼宝，藏，田尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, Vasudhārā, Stream of Gems Goddess, jewel, precious gem, treasure, laying down, depositing, keeping, preserving, O field / in field, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.117 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 6 句）

verses.iast: oṃ vasudhariṇi mahā-vasu-vṛṣṭi-nipātini sarvasattvānāṃ dāridrya-duḥkha-praśamani svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！财物具请执持，大、摩诃（广大无边），财物，一雨，上首·太·在于，诸一切众生、普皆有情之，乏，苦、一切逼恼苦厄，疗尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! good + O bearer of hold! bear! sustain! great, vast, supreme, good, wholesome, rain, chief + very + in, of all all sentient beings, poverty, suffering, pain, sorrow, distress, O heal, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.117 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 7 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！吉祥、圣德威光，财物面门，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, good + O face, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.117 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 8 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！柔顺良好、优渥尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O yielding good, liberal, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.117 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 9 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊佛母顶礼，圣、尊贵圣者，五眼目，向诸天神
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed Mother / Lady Bhagavatī, noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), five + eye, to all a god
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.130 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 1 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切如来·一切·怖畏·诸离！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all Tathagatas, all, fear, of all lost!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.130 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 2 句）

verses.iast: tadyathā — oṃ maṇidhari vajriṇi mahāpratisare rakṣa rakṣa māṃ sarvasattvāṃś ca svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！持摩尼宝珠（如意离垢宝）尊，具金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊，大随求佛母（随愿即得大明王母）尊，祈请再三拥护、守护于我，诸一切众生、普皆有情以及圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! O bearer of Maṇi jewel, luminous gem, O bearer of Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, O Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess / in Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess, evermore protect, guard and shelter me, all sentient beings and Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.130 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 3 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！孔雀措施尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! peacock or hen + O step, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.130 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 4 句）

verses.iast: oṃ mahāsāhasrapramardani sarvagraha-nakṣatra-vidhvaṃsani hūṃ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！大·因达罗·摧碎，一切曜执，星宿（二十八宿），摧灭尊，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! great + consisting of 1000 + O crushing, all + planet, constellation, lunar mansion, O ruining, spoiling, destroying, violating, Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.130 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 5 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！具足大冷尊，一切、普皆遍满，灾横、恼害横祸，疗尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! great + O one endowed with sail, all, every, complete, calamity, affliction, sudden disaster, O heal, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.130 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 6 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！贡高大方·守护掩蔽·具一样，一切罪业，闢理由，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! high-minded + protect shelter + O bearer of the same, all + evil, settle + O also means of purification, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.130 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 7 句）

verses.meaningZh: 如是（结句印定），吉祥、圣德威光，五眼目，大明妃，陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义），三磨钵耽
verses.meaningEn: Thus, so it is stated, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, five + eye, great + wise consort, Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell, finished, complete, perfect
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.130 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 8 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊（薄伽梵）致敬·金刚总持、执金刚尊·大海、功德海·责任、责难·如来·出·堪敬尊·正等正觉、正遍知！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, Vajradhara, Holder of the Vajra, ocean, sea, blame, censure, Tathāgata, income, Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha!

verses.meaningEn: O one endowed with treasure, auspicious Lakṣmī/Ratna-family seed syllable, might, majesty, superhuman strength, power over, O stainless, spotless, pure / in stainless, spotless, pure, pure, O utterly spotless, taintless / in utterly spotless, taintless, radiate compassionate light! verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, Vasudhārā, Stream of Gems Goddess, jewel, precious gem, treasure, laying down, depositing, keeping, preserving, O field / in field, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.142.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 6 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！财物具请执持，大、摩诃（广大无边），财物，一雨，上首·太·在于，诸一切众生、普皆有情之，乏，苦、一切逼恼苦厄，疗尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! good + O bearer of hold! bear! sustain! great, vast, supreme, good, wholesome, rain, chief + very + in, of all all sentient beings, poverty, suffering, pain, sorrow, distress, O heal, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！吉祥、圣德威光，财物面门，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, good + O face, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！柔顺良好、优渥尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O yielding good, liberal, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.142.1 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 9 句）

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, Aparimitāyus + primordial wisdom + press out + determined to + to, Tathāgata + income, to/for Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.153 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 1 句）

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！再三福德、胜妙功德，大福，无限量福德，无限量·福德·圣智·资粮·积累尊
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! merit, auspicious virtue again and again, very auspicious or fortunate, unmeasured + merit, unmeasured + merit + primordial wisdom + something accumulated + O heaped up
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.153 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 2 句）

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! all + volitional formations + thoroughly pure + Dharma, sky + tip, own-being + O completely purified, walk + O accessory, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.153 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 3 句）

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed Mother / Lady Bhagavatī, noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), five + eye, to all a god
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.725.2 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 1 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切如来·一切·怖畏·诸离！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all Tathagatas, all, fear, of all lost!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.725.2 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 2 句）

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！持摩尼宝珠（如意离垢宝）尊，具金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊，大随求佛母（随愿即得大明王母）尊，祈请再三拥护、守护于我，诸一切众生、普皆有情以及圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！金刚正法，心、心髓、根本心咒，藏、胎藏、心髓宝藏尊，一切罪业，障蔽、烦恼所知障，闢理由，一切佛陀，加持、神力摄持，所加持、安住摄持尊，普遍、周遍十方，普光明照、遍照瑞光，最胜尊胜、普胜一切！尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: oṃ maṇidhari vajriṇi mahāpratisare sarvavighna-vināyakān vidhvaṃsaya rakṣa rakṣa māṃ sarvasattvāṃś ca hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！持摩尼宝珠（如意离垢宝）尊，具金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊，大随求佛母（随愿即得大明王母）尊，一切障碍，毗那夜迦（常随障难鬼王），请彻底摧毁、令其坏散无余！祈请再三拥护、守护于我，诸一切众生、普皆有情以及吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O bearer of Maṇi jewel, luminous gem, O bearer of Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, O Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess / in Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess, all + obstacle, Vināyaka, obstacle-creating/removing spirit, utterly demolish and disperse! evermore protect, guard and shelter me, all sentient beings and Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊（薄伽梵）致敬，向无量寿智决定王如来·圣智·报刊往外·决定·威光·王，如来·出·堪敬尊，向正等正觉、正遍知
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, Aparimitāyus + primordial wisdom + press out + determined to + to, Tathāgata + income, to/for Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.1814.3 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 1 句）

verses.iast: tadyathā — oṃ puṇya puṇya mahāpuṇya aparimitapuṇya aparimitapuṇyajñānasaṃbhāropacite
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！再三福德、胜妙功德，大福，无限量福德，无限量·福德·圣智·资粮·积累尊
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! merit, auspicious virtue again and again, very auspicious or fortunate, unmeasured + merit, unmeasured + merit + primordial wisdom + something accumulated + O heaped up
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.1814.3 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 2 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊佛母顶礼，圣、尊贵圣者，吉祥、圣德威光，总持任持·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed Mother / Lady Bhagavatī, noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, upholding (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.1814.4 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 1 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Three Jewels (Buddha, Dharma, Saṃgha)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.1814.4 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 2 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊（薄伽梵）致敬·金刚总持、执金刚尊·大海、功德海·责任、责难·如来·出·堪敬尊·正等正觉、正遍知！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, Vajradhara, Holder of the Vajra, ocean, sea, blame, censure, Tathāgata, income, Perfectly and Completely Awakened Buddha!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.1814.4 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 3 句）

verses.iast: tadyathā — oṃ surūpe bhadravati maṅgale acale acapale ughātini ubhedini sasyavati dhānyavati
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！善见尊，具足贤尊，吉祥、胜妙瑞相尊，不动明王、不动摇尊，无动摇尊，破暗合集·真如实际·离名相假立，破有相福德光·施度调伏·离名相假立，具足稼尊，具足驮他尊
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! O handsome-figured, beautiful, O one endowed with blessed, O auspiciousness, blessing, good fortune / in auspiciousness, blessing, good fortune, O Acala, Immovable Wisdom King / steadfast / in Acala, Immovable Wisdom King / steadfast, acapale, dissolving dense ignorance & immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), blessedness transcending existence & generosity & self-mastery & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation), O one endowed with grain, dha + O one endowed with other
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.1814.4 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 4 句）

verses.iast: dhanavati śrīmati prabhāvati amale vimale nirmale ruru surūpe vimale
verses.meaningZh: 具足财尊，吉祥宝部心印（福德庄严总持），威，无垢、离染清净尊，毘磨利，净无垢秽、纤尘不染尊，大悲流注、光明赫奕！善见尊，毘磨利
verses.meaningEn: O one endowed with treasure, auspicious Lakṣmī/Ratna-family seed syllable, might, majesty, superhuman strength, power over, O stainless, spotless, pure / in stainless, spotless, pure, pure, O utterly spotless, taintless / in utterly spotless, taintless, radiate compassionate light! O handsome-figured, beautiful, pure
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.1814.4 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 5 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！吉祥、圣德威光，财源佛母（持世丰饶母），珍宝、摩尼宝，藏，田尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, Vasudhārā, Stream of Gems Goddess, jewel, precious gem, treasure, laying down, depositing, keeping, preserving, O field / in field, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.1814.4 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 6 句）

verses.iast: oṃ vasudhariṇi mahā-vasu-vṛṣṭi-nipātini sarvasattvānāṃ dāridrya-duḥkha-praśamani svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！财物具请执持，大、摩诃（广大无边），财物，一雨，上首·太·在于，诸一切众生、普皆有情之，乏，苦、一切逼恼苦厄，疗尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! good + O bearer of hold! bear! sustain! great, vast, supreme, good, wholesome, rain, chief + very + in, of all all sentient beings, poverty, suffering, pain, sorrow, distress, O heal, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.1814.4 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 7 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！吉祥、圣德威光，财物面门，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, good + O face, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.1814.4 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 8 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！柔顺良好、优渥尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O yielding good, liberal, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.1814.4 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 9 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命敬礼·离名相假立，向威猛金刚手菩萨，向大药叉军主
verses.meaningEn: Bowing, fierce + to Vajrapāṇi, mahāyakṣasenāpataye

verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & cutting rigid pride again and again, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & cutting rigid pride again and again, suffused again and again, shatter! split open! again and again, moving to and fro, trembling, whirling

verses.meaningZh: 索索、滴溜溜，再三令索索、滴溜溜，一切一切众生、普皆有情，请开晓觉悟、令发菩提觉智！祈请理解、聪慧，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒泮吒（顿断一切魔障）！
verses.meaningEn: Moving to and fro, trembling, whirling, cause to moving to and fro, trembling, whirling! again and again, all sentient beings (plural), awaken! enlighten! illuminate! may You understanding, intelligence! Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ Phaṭ (shatter all obstacles)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.1814.5 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 11 句）

verses.meaningZh: 圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊佛母顶礼，圣、尊贵圣者，五眼目，向诸天神
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed Mother / Lady Bhagavatī, noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), five + eye, to all a god
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.2258 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 1 句）

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切如来·一切·怖畏·诸离！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all Tathagatas, all, fear, of all lost!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.2258 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 2 句）

verses.iast: tadyathā — oṃ maṇidhari vajriṇi mahāpratisare rakṣa rakṣa māṃ sarvasattvāṃś ca svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！持摩尼宝珠（如意离垢宝）尊，具金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障）尊，大随求佛母（随愿即得大明王母）尊，祈请再三拥护、守护于我，诸一切众生、普皆有情以及圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! O bearer of Maṇi jewel, luminous gem, O bearer of Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, O Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess / in Mahāpratisarā, Great Wish-Fulfilling Amulet Goddess, evermore protect, guard and shelter me, all sentient beings and Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.2258 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 3 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！孔雀措施尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! peacock or hen + O step, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.2258 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 4 句）

verses.iast: oṃ mahāsāhasrapramardani sarvagraha-nakṣatra-vidhvaṃsani hūṃ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！大·因达罗·摧碎，一切曜执，星宿（二十八宿），摧灭尊，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! great + consisting of 1000 + O crushing, all + planet, constellation, lunar mansion, O ruining, spoiling, destroying, violating, Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.2258 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 5 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！具足大冷尊，一切、普皆遍满，灾横、恼害横祸，疗尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! great + O one endowed with sail, all, every, complete, calamity, affliction, sudden disaster, O heal, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.2258 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 6 句）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！贡高大方·守护掩蔽·具一样，一切罪业，闢理由，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! high-minded + protect shelter + O bearer of the same, all + evil, settle + O also means of purification, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自剑桥大学馆藏贝叶经 MS Or.2258 (12th–18th century) 外交转写（第 7 句）

verses.meaningZh: 如是（结句印定），吉祥、圣德威光，五眼目，大明妃，陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义），三磨钵耽
verses.meaningEn: Thus, so it is stated, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, five + eye, great + wise consort, Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell, finished, complete, perfect

prajñāpāramitāhṛdayasūtram | saṃkṣiptamātṛkā
namaḥ sarvajñāya
evaṃ mayā śrutam | ekasmin samaye bhagavān rājagṛhe viharati sma gṛdhrakūṭe parvate mahatā bhikṣusaṃghena sārdhaṃ mahatā ca bodhisattvasaṃghena | tena khalu samayena bhagavān gambhīrāvasaṃbodhaṃ nāma samādhiṃ samāpannaḥ
āryāvalokiteśvarabodhisattvo gambhīrāyāṃ prajñāpāramitāyāṃ caryāṃ caramāṇo vyavalokayati sma | pañca skandhāḥ, tāṃś ca svabhāvaśūnyān paśyati sma
athāyuṣmān śāriputro buddhānubhāvena āryāvalokiteśvaraṃ bodhisattvam etad avocat

iha śāriputra rūpaṃ śūnyatā, śūnyataiva rūpam
evam eva vedanāsaṃjñāsaṃskāravijñānāni
ihaṃ śāriputra sarvadharmāḥ śūnyatālakṣaṇā anutpannā aniruddhā amalā na vimalā nonā na paripūrṇāḥ
na vidyā nāvidyā na vidyākṣayo nāvidyākṣayo yāvanna jarāmaraṇaṃ na jarāmaraṇakṣayo na duḥkhasamudayanirodhamārgā na jñānaṃ na prāptitvam
bodhisattvasya(ś ca?) prajñāpāramitām āśritya viharati cittāvaraṇaḥ

atha khalu bhagavān tasmāt samādher vyutthāya āryāvalokiteśvarasya bodhisattvasya sādhukāram adāt - sādhu sādhu kulaputra

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §3】Chi: Dharmacandra 法月 (738CE) T.252 849a5 - 849b19：(7)如是我聞。一時佛在王舍大城靈鷲山中。與(8)大比丘衆滿百千人。菩薩摩訶薩七萬七千(9)人倶。其名曰觀世音菩薩。文殊師利菩薩。彌(10)勒菩薩等。以爲上首。皆得三昧總持。 | 藏本 (Tib: Vimalamitra and Rin chen sde, Kg 21, shes phyin sna tshogs, ka 144b6 - 146a2-3)：’di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na | bcom ldan ’das rgyal po’i khab na bya rgod phung po’i ri la | dge slong gi dge ’dun chen po dang | byang chub sems dpa’i dge ’dun chen po dang thabs cig (145a1) tu bzhugs te | de’i tshe bcom ldan ’das zab mo snang ba zhes bya ba’i chos kyi rnam grangs kyi ting nge ’dzin la mos par zhugs so ||
verses.meaningEn: Eng: Conze (1973) 140 -: Thus have I heard at one time. The Lord dwelled at Rājagṛha, on the Vulture Peak, together with a large gathering of both monks and Bodhisattvas. At that time the Lord, after he had taught the discourse on dharma called «deep splendour», had entered into concentration.

verses.meaningEn: Eng: Beal (1865) 25 -: Avalokiteśwara (The Devatā of the Sūtra). When the Prajnā Pāramitā has been fully practised, then clearly behold that the five skandhas are all empty, vain, and unreal. So it is we escape the possibility of sorrow or obstruction.
verses.classicalTranslitZh: (10)觀世音菩薩。行深般若波羅蜜時。照見五陰(11)空。度一切苦厄。

verses.meaningEn: Eng: Beal (1865) 25 -: So there will be no such thing as ignorance (avdiyā), nor yet freedom from ignorance, and therefore these can be none of its consequences (viz., the twelve nidānas. Colebrooke p.255); and therefore no such thing as decay or death (jarā or maraṅa), nor yet freedom from decay and death. So neither can there be a method (or way) for destroying the concourse of sorrows. No such thing as wisdom, and no such thing as attaining (happiness or rest), as there will not be ought that can be attained.
verses.classicalTranslitZh: (19)無無明亦無無明盡。乃至無老死無老死盡。(20)無苦集滅道。無智亦無得。以無所得故。

verses.meaningEn: Eng: Beal (1865) 25 -: The Bodhisatwa resting on this Prajnā Pāramitā, no sorrow of obstruction can then affect his heart, for there will be no (28) such thing as sorrow of obstruction.
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 菩薩(21)依般若波羅蜜故。心無罣礙。

verses.iast: tasmāj jñātavyaḥ prajñāpāramitāmahāmantro mahāvidyāmantro 'nuttaramantro 'samasamamantraḥ sarvaduḥkhapraśamanaḥ satyam amithyatvāt
verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §12】Chi: Kumārajīva 鳩摩羅什 (402-412CE) T.250 847c8 - 847c29：故知般若波羅蜜是大明呪。無上明呪。(25)無等等明呪。能除一切苦眞實不虚故説般 | 藏本 (Tib: Dunhuang (8-9th century) 1a1-2 - 1a16)：(13)de bas nas shes rab gyi pha rol phyin pa chen po ’i sngag || bla na myed pa’i sngag mnyam ba dang myï mnyam ba’ï sngags | sdug sngal thams cad | (14)rab tu zhi ba’i sngags | bden te myï brdzun pas na |
verses.meaningEn: Eng: Beal (1865) 25 -: Therefore know that this Prajnā Pāramitā is the the Great Spiritual Dhāraṇī,–it is the Great Light-giving Dhāraṇī. This is the unsurpassed Dhāraṇī. This is the unequalled Dhāraṇī, able to destroy all sorrows. True and real, (i.e., full of meaning), not vain (i.e., unmeaning).
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 故知般若波羅蜜是大明呪。無上明呪。(25)無等等明呪。能除一切苦眞實不虚故説般

Tārānamaskāraikaviṃśatistotra
namas tārāyai
namastāre ture vīre kṣaṇadyutinibhekṣaṇe | trailokyanāthavaktrābja- vikasatkamalodbhave
namaḥ śataśaraccandra- saṃpūrṇapaṭalānane | tārāsahasranikara- prahasatkiraṇojjvale
namaḥ kanakanīlābja- pāṇipadmavibhūṣite | dānavīryatapaḥśānti- titikṣādhyānagocare
namas tathāgatoṣṇīṣa- vijayānantacāriṇi | 'śeṣapāramitāprāpta- jinaputraniṣevite
namas tutrārehuṃkāra- pūritāśādigantare | saptalokakramākrānti niśeṣākarṣaṇakṣame
namaḥ śakrānalabrahma- marudviśveśvarārcite | bhūtavetālagandharva- gaṇayakṣapuraskṛte
namas traḍ iti phaṭkāra- parayantrapramardini | pratyālīḍhapadanyāse śikhijvālākulojjvale
namas ture mahāghore mālavīravināśini | bhṛkuṭīkṛtavaktrābja- sarvaśatruniṣūdini
namas triratnamudrāṅka- hṛdyāṅgulivibhūṣite | bhūṣitāśeṣadikcakra- nikarasvakarākule
namaḥ pramuditāśeṣa- muktākṣīraprasāriṇi | hasatprahasattutāre māralokavaśaṃkari
namaḥ samantabhūpāla- paṭalākarṣaṇakṣame | caladbhṛkuṭihūṃkāra- sarvāpadavimocini
namaḥ śikhaṇḍakhaṇḍendu- mukuṭābharaṇojjvale | amitābhajaṭābhāra- bhāsvārakiraṇadhruve
namaḥ kalpāntahutabhug- jvālāmālāntarasthite | ālīḍhamuditābaddhar ipucakravināśini
namaḥ karatalāghāta- caraṇāhatabhūtale | bhṛkuṭīkṛtahuṃkāra- saptapātālabhedini
namaḥ śive śubhe śānte śāntanirvāṇagocare | svāhāpraṇavasaṃyukte mahāpātakanāśini
namaḥ pramuditābaddhar ipugātraprabhedini | daśākṣarapadanyāsa- vidyāhuṃkāradīpite
namas ture pādaghāte huṃkārabījite | merumaṇḍārakailāsa- bhuvanatrayacāliṇi
namaḥ surasarākāra- hariṇāṅkakarasthite | tāradviruktaphaṭkāra aśeṣaviṣanāśini
namaḥ suragaṇayakṣa- kiṃnarasevite | ābaddhamuditābhoga- kaliduḥsvapnanāśini
namaś candrārkasampūrṇa- nayanadyutibhāsvare | haradviruktatuttāre- viṣamajvaranāśini
namaḥ tritatāvinyāsa- śivaśaktisamanvite | grahavetālayakṣoṣma- nāśini pravare ture
mantramūlam idaṃ stotraṃ namaskāraikaviṃśakaṃ | yaḥ paṭhet prasannadhīmān devyāṃ bhaktisamanvitaḥ
sāyaṃ vā prātarutthāya smaret sarvābhayapradam | sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvadurgatināśanam
abhiṣikto bhavet tūrṇaṃ saptabhir jinakoṭibhiḥ | asmin mahattvam āpadya so 'nte bauddhapadaṃ vrajet
viṣaṃ tasya mahāghoraṃ sthāvaraṃ vātha jaṅgamam | smaraṇāt pralayaṃ yāti khāditaṃ pītam eva vā
grahajvaraviṣārtīnāṃ paramātiviṣanāśānām | anyeṣāṃ caiva sattvānāṃ dvitrisaptābhivārttinām
putrakāmo labhet putraṃ ghanakāmo labhed dhanam | sarvakāmānavāpnoti na vighnaiḥ pratihanyate
iti śrīsamyaksaṃbuddhavairocanabhāṣitaṃ bhagavatyāryatārādevyā namaskāraikaviṃśatināmāṣṭottaraśatakaṃ buddhabhāṣitaṃ parisamāptam

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §1】Chi: T.1108A：聖救度佛母二十一種禮讚經 翰林學士承旨中奉大夫安藏奉 詔譯 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：rgya gar skad du | na maḥtā rā e ka biṃ śa ti sto tra gu ṇa hi ta sā ka | bod skad du | sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal nyi śu rtsa gcig gis bstod pa phan yon daṅ bcas pa |
verses.meaningEn: Ferrying across, bowing

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §2】Chi: T.1108A：唵敬禮多哩速疾勇，咄多哩者除怖畏，咄哩能授諸勝義，具莎訶字我讚禮！ | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo ||
verses.meaningEn: Homage to ferrying across (vocative invocation)!
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 唵敬禮多哩速疾勇，咄多哩者除怖畏，咄哩能授諸勝義，具莎訶字我讚禮！

verses.meaningEn: Homage + O a star, O quick, eager, prompt, willing / in quick, eager, prompt, willing, O heroic, valiant, fearless hero / in heroic, valiant, fearless hero, birth under favorable conditions + splendour + like + O look Immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from conditioned marks, of a man + equally + lotus blossom + O origin
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮救度速勇母 目如剎那電光照 三世界尊蓮華面 從妙華中現端嚴

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §4】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮百秋朗月母 普遍圓滿無垢面 如千星宿俱時聚 殊勝威光超於彼 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal ston ka'i zla ba kun du | | gaṅ ba brgya ni brtsegs pa'i źal ma | | skar ma stoṅ phrag tshogs pa rnams kyis | | rab tu phye ba'i 'od rab 'bar ma | |(2)
verses.meaningEn: Homage to primordial tranquil peace & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust, full, cover, O mouth! Tārā + thousand + heap, blazing (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮百秋朗月母 普遍圓滿無垢面 如千星宿俱時聚 殊勝威光超於彼

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §5】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮紫磨金色母 妙蓮華手勝莊嚴 施精勤行柔善靜 忍辱禪定性無境 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal gser sṅo chu nas skyes kyi | | pad+mas phyag ni rnam par brgyan ma | | sbyin pa brtson 'grus dka' thub źi ba | | bzod pa bsam gtan spyod yul ñid ma | |(3)
verses.meaningEn: Homage to gold, blue lotus, a lotus hand, O magnificence! Generosity & self-mastery & beyond nominal designation & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), endurance + meditative concentration + O scope
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮紫磨金色母 妙蓮華手勝莊嚴 施精勤行柔善靜 忍辱禪定性無境

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §6】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮如來頂髻母 最勝能滿無邊行 得到彼岸盡無餘 勝勢佛子極所愛 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal de bźin gśegs pa'i gtsug tor | | mtha' yas rnam par rgyal bar spyod ma | | ma lus pha rol phyin pa thob pa'i | | rgyal ba'i sras kyis śin tu bsten ma | |(4)
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Tathāgata, Uṣṇīṣa, supreme victory! triumph!, boundless, O bearer of prison! No rest or remainder + Pāramitā + filled with astonishment and wonder, son of a Buddha + O inhabited
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮如來頂髻母 最勝能滿無邊行 得到彼岸盡無餘 勝勢佛子極所愛

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §7】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮怛囉吽字母 聲愛方所滿虛空 運足遍履七世界 悉能鉤召攝無餘 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal tuttā ra hūṃ yi ge | | 'dod daṅ phyogs daṅ nam mkha' gaṅ ma | | 'jig rten bdun po źabs kyis mnan te | | lus pa med par 'gugs par nus ma | |(5)
verses.meaningEn: Homage to immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy, fulfilling (vocative invocation)! Seven + world + stride + ascending, in + offspring + the same as + O enduring
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮怛囉吽字母 聲愛方所滿虛空 運足遍履七世界 悉能鉤召攝無餘
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A

verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮釋梵火天母 風神自在眾俱集 部多起屍尋香等 諸藥叉眾作稱歎
