verses.diplomaticOriginal: phyag 'tshal brgya byin me lha tshaṅs pa | | rluṅ lha sna tshogs dbaṅ phyug mchod ma | | 'byuṅ po ro laṅs dri za rnams daṅ | | gnod sbyin tshogs kyis mdun nas bstod ma | |(6)

verses.iast: namas traḍ iti phaṭkāra- parayantrapramardini | pratyālīḍhapadanyāse śikhijvālākulojjvale
verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §9】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮特囉胝發母 於他加行極摧壞 展左踡右作足踏 頂髻熾盛極明耀 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal traṭ ces bya daṅ phaṭ kyis | | pha rol 'khrul 'khor rab tu 'joms ma | | g.yas bskum g.yon brkyaṅ źabs kyis mnan te | | me 'bar 'khrugs pa śin tu 'bar ma | |(7)
verses.meaningEn: Homage to pacifying conflict & turmoil — primordial non-arising, thus, so it is stated, shatter obstacles and ignorance!, hymn of praise, someone else, suppose now, become perplexed or ashamed, this, O day! Left foot forward + O putting down the feet, blazing (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮特囉胝發母 於他加行極摧壞 展左踡右作足踏 頂髻熾盛極明耀
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A
verses.diplomaticOriginal: phyag 'tshal traṭ ces bya daṅ phaṭ kyis | | pha rol 'khrul 'khor rab tu 'joms ma | | g.yas bskum g.yon brkyaṅ źabs kyis mnan te | | me 'bar 'khrugs pa śin tu 'bar ma | |(7)

verses.iast: namas ture mahāghore mālavīravināśini | bhṛkuṭīkṛtavaktrābja- sarvaśatruniṣūdini
verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §10】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮都哩大緊母 勇猛能摧怨魔類 於蓮華面作顰眉 摧壞一切冤家眾 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal tu re 'jigs pa chen mo | | bdud kyi dpa' bo rnam par 'joms ma | | chu skyes źal ni khro gñer ldan mdzad | | dgra bo thams cad ma lus gsod ma | |(8)
verses.meaningEn: Homage to O quick, eager, prompt, willing / in quick, eager, prompt, willing, O most horrible / in most horrible, garland, heroic, without, O aged! Blessedness transcending existence & freedom from karmic agency & cutting rigid pride, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮都哩大緊母 勇猛能摧怨魔類 於蓮華面作顰眉 摧壞一切冤家眾
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A
verses.diplomaticOriginal: phyag 'tshal tu re 'jigs pa chen mo | | bdud kyi dpa' bo rnam par 'joms ma | | chu skyes źal ni khro gñer ldan mdzad | | dgra bo thams cad ma lus gsod ma | |(8)

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §11】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮三寶嚴印母 手指當心威嚴相 嚴飾方輪盡無餘 自身熾盛光聚種 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal dkon mchog gsum mtshon phyag rgya'i | | sor mos thugs kar rnam par brgyan ma | | ma lus phyogs kyi 'khor los brgyan pa'i | | raṅ gi 'od kyi tshogs rnams 'khrug ma | |(9)
verses.meaningEn: Homage to three, jewel, stamped, being in the heart, finger or toe, O magnificence! Be busy for + going + no rest or remainder + circuit of the quarters of the compass, heap + self + O confounded
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮三寶嚴印母 手指當心威嚴相 嚴飾方輪盡無餘 自身熾盛光聚種
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A
verses.diplomaticOriginal: phyag 'tshal dkon mchog gsum mtshon phyag rgya'i | | sor mos thugs kar rnam par brgyan ma | | ma lus phyogs kyi 'khor los brgyan pa'i | | raṅ gi 'od kyi tshogs rnams 'khrug ma | |(9)

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §12】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮威德歡悅母 寶冠珠鬘眾光飾 最極喜笑覩怛哩 鎮世間魔作攝伏 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal rab tu dga' ba brjid pa'i | | dbu rgyan 'od kyi phreṅ ba spel ma | | bźad pa rab bźad tu ttā ra yis | | bdud daṅ 'jig rten dbaṅ du mdzad ma | |(10)
verses.meaningEn: Homage to remaining, pearl, milk, O bearer of stretching! Ferrying across (vocative invocation), Māra + mostly ) look + down + O causing welfare or happiness
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮威德歡悅母 寶冠珠鬘眾光飾 最極喜笑覩怛哩 鎮世間魔作攝伏
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A
verses.diplomaticOriginal: phyag 'tshal rab tu dga' ba brjid pa'i | | dbu rgyan 'od kyi phreṅ ba spel ma | | bźad pa rab bźad tu ttā ra yis | | bdud daṅ 'jig rten dbaṅ du mdzad ma | |(10)

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §13】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮守護眾地母 亦能鉤召諸神眾 搖顰眉面吽聲字 一切衰敗令度脫 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal sa gźi skyoṅ ba'i tshogs rnams | | thams cad 'gugs par nus ma ñid ma | | khro gñer g.yo ba'i yi ge hūṃ gis | | phoṅs pa thams cad rnam par sgrol ma | |(11)
verses.meaningEn: Homage to universal, earth-protector, spawn, cover, the same as, O enduring! Stirring, liberating (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮守護眾地母 亦能鉤召諸神眾 搖顰眉面吽聲字 一切衰敗令度脫
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A
verses.diplomaticOriginal: phyag 'tshal sa gźi skyoṅ ba'i tshogs rnams | | thams cad 'gugs par nus ma ñid ma | | khro gñer g.yo ba'i yi ge hūṃ gis | | phoṅs pa thams cad rnam par sgrol ma | |(11)

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §14】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮頂冠月相母 冠中現勝妙嚴光 阿彌陀佛髻中現 常放眾妙寶光明 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal zla ba'i rtse mos dbu brgyan | | brgyan pa thams cad śin tu 'bar ma | | ral pa'i khrod na 'od dpag med las | | rtag par śin tu 'od ni mdzad ma | |(12)
verses.meaningEn: Homage to primordial tranquil peace & space-like boundlessness & conflict-free peace (imperative seal), diadem, ornament, O flaming! Selfless great loving-kindness & immutable Suchness & blessedness transcending existence, be bright + sound + a pig + O steady
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮頂冠月相母 冠中現勝妙嚴光 阿彌陀佛髻中現 常放眾妙寶光明
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A
verses.diplomaticOriginal: phyag 'tshal zla ba'i rtse mos dbu brgyan | | brgyan pa thams cad śin tu 'bar ma | | ral pa'i khrod na 'od dpag med las | | rtag par śin tu 'od ni mdzad ma | |(12)

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §15】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮如盡劫火母 安住熾盛頂髻中 普遍喜悅半趺坐 能摧滅壞惡冤輪 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal bskal pa tha ma'i me ltar | | 'bar ba'i phreṅ ba'i dbus na gnas ma | | g.yas brkyaṅ g.yon bskum kun nas bskor dgas | | dgra yi dpuṅ ni rnam par 'joms ma | |(13)
verses.meaningEn: Homage to sacred offering, blaze, garland, O being within! To expound + bound, destroying obstacles (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮如盡劫火母 安住熾盛頂髻中 普遍喜悅半趺坐 能摧滅壞惡冤輪
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A
verses.diplomaticOriginal: phyag 'tshal bskal pa tha ma'i me ltar | | 'bar ba'i phreṅ ba'i dbus na gnas ma | | g.yas brkyaṅ g.yon bskum kun nas bskor dgas | | dgra yi dpuṅ ni rnam par 'joms ma | |(13)

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §16】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮手按大地母 以足踐蹋作鎮壓 現顰眉面作吽聲 能破七險鎮降伏 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal sa gźi'i ṅos la phyag gi | | mthil gyis bsnun ciṅ źabs kyis brduṅ ma | | khro gñer can mdzad yi ge hūṃ gis | | rim pa bdun po rnams ni 'gems ma | |(14)
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the palm of the hand, malicious feeling, residence, beaten, O the surface of the earth! Bhṛkuṭī + done + the sound hum, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & ultimate truth & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮手按大地母 以足踐蹋作鎮壓 現顰眉面作吽聲 能破七險鎮降伏
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A
verses.diplomaticOriginal: phyag 'tshal sa gźi'i ṅos la phyag gi | | mthil gyis bsnun ciṅ źabs kyis brduṅ ma | | khro gñer can mdzad yi ge hūṃ gis | | rim pa bdun po rnams ni 'gems ma | |(14)

verses.iast: namaḥ śive śubhe śānte śāntanirvāṇagocare | svāhāpraṇavasaṃyukte mahāpātakanāśini
verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §17】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮安隱柔善母 涅槃寂滅最樂境 莎訶命種以相應 善能消滅大災禍 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal bde ma dge ma źi ma | | mya ṅan 'das źi spyod yul ñid ma | | svā hā oṃ daṅ yaṅ dag ldan pas | | sdig pa chen po 'joms pa ñid ma | |(15)
verses.meaningEn: Homage to O kind, friendly, mild, gracious, lovely, auspicious, fortunate, to, O peaceful, calm, tranquil / in peaceful, calm, tranquil, peaceful, Nirvāṇa, O scope! Hail! may auspicious accomplishment be sealed + the sacred syllable Om + saṃ + O yoked, long flight + be glad + O aged
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮安隱柔善母 涅槃寂滅最樂境 莎訶命種以相應 善能消滅大災禍
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A
verses.diplomaticOriginal: phyag 'tshal bde ma dge ma źi ma | | mya ṅan 'das źi spyod yul ñid ma | | svā hā oṃ daṅ yaṅ dag ldan pas | | sdig pa chen po 'joms pa ñid ma | |(15)

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §18】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮普遍極喜母 諸怨支體令脫離 十字呪句妙嚴布 明呪吽聲常朗耀 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal kun nas bskor rab dga' ba'i | | dgra yi lus ni rab tu 'gems ma | | yi ge bcu pa'i ṅag ni bkod pa'i | | rig pa hūṃ las sgron ma ñid ma | |(16)
verses.meaningEn: Homage to strap, ultimate truth & awakened spiritual movement & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation)! Fringe of a garment + a saw + putting down the feet, Vidyā + the sound hum + ) + O going
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮普遍極喜母 諸怨支體令脫離 十字呪句妙嚴布 明呪吽聲常朗耀
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A
verses.diplomaticOriginal: phyag 'tshal kun nas bskor rab dga' ba'i | | dgra yi lus ni rab tu 'gems ma | | yi ge bcu pa'i ṅag ni bkod pa'i | | rig pa hūṃ las sgron ma ñid ma | |(16)

verses.iast: namas ture pādaghāte huṃkārabījite | merumaṇḍārakailāsa- bhuvanatrayacāliṇi
verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §19】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮都哩巴帝母 足躡相勢吽字種 彌嚕曼陀結辣薩 於此三處能搖動 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal tu re'i źabs ni brdabs pas | | hūṃ gi rnam pa'i sa bon ñid ma | | ri rab man dā ra daṅ 'bigs byed | | 'jig rten gsum rnams g.yo ba ñid ma | |(17)
verses.meaningEn: Homage to O quick, eager, prompt, willing / in quick, eager, prompt, willing, foot, O slaying, causal emptiness & spiritual joy & freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation)! Mount Meru + cream + the hither + of a mountain, blessedness transcending existence & supreme ineffable speech & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮都哩巴帝母 足躡相勢吽字種 彌嚕曼陀結辣薩 於此三處能搖動
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A
verses.diplomaticOriginal: phyag 'tshal tu re'i źabs ni brdabs pas | | hūṃ gi rnam pa'i sa bon ñid ma | | ri rab man dā ra daṅ 'bigs byed | | 'jig rten gsum rnams g.yo ba ñid ma | |(17)

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §20】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮薩囉天海母 手中執住神獸像 誦二怛囉作發聲 能滅諸毒盡無餘 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal lha yi mtsho yi rnam pa'i | | ri dags rtags can phyag na bsnams ma | | tā ra gñis brjod phaṭ kyi yi ges | | dug rnams ma lus par ni sel ma | |(18)
verses.meaningEn: Homage to well-flavoured, disposition, fallow, hook, palm, O standing! A star + twice said + shatter obstacles and ignorance! + hymn of praise, no rest or remainder + stir + certainly + O aged
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮薩囉天海母 手中執住神獸像 誦二怛囉作發聲 能滅諸毒盡無餘
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A
verses.diplomaticOriginal: phyag 'tshal lha yi mtsho yi rnam pa'i | | ri dags rtags can phyag na bsnams ma | | tā ra gñis brjod phaṭ kyi yi ges | | dug rnams ma lus par ni sel ma | |(18)

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §21】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮諸天集會母 天緊那羅所依愛 威德歡悅若堅鎧 滅除鬪諍及惡夢 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal lha yi tshogs rnams rgyal po | | lha daṅ mi'am ci yis bsten ma | | kun nas go cha dga' ba'i brjid kyis | | rtsod daṅ rmi lam ṅan pa sel ma | |(19)
verses.meaningEn: Homage to sgl, Yakṣa, a class of mythical beings, stay by, O going! Bound + joy + winding, destroying obstacles (vocative invocation)
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮諸天集會母 天緊那羅所依愛 威德歡悅若堅鎧 滅除鬪諍及惡夢
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A
verses.diplomaticOriginal: phyag 'tshal lha yi tshogs rnams rgyal po | | lha daṅ mi'am ci yis bsten ma | | kun nas go cha dga' ba'i brjid kyis | | rtsod daṅ rmi lam ṅan pa sel ma | |(19)

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §22】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮日月廣圓母 目覩猶勝普光照 誦二喝囉咄怛哩 善除惡毒瘟熱病 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal ñi ma zla ba rgyas pa'i | | spyan gñis po la 'od rab gsal ma | | ha ra gñis brjod tu ttā ra yis | | śin tu drag po'i rims ni sel ma | |(20)
verses.meaningEn: Bowing, moon + arka flowers + along with + Purna, a man's name + splendour + be bright + O vowel Ferrying across (vocative invocation), perilous + be hot or feverish + certainly + O aged
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮日月廣圓母 目覩猶勝普光照 誦二喝囉咄怛哩 善除惡毒瘟熱病
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A
verses.diplomaticOriginal: phyag 'tshal ñi ma zla ba rgyas pa'i | | spyan gñis po la 'od rab gsal ma | | ha ra gñis brjod tu ttā ra yis | | śin tu drag po'i rims ni sel ma | |(20)

verses.iast: namaḥ tritatāvinyāsa- śivaśaktisamanvite | grahavetālayakṣoṣma- nāśini pravare ture
verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §23】Chi: T.1108A：敬禮具三真實母 善靜威力皆具足 藥叉執魅尾怛辣 都哩最極除災禍 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：phyag 'tshal de ñid gsum rnams bkod pa'i | | źi ba'i mthu daṅ yaṅ dag ldan ma | | gdon daṅ ro laṅs gnod sbyin tshogs rnams | | 'joms pa tu re rab mchog ñid ma | |(21)
verses.meaningEn: Homage to three, father, pain, threshold, kind, ability, O accompanied by! Planet + a kind of goblins or vampires + Yakṣa + heat, destroying obstacles (vocative invocation), O cover, upper garment / in cover, upper garment, O quick, eager, prompt, willing / in quick, eager, prompt, willing
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 敬禮具三真實母 善靜威力皆具足 藥叉執魅尾怛辣 都哩最極除災禍
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A
verses.diplomaticOriginal: phyag 'tshal de ñid gsum rnams bkod pa'i | | źi ba'i mthu daṅ yaṅ dag ldan ma | | gdon daṅ ro laṅs gnod sbyin tshogs rnams | | 'joms pa tu re rab mchog ñid ma | |(21)

verses.iast: mantramūlam idaṃ stotraṃ namaskāraikaviṃśakaṃ | yaḥ paṭhet prasannadhīmān devyāṃ bhaktisamanvitaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §24】Chi: T.1108A：若有智者勤精進 至心誦此二十一 救度尊處誠信禮 是故讚嘆根本呪 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：rtsa ba'i sṅags kyis bstod pa 'di daṅ | | phyag 'tshal ba ni ñi śu rtsa gcig | | lha mo la gus yaṅ dag ldan pa'i | | blo ldan gaṅ gis rab tu brjod pas | |(22)
verses.meaningEn: Mantra + to, this, here, praise, hymn, bowing Whoever, he who, ultimate truth & beyond conceptual fabrication & immutable Suchness, believing in, generosity & self-mastery & supreme ineffable speech & supreme vehicle of awakening, distribution + accompanied by
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 若有智者勤精進 至心誦此二十一 救度尊處誠信禮 是故讚嘆根本呪
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A
verses.diplomaticOriginal: rtsa ba'i sṅags kyis bstod pa 'di daṅ | | phyag 'tshal ba ni ñi śu rtsa gcig | | lha mo la gus yaṅ dag ldan pa'i | | blo ldan gaṅ gis rab tu brjod pas | |(22)

verses.iast: sāyaṃ vā prātarutthāya smaret sarvābhayapradam | sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvadurgatināśanam
verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §25】Chi: T.1108A：每晨旦起夕時禮 憶念施諸勝無畏 一切罪業盡消除 悉能超越諸惡趣 | 藏本 (Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca)：srod daṅ tho raṅs laṅs par byas nas | | dran pas mi 'jigs thams cad rab ster | | sdig pa thams cad rab tu źi ba | | ṅan 'gro thams cad 'joms pa ñid do | (23)
verses.meaningEn: Evening, or, early, recalling, all + giving safety All + evil + heal, all + evil destiny + destroying
verses.classicalTranslitZh: 每晨旦起夕時禮 憶念施諸勝無畏 一切罪業盡消除 悉能超越諸惡趣
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (3 本)：San: Wayman (1959) · Tib: Kg, rgyud, ca · Chi: T.1108A

Nirvikalpapraveśadhāraṇī
evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān rājagṛhe virahati sma
tatra khalu bhagavā (n anekaśatasahasrayā parṣadā parivṛtaḥ puraskṛto) dharmaṃ deśayati sma | yad uta dharmāṇāṃ nirvikalpatām ārabhya
atha tasyām eva parṣady avikalpaprabhāso nāma bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ
bhagavāṃs teṣām etad avocat
tasya tāni kramaśo vikalpanimittāni parivarjayataḥ
tasya tāni pari (varjayataḥ tadanyāni tattvanirūpaṇavikalpanimittāni samudācaranty āmukhībhavanty ābhāsagamanayogena
tasya tāny api parivarjayato 'parāṇi prāptinirūpaṇavikalpanimittāni samudācaranty āmukhībhavanty ābhāsagamanayogena
evaṃ sa bodhisattvo mahāsattva etāni sarvākāravikalpanimittāny amanasikārataḥ parivarjayan suprayukto bhavaty avikalpena
kena kāraṇena kulaputrā avikalpadhātur avikalpa ity ucyate
katarat tad avikalpaṃ
tad yathā kulaputrā ekaghanasāramayasya pāṣāṇaparvatasyādhastān mahānānāratnaparipūrṇanidhiḥ syād ( | ) bhāsurāṇāṃ vicitrāṇāṃ mahācintāmaṇiratnānāṃ | yad uta rūpyaratnasya vā | suvarṇaratnasya vā | (aśmagarbhanānāratnasya vā
tathā hi kulaputrā iyam upamā kṛtā yāvad evāsyārthasya vijñaptaye
kathaṃ punaḥ kulaputrā bodhisattvo mahāsattva etāni yathānirdiṣṭāni vikalpanimittāni vyupaparīkṣamāṇo 'vikalpadhātuṃ praviśati
iha kulaputrāḥ bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ sarvākārajñatānirūpaṇavikalpanimitta āmukhībhūta evaṃ vyupaparīkṣate
asya kulaputrā dharmaparyāyasya udgrahaṇalekhanavācanād bahutaraṃ puṇyaṃ nanv eva gaṅgānadīvālukopamātmabhāvaparityāgasya nanv eva gaṃgānadīvālukopamalokādhātuparipūrṇaratnadānasya nanv eva gaṃgānadīvālukopamalpkadhātuparipūrṇatathāgatabiṃbakārāpaṇapuṇyaskandhasyeti
atha khalu bhagavāṃs tasyāṃ velāyāṃ ime gāthe abhāṣata
idam avocad bahgavān āttamanā avikalpaprabhāsaś ca bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ sā ca sarvāvatī parṣat sadevamānuṣāsuragandharvaś ca loko bhagavato bhāṣitam abhyanandann iti

verses.iast: oṃ namaḥ sarvajñāya | namo bhagavate bhaiṣajyaguruvaiḍūryaprabharājāya tathāgatāya
verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §1】T. 449 404c13-401a26 - 401b20-24：(401a04)藥師如來本願功德經序 (401a05)藥師如來本願經者，致福消災之要法也；曼殊以慈悲之力請說尊號，如來以利物之心盛陳功業；十二大願彰因行之弘遠，七寶莊嚴顯果德之純淨；憶念稱名則眾苦咸脫，祈請供養則諸願皆滿；至於病士求救應死更生，王者攘災轉禍為福；信是消百怪之神符，除九橫之妙術矣。(401a11)昔宋孝武之世，鹿野寺沙門慧簡已曾譯出在世流行，但以梵宋不融、文辭雜糅，致令轉讀之輩多生疑惑。矩早學梵書恒披葉典，思遇此經驗其紕謬；開皇十七年初獲一本，猶恐脫誤未敢即翻，至大業十一年復得二本，更相讎比方為揩定，遂與三藏法師達磨笈多，并大隋翻經沙門法行明則、長順海馭等，於東都洛水南上林園翻經舘重譯此本。深鑑前非方懲後失，故一言出口必三覆乃書，傳度幽旨差無大過；其年十二月八日翻勘方了，仍為一卷。(401a21)所願此經深義人人共解，彼佛名號處處遍聞，十二夜叉念佛恩而護國，七千眷屬承經力以利民，帝祚遐永，群生安樂，式貽來世序云爾。 佛說藥師如來本願經 (401a26)新翻藥師經，大業十二年十二月八日，沙門慧矩等六人，於東都洛水南上林園譯出。此本最定，諸讀誦者願莫更疑，得罪不輕。 | 藏本 (Kj D 274a2 - 274b2-4)：(2)saṅs rgyas daṅ byaṅ chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo ||
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to/for omniscient Homage to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, Bhaiṣajyaguru, lapis lazuli, light, to, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One!

dhāraṇīparivartaḥ
atha khalu bhaiṣajyarājo bodhisattvo mahāsattva utthāyāsanād ekāṃsam uttarāsaṅgaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇaṃ jānumaṇḍalaṃ pṛthivyāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya yena bhagavāṃs tenāñjaliṃ praṇamya bhagavantam etad avocat kiyad bhagavan sa kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā puṇyaṃ prasavet, ya imaṃ saddharmapuṇḍarīkaṃ dharmaparyāyaṃ dhārayet, kāyagataṃ vā pustakagataṃ vā kṛtvā?
atha khalu bhaiṣajyarājo bodhisattvo mahāsattvas tasyāṃ velāyāṃ bhagavantam etad avocat
anye manye mane mamane citte carite same samitā viśānte mukte muktatame same aviṣame samasame jaye kṣaye akṣaye akṣiṇe śānte samite dhāraṇi ālokabhāṣe pratyavekṣaṇi nidhiru abhyantaraniviṣṭe abhyantarapāriśuddhimutkule araḍe paraḍe sukāṅkṣi asamasame buddhavilokite dharmaparīkṣite saṃghanirghoṣaṇi nirghoṇi bhayābhayaviśodhani mantre mantrākṣayate rute rutakauśalye akṣaye akṣayavanatāye vakkule valoḍra amanyanatāye svāhā
imāni bhagavan mantradhāraṇīpadāni dvāṣaṣṭibhir gaṅgānadīvālikāsamair buddhair bhagavadbhir bhāṣitāni
atha khalu bhagavān bhaiṣajyarājāya bodhisattvāya mahāsattvāya sādhukāramadāt sādhu sādhu bhaiṣajyarāja, sattvānām arthaḥ kṛtaḥ
atha khalu pradānaśūro bodhisattvo mahāsattvo bhagavantam etad avocat
atha khalu pradānaśūro bodhisattvo mahāsattvas tasyāṃ velāyām imāni dhāraṇīmantrapadāni bhāṣate sma
jvale mahājvale ukke tukke mukke aḍe aḍāvati nṛtye nṛtyāvati iṭṭini viṭṭini ciṭṭini nṛtyani nṛtyāvati svāhā
imāni bhagavan dhāraṇīpadāni gaṅgānadīvālikāsamais tathāgatair arhadbhiḥ samyaksaṃbuddhair bhāṣitāni, anumoditāni ca
atha khalu vaiśravaṇo mahārājo bhagavantam etad avocat
aṭṭe taṭṭe naṭṭe vanaṭṭe anaḍe nāḍi kunaḍi svāhā
ebhir bhagavan dhāraṇīpadaisteṣāṃ dharmabhāṇakānāṃ pudgalānāṃ rakṣāṃ karomi, yojanaśatāccāhaṃ teṣāṃ kulaputrāṇāṃ kuladuhitṛṇāṃ ca evaṃrūpāṇāṃ sūtrāntadhārakāṇāṃ rakṣā kṛtā bhaviṣyati, svastyayanaṃ kṛtaṃ bhaviṣyati
atha khalu virūḍhako mahārājo tasyām eva parṣadi saṃnipatito 'bhūt saṃniṣaṇṇaś ca kumbhāṇḍakoṭīnayutaśatasahasraiḥ parivṛtaḥ puraskṛtaḥ
agaṇe gaṇe gauri gandhāri caṇḍāli mātaṅgi pukkasi saṃkule vrūsali sisi svāhā
imāni tāni bhagavan dhāraṇīmantrapadāni, yāni dvācatvāriṃśadbhir buddhakoṭībhir bhāṣitāni
atha khalu lambā ca nāma rākṣasī vilambā ca nāma rākṣasī kūṭadantī ca nāma rākṣasī puṣpadantī ca nāma rākṣasī makuṭadantī ca nāma rākṣasī keśinī ca nāma rākṣasī acalā ca nāma rākṣasī mālādhārī ca nāma rākṣasī kuntī ca nāma rākṣasī sarvasattvojohārī ca nāma rākṣasī hārītī ca nāma rākṣasī saputraparivārā etāḥ sarvā rākṣasyo yena bhagavāṃstenopasaṃkrāntāḥ
atha khalu tāḥ sarvā rākṣasya ekasvareṇa samaṃ saṃgītyā bhagavata imāni dhāraṇīmantrapadāni prayacchanti sma
imaṃ śīrṣaṃ samāruhya mā kaścid drohī bhavatu dharmabhāṇakānāṃ yakṣo vā rākṣaso vā preto vā piśāco vā pūtano vā kṛtyo va vetālo vā kumbhāṇḍo vā stabdho vā omārako vā ostārako vā apasmārako vā yakṣakṛtyo vā amanuṣyakṛtyo vā manuṣyakṛtyo vā ekāhiko vā dvaitīyako vā traitīyako vā caturthako vā nityajvaro vā viṣamajvaro vā
atha khalu tā rākṣasya evasvareṇa samaṃ saṃgītyā bhagavantam ābhir gāthābhir adhyabhāṣanta
saptadhāsya sphuṭenmūrdhā arjakasyeva mañjarī | ya imaṃ mantra śrutvā vai atikrameddharmabhāṇakam
yā gatirmātṛghātīnāṃ pitṛghātīna yā gatiḥ | tāṃ gatiṃ pratigacchedyo dharmabhāṇakamatikramet
yā gatistilapīḍānāṃ tilakūṭānāṃ ca yā gatiḥ | tāṃ gatiṃ pratigacchedyo dharmabhāṇakamatikramet
yā gatistulakūṭānāṃ kāṃsyakūṭāna yā gatiḥ | tāṃ gatiṃ pratigacchedyo dharmabhāṇakamatikramet
evamuktvā tāḥ kuntipramukhā rākṣasyo bhagavantam etadūcuḥ - vayam api bhagavaṃsteṣām evaṃrūpāṇāṃ dharmabhāṇakānāṃ rakṣāṃ kariṣyāmaḥ, svastyayanaṃ daṇḍaparihāraṃ viṣadūṣaṇaṃ kariṣyāma iti
asmin khalu punar dhāraṇīparivarte nirdiśyamāne aṣṭāṣaṣṭīnāṃ prāṇisahasrāṇām anutpattikadharmakṣāntipratilābho 'bhūt
iti śrīsaddharmapuṇḍarīke dharmaparyāye dhāraṇīparivarto nāmaikaviṃśatimaḥ

verses.meaningEn: Kern (1884): With these spells, O Lord, I shall guard those preachers over an extent of a hundred yoganas. Thus will those young men or young ladies of good family, who keep this Sûtrânta, be guarded, be safe.
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (5 本)：Vaidya (1960) 233,1 - 235,1 · T.263, Dharmarakṣa 竺法護, 286 A.D., p. 63a6 · T.262, Kumārajīva 鳩摩羅什, 405 A.D., p. · 1100 A.D.? Kj mdo sde ja 16a7

verses.iast: atha khalu virūḍhako mahārājo tasyām eva parṣadi saṃnipatito 'bhūt saṃniṣaṇṇaś ca kumbhāṇḍakoṭīnayutaśatasahasraiḥ parivṛtaḥ puraskṛtaḥ

verses.meaningEn: Kern (1884): At that meeting was present Virûdhaka, another of the four rulers of the cardinal points, sitting surrounded and attended by hundred thousands of myriads of kotis of Kumbhândas.

verses.meaningEn: Kern (1884): These talismanic words, O Lord, have been pronounced by forty-two hundred thousand myriads of kotis of Buddhas.
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (5 本)：Vaidya (1960) 233,1 - 235,1 · T.263, Dharmarakṣa 竺法護, 286 A.D., p. 63a6 · T.262, Kumārajīva 鳩摩羅什, 405 A.D., p. · 1100 A.D.? Kj mdo sde ja 16a7

verses.meaningEn: Kern (1884): Thereupon the giantesses called Lambâ,Vilambâ, Kûtadantî, Pushpadantî, Makutadantî, Kesinî, Akalâ, Mâlâdharî, Kuntî, Sarvasattvogahârî, and Hârîtî, all with their children and suite went up to the place where the Lord was,

verses.iast: atha khalu tāḥ sarvā rākṣasya ekasvareṇa samaṃ saṃgītyā bhagavata imāni dhāraṇīmantrapadāni prayacchanti sma

verses.meaningEn: Kern (1884): And the giantesses all simultaneously and in a chorus gave to the Lord the following words of spells:
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (5 本)：Vaidya (1960) 233,1 - 235,1 · T.263, Dharmarakṣa 竺法護, 286 A.D., p. 63a6 · T.262, Kumārajīva 鳩摩羅什, 405 A.D., p. · 1100 A.D.? Kj mdo sde ja 16a7

verses.iast: imaṃ śīrṣaṃ samāruhya mā kaścid drohī bhavatu dharmabhāṇakānāṃ yakṣo vā rākṣaso vā preto vā piśāco vā pūtano vā kṛtyo va vetālo vā kumbhāṇḍo vā stabdho vā omārako vā ostārako vā apasmārako vā yakṣakṛtyo vā amanuṣyakṛtyo vā manuṣyakṛtyo vā ekāhiko vā dvaitīyako vā traitīyako vā caturthako vā nityajvaro vā viṣamajvaro vā

verses.meaningEn: Kern (1884): No one shall overpower and hurt such preachers; no goblin, giant, ghost, devil, imp, sorcerer, spectre, gnome; no spirit causing epilepsy, no sorcerer of goblin race, no sorcerer of not-human race, no sorcerer of human race; no sorcerer producing tertian ague, quartian ague, quotidian ague.
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (5 本)：Vaidya (1960) 233,1 - 235,1 · T.263, Dharmarakṣa 竺法護, 286 A.D., p. 63a6 · T.262, Kumārajīva 鳩摩羅什, 405 A.D., p. · 1100 A.D.? Kj mdo sde ja 16a7

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §20】T.263, Dharmarakṣa 竺法護, 286 A.D., p. 63a6：. | 藏本 (1100 A.D.? Kj mdo sde ja 16a7)：.

verses.meaningEn: Kern (1884): 1. His head shall be split into seven pieces, like a sprout of Symplocos Racemosa, who after hearing this spell would attack a preacher.
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (5 本)：Vaidya (1960) 233,1 - 235,1 · T.263, Dharmarakṣa 竺法護, 286 A.D., p. 63a6 · T.262, Kumārajīva 鳩摩羅什, 405 A.D., p. · 1100 A.D.? Kj mdo sde ja 16a7

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §22】T.263, Dharmarakṣa 竺法護, 286 A.D., p. 63a6：. | 藏本 (1100 A.D.? Kj mdo sde ja 16a7)：.
verses.meaningEn: Kern (1884): 2. He shall go the way of parricides and matricides, who would attack a preacher.
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (5 本)：Vaidya (1960) 233,1 - 235,1 · T.263, Dharmarakṣa 竺法護, 286 A.D., p. 63a6 · T.262, Kumārajīva 鳩摩羅什, 405 A.D., p. · 1100 A.D.? Kj mdo sde ja 16a7

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §23】T.263, Dharmarakṣa 竺法護, 286 A.D., p. 63a6：. | 藏本 (1100 A.D.? Kj mdo sde ja 16a7)：.
verses.meaningEn: Kern (1884): 3. He shall go the way of oil-millers and sesamum-pounders, who would attack a preacher.
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (5 本)：Vaidya (1960) 233,1 - 235,1 · T.263, Dharmarakṣa 竺法護, 286 A.D., p. 63a6 · T.262, Kumārajīva 鳩摩羅什, 405 A.D., p. · 1100 A.D.? Kj mdo sde ja 16a7

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §24】T.263, Dharmarakṣa 竺法護, 286 A.D., p. 63a6：. | 藏本 (1100 A.D.? Kj mdo sde ja 16a7)：.

verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (5 本)：Vaidya (1960) 233,1 - 235,1 · T.263, Dharmarakṣa 竺法護, 286 A.D., p. 63a6 · T.262, Kumārajīva 鳩摩羅什, 405 A.D., p. · 1100 A.D.? Kj mdo sde ja 16a7

verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (5 本)：Vaidya (1960) 233,1 - 235,1 · T.263, Dharmarakṣa 竺法護, 286 A.D., p. 63a6 · T.262, Kumārajīva 鳩摩羅什, 405 A.D., p. · 1100 A.D.? Kj mdo sde ja 16a7

verses.iast: oṃ mahāsukha vajrasattva jaḥ hūṃ vaṃ hoḥ suratastvaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §1】梵本义译：嗡！大乐，金刚萨埵（普贤金刚心），金刚钩召摄引入坛种子，吽（金刚心印）！金刚界大日智法身水轮甘露种子，金刚欢喜三昧耶融摄种子，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际 | 藏本 (17. Prajñāpāraṃitānayaśatapañcāśatikā; śer rab sna tshogs ka)：śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa’i tshul brgya lṅa bcu pa |
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! great + easy, Vajrasattva, Diamond-Essence Being, Vajra-hook summoning seed syllable (ākarṣaṇa), Hūṃ! Vajradhātu Mahāvairocana ambrosia seed syllable, Vajra-joy samaya-union seed syllable, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: 参校证本 (1 本)：17. Prajñāpāraṃitānayaśatapañcāśatikā; śer rab sna tshogs ka

verses.meaningZh: 【奥斯陆多本对勘 §1】梵本义译：归命顶礼世尊佛母顶礼·圣智了知·清净离诸尘垢！即说咒曰：嗡！再三聪明、英明尊，大慧，聪明普光明照，一切如来·圣智·辅以，世尊佛母！（呼格），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！ | 藏本 (19. Kauśikaprajñāpāramitā; śer rab sna tshogs ka)：śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa kau śi ka źes bya ba |
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed Mother / Lady Bhagavatī, knowing (vocative invocation)! Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! O intelligent, wise, knowing again and again, mahāprajñe, intelligent + O splendor, all Tathagatas + primordial wisdom + O accompanied by, O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

Oṃ! Hūṃ! a lake + only apprehend + tree or mountain Oṃ! Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara Oṃ! Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising Oṃ! Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'aṃ': primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, Vajradhātu Mahāvairocana ambrosia seed syllable, Hūṃ! Oṃ! Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'e': samādhi invocation

titleEnglish: Vienna rKTs Derge Zungdu (D848): ārya-jñānolka-nāma-dhāraṇī-sarvagatipariśodhanī (ārya a pa ri mi ta ā yurjña na nāma mahā yā na sūtra)
translatorZh: 维也纳大学 rKTs 德格版甘珠尔《陀罗尼集 (gZungs 'dus)》(1D/100.txt)
sutraSourceZh: Derge Zungdu 1D/100.txt · Folio 56b1(gzungs) (འཕགས་པ tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa ཞེས་བྱ་བ ཐེག་པ་ཆེན་པོའི་མདོ)

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/100.txt，叶码：56b1(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：Ar+ya a pa ri mi ta A yur+dz+nya na nA ma ma hA yA na sU tra；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：འཕགས་པ tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa ཞེས་བྱ་བ ཐེག་པ་ཆེན་པོའི་མདོ。
recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：yi ger 'drir 'jug na de dag gi yon tan dang legs par 'gyur ba ni 'di dag go།  ། ཨོཾ ན་མོ བྷ་ག་བ་ཏེ།  a ba ri mi ta A yur+dz+nyA na su bi nish+tsi ta te dzo rA dzA ya།  ta thA ga tA ya།  ar+ha te saM myak+saM bud+d+hA ya།  tad+ya thA།  ཨོཾ pu N+ye pu N+ye མ་ཧཱ pu N+ye a pa ri mi ta pu N+ye a pa ri mi ta pu N+ya dz+nyA na saM b+ha ro pa tsi te།  ཨོཾ sarba saM skA ra pa ri shud+d+ha d+har+m+ma te ga ga na sa mut+ga te swa b+hA ba bi shud+d+he མ་ཧཱ na ya pa ri bA re སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  'jam dpal དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad po 'di dag gang la la zhig yi ger 'dri 'am yi ger 'drir 'jug gam།  glegs bam la bris te khyim na 'chang ngam klog par gyur pa de'i tshe zad pa las tshe lo brgya thub par 'gyur te།  'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ tshe dpag tu med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams yon tan dpag tu med pa sogs par skye bar 'gyur ro།  ། ཨོཾ ན་མོ བྷ་ག་བ་ཏེ།  a ba ri（EWTS: yi ger 'drir 'jug na de dag gi yon tan dang legs par 'gyur ba ni 'di dag go/ /o~M na mo b+ha ga ba te/ a ba ri mi ta A yur+dz+nyA na su bi nish+tsi ta te dzo rA dzA ya/ ta thA ga tA ya/ ar+ha te saM myak+saM bud+d+hA ya/ tad+ya thA/ o~M pu N+ye pu N+ye ma hA pu N+ye a pa ri mi ta pu N+ye a pa ri mi ta pu N+ya dz+nyA na saM b+ha ro pa tsi te/ o~M sarba saM skA ra pa ri shud+d+ha d+har+m+ma te ga ga na sa mut+ga te swa b+hA ba bi shud+d+he ma hA na ya pa ri bA re swA hA/ 'jam dpal de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad po 'di dag gang la la zhig yi ger 'dri 'am yi ger 'drir 'jug gam/ glegs bam la bris te khyim na 'chang ngam klog par gyur pa de'i tshe zad pa las tshe lo brgya thub par 'gyur te/ 'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dpag tu med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams yon tan dpag tu med pa sogs par skye bar 'gyur ro/ /o~M na mo b+ha ga ba te/ a ba ri）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/100.txt，叶码：65a1(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：Ar+ya sap+ta bud+d+ha kaM nA ma ma hA yA na sU tra；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：འཕགས་པ sangs rgyas bdun pa ཞེས་བྱ་བ ཐེག་པ་ཆེན་པོའི་མདོ。
recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：ཨོཾ ha la ha la།  hi la hi lA ya།  ན་མོ dza ga na mi tsa nA ya།  ན་མོ na maHསྭཱ་ཧཱ།  de nas དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ rnam par gzigs kyis བྱང་ཆུབ་སེམས་དཔའ sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i སྙིང་པོ la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to།  ། nam mkha'i སྙིང་པོ gang la la zhig རིག་སྔགས ན་མོ bud d+hA ya།  ན་མོ d+harmA ya།  na maHsaM g+hA ya།  ཨོཾ pa tsa pa tsa pA tsa ya pA tsa ya།  sarba b+hU tA nAM།  ts+tshin+da ya།  kI la ya།  ba ra bid+yA nAM སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  nam mkha'i སྙིང་པོ sems can thams cad la phan pa'i don dang །  nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar bya ba cad la phan pa'i don dang །  nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar bya ba dang །  'byung po thams cad bzlog pa'i phyir གསང་སྔགས kyi gzhi 'di dag bka' stsal to།  ། ན་མོ bud d+hA ya།  ན་མོ d+harmA ya།  na maHsaM g+hA ya།  ཨོཾ ka la ka la།  ki li ki li།  ku lu ku lu།  ku lo t+hA d+ha（EWTS: o~M ha la ha la/ hi la hi lA ya/ na mo dza ga na mi tsa nA ya/ na mo na maHswA hA/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par gzigs kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nam mkha'i snying po la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /nam mkha'i snying po gang la la zhig rig sngags na mo bud d+hA ya/ na mo d+harmA ya/ na maHsaM g+hA ya/ oM pa tsa pa tsa pA tsa ya pA tsa ya/ sarba b+hU tA nAM/ ts+tshin+da ya/ kI la ya/ ba ra bid+yA nAM swA hA/ nam mkha'i snying po sems can thams cad la phan pa'i don dang / nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar bya ba cad la phan pa'i don dang / nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar bya ba dang / 'byung po thams cad bzlog pa'i phyir gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /na mo bud d+hA ya/ na mo d+harmA ya/ na maHsaM g+hA ya/ oM ka la ka la/ ki li ki li/ ku lu ku lu/ ku lo t+hA d+ha）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/100.txt，叶码：79b5(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：Ar+ya a gra pra dI pa d+hA ra NI bi d+yA rA dzA；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：འཕགས་པ རིག་སྔགས kyi rgyal po sgron ma mchog gi གཟུངས。
recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：le dz+wa le།  dz+wa le ga te།  huk+ku།  muk+ku།  saM ma te།  མ་ཧཱ saM ma te།  མ་ཧཱ dz+wa le།  dz+wa ba la me།  sa he sa he།  མ་ཧཱ dz+wa le།  uk+ke muk+ke།  sha me།  saM ma te།  མ་ཧཱ saM ma te།  མ་ཧཱ sha me སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  de nas བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས kyis tshe dang ldan ba kun dga' bo la phe།  hi li mi li།  ti le སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  de nas བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' po la bka' stsal pa།  kun dga' bo khyod kyis གཟུངས kyi གསང་སྔགས 'di 'di dag zung shig ། long shig ། chos shig ། lhogs shig ། kun dza hi la ba te།  tsaN+DIl ba te སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  de nas བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa།  kun dga' bo khyod གཟུངས kyi གསང་སྔགས gzhi 'di dag zung shig ། long shig ། chongs shig ། lhogs shig ། kun chub par（EWTS: le dz+wa le/ dz+wa le ga te/ huk+ku/ muk+ku/ saM ma te/ ma hA saM ma te/ ma hA dz+wa le/ dz+wa ba la me/ sa he sa he/ ma hA dz+wa le/ uk+ke muk+ke/ sha me/ saM ma te/ ma hA saM ma te/ ma hA sha me swA hA/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan ba kun dga' bo la phe/ hi li mi li/ ti le swA hA/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' po la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis gzungs kyi gsang sngags 'di 'di dag zung shig /long shig /chos shig /lhogs shig /kun dza hi la ba te/ tsaN+DIl ba te swA hA/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi 'di dag zung shig /long shig /chongs shig /lhogs shig /kun chub par）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

verses.iast: baicanarasmi sañco dite ā gaccha ārya ākāśa garbha mahākāruṇikā pūrayahaśāna
verses.meaningZh: 解脱系缚大力·妙行迁变空·离名相假立，一切诸谛圆满·圣智通达·妙行迁变空，施度调伏·真如实际，悉昙「ā」韵字门：远离寂静周遍，去吧、趣向菩提！圣、尊贵圣者，虚空界（无碍周遍），藏、胎藏、心髓宝藏，大悲圣尊、具足大悲心者，圆满充盈·第一义谛

verses.iast: oṃ bhaiṣajye bhaiṣajye mahā bhaiṣajye bhaiṣajya rāsa mutga te svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三法药、疗病妙药尊，大、摩诃（广大无边），法药、疗病妙药尊，法药、疗病妙药，戏剧、体育，无我大慈三昧·真如实际·妙行趣入，向汝、彼等，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O medicine, healing remedy / in medicine, healing remedy again and again, great, vast, supreme, O medicine, healing remedy / in medicine, healing remedy, medicine, healing remedy, a kind of rustic dance, selfless great loving-kindness & immutable Suchness & awakened spiritual movement, to Thee / they, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/100.txt，叶码：87b4(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：b+ha ga bA na a mi tA b+ha d+hA ra NI man+t+ra；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས snang ba mtha' 87b5(གཟུངས): yas kyi གཟུངས sngags。
recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：Ta ni།  sarba pA pa ni།  bud+d+ha a d+hiSh+ThA ni na སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  འཕགས་པ rgyal ba'i bla ma'i གཟུངས rdzogs so།  @#།  ། rgya gar skad du།  b+ha ga bA na a mi tA b+ha དྷཱ་ར་ཎཱི man+t+ra།  bod skad du།  བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས snang ba mtha' mi ta ga ga na kIrti ka re sarba kle shak+Sha yaM ka ri སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  གཟུངས 'di'i yon tan ni bskal pa brgya stong du bsags pa'i las kyi sgrib pa yang 'di lan gsum bzlas brjod byas na sgrib pa de rnams zad par 'gyur ro།  ། lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas na rtsa ba bzhi'i ltung du hi ke སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  lus la nad byung ba'am།  nad khong skams su gyur kyang rung ste།  lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bsngags te།  bsil yab kyis de la g.yabs na nad med par 'gyur ro།  ། གཟུངས sngags de gsungs ma thag tu 'khor thams cad yi rangs te།（EWTS: Ta ni/ sarba pA pa ni/ bud+d+ha a d+hiSh+ThA ni na swA hA/ 'phags pa rgyal ba'i bla ma'i gzungs rdzogs so// @#/ /rgya gar skad du/ b+ha ga bA na a mi tA b+ha d+hA ra NI man+t+ra/ bod skad du/ bcom ldan 'das snang ba mtha' mi ta ga ga na kIrti ka re sarba kle shak+Sha yaM ka ri swA hA/ gzungs 'di'i yon tan ni bskal pa brgya stong du bsags pa'i las kyi sgrib pa yang 'di lan gsum bzlas brjod byas na sgrib pa de rnams zad par 'gyur ro/ /lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas na rtsa ba bzhi'i ltung du hi ke swA hA/ lus la nad byung ba'am/ nad khong skams su gyur kyang rung ste/ lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bsngags te/ bsil yab kyis de la g.yabs na nad med par 'gyur ro/ /gzungs sngags de gsungs ma thag tu 'khor thams cad yi rangs te/）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, evil, karmic sin, unwholesome deed, beyond nominal designation (nāma) — purified faculties

recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：na la se།  a na la saM b+ha be།  a na la sa ga tiM ga te སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། tad+ya thA།  he ma he ma།  ha ma ha ma སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། tad+ya thA།  a mi tot+b+ha be།  a mi ta saM b+ha be།  a mi ta bi krAn+te།  a mi ta bi krAn+ti ka re།  a mi ta ga ga na kIrti ka re སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ yon tan 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། tad+ya thA།  ga ga na a ka ra།  ga ga na saM b+ha be།  ga ga na kIrti ka re སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ kun nas spos mchog la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། tad+ya thA།  sa ma sa me སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis 'brug bsgrags gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། tad+ya thA།  a sa ma sa me སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  de bzhin（EWTS: na la se/ a na la saM b+ha be/ a na la sa ga tiM ga te swA hA/ de bzhin gshegs pa sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tad+ya thA/ he ma he ma/ ha ma ha ma swA hA/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tad+ya thA/ a mi tot+b+ha be/ a mi ta saM b+ha be/ a mi ta bi krAn+te/ a mi ta bi krAn+ti ka re/ a mi ta ga ga na kIrti ka re swA hA/ de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tad+ya thA/ ga ga na a ka ra/ ga ga na saM b+ha be/ ga ga na kIrti ka re swA hA/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun nas spos mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tad+ya thA/ sa ma sa me swA hA/ de bzhin gshegs pa gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis 'brug bsgrags gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tad+ya thA/ a sa ma sa me swA hA/ de bzhin）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

verses.tangNoteZh: 藏文音译原貌：na la se།  a na la saM b+ha be།  a na la sa ga tiM ga te སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། tad+ya thA།  he ma he ma།  ha ma ha ma སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། tad+ya thA།  a mi tot+b+ha be།  a mi ta saM b+ha be།  a mi ta bi krAn+te།  a mi ta bi krAn+ti ka re།  a mi ta ga ga na kIrti ka re སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ yon tan 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། tad+ya thA།  ga ga na a ka ra།  ga ga na saM b+ha be།  ga ga na kIrti ka re སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ kun nas spos mchog la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། tad+ya thA།  sa ma sa me སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis 'brug bsgrags gshegs pa la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། tad+ya thA།  a sa ma sa me སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  de bzhin

titleSanskritIast: ārya-kṣitigarbhāṣṭottaraśatakanāma-dhāraṇī-mantra-sahita (ārya aṣṭa maṇḍal ka nāma mahā yā na sūtra)
titleEnglish: Vienna rKTs Derge Zungdu (D881): ārya-kṣitigarbhāṣṭottaraśatakanāma-dhāraṇī-mantra-sahita (ārya aṣṭa maṇḍal ka nāma mahā yā na sūtra)
translatorZh: 维也纳大学 rKTs 德格版甘珠尔《陀罗尼集 (gZungs 'dus)》(1D/100.txt)
sutraSourceZh: Derge Zungdu 1D/100.txt · Folio 122a2(gzungs) (འཕགས་པ dkyil 'khor brgyad pa zhes 122a3(གཟུངས): bya ba ཐེག་པ་ཆེན་པོའི་མདོ)
deityZh: འཕགས་པ dkyil 'khor brgyad pa zhes 122a3(གཟུངས): bya ba ཐེག་པ་ཆེན་པོའི་མདོ
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/100.txt，叶码：122a2(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：Ar+ya aSh+Ta maN+Dal ka nA ma ma hA yA na sU tra；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：འཕགས་པ dkyil 'khor brgyad pa zhes 122a3(གཟུངས): bya ba ཐེག་པ་ཆེན་པོའི་མདོ。
recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：legs so།  ། rigs kyi bu de'i phyir སྙིང་པོ gang brjod pa tsam gyis mtshams med pa lnga 'byang zhing །  dngos grub thams cad kyang thob par 'gyur ba བྱང་ཆུབ་སེམས་དཔའ brgyad kyi སྙིང་པོ nyon cig ། ཨོཾ མ་ཧཱ ཧཱུྃ མ་ཧཱ bI ra སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  སྙིང་པོ 'dis ni dbus kyi བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས mchod do།  ། ཨོཾ hrI ཧཱུྃ པདྨ pri ya སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  འཕགས་པ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi སྙིང་པོ'o།  ། ཨོཾ mai hA rA Na སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  byams pa'i སྙིང་པོ'o།  ། ཨོཾ A kA sha gar+b+hA ya སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  nam mkha'i སྙིང་པོ'i སྙིང་པོ'o།  ། ཨོཾ swA hri rA dza ya སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  kun du bzang po'i སྙིང་པོ'o།  ། ཨོཾ ku ru b+ha na ra ha སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  lag na rdo rje'i སྙིང་པོ'o།  ། ཨོཾ shrI aM ra~M ga སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i སྙིང་པོ'o།  ། ཨོཾ ni swA ra~M b+ha སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba'i སྙིང་པོ'o།  ། ཨོཾ k+Shi ti ha（EWTS: legs so/ /rigs kyi bu de'i phyir snying po gang brjod pa tsam gyis mtshams med pa lnga 'byang zhing / dngos grub thams cad kyang thob par 'gyur ba byang chub sems dpa' brgyad kyi snying po nyon cig /o~M ma hA hU~M ma hA bI ra swA hA/ snying po 'dis ni dbus kyi bcom ldan 'das mchod do/ /o~M hrI hU~M pad+ma pri ya swA hA/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi snying po'o/ /o~M mai hA rA Na swA hA/ byams pa'i snying po'o/ /o~M A kA sha gar+b+hA ya swA hA/ nam mkha'i snying po'i snying po'o/ /o~M swA hri rA dza ya swA hA/ kun du bzang po'i snying po'o/ /o~M ku ru b+ha na ra ha swA hA/ lag na rdo rje'i snying po'o/ /o~M shrI aM ra~M ga swA hA/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i snying po'o/ /o~M ni swA ra~M b+ha swA hA/ sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba'i snying po'o/ /o~M k+Shi ti ha）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

verses.iast: oṃ hūṃ hrīḥ āḥ kṣaḥ maḥ laḥ vaḥ raḥ yaṃ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！吽（金刚心印）！莲华部心印（清净惭愧·弥陀观音种子），语金刚种子字（一切法本不生清净妙语），乞洒字门（尽诸漏障究竟寂灭（kṣaya）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入），摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入），攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入），嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入），风大自在除障种子，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Hūṃ! Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, speech-vajra seed syllable Āḥ (non-arising), exhaustion of all karmic outflows (kṣaya) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release, freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release, supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release, Vāyu wind-mandala swiftness seed syllable, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/100.txt，叶码：123a2(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：Ar+ya sarba ta thA ga ta a d+hiSh+ThA na hr-i da ya gu h+ya d+hA tu ka raN+Da nA ma d+hA ra NI ma hA yA na sU tra；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：འཕགས་པ དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs kyi སྙིང་པོ gsang ba ring bsrel gyi za ma tog ces bya ba'i གཟུངས ཐེག་པ་ཆེན་པོའི་མདོ。
recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：dag ste།  chos kyi sku dang །  longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang །  de bzhin du sprul pa'i sku ste།  dus gsum pa thams cad kyi ring bsrel gyi za ma tog gi phyag rgya'i གཟུངས kyi chos kyi rnam grangs yin no།  ། na ma s+t+rai ya d+h+wi kAnAM།  sarba ta thA ga tA nAM།  ཨོཾ b+hu bi b+ha bA na ba re ba tsa Tau།  tsu lu tsu lu།  d+ha re d+ha re།  sarba ཏ་ཐཱ་ག་ཏ།  d+hA tu d+ha re།  པདྨ gar+b+he།  dza ya ba re།  a tsa le།  sma ra ཏ་ཐཱ་ག་ཏ།  d+har+m+ma tsakra།  pra bar+t+ta na།  བཛྲ bo d+hi maN+Da a laM kA ra།  a laM kr-i te།  sarba ཏ་ཐཱ་ག་ཏ།  a d+hiSh+Thi te།  bo d+ha ya bo d+ha ya།  bo bud+d+ha།  sarba ཏ་ཐཱ་ག་ཏ a d+hiSh+Thi te།  d+hA tu gar+b+he སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  sa ma ya a d+hiSh+Thi te སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  sarba ཏ་ཐཱ་ག་ཏ hr-i da ya།  d+hA tu mu dre སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  su pra tiSh+Thi ta།  stu be ཏ་ཐཱ་ག་ཏ a d+hiSh+Thi te།  ཧཱུྃ ཧཱུྃ སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  ཨོཾ sarba ཏ་ཐཱ་ག་ཏ uSh+NI Sha d+hA tu mu drA Ni།  sarba ཏ་ཐཱ་ག་ཏ d+harma d+hA tu bi b+hu Shi ta a d+hiSh+Thi te（EWTS: dag ste/ chos kyi sku dang / longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang / de bzhin du sprul pa'i sku ste/ dus gsum pa thams cad kyi ring bsrel gyi za ma tog gi phyag rgya'i gzungs kyi chos kyi rnam grangs yin no/ /na ma s+t+rai ya d+h+wi kAnAM/ sarba ta thA ga tA nAM/ o~M b+hu bi b+ha bA na ba re ba tsa Tau/ tsu lu tsu lu/ d+ha re d+ha re/ sarba ta thA ga ta/ d+hA tu d+ha re/ pad+ma gar+b+he/ dza ya ba re/ a tsa le/ sma ra ta thA ga ta/ d+har+m+ma tsakra/ pra bar+t+ta na/ badzra bo d+hi maN+Da a laM kA ra/ a laM kr-i te/ sarba ta thA ga ta/ a d+hiSh+Thi te/ bo d+ha ya bo d+ha ya/ bo bud+d+ha/ sarba ta thA ga ta a d+hiSh+Thi te/ d+hA tu gar+b+he swA hA/ sa ma ya a d+hiSh+Thi te swA hA/ sarba ta thA ga ta hr-i da ya/ d+hA tu mu dre swA hA/ su pra tiSh+Thi ta/ stu be ta thA ga ta a d+hiSh+Thi te/ hU~M hU~M swA hA/ o~M sarba ta thA ga ta uSh+NI Sha d+hA tu mu drA Ni/ sarba ta thA ga ta d+harma d+hA tu bi b+hu Shi ta a d+hiSh+Thi te）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：cad du snang bar byas so།  ། de nas པདྨ de las nor bu rdo rje mchog ldan ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས kyis skul ba'i sgra 'di byung ngo །  ། phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ gang lags pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། ཨོཾ ma Ni བཛྲ hr-i da ya།  བཛྲ mA ra sai n+ya bi dra ba ni།  ha na ha na།  བཛྲ gar+b+he trA sa ya trA sa ya།  sarba mA ra b+hu ba nA ni ཧཱུྃ ཧཱུྃ།  san+d+ha ra san+d+ha ra།  bud+d+ha mai tri sarba ཏ་ཐཱ་ག་ཏ།  badzre kalpa a d+hiSh+Thi te སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  པདྨ de las yang legs so ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i sgra grags te།  des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig（EWTS: cad du snang bar byas so/ /de nas pad+ma de las nor bu rdo rje mchog ldan zhes bya ba'i gzungs kyis skul ba'i sgra 'di byung ngo / /phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa gang lags pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /o~M ma Ni badzra hr-i da ya/ badzra mA ra sai n+ya bi dra ba ni/ ha na ha na/ badzra gar+b+he trA sa ya trA sa ya/ sarba mA ra b+hu ba nA ni hU~M hU~M/ san+d+ha ra san+d+ha ra/ bud+d+ha mai tri sarba ta thA ga ta/ badzre kalpa a d+hiSh+Thi te swA hA/ pad+ma de las yang legs so zhes bya ba'i sgra grags te/ des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

deityZh: འཕགས་པ byams pas dam bcas pa ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/100.txt，叶码：165b4(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：Ar+ya mai tri pra ti dz+nyA nA ma d+hA ra NI；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：འཕགས་པ byams pas dam bcas pa ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས。
recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：ཨོཾ ན་མོ བྷ་ག་བ་ཏེ།  shAkya mu na ye།  ta thA ga tA ya།  ar+ha te།  samyak+saM bud d+hA ya།  tad+ya thA།  ཨོཾ a dzi te།  a dzi te།  a pa rA dzi te།  a dzi tan dza ya།  ha ra ha ra།  mai tri a ba lo ki te།  ka ra ka ra།  མ་ཧཱ sa ma ya sid+d+he།  b+ha ra b+ha ra།  མ་ཧཱ bo d+hi maN+Da bI dze།  sma ra sma ra།  A sma kaM sa ma ya།  bo d+hi bo d+hi།  མ་ཧཱ bo d+hi སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  rtsa ba'i གསང་སྔགས so།  ། ཨོཾ mo hi mo hi།  མ་ཧཱ mo hi སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  སྙིང་པོ'o།  ཨོཾ mu ni mu ni sma ra སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  nye ba'i སྙིང་པོ'o།  ། གཟུངས 'di nyan pa tsam dang །  klog pa dang །  kha ton byed pa dang །  tshul bzhin yid la pa byams pas dam bcas pa ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས rdzogs so།  །  ། rgya gar gyi mkhan po བཛྲ pA Ni dang །  bod kyi lots+tsha ba།  dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa།  །（EWTS: oM na mo b+ha ga ba te/ shAkya mu na ye/ ta thA ga tA ya/ ar+ha te/ samyak+saM bud d+hA ya/ tad+ya thA/ oM a dzi te/ a dzi te/ a pa rA dzi te/ a dzi tan dza ya/ ha ra ha ra/ mai tri a ba lo ki te/ ka ra ka ra/ ma hA sa ma ya sid+d+he/ b+ha ra b+ha ra/ ma hA bo d+hi maN+Da bI dze/ sma ra sma ra/ A sma kaM sa ma ya/ bo d+hi bo d+hi/ ma hA bo d+hi swA hA/ rtsa ba'i gsang sngags so/ /o~M mo hi mo hi/ ma hA mo hi swA hA/ snying po'o/ o~M mu ni mu ni sma ra swA hA/ nye ba'i snying po'o/ /gzungs 'di nyan pa tsam dang / klog pa dang / kha ton byed pa dang / tshul bzhin yid la pa byams pas dam bcas pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so/ / //rgya gar gyi mkhan po badzra pA Ni dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba/ dge slong chos kyi shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa// //）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/100.txt，叶码：166a5(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：Ar+ya A pa ra Na bi skaM b+hi nA ma d+hA ra NI；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：འཕགས་པ sgrib pa rnam par sel ba ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས。
recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：sdig pa thams cad 'byang zhing 'chi ba'i dus su bde ba nyid du dus byed par 'gyur ro།  ། ཨོཾ shwe ta wa ra bi dza li ne སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  བྱང་ཆུབ་སེམས་དཔའ sems dpa' chen po sgrib pa rnam par sel ba'i སྙིང་པོ 'di nyin lan bdun mtshan lan bdun brjod na las brgyud mar bsags pa'i sdig pa thams cad 'byang zhing 'chi ba'i dus su gnad gcod pa'i sdug bsngal drag po mi 'byung ngo །  ། bde ba nyid du dus byed par 'gyur ro།  ། ཨོཾ sarba A ba ra Na bi skaM b+hi ne སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa de dag rnams la bshos gtsang la sogs pa'i mchod pas（EWTS: sdig pa thams cad 'byang zhing 'chi ba'i dus su bde ba nyid du dus byed par 'gyur ro/ /oM shwe ta wa ra bi dza li ne swA hA/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sgrib pa rnam par sel ba'i snying po 'di nyin lan bdun mtshan lan bdun brjod na las brgyud mar bsags pa'i sdig pa thams cad 'byang zhing 'chi ba'i dus su gnad gcod pa'i sdug bsngal drag po mi 'byung ngo / /bde ba nyid du dus byed par 'gyur ro/ /oM sarba A ba ra Na bi skaM b+hi ne swA hA/ sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa de dag rnams la bshos gtsang la sogs pa'i mchod pas）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：gsum la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། འཕགས་པ 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། ན་མོ rat+na tra yA ya།  ན་མོ བྷ་ག་བ་ཏེ d+harma d+hA tu ni gardzi ta rA dzA ya།  ta thA ga tA ya།  ar+ha te samyak+saM bud d+hA ya།  ན་མོ many+dzu shri ye།  ku mA ra b+hU tA ya།  tad+ya thA།  ཨོཾ dz+nyA nA lo ke།  tri rat+na paM sha saM d+hA ra Ni།  b+ha ga ba ti།  a bA yaM dA di a bA yaM dat+te me bo d+hi tsit+ta བཛྲ pa ri pA la ya།  sa man+ta a ba b+hA se na།  ha na ha na།  sarba satwa saM ta na pa ti taM།  kle shA nuts+tshe da ya།  ba ra lak+Sha Na།  a laM kr-i ta sha rI ri།  bo d+hi sa twa shi shU pa ti pA la ya།  bud d+hA na de shA ya།  de ba།  nA ga།  yak+Sha།  ga na d+harba།  a su ra།  ga ru Da།  kin+na ra།  ma ho ra ga ། ba shes+tha pA ya།  a pa yaM dad ti སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  གཟུངས 'di'i phan yon ni lan cig brjod pas kyang bskal pa stong du las kyi sgrib pa bsags pa 'byang bar 'gyur ro།  ། 'chi kar yang 'phags（EWTS: gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /na mo rat+na tra yA ya/ na mo b+ha ga ba te d+harma d+hA tu ni gardzi ta rA dzA ya/ ta thA ga tA ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saM bud d+hA ya/ na mo many+dzu shri ye/ ku mA ra b+hU tA ya/ tad+ya thA/ o~M dz+nyA nA lo ke/ tri rat+na paM sha saM d+hA ra Ni/ b+ha ga ba ti/ a bA yaM dA di a bA yaM dat+te me bo d+hi tsit+ta badzra pa ri pA la ya/ sa man+ta a ba b+hA se na/ ha na ha na/ sarba satwa saM ta na pa ti taM/ kle shA nuts+tshe da ya/ ba ra lak+Sha Na/ a laM kr-i ta sha rI ri/ bo d+hi sa twa shi shU pa ti pA la ya/ bud d+hA na de shA ya/ de ba/ nA ga/ yak+Sha/ ga na d+harba/ a su ra/ ga ru Da/ kin+na ra/ ma ho ra ga /ba shes+tha pA ya/ a pa yaM dad ti swA hA/ gzungs 'di'i phan yon ni lan cig brjod pas kyang bskal pa stong du las kyi sgrib pa bsags pa 'byang bar 'gyur ro/ /'chi kar yang 'phags）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/100.txt，叶码：167b5(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：Ar+ya many+dzu shrI b+haT+TA ra ka s+ya pradz+nyA bud+d+hi bar+d+ha na nA ma d+hA ra NI；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：rje btsun འཕགས་པ 'jam dpal gyi shes rab dang blo 'phel ba ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས。

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三息尊，大、摩诃（广大无边），息尊，再三拥护、守护，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），一切、普皆遍满，彼、此尊（阳性主格），嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，一切、普皆遍满，罪业、恶不善业，疗尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O rest / in rest again and again, great, vast, supreme, O rest / in rest, protect, guard and shelter! again and again, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, all, every, complete, he, that one, supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — expansive quiescence sealed with bodhicitta bindu and all, every, complete, evil, karmic sin, unwholesome deed, O heal / in heal, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: mahatāṃ parṣanmadhye ahamidānīmā barta yiṣyā mi siddhyantu me mantra pa dāḥsarva kāryāṇi
verses.meaningZh: 酒席救度佛母根本种子字，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·六度满行清净，因缘空寂大乐·无我大慈三昧·施度调伏，解脱系缚大力·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，一乘如实之道·六度满行清净，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·诸根清净自在），愿诸真言章句悉皆成就，于我、为我，真言、密咒（护心密语），跛字门（第一义谛（paramārtha）·本不生体性），施度调伏·一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢，一切果
verses.meaningEn: Feast + Tārā root seed syllable Tāṃ, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & perfection of the six pāramitās (vocative invocation), causal emptiness & spiritual joy & selfless great loving-kindness & generosity & self-mastery, spiritual strength freeing bonds & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, supreme vehicle of awakening & perfection of the six pāramitās, selfless great loving-kindness — purified faculties, may the mantra words be fully accomplished! to me, my, Mantra, sacred formula, ultimate truth (paramārtha) — primordial non-arising, generosity & self-mastery & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust, to be done

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，向诸星宿凡彼等诸有情，我之（行者所有），一切、普皆遍满，彼、此尊（阳性主格）已，离名相假立·圣智通达·妙行迁变空，拥护、守护，破有相福德光·解脱系缚大力·真如实际

translatorZh: 维也纳大学 rKTs 德格版甘珠尔《陀罗尼集 (gZungs 'dus)》(1D/100.txt)

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/100.txt，叶码：223b7(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：da sha b+hU mi d+hA ra NI；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：sa bcu 224a1(གཟུངས): pa'i གཟུངས。
recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：rdzogs so།  །  ། rgya gar gyi mkhan po a mo g+ha བཛྲ dang །  bod kyi lots+tsha ba ba ri rin chen grags pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa།  @#།  ། rgya gar skad du།  da sha b+hU mi དྷཱ་ར་ཎཱི།  bod skad du།  sa bcu pa'i གཟུངས།  sangs rgyas dang །  བྱང་ཆུབ་སེམས་དཔའ thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། de nas གསང་སྔགས la 'jug pa rnams kyis dgos pa thams cad so sor bsgrub par 'gyur ba ni།  ཨོཾ ཞེས་བྱ་བ don yod zhags pa པདྨ gtsug tor gyi dkyil pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rtag tu mchog sbyin par mdzad do།  ། གསང་སྔགས ཨོཾ ཞེས་བྱ་བ dran nas tshe 'phos pa ni 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du 'gro bar 'gyur ro།  ། གསང་སྔགས yi ge gcig pa'o།  ། ཨོཾ b+huH།  yi ge gnyis pa 'bum bzlas（EWTS: rdzogs so/ / //rgya gar gyi mkhan po a mo g+ha badzra dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba ba ri rin chen grags pas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa// @#/ /rgya gar skad du/ da sha b+hU mi d+hA ra NI/ bod skad du/ sa bcu pa'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas gsang sngags la 'jug pa rnams kyis dgos pa thams cad so sor bsgrub par 'gyur ba ni/ o~M zhes bya ba don yod zhags pa pad+ma gtsug tor gyi dkyil pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug rtag tu mchog sbyin par mdzad do/ /gsang sngags o~M zhes bya ba dran nas tshe 'phos pa ni 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /gsang sngags yi ge gcig pa'o/ /o~M b+huH/ yi ge gnyis pa 'bum bzlas）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/100.txt，叶码：226b4(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：Ar+ya a mo g+ha pA sha pA ra mi tA Shan+pa ri pU ra kA nA ma d+hA ra NI；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：འཕགས་པ don yod zhags pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par byed pa ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས。
recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། dus gsum du gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། བྱང་ཆུབ་སེམས་དཔའ sems dpa' chen po snying rje chen po dang ldan pa འཕགས་པ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། ཨོཾ a mo g+ha pA sha མ་ཧཱ dA na pA ra mi tA pA ri pU ra ya ཧཱུྃ།  da ra da ra།  bi bad+hi།  bi tsi traiH།  sarba satwA u pa b+ho ga ། sarba ཏ་ཐཱ་ག་ཏ།  མ་ཧཱ dA na pU dza me g+ha pra brta ya།  ta ra ta ra།  tA ra ya མ་ཧཱ པདྨ ma Ni ཧཱུྃ ཕཊ སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  'di ni don yod pa'i zhags pa'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i སྙིང་པོ thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། བྱང་ཆུབ་སེམས་དཔའ sems dpa' chen po snying rje chen po dang ldan pa འཕགས་པ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། ཨོཾ a mo g+ha shI la།  saM b+ha ra saM b+ha ra།  b+ha ra b+ha ra།  མ་ཧཱ shud+d+ha sa twa པདྨ bi（EWTS: la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum du gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po snying rje chen po dang ldan pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /o~M a mo g+ha pA sha ma hA dA na pA ra mi tA pA ri pU ra ya hU~M/ da ra da ra/ bi bad+hi/ bi tsi traiH/ sarba satwA u pa b+ho ga /sarba ta thA ga ta/ ma hA dA na pU dza me g+ha pra brta ya/ ta ra ta ra/ tA ra ya ma hA pad+ma ma Ni hU~M phaT swA hA/ 'di ni don yod pa'i zhags pa'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po snying rje chen po dang ldan pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /o~M a mo g+ha shI la/ saM b+ha ra saM b+ha ra/ b+ha ra b+ha ra/ ma hA shud+d+ha sa twa pad+ma bi）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

verses.tangNoteZh: 藏文音译原貌：la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། dus gsum du gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། བྱང་ཆུབ་སེམས་དཔའ sems dpa' chen po snying rje chen po dang ldan pa འཕགས་པ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། ཨོཾ a mo g+ha pA sha མ་ཧཱ dA na pA ra mi tA pA ri pU ra ya ཧཱུྃ།  da ra da ra།  bi bad+hi།  bi tsi traiH།  sarba satwA u pa b+ho ga ། sarba ཏ་ཐཱ་ག་ཏ།  མ་ཧཱ dA na pU dza me g+ha pra brta ya།  ta ra ta ra།  tA ra ya མ་ཧཱ པདྨ ma Ni ཧཱུྃ ཕཊ སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  'di ni don yod pa'i zhags pa'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i སྙིང་པོ thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། བྱང་ཆུབ་སེམས་དཔའ sems dpa' chen po snying rje chen po dang ldan pa འཕགས་པ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། ཨོཾ a mo g+ha shI la།  saM b+ha ra saM b+ha ra།  b+ha ra b+ha ra།  མ་ཧཱ shud+d+ha sa twa པདྨ bi

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/100.txt，叶码：228b3(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：Ar+ya sa man+ta b+ha dra nA ma d+hA ra NI；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：འཕགས་པ kun du bzang po ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས。
recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：satwA ya།  མ་ཧཱ kA ru Ni kA ya།  sa mr-i dAn+tu mAM།  sa man+ta b+ha dra དྷཱ་ར་ཎཱི སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  གཟུངས 'di thos ma thag tu བྱང་ཆུབ་སེམས་དཔའ bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa gnyis po de dag gis dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob par gyur to།  ། བྱང་ཆུབ་སེམས་དཔའ bo d+hi satwA ya།  མ་ཧཱ satwA ya།  མ་ཧཱ kA ru Ni kA ya།  tad+ya thA།  ti li ban d+hA mi།  mi li ban d+hA mi།  tsi li mi li ban d+hA mi།  sI mi ban d+hA mi།  bdag gi mtshams las su yang 'da' bar ma gyur cig སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  chu la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig yongs su bzlas te phyogs bcur b+ha ga bA na།  ཨཱརྱ a ba lo ki te shwa ra ya སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  'di ni bdag gi སྙིང་པོ bshad pa ste།  des bdag 'gugs par 'gyur ro།  ། de'i 'og tu zla ba yar gyi ngo'i tshes brgyad nas bzung ste nya'i bar du lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis te dus gsum du bzlas brjod bgyi།  dus gsum（EWTS: satwA ya/ ma hA kA ru Ni kA ya/ sa mr-i dAn+tu mAM/ sa man+ta b+ha dra d+hA ra NI swA hA/ gzungs 'di thos ma thag tu byang chub sems dpa' bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa gnyis po de dag gis dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' bo d+hi satwA ya/ ma hA satwA ya/ ma hA kA ru Ni kA ya/ tad+ya thA/ ti li ban d+hA mi/ mi li ban d+hA mi/ tsi li mi li ban d+hA mi/ sI mi ban d+hA mi/ bdag gi mtshams las su yang 'da' bar ma gyur cig swA hA/ chu la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig yongs su bzlas te phyogs bcur b+ha ga bA na/ Ar+ya a ba lo ki te shwa ra ya swA hA/ 'di ni bdag gi snying po bshad pa ste/ des bdag 'gugs par 'gyur ro/ /de'i 'og tu zla ba yar gyi ngo'i tshes brgyad nas bzung ste nya'i bar du lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis te dus gsum du bzlas brjod bgyi/ dus gsum）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/100.txt，叶码：231a1(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：Ar+ya nI la kaN+Tha nA ma d+hA ra NI；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：འཕགས་པ nI la kaN+Tha ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/100.txt，叶码：233a5(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：Ar+ya me kha la nA ma d+hA ra NI；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：འཕགས་པ me kha la ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས。
recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：sarba satwA nAM།  sid+d+h+yan+tu man+t+ra pa dA ya སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  འཕགས་པ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ha ya grI ba ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས rdzogs so།  @##།  ། rgya gar skad du།  ཨཱརྱ me kha la nA ma དྷཱ་ར་ཎཱི།  shig །  sdang ba thams cad zlog par gyis shig ། mi dang mi ma yin pa sdig pa byed pa rnams 'tsher ma gzhug cig ། sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། གསང་སྔགས kyi gzhi rnams grub par gyur cig སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  de la cho ga ni de bzhin gshegs su bzlog pa stsal bar bgyi'o།  ། tad+ya thA།  a baT+Ta ni།  baT+Ta ni།  i bi baT+Ta ni།  tsu lu tsi li།  ur+d+ha dAn+te།  sa man+ta།  dAn+te།  ni ra muN+De།  ni mi mu ni།  zhi ba dang །  bde legs su 'gyur bar bgyi'o སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo།（EWTS: sarba satwA nAM/ sid+d+h+yan+tu man+t+ra pa dA ya swA hA/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ha ya grI ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so// @##/ /rgya gar skad du/ Ar+ya me kha la nA ma d+hA ra NI/ shig / sdang ba thams cad zlog par gyis shig /mi dang mi ma yin pa sdig pa byed pa rnams 'tsher ma gzhug cig /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsang sngags kyi gzhi rnams grub par gyur cig swA hA/ de la cho ga ni de bzhin gshegs su bzlog pa stsal bar bgyi'o/ /tad+ya thA/ a baT+Ta ni/ baT+Ta ni/ i bi baT+Ta ni/ tsu lu tsi li/ ur+d+ha dAn+te/ sa man+ta/ dAn+te/ ni ra muN+De/ ni mi mu ni/ zhi ba dang / bde legs su 'gyur bar bgyi'o swA hA/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，彼、此尊（阳性主格）已，曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·远离寂静周遍·大空菩提点摄持）
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, having he, that one, beyond nominal designation (nāma) — expansive quiescence sealed with bodhicitta bindu

verses.meaningZh: 愿诸真言章句悉皆成就，真言、密咒（护心密语），向句、足迹、法位，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: May the mantra words be fully accomplished! Mantra, sacred formula, to/for word, verse-foot, step, abode, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 圣、尊贵圣者，无我大慈三昧·等虚空无碍·离一切相无相，陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义）
verses.meaningEn: Noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), selfless great loving-kindness & space-like boundlessness & freedom from conditioned marks, Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/100.txt，叶码：240a2(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：Ar+yA ba lo ki te shwa ra mA tA nA ma d+hA ra NI；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：འཕགས་པ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi yum ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས。

verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, Vidyā, sacred wisdom-spell, illumination, by name, called

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/100.txt，叶码：241b4(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：Ar+yA ba lo ki te shwa ra nA ma d+hA ra NI；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：འཕགས་པ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi གཟུངས ཞེས་བྱ་བ。
recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：cad las thar par 'gyur ro།  ། ཨོཾ ma Ni pad+me ཧཱུྃ།  zhes brjod pas འཕགས་པ spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal mthong bar 'gyur zhing །  tshe 'phos nas kyang bde ba can du skye ste།  'di la the tshom mam།  som nyi'am།  yid gnyis ma za dz+wa la dz+wa la ne།  tsa la tsa la ne།  pUrba yo ga sma ra པདྨ ha stA ya སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  gang gis rig pa 'di bklags pa de tshe rabs brgya stong du skye ba dran par 'gyur te།  'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang bde ba can gyi 'jig rten du skye bar 'gyur ro།  ། འཕགས་པ spyan ras gzigs kyi སྙིང་པོ rdzogs so།  །  ། 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། ན་མོ rat+na tra yA ya།  na ma Ar+yA ba lo ki te shwa rA ya།  bo d+hi satwA ya།  མ་ཧཱ satwA ya།  མ་ཧཱ kA ru Ni kA ya།  tad+ya thA།  ཨོཾ a ka Te།  bi ka De།  ni ka De།（EWTS: cad las thar par 'gyur ro/ /o~M ma Ni pad+me hU~M/ zhes brjod pas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal mthong bar 'gyur zhing / tshe 'phos nas kyang bde ba can du skye ste/ 'di la the tshom mam/ som nyi'am/ yid gnyis ma za dz+wa la dz+wa la ne/ tsa la tsa la ne/ pUrba yo ga sma ra pad+ma ha stA ya swA hA/ gang gis rig pa 'di bklags pa de tshe rabs brgya stong du skye ba dran par 'gyur te/ 'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang bde ba can gyi 'jig rten du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi snying po rdzogs so/ / //'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /na mo rat+na tra yA ya/ na ma Ar+yA ba lo ki te shwa rA ya/ bo d+hi satwA ya/ ma hA satwA ya/ ma hA kA ru Ni kA ya/ tad+ya thA/ o~M a ka Te/ bi ka De/ ni ka De/）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

deityZh: འཕགས་པ sgo drug pa ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/100.txt，叶码：260b1(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：Ar+ya Shan+mu kha nA ma d+hA ra NI；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：འཕགས་པ sgo drug pa ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས。
recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：par grol ba gang ci yod pa des sems can thams cad rnam par thar bar gyur cig །  'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa la bdag gnas par ma gyur cig ། tad+ya thA།  ཨོཾ k+Sha me k+Sha me།  k+ShAn+te k+ShA n+te།  da me da me།  dAn+te dAn+te།  b+ha dre b+ha dre།  su ya bi sho d+ha ni།  bA ga bi shwa d+ha ni།  ma naHsa~M shwa d+ha ni སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  rigs kyi bu dag de ltar na rigs kyi bu dang །  rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis sgo drug pa ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས 'di nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum bklags na de'i las kyi sgrib pa thams cad byang（EWTS: par grol ba gang ci yod pa des sems can thams cad rnam par thar bar gyur cig / 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa la bdag gnas par ma gyur cig /tad+ya thA/ oM k+Sha me k+Sha me/ k+ShAn+te k+ShA n+te/ da me da me/ dAn+te dAn+te/ b+ha dre b+ha dre/ su ya bi sho d+ha ni/ bA ga bi shwa d+ha ni/ ma naHsa~M shwa d+ha ni swA hA/ rigs kyi bu dag de ltar na rigs kyi bu dang / rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis sgo drug pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs 'di nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum bklags na de'i las kyi sgrib pa thams cad byang）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：satwa pa ri mo tsa kA ya།  tad+ya thA།  ཨོཾ b+hu ra b+hu ba སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  མ་ཧཱ A lo ka ka raN ta ma sti mi ra pa ta la bi nA sha ka།  rA ga dwe Sha མ་ཧཱ mo ha dz+wa la sha ma ka།  sha sa ka rak+Sha ka།  sarba a pA ya durga ti pra sha ma ka།  sarba satwa sa mA shwA sa na ka ra།  sarba A sha pa ri pU ra ka།  sarba ཏ་ཐཱ་ག་ཏ sa~M b+ha na ka ra།  he he མ་ཧཱ bo d+hi satwa།  ba ra ba ra dA ya ka།  པདྨ A lo ka sa~M b+ha ta།  མ་ཧཱ kA ru Ni ka།  dza TA mu ku Ta།  a la~M kr-i ta shi rA།  ma Ni ka na ka rA dza།  sha ta བཛྲ baiDUr+ya a la~M kr-i ta sha rI ra།  a mi tA b+ha dzi na ka ma la sa~M nya ra sa~M ha ra།  d+hu ru Ti།  d+hu ru Ti།  མ་ཧཱ maN+Da a laM ka ra Na།  sha ta pra se ka།  a ba bA si ta མ་ཧཱ bi Sha sha ma ka།  མ་ཧཱ bo d+hi satwa ba ra da སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས lag na པདྨ'i lus kyi dbyibs mdzes pa ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས།  byang（EWTS: satwa pa ri mo tsa kA ya/ tad+ya thA/ o~M b+hu ra b+hu ba swA hA/ ma hA A lo ka ka raN ta ma sti mi ra pa ta la bi nA sha ka/ rA ga dwe Sha ma hA mo ha dz+wa la sha ma ka/ sha sa ka rak+Sha ka/ sarba a pA ya durga ti pra sha ma ka/ sarba satwa sa mA shwA sa na ka ra/ sarba A sha pa ri pU ra ka/ sarba ta thA ga ta sa~M b+ha na ka ra/ he he ma hA bo d+hi satwa/ ba ra ba ra dA ya ka/ pad+ma A lo ka sa~M b+ha ta/ ma hA kA ru Ni ka/ dza TA mu ku Ta/ a la~M kr-i ta shi rA/ ma Ni ka na ka rA dza/ sha ta badzra baiDUr+ya a la~M kr-i ta sha rI ra/ a mi tA b+ha dzi na ka ma la sa~M nya ra sa~M ha ra/ d+hu ru Ti/ d+hu ru Ti/ ma hA maN+Da a laM ka ra Na/ sha ta pra se ka/ a ba bA si ta ma hA bi Sha sha ma ka/ ma hA bo d+hi satwa ba ra da swA hA/ bcom ldan 'das lag na pad+ma'i lus kyi dbyibs mdzes pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ byang）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：sangs rgyas dang །  བྱང་ཆུབ་སེམས་དཔའ thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། ཨོཾ ན་མོ བྷ་ག་བ་ཏེ།  bi pu la ba da na kAny+tsa nod k+Ship+ta།  pra b+hA sa ke tu mur+d+ha ne།  ta thA ga tA ya།  aR+ha te།  samyak+saM bud+d+ha ya།  ན་མོ བྷ་ག་བ་ཏེ shAkya mu na ye།  ta thA ga tA ya།  སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  mU la man+t+raM།  ཨོཾ sarba ཏ་ཐཱ་ག་ཏ bya ba lo ki te།  dza ya dza ya སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  hr-i da ya~M།  ཨོཾ hu ru hu ru dza ya mu khe སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  u pa hr-i da ya~M།  ཨོཾ བཛྲ A yu She སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  dge slong ngam།  dge slong ma'am།  dge bsnyen nam།  dge bsnyen ma'am།  gzhan ni 'jim pa la sogs pa yo byad thams cad la sngags 'di lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas par bya'o།  ། ཨོཾ ན་མོ བྷ་ག་བ་ཏེ bai ro tsa na pra b+ha rA dzA ya།  ta thA ga tA ya།  aR+ha te saM myak+saM bud+d+hA ya།  tad+ya thA།  ཨོཾ sU k+Sha me sU k+Sha me sa me sa ma ye།  shAn+te dAn+te a sa mA（EWTS: sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /o~M na mo b+ha ga ba te/ bi pu la ba da na kAny+tsa nod k+Ship+ta/ pra b+hA sa ke tu mur+d+ha ne/ ta thA ga tA ya/ aR+ha te/ samyak+saM bud+d+ha ya/ na mo b+ha ga ba te shAkya mu na ye/ ta thA ga tA ya/ swA hA/ mU la man+t+raM/ oM sarba ta thA ga ta bya ba lo ki te/ dza ya dza ya swA hA/ hr-i da ya~M/ o~M hu ru hu ru dza ya mu khe swA hA/ u pa hr-i da ya~M/ o~M badzra A yu She swA hA/ dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma'am/ gzhan ni 'jim pa la sogs pa yo byad thams cad la sngags 'di lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas par bya'o/ /o~M na mo b+ha ga ba te bai ro tsa na pra b+ha rA dzA ya/ ta thA ga tA ya/ aR+ha te saM myak+saM bud+d+hA ya/ tad+ya thA/ oM sU k+Sha me sU k+Sha me sa me sa ma ye/ shAn+te dAn+te a sa mA）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

verses.meaningZh: 广大、宽博无量，解脱系缚大力·施度调伏·离名相假立，造作离相·圣智通达·妙行迁变空，陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，打击、染污
verses.meaningEn: Vast, extensive, abundant, profound, spiritual strength freeing bonds & generosity & self-mastery & beyond nominal designation, freedom from karmic agency & non-dual wisdom awareness & awakened conduct beyond flux, generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — consecrating Dharma-stream, thrown, tossed, hit, afflicted

verses.iast: oṃ jaya jaya vijaya vijaya jayavāhini śaṅkari śaṅkari prabhaṅkari sarvaśatruṃ

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! conquer! victory! again and again, supreme victory! triumph! again and again, conquering (vocative invocation), O Sankara again and again, making (vocative invocation), all + enemy

verses.iast: jambhaya stambhaya mohaya bhagavati jayavāhini mathā mathā pramathā pramathā grasa
verses.meaningZh: 请调伏、摧折憍慢魔障！请制止、令暴恶魔障止息不动！请令怨魔迷闷失其毒力！世尊佛母！（呼格），尊胜降伏·生起不可得·尊胜，再三摧碎魔军与我慢烦恼（末他），再三那罗，妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: Crush! quell jaws of hostility! immobilize! halt hostile forces! bewilder hostile forces! O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! conquering (vocative invocation), churn and crush demonic hindrances! again and again, tormentor again and again, awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness

verses.meaningZh: 妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢·一切诸谛圆满，再三笑声，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！再三光明，腹垂尊，三眼目，四面目
verses.meaningEn: Awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, laughter, mirth again and again, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! light again and again, O having a large belly, three + O eye, four + O meters

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/100.txt，叶码：268b7(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：Ar+ya ka na ka ba ti nA ma d+hA ra NI；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：འཕགས་པ gser can ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས。

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), all + purifier of connected with hindrances, by name, called, Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：pa med par spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ rjes su dran par byas nas།  rang gi སྙིང་པོ gzhan gyis mi thub pa དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ thams cad kyis gsungs pa 'di smras so།  ། ཨོཾ ta ra ta ra།  tA yak+Sha rA k+Sha sa།  a d+hiSh+Thi te།  prah+ma b+hA Shi te།  in+d+ra b+hA Shi te།  tsa tu ra མ་ཧཱ rA dza b+hA Shi te།  tsan+d+ra sUr+ya b+hA Shi te།  ཨོཾ ti ri ti ri།  tsan+d+ra kI ra Ne།  ki li ki li།  sarba sha trU~M bi nA sha ni ཧཱུྃ ཕཊ སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  de nas བྱང་ཆུབ་སེམས་དཔའ yA mi།  ཨོཾ སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  pa bi tre སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  shwe te སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  shwe te pa ta pa bit+t+re སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  tad+ya thA།  tA re tA re།  tA ri Ni rak+Sha rak+Sha།  sarba ka li།  ka la ha།  bi gra ha།  bi byA d+hi།  duHsop+na b+ha ye b+h+yaHསྭཱ་ཧཱ།  rtag tu le lo med（EWTS: pa med par spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis de bzhin gshegs pa rjes su dran par byas nas/ rang gi snying po gzhan gyis mi thub pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsungs pa 'di smras so/ /o~M ta ra ta ra/ tA yak+Sha rA k+Sha sa/ a d+hiSh+Thi te/ prah+ma b+hA Shi te/ in+d+ra b+hA Shi te/ tsa tu ra ma hA rA dza b+hA Shi te/ tsan+d+ra sUr+ya b+hA Shi te/ o~M ti ri ti ri/ tsan+d+ra kI ra Ne/ ki li ki li/ sarba sha trU~M bi nA sha ni hU~M phaT swA hA/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' yA mi/ oM swA hA/ pa bi tre swA hA/ shwe te swA hA/ shwe te pa ta pa bit+t+re swA hA/ tad+ya thA/ tA re tA re/ tA ri Ni rak+Sha rak+Sha/ sarba ka li/ ka la ha/ bi gra ha/ bi byA d+hi/ duHsop+na b+ha ye b+h+yaHswA hA/ rtag tu le lo med）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/100.txt，叶码：279b7(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：Ar+yA Sh+Ta ma hA b+ha ya tA ra NI nA ma d+hA ra NI；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：འཕགས་པ 'jigs pa chen po brgyad las sgrol pa ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས。
recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：ya kalbe།  kalbe ni།  ga Ne a nan+ta kalbe།  a mr-i ta kalbe།  hu tA sha re།  a nan+ta mu khe།  a nan+ta tsak+Shu sa mut+ga te།  ཨོཾ b+ha སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  rigs kyi bu གཟུངས kyi གསང་སྔགས 'di dag ni sems can ngan song du 'gro ba rnams kyi don gyi phyir།  sangs na maHsarba bid+yA།  sid+d+h+ya n+tu me man+t+ra pA da སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  འཕགས་པ 'jigs pa chen po brgyad las sgrol ba ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས rdzogs །  @#།  ། འཕགས་པ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa'i གཟུངས།  བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས ma yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། tad+ya thA།  ཨོཾ mu ni d+harme།  saM gra ha d+harme།  a nu gra ha d+harme།  bi mu k+tid+harme།  sA ra a nu gra ha d+harme།  bai shra ba Na pa ri brta（EWTS: ya kalbe/ kalbe ni/ ga Ne a nan+ta kalbe/ a mr-i ta kalbe/ hu tA sha re/ a nan+ta mu khe/ a nan+ta tsak+Shu sa mut+ga te/ o~M b+ha swA hA/ rigs kyi bu gzungs kyi gsang sngags 'di dag ni sems can ngan song du 'gro ba rnams kyi don gyi phyir/ sangs na maHsarba bid+yA/ sid+d+h+ya n+tu me man+t+ra pA da swA hA/ 'phags pa 'jigs pa chen po brgyad las sgrol ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs // @#/ /'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa'i gzungs/ bcom ldan 'das ma yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tad+ya thA/ o~M mu ni d+harme/ saM gra ha d+harme/ a nu gra ha d+harme/ bi mu k+tid+harme/ sA ra a nu gra ha d+harme/ bai shra ba Na pa ri brta）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/101.txt，叶码：41b1(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：Ar+ya nI lAm+ba ra d+ha ra badzra pA Ni ka lpa nA ma d+hA ra NI；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：འཕགས་པ lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi cho ga ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས。
recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：rgya gar skad du།  ཨཱརྱ nI lAm+ba ra d+ha ra བཛྲ pA Ni ka lpa nA ma དྷཱ་ར་ཎཱི།  bod skad du།  འཕགས་པ lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi cho ga ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས།  dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can sangs gsungs pa'i རིག་སྔགས 'di brjod par bya'o།  ། tad+ya thA།  b+ho b+ho bAn+nA ga a d+hi pa ta ye།  id n+nI lA~M bar d+ha ra sha rI ra~M།  བཛྲ pA Ni hr-i da ya~M།  yaHsa mA ti kra ma tha།  ut+sa da na~M b+ha bi Sh+ya ti།  tad+ya thA།  bud+d+ha phud+d+ha།  bi bud+d+ha bi bud+d+ha།  ma hi prA p+ta།  ha ra ha ra nA gA nA~M།  bra ha ra pra ha ra nA gA nA~M།  ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da nA ga hri da yA ni།  b+hin+d+ha b+hin+d+ha nA ga ma rmA Ni།  bi sI r+yan+tu nA ga sha rI rA Ni།  bispo Ta ya nA ga nA ya nA ni།  tad+ya thA།  ཧཱུྃ ཕཊ།  nA ga bi da ra NA ya ཕཊ།  nA got+sa da nA ya ཕཊ།  nI lA~M pa sa nA ya ཕཊ།  a pra ti ha ta pa la pa rA kra mA ya ཕཊ།  kr-i tAn+tA ya ཕཊ།  kr-itAn+ta rU pA ya（EWTS: @#/ /rgya gar skad du/ Ar+ya nI lAm+ba ra d+ha ra badzra pA Ni ka lpa nA ma d+hA ra NI/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can gyi cho ga zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje gos sngon po can sangs gsungs pa'i rig sngags 'di brjod par bya'o/ /tad+ya thA/ b+ho b+ho bAn+nA ga a d+hi pa ta ye/ id n+nI lA~M bar d+ha ra sha rI ra~M/ badzra pA Ni hr-i da ya~M/ yaHsa mA ti kra ma tha/ ut+sa da na~M b+ha bi Sh+ya ti/ tad+ya thA/ bud+d+ha phud+d+ha/ bi bud+d+ha bi bud+d+ha/ ma hi prA p+ta/ ha ra ha ra nA gA nA~M/ bra ha ra pra ha ra nA gA nA~M/ ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da nA ga hri da yA ni/ b+hin+d+ha b+hin+d+ha nA ga ma rmA Ni/ bi sI r+yan+tu nA ga sha rI rA Ni/ bispo Ta ya nA ga nA ya nA ni/ tad+ya thA/ hU~M phaT/ nA ga bi da ra NA ya phaT/ nA got+sa da nA ya phaT/ nI lA~M pa sa nA ya phaT/ a pra ti ha ta pa la pa rA kra mA ya phaT/ kr-i tAn+tA ya phaT/ kr-itAn+ta rU pA ya）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

verses.iast: ārya nī lāmba radhara vajra pāṇikanāma dhāraṇī
verses.meaningZh: 圣、尊贵圣者，曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·禅定三昧总持），离一切相无相·无我大慈三昧·解脱系缚大力，持啰尊，金刚（坚固不坏、摧破一切障），手掌·女孩子·是的，陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义）
verses.meaningEn: Noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), beyond nominal designation (nāma) — deep samādhi retention, freedom from conditioned marks & selfless great loving-kindness & spiritual strength freeing bonds, holder of ra, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, hand + a girl + yes, Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/101.txt，叶码：50a1(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：badzra sU k+Sh+ma a pra ti ha ta nA ma d+hA ra NI；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：rdo rje phra mo thogs pa med pa ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས。
recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：rgya gar skad du།  བཛྲ sU k+Sh+ma a pra ti ha ta nA ma དྷཱ་ར་ཎཱི།  bod skad du།  rdo rje phra mo thogs pa med pa ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས།  sangs rgyas dang བྱང་ཆུབ་སེམས་དཔའ thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na།  བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས rdo rje rigs pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so།  ། sangs rgyas kyi mthus gsang ba pa'i bdag po rdo rje ཧཱུྃ ཞེས་བྱ་བs bzhin rab tu 'bar ba bstan te།  བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས kyi thad du 'dug go།  ། de'i tshe བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས kyi thugs kyi sprul pa las bram ze'i khye'u cig byung ste།  གཟུངས sngags rnams rab tu brjod du gsol།  lag na rdo rjes smras pa།  bram ze'i khye'u rab tu nyon la yid la zung shig dang །  nga yis bde gshegs khro bo thams cad kyis rtag tu brjod pa'i yang snying 'di rab tu smras so།  ། ན་མོ rat+na tra yA ya།  na ma sh+tsaN+Da བཛྲ pA Na ye།  མ་ཧཱ（EWTS: @#/ /rgya gar skad du/ badzra sU k+Sh+ma a pra ti ha ta nA ma d+hA ra NI/ bod skad du/ rdo rje phra mo thogs pa med pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rigs pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi mthus gsang ba pa'i bdag po rdo rje hU~M zhes bya bas bzhin rab tu 'bar ba bstan te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du 'dug go/ /de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kyi sprul pa las bram ze'i khye'u cig byung ste/ gzungs sngags rnams rab tu brjod du gsol/ lag na rdo rjes smras pa/ bram ze'i khye'u rab tu nyon la yid la zung shig dang / nga yis bde gshegs khro bo thams cad kyis rtag tu brjod pa'i yang snying 'di rab tu smras so/ /na mo rat+na tra yA ya/ na ma sh+tsaN+Da badzra pA Na ye/ ma hA）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。
