meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/101.txt，叶码：50b3(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：Ar+ya badzra b+hai ra ba d+hA ra NI nA ma；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：ཨཱརྱ བཛྲ b+hai ra ba དྷཱ་ར་ཎཱི nA ma。

verses.meaningZh: 胜伏、最胜吉祥！再三成办羯磨事业（俱噜）
verses.meaningEn: Conquer! victory! accomplish & enact this sacred work! again and again

verses.iast: ārya caurabi dhvansa na nāma dhāraṇī
verses.meaningZh: 圣、尊贵圣者，妙行迁变空·清净离诸尘垢·解脱系缚大力，面纱彼，不、非、无，名为、号曰，陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义）
verses.meaningEn: Noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), awakened conduct beyond flux & stainless purity free from dust & spiritual strength freeing bonds (vocative invocation), veil + he, not, non-, by name, called, Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/101.txt，叶码：57b2(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：Ar+ya a tsa la nA ma d+hA ra NI；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：འཕགས་པ khro bo mi g.yo 57b3(གཟུངས): ba'i གཟུངས ཞེས་བྱ་བ。
recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：rigs ldan ljang gus ga shal byas pa།  mtha' yas dang 'jog po nag pos zhabs gdub byas pa།  tshangs pa dang །  khyab 'jug dang །  dbang phyug dang །  klu dang །  gnod sbyin dang །  sha za dang 'byung po thams cad ha hi ཧཱུྃ zhes brjod pas skrag par byed pa།  ha~M ma~M གསང་སྔགས smras pa།  na maHsa man+ta ཨཱརྱ tsa la na~M།  tra Ta tra Ta།  a mo g+ha tsaN+Da མ་ཧཱ ro Sha Na།  s+pho Ta ya s+pho Ta ya ཧཱུྃ།  tra ma ya tra ma ya ཧཱུྃ ཕཊ།  t+r+wa thaHha~M ma~M།  tad+ya thA།  ཨོཾ AHཧཱུྃ།  shud+d+he shud+d+he།  ra~M ho ya།  bi shud+d+he bi shud+d+he།  a shu ma~M bi shu ra~M།  sho d+ha ne bi sho d+ha ne།  tsaN+Da tsaN+Da།  ma ma།  ba la ba la།  ma ra ma ra།  ma ra ya ma ra ya།  sarba sha tru~M།  sarba big+h+na na།  sarba duSh+Ta~M ཧཱུྃ ཕཊ།  ཨོཾ tsaN+Da མ་ཧཱ ro Sha Na ཧཱུྃ ཕཊ།  de'i cho ga la ha~M ma~M ཞེས་བྱ་བ rdzas gang dang gang la bkod de།  sngags 'di brgya rtsa brgyad du sngags na gang bsgrubs pa 'grub（EWTS: rigs ldan ljang gus ga shal byas pa/ mtha' yas dang 'jog po nag pos zhabs gdub byas pa/ tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / sha za dang 'byung po thams cad ha hi hU~M zhes brjod pas skrag par byed pa/ ha~M ma~M gsang sngags smras pa/ na maHsa man+ta Ar+ya tsa la na~M/ tra Ta tra Ta/ a mo g+ha tsaN+Da ma hA ro Sha Na/ s+pho Ta ya s+pho Ta ya hU~M/ tra ma ya tra ma ya hU~M phaT/ t+r+wa thaHha~M ma~M/ tad+ya thA/ o~M AHhU~M/ shud+d+he shud+d+he/ ra~M ho ya/ bi shud+d+he bi shud+d+he/ a shu ma~M bi shu ra~M/ sho d+ha ne bi sho d+ha ne/ tsaN+Da tsaN+Da/ ma ma/ ba la ba la/ ma ra ma ra/ ma ra ya ma ra ya/ sarba sha tru~M/ sarba big+h+na na/ sarba duSh+Ta~M hU~M phaT/ o~M tsaN+Da ma hA ro Sha Na hU~M phaT/ de'i cho ga la ha~M ma~M zhes bya ba rdzas gang dang gang la bkod de/ sngags 'di brgya rtsa brgyad du sngags na gang bsgrubs pa 'grub）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/101.txt，叶码：86a6(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：Ar+ya ma Ni b+ha dra nA ma d+hA ra NI；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：འཕགས་པ nor bu bzang po'i གཟུངས ཞེས་བྱ་བ。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/101.txt，叶码：87a1(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：kA ru Ni ka s+ya Ar+ya dzam+b+ha la dza lan+d+ra su shaM ka ra nA ma d+hA ra NI；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：འཕགས་པ gnod 'dzin chu dbang snying rje can gyi གཟུངས bde byed ces bya ba。

verses.meaningZh: 施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢，真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，妙行趣入·解脱系缚大力·清净离诸尘垢，真如实际·解脱系缚大力·造作离相，药叉（夜叉护法捷疾神），三昧耶（本誓、平等契合、时际），那罗矣，莲华部心印金刚不坏菩提心印，泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust (imperative seal), awakened spiritual movement & spiritual strength freeing bonds & stainless purity free from dust, immutable Suchness & spiritual strength freeing bonds & freedom from karmic agency, Yakṣa, nature/wealth guardian spirit, Samaya, sacred vow, pledge, union, man + particle to express certainty, Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara + adamantine bodhicitta seed syllable, Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/101.txt，叶码：90a3(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：Ar+ya b+ha dra rA trI nA ma sU tra；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：འཕགས་པ mtshan mo bzang po ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i mdo。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/101.txt，叶码：96b3(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：Ar+ya bratI t+ya sa mut+pA da hr-i da ya bi d+hi d+hA ra NI；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：འཕགས་པ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba'i snying bo'i cho ga'i གཟུངས。
recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：བྱང་ཆུབ་སེམས་དཔའ rnams la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། brtul zhugs grub pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། sems can gyi sman pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། nor bu grub pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། 'di lta ste།  ན་མོ rat+na tra yA ya།  ཨོཾ ye d+harmA he tupra b+ha bA he tu na te ShA~M ta bu kha zas la།  ། bdun nam nyi shu bzlas nas kyang །  ། khong du btang na phan par 'gyur།  ། de yi bzlas brjod snga ma ste། 'di dag rab tu bzlas bar bya།  ། ན་མོ rat+na tra yA ya།  ཨོཾ ye ng+harmA he tu pra b+ha bA he tu na tA+e NI ta thA ga to h+ya ba datA།  ། te ShA ny+tsa ya na rat+na aM gi wang la ni sngags bzlas nas།  ། སྙིང་པོ stobs chen 'di bris gdags།  ། ཨོཾ བཛྲ kro d+ha མ་ཧཱ ba la ha na da ha pa tsa bi d+h+wan+sa ya dza Ti lཨོཾ b+ho d+ha ra u ts+tshuSh+ma kro d+ha ཧཱུྃ ཕཊ སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  ། gtsang sbra byas te mgul par gdags།  ། de bzhin yungs kar dag la yang །  ། bzlas（EWTS: byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brtul zhugs grub pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can gyi sman pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nor bu grub pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di lta ste/ na mo rat+na tra yA ya/ o~M ye d+harmA he tupra b+ha bA he tu na te ShA~M ta bu kha zas la/ /bdun nam nyi shu bzlas nas kyang / /khong du btang na phan par 'gyur/ /de yi bzlas brjod snga ma ste//'di dag rab tu bzlas bar bya/ /na mo rat+na tra yA ya/ o~M ye ng+harmA he tu pra b+ha bA he tu na tA+e NI ta thA ga to h+ya ba datA/ /te ShA ny+tsa ya na rat+na aM gi wang la ni sngags bzlas nas/ /snying po stobs chen 'di bris gdags/ /o~M badzra kro d+ha ma hA ba la ha na da ha pa tsa bi d+h+wan+sa ya dza Ti loM b+ho d+ha ra u ts+tshuSh+ma kro d+ha hU~M phaT swA hA/ /gtsang sbra byas te mgul par gdags/ /de bzhin yungs kar dag la yang / /bzlas）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

verses.iast: oṃ ye dharmā hetuprabhavā hetuṃ teṣāṃ tathāgato hy avadat teṣāṃ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！凡彼等诸有情，正法、诸法实相，因生，因，彼等一切之，如来，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），最上真言离言说·施度调伏·真如实际，彼等一切之
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! those who, whoever (pl.), Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena, cause + excelling, cause, of them, their, tathāgato, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery & immutable Suchness, of them, their

verses.diplomaticOriginal: 'di lta ste ། ན་མོ rat+na tra yA ya ། ཨོཾ ye d+harmA he tupra b+ha bA he tu na te ShA~M ta bu kha zas la ། bdun nam nyi shu bzlas nas kyang ། khong du btang na phan par 'gyur །

verses.iast: ca yo nirodha evaṃvādī mahāśramaṇaḥ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 左字门（妙行迁变空（caryā）·本不生体性），凡彼圣尊、能…者，灭谛，如是论者，大沙门，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux (caryā) — primordial non-arising, who, whichever, suppression, thus + vādī, great, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 藏文音译原貌：བྱང་ཆུབ་སེམས་དཔའ rnams la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། brtul zhugs grub pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། sems can gyi sman pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། nor bu grub pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། 'di lta ste།  ན་མོ rat+na tra yA ya།  ཨོཾ ye d+harmA he tupra b+ha bA he tu na te ShA~M ta bu kha zas la།  ། bdun nam nyi shu bzlas nas kyang །  ། khong du btang na phan par 'gyur།  ། de yi bzlas brjod snga ma ste། 'di dag rab tu bzlas bar bya།  ། ན་མོ rat+na tra yA ya།  ཨོཾ ye ng+harmA he tu pra b+ha bA he tu na tA+e NI ta thA ga to h+ya ba datA།  ། te ShA ny+tsa ya na rat+na aM gi wang la ni sngags bzlas nas།  ། སྙིང་པོ stobs chen 'di bris gdags།  ། ཨོཾ བཛྲ kro d+ha མ་ཧཱ ba la ha na da ha pa tsa bi d+h+wan+sa ya dza Ti lཨོཾ b+ho d+ha ra u ts+tshuSh+ma kro d+ha ཧཱུྃ ཕཊ སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  ། gtsang sbra byas te mgul par gdags།  ། de bzhin yungs kar dag la yang །  ། bzlas
verses.diplomaticOriginal: de yi bzlas brjod snga ma ste ། 'di dag rab tu bzlas bar bya ། ན་མོ rat+na tra yA ya ། ཨོཾ ye ng+harmA he tu pra b+ha bA he tu na tA+e NI ta thA ga to h+ya ba datA ། te ShA ny+tsa ya na rat+na aM gi wang la ni sngags bzlas nas །

verses.iast: oṃ vajrakrodha mahābala hana daha paca vidhvaṃsaya jaṭiloṃbhodhara ucchuṣmakrodha hūṃ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！金刚忿，大力威神、大势力尊，击破怨魔与无明惑（贺曩），智火焚净一切罪垢（娜贺），成熟善根、烧尽业障（跛左），请彻底摧毁、令其坏散无余！持守摄受·生起不可得·尊胜，乌枢沙摩明王忿，吽（金刚心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Vajra + wrath, of great power and might, strike down afflictions and mara-forces! incinerate all defilements with wisdom-fire! ripen merit and burn away karmic obstructions! utterly demolish and disperse! bearing, Ucchuṣma + wrath, Hūṃ! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: sarva tathāgata guhya a dhiṣṣā na adhiṣṭhi te svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，如来（乘如实道来成正觉），密，悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性，法界总持任持·六度满行清净，不、非、无，居民尊，向汝、彼等，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, hidden or covered, secret, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'a': primordial non-arising, Dharma-realm retention & perfection of the six pāramitās, not, non-, O resident, permanently abiding, to Thee / they, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: oṃ namo bhagavate sarva trailokya prati viśiṣṭāya buddhā yate namaḥ tadya thā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊（薄伽梵）致敬，一切、普皆遍满，三界、三千世界，对，向殊胜，佛陀、觉者，拘牵尊，归命，真如实际·施度调伏·一乘如实之道，他字门（无住安立（sthāna）·远离寂静周遍）
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, all, every, complete, the Three Worlds (Trailokya), toward, to/for separate, distinct, marked by, Buddha, the Awakened One, O held, restrained, checked, controlled / in held, restrained, checked, controlled, homage to immutable Suchness & generosity & self-mastery & supreme vehicle of awakening, non-abiding equipoise (sthāna) — expansive quiescence

verses.diplomaticOriginal: ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so ། བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu gtsug tor gyi gseb nas གསང་སྔགས kyi gzhi 'di dag byung ngo ། ན་མོ བྷ་ག་བ་ཏེ uSh+NI ShA ya shud+d+he bi ra dze bi ma le སྭཱ་ཧཱ ། བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས bsrung ba mdzad du gsol ། ཨོཾ raM Shi ga Na pra shA sta sarba ta thA ga toSh+NI Sha si tA ta pa tre ཧཱུྃ drU~M hrU~MHSh+Tཨོཾ །

verses.iast: oṃ ṛṣigaṇapraśastāya sarvatathāgatoṣṇīṣasitātapatre hūṃ ṭrūṃ jambhanakarī hūṃ ṭrūṃ stambhanakarī hūṃ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！向仙人海会众善祥，一切如来·佛顶肉髻相·大白伞盖尊，吽（金刚心印）！金刚顶护身结界心印，能作令愚尊，吽（金刚心印）！金刚顶护身结界心印，能作僵仆尊，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Ṛṣi + assembly + to, all Tathagatas + Uṣṇīṣa + O White Parasol, Hūṃ! vajra-armor protection seed syllable, maker of crushing, destroying, Hūṃ! vajra-armor protection seed syllable, maker of laming, paralyzing, fixing, stopping, restraining, Hūṃ!

verses.iast: ṭrūṃ mohanakarī hūṃ ṭrūṃ rakṣa rakṣa māṃ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 金刚顶护身结界心印，能作作昏尊，吽（金刚心印）！金刚顶护身结界心印，祈请再三拥护、守护于我，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Vajra-armor protection seed syllable, maker of stupefying, perplexing, deceiving, Hūṃ! vajra-armor protection seed syllable, evermore protect, guard and shelter me, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: oṃ ṛṣigaṇapra śasta ya sarva tathāga toṣṇī ṣasitātapatre hūṃ dhūṃ
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！仙人·海会众·转载，吉祥、喜悦，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），一切、普皆遍满，如是宝树宝山，真如实际·六度满行清净·离诸诤论无诤，六度满行清净·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，吽（金刚心印）！驮字门（法界总持任持（dhātu
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! deityZh: dpal lha mo gtsug tor rol pa'i tan+t+ra
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/101.txt，叶码：138b2(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：138b3(gzungs): shrI de bi uSh+NA Sha la lA tan+t+ra；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：dpal lha mo gtsug tor rol pa'i tan+t+ra。
recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：do།  ། phur bus gdab bo།  ། gnod byed kyi gdon dang །  smyo byed rnga zhon gyi gdon dang །  grong rgyun la sogs pa'i gdon rnams ni smyo byed gdon du za ba yin pas na shugs sgrol ma'i རིག་སྔགས kyis gcad do།  ། རིག་སྔགས 'chang gi phur bus gdab po།  ། ཨོཾ a ka ra pra ma ni b+h+yaHཕཊ།  sha tu ma ki li ki la ya ཧཱུྃ ཕཊ།  bud med nag mor mngon pa dang །  ། rnal 'byor spyan rtul byed pa ni།  ། sgrol byed nag mo'i gdon yin pas།  ། legs ldan dka' thub kyi རིག་སྔགས kyis gcad do།  ། shugs sgrol ma dbang phyug gtso mo'i phur bus gdab po།  ། sarba pra ma ni b+h+yaHཕཊ།  ro ti ba~M ki li ki la ya ཧཱུྃ ཕཊ།  skya rims klad pa na ba dang །  ། rkang lag 'khol ba'i nad byung na 'byung po nag po'i gdon yin pas dpal chen dbang gi རིག་སྔགས kyis gcad do།  ། shugs sgrol chen mo'i phur bus gdab po།  ། dza（EWTS: do/ /phur bus gdab bo/ /gnod byed kyi gdon dang / smyo byed rnga zhon gyi gdon dang / grong rgyun la sogs pa'i gdon rnams ni smyo byed gdon du za ba yin pas na shugs sgrol ma'i rig sngags kyis gcad do/ /rig sngags 'chang gi phur bus gdab po/ /o~M a ka ra pra ma ni b+h+yaHphaT/ sha tu ma ki li ki la ya hU~M phaT/ bud med nag mor mngon pa dang / /rnal 'byor spyan rtul byed pa ni/ /sgrol byed nag mo'i gdon yin pas/ /legs ldan dka' thub kyi rig sngags kyis gcad do/ /shugs sgrol ma dbang phyug gtso mo'i phur bus gdab po/ /sarba pra ma ni b+h+yaHphaT/ ro ti ba~M ki li ki la ya hU~M phaT/ skya rims klad pa na ba dang / /rkang lag 'khol ba'i nad byung na 'byung po nag po'i gdon yin pas dpal chen dbang gi rig sngags kyis gcad do/ /shugs sgrol chen mo'i phur bus gdab po/ /dza）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

deityZh: 'phags ma 'od zer can ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/101.txt，叶码：142a1(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：Ar+ya mA rI tsI nA ma d+hA ra NI；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：'phags ma 'od zer can ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས。
recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：breg tu med par gyur cig །  gzhur med par gyur cig ། tshig par byar med par gyur cig ། dgra'i dbang du mi 'gro bar gyur cig ། de la གསང་སྔགས kyi tshig ni 'di rnams yin no།  ། tad+ya thA།  ཨོཾ pa tA kra ma si།  ba rA kra ma si།  u da ya ma si།  nai ra ma si།  ar+k+ka ma si།  mar+k+ka ma si།  ur ma ma si།  pha na ma si།  gul ma ma si།  tsI ba ra ma si།  མ་ཧཱ tsI bar ma si།  an+ta rad+haM na ma si སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  ཨོཾ lha mo 'od zer can bdag lam du skyobs shig ། bdag lam log pa las skyobs shig ། bdag skye srungs shig །  bdag sbrul las srungs shig སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  bdag 'jigs pa thams cad dang །  gnod pa dang །  nad 'go ba dang །  'khrugs pa thams cad las srungs shig srungs shig ། ན་མོ rat+na tra yA ya།  tad+ya thA།  ཨོཾ A lo།  tA lo།  kA lo།  sats+tsha lo sa ma（EWTS: breg tu med par gyur cig / gzhur med par gyur cig /tshig par byar med par gyur cig /dgra'i dbang du mi 'gro bar gyur cig /de la gsang sngags kyi tshig ni 'di rnams yin no/ /tad+ya thA/ oM pa tA kra ma si/ ba rA kra ma si/ u da ya ma si/ nai ra ma si/ ar+k+ka ma si/ mar+k+ka ma si/ ur ma ma si/ pha na ma si/ gul ma ma si/ tsI ba ra ma si/ ma hA tsI bar ma si/ an+ta rad+haM na ma si swA hA/ oM lha mo 'od zer can bdag lam du skyobs shig /bdag lam log pa las skyobs shig /bdag skye srungs shig / bdag sbrul las srungs shig swA hA/ bdag 'jigs pa thams cad dang / gnod pa dang / nad 'go ba dang / 'khrugs pa thams cad las srungs shig srungs shig /na mo rat+na tra yA ya/ tad+ya thA/ oM A lo/ tA lo/ kA lo/ sats+tsha lo sa ma）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

titleZh: 【DB9·维也纳rKTs】德格版《陀罗尼集》D994：āryā sarva dharma mā tṛ kā nā m-i dhāraṇī
titleSanskritIast: āryā sarva dharma mā tṛ kā nā m-i dhāraṇī
titleEnglish: Vienna rKTs Derge Zungdu (D994): āryā sarva dharma mā tṛ kā nā m-i dhāraṇī
translatorZh: 维也纳大学 rKTs 德格版甘珠尔《陀罗尼集 (gZungs 'dus)》(1D/101.txt)
sutraSourceZh: Derge Zungdu 1D/101.txt · Folio 149b6(gzungs) ('phags ma chos thams cad kyi yum ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས)
deityZh: 'phags ma chos thams cad kyi yum ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/101.txt，叶码：149b6(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：Ar+yA sarba d+harma mA tr-i kA nA m-i d+hA ra NI；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：'phags ma chos thams cad kyi yum ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས。
recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：ba ta ni སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  de nas gnas gtsang ma'i lha rnams kyis བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས la 'di skad ces gsol to།  ། བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས bdag cag gis གཟུངས 'di'i སྙིང་པོ brjod par bgyi'o།  ། tad+ya thA།  ats+tshe།  a na le།  e lu le།  e khu phe།  mur+d+ha a nu ga te sarba d+harma a d+hi pa ta ye།  prA pa te dz+yosna ka ra a d+hi ga ta dz+nyA ne bi shud+d+he ba ti སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas།  tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang །  thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dag yi rangs te།  བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས（EWTS: ba ta ni swA hA/ de nas gnas gtsang ma'i lha rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis gzungs 'di'i snying po brjod par bgyi'o/ /tad+ya thA/ ats+tshe/ a na le/ e lu le/ e khu phe/ mur+d+ha a nu ga te sarba d+harma a d+hi pa ta ye/ prA pa te dz+yosna ka ra a d+hi ga ta dz+nyA ne bi shud+d+he ba ti swA hA/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dag yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

verses.meaningZh: 遭，生起不可得·尊胜·一乘如实之道·一切诸谛圆满，掌，圣智了知·法界总持任持，清净、纯洁无染尊，解脱系缚大力·真如实际·一切诸谛圆满

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/101.txt，叶码：150a4(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：Ar+ya gra ha mA hr-i kA nA ma d+hA ra NI；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：'phags 150a5(གཟུངས): ma gza' rnams kyi yum ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས。
recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：gnyis pa la sgo bzhis mdzes pa rim pa bzhin du byas pa la པདྨ rgyas pa'i steng du lha nyi ma bsam par bya ba ni lus gzi brjid kyi phung po li khri nye bar 'bar ba lta bu nyi ma stong dang mtshungs ba'i 'od zer can no།  ། ཨོཾ mai g+holkA ya སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  shar du zla ba dkar bo།  ཨོཾ shi tAM sha be སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  me'i mtshams su mig dmar po།  ཨོཾ rak+tAM ga ku mA rA ya སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  gshin rje'i phyogs su rgyal rigs gza' lhag mdog ser po།  ཨོཾ bu d+hA ya སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  bden bral du phur bu dmar ser།  ཨོཾ braM ha spa ha ye སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  nub kyi phyogs su ba ba sangs dkar po།  ཨོཾ a su rot+ta mA ya སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  rlung du spen pa mig sman ltar shin tu gnag pa།  ཨོཾ kr-iSh+Na war+N+N+la ya སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  lus ngan po'i phyogs su sgra gcan dmar nag ། ཨོཾ a mr-i ta pri yA ya སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  dbang ldan gyi mtshams su（EWTS: gnyis pa la sgo bzhis mdzes pa rim pa bzhin du byas pa la pad+ma rgyas pa'i steng du lha nyi ma bsam par bya ba ni lus gzi brjid kyi phung po li khri nye bar 'bar ba lta bu nyi ma stong dang mtshungs ba'i 'od zer can no/ /oM mai g+holkA ya swA hA/ shar du zla ba dkar bo/ oM shi tAM sha be swA hA/ me'i mtshams su mig dmar po/ oM rak+tAM ga ku mA rA ya swA hA/ gshin rje'i phyogs su rgyal rigs gza' lhag mdog ser po/ oM bu d+hA ya swA hA/ bden bral du phur bu dmar ser/ oM braM ha spa ha ye swA hA/ nub kyi phyogs su ba ba sangs dkar po/ oM a su rot+ta mA ya swA hA/ rlung du spen pa mig sman ltar shin tu gnag pa/ oM kr-iSh+Na war+N+N+la ya swA hA/ lus ngan po'i phyogs su sgra gcan dmar nag /oM a mr-i ta pri yA ya swA hA/ dbang ldan gyi mtshams su）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

verses.diplomaticOriginal: nub kyi phyogs su ba ba sangs dkar po ། ཨོཾ a su rot+ta mA ya སྭཱ་ཧཱ །

deityZh: rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa ཞེས་བྱ་བ
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/101.txt，叶码：157b3(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：Ar+ya tA rA b+haT+TA ra ka nA ma aSh+Ta sha ta kaM；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa ཞེས་བྱ་བ。
recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：ba can 'gro ba།  ། de rnams bdag gis bshad par bya།  ། lha yi dge 'dun bdag la nyon།  ། 'di la rjes su yi rangs gyis།  ། legs par bsdams par gyur la bstod།  ། ཨོཾ dge ba can ni gzi brjid che།  ། 'jig rten gso byed snyan pa che།  །  dbyangs can ma ni spyan yangs ma།  ། shes rab dpal dang blo 'phel ma།  ། gso byed ma dang rgyas 'debs ma།  སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  ཨོཾ gyis rnam pa 'dod gzugs ma།  ། sems can kun la phan par brtson།  ། g.yul las sgrol byed rgyal ba mo།  ། lha mo shes shwa rA ya།  bo d+hi sa twA ya།  ། མ་ཧཱ sa hA ya།  མ་ཧཱ kA ru Ni kA ya།  tad+ya thA།  ཨོཾ tA re tut+ta re tu re sarba duSh+Ta pra duSh+TaM ma ma kr-i te dzam+b+ha ya།  stam+b+ha ya།  mo ha ya།  ban+d+ha ya།  ཧཱུྃ ཧཱུྃ ཧཱུྃ།  ཕཊ ཕཊ ཕཊ།  sarba duSh+Ta stam+b+ha ni tA re སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  ། 'phags ma sgrol（EWTS: ba can 'gro ba/ /de rnams bdag gis bshad par bya/ /lha yi dge 'dun bdag la nyon/ /'di la rjes su yi rangs gyis/ /legs par bsdams par gyur la bstod/ /oM dge ba can ni gzi brjid che/ /'jig rten gso byed snyan pa che/ / dbyangs can ma ni spyan yangs ma/ /shes rab dpal dang blo 'phel ma/ /gso byed ma dang rgyas 'debs ma/ swA hA/ oM gyis rnam pa 'dod gzugs ma/ /sems can kun la phan par brtson/ /g.yul las sgrol byed rgyal ba mo/ /lha mo shes shwa rA ya/ bo d+hi sa twA ya/ /ma hA sa hA ya/ ma hA kA ru Ni kA ya/ tad+ya thA/ oM tA re tut+ta re tu re sarba duSh+Ta pra duSh+TaM ma ma kr-i te dzam+b+ha ya/ stam+b+ha ya/ mo ha ya/ ban+d+ha ya/ hU~M hU~M hU~M/ phaT phaT phaT/ sarba duSh+Ta stam+b+ha ni tA re swA hA/ /'phags ma sgrol）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/101.txt，叶码：160a4(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：'phags ma sgrol ma rang gis dam bcas pa ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས。

verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, parākramo, Vajra, indestructible diamond-thunderbolt, hold! bear! sustain! command + water + as many + hail! may auspicious accomplishment be sealed

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/101.txt，叶码：167a2(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：Ar+ya dza ya ba tI nA ma d+hA ra NI；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：འཕགས་པ rgyal ba can 167a3(གཟུངས): ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས。
recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：pa 'di zung shig །  tad+ya thA།  dza ye dza ye dza ye།  མ་ཧཱ dza ya bA ti ye།  bud+d+ha a d+hi Sh+Thi te།  d+harma a ba b+hA sa ni།  bud+d+ha ad+hi ga me dz+nyA na a ba b+hA se སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  lag na rdo rje 'di dag ni དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i གསང་སྔགས kyi gzhi ni།  stam+b+hi ta།  sarba a hi tiSh+Thi NAM།  ན་མོ b+ha ga ba ti།  bud+d+ha s+ya།  མ་ཧཱ ga ru NAM།  bi ha ri ni།  sid+d+h+yan+tu man+dza pa dA སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  de nas བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས la gsang ba ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsol to།  །  བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang །  sangs rgyas kyis byin gyis brlabs kyis bdag gis རིག་སྔགས kyi rgyal mo rgyal ba can 'di'i གཟུངས kyi གསང་སྔགས kyi gzhi rnams brjod par bgyi'o།  ། tad+ya thA།  dza ya dza ya dza ya།  ཕཊ ཕཊ ཕཊ།  dz+wa（EWTS: pa 'di zung shig / tad+ya thA/ dza ye dza ye dza ye/ ma hA dza ya bA ti ye/ bud+d+ha a d+hi Sh+Thi te/ d+harma a ba b+hA sa ni/ bud+d+ha ad+hi ga me dz+nyA na a ba b+hA se swA hA/ lag na rdo rje 'di dag ni de bzhin gshegs pas spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i gsang sngags kyi gzhi ni/ stam+b+hi ta/ sarba a hi tiSh+Thi NAM/ na mo b+ha ga ba ti/ bud+d+ha s+ya/ ma hA ga ru NAM/ bi ha ri ni/ sid+d+h+yan+tu man+dza pa dA swA hA/ de nas bcom ldan 'das la gsang ba ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsol to/ / bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang / sangs rgyas kyis byin gyis brlabs kyis bdag gis rig sngags kyi rgyal mo rgyal ba can 'di'i gzungs kyi gsang sngags kyi gzhi rnams brjod par bgyi'o/ /tad+ya thA/ dza ya dza ya dza ya/ phaT phaT phaT/ dz+wa）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/101.txt，叶码：171a7(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：Ar+ya ma hA la k+ShI NI sU tra；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：འཕགས་པ dpal chen mo'i mdo。
recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：mo།  པདྨ'i spyan།  byed pa mo།  'od chen mo།  zas sbyin ma།  rin po che rab tu sbyin ma།  dpal chen mo།  ། s+yAd ya the da nA།  dzi ni།  g+h+ri ni།  sarba ar+tha sA d+ha ni།  sha shi ni a lak+Sh+mi ni།  me nA sha ya sid+d+h+yan+tu man+t+ra padAHསྭཱ་ཧཱ།  ཨོཾ b+h+r-i ku TI pa ra ma su b+ha ge སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  lan gsum du brjod par bya ste།  gang la la dus gsum du 'don pa de'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad 'jig par 'gyur ro།  ། skal ba bzang po dang ldan par 'gyur ro།  ། 'byor pa zad mi shes par 'gyur ro།  ། mi dang phrad du cig སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས kyis de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang བྱང་ཆུབ་སེམས་དཔའ sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས kyis bka' stsal pa la mngon par dga'o།  ། dpal gyi lha mo chen mo'i mtshan bcu gnyis pa rdzogs so།  །（EWTS: mo/ pad+ma'i spyan/ byed pa mo/ 'od chen mo/ zas sbyin ma/ rin po che rab tu sbyin ma/ dpal chen mo/ /s+yAd ya the da nA/ dzi ni/ g+h+ri ni/ sarba ar+tha sA d+ha ni/ sha shi ni a lak+Sh+mi ni/ me nA sha ya sid+d+h+yan+tu man+t+ra padAHswA hA/ oM b+h+r-i ku TI pa ra ma su b+ha ge swA hA/ lan gsum du brjod par bya ste/ gang la la dus gsum du 'don pa de'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad 'jig par 'gyur ro/ /skal ba bzang po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /'byor pa zad mi shes par 'gyur ro/ /mi dang phrad du cig swA hA/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa la mngon par dga'o/ /dpal gyi lha mo chen mo'i mtshan bcu gnyis pa rdzogs so// //）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

deityZh: འཕགས་པ mig rnam par sbyong ba ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i རིག་སྔགས
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/101.txt，叶码：176b1(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：Ar+ya tsak+Shur bi sho d+ha ni nA ma bid+yA 176b2(gzungs): man+t+ra；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：འཕགས་པ mig rnam par sbyong ba ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i རིག་སྔགས。
recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：li།  hi li te mi li།  hu yA hu yA hU A ma ni།  hu lu hu lu hu lu hu du hu du hu du།  tsak+Shur me bi shod+ha ya སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  kun dga' bo རིག་སྔགས kyi rgyal mo mig rnam par sbyong ba 'di ni mig gi skyon dang །  rlung gi skyon dang །  mkhris pa'i skyon dang །  bad kan gyi skyon dang །  par ma gyur cig །  bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi mig rnam par dag par gyur cig སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  kun dga' bo རིག་སྔགས kyi rgyal mo mig rnam par sbyong ba 'di ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas drug gis gsungs ba'o།  ། nga yang da lta 'chad de།  rgyal po chen po bzhi dang །（EWTS: li/ hi li te mi li/ hu yA hu yA hU A ma ni/ hu lu hu lu hu lu hu du hu du hu du/ tsak+Shur me bi shod+ha ya swA hA/ kun dga' bo rig sngags kyi rgyal mo mig rnam par sbyong ba 'di ni mig gi skyon dang / rlung gi skyon dang / mkhris pa'i skyon dang / bad kan gyi skyon dang / par ma gyur cig / bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi mig rnam par dag par gyur cig swA hA/ kun dga' bo rig sngags kyi rgyal mo mig rnam par sbyong ba 'di ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas drug gis gsungs ba'o/ /nga yang da lta 'chad de/ rgyal po chen po bzhi dang /）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/101.txt，叶码：180b4(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：Ar+ya dz+wa ra pra sha ma ni nA ma d+hA ra NI；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：འཕགས་པ rims nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས。
recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：ni།  bdag gi rims nad song shig ། ma 'dug shig སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis 'jig rten na sangs rgyas bla na med pa dang །  'jig rten na chos dang །  dge 'dun bla na med pa'i bden pa dang །  bden pa'i tshig des bdag gi rims nad song ma 'dug shig སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  sid+h+yan+tu man+t+ra pa dai།  ta ra tu།  bid+ya taM bra h+ma a nu mo te སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  skud pa nag po la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas te mdud pa nyi shu rtsa gcig dor ro།  ། བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas།  phyag 'tshal lo།  ། ཏ་དྱ་ཐཱ།  i li me ti me li།  ha ne su ha ne།  che ge mo zhig dz+wa ra ban d+hA mi།  e ka hi kaM།  tri hi kaM tsa turtsa kaM།  ni t+ya dz+wa raM སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  cho ga ni 'di bris te mgul du btags na rims nad med par byed do།  ། rims nad（EWTS: ni/ bdag gi rims nad song shig /ma 'dug shig swA hA/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis 'jig rten na sangs rgyas bla na med pa dang / 'jig rten na chos dang / dge 'dun bla na med pa'i bden pa dang / bden pa'i tshig des bdag gi rims nad song ma 'dug shig swA hA/ sid+h+yan+tu man+t+ra pa dai/ ta ra tu/ bid+ya taM bra h+ma a nu mo te swA hA/ skud pa nag po la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas te mdud pa nyi shu rtsa gcig dor ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ phyag 'tshal lo/ /ta d+ya thA/ i li me ti me li/ ha ne su ha ne/ che ge mo zhig dz+wa ra ban d+hA mi/ e ka hi kaM/ tri hi kaM tsa turtsa kaM/ ni t+ya dz+wa raM swA hA/ cho ga ni 'di bris te mgul du btags na rims nad med par byed do/ /rims nad）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/101.txt，叶码：185b2(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：a gra bid+yA man+t+ra；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：a gra bid+yA man+t+ra。

titleEnglish: Vienna rKTs Derge Zungdu (D1031): prajñā bardha ni nāma dhāraṇī
translatorZh: 维也纳大学 rKTs 德格版甘珠尔《陀罗尼集 (gZungs 'dus)》(1D/101.txt)
sutraSourceZh: Derge Zungdu 1D/101.txt · Folio 185b7(gzungs) (shes rab skyed pa ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས)
deityZh: shes rab skyed pa ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/101.txt，叶码：185b7(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：pradz+nyA bar+d+ha ni nA ma d+hA ra NI；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：shes rab skyed pa ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས。
recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས sems can shes rab rtul po།  blo zhan pa།  yid mi gzhungs pa rnams kyi slad du shes rab skyed pa zhes bgyi ba'i གཟུངས bshad du gsol།  bshad pa།  ཧཱུྃ pi tsu pi tsu pradz+nyA bar+d+ha ni།  dz+wa la dz+wa la me d+hA bar+d+ha ni།  d+hi ri d+hi ri།  bud+d+hi bar+d+ha ni སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  gang zhig གཟུངས 'di 'dzin pa dang །  klog pa dang །  'dri ba dang །  'drir 'jug pa dang །  chung ngu na yi ge 'bru gcig tsam thos na yang de'i tshe 'di nyid la shes rab chen por 'gyur ro།  ། gang gis zla ba drug gi bar du nyin re zhing rtsa ba（EWTS: bcom ldan 'das sems can shes rab rtul po/ blo zhan pa/ yid mi gzhungs pa rnams kyi slad du shes rab skyed pa zhes bgyi ba'i gzungs bshad du gsol/ bshad pa/ hU~M pi tsu pi tsu pradz+nyA bar+d+ha ni/ dz+wa la dz+wa la me d+hA bar+d+ha ni/ d+hi ri d+hi ri/ bud+d+hi bar+d+ha ni swA hA/ gang zhig gzungs 'di 'dzin pa dang / klog pa dang / 'dri ba dang / 'drir 'jug pa dang / chung ngu na yi ge 'bru gcig tsam thos na yang de'i tshe 'di nyid la shes rab chen por 'gyur ro/ /gang gis zla ba drug gi bar du nyin re zhing rtsa ba）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

deityZh: mdo chen po kun du rgyu ba dang kun du rgyu ba ma yin pa dang mthun pa'i mdo ཞེས་བྱ་བ
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/101.txt，叶码：190a4(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：A T+wa nA TI 190a5(gzungs): ya sU traM nA ma ma hA sU tra；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：mdo chen po kun du rgyu ba dang kun du rgyu ba ma yin pa dang mthun pa'i mdo ཞེས་བྱ་བ。
recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：kiT+Ti mU le།  hi li kiT+Ti mU le།  hu du me།  hu du ra du me།  gau ri།  gan+d+ha ri།  go do ha ni།  o ke mo ke སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  btsun pa བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས kyi spyan sngar bdag gis dri za rnams dang །  dri za chen po rnams dang །  dri za'i sde dpon rnams dang །  le།  e hi e hi།  sa dA mat+ti ke།  sa dA b+haN+Di ni ke།  tiSh+Tha duSh+Ta bad+d+ho si སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  btsun pa བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས kyi nyan thos dge slong ngam།  dge slong ma 'am།  dge bsnyen nam།  dge bsnyen ma gang la la kun du rgyu ba dang kun du rgyu ba ma lags sngags kyi tshig ni 'di dag lags so།  ། tad+ya thA།  hu me hu me།  hu mi le།  hu mi lA bA tI ye སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  btsun pa བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས kyi spyan sngar bdag gis grul bum rnams dang །  grul bum chen po rnams dang །  grul bum gyi sde dpon rnams（EWTS: kiT+Ti mU le/ hi li kiT+Ti mU le/ hu du me/ hu du ra du me/ gau ri/ gan+d+ha ri/ go do ha ni/ o ke mo ke swA hA/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar bdag gis dri za rnams dang / dri za chen po rnams dang / dri za'i sde dpon rnams dang / le/ e hi e hi/ sa dA mat+ti ke/ sa dA b+haN+Di ni ke/ tiSh+Tha duSh+Ta bad+d+ho si swA hA/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma 'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma gang la la kun du rgyu ba dang kun du rgyu ba ma lags sngags kyi tshig ni 'di dag lags so/ /tad+ya thA/ hu me hu me/ hu mi le/ hu mi lA bA tI ye swA hA/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar bdag gis grul bum rnams dang / grul bum chen po rnams dang / grul bum gyi sde dpon rnams）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

verses.meaningZh: 曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·远离寂静周遍），无我大慈三昧·法界总持任持，清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤·一切诸谛圆满

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/101.txt，叶码：235a2(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：Ar+ya ga Nu a la~M ka ra a gra nA ma d+hA ra NI；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：འཕགས་པ sdong po rgyan gyi mchog ces bya ba'i གཟུངས。

verses.meaningZh: 再三坚固任持总持法印（度噜），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！

recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས།  dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo།  ། ན་མོ rat+na tra yA ya།  ན་མོ བྷ་ག་བ་ཏེ།  བཛྲ sA ra pra marda ni།  ta thA ga tA ya།  ar+ha te saM myak+saM bud+d+hA ya།  tad+ya thA།  ཨོཾ badzre badzre།  མ་ཧཱ badzre།  མ་ཧཱ te dza badzre།  མ་ཧཱ bid+yA badzre།  མ་ཧཱ bo d+hi tsit+ta badzre།  མ་ཧཱ po d+hi maN+Do ba saM kra ma Na བཛྲ།  sarba karma A bar Na bi sho d+ha na badzre སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  གཟུངས sngags 'di'i cho ga ni 'di yin te།  dran pa tsam gyi mod la phyogs bcu dag na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས gang gA'i klung gi bye ma'i rdul phra rab snyed la mchod pa byas par 'gyur ro།  ། mchod pa'i sprin ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས rdzogs །  @#།  ། ཨོཾ ན་མོ བྷ་ག་བ་ཏེ rat+na ke tu rA dzA ya།  ta thA ga tA ya།  arta te saM myak+saMbud+d+ha ya།  ཏ་དྱ་ཐཱ།  ཨོཾ rat+ne rat+ne mahA rat+he rat+na bi dza ye སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  zhes lan brgyad brjod pas phyag bya'o།  @#།  ། na maHsarba（EWTS: zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /na mo rat+na tra yA ya/ na mo b+ha ga ba te/ badzra sA ra pra marda ni/ ta thA ga tA ya/ ar+ha te saM myak+saM bud+d+hA ya/ tad+ya thA/ oM badzre badzre/ ma hA badzre/ ma hA te dza badzre/ ma hA bid+yA badzre/ ma hA bo d+hi tsit+ta badzre/ ma hA po d+hi maN+Do ba saM kra ma Na badzra/ sarba karma A bar Na bi sho d+ha na badzre swA hA/ gzungs sngags 'di'i cho ga ni 'di yin te/ dran pa tsam gyi mod la phyogs bcu dag na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang gA'i klung gi bye ma'i rdul phra rab snyed la mchod pa byas par 'gyur ro/ /mchod pa'i sprin zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs // @#/ /oM na mo b+ha ga ba te rat+na ke tu rA dzA ya/ ta thA ga tA ya/ arta te saM myak+saMbud+d+ha ya/ ta d+ya thA/ oM rat+ne rat+ne mahA rat+he rat+na bi dza ye swA hA/ zhes lan brgyad brjod pas phyag bya'o// @#/ /na maHsarba）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

deityZh: su rU pa ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས
meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/101.txt，叶码：240a7(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：surU pa nA mad+hA ra NI；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：su rU pa ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས。
recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：thA ga tA ya།  ar+ha te sཨོཾmyak+saM bud+d+ha ya།  tad+ya thA།  ཨོཾ su ru su ru།  bra su ru pra su ru།  ta ra ta ra།  b+ha ra b+ha ra།  saM b+ha ra saM b+ha ra།  sma ra sma ra།  san+ta r+pa ya།  san+ta r+pa ya།  sarba pre tA nAM སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  གཟུངས 'dis chu dang bcas pa'i zan la lan bdun yongs su bzlas ngo lon gyis shig །  na maHsarba ཏ་ཐཱ་ག་ཏ a ba lo ki te ཨོཾ sam+b+ha ra sam+b+ha ra ཧཱུྃ།  kun dga' bo 'dis kyi gtor ma la lan bdun bzlas brjod byas nas lag pa brkyang ste sgo drung du sbyin par bya'o།  ། se gol yang brdab par bya'o།  ། de ltar byas dag lha'i bza' ba dang btung ba rnams kyis tshim par byas par 'gyur ro།  ། bram ze'i drang srong de dag kyang dbang bo tshim par 'gyur te།  de dag thams cad kyis ཨོཾ bde legs su gyur cig ces bya ba'i sgra 'byin par byed la།  sems can de dag kyang bsam pa yongs（EWTS: thA ga tA ya/ ar+ha te soMmyak+saM bud+d+ha ya/ tad+ya thA/ oM su ru su ru/ bra su ru pra su ru/ ta ra ta ra/ b+ha ra b+ha ra/ saM b+ha ra saM b+ha ra/ sma ra sma ra/ san+ta r+pa ya/ san+ta r+pa ya/ sarba pre tA nAM swA hA/ gzungs 'dis chu dang bcas pa'i zan la lan bdun yongs su bzlas ngo lon gyis shig / na maHsarba ta thA ga ta a ba lo ki te oM sam+b+ha ra sam+b+ha ra hU~M/ kun dga' bo 'dis kyi gtor ma la lan bdun bzlas brjod byas nas lag pa brkyang ste sgo drung du sbyin par bya'o/ /se gol yang brdab par bya'o/ /de ltar byas dag lha'i bza' ba dang btung ba rnams kyis tshim par byas par 'gyur ro/ /bram ze'i drang srong de dag kyang dbang bo tshim par 'gyur te/ de dag thams cad kyis oM bde legs su gyur cig ces bya ba'i sgra 'byin par byed la/ sems can de dag kyang bsam pa yongs）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

verses.meaningZh: 归命一切、普皆遍满，如来（乘如实道来成正觉），观照、慈悲垂视尊，嗡！随着星宿，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性），随着星宿，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性），吽（金刚心印）！

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/101.txt，叶码：247b3(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：A r+ya sab+ta pe tA Da ka 247b4(gzungs): nA ma d+hA ra NI；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：འཕགས་པ ro langs bdun pa ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས。
recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：bya'o།  ། tad+ya thA།  ha ra།  མ་ཧཱ gA re།  g+ha sa ra ba ti།  d+ha ra d+ha ri།  d+ha ra Ni།  tsho ra tsho ra།  Ni ka ro ti ti།  kot+ta sa mA d+hi ni།  sa ma ra sa ra Ni།  sa ra na ko ta ma ti།  sam+b+ha be།  b+ha ba na།  nA ga re།  b+ha da nI།  sA dA ni ti སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  kun dga' bo གཟུངས sngags kyi ma bi tsa ra thA།  sti ri s+thi ra mu le།  ma tha ni rma tha ni།  tsA la ni།  mA ka nI།  dzam+b+ha ni།  bI dA ni།  lha ya swa kr-i ni།  b+ha ga ba ti།  ཏ་ཐཱ་ག་ཏ།  bi ta the།  ti bi g+ha d+ha re།  bar bra de།  ha re tiSh+Tha།  nI la ba sa ni སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  kun dga' bo ro langs 'di a yu d+he སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  kun dga' bo 'di dag ni gnod sbyin thams cad dang །  srin po thams cad dang །  གསང་སྔགས thams cad dang །  dang །  byad dang །  sdig pa rab tu zhi bar byed pa'o།  ། rgyal pos bkrabs pa dang །  la gcan pa phyir zlog par byed do།  ། de（EWTS: bya'o/ /tad+ya thA/ ha ra/ ma hA gA re/ g+ha sa ra ba ti/ d+ha ra d+ha ri/ d+ha ra Ni/ tsho ra tsho ra/ Ni ka ro ti ti/ kot+ta sa mA d+hi ni/ sa ma ra sa ra Ni/ sa ra na ko ta ma ti/ sam+b+ha be/ b+ha ba na/ nA ga re/ b+ha da nI/ sA dA ni ti swA hA/ kun dga' bo gzungs sngags kyi ma bi tsa ra thA/ sti ri s+thi ra mu le/ ma tha ni rma tha ni/ tsA la ni/ mA ka nI/ dzam+b+ha ni/ bI dA ni/ lha ya swa kr-i ni/ b+ha ga ba ti/ ta thA ga ta/ bi ta the/ ti bi g+ha d+ha re/ bar bra de/ ha re tiSh+Tha/ nI la ba sa ni swA hA/ kun dga' bo ro langs 'di a yu d+he swA hA/ kun dga' bo 'di dag ni gnod sbyin thams cad dang / srin po thams cad dang / gsang sngags thams cad dang / dang / byad dang / sdig pa rab tu zhi bar byed pa'o/ /rgyal pos bkrabs pa dang / la gcan pa phyir zlog par byed do/ /de）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/101.txt，叶码：251a7(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：Ar+ya ga Na ba ti hr-i da ya；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：འཕགས་པ tshogs kyi bdag po'i སྙིང་པོ。
recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：kun dga' bo gang la la tshogs kyi bdag po tshogs kyi dbang phyug gi སྙིང་པོ 'dzin na de'i las thams cad grub par 'gyur ro།  ། de bzung bas dgos pa 'grub cing གསང་སྔགས thams cad kyang dngos grub tu 'gyur ro།  ། tad+ya thA།  ན་མོ stu te མ་ཧཱ ga Na pa ta ye སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  ཨོཾ ka Ta ka Ta།  ma Ta ma Ta།  da ra da ra།  bi da ra།  bi da ra།  ha na ha na།  gr-ih+na gr-ih+na།  d+hA ba d+hA ba།  b+hany+dza b+hany+dza།  staM b+ha staM b+ha།  dzaM b+ha dzaM b+ha།  mo ha mo ha།  de hi de hi།  dA pa ya dA pa ya།  d+hA na d+hA n+ya sid+d+hiM me pra yats+tsha sa ma ya ma nu sma ra མ་ཧཱ ru dra ba tsa nI ye སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  ཨོཾ ku ru ku ru སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  ཨོཾ tu ru tu ru སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  ཨོཾ mu ru mu ru སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  ཨོཾ pA pa shAn+ti ba su puSh+TiM ku ru སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  ad+gu ta bin+du k+tsa b+hi ta tsit+ta མ་ཧཱ bi dA raHsa mA gats+tsha ti མ་ཧཱ b+ha ya།  མ་ཧཱ ba la།  མ་ཧཱ ba ra kra ma།  ma sA ha sti།  མ་ཧཱ dak+Shi Ni ya bra cod ya ma སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  tad+ya thA།  ཨོཾ ku ru（EWTS: kun dga' bo gang la la tshogs kyi bdag po tshogs kyi dbang phyug gi snying po 'dzin na de'i las thams cad grub par 'gyur ro/ /de bzung bas dgos pa 'grub cing gsang sngags thams cad kyang dngos grub tu 'gyur ro/ /tad+ya thA/ na mo stu te ma hA ga Na pa ta ye swA hA/ oM ka Ta ka Ta/ ma Ta ma Ta/ da ra da ra/ bi da ra/ bi da ra/ ha na ha na/ gr-ih+na gr-ih+na/ d+hA ba d+hA ba/ b+hany+dza b+hany+dza/ staM b+ha staM b+ha/ dzaM b+ha dzaM b+ha/ mo ha mo ha/ de hi de hi/ dA pa ya dA pa ya/ d+hA na d+hA n+ya sid+d+hiM me pra yats+tsha sa ma ya ma nu sma ra ma hA ru dra ba tsa nI ye swA hA/ oM ku ru ku ru swA hA/ oM tu ru tu ru swA hA/ oM mu ru mu ru swA hA/ oM pA pa shAn+ti ba su puSh+TiM ku ru swA hA/ ad+gu ta bin+du k+tsa b+hi ta tsit+ta ma hA bi dA raHsa mA gats+tsha ti ma hA b+ha ya/ ma hA ba la/ ma hA ba ra kra ma/ ma sA ha sti/ ma hA dak+Shi Ni ya bra cod ya ma swA hA/ tad+ya thA/ oM ku ru）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 9 大数据库「奥地利维也纳大学 rKTs (Resources for Kanjur & Tanjur Studies)」德格版《陀罗尼集 (Zungdu, D846–D1095)》电子原典（档案：1D/101.txt，叶码：252a3(gzungs)）。原典「rgya gar skad du (梵语云)」：shrI ma hA kA la nA ma d+hA ra NI；「bod skad du (藏语云)」：dpal mgon po nag po ཞེས་བྱ་བ'i གཟུངས。
recitationTipsZh: 藏文转写原咒：ldan 'das bdag gi rig pa 'di 'bul gyis bzhes su gsol།  ཨོཾ shrI མ་ཧཱ kA la g+ha Na g+ha Na Ti སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  na maHshrI མ་ཧཱ kA la ga Ne gu ti shA ya།  ན་མོ yo gi na NI na།  tad+ya thA།  ཨོཾ hi le hi le།  ki te ki te ni།  tsi de tsi de ni སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  'di bton pas nad thams cad dang །  rA dza d+hU te na།  ba hu shra be།  ba hu pa ri pA ri།  ba hu pa ri sho d+ha ne i maM dzA ra tsaN+Da laM།  ha na ha na།  ཨོཾ suM b+ha།  ni suM b+ha།  shi ra muny+tsa།  tsak+Shu muny+tsa།  shro tra muny+tsa།  g+h+rA Na muny+tsa།  dzi hwA muny+tsa།  ka Na Tha muny+tsa།  grI ba muny+tsa།  priSh+Tha muny+tsa།  kA Ti kA muny+tsa།  kuk+Sha muny+tsa།  U ru muny+tsa།  dza nau muny+tsa།  hasta muny+tsa།  pA dau muny+tsa།  aM gu li muny+tsa།  i ga pra t+yaM ga muny+tsa།  a ba sa ra།  a n+ya si maM gats+tsha།  dz+wa ra mu to si bdag la སྭཱ་ཧཱ།  ཨོཾ dz+wa la mA aM gu li ཧཱུྃ།  sarba dz+wa rA na na ཕཊ།  འཕགས་པ nag po chen po'i གཟུངས rims nad thams cad（EWTS: ldan 'das bdag gi rig pa 'di 'bul gyis bzhes su gsol/ oM shrI ma hA kA la g+ha Na g+ha Na Ti swA hA/ na maHshrI ma hA kA la ga Ne gu ti shA ya/ na mo yo gi na NI na/ tad+ya thA/ oM hi le hi le/ ki te ki te ni/ tsi de tsi de ni swA hA/ 'di bton pas nad thams cad dang / rA dza d+hU te na/ ba hu shra be/ ba hu pa ri pA ri/ ba hu pa ri sho d+ha ne i maM dzA ra tsaN+Da laM/ ha na ha na/ oM suM b+ha/ ni suM b+ha/ shi ra muny+tsa/ tsak+Shu muny+tsa/ shro tra muny+tsa/ g+h+rA Na muny+tsa/ dzi hwA muny+tsa/ ka Na Tha muny+tsa/ grI ba muny+tsa/ priSh+Tha muny+tsa/ kA Ti kA muny+tsa/ kuk+Sha muny+tsa/ U ru muny+tsa/ dza nau muny+tsa/ hasta muny+tsa/ pA dau muny+tsa/ aM gu li muny+tsa/ i ga pra t+yaM ga muny+tsa/ a ba sa ra/ a n+ya si maM gats+tsha/ dz+wa ra mu to si bdag la swA hA/ oM dz+wa la mA aM gu li hU~M/ sarba dz+wa rA na na phaT/ 'phags pa nag po chen po'i gzungs rims nad thams cad）。系统已自动将其 EWTS 藏转梵文还原为标准 IAST 梵音与六体对照。

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 10 大数据库「ALL-NIBS 陀罗尼保护计划（Asian Legacy Library & Nagarjuna Institute）」。完整呈现尼泊尔尼瓦尔写本外交原貌（Diplomatic Newar：「imāni bajrapāṇe navagrahāṇāṁ mantra hṛdayāni paṭhitasiddhāni yathānu krama varṇa bhedena diśāca gandha maṇḍalake cintaye padmamadhye dvādaśāṁgula pramāṇaṁ caturasraṁ caturdbāreṇa śobhitaṁ kūṭāgāraṁ cakra samanvitaṁ || tanmadhye sita kamalopari kuṁkuma gandha maṇḍala kecittaye debabhāskaraṁ tāpasa rupadharaṁ raktavarṇa sahasra sūryyakoṭī samaprabho sindhūrabarṇa stejo mālina bigrahaṁ || asyadeyaṁ kṣīrabhojanaṁ || kundurudhūpaṁ || ommegholkāyasbāhā」）与标准古典梵文校勘本（Normalized IAST）之双轨对照，并总结尼瓦尔正字法音变规律：sbāhā → svāhā (Newar bilabial-dental cluster)；b → v (bajra → vajra, sarba → sarva, bhagabān → bhagavān)；post-r gemination simplified (sarvva → sarva, dharmma → dharma, āryya → ārya)；ṁ → ṃ (ISO 15919 anusvāra → standard IAST ṃ)。

verses.meaningZh: 施到彼岸陀罗尼，尸罗·彼岸·病人·气息·是的·陀罗尼，忍辱·彼岸·病人·气息·是的·陀罗尼，精进到彼岸·名为·陀罗尼，禅定到彼岸·名为·陀罗尼，再三般若波罗蜜多·名为·陀罗尼，总持任持·妙行迁变空，总持任持·生起不可得·尊胜，威猛·圣救度佛母·名为·陀罗尼，大方等無想经
verses.meaningEn: Dhāraṇī, moral discipline + carrying over + sick + breath + yes + Dhāraṇī, patience + carrying over + sick + breath + yes + Dhāraṇī, virya-paramita + by name + Dhāraṇī, dhyana-paramita + by name + Dhāraṇī, Perfection of Wisdom + by name + Dhāraṇī again and again, upholding, upholding, mighty + Tārā + by name + Dhāraṇī, Mahāmeghasūtra (Da Fangdeng Wuxiang Jing)

verses.meaningZh: 总持任持·最上真言离言说，施度调伏·本性寂静止息·造作离相，如意摩尼宝珠·世间自在王·名为·陀罗尼，佛陀·尊神·名为·陀罗尼，莲华·愉悦·是的·陀罗尼，一切·佛陀·菩提，勇猛大士·是的·陀罗尼，圣星，最上真言离言说·本性寂静止息·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Upholding, generosity & self-mastery & primordial tranquil peace & freedom from karmic agency, Cintāmaṇi + Lokeśvara + by name + Dhāraṇī, Buddha + lord + by name + Dhāraṇī, lotus flower + glad at heart + yes + Dhāraṇī, all + Buddha + Bodhi, hero + yes + Dhāraṇī, noble + a star, supreme ineffable speech & primordial tranquil peace & immutable Suchness

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊（薄伽梵）致敬，向一切·三界·对·殊胜，向佛陀、觉者，向汝、彼等，至心归命礼！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, all + the Three Worlds + toward + to, to/for Buddha, the Awakened One, to Thee / they, reverent homage!
verses.tangNoteZh: 尼瓦尔写本异文：oṁ namo bhagavate sarvvatrailokyaprativiśiṣṭāya buddhāya te namaḥ | tadyathā | oṁ bhrūṁ bhrūṁ bhrūṁ śodhaya śodhaya viśodhaya viśodhaya asamasamantāvabhāsaspharaṇagatigaganasvabhāvaviśuddhe | abhiṣiñcantu māṁ sarvvatathāgatāḥ sugatavaravacanāmṛtābhiṣekair mahāmudrāmantrapadaiḥ | oṁ āhara āhara mama āyuḥsaṁdhāraṇi śodhaya viśodhaya uṣṇīṣavijayapariśuddhe sbāhā ||

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:
verses.tangNoteZh: 尼瓦尔写本异文：oṁ namo bhagavate sarvvatrailokyaprativiśiṣṭāya buddhāya te namaḥ | tadyathā | oṁ bhrūṁ bhrūṁ bhrūṁ śodhaya śodhaya viśodhaya viśodhaya asamasamantāvabhāsaspharaṇagatigaganasvabhāvaviśuddhe | abhiṣiñcantu māṁ sarvvatathāgatāḥ sugatavaravacanāmṛtābhiṣekair mahāmudrāmantrapadaiḥ | oṁ āhara āhara mama āyuḥsaṁdhāraṇi śodhaya viśodhaya uṣṇīṣavijayapariśuddhe sbāhā ||

verses.iast: oṃ bhrūṃ bhrūṃ bhrūṃ śodhaya śodhaya viśodhaya viśodhaya asamasamantāvabhāsaspharaṇagatigaganasvabhāvaviśuddhe
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三一字顶轮王与尊胜佛顶最上心印，再三请净除、涤荡清净！再三请最极净除、彻底涤净一切业障！无等·普现·遍·趣向·虚空·自性·最极清净
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Uṣṇīṣa-cakravartin & Vijayā crown seed syllable again and again, purify! cleanse! again and again, thoroughly purify! cleanse completely! again and again, unequalled + suffusion + course + sky + own-being + O completely purified
verses.tangNoteZh: 尼瓦尔写本异文：oṁ namo bhagavate sarvvatrailokyaprativiśiṣṭāya buddhāya te namaḥ | tadyathā | oṁ bhrūṁ bhrūṁ bhrūṁ śodhaya śodhaya viśodhaya viśodhaya asamasamantāvabhāsaspharaṇagatigaganasvabhāvaviśuddhe | abhiṣiñcantu māṁ sarvvatathāgatāḥ sugatavaravacanāmṛtābhiṣekair mahāmudrāmantrapadaiḥ | oṁ āhara āhara mama āyuḥsaṁdhāraṇi śodhaya viśodhaya uṣṇīṣavijayapariśuddhe sbāhā ||

verses.meaningZh: 愿一切如来普施甘露灌顶！于我，诸一切如来，真言宣演·一切诸谛圆满，以诸大手印真言章句
verses.meaningEn: May all Buddhas consecrate and anoint me, all Tathagatas (plural), uttering, Mahāmudrā + by
verses.tangNoteZh: 尼瓦尔写本异文：oṁ namo bhagavate sarvvatrailokyaprativiśiṣṭāya buddhāya te namaḥ | tadyathā | oṁ bhrūṁ bhrūṁ bhrūṁ śodhaya śodhaya viśodhaya viśodhaya asamasamantāvabhāsaspharaṇagatigaganasvabhāvaviśuddhe | abhiṣiñcantu māṁ sarvvatathāgatāḥ sugatavaravacanāmṛtābhiṣekair mahāmudrāmantrapadaiḥ | oṁ āhara āhara mama āyuḥsaṁdhāraṇi śodhaya viśodhaya uṣṇīṣavijayapariśuddhe sbāhā ||

verses.iast: oṃ āhara āhara mama āyuḥsaṃdhāraṇi śodhaya viśodhaya uṣṇīṣavijayapariśuddhe svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三请摄召、赐予妙寿福德供养！我之（行者所有），寿命擎尊，请净除、涤荡清净！请最极净除、彻底涤净一切业障！佛顶肉髻相·最胜尊胜·圆满清净，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! bring! fetch! bestow! again and again, my, of me (the practitioner), life-force + O supporting, purify! cleanse! thoroughly purify! cleanse completely! Uṣṇīṣa + supreme victory! triumph! + O thoroughly pure, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 尼瓦尔写本异文：oṁ namo bhagavate sarvvatrailokyaprativiśiṣṭāya buddhāya te namaḥ | tadyathā | oṁ bhrūṁ bhrūṁ bhrūṁ śodhaya śodhaya viśodhaya viśodhaya asamasamantāvabhāsaspharaṇagatigaganasvabhāvaviśuddhe | abhiṣiñcantu māṁ sarvvatathāgatāḥ sugatavaravacanāmṛtābhiṣekair mahāmudrāmantrapadaiḥ | oṁ āhara āhara mama āyuḥsaṁdhāraṇi śodhaya viśodhaya uṣṇīṣavijayapariśuddhe sbāhā ||

verses.iast: mayāśrutamekisma nsamaye bhagavānya dharmātye giriśikhare viharitismā
verses.meaningZh: 谛听妙闻·无我大慈三昧，离名相假立·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧，出有坏他，正法疾速，宝山王安住不动山尖，最上真言离言说·因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Hearing, beyond nominal designation & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness (reverent offering), other, Dharma + O hastening, steadfast sacred mountain peak + O peaked, supreme ineffable speech & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust

verses.iast: mahatāca bhikṣu saṃghena sārddha bodhisatva gaṇenaca
verses.meaningZh: 广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，比丘，以圣僧伽、清净海众，俱，菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情），海会众·勇健·及
verses.meaningEn: Great, beggar, religious mendicant, a Brahman in the last stage of his life, also a Buddhist, by/through Saṃgha, noble spiritual community, with a half, Bodhisattva, Awakening Being, assembly + strong + and

verses.iast: kroṭa rājagaṇe sardvaṃ viyā dhara gaṇe tathā
verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·清净离诸尘垢·断除憍慢执障，王海会众，湖两个，一样、也他，请执持、总持护念！海会众、圣众眷属尊，如是、亦复如是
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust & cutting rigid pride, king + O assembly, a lake + two, like, as, hold! bear! sustain! O assembly, host,retinue / in assembly, host,retinue, thus, in that same way
verses.tangNoteZh: 尼瓦尔写本异文：(257) mayāśrutamekisma nsamaye bhagavānya dharmātye giriśikhare viharitismā|| mahatāca bhikṣu saṁghena sārddha bodhisatva gaṇenaca| kroṭa rājagaṇe sardvaṁ viyā dhara gaṇe tathā| locanā bhṛkuṭīcaivatārā bhagavatī tathā| mārīcī parṇu sāmakī pāṇurā tatā|| tatra bhagavantā spāgre bhagavannava lokitaḥ| lokānāma nukampāyeḥ śāstāraṁ paripṛcchati| bhagavantakṛ hi sarvajñajñāna nirmmala locanaḥ| bhagavatyā mṛtārāyoḥ kulamātu

verses.meaningZh: 眼、佛眼遍照，颦眉观音母·以及·圣救度佛母，具足才尊，如是、亦复如是
verses.meaningEn: Eye, illuminating vision, Bhṛkuṭī + and indeed + Tārā, endowed with excellence, thus, in that same way

verses.meaningZh: 摩利支天菩萨（阳焰威光佛母），第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，原有债务佛母，第一义谛·离诸诤论无诤·清净离诸尘垢，慈父
verses.meaningEn: Mārīcī, Goddess of Dawn Rays, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace (imperative seal), the original debt (feminine), ultimate truth & conflict-free peace & stainless purity free from dust, father
verses.tangNoteZh: 尼瓦尔写本异文：(257) mayāśrutamekisma nsamaye bhagavānya dharmātye giriśikhare viharitismā|| mahatāca bhikṣu saṁghena sārddha bodhisatva gaṇenaca| kroṭa rājagaṇe sardvaṁ viyā dhara gaṇe tathā| locanā bhṛkuṭīcaivatārā bhagavatī tathā| mārīcī parṇu sāmakī pāṇurā tatā|| tatra bhagavantā spāgre bhagavannava lokitaḥ| lokānāma nukampāyeḥ śāstāraṁ paripṛcchati| bhagavantakṛ hi sarvajñajñāna nirmmala locanaḥ| bhagavatyā mṛtārāyoḥ kulamātu

verses.meaningZh: 于彼处、其中，世尊末，一切诸谛圆满·第一义谛·妙行趣入，出有坏九，随一趣往
verses.meaningEn: There, therein, Bhagavān + end, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & ultimate truth & awakened spiritual movement (vocative invocation), nine, mostly ) look + going
verses.tangNoteZh: 尼瓦尔写本异文：(257) mayāśrutamekisma nsamaye bhagavānya dharmātye giriśikhare viharitismā|| mahatāca bhikṣu saṁghena sārddha bodhisatva gaṇenaca| kroṭa rājagaṇe sardvaṁ viyā dhara gaṇe tathā| locanā bhṛkuṭīcaivatārā bhagavatī tathā| mārīcī parṇu sāmakī pāṇurā tatā|| tatra bhagavantā spāgre bhagavannava lokitaḥ| lokānāma nukampāyeḥ śāstāraṁ paripṛcchati| bhagavantakṛ hi sarvajñajñāna nirmmala locanaḥ| bhagavatyā mṛtārāyoḥ kulamātu

verses.meaningZh: 世间·气息·是的，离名相假立·造作离相·无我大慈三昧，天人师，般问
verses.meaningEn: World + breath + yes, beyond nominal designation & freedom from karmic agency & selfless great loving-kindness, śāstāraṃ, wisdom + ask
verses.tangNoteZh: 尼瓦尔写本异文：(257) mayāśrutamekisma nsamaye bhagavānya dharmātye giriśikhare viharitismā|| mahatāca bhikṣu saṁghena sārddha bodhisatva gaṇenaca| kroṭa rājagaṇe sardvaṁ viyā dhara gaṇe tathā| locanā bhṛkuṭīcaivatārā bhagavatī tathā| mārīcī parṇu sāmakī pāṇurā tatā|| tatra bhagavantā spāgre bhagavannava lokitaḥ| lokānāma nukampāyeḥ śāstāraṁ paripṛcchati| bhagavantakṛ hi sarvajñajñāna nirmmala locanaḥ| bhagavatyā mṛtārāyoḥ kulamātu

verses.meaningZh: 破有相福德光·妙行趣入·最上真言离言说，诚然、因为、实乃，一切智圣智，净无垢秽、纤尘不染，眼、佛眼遍照
verses.meaningEn: Blessedness transcending existence & awakened spiritual movement & supreme ineffable speech, for, indeed, surely, omniscient + primordial wisdom, utterly spotless, taintless, eye, illuminating vision
verses.tangNoteZh: 尼瓦尔写本异文：(257) mayāśrutamekisma nsamaye bhagavānya dharmātye giriśikhare viharitismā|| mahatāca bhikṣu saṁghena sārddha bodhisatva gaṇenaca| kroṭa rājagaṇe sardvaṁ viyā dhara gaṇe tathā| locanā bhṛkuṭīcaivatārā bhagavatī tathā| mārīcī parṇu sāmakī pāṇurā tatā|| tatra bhagavantā spāgre bhagavannava lokitaḥ| lokānāma nukampāyeḥ śāstāraṁ paripṛcchati| bhagavantakṛ hi sarvajñajñāna nirmmala locanaḥ| bhagavatyā mṛtārāyoḥ kulamātu

verses.meaningZh: 以世尊佛母！（呼格），殒·此边·活生生，造作离相·离一切相无相·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: With/by O Blessed Goddess / Bhagavatī! to die + the hither + of living, freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks & selfless great loving-kindness (imperative seal)

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed Mother / Lady Bhagavatī, fulfilling, endowed with press out, extract, the Soma, Tārā + possession

verses.meaningEn: O Blessed Goddess + of a demon + Purna, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust, hatchet + dha + noble, beyond nominal designation & fruition of enlightenment & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation)

verses.meaningEn: Supreme vehicle of awakening & beyond nominal designation & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), great, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & spiritual strength freeing bonds & generosity & self-mastery, or, indeed + suppose now + to Thee

verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — expansive quiescence

verses.meaningZh: 最上真言离言说·无我大慈三昧·一乘如实之道，一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·离名相假立，出有坏不，那罗那个，最上真言离言说·因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme vehicle of awakening, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation (reverent offering), not, of a man + that, supreme ineffable speech & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust
verses.tangNoteZh: 尼瓦尔写本异文：om namo bhagavate jambharāya || evaṁmayāśṛtameka sminsamaye bhagavāna śrāvatyāṁ viharatismā || jetavane anātha pinusyārā mamahatābhikṣa saṁghena sārddha marddha trayā daśabhirvbhitṛśataiḥ || athakhalu māṇibhadro mahāyakṣa senāpatiyena bhagavāṁsta nopasaṁkrāntaḥ ūpasaṁkramya bhagavataḥ pādauśila sāvanditvā ekānte skādaikānte skilvā mahāyakṣa senāpati vbhagavaṁnta me tadvocata || idaṁbhadanta bhagavanta mahudayaṁyaḥ ka

verses.iast: jetavane anātha pinusyārā mamahatābhikṣa saṃghena sārddha marddha trayā daśabhirvbhitṛśataiḥ
verses.meaningZh: 祇树林尊，不是救度者、无助，第一义谛·离名相假立·一切诸谛圆满，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，以圣僧伽、清净海众，俱，调伏碾碎·无我大慈三昧，以守护掩蔽、度脱从中，施度调伏·本性寂静止息·破有相福德光
verses.meaningEn: O the grove called Jeta / in the grove called Jeta, having no protector, helpless, ultimate truth & beyond nominal designation & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, great, by/through Saṃgha, noble spiritual community, with a half, subduing, with/by protect shelter, rescue from, generosity & self-mastery & primordial tranquil peace & blessedness transcending existence
verses.tangNoteZh: 尼瓦尔写本异文：om namo bhagavate jambharāya || evaṁmayāśṛtameka sminsamaye bhagavāna śrāvatyāṁ viharatismā || jetavane anātha pinusyārā mamahatābhikṣa saṁghena sārddha marddha trayā daśabhirvbhitṛśataiḥ || athakhalu māṇibhadro mahāyakṣa senāpatiyena bhagavāṁsta nopasaṁkrāntaḥ ūpasaṁkramya bhagavataḥ pādauśila sāvanditvā ekānte skādaikānte skilvā mahāyakṣa senāpati vbhagavaṁnta me tadvocata || idaṁbhadanta bhagavanta mahudayaṁyaḥ ka

verses.iast: athakhalu māṇibhadro mahāyakṣa senāpatiyena bhagavāṃsta nopasaṃkrāntaḥ ūpasaṃkramya bhagavataḥ pādauśila sāvanditvā ekānte
verses.meaningZh: 尔时诚然，无我大慈三昧·离诸诤论无诤·破有相福德光，大药叉，将军借由彼因缘，破有相福德光·妙行趣入·最上真言离言说，离名相假立·第一义谛·一切诸谛圆满，第一义谛·一切诸谛圆满·造作离相，世尊、薄伽梵（具六德圣尊），第一义谛·施度调伏·本性寂静止息，礼敬赞叹·一切诸谛圆满，一面
verses.meaningEn: Now + indeed, selfless great loving-kindness & conflict-free peace & blessedness transcending existence, great + Yakṣa, chief of an army + by which, blessedness transcending existence & awakened spiritual movement & supreme ineffable speech, beyond nominal designation & ultimate truth & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, ultimate truth & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from karmic agency, Bhagavān, the Blessed/World-Honored One, ultimate truth & generosity & self-mastery & primordial tranquil peace, venerating, one side

verses.iast: skādaikānte skilvā mahāyakṣa senāpati vbhagavaṃnta me tadvocata
verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·造作离相·施度调伏，一切诸谛圆满·造作离相·离一切相无相，大药叉，将军，最上真言离言说·破有相福德光·妙行趣入，于我、为我，真如实际·施度调伏·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from karmic agency & generosity & self-mastery (vocative invocation), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks, great + Yakṣa, chief of an army, general, supreme ineffable speech & blessedness transcending existence & awakened spiritual movement, to me, my, immutable Suchness & generosity & self-mastery & supreme ineffable speech

verses.meaningEn: This + venerable, Bhagavān + end, gladden + water + Vāyu wind-mandala swiftness seed syllable + whoever, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — primordial non-arising

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! speech-vajra seed syllable Āḥ (non-arising), vajra seed syllable Huṃ, delighting, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 趣往、途径，佛陀、觉者，破有相福德光·施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢，谁，名为、号曰，陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义），三磨钵耽
verses.meaningEn: Going, way, Buddha, the Awakened One, blessedness transcending existence & generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust, kasya, by name, called, Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell, samāptaḥ
verses.tangNoteZh: 尼瓦尔写本异文：rāyā samyakkaṁ buddhāya || bodhi pratiṣṭhāyayati || om āḥ hu̐ sūgatavajatuṣyahoḥ svāhā || ita buddha bhaddāra kasya nāma dhāraṇī samāptaḥ || 119 || om namo buddhāya || om namo bhagavate āryya śrīpadamottama tathāgatā yārhate samyakkaṁ buddhāya || tadyathā || om padme 2 padmodbhave sukhāvatī managachaṇna svāhā || iti gāthādvayaṁkāragata suddhārta aṣṭottaraśataṁ jāppa etyo praśuddhā bhavanita || || iti āryya śrīpadmott

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to/for Buddha, the Awakened One
verses.tangNoteZh: 尼瓦尔写本异文：rāyā samyakkaṁ buddhāya || bodhi pratiṣṭhāyayati || om āḥ hu̐ sūgatavajatuṣyahoḥ svāhā || ita buddha bhaddāra kasya nāma dhāraṇī samāptaḥ || 119 || om namo buddhāya || om namo bhagavate āryya śrīpadamottama tathāgatā yārhate samyakkaṁ buddhāya || tadyathā || om padme 2 padmodbhave sukhāvatī managachaṇna svāhā || iti gāthādvayaṁkāragata suddhārta aṣṭottaraśataṁ jāppa etyo praśuddhā bhavanita || || iti āryya śrīpadmott

verses.iast: om namo bhagavate ārya śrīpadamottama tathāgatā yārhate samyakkaṃ buddhāya
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊（薄伽梵）致敬，圣、尊贵圣者，吉祥·秋天·本刹·最上，如来（乘如实道来成正觉），一乘如实之道·清净离诸尘垢·因缘空寂大乐，权利之后，向佛陀、觉者
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), auspiciousness + fall + this + highest, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One, supreme vehicle of awakening & stainless purity free from dust & causal emptiness & spiritual joy (vocative invocation), right + or emphasizing particle, to/for Buddha, the Awakened One
verses.tangNoteZh: 尼瓦尔写本异文：rāyā samyakkaṁ buddhāya || bodhi pratiṣṭhāyayati || om āḥ hu̐ sūgatavajatuṣyahoḥ svāhā || ita buddha bhaddāra kasya nāma dhāraṇī samāptaḥ || 119 || om namo buddhāya || om namo bhagavate āryya śrīpadamottama tathāgatā yārhate samyakkaṁ buddhāya || tadyathā || om padme 2 padmodbhave sukhāvatī managachaṇna svāhā || iti gāthādvayaṁkāragata suddhārta aṣṭottaraśataṁ jāppa etyo praśuddhā bhavanita || || iti āryya śrīpadmott

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:

verses.iast: om padme padmodbhave sukhāvatī managachaṇna svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！莲华（出淤泥而不染清净心）尊，莲华氏族，极乐世界，无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·妙行趣入，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O lotus flower (pure, unstained) / in lotus flower (pure, unstained), lotus flower + O origin, Western Pure Land, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & awakened spiritual movement, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 尼瓦尔写本异文：rāyā samyakkaṁ buddhāya || bodhi pratiṣṭhāyayati || om āḥ hu̐ sūgatavajatuṣyahoḥ svāhā || ita buddha bhaddāra kasya nāma dhāraṇī samāptaḥ || 119 || om namo buddhāya || om namo bhagavate āryya śrīpadamottama tathāgatā yārhate samyakkaṁ buddhāya || tadyathā || om padme 2 padmodbhave sukhāvatī managachaṇna svāhā || iti gāthādvayaṁkāragata suddhārta aṣṭottaraśataṁ jāppa etyo praśuddhā bhavanita || || iti āryya śrīpadmott

verses.meaningZh: 如是（结句印定），孤起·无二·偈子赞叹·去，总持任持·一切诸谛圆满，八·无上·百，生起不可得·尊胜·第一义谛，真如实际·一乘如实之道，转载真实，星宿·一样·趣往
verses.meaningEn: Thus, so it is stated, gatha + hymn of praise + understood, upholding, eight + upper, transcending birth & victorious & ultimate truth, immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening, forward, star + te + going
verses.tangNoteZh: 尼瓦尔写本异文：rāyā samyakkaṁ buddhāya || bodhi pratiṣṭhāyayati || om āḥ hu̐ sūgatavajatuṣyahoḥ svāhā || ita buddha bhaddāra kasya nāma dhāraṇī samāptaḥ || 119 || om namo buddhāya || om namo bhagavate āryya śrīpadamottama tathāgatā yārhate samyakkaṁ buddhāya || tadyathā || om padme 2 padmodbhave sukhāvatī managachaṇna svāhā || iti gāthādvayaṁkāragata suddhārta aṣṭottaraśataṁ jāppa etyo praśuddhā bhavanita || || iti āryya śrīpadmott

verses.meaningZh: 如是（结句印定），圣、尊贵圣者，吉祥庄严·本性寂静止息
verses.meaningEn: Thus, so it is stated, noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), glorious

verses.meaningZh: 相忍耐力，天女、佛母明妃，般若波罗蜜多清净吉祥，最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢，最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜，罪业、恶不善业，破暗合集·离诸诤论无诤·远离虚妄安立，般若彼岸，有限、干脆
verses.meaningEn: Disposition + fortitude, goddess, sacred female deity, Perfection of Wisdom + auspicious, supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious & stainless purity free from dust (vocative invocation), supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious, evil, karmic sin, unwholesome deed, dissolving dense ignorance & conflict-free peace & beyond conceptual fabrication, Prajñā + carrying over, measured, defined, limited

verses.iast: vailocanodbhava śirobhavavāmamakhe abhitābha-akṣommaḥ dhvajama vajaḍaghaṇṭhaḥ ratnanābhau amogha pāṇa

verses.meaningEn: Awakened, awakening (vocative invocation), crooked, tortuous, false, dishonest, ambiguous, malignant, inimical, bearing, supreme vehicle of awakening & ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust (imperative seal), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & beyond nominal designation & ultimate truth, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — perfected spiritual vigor, all, every, complete

verses.meaningEn: Who, whichever, selfless great loving-kindness & immutable Suchness & blessedness transcending existence, to make a vow, dha + wealth + words + or interrog, generosity & self-mastery & primordial tranquil peace & supreme vehicle of awakening

verses.meaningEn: Spiritual strength freeing bonds & generosity & self-mastery & Dharma-realm retention, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, selfless great loving-kindness & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās

verses.meaningEn: Glorious, supreme vehicle of awakening & non-abiding equipoise & transcending birth & victorious, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & awakened conduct beyond flux & selfless great loving-kindness, blessedness transcending existence & generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust

verses.meaningEn: Transcending birth & victorious & immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), there, therein, indeed, verily, certainly, blessedness transcending existence & awakened spiritual movement & supreme ineffable speech, do not + joy, do not + think + triple + very + particle to express certainty

verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, hole + crawling, Lokeśvara, Sovereign Lord of the World, all + suffering + heal, Maṇi jewel + O lotus flower, Hūṃ! Lotus-family seed of Amitābha & Avalokiteśvara, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: ? śrī khasaryya nāma dhāraṇī ? śrī abhayaṃkarināmadhāraṇī ? śrī mahamrabhujalokeśva
verses.meaningZh: 吉祥、圣德威光，等虚空无碍·一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢，名为、号曰，陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义），吉祥、圣德威光，能作成办·总持任持·破有相福德光，吉祥、圣德威光，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: Auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, space-like boundlessness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust, by name, called, Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, making, upholding, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, great

verses.iast: siddhinikā ? śrī ṣaḍakṣarī nāma dhāraṇī ? śrī nīlakaṇṭha lokeśvara nāmadhāraṇī
verses.meaningZh: 悉地成就·一切诸谛圆满，吉祥、圣德威光，六字大明咒，名为、号曰，陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义），吉祥、圣德威光，青颈观自在（吞摄诸毒大悲相），世间自在王（观音尊号），名为陀罗尼
verses.meaningEn: Perfected, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, Mantra of Six Syllables, by name, called, Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell, auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, Nīlakaṇṭha, Blue-Throated Compassionate One, Lokeśvara, Sovereign Lord of the World, by name + Dhāraṇī

verses.meaningZh: 吉祥、圣德威光，莲华手，名为、号曰，陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义），吉祥、圣德威光，妙行流布·总持任持·一切诸谛圆满，吉祥、圣德威光，六度满行清净·息灭诤怨·造作离相

verses.meaningZh: 名为陀罗尼，吉祥、圣德威光，生起不可得·尊胜·无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢，吉祥、圣德威光，难迥遮·大自在天·格局，称赞，吉祥、圣德威光，世间自在王（观音尊号）

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊佛母顶礼，圣、尊贵圣者，吉祥、圣德威光，向金刚亥母
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to to the Blessed Mother / Lady Bhagavatī, noble, holy, exalted (Ārya), auspiciousness, glory, sacred splendor, to Dakini Vajravarahi
verses.tangNoteZh: 尼瓦尔写本异文：oṁ namo bhagavatyai āryya-śrī-bajravārāhyai | oṁ bajravairocanīye hūṁ hūṁ phaṭ sbāhā | oṁ sarvvabuddhaḍākinīye bajravarṇṇanīye hūṁ hūṁ phaṭ sbāhā ||

verses.iast: oṃ vajravairocanīye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！金刚大日尊，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Vajra + O of, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 尼瓦尔写本异文：oṁ namo bhagavatyai āryya-śrī-bajravārāhyai | oṁ bajravairocanīye hūṁ hūṁ phaṭ sbāhā | oṁ sarvvabuddhaḍākinīye bajravarṇṇanīye hūṁ hūṁ phaṭ sbāhā ||

verses.iast: oṃ sarvabuddhaḍākinīye vajravarṇanīye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！一切·佛陀·荼吉尼·此处尊，金刚赞叹尊，吽吽（金刚不坏心印）！泮吒（摧破魔障）！圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! all + Buddha + Ḍākinī, Vajra + O praise, Hūṃ Hūṃ (adamantine bodhicitta seal)! Phaṭ! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 尼瓦尔写本异文：oṁ namo bhagavatyai āryya-śrī-bajravārāhyai | oṁ bajravairocanīye hūṁ hūṁ phaṭ sbāhā | oṁ sarvvabuddhaḍākinīye bajravarṇṇanīye hūṁ hūṁ phaṭ sbāhā ||

verses.meaningEn: Everywhere, at all times & places, bull + vain, awakened spiritual movement & immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, to come, Manojava, jino, winning + eager, superlative, O Cakravartin, universal wheel-turning monarch, mahābalaḥ

verses.meaningEn: Gladden + dignity, Dharma-realm retention & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust, un-other, beyond nominal designation & supreme vehicle of awakening, great + direction of the will

verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & awakened spiritual movement & primordial tranquil peace, of words, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & beyond nominal designation, truth + bark, truth-speaking, promise, vow (feminine) and awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening

verses.meaningZh: 嗡（三身总持圣音）！归命，向诸一切佛陀菩提萨埵
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! homage to all + Buddha + to all Bodhisattva
verses.tangNoteZh: 尼瓦尔写本异文：oṁ namaḥ sarvvabuddhabodhisatvebhyaḥ | oṁ sitātapatre aparājite pratyaṅgire sarvvakṛtyakākhorddavināśani hūṁ mama hūṁ ni sbāhā ||

verses.iast: oṃ sitātapatre aparājite pratyaṅgire sarvakṛtyakākhordavināśani hūṃ mama hūṃ ni svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！大白伞盖（清净护庇）尊，无能胜、不可摧伏尊，般罗底扬吉罗（大回遮母、总破邪咒母）尊，能灭除一切业行压镇尊，吽（金刚心印）！我之（行者所有），吽（金刚心印）！曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·诸根清净自在），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! O White Parasol (pure protective canopy) / in White Parasol (pure protective canopy), O invincible, unconquered / in invincible, unconquered, O Pratyaṅgirā, Counter-Sorcery Protective Goddess / in Pratyaṅgirā, Counter-Sorcery Protective Goddess, all + actions + O destroyer of an evil demon, Hūṃ! my, of me (the practitioner), Hūṃ! beyond nominal designation (nāma) — purified faculties, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 尼瓦尔写本异文：oṁ namaḥ sarvvabuddhabodhisatvebhyaḥ | oṁ sitātapatre aparājite pratyaṅgire sarvvakṛtyakākhorddavināśani hūṁ mama hūṁ ni sbāhā ||

verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·最上真言离言说·真如实际，吉祥安隐、善妙无恙，转载·那个·来，六度满行清净·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme ineffable speech & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), well-being, fortune, auspicious safety, forward + that + to come, perfection of the six pāramitās & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening

verses.meaningZh: 吉祥安隐、善妙无恙，清净离诸尘垢·息灭诤怨，吉祥安隐截至日子已，一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Well-being, fortune, auspicious safety, stainless purity free from dust & pacifying conflict & turmoil (imperative seal), well-being + having by day, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation)

verses.meaningZh: 立尊，一切处、普皆周遍，吉祥安隐、善妙无恙，嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·真如实际，无我大慈三昧·妙行迁变空·六度满行清净，罪业·勿·去

verses.meaningEn: O all, every, complete / in all, every, complete, having he, that one, O all, every, complete / in all, every, complete, inward breath (plural), all, every, complete, blessedness transcending existence & immutable Suchness & non-dual wisdom awareness, exclusive, belonging only to

verses.meaningEn: A lake + particle emphasizing the preceding word or merely expletive, blissful, may they all abide in peace! all, every, complete, beyond nominal designation (nāma) — primordial non-arising

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·真如实际·贤！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & immutable Suchness, blessed!
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：-
verses.diplomaticOriginal: @1a namaḥ samaṃta bhadrāya || atha khalu samaṃta bhadro bodhisatvo mahāsa tva etāne valoka dhātu paraṃparā nabhi lāpyā nabhi lāpya buddha kṣetra paramāṇu rajaḥ samānkalpānkalpa prasarā nabhidyotaya māno bhūya syā mātrayā gāthābhirgītena praṇidhānama kārṣīt || yāvata ke …

verses.iast: atha khalu samaṃta bhadro bodhisatvo mahāsa tva etāne valoka dhātu paraṃparā
verses.meaningZh: 尔时、次复吉祥启白，诚然、确实，一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·真如实际，贤，菩提·彼·长柄，大彼，嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，长柄气息尊，转动故乡，界、法界、佛舍利界，历次、累累
verses.meaningEn: Now, thereupon, auspiciously, indeed, verily, certainly, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & immutable Suchness, blessed, Bodhi + he + stem, great + he, supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — primordial non-arising, stem + O breath, turn + home, realm, element, sphere, relic-essence, following one another, successive, repeated
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：-

verses.iast: nabhi lāpyā nabhi lāpya buddha kṣetra paramāṇu rajaḥ samānkalpānkalpa prasarā nabhidyotaya
verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·破有相福德光，离一切相无相·第一义谛·一乘如实之道，离名相假立·破有相福德光，离一切相无相·第一义谛·一乘如实之道，佛陀、觉者，田，极微尘，尘，一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·离名相假立，初升、洪水，离名相假立·破有相福德光·施度调伏
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & blessedness transcending existence (vocative invocation), freedom from conditioned marks & ultimate truth & supreme vehicle of awakening, beyond nominal designation & blessedness transcending existence (vocative invocation), freedom from conditioned marks & ultimate truth & supreme vehicle of awakening, Buddha, the Awakened One, field, infinitely small part or atom, rajaḥ, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation, coming forth, rising, appearing, spreading, free course, bold behaviour, beyond nominal designation & blessedness transcending existence & generosity & self-mastery
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：-

verses.iast: māno bhūya syā mātrayā gāthābhirgītena praṇidhānama kārṣīt
verses.meaningZh: 慢，又么，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·远离寂静周遍），以称计、范围，以孤起融通妙歌赞颂，归命敬礼·第一义谛，造作离相·清净离诸尘垢·六度满行清净
verses.meaningEn: Māno, bhūya, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — expansive quiescence, with/by measure, limit , quantity, size, duration, gatha + to + by, bowing, freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust & perfection of the six pāramitās
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：-

verses.iast: yāvata ke ciddaśaddiśi loke sarvatriyadhvagatā narasiṃhāḥ
verses.meaningZh: 一乘如实之道·最上真言离言说·真如实际，迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·钩召发起三昧），妙行迁变空·施度调伏·本性寂静止息，世间、世界尊，一切·般舟·去，诸纳拉辛哈
verses.meaningEn: Supreme vehicle of awakening & supreme ineffable speech & immutable Suchness, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — samādhi invocation, awakened conduct beyond flux & generosity & self-mastery & primordial tranquil peace (vocative invocation), O world, realm / in world, realm, all + of present + understood, Narasimha (plural)
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：-

verses.meaningZh: 彼等我身，金刚界大日智法身水轮甘露种子柔善尊，一切、普皆遍满尊，周遍气息
verses.meaningEn: Them + alas! Vajradhātu Mahāvairocana ambrosia seed syllable + O or house, O all, every, complete, no rest or remainder + breath
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：-

verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·一乘如实之道·真如实际，以自尊，喜
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness, by/through pride, prasannaḥ
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：-

verses.iast: kṣetra rajopamakā ya praṇāmaiḥ sarvajināna karomi praṇāmaṃ sarva jinābhimukhenama nena bhadracariṃ praṇidhāna balena
verses.meaningZh: 田，清净离诸尘垢·生起不可得·尊胜·第一义谛，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），以诸最敬，一切·胜者·气息，能作成办·造作离相，最敬，一切、普皆遍满，归命敬礼·生起不可得·尊胜，离名相假立，善哉经过，发愿，以力、十力神通威神力
verses.meaningEn: Field, stainless purity free from dust & transcending birth & victorious & ultimate truth, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, by/with bow, reverent salutation, all + Victor + breath, making (vocative invocation), bow, reverent salutation, all, every, complete, bowing, beyond nominal designation (by spiritual power), the (vow to perform the) excellent course (of Bodhisattvas), to make a vow, by/through power, strength, spiritual force
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：-

verses.iast: ekarajāgri rajopama buddhāna buddha sutāna niṣaṇṇaku madhye evama śeṣata dharmata dhātuṃ sarvadhi mūcyami pūrṇṇa jinebhiḥ
verses.meaningZh: 一·山羊·尊尊，尘郁多摩，佛陀气息，佛陀、觉者，报刊往外一线，依止处大地，中尊，最上真言离言说·无我大慈三昧，本性寂静止息·六度满行清净·真如实际，驮理趣，界、法界、佛舍利界，湖刑尊，无我大慈三昧·妙行迁变空·一乘如实之道，富楼那，以诸胜者、最胜诸佛
verses.meaningEn: Drift + O first, dyer + uppermost, Buddha + breath, Buddha, the Awakened One, press out + thread, sitting down + earth, O neutral, impartial, supreme ineffable speech & selfless great loving-kindness, primordial tranquil peace & perfection of the six pāramitās & immutable Suchness, dha + thought, realm, element, sphere, relic-essence, a lake + O punishment, selfless great loving-kindness & awakened conduct beyond flux & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), Purna, with Victor, Conqueror (Buddha)
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：-

verses.iast: teṣu ca akṣaya varṇṇa samudrān sarva svarāṃga samudra rutebhiḥ
verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·六度满行清净以及无尽，显色、身色光彩，大海、生死海，一切、普皆遍满，一切诸谛圆满·最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢，大海、生死海，以诸梵音、号啕
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & perfection of the six pāramitās (imperative seal) and imperishable, color, hue, luminous appearance, ocean, boundless sea, all, every, complete, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust, ocean, boundless sea, with voice, cry, sound
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：-

verses.meaningZh: 一切、普皆遍满，胜者气息，妙行趣入·离诸诤论无诤·离名相假立，一切诸谛圆满·妙行趣入·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: All, every, complete, Victor + breath, awakened spiritual movement & conflict-free peace & beyond nominal designation, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & awakened spiritual movement & immutable Suchness
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：-
