verses.meaningEn: Thus, so it is stated, Bodhisattva
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：MS-OR-00713

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛陀、觉者！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Buddha, the Awakened One!
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：MS-OR-00713

verses.meaningZh: 菩提心众疏，最上真言离言说·造作离相·六度满行清净
verses.meaningEn: Aspiration to enlightenment, supreme ineffable speech & freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：MS-OR-00713

verses.meaningZh: 心、菩提心、心识，闢·他·诸父，诸法，真如实际·一乘如实之道·造作离相，才鸣呼
verses.meaningEn: Mind, heart, thought, bodhicitta, settle + tha + father, all things, immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening & freedom from karmic agency, excellence
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：MS-OR-00713

verses.meaningZh: 多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·本不生体性），天神·告诉·积累，在于变坏，迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·诸根清净自在·大空菩提点摄持），自性称计
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness (tathatā) — primordial non-arising, a god + say + piled up, in, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — purified faculties sealed with bodhicitta bindu, own-being + measure
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：MS-OR-00713

verses.meaningZh: 如是宣说、佛言
verses.meaningEn: Spoke, declared thus
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：MS-OR-00713

verses.meaningZh: 一切有离，蕴·放置·长柄·十二处，渊博，嚩啰·幅度·优胜·彼
verses.meaningEn: All things or beings + lost, aggregate + put + stem + ayatana, to be seized, taken, held, gathered, gained, received, perceived, understood, learned, taking + width + winning + him
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：MS-OR-00713

verses.iast: dharmanairātmya samatayā sva cittamādyanutyannaṃ śūnyatāsvabhāvamiti kosyavacanasyārthaḥ sarvabhāvavegatamiti bhāvaśabdena ātmādaya ucyante
verses.meaningZh: 法空，以萨麻丹，嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，妙行迁变空·真如实际·无我大慈三昧，空性·自性·称计，真言宣演·造作离相，一切有·余力·彼·如是，以物声，我者残忍，妙行迁变空·一乘如实之道·离名相假立
verses.meaningEn: Inherent emptiness of dharmas, with/by to, supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — primordial non-arising, awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness & selfless great loving-kindness, emptiness + own-being + measure, uttering, all things or beings + jerk + him + thus, becoming + by, merciless, awakened conduct beyond flux & supreme vehicle of awakening & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：MS-OR-00713

verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·施度调伏·造作离相，我床坐，长寿护命·欢喜悦泽·生起不可得·尊胜，最上真言离言说·破有相福德光·真如实际，不、非、无，成办、生起、安住
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & generosity & self-mastery & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation), self + state of seat, vitalizing, delighting, supreme ineffable speech & blessedness transcending existence & immutable Suchness, not, non-, becomes, arises, is
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：MS-OR-00713

verses.meaningZh: 迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·诸根清净自在·大空菩提点摄持），作
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — purified faculties sealed with bodhicitta bindu, kāraṇaṃ
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：MS-OR-00713

verses.meaningZh: 彼等一切之·如此·解脱，一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·最上真言离言说，业相，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·远离寂静周遍）
verses.meaningEn: Of them + so + O liberation, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & supreme ineffable speech, activity + mark, immutable Suchness (tathatā) — expansive quiescence
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：MS-OR-00713

verses.iast: evaṃ tāvadātmādayo bhāvāna vidyante prāgevatatsvabhāvaṃ cittamiti
verses.meaningZh: 如是、如此，真如实际·最上真言离言说·施度调伏，物气息，向解假定今日汝，原来·彼·自性，心称计
verses.meaningEn: Thus, in this way, immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery, becoming + breath, understanding + suppose now + to Thee, formerly + That + own-being, mind + measure
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：MS-OR-00713

verses.iast: ataḥ sarvabhāvavigataṃ ska tanasvabhāvaṃ cittaṃ bhavatītyāha
verses.meaningZh: 走道那么、游方，一切有离，迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·本不生体性），裔胄自性，心、菩提心、心识，成办·经过·如是宣说
verses.meaningEn: Walk about, wander, run, all things or beings + lost, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — primordial non-arising, offspring + own-being, mind, heart, thought, bodhicitta, becomes + course + spoke
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：MS-OR-00713

verses.meaningZh: 蕴·放置·长柄·十二处，渊博，嚩啰·幅度·优胜·净水·鸿毛
verses.meaningEn: Aggregate + put + stem + ayatana, to be seized, taken, held, gathered, gained, received, perceived, understood, learned, taking + width + winning + water + down
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：MS-OR-00713

provenance.rawSnippet:
śrī saṃpuṭodbhava tantra 

[Elder, G.R., The Saṃpuṭa tantra: edition and translation, chapters I-IV. Unpublished Ph. D. dissertation submitted to Columbia University, 1978]







THE SAṂPUṬA TANTRA - SANSKRIT EDITION 



(Chapter 1) <<pp36-63>> 

(oṃ) namo vajraḍākāya // 

evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān sarvatathāgatakāyavākcitta(hṛdaya)vajrayoṣidbhageṣu vijahāra // 

tatra khalu bhagavān aśītikoṭiyogīśvaramadhye vajragarbham avalokaḥ smitam akārṣīt // 

samanantaraṃ smite 'smin vajragarbha utthāyāsanād ekāṃsam uttarāsaṅgaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇaṃ jānumaṇḍalaṃ pṛthivyāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya kṛtāñjalipuṭottatvā bhagavantam etad avocat // 

śrotum icchāmi jñānendra sarvatantranidānakaṃ / 
rahasyaṃ saṃpuṭodbhūtaṃ lakṣaṇam // 

bhagavān āha //

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！归命，向世尊（薄伽梵）致敬，向吉祥喜金刚

verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Columbia University

(Chapter 1) <<pp36-63>> 

(oṃ) namo vajraḍākāya // 

evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān sarvatathāgatakāyavākcitta(hṛdaya)vajrayoṣidbhageṣu vijahāra // 

tatra khalu bhagavān aśītikoṭiyogīśvaramadhye vajragarbham avalokaḥ smitam akārṣīt // 

samanantaraṃ smite 'smin vajragarbha utthāyāsanād ekāṃsam uttarāsaṅgaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇaṃ jānumaṇḍalaṃ pṛthivyāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya kṛtāñjalipuṭottatvā bhagavantam etad avocat // 

śrotum icchāmi jñānendra sarvatantranidānakaṃ / 
rahasyaṃ saṃpuṭodbhūtaṃ lakṣaṇam // 

bhagavān āha //

verses.iast: tadyathā kulaputra māyākāranāṭake pratyupasthite māyākāranirmitāṃ striyaṃ dṛṣṭvā kaścidrāgaparītavetāḥ
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：善男子，幻术者那罗，我身尊，幻术者化，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，施度调伏·六度满行清净·断除憍慢执障，造作离相·本性寂静止息·妙行迁变空
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: a good man, conjurer + O actor, O I shall wait on  S, conjurer + a magic creation, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust, generosity & self-mastery & perfection of the six pāramitās & cutting rigid pride, freedom from karmic agency & primordial tranquil peace & awakened conduct beyond flux
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Matsunami No. 251

verses.iast: tadyathā sarvebhyo vṛkṣebhyaḥ prāgvanaṃ nāsti tadā ekaikasmādapi nāsti
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：一切富人，向诸茂盛树，依然呼吸，离名相假立·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，彼时，造作离相·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧，离名相假立·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: all + belonging to one's household, to all tree, as before + breathe, beyond nominal designation & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), at that time, in that case, then, freedom from karmic agency & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), beyond nominal designation & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Matsunami No. 251

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：造作离相·清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Matsunami No. 251

verses.iast: tadyathā sve bhṛtyāḥ svāni dhanāni yattu yasya parāyattaṃ na tattasyātmīyaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，方位、滋补之，一切自，一切财，一乘如实之道·真如实际，凡彼…之，依存、受支配，不、非、无，彼·彼之·魔怔自我
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: supreme ineffable speech (vāk) — samādhi invocation, of bearing, carrying, maintaining, nourishing, own, treasure (plural), supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness (imperative seal), whose, of whom, dependent on, subject to, not, non-, That + his + characterized by a self
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Matsunami No. 251

verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧，离一切相无相·离名相假立·真如实际，罪业、恶不善业之，酒席、节日，生起不可得·尊胜·一乘如实之道·真如实际，以清净吉祥、善妙庄严，造作离相·离名相假立，桑菩提心，设使，名为、号曰，不、非、无，愿得成就、当如是
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness (imperative seal), freedom from conditioned marks & beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness (imperative seal), of evil, karmic sin, unwholesome deed, feast, festival, transcending birth & victorious & supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness (by spiritual power), by/through auspicious, pure, bright, virtuous, freedom from karmic agency & beyond nominal designation (by spiritual power), saṃ + aspiration to enlightenment, if, when, by name, called, not, non-, may it be so

verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & freedom from conditioned marks & ultimate truth, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation, god, celestial deity (Deva)
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Palm leaf C 14

verses.iast: yata sukhenaiva sukhaṃ pravṛddhamutplāvayatyapramitā ghān bhavaduḥkhaśatāni tartukīmairapi sa nāni hartukāmaiḥ
verses.meaningZh: 拘牵，乐·勇健·犹如，安乐，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·远离寂静周遍），愿成·苦·一切百，真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·造作离相，彼、此尊（阳性主格），阿支罗尊，以诸把手童子是的
verses.meaningEn: Held, restrained, checked, controlled, easy + strong + like, sukhaṃ, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, beyond nominal designation (nāma) — expansive quiescence, be! become! + suffering + hundred, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation), he, that one, O naked, grip + child + by
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Palm leaf C 14

verses.iast: bahusaukhyaśatāni bhoktukāmairna vimocyaṃ hi sadaiva bodhicittaṃ

verses.meaningEn: Many + welfare + hundred, blessedness transcending existence & freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness, settle + the same, for, indeed, surely, he + belonging to or coming from the gods, aspiration to enlightenment
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Palm leaf C 14

verses.iast: bhavacārakabandhano varā tānāṃ suta ucyate kṣaṇena
verses.meaningZh: 有狱系缚，殊胜、胜愿、妙好，一线，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，妙行迁变空·一乘如实之道·真如实际，以一刹那
verses.meaningEn: Bondage, choicest, supreme boon, excellent, thread, fibre, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness, awakened conduct beyond flux & supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), by/through birth under favorable conditions
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Palm leaf C 14

verses.meaningEn: He, that one, venerating, becomes, arises, is, particle to express certainty + to expound, indeed, verily, alone, having become a house or habitation, Victor + jewel + framer, making

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼玅依！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to beautiful, to!
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Palm leaf No 772
verses.diplomaticOriginal: <01B> namo mañjunāthāya|| sugatānsasutānsadharmmakāyān praṇipatyādarato'khilāśca vandyān| sugatātmajasambarāvatāraṁ kathayiṣyā mi yathāgama samāsāt|| na hi kiñcidapūrvamatra vācyanna ca saṁgranthanakauśalaṁ mamāsti| ataeva na me parārthacintā svamano bhāva yituṁ kṛtaṁ mayedam|| …

verses.meaningZh: 持守摄受·一切诸谛圆满，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·离诸诤论无诤，礼敬赞叹·最上真言离言说
verses.meaningEn: Bearing, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace, venerating
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Palm leaf No 772

verses.meaningZh: 善逝·自我·疲惫·天衣·入，造作离相·无住安立·一乘如实之道，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·诸根清净自在），犹如趣往，从合
verses.meaningEn: Sugata + self + be exhausted + garment + descent, freedom from karmic agency & non-abiding equipoise & supreme vehicle of awakening, selfless great loving-kindness — purified faculties, just as + going to or in, from time, occasion, juncture
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Palm leaf No 772

verses.iast: na hi kiñcidapūrvamatra vācyanna ca saṃgranthanakauśalaṃ mamāsti
verses.meaningZh: 不、非、无，诚然、因为、实乃，圆满充盈·造作离相，语言·假定今日·不以及我身福利，我之有
verses.meaningEn: Not, non-, for, indeed, surely, fulfilling, words + suppose now + not and literary composition + welfare, my + is
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Palm leaf No 772

verses.iast: ataeva na me parārthacintā svamano bhāva yituṃ kṛtaṃ mayedam
verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·最上真言离言说，不、非、无，于我、为我，利他思，自意，物，一乘如实之道·真如实际，所作、已成办，过去此
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & supreme ineffable speech, not, non-, to me, my, to benefit others + thought, own + mind, becoming, being, supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness, done, made, accomplished, made or consisting of + this
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Palm leaf No 772

verses.iast: mama tāvadanena yāti vṛrddhiṃ kuśalaṃ bhāvayituṃ prasādavegaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 我之（行者所有），以乃至粮，揭帝、步调尊，最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·法界总持任持，善，破有相福德光·最上真言离言说·一乘如实之道，淳余力
verses.meaningEn: My, of me (the practitioner), moreover + by, O gone, passed,, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & Dharma-realm retention, kuśalaṃ, blessedness transcending existence & supreme ineffable speech & supreme vehicle of awakening, pure
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Palm leaf No 772

verses.meaningZh: 尔时、次复吉祥启白，无我大慈三昧·真如实际·一切诸谛圆满，归命敬礼·第一义谛，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·无住安立，风大自在除障种子
verses.meaningEn: Now, thereupon, auspiciously, selfless great loving-kindness & immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, bowing (vocative invocation), all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & non-abiding equipoise (imperative seal), Vāyu wind-mandala swiftness seed syllable
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Palm leaf No 772

verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·六度满行清净·一乘如实之道，一切诸谛圆满·施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢，获，许多·企求·义利·成就法
verses.meaningEn: Freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās & supreme vehicle of awakening, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust, pratilabdhā, much + desirous + meaning + accomplishing
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Palm leaf No 772

verses.iast: yadi nātra vicintyate hitaṃ punarapyeṣa samāgamaḥ kutaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 设使，离名相假立·真如实际·清净离诸尘垢，闢主顾，并立，第一义谛·离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢，来诣一起、会议，为谁的
verses.meaningEn: If, when, beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust, settle + =, hitaṃ, ultimate truth & beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust, coming together, meeting, union, intercourse with, kutaḥ
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Palm leaf No 772

verses.iast: rātro yathā me ghaghanāndhakāre vidyutkṣyaṇaṃ darśayati prakāsaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 晚上、随一也他，犹如、如…所说，于我、为我，想必·健南·暗尊，最上真言离言说·施度调伏·一乘如实之道，示，转载咳嗽
verses.meaningEn: Night, mostly as or, just as, according to, to me, my, surely + slaying + O dark, supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery & supreme vehicle of awakening, teach, forward + cough
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Palm leaf No 772

verses.iast: buddhānubhāvena tathā kadācillokasya puṇyeṣu matiḥ kṣaṇa syāt
verses.meaningZh: 以佛陀体面，如是、亦复如是，几时·鹞鹰·谁，于诸福德、胜妙功德中，智慧，一刹那，愿得成就、当如是
verses.meaningEn: Buddha + by, thus, in that same way, when? at what time? how? With never, among/in merit, auspicious virtue, matiḥ, birth under favorable conditions, may it be so
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Palm leaf No 772

verses.iast: tasmācchubhaṃ durlla meva nityaṃ balaṃ tu pāpasya mahatsughoraṃ
verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧，施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢·离一切相无相，无我大慈三昧·最上真言离言说，常恒、永不间断，跋蓝，然而、而、实则，罪业、恶不善业之，广大·报刊往外·威怖
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness, generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from conditioned marks, selfless great loving-kindness & supreme ineffable speech, constantly, eternally, balaṃ, but, indeed, moreover, of evil, karmic sin, unwholesome deed, great + press out + formidable
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Palm leaf No 772

verses.meaningZh: 真如实际·生起不可得·尊胜·一乘如实之道，奢字门（本性寂静止息（śānti）·损减除灭忧苦），真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·本性寂静止息
verses.meaningEn: Immutable Suchness & transcending birth & victorious & supreme vehicle of awakening (by spiritual power), primordial tranquil peace (śānti) — dispelling sorrow, immutable Suchness & stainless purity free from dust & primordial tranquil peace
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Palm leaf No 772

verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Asha Archives MS 2145

verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Asha Archives MS 2145

verses.iast: namaḥ svāhātyaya devī namasyāmi syāme prayachatu guṇaughaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼圆满吉祥成就过·天女、佛母明妃·我具寿、表示敬意·一切诸谛圆满·一乘如实之道·无我大慈三昧·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道·妙行趣入·离诸诤论无诤·破暗合集！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to hail! may auspicious accomplishment be sealed, sin, goddess, sacred female deity, I to be worshipped, venerable, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & supreme vehicle of awakening & selfless great loving-kindness (vocative invocation), ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening (imperative seal), awakened spiritual movement & conflict-free peace & dissolving dense ignorance!
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Asha Archives MS 2145
verses.diplomaticOriginal: @1a oṃ̐ namaḥ śrī sarvva buddha bodhisatvebhyaḥ || nama śrī bhagavatya āryya prajñāpāramitāyaiḥ || tadyathā || śruti smṛti gati vijaye svāhā || || śrutaṃ mayaika samaye gṛdva kuṭe tathā gataḥ vijahāra dharmma dhāto gambhire buddha gocare || bodhisatva samuccayeyā …

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼一切佛陀·诸菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to all, Buddha, Bodhisattva, Awakening Being!
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Asha Archives MS 2145

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼弥勒菩萨（慈氏尊）·诸圣供、开始·诸菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to Maitreya, Loving-Kindness Bodhisattva, bringing forth, offering, presenting, beginning, Bodhisattva, Awakening Being!
verses.tangNoteZh: 馆藏写本：Asha Archives MS 2145

verses.meaningZh: 归命一切诸国家政策之，即说咒曰：以佛陀、觉者，以佛陀、觉者，离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢·生起不可得·尊胜，魔，愿胜伏、最胜吉祥！我之（行者所有）

verses.iast: śaṃ tadyathā amāñi vihi phali (amāṇi vihi phali) svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 奢字门（本性寂静止息（śānti）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），即说咒曰：无我大慈三昧·圣智通达，空气、虚空尊，有果、利养益处尊，一切本刹，空气、虚空尊，有果、利养益处尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Primordial tranquil peace (śānti) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, Thus goes the mantra: selfless great loving-kindness & non-dual wisdom awareness (vocative invocation), O air, the sky, O fruitful, having gain or advantage, this (plural), O air, the sky, O fruitful, having gain or advantage, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

Lefthand fragment, 4 1/2" 3", with string-hole, of a leaf numbered 70. Full size, probably 18" 3". Language: Sanskrit. Characters: upright Gupta of seventh or eighth century. verses.meaningZh: 凡彼等诸有情，正法、诸法实相，因生，因，彼等一切之，如来，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），最上真言离言说·施度调伏·真如实际，彼等一切之以及凡彼圣尊、能…者，灭谛，如是论者，大沙门，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Those who, whoever (pl.), Dharma, cosmic truth/teaching/phenomena, cause + excelling, cause, of them, their, tathāgato, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery & immutable Suchness, of them, their and who, whichever, suppression, thus + vādī, great, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: oṃ gate gate pāragate pārasaṃgate bodhi svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！再三度越吧、已往彼岸尊！度向彼岸吧、已达究竟彼岸！普同度至彼岸吧（圆证菩提）！菩提、无上正觉，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! gone, O One gone beyond! again and again, gone all the way to the other shore! gone completely altogether beyond! Bodhi, awakening, enlightenment, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 西域婆罗谜写卷外交转写：l.1: a /// + + + + + .. .. .. + /// l.2: b /// + + + + tvaḥ sarva[dh]. + /// l.3: c /// .. s(a)tvasya mahāsatvasya /// l.4: d /// yatena cāyaṃ manasā /// l.5: e /// .i athāyuṣmāṃñ cchāra + /// l.6: f /// + .. .. tvo niryānya[k].F + /// l.7: g /// + + + + [h]ā + + + /// Section: V

verses.meaningZh: 嗡！文殊般若心印（甚深智慧总持），闻·正念·最胜尊胜，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Mañjuśrī wisdom seed syllable (prajñā), hearing + mindfulness + O supreme victory! triumph! Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼世尊（薄伽梵）致敬·释迦牟尼佛（能仁寂默）·如来（乘如实道来成正觉）！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, Śākyamuni Buddha, Sage of the Śākyas, Tathāgata, Thus-Come One!

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼妙法莲华经·契经！
verses.meaningEn: Homage to the lotus of the good law, T, discourse!

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra:

verses.iast: anye manye mane mamane citte carite śame śamitāvi śānte mukte
verses.meaningZh: 他尊，持心、易逝来讲尊，自尊尊，瞒自然，心、菩提心、心识尊，运作、打算尊，息尊，能柔善闢，寂静、调柔安稳尊，除此之外
verses.meaningEn: O other / in other, O thinking one's self-, appearing as, passing for / in thinking one's self-, appearing as, passing for, O pride / in pride, maṃ + O certainly, O mind, heart, thought, bodhicitta / in mind, heart, thought, bodhicitta, O operation, calculation, problem, O rest / in rest, appeased + settle, O peaceful, calm, tranquil / in peaceful, calm, tranquil, except

verses.iast: muktatame same aviṣame samasame jaye kṣaye akṣīṇe śānte samite dhāraṇi
verses.meaningZh: 已解脱暗尊，平尊，平等、就是尊，比较平等、同样尊，胜伏、最胜吉祥！尊，向住着、出没，无疲惫、败絮，寂静、调柔安稳尊，彼有限，陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义）尊
verses.meaningEn: Liberated + O dark, O equal, O not unequal, O quite equal, O conquer! victory! / in conquer! victory! to abide, dwell, inhabit, non-O diminished, wasted, exhausted, broken down, thin, emaciated, feeble, O peaceful, calm, tranquil / in peaceful, calm, tranquil, he + O measured, O Dhāraṇī, total retention, protective spell

verses.meaningZh: 光明妙语，看待、如理作意尊，离名相假立·法界总持任持·清净离诸尘垢，内部殖尊，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Light + O speech, O regard, attention, care, beyond nominal designation & Dharma-realm retention & stainless purity free from dust (imperative seal), interior + O settled down, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningEn: Homage to the Blessed One, World-Honored Lord, great, to!

verses.meaningZh: 无常，鸣呼，行（诸行造作），持守摄受·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: Not everlasting, perishable, transient, inconstant, vata, volitional formations, conditioned phenomena, bearing

verses.iast: utpadya hi nirudhyante teṣāṃ vyupaśamaḥ sukham
verses.meaningZh: 迸今日，诚然、因为、实乃，向在于·增长·假定今日·汝，彼等一切之，寂静，安乐
verses.meaningEn: Burst forth + now, for, indeed, surely, in + grow + suppose now + to Thee, of them, their, vyupaśamaḥ, sukham

verses.meaningZh: 已解脱暗尊，平尊，平等、就是尊，比较平等、同样尊，胜伏、最胜吉祥！尊，向住着、出没，无疲惫、败絮，寂静、调柔安稳尊，彼有限，陀罗尼、总持（总一切法、持无量义）尊

verses.meaningEn: Light + O speech, O regard, attention, care, beyond nominal designation & Dharma-realm retention & stainless purity free from dust (imperative seal), interior + O settled down, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: siddhe susiddhe mocani mokṣaṇi mukte vimukte amale vimale nirmale maṅgalye
verses.meaningZh: 成就者、已成就尊，善妙成就、最胜悉地尊，解放尊，自由化尊，除此之外，究竟解脱、离诸系缚尊，无垢、离染清净尊，毘磨利，净无垢秽、纤尘不染尊，最极吉祥、致福清净尊
verses.meaningEn: O accomplished, perfected adept (Siddha) / in accomplished, perfected adept (Siddha), O well-accomplished, supremely perfected / in well-accomplished, supremely perfected, O delivering from, hurling, O freeing, delivering, except, O completely liberated, emancipated / in completely liberated, emancipated, O stainless, spotless, pure / in stainless, spotless, pure, pure, O utterly spotless, taintless / in utterly spotless, taintless, O auspicious, bringing felicity / in auspicious, bringing felicity
verses.tangNoteZh: 西域婆罗谜写卷外交转写：见原卷

verses.iast: hiraṇyagarbhe ratnagarbhe bhadragarbhe sarvārthasādhani paramārthasādhani svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 金胎神尊，宝藏尊，贤藏，一切义利成就法，第一义谛成就法，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: O Spirit Born from a Golden Egg / in Spirit Born from a Golden Egg, O filled with jewels, blessed + O womb, all aims and benefits + O accomplishing, ultimate truth + O accomplishing, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 西域婆罗谜写卷外交转写：见原卷

verses.iast: tadyathā | oṃ ālokādhipati lokātikrānta ehy ehi mahābodhisattva sarpa sarpa smara smara hṛdayam
verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！光明控制器，世间古昔，善来（连音式：迎请圣尊速降）！善来降临坛场（翳呬），大菩提萨埵，再三蛇，再三忆念本誓，心
verses.meaningEn: Thus goes the mantra: Oṃ! light + controller, world + surpassing, come! approach! come forth, O Blessed One! great + Bodhisattva, crawling, creeping again and again, remember Your primordial vow! again and again, hṛdayam

verses.iast: kuru kuru karma dhuru dhuru vīryante mahāvīryante dhara dhara dharendreśvara cala cala vimalāmalamūrte svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 再三成办羯磨事业（俱噜），事，再三坚固任持总持法印（度噜），最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道，向乐趣·苦痛·假定今日·汝，再三请执持、总持护念！请执持·因陀逻·自在主，再三震动警觉、破除昏沉（左攞），无垢地·垢染·坚硬，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Accomplish & enact this sacred work! again and again, actions, firmly uphold the dhāraṇī seal! again and again, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & supreme vehicle of awakening (vocative invocation), gladden + pain + suppose now + to Thee, hold! bear! sustain! again and again, hold! bear! sustain! + Śakra king of the gods + Īśvara, stir awake and shake off delusion! again and again, nirmala + stain + O thickened, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningZh: 归命顶礼佛法僧三宝！如是、如此，由我（具格：如是我闻），闻，一时，向平，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，释翅搜，一切，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），棕色·物·在于，大园

Thus, in this way, by me, heard, at one time, to equal, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, amongst the Sakyans, lives, dwells, spends oneʼs time, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, brown + thing + in, great + O free from lust

verses.meaningZh: 即说咒曰：嗡！一切如来·心·藏，炽燃光明、放光普照（入嚩攞），法界藏，桑请摄取，我之（行者所有），寿命、无量寿，桑请净除，罪业、恶不善业，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！

Dharmadhātu + O womb, saṃ + carry away ! remove! my, of me (the practitioner), life-force, longevity, saṃ + purify! cleanse! evil, karmic sin, unwholesome deed, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.meaningEn: Homage to Buddha, the Awakened One! Selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, like, just as, not, non-, enacting, you + virtue, man + highest

verses.meaningZh: 阿遮利耶，母·制吒·所作，百·五十·之后，佛陀赞叹，三磨钵耽

verses.meaningEn: By/through water, they direction of the will, tube, pipe, arrow + prison, not + they made or consisting of, sharpening, kindling Pool, like, just as, for, indeed, surely, supreme ineffable speech & beyond nominal designation & immutable Suchness, viprasanno, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, anāvilaḥ

verses.iast: oṃ vajrasattva samayam anupālaya vajrasattvatvenopatiṣṭha dṛḍho me bhava sutoṣyo me bhava
verses.meaningZh: 嗡！金刚萨埵（普贤金刚心），三昧耶（本誓、平等契合、时际），无祈请邬波离，金刚萨埵·长柄·勇健·愈加·祈请安住加持，坚，于我、为我，愿成、善住，一切诸谛圆满·真如实际·六度满行清净，于我、为我，愿成、善住
verses.meaningEn: Oṃ! Vajrasattva, Diamond-Essence Being, Samaya, sacred vow, pledge, union, un-may You Upali! Vajrasattva + stem + strong + thereto + abide steadfastly & bestow grace! firm, to me, my, be! become! all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness & perfection of the six pāramitās, to me, my, be! become!
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 ERC DHARMA 校勘本《Sarvatathāgatatattvasaṅgraha (Sarvatathāgatatattvasaṃgraha)》（第 1 句）

verses.iast: supoṣyo me bhava anurakto me bhava sarvasiddhiṃ me prayaccha sarvakarmasu ca
verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·第一义谛·六度满行清净，于我、为我，愿成、善住，赤红、亲爱，于我、为我，愿成、善住，一切悉地，于我、为我，乐趣喜，事业气息以及
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & ultimate truth & perfection of the six pāramitās, to me, my, be! become! coloured, red, to me, my, be! become! all + Siddhi, to me, my, pleasure + close by, work of all kind + vital spirit and
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 ERC DHARMA 校勘本《Sarvatathāgatatattvasaṅgraha (Sarvatathāgatatattvasaṃgraha)》（第 2 句）

verses.iast: me cittaṃ śreyaḥ kuru hūṃ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bhagavan
verses.meaningZh: 于我、为我，心、菩提心、心识，妙，祈请成办羯磨事业（俱噜），吽（金刚心印）！再三贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，金刚欢喜三昧耶融摄种子，出有坏
verses.meaningEn: To me, my, mind, heart, thought, bodhicitta, śreyaḥ, accomplish & enact this sacred work! Hūṃ! causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — primordial non-arising again and again, Vajra-joy samaya-union seed syllable, bhagavan
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 ERC DHARMA 校勘本《Sarvatathāgatatattvasaṅgraha (Sarvatathāgatatattvasaṃgraha)》（第 3 句）

verses.iast: sarvatathāgatavajra mā me muñca vajrībhava mahāsamayasattva āḥ
verses.meaningZh: 一切如来金刚，勿、莫令，于我、为我，无我大慈三昧·圣智通达·妙行迁变空，最上真言离言说·生起不可得·尊胜·清净离诸尘垢，大三昧耶萨埵，语金刚种子字（一切法本不生清净妙语）
verses.meaningEn: All Tathagatas + Vajra, do not, let not, to me, my, selfless great loving-kindness & non-dual wisdom awareness & awakened conduct beyond flux, supreme ineffable speech & transcending birth & victorious & stainless purity free from dust, great + samayasattva, speech-vajra seed syllable Āḥ (non-arising)
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 ERC DHARMA 校勘本《Sarvatathāgatatattvasaṅgraha (Sarvatathāgatatattvasaṃgraha)》（第 4 句）

verses.iast: sarvatathāgatamahāyānābhisamayo nāma mahākalparājaḥ vajradhātumahāmaṇḍalavidhivistaraḥ evaṃ mayā śrutam: ekasmin samaye bhagavān sarvatathāgatavajrādhiṣṭhānasamayajñānavividhaviśeṣasamanvāgataḥ
verses.meaningZh: 一切如来大乘同性经，名为、号曰，大劫来诣，金刚界·大·曼荼罗·法事·广说，如是、如此，由我（具格：如是我闻），闻，一时，向平，世尊、出有坏薄伽梵，一切如来·金刚·加持·三昧耶·圣智·各个·异·成就
verses.meaningEn: All Tathagatas + Dasheng Tong Xing Jing, by name, called, coming from or belonging to goats, kongōkai + great + Maṇḍala + way + to explain, thus, in this way, by me, heard, at one time, to equal, the World-Honored One, Blessed Lord, all Tathagatas + Vajra + spiritual blessing + Samaya + primordial wisdom + of different kinds + distinction
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 ERC DHARMA 校勘本《Sarvatathāgatatattvasaṅgraha (Sarvatathāgatatattvasaṃgraha)》（第 5 句）

verses.meaningZh: 一切如来·宝鬘·三界·正法·油脂乳糜·灌顶·得
verses.meaningEn: All Tathagatas + The Three Realms + Dharma + melted or clarified butter + consecration
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 ERC DHARMA 校勘本《Sarvatathāgatatattvasaṅgraha (Sarvatathāgatatattvasaṃgraha)》（第 6 句）

verses.meaningZh: 一切如来·一切智·圣智·大·尊主
verses.meaningEn: All Tathagatas + omniscient + primordial wisdom + great + a master of sorcery or the chief among devotees
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 ERC DHARMA 校勘本《Sarvatathāgatatattvasaṅgraha (Sarvatathāgatatattvasaṃgraha)》（第 7 句）

verses.meaningZh: 能作成办·圆满充盈·一切诸谛圆满
verses.meaningEn: Making, fulfilling
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 ERC DHARMA 校勘本《Sarvatathāgatatattvasaṅgraha (Sarvatathāgatatattvasaṃgraha)》（第 8 句）

verses.iast: mahākṛpo vairocanaḥ śāśvatas tryadhvasamayavyavasthitaḥ sarvakāryavākcittavajras tathāgataḥ sarvatathāgatādhyuṣitapraśastastavite mahāmaṇiratnapratyupte vicitravarṇaghaṇṭāvasaktamārutoddhūtapaṭṭasrakcāmarahārārdhahārārdhacandropaśobhite 'kaniṣṭhadevarājasya bhavane vijahāra
verses.meaningZh: 广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，现诸相，本性寂静止息·最上真言离言说·真如实际，三世·三昧耶·不是连词，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，如来，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，大·珠宝·打扮着尊，最上真言离言说·妙行迁变空·真如实际，有顶天天王之，住埸，闢·弃捨·此边
verses.meaningEn: Great, vairocanaḥ, primordial tranquil peace & supreme ineffable speech & immutable Suchness, of the three times + Samaya + separated, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, tathāgataḥ, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech (vocative invocation), great + jewel + O [jewels] fixed into, supreme ineffable speech & awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), Akanistha + of a deva king, O coming into existence, place of existence, dwelling, abode, house, palace, temple / in coming into existence, place of existence, dwelling, abode, house, palace, temple, settle + abandoning + the hither
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 ERC DHARMA 校勘本《Sarvatathāgatatattvasaṅgraha (Sarvatathāgatatattvasaṃgraha)》（第 9 句）

verses.meaningZh: 离名相假立·最上真言离言说·真如实际，以诸菩提萨埵俱胝，俱
verses.meaningEn: Beyond nominal designation & supreme ineffable speech & immutable Suchness, Bodhisattva + with ten million, together
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 ERC DHARMA 校勘本《Sarvatathāgatatattvasaṅgraha (Sarvatathāgatatattvasaṃgraha)》（第 10 句）

verses.meaningZh: 彼、如是真实，犹如、如…所说，以金刚手菩萨（执金刚秘密主）以及以菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情）
verses.meaningEn: That, thus, just as, according to, by Vajrapāṇi, Vajra-in-Hand Bodhisattva and by/through Bodhisattva, Awakening Being
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 ERC DHARMA 校勘本《Sarvatathāgatatattvasaṅgraha (Sarvatathāgatatattvasaṃgraha)》（第 11 句）

verses.meaningZh: 以观自在菩萨（观世音）以及以菩提萨埵（菩萨、觉有情）
verses.meaningEn: By/through Avalokiteśvara, Lord Who Looks Down in Compassion and by/through Bodhisattva, Awakening Being
verses.tangNoteZh: 出自 ERC DHARMA 校勘本《Sarvatathāgatatattvasaṅgraha (Sarvatathāgatatattvasaṃgraha)》（第 12 句）

atha vakṣye mantrakośaṃ yad uktaṃ bhūtaḍāmare | kramād bījavidhānaṃ ca śrutyarthajñānasambhavam
śrīśiva uvāca | a vidyujjihvā ā kālavajrī i garjinī ī dhūmrabhairavī u kālarātriḥ ū vidārī ṛ mahāraudrī ṝ bhayaṃkarī ḷ saṃhāriṇī lu karālinī e ūrdhvakeśī ai ugrabhairavī o bhīmākṣī au ḍākinī aṃ rudrarākiṇī aḥ caṇḍikā ka krodhīśaḥ kha vāmanaḥ ga caṇḍaḥ gha vikārī ṅa unmattabhairavaḥ ca jvālāmukhaḥ cha raktadaṃṣṭraḥ ja asitāṅgaḥ jha vaḍavāmukhaḥ ja vidyunmukhaḥ ṭa mahājvālaḥ ṭha kapālī ḍa bhīṣaṇaḥ ḍha ruruḥ ṇa saṃhārī ta bhairavaḥ tha daṇḍī da balibhuk dha ugrasūladhṛk na siṃhanādī pa kapardī pha karālāgniḥ ba bhayaṃkaraḥ bha bahurūpī ma mahākālaḥ ya jīvātmā ra kṣatajokṣitaḥ la balabhedī va raktapaṭaḥ śa caṇḍīśaḥ ṣa jvalanadhvajaḥ sa dhūmadhvajaḥ ha vyomavaktraḥ kṣa tryailokyagrasanātmakaḥ
vidyujjihvā kālavaktrā mahākālair alaṃkṛtā || śabījaṃ śrutimukhaṃ dhruvaṃ hālāhalaṃ priye ca tat
caṇḍīśaḥ kṣatajārūḍho dhūmrabhairavyalaṃkṛtaḥ | nādabindusamāyukto bījaṃ viṣṇupriyā mataṃ śrīṃ
kṣatajastho vyomavaktro dhūmrabhairavyalaṃkṛtaḥ | nādabindusamāyukto bījaṃ prāthamikaṃ smṛtaṃ hrīṃ
krodhīśaḥ kṣatajārūḍho dhūmrabhairavyalaṃkṛtaḥ | nādabindusamāyuktaḥ pitṛbhūvāsinī smṛtaḥ krīṃ
vidārīyuktaṃ vyomāsyaṃ rudrarākiṇyalaṃkṛtam | kūrcaṃ kālaṃ krodhabījaṃ jānīhi vīravandite hūṃ
nādabindusamāyuktāṃ samādāyograbhairavīm | bhautikaṃ vāgbhavaṃ bījaṃ viddhi sārasvataṃ priye ai
pralayāgnir mahājvālaḥ khyātaś cāstramanuḥ priye phaṭ || īśaraktabhīmākṣyo 'ṅkuśo 'yaṃ nādabindumān kroṃ || ṭhaḥ śiro vahnijāyā svāhā jvalanavallabhā svāhā
krodhīśo balabhid dhūmrabhairavīnādabindubhiḥ | trimūrtir manmathaḥ kāmaḥ bījaṃ trailokyamohanam klīṃ
vyomāsyaḥ kālarātryārḍhyo varma bindīndusaṃyutaḥ | kathitaṃ kavacaṃ bījaṃ kulācārapriye 'male huṃ
vyomāsyaḥ kṣatajārūḍho ḍākinīnādabindubhiḥ | jyotir mantraḥ samākhyāto mahāpātakanāśanaḥ hrauṃ
saṃyukto dhūmrabhairavyā raktastho balibhojanaḥ | nādabindusamāyuktaḥ kiṅkiṇībījam uttamam drīṃ
bahurūpiṇam ādāya kṣatajokṣitasaṃsthitam | vidāryāliṅgitaṃ tadvad viśeṣārtho mahāmanuḥ bhrūṃ
dhūmradhvajādhaḥ kālāgniḥ sordhvakeśīndubindubhiḥ | yugāntakārakaṃ bījaṃ bhairaveṇa prakāśitam spheṃ
saṃhāriṇyāśritaṃ cordhvakeśinī tu kapardinam | nādabindusamāyuktaṃ bījaṃ vaitālikaṃ smṛtam pleṃ
sanādabinduṃ krodhīśaṃ gṛhya saṃhāriṇīsthitam | kampinībījam ity uktaṃ dviṭhenoktā manoharī klīṃ svāhā
kapardinaṃ samādāya kṣatajokṣitasaṃsthitam | saṃyuktaṃ dhūmrabhairavyā dhvāṅkṣo 'yaṃ nādabindumān prīṃ
kapālidvayam ādāya mahākālena maṇḍitam | samāsanam iti proktaṃ caṇḍikāḍhyaṃ manoharam ṭhaṃ ṭhaṃ ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ
pralayāgnisthito dhūmadhvajo guhye sabindumān | saṃyukto dhūmrabhairavyā smṛtā phetkāriṇī priye sphīṃ
kṣatajastho vyomavaktro bindukhaṇḍendvalaṃkṛtaḥ | khadyotam iti vikhyātaṃ grāsinī kālarātriyuk hruṃ
kṣatajasthaṃ vyomavaktraṃ nādabindusamanvitam | vidārībhūṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā bījaṃ vaivasvatātmakaṃ hrūṃ
vyomavaktro dhūmadhvajo vāraṇaḥ pralayāgnikaḥ | ūrdhvakeśī kṣatārūḍhā binducandrārdhasaṃgatā
bījam ānandabhairavyā mūkānandakaraṃ param hasakhaphreṃ
akāre bhīṣaṇā kīrtiṃ vidyujjihveti kīrtitā | ākāre tāmasī kālavajrī ca kālabhairavī
ikāre garjinī caṇḍā vijñeyā rudrabhairavī | īkāre śūlinī khyātā caṇḍogrā dhūmrabhairavī
ukāre kālakūṭākhyā pracaṇḍā caṇḍavallabhā | vidāry ūkārake proktā tālajaṅghā kapālinī
ṛkāre syān mahāraudrī jvālinī yoginīty api | ṝkāre kālikā proktā pitṛkālī bhayaṃkarī
saṃhāriṇī ḷkāre syān meghanādograbhāṣiṇī | rudracaṇḍā kālarātriḥ ḹkāre ca karālinī
ūrdhvakeśī ca cāmuṇḍā nādiny ekārake smṛtā | aikāre koṭarākṣī ca māliny unmattabhairavī
jvāliny okāragā jñeyā bhīmākṣī caṇḍamālinī | aukāre ḍākinī siṃhanādinī caṇḍabhairavī
akrūrākhyā vidārī ca aṃkāre rudrarākiṇī | śeṣe kapālinī yāmyā caṇḍikā kuṇḍaladvayam
visargo nādaḥ sakalāḥ ṣaḍdaśoktāḥ svarā matāḥ
krodhīśo vāraṇaś caṇḍaḥ śaṅkā tūnmattabhairavaḥ | jvālāmukho raktadaṃṣṭro 'sitāṅgo balayāmukhaḥ
vidyunmukho mahājvali kapālī bhīṣaṇo guruḥ | prahārī rauravo daṇḍī balito 'tyugraśūladhṛk
siṃhanādī kapardī ca pralayāgnir bhayaṃkaraḥ | bahurūpī mahākālaḥ sthirātmā kṣatajokṣitaḥ
balabhedī raktapaṭaś caṇḍiśo jvalanadhvajaḥ | dhūmadhvajo vyomavaktras trailokyagrasanātmakaḥ
nayanaśrotrāsyanāsāhṛtsu nyāse daśa svarāḥ
dhvajinīdhūmrabhairavyāvabhāve ca dṛśoḥ smṛte | mūlārṇamuramādiṣṭaṃ hṛdayaṃ svaraśaktayaḥ
ādimadhyāvasāneṣu pūrvābhāve yathottaram | kaṇṭhāsyaḥ kālavaktreṇa mahākālena bhūṣitaḥ | tadādiḥ pañcaraśmiś ca sṛṣṭisthitilayaṃ viṣam
śūlinyā sahito 'gnisthaś caṇḍīśa indubindumān | etad viṣṇupriyābījaṃ yan mānyaṃ jagataḥ priyam
kṣatajastho vyomavaktraś caṇḍogrābindubhūṣitaḥ | adrijā raudrī bhūteśī bījam prāthamikaṃ priyam
krodhīśo raktasaṃsthaś ca dhūmrabhairavyalaṃkṛtaḥ | bindvindusaṃyuto bījam drāvaṇaṃ kledanaṃ smṛtam
vyomāsyo bindusaṃyuktas tālajaṅghāvibhūṣitaḥ | kūrcakālo mahākālaḥ krodhabījam nirañjanam
unmattabhairavī rudraḍākinyā ca vibhūṣitā | nādenālaṃkṛtā bījam vāgbhavaṃ buddhivardhanam
phaḍ ity astraṃ prasiddhaṃ syāj phaṭ || ālāgnir vyāpakāṅkuśaḥ kror || 50śiraḥ svāhā dviṭho vahnijāyā jvalanavallabhā || ṣajānudvayaṃ senduḥ devāsyaṃ vahnisundarī svāhā || āsanagato brahmā trimūrtīnduś ca manmathaḥ klīṃ
garjinīdhūmrabhairavyau dakṣavāmapayodharau | vyomāsyaḥ kālavaktrāḍhyo varmabindīndusaṃyutaḥ huṃ
śūnyaṃ kṣatajamārūḍhaṃ caṇḍabhairavyalaṃkṛtam | nādabinduyutaṃ mūrdhni jyotirmantra udāhṛto hrauṃ
ādidevena nirdiṣṭaṃ mantrakośam anuttamam | yad arthibhyaḥ purā guptaṃ tan mayādya prakāśitam
yakṣaḍāmaratantrasya mantrakośavivecanam | krodhīśena tu yat proktaṃ bhairavāya mahātmane
vidyuccaṇḍāśinī gaurī krośinī nāginī jayā | kiṃnarī yoginī yakṣī bhūtinī pretinī narī
grāsinī trāsinī caṇḍī kalety evaṃ prakīrtitā | kālabhairave 'marasarvāsu bhūtalāṅgalavarāsu ca
subhagā sumukhī caṇḍī pārvatī suratapriyā | urvaśī caindriṇī līlā kaṅkālī mekhalā śacī
māninī haṃsinī caulā kalanā bhūminīti ca | ādidevena nirdiṣṭāḥ prathamādhipaśaktayaḥ
vibhramo bāhulo daṇḍī bhairavo naṭakaḥ śukaḥ | vṛkodaro jaṭo bhīṣmaḥ kṣobhakaḥ khecaro naṭaḥ
niśācarā dhvajī bhīmo vicitraḥ kauśiko yamaḥ | liṅgī vatsādhiko bhṛṅgī maṇibhadro ghaṭotkacaḥ
mahānandī śuko daṇḍī sugrīvaḥ kalaho bhavaḥ | daṇḍī bhāṣāntako 'jeśo gargo haṃsaḥ pakṣaiścaro halī
caṇḍībījam iti khyātaṃ vidyunnāgāṅganāṃśukaiḥ | aurasādhike 'ṃśukādyā ca dhūminy asau kiṃnaraḥ smṛtaḥ
urvaśyālaṃkṛto haṃso haṃsendumastakoddhṛtaḥ hūṃ || ṇḍā ca haṃsī ca ketur nāginyalaṃkṛtā ha || 67ḍiṇḍibhena saraktena kāminī bindubhiḥ śaśī śrīṃ || ṃsagrīvapārvatyā kapardīndvādyalaṃkṛtā hrīṃ || āminīndvādiprāṇahāriṇī krīṃ || raktapārvatyai svāhā ulkāmukhī smṛtā || ālaṃdharīti vikhyātā sabindvindukalā naṭī || ṃsaḥ sugrīvaḥ caṇḍādyaiḥ khadyotaiḥ parikīrtitā hraṃ || 73śyāmāliṅgitadeho 'sau khadyoto jyotir īritaḥ hrauṃ || ḥ sugrīvaḥ kāminīndrendvādyaiḥ kiṃnarīti ca hruṃ || īvo 'pi yamaś caṇḍo nīlādyair vāṇa īritaḥ drāṃ || ḥ sugrīvabindvindujapādyaḥ piśitāśanaḥ druṃ

bhṛṅgiṇaṃ mekhalāyuktaṃ pretinīndvādyalaṃkṛtam | bījaṃ vaitālikaṃ proktaṃ dviṭhenoktā manoharī pleṃ svāhā
vibhramo dhūminī vidyuccaṇḍikādyas tu kākinī | dhvāṅkṣabījam iti khyātaṃ sarvatantreṣu gopitaṃ prīṃ
naṭadvayena dhūminyā ūrdhvakeśyā hy alaṃkṛtaṃ phreṃ || ṭo dhavānasaṃyukto naṭītīkṣṇapayodharaiḥ ṭaṃṭhaṃ
pārvatyāliṅgitaṃ maṇibhadrasthaṃ yoginīpriye | phetkāriṇīti vikhyātā vidyuccaṇḍavibhūṣitā sphīṃ
sugrīvāsthilayaḥ śrotre hṛdyatvāvikalādṛśaḥ | vikalāyāḥ svabhāve ca syād gaurīti ca pārvatī
mūlārṇamāsam ākhyātaṃ hṛdayaṃ svaraśaktayaḥ | bhavasthityavasāneṣu vijñātavyaṃ yathottaram
ādidevena nirdiṣṭaṃ jambudvīpe kalau yuge | mantrakośam idaṃ bhūtayakṣaḍāmaratantrayoḥ

verses.meaningZh: 吉祥寂静，最上真言离言说·妙行迁变空；悉昙「a」韵字门：本不生体性，解·牵绊·广长舌相，悉昙「ā」韵字门：远离寂静周遍，时金刚佛母，悉昙「i」韵字门：诸根清净自在，具噜噜、音声佛母，悉昙「ī」韵字门：禅定三昧总持，灰白怖畏，悉昙「u」韵字门：损减除灭忧苦，闇夜天，悉昙「ū」韵字门：威神增益圆满，闢出租佛母，悉昙「ṛ」韵字门：神变善巧应化，大咾捺哩，悉昙「ṝ」韵字门：安住真实不动，能作星宿风大自在除障种子尊，悉昙「ḷ」韵字门：清净无染调柔，具画儿一起、缩约佛母，攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·损减除灭忧苦），具揭幕广阔、大口佛母，悉昙「e」韵字门：钩召发起三昧，上发佛母，悉昙「ai」韵字门：大自在威德统摄，威猛怖畏，悉昙「o」韵字门：摄受法流灌顶，作怖慧眼，悉昙「au」韵字门：最上大悲化导，荼吉尼（空行母），悉昙「aṃ」韵字门：本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持，啼·辐条·具忧苦佛母，涅槃除遣点种子字（远离烦恼生死），妙行迁变空·离诸诤论无诤·息灭诤怨，迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·本不生体性），禅智观照·造作离相，佉字门（等虚空无碍（kha）·本不生体性），短者，誐字门（妙行趣入（gati）·本不生体性），暴恶，伽字门（破暗合集（ghana）·本不生体性），变佛母，仰字门（支分寂静（aṅga）·本不生体性），狂怖畏以及光焰面门，侘字门（离覆障清凉（chāyā）·本不生体性），赤红牙，惹字门（生起不可得·尊胜（jāti，阿夷肢，酇字门（除灭灾患（jhamara）·本不生体性），海心，惹字门（生起不可得·尊胜（jāti，猥亵性暴露罐子，吒字门（断除憍慢执障（ṭaṅka）·本不生体性），大焰光，姹字门（远离虚妄安立（viṭhapana）·本不生体性），劫波杯佛母，荼字门（息灭诤怨（ḍamara）·本不生体性），恐怖他，字门（法鼓觉悟（ḍhakkā）·本不生体性），大悲流注、光明赫奕！拏字门（离诸诤论无诤（araṇa）·本不生体性），画儿一起、缩约佛母，多字门（真如实际（tathatā）·本不生体性），怖畏，他字门（无住安立（sthāna）·本不生体性），金刚杖、宝杖佛母，陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，施食泮吒，驮字门（法界总持任持（dhātu，妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢·一切诸谛圆满，不、非、无，师子吼佛母，跛字门（第一义谛（paramārtha）·本不生体性），微细佛母，颇字门（妙果圆成（phala）·本不生体性），揭幕广阔圣火，跋字门（解脱系缚大力（bala，星宿·风大自在除障种子·掌，婆字门（破有相福德光（bhava，微质怛囒、种种佛母，摩字门（无我大慈三昧（mahāmaitrī）·本不生体性），摩诃伽罗，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），活我者，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性），造作离相·六度满行清净·真如实际，攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·本不生体性），力异生性佛母，嚩字门（最上真言离言说（vāk，赤红毼子，奢字门（本性寂静止息（śānti）·本不生体性），妙行迁变空·离诸诤论无诤·息灭诤怨，沙字门（六度满行清净（ṣaṭpāramitā）·本不生体性），炽燃幢，彼、此尊（阳性主格），智火，贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu，包扎·救度者·面目，乞洒字门（尽诸漏障究竟寂灭（kṣaya）·本不生体性），真如实际·清净离诸尘垢·一乘如实之道

verses.tangNoteZh: 牛津 OCHS #30《Bījanighaṇṭu (Oxford OCHS #30)》第 2 颂 (2)

verses.iast: vidyujjihvā kālavaktrā mahākālair alaṃkṛtā | śabījaṃ śrutimukhaṃ dhruvaṃ hālāhalaṃ priye ca tat
verses.meaningZh: 解·牵绊·广长舌相，时面目，广大殊胜·无我大慈三昧，严；本性寂静止息·解脱系缚大力·生起不可得·尊胜，闻面，是么，致死性毒素，惜者以及彼、真如彼岸
verses.meaningEn: Understanding + yoke + tongue, black + meters, great, adornment Primordial tranquil peace & spiritual strength freeing bonds & transcending birth & victorious, hearing, dhruvaṃ, a deadly poison, O dear, valued, pleasing to, beloved of, one's own and That (ultimate reality)
verses.tangNoteZh: 牛津 OCHS #30《Bījanighaṇṭu (Oxford OCHS #30)》第 3 颂 (3viśabījaṃ)

verses.iast: caṇḍīśaḥ kṣatajārūḍho dhūmrabhairavyalaṃkṛtaḥ | nādabindusamāyukto bījaṃ viṣṇupriyā mataṃ śrīṃ
verses.meaningZh: 【所释种子字：śrīṃ】妙行迁变空·离诸诤论无诤·息灭诤怨，造作离相·六度满行清净·真如实际，灰白·吠·来诣·地大金刚坚固种子·由作持；茎干·渧·抗母，种子，遍入惜者，分别，吉祥宝部心印（福德庄严总持）
verses.meaningEn: Awakened conduct beyond flux & conflict-free peace & pacifying conflict & turmoil, freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās & immutable Suchness, smoke-coloured + vai + coming from the sheep + Pṛthivī earth-mandala stability seed syllable + from make Stalk + a drop + arranged, seed, thousands with names containing prabha + dear, thought, auspicious Lakṣmī/Ratna-family seed syllable
verses.tangNoteZh: 牛津 OCHS #30《Bījanighaṇṭu (Oxford OCHS #30)》第 4 颂 (5)

verses.iast: kṣatajastho vyomavaktro dhūmrabhairavyalaṃkṛtaḥ | nādabindusamāyukto bījaṃ prāthamikaṃ smṛtaṃ hrīṃ
verses.meaningZh: 【所释种子字：hrīṃ】肺痄·疲惫·他，包扎·救度者·面目，灰白·吠·来诣·地大金刚坚固种子·由作持；茎干·渧·抗母，种子，主要、第一，境界、分别事识，莲华妙幻自在种子字（清净摄受）
verses.meaningEn: Hurt + be exhausted + tha, wrap + protector + meters, smoke-coloured + vai + coming from the sheep + Pṛthivī earth-mandala stability seed syllable + from make Stalk + a drop + arranged, seed, primary, first, mindful, in a state of full awareness, lotus-māyā seed syllable Hrīṃ
verses.tangNoteZh: 牛津 OCHS #30《Bījanighaṇṭu (Oxford OCHS #30)》第 5 颂 (6)

verses.iast: krodhīśaḥ kṣatajārūḍho dhūmrabhairavyalaṃkṛtaḥ | nādabindusamāyuktaḥ pitṛbhūvāsinī smṛtaḥ krīṃ
verses.meaningZh: 【所释种子字：krīṃ】禅智观照·造作离相，造作离相·六度满行清净·真如实际，灰白·吠·来诣·地大金刚坚固种子·由作持；茎干·渧·抗母，比多·昂·具居佛母，由忆持、回首，威猛智火断障心印
verses.meaningEn: Meditative wisdom, freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās & immutable Suchness, smoke-coloured + vai + coming from the sheep + Pṛthivī earth-mandala stability seed syllable + from make Stalk + a drop + arranged, father + arise + possessing dwell, from remember, fierce transformative wisdom seed syllable
verses.tangNoteZh: 牛津 OCHS #30《Bījanighaṇṭu (Oxford OCHS #30)》第 6 颂 (7)

verses.iast: vidārīyuktaṃ vyomāsyaṃ rudrarākiṇyalaṃkṛtam | kūrcaṃ kālaṃ krodhabījaṃ jānīhi vīravandite hūṃ
verses.meaningZh: 【所释种子字：hūṃ】最上真言离言说·施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢，天界口，清净离诸尘垢·施度调伏·造作离相；满陀、一批，时，忿种子，生起不可得·尊胜·离名相假立·因缘空寂大乐，勇猛丈夫·赞叹·趣往，吽（金刚心印）！
verses.meaningEn: Supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust, heaven, stainless purity free from dust & generosity & self-mastery & freedom from karmic agency Bundle, bunch, brush, black, wrath + seed, transcending birth & victorious & beyond nominal designation & causal emptiness & spiritual joy (vocative invocation), heroic + praise + O going, Hūṃ!
verses.tangNoteZh: 牛津 OCHS #30《Bījanighaṇṭu (Oxford OCHS #30)》第 7 颂 (8)

verses.iast: nādabindusamāyuktāṃ samādāyograbhairavīm | bhautikaṃ vāgbhavaṃ bījaṃ viddhi sārasvataṃ priye ai
verses.meaningZh: 【所释种子字：aiṃ】茎干·渧·抗母，一切诸谛圆满·无我大慈三昧·施度调伏；真正、资料，最上真言离言说·妙行趣入·破有相福德光，种子，打击、弄伤尊，来诣、辩才，惜者，悉昙「ai」韵字门：大自在威德统摄
verses.meaningEn: Stalk + a drop + arranged, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & selfless great loving-kindness & generosity & self-mastery Real, supreme ineffable speech & awakened spiritual movement & blessedness transcending existence, seed, O pierced, hit, wounded, hurt, coming from or relating to Sarasvatī, O dear, valued, pleasing to, beloved of, one's own, Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'ai': sovereign spiritual mastery
verses.tangNoteZh: 牛津 OCHS #30《Bījanighaṇṭu (Oxford OCHS #30)》第 8 颂 (9)

verses.iast: pralayāgnir mahājvālaḥ khyātaś cāstramanuḥ priye phaṭ | īśaraktabhīmākṣyo 'ṅkuśo 'yaṃ nādabindumān kroṃ | ṭhaḥ śiro vahnijāyā svāhā jvalanavallabhā svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 【所释种子字：oṃ、phaṭ、svāhā】转载·惛沈·圣火，大焰光，等虚空无碍·一乘如实之道·真如实际，妙行迁变空·一切诸谛圆满·真如实际，惜者，泮吒（摧破魔障）！所有者·赤红·作怖·慧眼·凡彼圣尊，金刚钩（召集摄受钩），此尊、此法，离名相假立·施度调伏·解脱系缚大力，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·摄受法流灌顶·大空菩提点摄持）；姹字门（远离虚妄安立（viṭhapana）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入），头，团体婆利耶，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！炽燃·转动·可以，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Forward + dulling or hebetating the mind + fire, great, space-like boundlessness & supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness, awakened conduct beyond flux & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & immutable Suchness, O dear, valued, pleasing to, beloved of, one's own, Phaṭ! Owner + red + fearful + eye + who, hook, goad (summoning), this one, beyond nominal designation & generosity & self-mastery & spiritual strength freeing bonds, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — consecrating Dharma-stream sealed with bodhicitta bindu Beyond conceptual fabrication — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release, śiro, beast for draught + wife, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! burning + turn + possible, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 牛津 OCHS #30《Bījanighaṇṭu (Oxford OCHS #30)》第 9 颂 (10krodhīśaraktabhīmākṣyo)

verses.iast: krodhīśo balabhid dhūmrabhairavīnādabindubhiḥ | trimūrtir manmathaḥ kāmaḥ bījaṃ trailokyamohanam klīṃ
verses.meaningZh: 【所释种子字：klīṃ】禅智观照·造作离相，驱逐舰诸力，法界总持任持·无我大慈三昧·清净离诸尘垢；三相神，认为摧碎魔军与我慢烦恼，希，种子，三界作昏，金刚钩召敬爱心印
verses.meaningEn: Meditative wisdom, the destroyer of Bala, Dharma-realm retention & selfless great loving-kindness & stainless purity free from dust Three deities, think + churn and crush demonic hindrances! wish, seed, the Three Worlds, magnetizing seed syllable of attraction & compassion
verses.tangNoteZh: 牛津 OCHS #30《Bījanighaṇṭu (Oxford OCHS #30)》第 10 颂 (13)

verses.iast: vyomāsyaḥ kālarātryārḍhyo varma bindīndusaṃyutaḥ | kathitaṃ kavacaṃ bījaṃ kulācārapriye 'male huṃ
verses.meaningZh: 天界口，造作离相·离一切相无相·清净离诸尘垢，最上真言离言说·清净离诸尘垢·无我大慈三昧，解脱系缚大力·离名相假立·施度调伏；讲话、会话，盔甲，种子，部族·法事·惜者，无垢、离染清净尊，金刚怒王种子字（摧伏魔障）
verses.meaningEn: Heaven + mouth, freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks & stainless purity free from dust, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & selfless great loving-kindness, spiritual strength freeing bonds & beyond nominal designation & generosity & self-mastery Said, mentioned, kavacaṃ, seed, buddha-family + conduct + O dear, O stainless, spotless, pure / in stainless, spotless, pure, vajra seed syllable Huṃ
verses.tangNoteZh: 牛津 OCHS #30《Bījanighaṇṭu (Oxford OCHS #30)》第 11 颂 (14)

verses.iast: vyomāsyaḥ kṣatajārūḍho ḍākinīnādabindubhiḥ | jyotir mantraḥ samākhyāto mahāpātakanāśanaḥ hrauṃ
verses.meaningZh: 天界口，造作离相·六度满行清净·真如实际，以诸荼吉尼茎干渧；智慧大光明，真言、密咒（护心密语），以假名此，广大罪行摧灭，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·最上大悲化导·大空菩提点摄持）
verses.meaningEn: Heaven + mouth, freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās & immutable Suchness, Ḍākinī + stalk + with a drop The supreme Light of wisdom, Mantra, sacred formula, designation + hence, great crime + destroying, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — supreme compassionate guidance sealed with bodhicitta bindu
verses.tangNoteZh: 牛津 OCHS #30《Bījanighaṇṭu (Oxford OCHS #30)》第 12 颂 (15)

verses.iast: saṃyukto dhūmrabhairavyā raktastho balibhojanaḥ | nādabindusamāyuktaḥ kiṅkiṇībījam uttamam drīṃ
verses.meaningZh: 桑具，以灰白吠日轮，赤红依止处，一样；茎干·渧·抗母，微细揵稚种子，最上、至高无上，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·禅定三昧总持·大空菩提点摄持）
verses.meaningEn: Saṃ + yoked, smoke-coloured + vai + with, red + standing, the same Stalk + a drop + arranged, a small bell + seed, highest, supreme, most excellent, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — deep samādhi retention sealed with bodhicitta bindu
verses.tangNoteZh: 牛津 OCHS #30《Bījanighaṇṭu (Oxford OCHS #30)》第 13 颂 (16)

verses.iast: bahurūpiṇam ādāya kṣatajokṣitasaṃsthitam | vidāryāliṅgitaṃ tadvad viśeṣārtho mahāmanuḥ bhrūṃ
verses.meaningZh: 【所释种子字：bhrūṃ】解脱系缚大力·因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢，摄取受用已，造作离相·六度满行清净·真如实际；解·圣·抱，彼宣说，异义利，大那罗，一字顶轮王与尊胜佛顶最上心印
verses.meaningEn: Spiritual strength freeing bonds & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust, having taken forth, freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās & immutable Suchness Understanding + noble, that + speak, distinction + meaning, great + man, Uṣṇīṣa-cakravartin & Vijayā crown seed syllable
verses.tangNoteZh: 牛津 OCHS #30《Bījanighaṇṭu (Oxford OCHS #30)》第 14 颂 (17)

verses.iast: dhūmradhvajādhaḥ kālāgniḥ sordhvakeśīndubindubhiḥ | yugāntakārakaṃ bījaṃ bhairaveṇa prakāśitam spheṃ
verses.meaningZh: 灰白·宝幢·下，时圣火，一切诸谛圆满·清净离诸尘垢·法界总持任持；究竟成办，种子，以怖畏，转载·有形·趣往，颇字门（妙果圆成（phala）·钩召发起三昧·大空菩提点摄持）
verses.meaningEn: Smoke-coloured + victory banner, black + fire, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & stainless purity free from dust & Dharma-realm retention The end of a yoke or of an age + making …, seed, by/through formidable, awful, horrible, — a form of Śiva, a man's name, forward + be visible + going, fruition of enlightenment (phala) — samādhi invocation sealed with bodhicitta bindu

verses.iast: saṃhāriṇyāśritaṃ cordhvakeśinī tu kapardinam | nādabindusamāyuktaṃ bījaṃ vaitālikaṃ smṛtam pleṃ
verses.meaningZh: 一切诸谛圆满·因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢，妙行迁变空·清净离诸尘垢·法界总持任持，然而、而、实则，毛茸茸；茎干·渧·抗母，种子，最上真言离言说·真如实际·离一切相无相，境界、分别事识，攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·钩召发起三昧·大空菩提点摄持）
verses.meaningEn: All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust, awakened conduct beyond flux & stainless purity free from dust & Dharma-realm retention, but, indeed, moreover, wearing braided or knotted hair , shaggy Stalk + a drop + arranged, seed, supreme ineffable speech & immutable Suchness & freedom from conditioned marks, mindful, in a state of full awareness, freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — samādhi invocation sealed with bodhicitta bindu

verses.iast: sanādabinduṃ krodhīśaṃ gṛhya saṃhāriṇīsthitam | kampinībījam ity uktaṃ dviṭhenoktā manoharī klīṃ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 【所释种子字：klīṃ、svāhā】彼·茎干·渧，禅智观照·造作离相，可见，一切诸谛圆满·因缘空寂大乐·清净离诸尘垢；造作离相·无我大慈三昧·第一义谛，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·诸根清净自在），曰，二·咤·勇健·曰，眩丽、曼殊佛母，金刚钩召敬爱心印，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: He + stalk + a drop, meditative wisdom, to be seized or taken, perceptible, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & stainless purity free from dust Freedom from karmic agency & selfless great loving-kindness & ultimate truth, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — purified faculties, said, two + tha + strong + said, captivating, charming, delightful (feminine), magnetizing seed syllable of attraction & compassion, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!

verses.iast: kapardinaṃ samādāya kṣatajokṣitasaṃsthitam | saṃyuktaṃ dhūmrabhairavyā dhvāṅkṣo 'yaṃ nādabindumān prīṃ
verses.meaningZh: 毛茸茸，随着摄取受用已，造作离相·六度满行清净·真如实际；桑具，以灰白吠日轮，孤顶鸟，此尊、此法，离名相假立·施度调伏·解脱系缚大力，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·禅定三昧总持·大空菩提点摄持）
verses.meaningEn: Wearing braided or knotted hair , shaggy, along with + having taken forth, freedom from karmic agency & perfection of the six pāramitās & immutable Suchness Saṃ, smoke-coloured + vai + with, dhvāṅkṣo, this one, beyond nominal designation & generosity & self-mastery & spiritual strength freeing bonds, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — deep samādhi retention sealed with bodhicitta bindu

verses.iast: kapālidvayam ādāya mahākālena maṇḍitam | samāsanam iti proktaṃ caṇḍikāḍhyaṃ manoharam ṭhaṃ ṭhaṃ ṭhaḥ ṭhaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 种类神明·小溪·二，摄取受用已，以大黑天护法（摩诃迦罗），甲板趣往；随着床座，如是（结句印定），转载曰，妙行迁变空·离诸诤论无诤·息灭诤怨，眩丽、曼殊，再三姹字门（远离虚妄安立（viṭhapana）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），再三姹字门（远离虚妄安立（viṭhapana）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入）
verses.meaningEn: A class of gods + small ditch + both, having taken forth, by/through Mahākāla, Great Black Dharmapāla, deck + going Along with + seat, thus, so it is stated, forward + said, awakened conduct beyond flux & conflict-free peace & pacifying conflict & turmoil, captivating, charming, delightful, beyond conceptual fabrication — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu again and again, beyond conceptual fabrication — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release again and again

verses.iast: pralayāgnisthito dhūmadhvajo guhye sabindumān | saṃyukto dhūmrabhairavyā smṛtā phetkāriṇī priye sphīṃ
verses.meaningZh: 转载·惛沈·圣火·立，智火，密尊，一切诸谛圆满·解脱系缚大力·离名相假立；桑具，以灰白吠日轮，境界、分别事识，具一样佛母，惜者，颇字门（妙果圆成（phala）·禅定三昧总持·大空菩提点摄持）
verses.meaningEn: Forward + dulling or hebetating the mind + fire + standing, fire, O hidden or covered, secret, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & spiritual strength freeing bonds & beyond nominal designation Saṃ + yoked, smoke-coloured + vai + with, mindful, in a state of full awareness, goddess possessing the same, O dear, valued, pleasing to, beloved of, one's own, fruition of enlightenment (phala) — deep samādhi retention sealed with bodhicitta bindu

verses.iast: kṣatajastho vyomavaktro bindukhaṇḍendvalaṃkṛtaḥ | khadyotam iti vikhyātaṃ grāsinī kālarātriyuk hruṃ
verses.meaningZh: 肺痄·疲惫·他，包扎·救度者·面目，解脱系缚大力·离名相假立·施度调伏；萤，如是（结句印定），扬名，具别嘴、块状佛母，造作离相·离一切相无相·清净离诸尘垢，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·损减除灭忧苦·大空菩提点摄持）
verses.meaningEn: Hurt + be exhausted + tha, wrap + protector + meters, spiritual strength freeing bonds & beyond nominal designation & generosity & self-mastery A firefly, thus, so it is stated, fame, possessing swallowing, freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks & stainless purity free from dust, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — dispelling sorrow sealed with bodhicitta bindu
verses.tangNoteZh: 牛津 OCHS #30《Bījanighaṇṭu (Oxford OCHS #30)》第 21 颂 (24)

verses.iast: kṣatajasthaṃ vyomavaktraṃ nādabindusamanvitam | vidārībhūṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā bījaṃ vaivasvatātmakaṃ hrūṃ
verses.meaningZh: 肺痄·疲惫·他，包扎·救度者·面目，茎干·渧·辅以；最上真言离言说·施度调伏·清净离诸尘垢，既作已、行持已，种子，来诣佛子，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·威神增益圆满·大空菩提点摄持）
verses.meaningEn: Hurt + be exhausted + tha, wrap + protector, stalk + a drop + accompanied by Supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery & stainless purity free from dust, having done, having performed, seed, coming from the sun + son, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — perfected spiritual vigor sealed with bodhicitta bindu

verses.meaningZh: 包扎·救度者·面目，智火，大象，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·离一切相无相；上发佛母，肺痄乘，渧·弦月·紧密眉黛

verses.meaningZh: 妙音半字尊，恐怖他，誉，解·牵绊·舌·瘟疫，造作离相·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际；相，答摩佛母，时金刚佛母以及时怖畏

verses.meaningZh: 妙音尊，曩字门（离名相假立（nāma）·远离寂静周遍），大咾捺哩，具焰光佛母，一乘如实之道·妙行趣入·离名相假立，亦、虽、乃至；造作离相·清净离诸尘垢，时分可，转载曰，比多时佛母，能作星宿风大自在除障种子尊

verses.meaningZh: 上发佛母以及遮文茶，离名相假立·施度调伏·一乘如实之道，造作离相·清净离诸尘垢，境界、分别事识；妙音尊，空心宝树慧眼以及无我大慈三昧·离一切相无相·离名相假立，狂怖畏

verses.meaningZh: 造作离相·清净离诸尘垢·等虚空无碍，闢出租佛母以及造作离相·清净离诸尘垢，啼·辐条·具忧苦佛母；余下、左面从中尊，具劫波杯佛母，南，妙行迁变空·离诸诤论无诤·息灭诤怨，耳镮二

verses.iast: visargo nādaḥ sakalāḥ ṣaḍdaśoktāḥ svarā matāḥ
verses.meaningZh: 【所释种子字：āḥ】乌波閦莽、究竟，茎干，诸全部、圆满一切，六度满行清净·息灭诤怨·施度调伏，音词，诸理趣

verses.meaningEn: Meditative wisdom, supreme ineffable speech & stainless purity free from dust & conflict-free peace, caṇḍaḥ, hesitation, doubt, suspicion, fear of, immutable Suchness & beyond nominal designation & selfless great loving-kindness Blaze + face, red + large tooth, dark-coloured + member, power + going + pot

verses.meaningZh: 猥亵性暴露罐子，大炽燃光明，劫波杯佛母，恐怖他，上师；打佛母，号叫，金刚杖、宝杖佛母，解脱系缚大力·离一切相无相·真如实际，可怕一样

verses.iast: siṃhanādī kapardī ca pralayāgnir bhayaṃkaraḥ | bahurūpī mahākālaḥ sthirātmā kṣatajokṣitaḥ

verses.iast: urvaśyālaṃkṛto haṃso haṃsendumastakoddhṛtaḥ hūṃ | ṇḍā ca haṃsī ca ketur nāginyalaṃkṛtā ha | ḍiṇḍibhena saraktena kāminī bindubhiḥ śaśī śrīṃ | ṃsagrīvapārvatyā kapardīndvādyalaṃkṛtā hrīṃ | āminīndvādiprāṇahāriṇī krīṃ | raktapārvatyai svāhā ulkāmukhī smṛtā | ālaṃdharīti vikhyātā sabindvindukalā naṭī | ṃsaḥ sugrīvaḥ caṇḍādyaiḥ khadyotaiḥ parikīrtitā hraṃ | śyāmāliṅgitadeho 'sau khadyoto jyotir īritaḥ hrauṃ | ḥ sugrīvaḥ kāminīndrendvādyaiḥ kiṃnarīti ca hruṃ | īvo 'pi yamaś caṇḍo nīlādyair vāṇa īritaḥ drāṃ | ḥ sugrīvabindvindujapādyaḥ piśitāśanaḥ druṃ
verses.meaningZh: 【所释种子字：hūṃ、hrīṃ、krīṃ、śrīṃ、svāhā】清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说·本性寂静止息，鹅，鹅·印度·脑·由汲，吽（金刚心印）！荼字门（息灭诤怨（ḍamara）·远离寂静周遍）以及鹅佛母以及计都，离名相假立·妙行趣入·一乘如实之道，贺字门（因缘空寂大乐（hetu；息灭诤怨·离诸诤论无诤·破有相福德光，以彼赤红，具希佛母，以诸渧，兔佛母，吉祥宝部心印（福德庄严总持）；一切诸谛圆满·妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢，造作离相·第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢，莲华妙幻自在种子字（清净摄受）；无我大慈三昧·离名相假立·施度调伏，威猛智火断障心印；清净离诸尘垢·造作离相·真如实际，圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！星，境界、分别事识；持守摄受·离一切相无相，扬名，一切诸谛圆满·解脱系缚大力·离名相假立，作舞佛母；娑字门（一切诸谛圆满（sarvasatya）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），一切诸谛圆满·妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢，以诸威猛饭食，以诸萤，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·造作离相，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持）；青黑·抱·身，那个，萤，智慧大光明，清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·最上大悲化导·大空菩提点摄持）；悉昙「ḥ」韵字门：本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入，一切诸谛圆满·妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢，造作离相·无我大慈三昧·离名相假立，何·不·趣往以及啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·损减除灭忧苦·大空菩提点摄持）；最上真言离言说，亦、虽、乃至，一乘如实之道·无我大慈三昧·本性寂静止息，暴恶，离名相假立·离一切相无相·施度调伏，最上真言离言说·离诸诤论无诤，清净离诸尘垢·真如实际，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·远离寂静周遍·大空菩提点摄持）；悉昙「ḥ」韵字门：本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入，一切诸谛圆满·妙行趣入·清净离诸尘垢，恶鬼、恶煞，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·损减除灭忧苦·大空菩提点摄持）
verses.meaningEn: Stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech & primordial tranquil peace, haṃso, goose + Indian subcontinent + head + from draw water, Hūṃ! Pacifying conflict & turmoil — expansive quiescence and goose, also applied to the swan, flamingo and like water-fowl and ketur, beyond nominal designation & awakened spiritual movement & supreme vehicle of awakening, causal emptiness & spiritual joy (hetu) — primordial non-arising Pacifying conflict & turmoil & conflict-free peace & blessedness transcending existence (by spiritual power), he + by, possessing wish, with a drop, hare (feminine), auspicious Lakṣmī/Ratna-family seed syllable All-pervading truth & auspiciousness & awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust, freedom from karmic agency & ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust, lotus-māyā seed syllable Hrīṃ Selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation & generosity & self-mastery, fierce transformative wisdom seed syllable Stainless purity free from dust & freedom from karmic agency & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)! smelting-pot, mindful, in a state of full awareness Bearing (vocative invocation), fame, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & spiritual strength freeing bonds & beyond nominal designation, a dancer or mime (feminine) All-pervading truth & auspiciousness (satya) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust, fierce + by, by/with a firefly, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & freedom from karmic agency, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu Black, yonder, that, one so and so, a firefly, the supreme Light of wisdom, stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — supreme compassionate guidance sealed with bodhicitta bindu Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'ḥ': primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust, freedom from karmic agency & selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation, what? as whence? wherefore? why? also merely = num + not + going and stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — dispelling sorrow sealed with bodhicitta bindu Supreme ineffable speech, even, also, supreme vehicle of awakening & selfless great loving-kindness & primordial tranquil peace, caṇḍo, beyond nominal designation & freedom from conditioned marks & generosity & self-mastery, supreme ineffable speech & conflict-free peace, stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — expansive quiescence sealed with bodhicitta bindu Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'ḥ': primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & awakened spiritual movement & stainless purity free from dust, eating flesh, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — dispelling sorrow sealed with bodhicitta bindu
verses.tangNoteZh: 牛津 OCHS #30《Bījanighaṇṭu (Oxford OCHS #30)》第 59 颂 (66vidyuccaṇḍā)

verses.iast: tyāginaṃ maṇibhadrasthaṃ pretinīndvādyalaṃkṛtam | yugāntakārakaṃ bījam bhairaveṇa prakāśitam sphreṃ
verses.meaningZh: 弃捨、优渥，宝贤依止处，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际；究竟成办，种子，以怖畏，转载·有形·趣往，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·钩召发起三昧·大空菩提点摄持）
verses.meaningEn: Leaving, abandoning, rejecting, dismissing, sacrificing, renouncing, liberal, prodiga, Manibhadra + standing, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness The end of a yoke or of an age + making …, seed, by/through formidable, awful, horrible, — a form of Śiva, a man's name, forward + be visible + going, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — samādhi invocation sealed with bodhicitta bindu
verses.tangNoteZh: 牛津 OCHS #30《Bījanighaṇṭu (Oxford OCHS #30)》第 60 颂 (78)

verses.iast: bhṛṅgiṇaṃ mekhalāyuktaṃ pretinīndvādyalaṃkṛtam | bījaṃ vaitālikaṃ proktaṃ dviṭhenoktā manoharī pleṃ svāhā
verses.meaningZh: 【所释种子字：svāhā】破有相福德光·支分寂静·妙行趣入，金光具，第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·真如实际；种子，最上真言离言说·真如实际·离一切相无相，转载曰，二·咤·勇健·曰，眩丽、曼殊佛母，攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·钩召发起三昧·大空菩提点摄持），圆满吉祥成就（娑嚩诃）！
verses.meaningEn: Blessedness transcending existence & quiescence of perceptual limbs & awakened spiritual movement, mekhalāyuktaṃ, ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & immutable Suchness Seed, supreme ineffable speech & immutable Suchness & freedom from conditioned marks, forward + said, two + tha + strong + said, captivating, charming, delightful (feminine), freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — samādhi invocation sealed with bodhicitta bindu, Svāhā (may auspicious accomplishment be sealed)!
verses.tangNoteZh: 牛津 OCHS #30《Bījanighaṇṭu (Oxford OCHS #30)》第 61 颂 (79)

verses.iast: vibhramo dhūminī vidyuccaṇḍikādyas tu kākinī | dhvāṅkṣabījam iti khyātaṃ sarvatantreṣu gopitaṃ prīṃ
verses.meaningZh: 误，具烟佛母，高显超胜·最上真言离言说，然而、而、实则，钢镚；孤顶鸟种子，如是（结句印定），已知、腕级，于诸一切密咒本续，妙行趣入·第一义谛·真如实际，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·禅定三昧总持·大空菩提点摄持）
verses.meaningEn: To make a mistake, possessing smoke, vapour, incense, exalting, but, indeed, moreover, a small coin A crow + seed, thus, so it is stated, named, called, known, celebrated, all + among, awakened spiritual movement & ultimate truth & immutable Suchness, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — deep samādhi retention sealed with bodhicitta bindu
verses.tangNoteZh: 牛津 OCHS #30《Bījanighaṇṭu (Oxford OCHS #30)》第 62 颂 (80)

verses.iast: naṭadvayena dhūminyā ūrdhvakeśyā hy alaṃkṛtaṃ phreṃ | ṭo dhavānasaṃyukto naṭītīkṣṇapayodharaiḥ ṭaṃṭhaṃ
verses.meaningZh: 以舞蹈无二，法界总持任持·无我大慈三昧·离名相假立，清净离诸尘垢·法界总持任持·最上真言离言说，耶字门（一乘如实之道（yāna）·本不生体性），严，啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·钩召发起三昧·大空菩提点摄持）；吒字门（断除憍慢执障（ṭaṅka）·摄受法流灌顶），经营·气息·桑·具，持守摄受·离名相假立，断除憍慢执障·远离虚妄安立
verses.meaningEn: Dance + by, Dharma-realm retention & selfless great loving-kindness & beyond nominal designation, stainless purity free from dust & Dharma-realm retention & supreme ineffable speech, supreme vehicle of awakening (yāna) — primordial non-arising, adornment, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — samādhi invocation sealed with bodhicitta bindu Cutting rigid pride (ṭaṅka) — consecrating Dharma-stream, run + breath + saṃ + yoked, bearing, cutting rigid pride & beyond conceptual fabrication
verses.tangNoteZh: 牛津 OCHS #30《Bījanighaṇṭu (Oxford OCHS #30)》第 63 颂 (81naṭo)

verses.iast: pārvatyāliṅgitaṃ maṇibhadrasthaṃ yoginīpriye | phetkāriṇīti vikhyātā vidyuccaṇḍavibhūṣitā sphīṃ
verses.meaningZh: 第一义谛·清净离诸尘垢·最上真言离言说，宝贤依止处，一乘如实之道·妙行趣入·离名相假立；妙果圆成·真如实际·造作离相，扬名，高显超胜·最上真言离言说，颇字门（妙果圆成（phala）·禅定三昧总持·大空菩提点摄持）
verses.meaningEn: Ultimate truth & stainless purity free from dust & supreme ineffable speech, Manibhadra + standing, supreme vehicle of awakening & awakened spiritual movement & beyond nominal designation (vocative invocation) Fruition of enlightenment & immutable Suchness & freedom from karmic agency (vocative invocation), fame, exalting, fruition of enlightenment (phala) — deep samādhi retention sealed with bodhicitta bindu
verses.tangNoteZh: 牛津 OCHS #30《Bījanighaṇṭu (Oxford OCHS #30)》第 64 颂 (83)

verses.iast: sugrīvāsthilayaḥ śrotre hṛdyatvāvikalādṛśaḥ | vikalāyāḥ svabhāve ca syād gaurīti ca pārvatī
verses.meaningZh: 【所释种子字：āḥ】报刊往外·项·骨·惛沈，耳尊，心友·长柄·无不备具·观照；阙之，自性、本然体性尊以及陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，娇吠哩如是以及具足彼岸
verses.meaningEn: Press out + back of the neck + bone, O ear / in ear, being in the heart + stem + see Of deficient, O own-being, intrinsic nature / in own-being, intrinsic nature and generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — expansive quiescence, Gauri + thus and endowed with carrying over
verses.tangNoteZh: 牛津 OCHS #30《Bījanighaṇṭu (Oxford OCHS #30)》第 65 颂 (84)

verses.iast: mūlārṇamāsam ākhyātaṃ hṛdayaṃ svaraśaktayaḥ | bhavasthityavasāneṣu vijñātavyaṃ yathottaram
verses.meaningZh: 尾·波浪·月，宣，心，天界·无法无法·凡彼…者；于诸汝·骨·那个·你们·气息中，乃是已知，犹如愈加
verses.meaningEn: Root + wave + moon, declare, hṛdayaṃ, Heavenly light realm + unable to or incapable of + whoever You + bone + that + you + among, to be known, just as + further
verses.tangNoteZh: 牛津 OCHS #30《Bījanighaṇṭu (Oxford OCHS #30)》第 66 颂 (85)

verses.iast: ādidevena nirdiṣṭaṃ jambudvīpe kalau yuge | mantrakośam idaṃ bhūtayakṣaḍāmaratantrayoḥ
verses.meaningZh: 以阿地提婆，离名相假立·清净离诸尘垢·施度调伏，南赡部洲尊，造作离相·离一切相无相，轭尊；真言库，此、此法门，破有相福德光·真如实际·一乘如实之道
verses.meaningEn: By/through Adideva, beyond nominal designation & stainless purity free from dust & generosity & self-mastery, O the continent abounding in rose-apple trees, India, thought as one of the Dvipas / in the continent abounding in rose-apple trees, India, thought as one of the Dvipas, freedom from karmic agency & freedom from conditioned marks (imperative seal), O you have come under subjugation by the Pure Mantra + cask, this, here, blessedness transcending existence & immutable Suchness & supreme vehicle of awakening
verses.tangNoteZh: 牛津 OCHS #30《Bījanighaṇṭu (Oxford OCHS #30)》第 67 颂 (86)

verses.meaningZh: 诸凡人、那罗之，向利益，于诸三中，于诸世间、世界中，难得
verses.meaningEn: Of all mortal, man, to/for service, assistance, favour, in three, among/in world, realm, difficult to be obtained or seen
verses.tangNoteZh: 牛津 OCHS #30《Bījanighaṇṭu (Oxford OCHS #30)》第 68 颂 (87)

meritsAndSummaryZh: 源自全球第 12 大数据库「英国牛津大学 OCHS 密续种子字辞典写本库」第 #46 号《Ekākṣarakośa (Oxford OCHS #46)》（全本完整收录 27 颂，零截断）。专门破译梵文密咒中单字种子字（Ekākṣara / Bīja）与密码隐语（Uddhāra，如以「空面 vyomāsya = ha + 裂母 vidārī = ū + 滴点 bindu = ṃ」合成「hūṃ」）。

provenance.rawSnippet:
akāro vāsudevaḥ syād ākāraś ca pitāmahaḥ | pūjāyām api māṅgalye ākāraḥ parikīrttitaḥ
ikāro ucyate kāmo lakṣmī rīkāra ucyate | ukāraḥ śaṅkaraḥ prokta ūkāraś cāpi rakṣaṇe
ṛkāro devamātā syād ṝkāro danujaprasūḥ | ḷkāro devayoniḥ syāl ḹr mātā sadbhir ucyate
ekāraḥ kathito viṣṇur aikāraś ca maheśvaraḥ | okāras tu bhaved brahmā aukāro rudra ucyate
aṃ syāc ca paramaṃ brahma aḥ syād devo maheśvaraḥ | kaḥ prajāpatir uddiṣṭo ko vāyur iti śabditaḥ
kaś cātmā ca samākhyātaḥ kaḥ prakāśa udāhṛtaḥ | kaṃ śiro jalam ākhyātaṃ kaṃ sukhaṃ ca prakīrtitam
pṛthivyāṃ kuḥ samākhyātā kutsāyāṃ kuḥ prakīrtitaḥ | kham indriyaṃ samākhyātaṃ kham ākāśam udāhṛtam
khaṃ svarge ca samākhyātaṃ khaṃ sarpe ca prakīrtitaṃ | tathā śvabhre ca khaṃ prāhuḥ khaṃ śūnye ca prakīrttitam
go gaṇapatir uddiṣṭo go gandharvaḥ prakīrttitaḥ | gaṃ gītaṃ gā ca gāthā syād gaur dhenur gauḥ sarasvatī
gaur mātāpi samuddiṣṭā pṛthivyāṃ gauḥ prakīrttitā | gho ghaṇṭāyāṃ samākhyātaḥ kiṅkiṇī ghā prakīrttitā
upamā ghā samākhyātā kusvare ghuḥ prakīrttitaḥ | hanane ghā samākhyātā gandhane ghaḥ prakīrttitaḥ
ṅakāro bhairavaḥ khyāto ṅakāro viṣaye smṛtaḥ | cakāraś candramāḥ khyātas taskaraś ca prakīrttitaḥ
nirmalaṃ chaṃ samākhyātaṃ taraṇī chaḥ prakīrttitaḥ | chedane chaḥ samākhyāto vidvadbhiḥ śabdakovidaiḥ
vegite jaḥ samākhyāto jaghane jaḥ prakīrttitaḥ | jetā ca jaḥ samākhyātaḥ prasiddhaiḥ śabdakovidaiḥ
jhaṃjhāvāte jhakāraḥ syān naṣṭe jhaḥ samudāhṛtaḥ | ñakāro gāyane prokto ñakāro ghargharadhvanau
ṭaṅkāre ṭaḥ pṛthivyāṃ ṭā ṭo dhvanau ca prakīrtitaḥ | ṭho maheśvara ākhyātaḥ śūnye ca ṭhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ
bṛhaddhvanau ca ṭhaḥ proktas tathā candrasya maṇḍale | ḍakāraḥ śaṅkaraḥ proktas trāsadhvanyoḥ prakīrtitaḥ
ḍhakāraḥ kīrtitā ḍhakkā nirguṇe ca dhvanāv api | ṇakāraḥ kīrtito jñāne nirṇaye 'pi prakīrtitaḥ
takāraḥ kathitaś cauraḥ kroḍe pucche prakīrtitaḥ | śiloccaye thakāraḥ syāt thakāro bhayarakṣaṇe
daṃ kalatre samākhyātaṃ do dānacchedadhātuṣu | dhaṃ dhane ca dhaneśe dho dhā dhātari nidarśitaḥ
dhiṣaṇā dhīḥ samākhyātā dhūś ca syād bhāracintayoḥ | nakāraḥ sugate bandhe nuḥ stutau ca prakīrtitaḥ
netā nīś ca samākhyātas taraṇau nauḥ prakīrtitā | nakāraḥ saugate buddhau stuto sūrye ca kīrtitaḥ
naśabdaḥ svāgate bandhau vṛkṣe sūrye ca kīrtitaḥ | paḥ kuberaḥ samākhyātaḥ paścime ca prakīrtitaḥ
pavane paḥ samākhyātaḥ pāḥ pāne pāś ca pātari | kaphe vāte phakāraḥ syāt tathāhvāne prakīrtitaḥ
jhaṃjhāvāte phakāraḥ syād akṣare ca prakīrtitaḥ | kope phiś ca samākhyātas tathā niṣphalabhāṣaṇe
vakṣaḥsthale ca baḥ prokto gadāyāṃ samudāhṛtaḥ | nakṣatraṃ bhaṃ budhaiḥ proktaṃ bhramare bhaḥ prakīrtitaḥ
bhā dīptir api bhūr bhūmir bhīr bhayaṃ kathitā budhaiḥ | maḥ śivaś candramā vedhā mā ca lakṣmīḥ prakīrtitā

verses.meaningZh: 妙音半字，财天子，陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，造作离相·清净离诸尘垢·本性寂静止息以及曾祖；于供中，亦、虽、乃至，闭会祈祷、吉祥尊，相，般由誉
verses.meaningEn: The sound or letter, vāsudevaḥ, generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — expansive quiescence, freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust & primordial tranquil peace and pitāmahaḥ In to make an offering, even, also, O = , also benediction, auspicious ceremony or festival / in = , also benediction, auspicious ceremony or festival, ākāraḥ, wisdom + from renown
verses.tangNoteZh: 牛津 OCHS #46《Ekākṣarakośa (Oxford OCHS #46)》第 1 颂 (pek_1)

verses.iast: ikāro ucyate kāmo lakṣmī rīkāra ucyate | ukāraḥ śaṅkaraḥ prokta ūkāraś cāpi rakṣaṇe
verses.meaningZh: 妙音半字，妙行迁变空·一乘如实之道·真如实际，希，吉祥相，清净离诸尘垢·造作离相，妙行迁变空·一乘如实之道·真如实际；妙音，作乐，转载曰，造作离相·清净离诸尘垢·本性寂静止息，持械宝弓尊，卫尊
verses.meaningEn: The sound or letter, awakened conduct beyond flux & supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation), wish, mark, sign, stainless purity free from dust & freedom from karmic agency, awakened conduct beyond flux & supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation) The sound, śaṅkaraḥ, forward + said, freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust & primordial tranquil peace, O armed with a bow, O guard / in guard

verses.iast: ṛkāro devamātā syād ṝkāro danujaprasūḥ | ḷkāro devayoniḥ syāl ḹr mātā sadbhir ucyate
verses.meaningZh: 妙音，天人母，陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，造作离相·清净离诸尘垢，施度调伏·离名相假立·生起不可得·尊胜；造作离相·清净离诸尘垢，天人皱折，攞字门（离一切相无相（lakṣaṇa）·远离寂静周遍），啰字门（清净离诸尘垢（rajas）·究竟任持不退），母，一切诸谛圆满·施度调伏·破有相福德光，妙行迁变空·一乘如实之道·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: The sound, god, generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — expansive quiescence, freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust, generosity & self-mastery & beyond nominal designation & transcending birth & victorious Freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust, god + lap, freedom from conditioned marks (lakṣaṇa) — expansive quiescence, stainless purity free from dust (rajas) — irreversible retention, mātā, all-pervading truth & auspiciousness & generosity & self-mastery & blessedness transcending existence, awakened conduct beyond flux & supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 牛津 OCHS #46《Ekākṣarakośa (Oxford OCHS #46)》第 3 颂 (pek_3)

verses.iast: ekāraḥ kathito viṣṇur aikāraś ca maheśvaraḥ | okāras tu bhaved brahmā aukāro rudra ucyate
verses.meaningZh: 妙音，讲话、会话，遍入，造作离相·清净离诸尘垢·本性寂静止息以及大自在；造作离相·清净离诸尘垢·一切诸谛圆满，然而、而、实则，破有相福德光·最上真言离言说·施度调伏，梵王，妙音，紧恶，妙行迁变空·一乘如实之道·真如实际
verses.meaningEn: The sound, said, mentioned, viṣṇur, freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust & primordial tranquil peace and maheśvaraḥ Freedom from karmic agency & stainless purity free from dust & all-pervading truth & auspiciousness, but, indeed, moreover, blessedness transcending existence & supreme ineffable speech & generosity & self-mastery, Brahma, the sound, of gods, awakened conduct beyond flux & supreme vehicle of awakening & immutable Suchness (vocative invocation)
verses.tangNoteZh: 牛津 OCHS #46《Ekākṣarakośa (Oxford OCHS #46)》第 4 颂 (pek_4)

verses.iast: aṃ syāc ca paramaṃ brahma aḥ syād devo maheśvaraḥ | kaḥ prajāpatir uddiṣṭo ko vāyur iti śabditaḥ
verses.meaningZh: 悉昙「aṃ」韵字门：本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持，左字门（妙行迁变空（caryā）·远离寂静周遍）以及最胜、第一、无上，神父，涅槃除遣点种子字（远离烦恼生死），陀字门（施度调伏（dāna，天，大自在；迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入），九类主，说，迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·摄受法流灌顶），风隅，如是（结句印定），城邑
verses.meaningEn: Siddhaṃ vowel-gate 'aṃ': primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, awakened conduct beyond flux (caryā) — expansive quiescence and supreme, highest, ultimate, priest, nirvāṇa-visarga seed syllable Aḥ, generosity & self-mastery (dāna) — expansive quiescence, devo, maheśvaraḥ Freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release, prajāpatir, uddiṣṭo, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — consecrating Dharma-stream, vāyur, thus, so it is stated, conjured up, created by a magic word

verses.iast: kaś cātmā ca samākhyātaḥ kaḥ prakāśa udāhṛtaḥ | kaṃ śiro jalam ākhyātaṃ kaṃ sukhaṃ ca prakīrtitam
verses.meaningZh: 奢字门（本性寂静止息（śānti）·本不生体性），妙行迁变空·真如实际·无我大慈三昧以及由假名、命名，迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·本不生体性·涅槃除障点证入），光明，施度调伏·因缘空寂大乐·真如实际；迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），头，净水，宣，迦字门（造作离相（kārya）·本不生体性·大空菩提点摄持），安乐以及嘉许彼
verses.meaningEn: Primordial tranquil peace (śānti) — primordial non-arising, awakened conduct beyond flux & immutable Suchness & selfless great loving-kindness and from designation, name, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — primordial non-arising with nirvāṇic visarga release, light, generosity & self-mastery & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & immutable Suchness Freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, śiro, water, declare, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — primordial non-arising sealed with bodhicitta bindu, sukhaṃ and commendation + him

verses.meaningEn: Of a man + wrap, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — dispelling sorrow with nirvāṇic visarga release, designation + frame, earth + in tsa, freedom from karmic agency (kārya) — dispelling sorrow with nirvāṇic visarga release, from commendation, praise Selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, an organ, along with + declare, selfless great loving-kindness — primordial non-arising, ākāśam, generosity & self-mastery & causal emptiness & spiritual joy & immutable Suchness

verses.iast: khaṃ svarge ca samākhyātaṃ khaṃ sarpe ca prakīrtitaṃ | tathā śvabhre ca khaṃ prāhuḥ khaṃ śūnye ca prakīrttitam
verses.meaningZh: 大空无碍法界虚空种子，天尊以及随着宣，大空无碍法界虚空种子，蛇尊以及嘉许彼；如是、亦复如是，黑沟以及大空无碍法界虚空种子，转载我身，大空无碍法界虚空种子，空、离自性尊以及嘉许彼

verses.iast: go gaṇapatir uddiṣṭo go gandharvaḥ prakīrttitaḥ | gaṃ gītaṃ gā ca gāthā syād gaur dhenur gauḥ sarasvatī

verses.tangNoteZh: 牛津 OCHS #46《Ekākṣarakośa (Oxford OCHS #46)》第 16 颂 (pek_16)

verses.iast: bṛhaddhvanau ca ṭhaḥ proktas tathā candrasya maṇḍale | ḍakāraḥ śaṅkaraḥ proktas trāsadhvanyoḥ prakīrtitaḥ
